title: QA Lead (Copado Robotic testing)
description:
**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
 **Amgen is seeking a QA Lead – Salesforce \& Copado Robotic Testing** 
 to lead quality engineering and testing capabilities for enterprise Salesforce platforms, including OneCRM and its integrated ecosystem. This role will be responsible for ensuring high\-quality, reliable, and compliant application releases through a combination of
 **manual, functional, integration, regression, and automated testing using Copado Robotic Testing (CRT)** 
 .
   

  

 The QA Lead will own the end\-to\-end testing strategy and execution, lead cross\-functional QA teams, and partner closely with business, product, engineering, architecture, and production support teams to ensure releases meet functional, technical, and quality expectations while supporting Amgen’s mission to serve patients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**QA \& Testing Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end QA activities for Salesforce applications and their integrated ecosystem, ensuring high\-quality releases with minimal production defects.
* Define and drive the overall test strategy, test planning, execution, defect management, and reporting across releases.
* Lead testing activities across functional, integration, system, regression, end\-to\-end, and user acceptance testing phases.
* Ensure appropriate test coverage based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and integration specifications.
* Serve as the primary QA point of contact for product, business, engineering, and technology stakeholders.


**Manual \& Functional Testing**
* Lead comprehensive manual testing of Salesforce applications, including business processes, workflows, validations, security, profiles, permission sets, and user experience.
* Design, review, and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data, and expected results.
* Ensure adequate coverage of positive, negative, boundary, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Validate complex Salesforce business processes spanning multiple objects, personas, applications, and integrations.
* Drive exploratory and risk\-based testing for business\-critical capabilities.


**Copado Robotic Testing \& Test Automation**
* Lead adoption and implementation of Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Design and maintain reusable, scalable, and maintainable automated test suites using Copado Robotic Testing.
* Identify appropriate manual regression scenarios for automation based on business criticality, repeatability, and ROI.
* Establish and continuously improve the automated regression test suite to increase coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD and release pipelines wherever applicable.
* Monitor automation execution results, investigate failures, and ensure timely maintenance of automated test scripts.
* Define standards and best practices for Copado Robotic Testing development, execution, and maintenance.


**Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**
* Lead end\-to\-end testing across Salesforce and integrated enterprise platforms, including MuleSoft APIs, Databricks, and other upstream/downstream applications.
* Validate API integrations, data transformations, interface processing, error handling, and data reconciliation.
* Coordinate testing dependencies across multiple application and technology teams.
* Ensure critical business journeys are validated across the complete application and integration landscape.


**Defect Management \& Quality Governance**
* Establish and enforce standardized defect management, triage, prioritization, and closure processes.
* Lead defect triage sessions with business, development, and product teams.
* Ensure defects are appropriately categorized based on severity, priority, business impact, and release risk.
* Track defect trends, leakage, reopen rates, and recurring quality issues.
* Drive root cause analysis for escaped production defects and implement preventive actions.
* Establish appropriate quality gates and release\-readiness criteria before production deployment.


**Test Planning \& Release Management**
* Develop comprehensive test plans and testing schedules aligned with sprint and release timelines.
* Estimate QA effort and determine appropriate testing capacity based on release scope and complexity.
* Coordinate QA activities across Agile sprints, major releases, hotfixes, patches, and production maintenance releases.
* Assess testing risks and proactively communicate potential impacts to release timelines.
* Provide clear QA sign\-off and release\-readiness recommendations based on test results, open defects, and residual risks.
* Support post\-production validation and hypercare testing following major releases.


**Quality Engineering \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive the transition from traditional testing toward a quality engineering and automation\-first approach.
* Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing through automation.
* Improve test efficiency through reusable test assets, automation, standardized processes, and optimized test data management.
* Establish QA standards, templates, metrics, and best practices across the delivery organization.
* Leverage defect and production incident trends to continuously strengthen regression coverage.
* Promote shift\-left testing, enabling early QA involvement during requirements, refinement, and solution\-design activities.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, Scrum Masters, and Production Support teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Participate in requirements and user\-story refinement to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and complete.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream application teams to coordinate integration and end\-to\-end testing.
* Act as the bridge between business and technology teams for quality\-related discussions.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, defects, dependencies, and release readiness to leadership and key stakeholders.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and mentor onshore/offshore QA and test automation teams.
* Drive appropriate allocation of QA resources based on release priorities and workload.
* Provide technical and functional guidance to manual and automation testers.
* Establish standards for test documentation, traceability, automation, and defect management.
* Drive knowledge sharing, cross\-skilling, and capability development within the QA team.
* Mentor team members on Salesforce testing, Copado Robotic Testing, quality engineering, and testing best practices.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 9–13 years of overall experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, or Quality Engineering.
* Significant experience leading QA activities for large\-scale enterprise applications and complex releases.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong experience in Salesforce functional and manual testing.
* Hands\-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, preferably including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Health Cloud.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated regression test suites.
* Experience testing Salesforce integrations, MuleSoft APIs, REST/SOAP services, and data interfaces.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks is preferred.
* Experience with end\-to\-end, integration, regression, API, and data validation testing.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies and CI/CD practices.
* Familiarity with Copado, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise delivery and ticketing platforms.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.
* Strong understanding of test automation strategy, quality gates, and release\-readiness criteria.
* Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences.
* Understanding of GxP, compliance, data privacy, and validation requirements is preferred.
* Proven experience managing distributed onshore/offshore QA teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality and customer experience.
* Ability to prioritize multiple testing activities and deliver effectively under tight release timelines.
* Strong ownership and accountability for application quality.
* Team\-oriented with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
* Ability and willingness to mentor QA engineers and promote testing and automation best practices.
* Ability to challenge requirements and solutions constructively from a quality and end\-user perspective.
* Adaptable to changing business priorities, project requirements, and evolving technology.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well\-being.
   

  

 Together, we live the Amgen values as we continue advancing science to serve patients.

title: Scientist IV, Documentary Standards
description:
**Description**
 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 This is a hands\-on, non\-supervisory scientific position in the Global Biologics. The incumbent is responsible for providing support for the development of USP documentary standards and reference standards for biological products such as Peptides, Oligonucleotides, Proteins, Carbohydrates, Complex Biologics, Vaccines, Antibiotics, and Advanced Therapies etc. The incumbent will provide quality and technical review of scientific documents for accuracy, clarity and compliance, manage and track reference standard stability program and organize efforts for continuous process improvements. The incumbent will also focus on supporting the reference standard suitability program, including preparing and reviewing CSU testing protocols, providing technical assistance to testing labs, reviewing analytical data and preparing summary reports for confirming the continued suitability of USP Reference Standards (RS). The incumbent needs to be excellent team player with good collaboration/liaising skills to complete assigned projects in time\-bound manner.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Scientist \-IV (Reviewer) Has The Following Responsibilities**
 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

* Performs technical and quality reviews of documents to ensure a high level of document quality and compliance before QA review
* Manages and tracks efforts for continuous process improvements.
* Develops and reviews SOP’s, Operation Manuals, and training documents.
* Assists in investigations of quality related issues resulting from customer complaints to include root cause analysis, corrective action identification, action planning, and implementation monitoring.
* Works with internal stakeholders to develop new and innovative standards for analytical analysis of biological products.
* Communicates and maintains working relationships with cross functional USP departments regarding assigned projects
* Supports day\-to\-day operations of the RS Stability (CSU) program covering the USP Biologics RS catalog inventory.
* Reviews RS testing history and drafts test protocols for CSU studies and submits to labs based on designated testing requirements and schedules.
* Liaisons and Assists laboratories to ensure CSU testing is completed as per protocol and in timely manner.
* Reviews laboratory reports, evaluates results and compares previous data and RS attributes to assess and conclude on RS suitability for use.
* Compiles, assess current and historical stability testing data and prepare stability trend reports in a time\-bound manner.
* Support the maintenance and updating various databases documenting laboratory data and program determinations on suitability and Stability interval updates.
* Filing and closure of QMS elements as per QMS system when required and supports the RS Laboratory, Supporting Quality Assurance and Reference Standard Evaluation in the investigation of unexpected stability testing results
* Works collaboratively with various USP departments as needed on test planning, data impact assessments and appropriate determination of next steps.
* Prepare, present and discuss regular work updates with Team Lead and other team members


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

**Scientist IV (Reviewer)**
* Ph.D. degree in Biochemistry/Biological Science/Pharmaceutical Science, or a related field with a minimum of 3 to 5 years of commensurate industrial experience, or Master’s degree in Biochemistry/Biological Science/Pharmaceutical Science or a related field with 8 to10 years of commensurate industrial experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Demonstrated experience in Technical review of analytical documents in Quality Assurance.
* Hands\-on experience with state\-of\-the\-art analytical techniques for the characterization of recombinant therapeutic proteins, peptides, gene therapy, vaccines and carbohydrates, such as UPLC/HPLC, LC\-MS, CD, Fluorescence spectroscopy, FTIR, DSC, SEC\-MALS, CE\-SDS (Reducing and Non\-reducing), icIEF, ELISA, SPR, ddPCR/qPCR etc.
* Strong ability to evaluate and compile analytical testing data, ability to write technical reports related to material characterization, references standard evaluations, and method development.
* Demonstrated experience in analytical method development, method qualification/validation and characterization of biological products and impurities using a variety of physicochemical techniques and biological assays.
* Excellent technical writing, presentation and oral communication skills are required.
* Must be excellent team player and able to work amicably and communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.


**Additional Desired Preferences**
* Knowledge of USP products and services is highly desirable.
* Operates collaboratively at all levels of the organization in a highly technical environment.
* Must be able to work in a fast\-paced environment and respond to shifting priorities.
* Well\-developed interpersonal, negotiation, conflict\-resolution and listening skills.
* Must possess the ability to multi\-task and to work effectively with a team.
* Takes ownership and personal responsibility to ensure work is delivered on time and is of the highest possible quality.
* Experience working in the compendial, pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industry strongly preferred.


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
 None, this is an individual contributor role.
   

  

**Benefits**
 USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.
   

  

 Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP
   

  

**Job Category** 
 Chemistry \& Scientific Standards
   

  

**Job Type** 
 Full\-Time

* Exposure to talent technology transformation initiatives.

 Every day at Resmed, technology helps improve lives. By joining our team, you'll contribute to solutions that support our mission of helping people breathe better and live healthier, longer lives. This role offers the opportunity to work on a strategic global initiative, collaborate with colleagues across Australia, Canada, India, Malaysia, and the United States, and make a tangible impact on the employee experience through innovative talent technology solutions.  Joining us is more than saying “yes” to making the world a healthier place. It’s discovering a career that’s challenging, supportive and inspiring. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. **Summary**
 We are seeking a
 **Business Program \& Operations Analyst – UAT \& Implementation** 
 to support a highly visible, enterprise\-wide refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation initiative being deployed across approximately 7,530 retail locations. This large\-scale program is transforming a traditionally manual temperature\-checking and logging process through sensor technology, automated data collection, temperature alerts, and work\-order automation.
   

  

 The program is designed to provide greater visibility into refrigeration equipment performance, identify potential equipment and temperature issues earlier, reduce product loss, support compliance requirements, improve preventive and corrective maintenance processes, and generate significant operational efficiencies and cost savings.
   

  

 In this role, you will help ensure the program is successfully implemented across the store network by supporting business requirements, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), process and SOP validation, training, operational readiness, implementation quality, and go\-live activities. You will work cross\-functionally with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and other program resources to ensure solutions meet business requirements and implementations remain on schedule without compromising quality.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst or program implementation experience, with hands\-on exposure to UAT, business process testing, requirements validation, training, and implementation readiness. Experience supporting retail, facilities, store operations, or large\-scale multi\-site implementations would be especially valuable.
   

  

**Click Apply Now To Join The Chamberlain Experience.**
**What You Will Be Accountable For**
* Support the implementation and deployment of a large\-scale refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation program across approximately 7,530 retail locations.

* Help ensure installations and implementations are completed correctly and meet established business and quality standards.
* Support data validation activities to ensure information captured during implementation is accurate and complete.
* Track testing activities, implementation issues, dependencies, readiness items, and stakeholder deliverables through completion.
* Balance an aggressive implementation timeline with the need for high\-quality testing, validation, and execution.
* Support successful go\-live activities and the transition of new processes into ongoing business operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, implementation effectiveness, operational consistency, and user adoption.


**What Qualifications You Need**

**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

description:

 Lead, manage, and coordinate QA/QC and QMS activities to support Mumbai facility repair operations. Oversee key quality functions, provide QA/QC operational support, deliver quality awareness and process training, and ensure the effective and sustainable implementation of the QMS in alignment with customer, industry, and NOV Global Quality/BPA/Standardization standards, as well as other applicable requirements.

* Plan and coordinate inspections and testing activities including receiving, in\-process, and final inspections, documentation review, functional testing, and FAT witnessing at internal facilities and customer/supplier sites.
* Monitor inspection and testing processes to ensure adherence to applicable quality standards and procedures.

* Lead internal quality audits (IQA), support BPA process audits, QMS certification audits, customer audits, and supplier audits as assigned.

* Supervise, coach, and develop QA/QC personnel, including performance management and training.

title: Associate Lead Testing
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
   

  

 If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
   

  

**QA Architect / Lead**
**Exp Range :** 
 8 \- 13 Years
   

  

**Job location :** 
 Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
   

  

 The QA Architect/Lead is responsible for the testing strategy and infrastructure across the entire platform. You will define the four\-tier test framework (unit, integration, contract, acceptance), establish the conventions that ensure every spec\-defined acceptance criterion has a verifying test, build out the validation infrastructure for parallel\-run cutover from the existing Health Data Engine, and lead the load testing campaign that validates the platform's high\-volume
   

  

 capacity claims.
   

  

 This role is technical\-lead calibre. You will design test frameworks that data engineers consume, set the CI/CD gating policies that determine what merges and what doesn't, and lead the validation that determines when the platform is ready for production traffic. You will work in close partnership with the architect on spec\-derived test conventions and with the data engineering team on the operational maturity of every component.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the four\-tier test framework: unit (per spec acceptance criterion), integration (within\-layer composition), contract (cross\-layer schema and behaviour), and acceptance (end\-to\-end scenarios). Establish the conventions that distinguish them and the CI gates that enforce them
* Establish the spec\-to\-test traceability standard. Every acceptance criterion in a unit spec must have at least one named test that verifies it; test names reference the AC ID by convention; CI enforces coverage. The traceability is regulatory\-defensible by design
* Build and maintain the test infrastructure — fixture management (HL7v2, CCDA, CSV, FHIR samples organized by source and DLQ scenario), DBT test runners, FHIR validator integration, Mini Cluster Flink test harnesses, HAPI test server harnesses for FHIR\-Repository interceptor work, end\-to\-end test orchestration
* Establish synthetic test data conventions — no real PHI in fixtures; structured\-but\-synthetic patient names, identifiers, dates; reusable patterns for multi\-source linkage scenarios; coverage of edge cases (NULLs, ECI merges, late\-arriving data, validation failures)
* Lead the load testing campaign — design the eight to ten scenarios that validate sustained 50K msg/sec ingest, 150K msg/sec peaks, full DBT refresh at billion\-row scale, 1,000 concurrent Starburst queries, 5,000 req/sec FHIR API, MDM degradation behaviour, and reprocessing during steady state. Lead execution; report against acceptance criteria
* Lead the parallel\-run validation framework — for the 30\-60 day cutover period when the new platform ingests alongside the existing Health Data Engine, establish what data is compared between the two systems, what tolerances are accepted, what reconciliation reports are produced, and what triggers a rollback decision
* Define performance SLOs and monitoring strategy. Every component has measurable latency, throughput, and freshness budgets. Build dashboards that operators use during incidents and that establish trend baselines over time
* Define and enforce CI/CD test gates — what blocks PR merge (spec lint, AC coverage, unit tests, integration tests, lint/format), what runs nightly (full integration suite, contract tests, slow scenarios), what runs in stage before promotion (acceptance tests). Codify in pipeline configuration and runbooks
* Build out test automation for FHIR profile validation — every Bundle published is validated against US Core 6\.1 in CI and in the runtime path. Establish the FHIR validator deployment, the profile pack management, and the test patterns that prove conformance
* Lead testing for the bidirectional FHIR flow — verifying loop prevention via origin tagging works under load, that the FHIR\-Repository egress interceptor captures every client\-originated change, that the loopback Flink job applies write\-authority rules correctly, and that no echoes propagate
* Establish testing patterns for MDM integration — synthesizing match/no\-match/multi\-match scenarios, validating ECI assignment correctness, validating ECI\_MERGE and ECI\_SPLIT handling end\-to\-end, validating DLQ routing for MDM failures
* Lead validation of data quality at every layer — DBT test suites for CDM, freshness checks at every layer boundary, anomaly detection for ingestion patterns, governance integration for quality metric publication to Atlan
* Mentor data engineers on test authorship under the spec\-driven development framework. Tests are part of every PR; their quality is part of the PR review; the QA lead sets the bar
* Participate in incident response and root cause analysis. Drive test additions that prevent recurrence — every production incident becomes a new acceptance criterion in the affected spec and a new test in the suite


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 8\+ years of QA experience with at least 3\-5 years focused on data quality, data warehousing, or data platform testing, and 2\+ years in a lead or architect role
* Demonstrated experience defining and operating QA strategies for large\-scale data platforms in cloud environments — preferably GCP
* Strong Python and SQL skills for test framework authorship. Familiarity with pytest and dbt\-test conventions required
* Experience with data validation across batch, streaming (Kafka), and event\-driven pipelines
* Experience with dbt — specifically dbt's native testing framework, dbt\-expectations or dbt\-utils packages, custom test authorship via macros, and source freshness checks
* Experience testing Iceberg or other open\-table\-format\-backed warehouses — schema evolution edge cases, partition handling, snapshot semantics, and CoW vs MoR behavioral differences
* Experience with healthcare data quality testing — HL7v2 parsing edge cases, FHIR profile conformance validation, terminology binding validation, master data quality
* Experience designing and executing load tests for data platforms at scale — JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or custom load generators. Familiarity with realistic load profile design (not just throughput, but representative mix of operations)
* Experience with parallel\-run validation and reconciliation between legacy and replacement data systems
* Strong CI/CD experience — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Cloud Build. Ability to design pipeline gates and integrate test execution into PR and release workflows
* Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. The role works across engineering, architecture, governance, and customer stakeholder groups


 Nice\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Experience with the HL7 FHIR validator, Inferno, or HAPI FHIR validation tooling
* Atlan experience for data quality metric publication and governance integration
* Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing for streaming data systems
* Experience integrating spec\-driven or contract\-first frameworks with QA workflows
* Test management tools experience (TestRail, Zephyr, qTest)
* Experience working in HIPAA\-regulated environments — synthetic PHI generation, audit trail validation, regulatory test evidence
* QA or cloud platform certifications


*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us* 
*!*

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. **The Opportunity**
 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading‑book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking‑book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front‑to‑back\-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision‑making for clients with capital‑markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high‑impact capital‑markets engagements across global banks, broker‑dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
   

  

 EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large\-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**

title: Associate Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Why it’s worth it:
   

  

 ReliaQuest’s Quality Engineering team is evolving quality from a test\-execution function into a platform capability focused on automation, reliability, and production safety. As an Associate Software Development Engineer in Test, you will help build automated testing and continuous integration capabilities across backend services, web applications, and mobile platforms.
   

  

 This is a code\-first, automation\-focused engineering role—not a manual testing or documentation\-only position. You will gain hands\-on experience with production\-level systems, test automation, CI/CD, failure analysis, and AI\-assisted engineering practices. Training, pairing, and guidance will be provided, with attitude and aptitude valued over previous job titles.
   

  

 The everyday hustle:
   

  

* Build and maintain automated API smoke and regression tests for backend services.
* Contribute to UI automation using Playwright and, based on interest and business needs, mobile automation.
* Improve test reliability, test data setup, and environment stability.
* Develop and maintain automated tests that run within GitLab CI pipelines.
* Investigate flaky or failing pipelines and, with guidance, determine whether failures are caused by product defects, test code, or environmental issues.
* Analyze logs, metrics, and test reports to identify and troubleshoot failures across services and environments.
* Create clear, actionable bug reports that include reproduction steps and relevant technical details.
* Collaborate with Software Engineering, SRE, and DevOps teams to resolve quality and reliability issues.
* Contribute to test standards, automation frameworks, pre\-commit hooks, engineering helpers, and other quality tooling.
* Help shape how quality is consistently measured and enforced across services.
* Use Claude and other AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test discovery, automation design, code review, failure triage, and technical documentation.
* Identify repeatable Quality Engineering tasks where AI can improve speed, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Carefully validate and refine AI\-generated outputs to ensure they meet engineering, reliability, and security expectations.
* Share useful AI prompts, patterns, and workflows with the broader QA/SDET team.
* Continuously improve automation and quality practices to help prevent incidents rather than only identify defects after they occur.


 Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* Foundational experience reading and modifying code in Java, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, and HTTP status codes.
* Familiarity with Git and branch\-based development workflows.
* A willingness to debug issues across multiple layers, including test code, services, pipelines, and environments.
* An automation\-first mindset and an interest in building reliable, maintainable test solutions.

title: Quality Control Engineer (Mechanical)
company: SVS Life Safety (a div of SVS Buildwel P Ltd)
description:
**Job title:** 
 QC Engineer — Fire Suppression Manufacturing \& Gas Cylinder Filling
 



**Company:** 
 SVS Buildwel Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Neetaji Subhash vihar Indl Area, Tikri, Delhi · On\-site
 



**Employment type:** 
 Full\-time · Mid\-Senior level
 



**Job function:** 
 Quality Assurance · Manufacturing
 



**Industry:** 
 Fire Protection / Industrial Machinery Manufacturing
 



**About SVS Buildwel** 




 SVS Buildwel has manufactured and installed fire safety and ELV systems for 18 years, serving government, PSU, metro, railway and hospital clients across India. Our Firetrex clean\-agent suppression systems are built in our own plant in Rohini, Delhi — not rebranded.
 



**The role** 




 We are creating a dedicated QC Engineer position at the plant.
 



 That matters more here than in most factories. A fire suppression system is only tested in a real emergency. A defect that escapes our gate is not discovered until the system is needed. You will be the last person between the shop floor and that moment.
 



 You will report to the DGM — Production, Planning \& QC.
 



**What you will do** 



* Incoming inspection of bought\-out material against specification, and collection of test certificates at receipt
* In\-process inspection at defined hold points on the line
* Final QC and functional testing on every unit before release
* Cylinder weighing, pressure testing and leak testing, with records maintained at serial level
* Own the calibration register for all gauges and instruments, and withdraw anything out of calibration
* Raise non\-conformance reports, drive disposition, and verify corrective action closes the root cause rather than the symptom
* Handle pre\-dispatch inspections by clients, consultants and third\-party inspectors — you will face them directly
* Maintain batch and serial traceability so any dispatched unit can be traced back to its material and its operator
* Feed quarterly warranty failure data back into production and design



**What you need** 



* Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
* 3–6 years in quality control in a manufacturing plant — pressure vessels, cylinders, valves, fire equipment, HVAC or comparable engineered products
* Hands\-on with pressure testing, leak testing, weighing and the associated record keeping
* Working knowledge of calibration control, and of raising and closing non\-conformance reports
* Able to read engineering drawings and a bill of materials, and inspect against a written specification rather than by eye
* Able to hold a rejection under commercial pressure. This is part of the job, not an edge case



**Nice to have** 



* Exposure to PESO requirements for gas cylinders and filling
* Experience facing client, consultant or third\-party pre\-dispatch inspection
* ISO 9001 quality system experience, including internal audit
* Exposure to clean agent systems — FK\-5\-1\-12, NOVEC, FM\-200 or similar



**Why this role** 




 You will not be inheriting someone else's quality system. There isn't one yet. You will define the hold points, build the records, set up calibration control, and decide what "passed" means at this plant — with direct access to the department head and no layer in between.
 



 If you have spent three or four years executing a QC plan somebody else wrote, this is the step where you write it.
 



**To apply:** 
 send your CV to dip@svslifesafety.com with "QC Engineer — Plant" in the subject line.

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
**About SaveIN** 
 : SaveIN is a Y\-Combinator\-backed fintech company on a mission to make financial products accessible and affordable for every Indian. We offer Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and no\-cost EMI solutions through a growing network of Banks, NBFCs, and lending partners, enabling consumers to fund healthcare, education, and everyday needs without financial stress.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 : SaveIN is looking for a Senior QA Engineer with a strong automation focus to help us scale test coverage across our lending and payments platform. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and compliance teams to ensure the reliability, security, and correctness of systems that handle real money movement and sensitive customer data.
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 days a week
 



**Mode of Work:** 
 On\-Site
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3\-5 years
 



**Reporting To** 
 : CTO
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (API, UI, and regression) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Own the test strategy for critical customer journeys, including onboarding, credit decisioning, disbursement, and repayment/collections.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks for testing integrations with bank partners (HDFC, ICICI, IDFC First) and bureau/KYC providers.
* Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively build automated regression suites to reduce manual QA dependency.
* Collaborate with developers to "shift testing left" by embedding test gates into CI/CD alongside SAST/security checks.
* Perform API contract testing, load/performance testing, and data validation for financial transactions.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and work with engineering to drive root\-cause fixes.
* Contribute to the test data management strategy, especially around PII/DPDP\-compliant sandbox data.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help formalize QA processes, test documentation, and release sign\-off criteria.
* Participate in production incident reviews to identify testing gaps that could have caught issues earlier.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong hands\-on automation focus.
* Proficiency with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured, Karate).
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and backend testing.
* Experience testing REST APIs, webhooks, and third\-party integrations.
* Basic scripting ability (Java/Python/JavaScript) for writing and maintaining test scripts.
* Understanding of the software testing lifecycle, including test planning, traceability, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Prior experience in fintech, banking, or lending products is a strong plus (understanding of KYC, credit underwriting, or payment flows).
* Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6\) is a plus.
* Exposure to security testing basics (e.g., OWASP Top 10\) is a plus, given the regulated environment.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience testing systems with multiple bank/NBFC integrations.
* Familiarity with compliance\-driven QA (e.g., audit trails, RBI/data protection considerations).
* Interest in AI\-assisted testing tools/agentic QA workflows, as this is a growing focus area for our team.

**About Grade Capital** 




 Grade Capital is a long\-term investment platform for crypto portfolios. Our curated crypto baskets and mutual fund\-style portfolios are built on strict risk management, data\-driven research, and proven investment principles — designed for steady growth, not short\-term reactions.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 In fintech, a bug isn't cosmetic — it's someone's money. You won't be handed a script to click through. You'll learn to think adversarially about financial systems: where data drifts, what breaks under load, what happens when a price feed goes stale mid\-transaction.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





 • Write and execute test cases across web and mobile — functional, regression, edge cases.
 



 • Test real financial flows: portfolios, transactions, order execution, data accuracy.
 



 • Log clear, reproducible bug reports with steps, evidence, and expected vs. actual.
 



 • Validate APIs with Postman; verify response contracts and error handling.
 



 • Cross\-check data integrity across UI, backend, and database.
 



 • Work directly with engineers through the fix–verify–close loop.
 



 • AI\-First Engineering (Non\-Negotiable).
 



  





**Core Requirements** 




  





 • Strong analytical and logical reasoning — you ask "what if" by instinct.
 



 • Sharp attention to detail: the off\-by\-one, the misaligned decimal, the missing null check.
 



 • QA fundamentals — STLC, test case design, bug life cycle, severity vs. priority.
 



 • Basics of REST APIs, JSON, and SQL for data verification.
 



 • Clear written communication; comfort with Jira, Postman, DevTools, Git.
 



  





**Strong Differentiators** 




  





 • Automation exposure (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) or scripting in Java/JS/Python.
 



 • Interest in fintech, crypto, trading, or Web3\.
 



 • Personal projects, hackathons, open source, or bug bounty work.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.

**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts

title: CQV Engineer
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 The CQV Engineer will be responsible for the commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment, systems, and processes used in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. This role ensures that all systems operate as intended and comply with regulatory standards. The CQV Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Familiarity with risk\-based approaches to C\&Q (e.g., ASTM E2500, ISPE).
* Develop and execute commissioning and qualification lifecycle protocols for new and existing process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities.
* Prepare C\&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and as per regulatory requirements.
* Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP \& SIP systems
* Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies.
* Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design.
* Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C\&Q.
* Review vendor documents (CTOP/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements.
* Ensure non\-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner.
* Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews.
* Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site.
* Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction.
* System Startup activities
* Supervise vendors/ contractors on site during commissioning activities.
* Ensure compliance with current industry regulations and guidelines relating to Commissioning, qualification and validation.
* Prepare and maintain detailed documentation, including protocols, reports, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e.g., ISPE, ASTM).
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless project execution.
* Provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders.


**Working Conditions**
* The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities.
* Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements.
* Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm., M. Pharm., B.Tech or BE or MSc.
* 5\-8 year’s experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing.
* Experience with writing and executing commissioning, qualification, and validation of biopharmaceutical equipment and systems (e.g., bioreactors, chromatography systems, filtration systems)
* Experience in preparing Risk assessments for new and existing process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities.


**Technical Skills**
* Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis.
* Strong understanding of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.
* Experience with process validation and computer system validation.
* Familiar with Delta\-V and other PCS/ DCS systems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

description:
Company Description
 



 Synergetic Communication Inc. is a debt collection agency focused on combining a customer\-centric approach with advanced technology to achieve effective delinquent account recovery. The company emphasizes innovation, using modern tools and streamlined processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and communication. Its compliance\-driven operations aim to foster trust and satisfaction among both clients and consumers. Team members are expected to balance strong results with respectful, empathetic interactions. Synergetic Communication Inc. is committed to redefining industry standards by aligning technology, communication, and positive consumer experiences.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We are expanding our Client Services and Administration team with multiple full\-time, on\-site openings based in Gurugram, India. This team is the operational and compliance backbone of the business, supporting consumer interactions, data integrity, training delivery, quality assurance, audit readiness, and platform uptime. Candidates are encouraged to apply once and indicate in their application which function best matches their experience; we will consider applicants across all openings.
 



  





 Open Functions
 



  





 Consumer Disputes \- Research, document, and resolve consumer disputes end to end. Review account histories, gather supporting documentation, prepare written responses within regulatory timeframes, and escalate issues that require compliance or legal review.
 



  





 Data Entry \- Accurately enter, validate, and maintain account and consumer records across internal platforms. Reconcile incoming client files, correct data discrepancies, and maintain the record quality that downstream reporting and compliance depend on.
 



  





 Learning Management System Admin (LMS) \- Administer the company learning platform: build and publish courses, manage user accounts and permissions, assign and track required compliance training, troubleshoot learner issues, and report on completion rates and certification status.
 



  





 Quality Call Scoring \- Monitor and score recorded consumer calls against quality and compliance scorecards. Document findings, identify coaching opportunities and trends, and partner with operations leadership to raise consistency across the floor.
 



  





 Internal Audit Testwork \- Execute internal audit test procedures across operational and compliance controls. Pull and review samples, document evidence and exceptions, prepare clear workpapers, and support remediation tracking through to closure.
 



  





 System Monitoring Admin \- Monitor production systems, dialer platforms, and scheduled processes for availability and errors. Track alerts, run daily health checks, log and escalate incidents, and maintain monitoring documentation and shift handoff notes.

Content distributors are transforming into content producers, service providers are becoming tech companies, technology companies are the catalyst for dramatic change in every sector, and customers want the latest innovations now.
   

  

 We help TMT companies create compelling employee and customer experiences, retaining skills and talent while achieving enterprise\-wide operational excellence. **CNS \- RISK \- PROCESS \& CONTROLS :**
 EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls

 Team

* Supporting to perform system upgrades, integrations, and testing


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* Must have at least 3 years of experience in a SAP GTS solution based functional role.
* Academic degree in Business Administration or – Informatics or a certificated IT education min. 4\+ year professional experience in IT processes and ITIL
* Also, practical experience of IT Service Management Processes such as software change and/or release management or application management experience
* You must have the ability to debug SAP code to a certain extent to resolve low level incidents.
* Experience in SAP GTS Edition for Hana with debugging, integration knowledge with other SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Also, effective communication skills are required to influence stakeholders to achieve support and consistency of the overall IT strategies and policies, specifically in their own subject areas.
* Must have excellent analytical skills, together with the ability to think "outside the box".
* Foreign Trade Zone handling within GTS incl. Material balancing


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.

As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Consulting QAS\- Quantitative Trading Book (QTB)**
**Profile: Senior Consultant \- Model Validator \- Generative AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading‑book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking‑book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front‑to‑back\-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision‑making for clients with capital‑markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high‑impact capital‑markets engagements across global banks, broker‑dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
   

  

 EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead components of large\-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services

 Team

title: Jr. Engineer / Engineer - Quality
description:
* Know, and apply, the safety and environment rules of the site.
* Know, apply and teach others to apply the quality rules and quality tools.
* Perform audits in production:
* Presence and validity of safety and quality work instructions.
* Start up of the line(s) / machine(s): Audit that the release of the first piece was carried out according to the corresponding standard.
* Poka Yokes: Audit the proper functioning of quality devices (Poka Yoke, controls integrated into machines….) according to the corresponding standard.
* Audit the standards (For example: OK start, work instructions, visual inspection standard, parameter setting records, magic square….) displayed \& used in production and notify the corresponding Supervisor/ Engineer of any non\-conformities.
* Audit that the controls performed are in line with the control plan requirements: Content, method, frequency, results \& reaction to non\-conformities.
* Stop at First Defect (Assembly lines) and Reaction To The First Defect (Upstream processes): Audit that the stoppage and reaction rules to the defect are respected and that a QRAP is open and monitored according to the corresponding standard.
* Audit that all the product is identified according to its status and according to the corresponding standard.
* Audit deviations: Method, training, documentation, parts identification, duration/number of parts versus the deviation limit.
* Support or perform StEDE assessments.
* Site\-specific or product\-specific audits.
* Prepare Quality Alerts and training of the concerned team on their content.
* Responsible to ensure that there is no Rework activity without an approved work instruction, trained Operator(s) and documented results.
* Train Operators on the Quality requirements and manage their Magic Square level 2 certification.
* Ensure that the measurement equipment is maintained in good condition, calibrated, and re\-calibrated according to the schedule.
* Respect for the Product: Ensure that components, work\-in\-progress, semi\-finished product, finished goods are handled, identified and protected to guarantee delivery to the customer in optimal conditions.
* Ensure that suspect or non\-conform product is identified and secured in a prison/quarantine cage, so that there is no risk of it being used in the next internal process or shipped to an external customer.
* Notify the Lead Operator and/or Supervisor in case of any deviation in their line(s) or machine(s).
* Define and validate with the Supervisor and APU Quality Engineer the immediate containment actions for any quality issues.
* Attend and participate in ongoing training specific to the position.

 TAFCO is India’s first Integrated Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) Solutions company focused on assessing, managing, and improving indoor air quality across residential, commercial, and industrial environments. description:

 Manage the correct synchronization and interaction between SAP and the ASRS along with other related systems.
   

  

 Participate in and lead improvement initiatives related to the efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity of the ASRS, as well as the management of faults, new projects, safety, storage, trends, and others related to the system and its different components or equipment such as AGV’s, racks, mobile devices, conveyors, robots and others. * Manage the performance of the integration and optimization of the company's different platforms with the ASRS to ensure correct system communication.
* Ensure warehouse personnel capability in research processes and root cause analysis, supported by data traceability to determine ASRS faults and other sub\-system faults that impact operation using analysis and problem\-solving tools.
