* Conduct training and create procedures and work aids for associates and general personnel on the handling and use of the ASRS, AGV, Robots and related sub\-system’s and all its components (equipment, faults, inventories, flows, among others).
* Manage and ensure resolution of communication error between eWM and other sub\-systems with help of support teams from SAP and vendor.
* Ownership for control room to ensure equipment uptime, reports generation, fault finding, resolution and timely delivery of materials.
* Ensure co\-ordination with ground operations team to ensure inventory hygiene, timely delivery or calling of manual commands along with prioritization of task for automated systems.
* Participate in/or lead in the development of new ASRS functionalities, Dashboards, design changes, improvements, tests, and others, to improve efficiency, efficacy, process, and storage capacity.
* Participate in global benchmarking platforms for the design, development, and implementation of automation of the company's ASRS or other related systems for the plant.
* Review the performance of ASRS suppliers or others related to improve the service provided in favor of the ASRS system reliability.

title: Ingénieur Développement Fournisseurs H/F
description:
L’Ingénieur développement et maturité des fournisseurs joue un rôle clé et hautement stratégique dans la montée en maturité des fournisseurs d’Arabelle Solutions. Sa mission : élever durablement le niveau de performance, de qualité et de sûreté nucléaire de nos partenaires industriels afin de sécuriser des projets critiques dans un environnement exigeant.
   

  

 Ce Poste Se Concentre Sur Le Développement Structurel Des Fournisseurs. Il Intervient Au Cœur Des Fondamentaux Qui Conditionnent La Fiabilité D’un Fournisseur
   

  

* Excellence du système de management de la qualité
* Renforcement de la culture et des exigences de sûreté nucléaire
* Robustesse organisationnelle, documentaire et suivi des sous\-traitants
* Capacité d’amélioration continue et de maîtrise des risques


 Le rôle s’adresse à un(e) ingénieur(e) structuré(e), rigoureux(se), doté(e) d’une forte culture qualité, maîtrisant les étapes du processus industriel de production, de la prise de commande à la livraison. Doté(e) d’un excellent relationnel, la personne sera capable d’être un véritable pilote du changement auprès de nos fournisseurs en les accompagnant dans une démarche Lean.
   

  

 En lien direct avec les experts internes, l’Ingénieur Développement Fournisseurs évalue la maturité des fournisseurs en menant des audits, en analysant leur organisation et en identifiant les risques et les potentiels signaux faibles. Appuyé par la stratégie sourcing, il/elle construit et pilote des plans de développement à fort impact (y compris opérationnels), accompagne les fournisseurs dans la transformation de leurs pratiques et garantit l’efficacité des actions engagées.
   

  

**Les Fournisseurs Suivis Sont**
* Les nouveaux fournisseurs d’Arabelle Solutions
* Les fournisseurs actuels présentant des problématiques de performance qualité
* Les fournisseurs stratégiques pour l’entreprise


 Son action contribue directement à la montée en maturité du panel fournisseurs, à la fiabilité de la supply chain nucléaire et à la réussite des projets d’Arabelle Solutions.
   

  

**MISSIONS ET ACTIVITÉS PRINCIPALES**
* Participer et valider la stratégie globale de sélection des fournisseurs avec les équipes sourcing
* Préparer, planifier et conduire des audits d’évaluation (ISO 9001, ISO 19443, exigences clients, référentiels internes) chez les fournisseurs
* Évaluer et challenger la structure organisationnelle et les processus des fournisseurs afin de répondre aux exigences techniques et administratives liées aux commandes nucléaires ; réaliser des évaluations de culture sûreté (organisation, suivi de la supply chain, gestion des compétences, robustesse des procédés, maîtrise documentaire)
* Identifier et mitiger les écarts, les signaux faibles et les risques pouvant impacter la qualité ou la sûreté
* Rédiger des rapports structurés, argumentés et exploitables
* Assurer l’interface avec les experts techniques internes pour coordonner les actions fournisseurs
* Construire avec les fournisseurs des plans de développement pragmatiques et mesurables (actions, échéances, indicateurs)
* Contribuer à la montée en maturité du panel fournisseurs : accompagnement Lean, coaching, suivi des actions et évaluation de leur efficacité
* Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques dans le respect des règles de confidentialité
* Construire et améliorer les standards de qualification, de maturité et les programmes de développement fournisseurs, en favorisant les synergies avec les entités du groupe EDF


**Compétences techniques**
* Diplôme d’Ingénieur ou formation équivalente
* Expérience de 10 ans minimum en qualité, audit ou développement fournisseurs, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé (nucléaire, énergie, ferroviaire, aéronautique)
* Maîtrise des systèmes de management de la qualité, avec une excellente connaissance de la norme ISO 9001
* Certification ou formation en sûreté nucléaire et/ou ISO 19443 fortement appréciée
* Bonne compréhension des exigences et de la culture de sûreté nucléaire
* Solide connaissance des procédés de fabrication et des environnements industriels de production
* Expertise en audits qualité, audits organisationnels et audits de processus
* Maîtrise des principes d’excellence opérationnelle appliqués à la fabrication
* Très bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la performance et à la conformité des fournisseurs
* Maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral


**Compétences comportementales**
* Leadership transverse et capacité à fédérer les parties prenantes
* Aptitude à accompagner le changement et à piloter des actions d’amélioration
* Excellentes capacités de communication, d’écoute et de négociation
* Esprit d’analyse et de synthèse développé
* Rigueur, autonomie et sens des responsabilités
* Forte capacité d’adaptation et aisance relationnelle avec des interlocuteurs variés
* Force de proposition et orientation résultats
* Déplacements réguliers à prévoir chez les fournisseurs
* Intervention dans un contexte industriel exigeant et fortement réglementé
* Collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et internationales


 Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
   

  

 At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Business Analyst
description:
A signed SOW is only as good as what happens to it next. This role exists to be the critical bridge between Sales, Project Intake, and Delivery Execution — making sure every signed project enters development with clarity, completeness, and functional accuracy, instead of ambiguity that surfaces three weeks into a build.
 



  





 You’ll convert signed SOWs, discovery notes, and client requirements into structured, developer\-ready documentation. Your work directly protects delivery efficiency, quality, and client satisfaction by catching gaps before development begins, not after.
 



  





***This role is for someone who enjoys:***



* Turning ambiguous requirements into precise, structured documentation
* Catching gaps and inconsistencies before they become delivery problems
* Working at the intersection of Sales, PMs, Developers, and QA
* Building reusable systems and templates rather than solving the same problem repeatedly



  





 If you’re someone who takes real satisfaction in a requirement document that leaves zero room for misinterpretation, this role will put that skill to constant use.
 



  





**What you’ll really be doing** 




  





**1\. Project Intake \& Transition** 



* Review signed SOWs, proposals, discovery notes, and transcripts
* Participate in internal kick\-off sessions to understand client priorities and technical constraints
* Identify gaps, ambiguities, or missing inputs before development begins
* Ensure complete transition from Sales to Delivery with zero requirement blind spots



  





**2\. Requirement Documentation** 



* Translate business requirements into Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs) and detailed User Stories
* Break down modules and features into data fields, validations, workflows, interactions, and conditional logic
* Define dynamic content behavior, click actions, role\-based access views, and system logic
* Ensure documentation is structured, version\-controlled, and delivery\-ready



  





**3\. Internal Task Structuring \& Execution Alignment** 



* Collaborate with Project Managers to convert requirements into structured development tasks (ClickUp, Jira, etc.)
* Identify task dependencies and logical execution sequences
* Support QA teams with initial test case outlines derived from business rules and acceptance criteria



  





**4\. Client Clarifications \& Change Management** 



* Track and document clarification requests during execution
* Support PMs and Account Managers in evaluating scope deviations and change requests
* Maintain version\-controlled documentation with client confirmations and change logs



  





**5\. Quality \& UAT Support** 



* Assist PMs in validating completed work against functional documentation before client delivery
* Participate in internal UAT cycles to ensure alignment between build and documented requirements
* Reduce last\-minute surprises during client reviews



  





**6\. Documentation Governance \& Hygiene** 



* Maintain centralized repositories of requirement documents and change logs
* Ensure consistent formatting, naming conventions, and version control standards
* Regularly clean up outdated or deprecated documentation references



  





**7\. Proactive Risk Identification** 



* Identify risks, inconsistencies, and vague requirements early in the process
* Escalate potential delivery blockers before development begins
* Flag redundant or unclear SOW elements that may lead to misinterpretation



  





**8\. Cross\-Department Collaboration** 



* Work closely with UI/UX designers to ensure designs align with documented functionality
* Annotate design files and provide developer\-facing logic notes
* Clarify workflow expectations and display conditions across teams



  





**9\. Process \& Template Improvement** 



* Refine internal templates for FRDs, change tracking, and requirement mapping
* Recommend process improvements to reduce friction during handoffs
* Improve intake efficiency through structured documentation patterns



  





**10\. Knowledge Sharing \& Reusability** 



* Document recurring modules, platform constraints, and reusable logic patterns
* Build and maintain an internal knowledge base for delivery reference
* Support onboarding by providing structured background documentation



**Who will thrive in this role** 



* You catch ambiguity and gaps before anyone else notices them
* You write documentation precisely enough that a developer never has to guess
* You move comfortably between Sales, PMs, Developers, and QA without losing context
* You maintain documentation discipline even when things get busy
* You think in reusable systems, not one\-off fixes



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Experience** 



* 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst in a digital agency, web development, or software delivery environment



  





**Must Have Skills** 



* Strong experience creating FRDs, user stories, process flows, and QA outlines
* Ability to convert business requirements into clear, structured, developer\-ready documentation
* Strong analytical thinking and logical reasoning skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
* Exceptional attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Strong understanding of website or application development lifecycles



  





**Tools \& Platforms** 



* Figma, Jira, ClickUp, Miro, Lucidchart, Confluence
* Google Workspace



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience working with US\-based agencies or white\-label service models
* Familiarity with SOWs, BRDs, technical specifications, and structured discovery documentation
* Understanding of WordPress, Shopify, custom PHP/JS builds, and API integrations
* Ability to annotate UI/UX designs and suggest usability improvements
* Knowledge of risk management, prioritization frameworks, and delivery dependency mapping



  





**What this role offers** 



* A high\-impact role sitting at the center of Sales, Delivery, and Client Success
* Ownership of the documentation that determines how smoothly every project runs
* Exposure to a wide variety of client projects and platforms
* Room to shape and improve internal documentation standards and templates

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
Responsible for ensuring the quality of sheet metal fabricated and welded components by monitoring production processes, conducting inspections, identifying defects, and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct incoming, in\-process, and final inspection of sheet metal and welded components.
* Inspect components manufactured through Laser Cutting, CNC Bending, Fabrication, TIG Welding and MIG Welding processes.
* Verify component dimensions using Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Gauges and other measuring instruments.
* Check welding quality, including weld size, penetration, bead appearance, undercut, porosity, cracks, spatter and distortion.
* Ensure welding operations are carried out as per WPS, drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Interpret and understand engineering drawings, GD\&T and welding symbols.
* Prepare and maintain Inspection Reports, Quality Check Sheets, NCR Reports and other quality records.
* Identify process and product defects and coordinate with Production and Engineering teams for corrective actions.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis and 8D.
* Implement and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
* Monitor welding and fabrication process parameters and ensure compliance with approved standards.
* Support first\-piece inspection, prototype inspection and new product development activities.
* Conduct welding defect analysis and support improvement activities to reduce rejection and rework.
* Ensure calibration status of measuring instruments and maintain relevant records.
* Participate in internal, customer and certification audits.
* Support implementation of 5S, Kaizen, Continuous Improvement and Zero Defect initiatives.
* Coordinate with Production, PPC, Maintenance and Engineering teams to resolve quality issues.
* Prepare daily/weekly quality reports covering rejection, rework, defects and process performance.
* Ensure compliance with applicable QMS procedures and customer\-specific requirements.


**Required Skills**
* Good knowledge of Sheet Metal Fabrication and Welding Processes.
* Strong knowledge of TIG and MIG Welding and common welding defects.
* Ability to read and interpret 2D engineering drawings and welding symbols.
* Knowledge of GD\&T and dimensional inspection.
* Knowledge of measuring instruments and inspection methods.
* Knowledge of RCA, CAPA, 8D and problem\-solving techniques.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management System.
* MS Office knowledge, particularly Excel and Word.


**Qualification**
* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent.


**Experience**
* 1–2 years of experience in Quality Engineering in sheet metal fabrication, TIG/MIG welding or automotive/engineering manufacturing

* Experience in Laser Cutting, CNC Bending, Welding \& Fabricatio
* n.Experience handling customer complaints and NCR/CAP
* A.Knowledge of welding quality standards and inspection practice
* s.Experience in CMM or other advanced inspection equipment will be an added advantag

description:
**Job Description**
 The role focuses on supporting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and related engineering applications, ensuring data integrity, system reliability, and efficient operation across integrated business platforms. Responsibilities include application support, data analysis, SQL reporting, troubleshooting, documentation, process improvement, and collaboration with engineering, IT, and business stakeholders.

Candidates should enjoy problem solving, working with data, learning new technologies, and supporting enterprise applications within an engineering and manufacturing environment. As experience grows, the role will progress toward ownership of engineering systems, business processes, and system improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical support for PLM systems and associated engineering applications across multiple business units and engineering disciplines.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application, system, and data\-related issues while ensuring minimal disruption to engineering operations.
* Write, maintain, and execute SQL queries to support reporting, data validation, data reconciliation, and engineering business processes.
* Monitor and maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across PLM and integrated enterprise systems.

* Support user training activities and assist in developing subject matter expertise within engineering and business teams.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and support activities, proactively driving issues through resolution while communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, and engineering governance requirements.

**Qualifications**

title: Salesforce QA Automation Engineer
description:
**India T\&M Special Bonus:**
 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Salesforce QA Automation Engineer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
   

  

**Scope of Services**
* Develop, maintain, and execute automated functional, regression, integration, smoke, and end\-to\-end test suites using Cypress and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Design test strategies, test plans, test scenarios, traceability, test data, entry and exit criteria, and release\-quality reporting.
* Perform manual and automated testing of Salesforce Service Cloud, Lightning applications, Lightning Web Components, Flows, Apex\-driven functionality, security, permissions, and integrations.
* Test Einstein Bots and other digital assistants across conversation flows, intents, entities, context variables, authentication, transactions, fallback behavior, error recovery, and bot\-to\-agent handoff.
* Validate Omni\-Channel routing, queues, skills, presence, transcripts, pre\-chat context, escalation, agent workflows, and service\-level behavior.
* Test digital engagement channels such as web messaging, in\-app messaging, SMS, and WhatsApp when in scope, including templates, consent, session handling, routing, and escalation.
* Develop API and integration tests for REST, SOAP, middleware, event\-driven interfaces, and downstream systems of record.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines and establish repeatable quality gates, execution reports, and failure diagnostics.
* Participate in refinement, sprint planning, reviews, defect triage, release readiness, and production issue investigations.
* Document defects with reproducible evidence, assess severity and business impact, support root\-cause analysis, and verify corrective actions.


**Required Experience And Qualifications**
* Five to seven years of software quality assurance or quality engineering experience.
* At least three years of hands\-on test automation experience, with strong current expertise using Cypress.
* Proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript and experience designing maintainable automation frameworks, reusable components, fixtures, mocks, and test utilities.
* Demonstrated experience testing Salesforce applications, preferably Service Cloud, Lightning Experience, Flows, Apex, LWC, Salesforce security, and enterprise integrations.
* Demonstrated experience testing Einstein Bots, enterprise chatbots, virtual assistants, or conversational AI solutions.
* Experience testing REST APIs and integration workflows using tools such as Postman, ReadyAPI, SoapUI, or code\-based API frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of test design techniques, risk\-based testing, regression strategy, defect management, test\-data management, and quality metrics.
* Ability to work independently and communicate test risks, evidence, and release recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.


**Salesforce And Chatbot Testing Capabilities**
* Service Cloud testing across Case Management, Knowledge, Omni\-Channel, routing, queues, console applications, entitlements, milestones, macros, quick text, and service analytics.
* Validation of chatbot dialogs, intents, entities, utterance variations, context retention, branching, disambiguation, fallback, error handling, timeout, escalation, and human handoff.
* Testing of authenticated and unauthenticated chatbot journeys, role\-based access, sensitive\-data handling, auditability, privacy, and negative\-security scenarios.
* Validation of multilingual and localized chatbot experiences, preferably English plus Spanish and/or Portuguese.
* Cross\-browser, responsive, accessibility, usability, and compatibility testing for customer and agent experiences.
* Validation of operational chatbot measures such as containment, transfer, fallback, abandonment, response time, resolution, and customer\-experience outcomes.


**Preferred Tools And Experience**
* Selenium WebDriver experience and the ability to maintain or transition existing Selenium automation assets.
* Tricentis Tosca experience, including model\-based automation, reusable test steps, test\-data management, and execution reporting.
* Azure DevOps, Git, Jenkins, Gearset, or comparable source\-control, CI/CD, deployment, and test\-management tooling.
* SQL or data\-query experience for back\-end validation, reconciliation, and test\-data verification.
* Experience with test management and defect tools such as Azure DevOps Test Plans, Jira, Zephyr, qTest, or equivalent.


**Performance Testing Experience: Plus**
* Experience using JMeter, PlayWright, LoadRunner, BlazeMeter, NeoLoad, k6, or a comparable performance\-testing tool.
* Ability to design load, stress, endurance, spike, and scalability scenarios for Salesforce\-integrated applications, APIs, and chatbot services.
* Experience analyzing response time, throughput, concurrency, error rates, bottlenecks, integration latency, and system behavior under peak demand.
* Ability to produce performance baselines, findings, and actionable recommendations while accounting for Salesforce platform limits and test\-environment constraints.


**Preferred Certifications**
* ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level or an advanced ISTQB test automation credential.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator.
* Tricentis Tosca certification or relevant performance\-testing certification.


**AI\-Assisted Quality Engineering**
* Use approved AI\-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor to accelerate test design, Cypress automation, API\-test development, test\-data preparation, debugging, refactoring, and test documentation.
* Generate candidate test scenarios from user stories and acceptance criteria, then independently validate functional, negative, security, accessibility, integration, chatbot, channel, and regression coverage.
* Use AI assistance to analyze failures, logs, selectors, flaky tests, automation gaps, and root\-cause hypotheses, with human review before code is committed or results are used for release decisions.
* Review AI\-generated test code and artifacts for correctness, maintainability, privacy, security, traceability, licensing, and alignment with enterprise quality\-engineering standards.
* Follow enterprise policies for approved tools, confidential data, source code, credentials, prompt handling, and responsible AI use without weakening QA accountability or release evidence.

* Experience working with Vector Databases for embeddings and semantic search.

title: Technical Manager
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
   

  

 This Position reports to:
   

  

 Lead Technology Product Manager
   

  

  

  

  

  

**What We Believe In**
 ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them achieve operational excellence – smarter and more sustainable. We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry\-specific integrated control systems, software solutions, measurement, analytics, and advanced services. Our commitment to innovation and quality drives digital transformation across critical industrial operations worldwide.
   

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, we are looking for experienced software professionals to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role requires leading or being part of a team with extensive expertise in full\-stack application development (Angular, .NET Core, C\#), cloud technologies, and data science. You will be responsible for establishing software quality standards, leading DevOps initiatives, managing stakeholder expectations, and ensuring the delivery of scalable, high\-quality solutions while mentoring and developing team members.
   

  

 The work model for the role is: Hybrid
   

  

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
* Maintain high standards of software quality within the team by establishing best industry practices, DevOps pipelines, and continuous build environments to accelerate software development and deployment.
* Identify and prioritize key stakeholders (external \& internal), aligning their expectations with project deliverables, milestones, and status reporting in collaboration with ABB project managers.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and architects to plan, design, develop, and test enterprise applications while leading documentation of requirements, user stories, estimates, and work plans.
* Drive team growth by identifying improvement opportunities, introducing innovation in processes and solutions, conducting peer\-reviews, mentoring team members, and providing regular performance feedback.


**Qualifications For The Role**
* Strong expertise in full\-stack application development using Angular, .NET Core, C\#, WebAPI, and Entity Framework Core, with solid experience in Azure deployment (Service Fabric \& Kubernetes) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Proven experience in DevOps practices, CI/CD pipeline setup, deployment automation, and establishing continuous build environments across platforms.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Data Science, Analytics, AI \& ML, ETL/ELT development, database design, and advanced SQL, with a strong grasp of security principles.
* Proficiency in project implementation methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Iterative) with demonstrated ability to manage deliverables, resolve complex technical issues, and guide teams through problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated leadership experience with proven ability to delegate tasks effectively, mentor team members, develop talent, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to resolve conflicts, coordinate across teams, and align technical solutions with business goals.
* Bachelor's (BE/BTech) or Master's (ME/MTech) degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with familiarity in Azure DevOps, modern development tools, and industry domain knowledge.


**More About Us**
 ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area (\>$6B revenue in 2021, 22,000 employees) automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the most complex industrial infrastructures on this planet. Through its divisions, we serve customers in the energy, process, and hybrid industries – from hydrocarbons, chemicals, water, mining, minerals, pulp \& paper to marine and ports, and many more. PA stands at the heart of some of the most important shifts in society, helping energy\-intense industries achieve safer, smarter, and more sustainable operations to enable a prosperous, low\-carbon society.
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Specialist I - Software Engineering
description:
**Role Description**
 Lead I, Software Engineering Our teams combine innovation, agility, and engineering excellence across healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, manufacturing, telecommunications, and other industries. You Are You are a hands\-on .NET technical leader who can turn complex business requirements and legacy application landscapes into secure, maintainable enterprise solutions. You own .NET solution architecture, technical direction, engineering standards, team enablement, and end\-to\-end delivery accountability. You can assess an unfamiliar codebase, make defensible modernization and design decisions, guide engineers through implementation, and step into code to resolve critical problems. You use AI\-first engineering to improve delivery while maintaining ownership of correctness and quality. The Opportunity Architecture \& Builder Mode
   

  

* Solution architecture ownership. Define application boundaries, service contracts, data flows, integration patterns, and non\-functional requirements. Produce practical high\-level and low\-level designs and architecture decisions that engineers can implement.
* Modern .NET engineering. Lead design and development using C\#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, and appropriate architectural patterns. Establish maintainable code structure, error handling, validation, and testability.
* Legacy modernization. Assess .NET Framework and legacy application portfolios, dependencies, libraries, and deployment constraints. Define incremental migration strategies to supported .NET versions, including compatibility analysis, regression protection, and safe cutover or rollback.
* Enterprise integration. Own API, database, messaging, and external\-system integration design. Guide data access, transaction boundaries, authentication, authorization, and reliable communication across applications and services.
* AI\-DLC operating model. Use Claude Code, Codex, or comparable tools for repository analysis, specifications, implementation, refactoring, and test generation. Establish approved agent instructions, coding rules, and human verification gates for the team.
* End\-to\-end delivery. Translate architecture into workstreams, estimates, dependencies, and executable tasks. Lead implementation, integration, testing, release readiness, and production handover in partnership with QA, UX, DevOps, security, and customer stakeholders. Firefighter Mode
* A legacy application must move to a modern .NET runtime. You identify compatibility risks, prioritize a viable migration path, validate critical functionality, and make the cutover plan defensible.
* A production API slows down or fails intermittently. You use traces, logs, metrics, profiling, and database evidence to isolate the bottleneck, implement a fix, and verify the result.
* An AI\-assisted refactor introduces a regression or violates an architectural constraint. You review the change, reproduce the defect, correct the design, and strengthen the relevant tests and guardrails.
* A release is blocked by an integration, security, or deployment issue. You coordinate the right teams, make the technical tradeoffs explicit, and drive a verified resolution without bypassing required controls. Systems Thinker Mode
* Architecture and design discipline. Apply clean architecture, SOLID principles, domain\-driven design where appropriate, modular monolith or microservice patterns, and well\-defined interfaces. Avoid unnecessary complexity and select patterns based on actual requirements.
* Performance and reliability. Design for throughput, latency, resilience, concurrency, resource usage, and fault isolation. Use appropriate caching, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and database optimization with measurable validation.
* Security and governance. Enforce secure coding, least privilege, secrets management, dependency and licensing policies, authentication/authorization, data protection, and approved AI\-tool usage. Partner with security teams on relevant threat and risk assessments.
* Team enablement. Mentor engineers, conduct design and code reviews, define reusable libraries and engineering standards, and break complex work into clear ownership and acceptance criteria. Build team capability rather than becoming the delivery bottleneck.
* Delivery and production accountability. Own technical risks, quality gates, dependencies, and release readiness. Establish observability, operational runbooks, rollback procedures, and measurable indicators such as defect trends, cycle time, rework, and service reliability. Minimum Qualifications
* Experience. Typically 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years in technical leadership, solution design, or ownership of enterprise application delivery. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.
* Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree is an advantage.
* Core .NET expertise. Strong hands\-on C\# and .NET experience, including production ASP.NET Core services, object\-oriented design, APIs, relational databases, debugging, automated testing, and software architecture.
* Leadership and delivery. Proven ability to guide engineers, own technical decisions, work with customer stakeholders, and deliver production systems. Practical experience with AI\-assisted engineering and its validation and governance requirements. Technical Toolkit We value demonstrated technical depth and the ability to learn adjacent technologies—not superficial familiarity with every tool listed below.
* Languages and application frameworks. C\#, supported .NET/.NET Framework versions, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, asynchronous programming, dependency injection, and relevant testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest.
* Architecture and integration. Clean architecture, domain\-driven design, REST APIs, microservices and modular monoliths, event\-driven integration, messaging, API gateways, and architecture decision records. Familiarity with gRPC or GraphQL is useful where applicable.
* Data and performance. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or comparable relational databases; EF Core and SQL performance tuning, indexing, transactions, caching, profiling, and application observability.
* Cloud and deployment. Experience deploying .NET workloads on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud; Docker, CI/CD, configuration management, identity and access integration, logs, metrics, and production troubleshooting. Kubernetes familiarity is an advantage.
* Modernization and quality. .NET Framework\-to\-modern\-.NET migration, dependency and compatibility assessment, automated unit/integration/contract testing, code review, static analysis, security scanning, and release/rollback practices.
* AI\-first engineering. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or comparable tools; repository\-aware development, specification\-driven workflows, agent instructions/skills, context engineering, and reviewable AI\-generated changes.
* Engineering leadership. Git, GitHub or Azure DevOps, Agile delivery, technical estimation, design reviews, mentoring, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination with QA, UX, platform, and security teams. Preferred Qualifications
* Experience leading complex .NET modernization, application decomposition, or cloud migration programs in consulting or customer\-facing environments.
* Experience with enterprise authentication, multi\-tenant applications, regulated environments, or high\-volume transactional systems.
* Experience establishing reusable .NET accelerators, architecture standards, automated quality gates, or governed AI\-DLC engineering practices.
* Relevant Microsoft, cloud, software architecture, or AI\-platform certifications; open\-source contributions or technical community leadership.


**Skills**
* NET, CI/CD, SQL, GitHub Copilot

* Experience developing full\-chip/SoC tests using the environments/tools (e.g., ASM, C, C\+\+, Perspec, OS, or drivers).
* Experience with industry standard emulator technologies (e.g., HAPS, Zebu, Veloce, or Palladium) ranging from build tools to advanced capabilities (e.g. power aware emulation).
* Experience with execution and RTL/firmware/software debug on hardware emulation (e.g., ZeBu Server, Palladium, Veloce) or FPGA (e.g., Xilinx, Altera).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 8 years of experience with full\-chip/SoC verification.
* Experience with EDA debug tools (e.g., Verdi, SimVision/Indago, GDB).
* Experience in programming and scripting in C, C\+\+, Python, Perl, or TCL.
* Experience with AI usage for enhancing emulation flows and debug.
* Understanding of SoC architecture and interfaces (e.g., DDR, PCIe, etc.).
* Understanding of RTL to Emulation/FPGA flows including emulation test benches, DFT and virtual machines (e.g., transactors/accelerated VIPs, hybrid, in\-circuit emulation).


**About The Job**
 In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting\-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML\-driven systems.
   

  

 In this role, you will help design, verify, and deploy ASIC projects through emulation based prototyping. You will work directly with other emulation Prototyping team members as well as Designers, Design Verification (DV) Engineers, Silicon Validation Engineers, and Software teams to deliver emulation based prototyping capabilities for our ASIC projects, including compiling projects managing our prototyping platforms, debugging issues in infrastructure and design, and assisting in the hardware and lab bring up and validation of our ASIC systems.
   

  

 The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.
   

  

 We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build full chip emulation or FPGA prototypes from complex SoC designs and deliver to multiple customers such as Software, Firmware, Platform, and Post\-Silicon Validation teams.
* Influence the Design and Verification teams to add emulation friendly model development.
* Bring up of system level emulation models through reset, boot, and bare metal content or OS.
* Work with Architects, Designers, Software Engineers, Pre and Post\-Silicon Verification Engineers to develop test plans, coverage, and to reproduce failures on emulation.
* Develop, execute, and debug full\-chip/System on a Chip (SoC) tests on emulation platforms. Explore new verification and emulation methodologies and implement them.

The platform unifies merchandise financial planning, WSSI/Merch Financial Planning, budget and OTB management, range and assortment planning, allocation and replenishment, visual merchandising, ERP, OMS, WMS, supplier collaboration, finance, and AI\-driven decision intelligence into a single connected source of truth.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 calculated planning measures behind it. You will own quality for that product.
 



 This is a quality assurance role that genuinely needs a planning brain. We are not looking for someone to follow a test script \- we are looking for someone who knows what a merchandise plan should do, and can say with authority whether the software is doing it.
 



  





**What you will do** 




 •    
 **Own test coverage for our WSSI planning product** 
  end to end, from planning grid through to committed data.
 



 •    
 **Test the full planning chain, not a single screen** 
  \- locked budget data feeds into WSSI, and WSSI in turn feeds weekly sales packs and assortment planning. You will verify that the numbers hold together as they move between them.
 



 •    
 **Cover allocation and store grading** 
  \- store grades and clusters, how purchase orders are distributed across stores, replenishment, and size splits. These depend on the same plan data, so they need testing as part of the same chain.
 



 •    
 **Define what “correct” looks like** 
  \- document the expected behaviour of each planning measure, including formulas, dependencies, rounding and rollup rules.
 



 •    
 **Build a trusted reference dataset** 
  that the wider engineering team can test against.
 



 •    
 **Verify data directly** 
 , using SQL against our databases and warehouse, as well as through the interface and APIs.
 



 •    
 **Work alongside developers** 
  to turn your expectations into automated regression checks that run continuously.
 



 •    
 **Bring an end\-to\-end view** 
  of the retail inventory planning cycle \- budget, range and assortment, buying, allocation, in\-season trading and reporting \- and hold us to it as a joined\-up process rather than a set of separate features.
 



  





**Your Experience \- What You Will Bring** 




**Essential:** 




 •   
 **Hands\-on experience of merchandise planning** 
 — either as a planner or allocator in a retail business, or implementing and validating planning systems for retail clients.
 



 •   
 **Solid command of planning mathematics** 
 : stock roll\-forward, open to buy, cover, sell\-through, markdown, weekly\-to\-period aggregation, and how changes at a summary level are allocated down to individual product lines.
 



 •    Confident writing your own SQL.
 



 •    
 **Clear, structured documentation skills** 
 — you can turn what you know into something the whole team can use.
 



 •    Experience with planning platforms
 



 •    API testing experience, or test automation exposure.
 



 • 
 **Background in a retail technology team or a software vendor serving retailers.** 




  





**You Might Be Coming From** 




 An implementation, functional or UAT consulting role on a retail planning platform, or a merchandise planning or allocation role in a retail business where you want to move into product and technology. Both routes work well here \- what matters is that you know the numbers.

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 Data Infrastructure \& Strategic Initiatives team is responsible for all the automation aspects of testing processes, ensuring quality of data and independent testing of corporate \& business level process and regulatory controls by providing seamless access to the appropriate data \& platforms required to execute the associated portfolio of tests.
   

  

 A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as “An independent point\-in\-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre\-defined pass/fail criteria.” Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite. Please note: This is not an application/software testing or application/software development role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an SME, drive sustainable automation in EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) test design, development, and implementation using a modern infrastructure and thoughtfully\-designed solutions. Additionally, train/mentor the Test Automation team and help with creating dashboards for the reporting purposes.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**

title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\- Assurance – Senior – Digital**
**Role** 
 :
 **GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety \& Reliability)**
**Position Details**
 As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG\-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit\-for\-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no\-go decisions.
   

  

 You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk \& compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional \+ non\-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk.
   

  

 This is a core full\-time role that requires a hands\-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q\&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi\-step workflows.
* Translate business use\-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red\-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements.
* Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams.
* Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across:
+ Core user journeys and primary business intents
+ Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
+ Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
+ Bias \& fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)

* Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e.g., minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk).
* Build reusable evaluation pipelines for:
+ Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
+ Grounding \& faithfulness (RAG\-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
+ Agentic behavior (tool\-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
+ Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)

* Combine LLM\-as\-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks).
* Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling:
+ batch runs on scenario suites
+ configurable metric definitions
+ reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
+ storage of traces and outputs for auditability

* Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples):
+ Prompt injection (direct \+ indirect) and tool hijacking
+ Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
+ Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
+ Training data leakage / memorization probes
+ Model denial\-of\-service / denial\-of\-wallet patterns

* Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre\-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers.
* Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows:
+ tool misuse / over\-permissioned tool access
+ unauthorized action execution
+ exfiltration via tools/connectors
+ prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)

* Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least\-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts.
* Produce high\-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision\-ready, including:
+ methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
+ quantitative results
+ qualitative results
+ risk assessment summary and recommended control actions

* Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk\-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no\-go.


**Key Requirements/Skills \& Qualification:**
* Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments.
* 4–7\+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas:
+ ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
+ security testing / red teaming
+ building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness.

* Strong hands\-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines).
* Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi\-agent systems, memory, routing.
* Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design).
* Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias).
* Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls.
* Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns.
* Familiarity with secure\-by\-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring.
* Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses.
* Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes.
* Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse\-style traces, dashboards.
* Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments.
* Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical \+ non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to challenge assumptions constructively (“effective challenge”) and influence engineering teams toward remediation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast\-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape.


**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset).
* Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts).
* Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain\-heavy enterprise assistants.
* Hands\-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault).


**Additional skills requirements:**
* Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
* Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self\-discipline.
* Must have demonstrated project management experience.
* Knowledge of firm’s reporting tools and processes.
* Proactive, organized, and self\-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask.
* Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions.
* Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources.
* A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 7200 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead Testing Services Consultant
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like
   

  

**what we’re saying, keep reading!**
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
 The Lead Testing Services Consultant at SimCorp, provides leadership in the planning, execution, and optimization of testing services to ensure the delivery of high\-quality solutions. With typically 7\+ years of experience in testing or quality assurance, this role works independently to manage complex testing projects, drive process improvements, and mentor junior team members. The Lead Consultant collaborates with cross\-functional teams, ensures that testing activities meet organizational goals, and contributes to the overall success of service delivery
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Lead the design and execution of comprehensive test plans, ensuring high standards of quality and performance for SimCorp solutions
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define testing requirements, align on project goals, and ensure full test coverage
* Analyze and resolve complex testing issues, implementing effective solutions in a timely manner
* Optimize testing processes and adopt best practices to improve efficiency and reduce the time to delivery
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, enhancing skill development and promoting high\-quality testing standards
* Monitor and analyze testing metrics to assess performance and identify areas for continuous improvement
* Develop and maintain detailed documentation for test plans, cases, and results, ensuring thorough records of testing efforts
* Provide advanced insights on testing strategies, tools, and technologies to ensure the most effective solutions are being used


**WHAT WE VALUE:**
* Managing testing projects to ensure solutions meet quality and performance standards
* Collaborating with development, QA, and operations teams to integrate testing into the overall service delivery process
* Implementing initiatives to introduce automated testing tools and frameworks to enhance testing efficiency
* Conducting root cause analyses for recurring testing issues and ensuring long\-term solutions are in place
* Engaging with clients and stakeholders to communicate testing progress, results, and potential risks
* Facilitating training sessions and knowledge sharing to promote best practices in testing within the team
* Monitoring trends and advancements in testing technologies to ensure the adoption of up\-to\-date tools
* Managing escalations and ensuring timely resolution of complex testing challenges


**Benefits**
 Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work\-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.
   

  

 Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route \- we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
   

  

**NEXT STEPS**
 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually
 **. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** 
 At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 For any questions you are welcome to contact
 **Swati Pal (Swati.pal@simcorp.com)** 
 , Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**WHO WE ARE?**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

title: Sr. SQE Performance Testing
description:
**Join the team as our new Senior Software Quality Engineer \- Performance Testing**
**Hyderabad, India \| Software Quality CoE**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Senior SQE \- Performance Testing to lead and own the end\-to\-end performance engineering lifecycle. The ideal candidate will contribute to defining the performance testing strategy, execute large\-scale load tests, and deliver actionable insights through robust reporting and analytics. This role will be part of the Software Quality CoE, and it demands strong technical expertise, critical thinking, and the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
   

  

 Additionally, this role requires leveraging modern AI/LLM tools to enhance productivity in automation, performance scripting, test design, and result analysis.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Performance Testing Strategy \& Ownership**
* Drive the overall performance testing strategy aligned with business and product goals.
* Own the end\-to\-end performance testing lifecycle, including planning, scripting, execution, monitoring, and reporting.


**Test Design \& Execution**
* Design and implement scalable load, stress, endurance, and spike test scenarios.
* Develop and maintain performance test frameworks and reusable assets.
* Execute tests to validate system scalability, reliability, and stability under load.


**Analysis \& Reporting**
* Analyze performance bottlenecks across application, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Deliver detailed performance reports, dashboards, and analytics with actionable recommendations.


**Collaboration \& Continuous Integration**
* Collaborate with development, DevOps, and architecture teams to resolve performance issues.
* Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous performance validation.
* Drive performance optimization initiatives and ensure SLAs/SLOs are met.


**What It Takes**
**Technical**
* 5 to 8 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Engineering.
* Strong expertise in any of the performance testing tools (code as a test) such as Gatling, K6, Locust, or similar.
* Solid understanding of performance testing methodologies, workload modeling, and capacity planning.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring \& observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar).
* Strong exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, etc.).
* Experience analyzing system metrics (CPU, memory, I/O, network, database performance).
* Proficiency in any scripting/programming language (Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized systems (Docker, Kubernetes).


**Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present performance insights to stakeholders.
* Ability to take ownership and make data\-driven decisions in high\-pressure scenarios.
* A team player who can challenge constructively and drive quality excellence.


**Mindset**
* A strong quality mindset with attention to detail and deep curiosity to identify system limits.
* Hands\-on, proactive, and continuously learning.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) or Digital Manufacturing domains.
* Experience in API performance testing and microservices architecture.
* Knowledge of shift\-left performance testing and performance engineering practices.

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Beacon Platform By CWAN**
 Beacon is a cloud\-native, cross\-asset risk analytics and quantitative development platform used by top\-tier asset managers and banks. It provides a transparent, extensible environment for building, deploying and scaling valuation models, pricing libraries and risk analytics across asset classes — including derivatives, structured products and fixed income. It combines pre\-built financial applications with a flexible developer infrastructure that lets quants and model developers write custom pricing and valuation logic, run scenario analysis, and integrate models directly into front\-office and risk workflows.
   

  

 The role
   

  

* You will own the reliability of Clearwater's risk and analytics applications in engineering terms — designing and building the automation, tooling and operational architecture that keeps the overnight and intraday pipelines correct and on time for asset managers and insurers who need to see their portfolios each morning.
* This is a senior engineering role on the application layer. The distinction that matters at this level: you are expected to retire classes of failure, not instances of them. When the same problem appears for the third time, we want the engineer who stops patching it and builds the thing that makes it impossible to fail. That work competes for time with the model and feature changes the quant and risk teams are asking for, so you will also need to argue for it in their terms — what the recurring failure is costing them now, and what fixing it properly buys them. Cloud fluency matters because the applications run on AWS and you need to operate them competently there, but you will not be provisioning the infrastructure beneath them.
* You will be based in Mumbai alongside the market data team — a group with front\-office training who partner on the genuinely hard analytics questions, not only on data plumbing. That adjacency is the point of the placement: you will sit with the quant, risk and market data teams and be expected to learn what the systems actually compute. When a curve build fails or an end\-of\-day risk run finishes late, we want engineers who can reason about which clients are affected and what the number means.
* The team is part of a globally distributed platform organisation spanning Mumbai, Tokyo and the US, with US\-based coverage for the London close, so every major market cutoff falls inside a staffed window. You will join and help shape a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation covering the end\-of\-day cycles of multiple regions. We are explicit about this because the three\-region model is what keeps it sustainable — there is no permanent night shift.
* You will have real ownership of the services you support and direct influence over how reliability is engineered into them. You will report to the support lead in Mumbai.


 What you'll do
   

  

 Design and build the tooling layer
   

  

* Own the diagnostic tooling strategy — including AI\-assisted tooling — so that establishing whether an issue is infrastructure or market data, and which clients it touches, takes seconds rather than a manual trawl through logs and jobs. Tooling, not documentation alone, is how we intend to get response times down.
* Write and review production\-quality Python that eliminates toil: runbook automation, health checks, self\-service diagnostics and remediation used across the team.
* Design automated recovery and self\-healing for analytics jobs, so a single failed task does not become a missed client deliverable.
* Set the observability standard — design monitoring and alerting around business outcomes (late valuations, missing risk measures, stale prices) rather than host and container metrics, and drive alert noise down so pages are actionable and rare.


 Own production and lead incidents
   

  

* Own incident response for client\-impacting issues: command the incident, mitigate, communicate, and run blameless postmortems that end in fixes rather than findings.
* Investigate at the application level — logs, stack traces, job histories and the code itself — to establish root cause, then fix it or hand the development team a diagnosis precise enough to act on.
* Track service commitments and recurring pain: report on timeliness and failure trends, and push through the fixes that retire repeat issues.
* Set the boundary for first\-line infrastructure work — stale hosts, memory pressure, connectivity failures, host loss — so routine cases are remediated locally and deeper platform work escalates cleanly.


 Harden the batch and end\-of\-day architecture
   

  

* Own and harden large\-scale batch and EOD processing: job orchestration, dependency management, retries, idempotency, backfills and safe reruns.
* Keep the overnight window on schedule — find where time is going across stages and drive the fixes with the development teams.


 Own the data and market data interface
   

  

* Support the reference data, market data and timeseries stores behind pricing and risk — schema and index design, replication, retention and query performance in NoSQL and timeseries systems.
* Operate data quality and reconciliation controls with the market data team: completeness checks, stale\-data and anomaly alerting, vendor feed failure handling.
* Debug data\-shaped production problems — a missing fixing, a bad identifier mapping, a holiday calendar difference, a failed download job, a partial vendor file — traced through to the affected downstream analytics.
* Act as a single escalation path with the market data team on front\-office\-facing issues, sharing triage and root cause rather than passing tickets between functions.


 Lead and influence
   

  

* Partner with quant developers and risk engineers to make reliability a design input rather than a post\-launch concern.
* Mentor engineers on incident triage, investigation technique and on\-call practice, and set the standards for automation and operational readiness.
* Contribute to production readiness reviews for new services and client onboardings.
* Support client escalations on risk and analytics output, and be the person client\-facing teams want in the room during an incident.
* Document architecture, runbooks and failure modes.


 What you'll bring
   

  

**Required**
* 7\+ years in software engineering for a business\-critical platform, with real ownership of services.
* Strong Python, plus shell. You must be comfortable reading and debugging application code to find root cause — this role is not runbook execution.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting depth — working from a vague client symptom through logs, job histories, data and code to a precise diagnosis.
* Hands\-on experience operating batch and scheduled workloads at scale, including workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Step Functions or equivalent).
* Solid grounding in distributed systems — you can reason about partial failure, retries, idempotency, consistency, and queue and backpressure behaviour under load.
* Working knowledge of AWS — enough to operate applications confidently (compute, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, basic networking) and to tell an infrastructure problem from an application one.
* Practical NoSQL experience (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra or similar): data modelling, indexing, replication and performance troubleshooting.
* Observability in practice — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry or equivalent — and sensible alert design.
* On\-call experience with structured escalation and postmortem writing, and the judgement to lead an incident rather than only participate in one.
* A general understanding of financial systems and genuine appetite to learn the business. You should be able to hold a conversation about what a valuation or a risk number is for, and be willing to go deeper.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Degree (B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MSc) in computer science, engineering or a related field.


**Preferred**
