description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering

title: Sr Associate Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Internationalization Software Engineer**
**About The Job**
 The Globalization Experience Team is searching for an Internationalization Software Engineer responsible for creating, enhancing, and maintaining robust software and tooling so SAS products work correctly for global users across languages, locales, and character sets. This role focuses on building and integrating foundational internationalization capabilities—Unicode correctness, locale‑sensitive formatting and sorting, and string externalization/resource management—while partnering with product teams to embed best practices early in the software development cycle. You’ll also use AI\-assisted techniques (when appropriate) to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation, helping teams deliver global\-ready software efficiently and consistently.
   

  

**As An Internationalization AI Software Developer, You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain software, libraries, and tooling that enable product teams to efficiently build high‑quality, global‑ready software in compliance with SAS Internationalization guidelines and standards.
* Work effectively in mature and legacy code to resolve customer\-impacting defects, coordinating with support and product teams to deliver patch updates for high\-priority fixes with strong testing and regression awareness to protect production behavior
* Partner closely with cross‑functional stakeholders—including product development teams, product managers, project managers, support engineers, and testers—to integrate internationalization best practices early and throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with internationalization testers to guide testing strategies, investigate defects, and drive engineering improvements that result in high‑quality, globally usable product deliverables.
* Use AI\-assisted tools responsibly as part of day‑to‑day engineering (e.g., accelerating code review and refactoring suggestions, log/defect triage, test generation, and documentation) while ensuring correctness, traceability, and alignment with SAS development standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience as a software developer, with hands‑on experience applying internationalization best practices and working with industry‑standard libraries such as ICU and CLDR.
* Experience using modern developer productivity tools (including AI\-assisted coding and review tools) to improve delivery speed and quality, with an understanding of validation practices (tests, reviews, and responsible use).
* Proficiency in one or more of the following programming languages: Go, Python, and C, with the ability to read, understand, and contribute to production codebases.
* Working proficiency in shell scripting (e.g., Bash or similar) to support automation, tooling, or development workflows.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross‑functional teams including developers, testers, and product stakeholders.
* Hands‑on experience using GitHub in a team environment, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code review processes.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence as part of an Agile development process, including issue tracking, planning, and documentation.
* Ability to adjust working hours to accommodate a variety of time zones
* You’re curious, passionate, authentic and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.


**Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience with SAS programming or familiarity with SAS language, tools, or development environments.
* Experience with TypeScript and Java Script a plus.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, including build, test, or deployment automation.
* Proficiency in additional spoken language.

title: IT Quality Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
Citi is looking for a Senior IT Quality Analyst to lead quality assurance across complex trading platform environments, ensuring that software meets the highest standards before reaching production. In this role, you will own UAT processes, drive test automation strategy, and serve as a senior quality voice across cross\-functional technology teams. Your work will directly influence the reliability and integrity of systems that support Futures and Options trading on a global scale.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead User Acceptance Testing initiatives for trading platform products, translating complex business requirements into structured test strategies and ensuring seamless rollout to production.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and scenarios using Java and Cucumber (BDD), improving test coverage and reducing time\-to\-market for critical system releases.
* Monitor software products and development processes for conformance to quality standards, identify risks and implement corrective actions to maintain compliance across the software development lifecycle.
* Conduct root cause analyses on quality failures, document findings with precision, and independently recommend process improvements that elevate team\-wide quality outcomes.
* Analyze complex trade data — including order types and execution flows — to validate system behavior and ensure alignment with FIX protocol and electronic trading regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate test strategy development and execution across project teams, global stakeholders, and third\-party vendors, ensuring consistent delivery against timelines and quality benchmarks.
* Gather, maintain, and report on quality metrics to provide leadership and project teams with clear visibility into testing progress, defect trends, and risk posture.
* Mentor and coach junior quality analysts, sharing technical expertise and contributing to the team's overall development.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 10 or more years of experience in an IT Quality or software quality assurance role, with demonstrated ownership across the full testing lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience testing trading platforms, with a solid understanding of Futures and Options products, order types, and electronic trading processes.
* Proficiency in test automation using Java and Behavior\-Driven Development frameworks, specifically Cucumber, with the ability to write, modify, and execute complex automated test scripts.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, container environments (ECS), and version control using GitHub, enabling integration of quality practices into modern delivery workflows.
* Good understanding of the FIX protocol, regulatory obligations for electronic trading, and the ability to validate system behavior against these standards.
* Ability to write complex queries and work with reporting tools to analyses large volumes of trade and system data effectively.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across project teams, vendors, and global counterparts to align on quality outcomes.


**Beneficial Skills \& Qualifications**
* Project management experience, with the ability to plan, track, and communicate quality workstreams within fast\-paced, time\-sensitive delivery programmes.
* Experience defining and documenting business requirements, bridging the gap between technology teams and business stakeholders to ensure test coverage reflects real\-world use cases.
* Prior involvement in vendor management, including coordinating quality activities and testing accountability across third\-party technology providers.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Senior System and Application Engineer
description:
**Overview** 




 NXP’s Wireless Connectivity group is building the next generation of wireless chipsets for Automotive, Gaming, IoT, Industrial and Smart\-Home devices.
 



 These chipsets will define ultra\-low power, high performance and low latency benchmarks for products that rely on Wi\-Fi, BT/BLE and 802\.15\.4
 



 We’re looking for a strong, self\-driven and curious System \& Application Engineer with a focus on SW.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Design, implement and unit test for NXP’s Software Solution on Wi\-Fi/Bluetooth/IoT solutions on existing as well as upcoming SoC
* Involved in designing Software solutions for bug fixes for customer reported issues, adding enhancement to existing features etc
* Debugging issues reported by customers as required on various platforms
* Providing technical support to customers during their evaluation and integration of NXP’s Wireless Connectivity solutions
* Working with Marketing, Sales and Field Application Engineers to understand customers use cases and requirements, and influence next generation products



  





**Qualifications\-** 



* MS/ME/MTECH with 6\+ years of experience in EE, CE, CS or equivalent is required
* Strong experience in embedded systems, operating systems including RTOS, Linux operating systems, kernel internals
* Experience with C programming and debugging is a must
* Very good understanding on Networking components like TCP/IP
* Having a background on Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, 15\.4 protocol a significant advantage
* Exposure to ARM processor architecture is required
* Experience with SDIO/PCIe/USB bus interface is preferred
* Need to work independently on tasks from understanding the requirements, to design, implementation and testing. Also need to work cross function teams
* Effective interpersonal, teamwork, and communication skills



  





 More information about NXP in India...

title: Automation Excellence Lead
description:
**Maersk Position Description**
* Business Title : Automation Excellence Lead
* Job level : JL4
* Department or Business Unit: Automation Excellence
* Supervisory Responsibilities: No
* Reports to: Head of Automation Excellence


**About The Role**
 The Automation Excellence Lead is responsible for driving the design, development, and deployment of next\-generation AI\-enabled solutions that transform how business processes operate across GSC. The role combines expertise in Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Workflow Automation, and Process Transformation to create scalable, intelligent, and autonomous business capabilities.
   

  

 The role serves as a technical leader, solution architect, and innovation catalyst, partnering with business stakeholders, Product Owners, technology teams and SMEs to translate business challenges into AI\-powered enterprise solutions. The position is expected to lead complex automation and AI initiatives while mentoring teams and establishing best practices for enterprise AI adoption.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
 :
   

  

**AI \& Intelligent Automation Strategy**
* Drive adoption of AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI capabilities across business processes.
* Identify opportunities to transform manual and rule\-based activities into intelligent autonomous workflows.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend enterprise adoption strategies.
* Contribute to the AI and automation roadmap aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with stakeholders to define high\-value AI use cases and business transformation opportunities.


**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Architect enterprise\-grade automation and AI solutions using Power Platform, Python, Azure AI Services, Copilot Studio, OpenAI, and related technologies.
* Design scalable AI architectures including RAG, multi\-agent systems, autonomous AI workflows, intelligent document processing, conversational AI, and process intelligence solutions.
* Define integration strategies across enterprise applications, APIs, databases, knowledge platforms, and workflow systems.
* Create reusable solution patterns, frameworks, components, and technical blueprints to accelerate delivery.


**Generative AI \& Agentic AI Development**
* Design and develop enterprise GenAI solutions leveraging LLMs and foundation models.
* Build intelligent AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, orchestrating, and executing business activities.
* Develop multi\-agent ecosystems supporting end\-to\-end business processes.
* Create AI copilots and digital assistants for operations, customer support, productivity, decision intelligence, and employee self\-service.
* Establish reusable agent frameworks, prompt libraries, connectors, and orchestration patterns.


**Technical Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex automation and AI initiatives from discovery to production adoption.
* Provide technical guidance, solution architecture oversight, and design review across projects.
* Establish coding standards, AI development standards, reusable frameworks, and quality engineering practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, solution governance assessments, and technical risk evaluations.
* Mentor developers and AI engineers on emerging technologies, technical design, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices.


**Innovation \& Capability Building**
* Drive experimentation with emerging AI technologies through proofs of concept, pilots, and rapid prototypes.
* Promote AI awareness, adoption, and practical use case identification across business functions.
* Contribute to AI community of practice, Automation Excellence standards, and Center of Excellence initiatives.
* Support capability\-building programs for AI, automation, prompt engineering, agentic design, and responsible AI.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business SMEs, and Technology Teams
* Translate business problems into scalable AI and automation solutions with clear business outcomes.
* Present solution recommendations, roadmaps, technical options, risks, and value realization outcomes to leadership.
* Drive alignment between business priorities, technology investments, delivery capacity, and adoption readiness.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in Automation, Software Engineering, AI Engineering, or Digital Transformation.
* 7\+ years of experience delivering AI, ML, GenAI, or intelligent automation solutions.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale automation and AI initiatives.
* Experience working with global stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, and business transformation programs.


**Technical Skills**
**Skill Area**
**Expected Capabilities**
**AI \& GenAI**
 Azure OpenAI, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, model evaluation, AI agent design patterns, hallucination mitigation, model monitoring, and governance.
   

  

**AI Platforms**
 Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Services, AI Builder, knowledge platforms, vector databases, and enterprise search patterns.
   

  

**Agentic AI**
 Design of autonomous agents, multi\-agent orchestration, tool use, planning, reasoning, workflow execution, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and agent monitoring.
   

  

**Programming**

title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
**About SaveIN** 
 : SaveIN is a Y\-Combinator\-backed fintech company on a mission to make financial products accessible and affordable for every Indian. We offer Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) and no\-cost EMI solutions through a growing network of Banks, NBFCs, and lending partners, enabling consumers to fund healthcare, education, and everyday needs without financial stress.
 



  





**About the Role** 
 : SaveIN is looking for a Senior QA Engineer with a strong automation focus to help us scale test coverage across our lending and payments platform. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and compliance teams to ensure the reliability, security, and correctness of systems that handle real money movement and sensitive customer data.
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-Time
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 days a week
 



**Mode of Work:** 
 On\-Site
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3\-5 years
 



**Reporting To** 
 : CTO
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (API, UI, and regression) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Own the test strategy for critical customer journeys, including onboarding, credit decisioning, disbursement, and repayment/collections.
* Build and maintain automation frameworks for testing integrations with bank partners (HDFC, ICICI, IDFC First) and bureau/KYC providers.
* Identify gaps in test coverage and proactively build automated regression suites to reduce manual QA dependency.
* Collaborate with developers to "shift testing left" by embedding test gates into CI/CD alongside SAST/security checks.
* Perform API contract testing, load/performance testing, and data validation for financial transactions.
* Write clear, reproducible bug reports and work with engineering to drive root\-cause fixes.
* Contribute to the test data management strategy, especially around PII/DPDP\-compliant sandbox data.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help formalize QA processes, test documentation, and release sign\-off criteria.
* Participate in production incident reviews to identify testing gaps that could have caught issues earlier.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3\-5 years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong hands\-on automation focus.
* Proficiency with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured, Karate).
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and integrating automated tests.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and backend testing.
* Experience testing REST APIs, webhooks, and third\-party integrations.
* Basic scripting ability (Java/Python/JavaScript) for writing and maintaining test scripts.
* Understanding of the software testing lifecycle, including test planning, traceability, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Prior experience in fintech, banking, or lending products is a strong plus (understanding of KYC, credit underwriting, or payment flows).
* Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6\) is a plus.
* Exposure to security testing basics (e.g., OWASP Top 10\) is a plus, given the regulated environment.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Experience testing systems with multiple bank/NBFC integrations.
* Familiarity with compliance\-driven QA (e.g., audit trails, RBI/data protection considerations).
* Interest in AI\-assisted testing tools/agentic QA workflows, as this is a growing focus area for our team.

title: Java Module Lead
description:

*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*

**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges



**Required Skills**



* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns



**Experience**



* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies



**Tech Stack**



* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube



******Additional Information******




**Required Qualifications:**
  

 Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent
   

  

  

  

**Personal Skills:**



* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.



****Additional Information****




**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**



* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* •24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more



**The Location:**




 Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.
   

  





**Why Should You Apply?**



* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.



**Start date: ASAP**




 Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

title: Technical Lead
description:
This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will write
 **production code every day** 
 , and you will lead by building the hardest parts yourself.
 



 It is
 **not a management role** 
 . There is no team to administer, no appraisal cycle, no delivery meetings in place of engineering. If you have moved away from daily coding, this role will not suit you.
 



  





**Our Primary tech stack:** 



* React
* React Native
* Python
* Salesforce
* Cloud\-native, across all major clouds
* An agentic layer running through all of it
* Whatever else the client needs



  





**What you will own:** 



* **The build.** 
 Production code every week, on the parts that matter most. Design, write, review, ship.
* **Agentic systems.** 
 LLM\-driven features running in production for clients. Agents, tool calling, retrieval, evaluation, and the cost and latency behind each choice.
* **The technical standard.** 
 Design and code reviews for two or three engineers working alongside you.
* **Delivery.** 
 Scope, estimate, sequence and commitment date. When a date is at risk you raise it before it moves.
* **Technical discussions with clients.** 
 Requirements, trade\-offs, and what is possible by when.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 6–8 years in software engineering, hands\-on throughout
* Python, with production depth
* React, and React Native for mobile
* Cloud in production on AWS, Azure or GCP, deployed and operated by you
* Production code written in the last 90 days
* An LLM or agent feature you have built and shipped to production
* Experience leading engineers technically, through reviews, standards and design decisions
* Delivery ownership: you have carried a date and answered for it
* Able to work hybrid from Coimbatore



  





**Preferred:** 



* Both startup and large\-organisation experience
* Daily use of AI engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor or Copilot, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* You follow the field closely and form views by building with new models and tooling rather than reading about them
* Salesforce
* Client\-facing experience, in India or abroad



  





**Process:** 




 Screening call, technical discussion, delivery and leadership conversation, offer. We aim to close within two weeks of first contact.

title: TechOps - DE - AMS - Gen AI Automation And AIOps Engineer - Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Position Title: TechOps \- Senior – Digital Engineering Operations – AI / Automation Engineer**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Senior in EY GDS Tech Ops practice, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent systems that streamline business and IT Operational processes by integrating Artificial Intelligence (LLMs, NLP, Vision) with automation tools (RPA, APIs). You will identify opportunities, build and operationalize AI, and automation solutions, and ensuring alignment with EY’s quality standards and client expectations. This role requires a senior developer with experience in building, deploying and managing AI \& automation solution in managed services engagements.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Design and develop AI\-powered automation workflows
* Integrate LLMs (e.g., GPT), NLP, and computer vision models into existing systems via APIs.
* Identify, analyse, and automate repetitive tasks across the life cycle of operations and engineer.
* Write custom scripts (mostly Python) to connect disparate platforms and build automation logic.
* Monitor, maintain, and debug automated workflows to ensure reliability and high performance.
* Create technical documentation and best\-practice guidelines for deployed automation solutions.
* Collaborate with AI Platform team to identify, integrate and manage AI and point solutions into the AI Platforms.
* Collaborate with AI, Automation, Operations, Engineering, and business stakeholders to identify, build, and operationalize AI and automation solutions.
* Drive adoption of AI, automation, tools and accelerators across engagements and practices.
* Support business development efforts involving automation \& AI solution including proposals, presentations, and client workshops.
* Ensure compliance with EY’s risk management and security standards.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong knowledge of Python and experience with API integration.
* Familiarity with RPA tools like UiPath, Power Automate, or Automation Anywhere.
* Ability to analyse complex processes and design automated solutions.
* Experience building AI and automation solutions \& tools in managed services engagements is a plus.
* Understanding of ITSM, and ITIL methodologies is a plus.
* Excellent communication and ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify automation opportunities.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* 5\+ years of overall experience, with at least 2 years in developing, implementing and managing AI \& automation solutions and tools.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG architecture, NLP frameworks, AI Ops, low\-code tools and scripting languages (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript)


**What we look for:**
* Enthusiastic learners with a passion for Python and experience with API integration \& RPA tools like UiPath, Power Automate
* Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.
* Team players who can collaborate effectively in a remote or hybrid work environment.
* Detail\-oriented professionals with strong documentation skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

title: Engineering Lead - AI
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross\-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology \| CBS Technology \| Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI \& Automation**
**Job Summary:**
 The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands\-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production\-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
   

  

 Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
   

  

**The ideal candidate will possess:**
* Extensive, hands\-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and data\-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non\-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production\-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM\-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI\-first architectures, including LLM\-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real\-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.


**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Engineering Ownership \& Delivery Accountability
+ Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:
- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade\-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go\-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.


* Hands\-on GenAI \& AI Systems Engineering
* 
+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production\-grade GenAI systems, including:
- Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool\-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human\-in\-the\-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:
- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.


* Architecture \& Engineering Standards
+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:
- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.


* AI Platform Engineering \& MLOps / LLMOps
+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:
- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non\-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.


* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI \& Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:
- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production\-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.


* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
+ Partner closely with:
- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.


**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**
* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production\-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go\-live, including reliability and cost optimization.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
 **real, reliable, and scalable systems** 
 —not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Python, Java, C\#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API\-driven, cloud\-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.


**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications, including:
+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool\-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:
+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.


**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**
* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.


**Detailed Responsibilities:**
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end\-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision\-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.


**Other Requirements:**
* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience


**Experience:**
* 10\+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3\+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3\+ Years in a global operations environment


**Certification Requirements:**
* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services

As a Technical Test Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end testing strategies, driving test automation initiatives, and mentoring the QA team. Your leadership will help ensure quality standards across all aspects of the SDLC—from planning to delivery. You will work closely with development, DevOps, and business teams to align QA efforts with overall project goals.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Define and own the overall automation testing strategy, ensuring alignment with project and product goals.
* Identify areas suitable for automation, perform ROI analysis, and prioritize test cases for automation.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable automation frameworks for both UI and API testing using industry best practices (e.g., Hybrid, BDD, POM).
* Lead the creation of comprehensive automation test plans outlining objectives, scope, tools, timelines, risks, and mitigation strategies aligned with business goals.
* Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites for web applications, REST APIs, and backend services.
* Review automation code, test scripts, and execution results to ensure quality, maintainability, and adherence to automation standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios and automation solutions.
* Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines and ensure reliable execution as part of the continuous delivery process.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve automation framework, environment, configuration, and test data issues to improve execution stability and reliability.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to QA engineers by establishing automation standards, coding practices, and testing best practices.
* Monitor automation coverage, execution trends, defect metrics, and overall quality KPIs, providing regular status updates to stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in testing processes, automation frameworks, tooling, and overall quality engineering practices.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives as part of Agile teams.
* Evaluate and recommend new testing tools, frameworks, AI\-assisted solutions, and engineering practices to continuously enhance the QA automation capability.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools and workflows to improve requirement analysis, test design, automation development, defect analysis, and overall QA productivity.

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager Testing with 15 years of experience in Software Testing, Test Automation, and Quality Assurance Engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for shaping QA and automation strategies, leading testing teams, supporting RFP responses, presales and solutioning initiatives, and driving the adoption of modern quality engineering practices, including CI/CD, Continuous Testing, and AI\-enabled testing. This role requires a strong blend of technical leadership, testing practice management, solutioning expertise, and client engagement experience to drive quality transformation across complex technology programs. Experience in Digital Commerce, Retail, or other large\-scale customer\-facing platforms is highly desirable.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Define and lead enterprise and programme\-level Quality Assurance strategies aligned with business objectives, technology architecture, delivery models, and risk. Assess existing testing practices and establish QA transformation roadmaps, target operating models, governance frameworks, engineering standards, and measurable quality outcomes.
* Design scalable, maintainable, and fit\-for\-purpose test automation architectures covering UI, API, integration, component, contract, and end\-to\-end testing. Define automation frameworks, reusable components, test\-data strategies, reporting, environment requirements, maintenance approaches, and technology selection based on application architecture, project requirements, scalability, maintainability, and overall QA strategy.
* Define and implement CI/CD\-integrated Quality Assurance and continuous testing strategies that provide fast, reliable, and actionable feedback throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Establish appropriate test execution strategies across pull requests, builds, deployments, integration and staging environments, regression cycles, and production validation.
* Address and optimise the practical engineering challenges associated with continuous testing, including pipeline efficiency, test reliability, execution time, environment readiness, test\-data management, dependencies, parallelisation, selective test execution, quality gates, and pipeline stability. Establish practices such as test impact analysis, risk\-based test selection, mocking, tagging, and other optimisation techniques to improve feedback time and pipeline reliability.
* Define and monitor QA and CI/CD metrics including automation coverage, execution time, test reliability, flakiness, pipeline stability, defect leakage, release confidence, and other relevant engineering and business outcomes.
* Define and lead Performance Testing strategies for critical applications, services, and customer journeys, covering workload modelling, test planning, scripting, execution, scalability, capacity assessment, performance monitoring, bottleneck identification, detailed test\-result analysis, performance optimisation, and performance regression.
* Lead detailed analysis of Performance Test results by correlating application, infrastructure, and monitoring metrics to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, resource utilisation issues, and system\-level degradation. Translate findings into actionable recommendations for performance optimisation, scalability, capacity planning, and engineering improvements.
* Define and implement API, Contract, and Component Testing strategies, establishing the appropriate balance across component, contract, API, integration, UI, end\-to\-end, and performance testing based on application architecture, business risk, and delivery requirements.
* Define test planning and test case design approaches across programmes, ensuring appropriate test scope, scenarios, coverage, traceability, risk\-based prioritisation, test data, environment requirements, entry/exit criteria, and execution strategies aligned with business and technical requirements.
* Partner with Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and Platform Engineering teams within and outside the organisation to embed quality throughout the software development and delivery lifecycle and promote shift\-left, continuous testing, and engineering\-led quality practices.
* Lead or significantly contribute to RFP, RFI, RFQ, presales, and client solutioning engagements from a Quality Assurance perspective. Translate client requirements and technology challenges into differentiated QA solutions, including QA strategies, automation architectures, CI/CD and continuous testing approaches, performance strategies, implementation roadmaps, effort estimates, resource models, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, risks, delivery approaches, and expected outcomes. Participate in client discovery sessions, solution workshops, proposal discussions, technical presentations, and solution defence activities.
* Drive the adoption of AI, GenAI, Agentic, and MCP\-based testing across Quality Assurance, identifying and implementing high\-value use cases such as test generation, automation code generation, test maintenance, test\-data generation, failure and defect analysis, intelligent test selection, test optimisation, and test\-result analysis. Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI\-enabled solutions capable of planning, generating, executing, analysing, and adapting testing activities.
* Mentor and develop QA professionals across technical testing, test automation, performance testing, modern testing practices, solutioning, proposals, RFP/RFI/RFQ engagements, and client\-facing activities. Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, coaching, and career development support while building strong testing capabilities and technical leadership within the team.
* Act as a trusted Quality Assurance advisor to senior stakeholders and clients, providing technical direction, influencing technology and delivery decisions, communicating risks and recommendations, and aligning QA outcomes with broader business objectives.

title: Manager, Product Management
description:
Manages the entire product life cycle for certain product(s) (e.g., hardware, software, wireless, web products, medical devices, etc.) from planning to execution to support the organization's strategy and objectives. Develops and directs marketing programs for a significant product or product category. Compiles and evaluates research on the market's product requirements and identifies enhancements to current features and functionality. Establishes marketing strategies, including product direction, advertising, packaging, pricing, expense budgets, profit plans and future product development, to manage a product or product category's life cycle. Interfaces with engineers, designers, suppliers and customers to develop product requirements and specifications. Prepares and coordinates product introductions and updates.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Electronics Solutions division of Nordson delivers cutting\-edge engineering and applications excellence to the world’s semiconductor, automotive electronics, printed circuit boards and precision assembly manufacturer with innovative fluid dispensing and surface treatment solutions. As part of the Growth and Strategy group for this $250M\+\+ division, the Technical Product Manager (TPM) is responsible for the development, and performance of a product line.
   

  

 The TPM oversee the product’s lifecycle, from conception (working with Market Manager and New Product Development Engineering) to discontinuation. This may include supervising Product Line Specialists who are located in the factory/manufacturing sites where the product is made. The TPM provides leadership within the organization to ensure competitiveness of assigned products and development of strategies to grow revenue profitably.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities**
* Using the NBS Next Phase Gate process in the development of new products, provide leadership in Phases 0\-2 i.e. \#0 Project Request; \#1 Planning/Feasibility; \#2 Proj Requirements where clear technical and commercial requirements are articulated and documented for NPD Engineering.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams in Sales, Operation, Marketing and NPD, to ensure successful product launches and iterations with messaging, marketing collateral, sales tools and aids for sales force.
* Continuously analyze market trends and customer feedback to identify opportunities of growth and improvement for existing products.
* Lead cross\-functional efforts for creating competitive offerings.
* 
* Maintain and communicate internally the competitive landscape of our market/products
+ Build internal knowledge of the competitive landscape by supporting MEKKO updates.
+ Develop and maintain tools/processes to collect the latest competitive information and analyzing data to advise on pricing, strategies, future opportunities, etc.
+ Produces competitive analysis materials comparing product with its key competitors for features and pricing in different geographies
+ Lead quarterly competitive reviews/updates
+ Participates in development of market share assessment and price/performance positioning as needed for existing and new products

* Monitor customer satisfaction and contribute to Operations/Sustaining Continuous Improvement projects, Quality and Cost of Poor Quality programs, etc.
* Leads NBS Next Simplification efforts on product lines to ensure progress towards Leadership Level Performance.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree and mechanical or electrical engineering is a plus
* Seven to ten years experience in product or market management role. Demonstrated ability to lead growth initiatives and provide guidance to the company about investment opportunities.
* Possess a highly developed attention to detail with strong organizational and project management skills
* Five years experience people management with proven track record at industrial manufacturing environment
* Thorough and accurate, good analytical skills, problem solver, team oriented individual
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Business acumen and the ability to effectively present the organization and its products
* Establish credibility, rapport, respect, and trust throughout the Division, be viewed as a team player, and work effectively in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* High proficiency with Microsoft Office – Excel, PPT etc.
* Knowledge of SAP a plus


**Preferred Skills And Abilities**
* Experience in a similar role supporting capital equipment for the electronics industry.
* Understanding of electronics manufacturing industry. Knowledge about dispensing industry is a plus.
* Effective matrix style management capabilities.
* Ability to multi\-task and effectively manage daily tasks
* Ability to bring positive change; detail oriented; leading by example
* Resides in India and must be able to travel internationally
* Fluent in English and other Asian languages

title: Senior Product Manager Tech, EU INTech - PGX
description:
**Description**
 Join EU INTech's Partner Growth Experience (PGX) team as a Senior Product Manager Tech and drive innovation in partner\-facing technology solutions across worldwide marketplaces. You'll own strategic product initiatives that directly impact vendor success and Amazon's growth trajectory in the EU region.
   

  

 As a Senior PMT on our team, you'll define product vision and roadmap for tools and experiences that empower thousands of vendors to grow their business on Amazon. You'll work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and customer obsession, partnering with engineering, UX, and cross\-functional stakeholders across EU and global teams to deliver scalable solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Exciting**
 Strategic Impact: Own end\-to\-end product strategy for vendor\-facing tools that influence billions in WW marketplace revenue
   

  

 Innovation at Scale: Build AI\-powered solutions and automation tools that transform how partners interact with Amazon's platform
   

  

 Cross\-functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering teams, business stakeholders, and regional leaders across multiple EU countries
   

  

 Product\-Driven Culture: Join a growing PMT function within a highly technical organization, helping shape the product management practice
   

  

 Global Reach: Your work will impact vendor experiences across EU marketplaces while contributing to global product standards
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to drive meaningful change in a fast\-paced, customer\-obsessed environment where your product decisions directly influence partner success and Amazon's competitive position in European retail.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Product Strategy \& Vision
   

  

 Define and own the product roadmap for vendor\-facing tools and experiences, translating business objectives into technical requirements and prioritized feature sets
   

  

 Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery to identify opportunities that drive vendor adoption and business growth across EU marketplaces
   

  

 Develop 3\-year product strategies aligned with EU INTech and broader International Stores goals
   

  

 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

 Partner with engineering teams to define technical architecture, make build\-vs\-buy decisions, and ensure scalable solutions that meet current and future needs
   

  

 Collaborate with UX designers to create intuitive, data\-driven experiences that reduce vendor friction and increase engagement
   

  

 Work closely with business stakeholders, retail teams, and regional leaders across EU countries to align product priorities with business outcomes
   

  

 Execution \& Delivery
   

  

 Write detailed product requirements documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable engineering teams to build with clarity
   

  

 Drive agile development processes, leading sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release planning to ensure on\-time delivery
   

  

 Make data\-driven trade\-off decisions balancing scope, timeline, and quality while managing stakeholder expectations
   

  

 Metrics \& Impact
   

  

 Define success metrics and KPIs for product initiatives, establishing measurement frameworks to track adoption, engagement, and business impact
   

  

 Analyze product performance data, conduct A/B tests, and iterate based on insights to continuously improve vendor outcomes
   

  

 Report on product health, progress against goals, and ROI to leadership and stakeholders
   

  

 Innovation \& Technical Depth
   

  

 Stay current with emerging technologies (AI/ML, automation, generative AI) and evaluate opportunities to enhance vendor tools and experiences
   

  

 Participate in technical design reviews, providing product perspective on architectural decisions and system integrations
   

  

 Build credibility with engineering teams through technical understanding and ability to engage in detailed technical discussions
   

  

 Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress to diverse audiences including executives, engineering leaders, and business partners
   

  

 Manage competing priorities and negotiate trade\-offs across multiple stakeholders with different objectives
   

  

 Build strong relationships across EU and global teams to drive alignment and remove blockers
   

  

**About The Team**
 We deliver comprehensive solutions that facilitate the growth and success of Amazon's partners, both Selling Partners and internal retail teams, across the entire vendor lifecycle.
   

  

 Our team owns a portfolio of 20\+ products spanning six critical areas of the Retail lifecycle: onboarding, listing \& catalog management, availability, business growth, profitability, support \& communication, and business planning \& negotiation.
   

  

 What makes PGX unique is our EU\-centric yet global approach. We leverage our proximity to Europe's sophisticated retail environment to build solutions that start regionally but scale worldwide. We collaborate extensively with global and regional tech teams, employing a strategic divide\-and\-conquer approach that accelerates innovation while avoiding duplication.
   

  

 Our culture is built on five core tenets: We're EU\-centric yet global in our solutions. We put customers first, prioritizing end customers, then selling partners, then Amazon. We embrace continuous learning, staying stubborn on vision but flexible on details. We champion standardization through reusable software architecture. And we believe less is more, building simple, intuitive experiences over complex one\-size\-fits\-all solutions.
   

  

 The team operates in a highly collaborative, fast\-paced environment where product managers work closely with engineering, UX, science, and business stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones. You'll partner with central platform teams, regional retail organizations, and global tech leaders to shape product strategy that directly impacts billions in revenue and millions of customer experiences.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to join a team that's redefining Selling Partner experience at Amazon scale, working on products that matter to vendors worldwide while being part of a culture that values innovation, customer obsession, and technical excellence.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: Product Manager, Google Photos
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc.).
* Experience integrating generative AI tools or Large Language Model (LLM) interfaces into workflows.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in a technology or business related field.
* 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to executive leadership.
* Experience working on consumer\-facing UI products that operate at scale, with a strong emphasis on mobile app experiences (iOS/Android).
* Experience working with GenAI and ML technologies and how they can be applied to creative user problems.
* Experience using data and analytics to drive product growth and optimize user engagement metrics.
* Ability to work effectively in a complex organizational setup, collaborating with teams across different time zones and geographies.


**About The Job**
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
   

  

 In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
   

  

 One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
   

  

 Hundreds of millions of users consume Memories to look back at their photos library, to ground themselves in what matters most to them.
   

  

 While the underlying human need around identity and have not changed, AI is unleashing a set of capabilities that lets us deliver on these needs better than ever before, and in a more personalized way than ever before.
   

  

 In this role, your role is to capture this opportunity to deliver the next generation of the Memories experience. You will build a system that understands what's in each user's library and the context of what's going on in their life, and adapts to deliver the right moments at the right time, in formats that are fresh and engaging for that user.
   

  

 Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client\-side (web and mobile), with server\-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. We are dedicated to making Google experiences centered around the user.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work with partner teams (e.g., Engineers, Program Managers (PgMs), UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements to turn PRDs into OKRs for one or more teams. Drive launches, maintenance, and retirement in collaboration with other cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Set the vision, goals, strategy, and roadmap for your workstreams, and align cross\-functional and cross\-product area stakeholders.

title: Senior Product Manager

**Why Esko?**
 Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140\+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions.  Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI\-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi\-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud\-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI\-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Product Manager – Cloud Platform Services**

 You will own the product direction and roadmap for foundational capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other shared platform services used across multiple Esko products. You will work closely with Architects, Engineering leaders, and Product Managers to identify common platform needs, establish priorities, drive adoption, and translate platform strategy into an executable roadmap.
   

  

 You must be comfortable engaging with Architects and Engineering leaders on APIs, distributed systems, data architectures, cloud\-native services, scalability, reliability, and technical trade\-offs.
   

  

**What You Will Do**

* Lead cross\-platform planning and align dependencies across Platform Services, IAM, Infrastructure Engineering, and consuming product teams.
* Balance product needs, platform investments, technical debt, reliability, scalability, and architectural evolution when setting priorities.
* Define success measures and use adoption, usage, developer experience, reliability, and business outcomes to guide platform investments.


**Required Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in the software industry, including 5\+ years in product management for cloud, SaaS, API, developer, or other technically complex software products.
* Experience owning the strategy and roadmap for platform products or shared services used by multiple products or engineering teams.
* Strong technical understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, data stores, multi\-tenancy, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Demonstrated ability to participate effectively in architecture and technical design discussions with Architects and senior Engineers, understand trade\-offs, and connect technical decisions to product outcomes.
* Experience with APIs and developer\-facing products, including concepts such as API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, integration patterns, and developer experience.
* Strong product judgment and ability to prioritize across product capabilities, technical investments, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
* Experience defining and using adoption, usage, and outcome metrics to guide product decisions.
* Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience driving alignment across Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams.


**Preferred Experience**
* Prior experience in software engineering, solution architecture, technical product management, or another hands\-on technical role.
* Experience with developer platforms, API platforms, or shared cloud services.
* Experience with platform capabilities such as workflow, search, repository/data services, APIs, or integration services.
* Experience in a multi\-product SaaS organization where shared platform capabilities serve multiple products.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Cloud Platform Services have a clear strategy, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Product teams understand what the platform provides, how to consume it, and where ownership boundaries lie.
* Shared platform capabilities evolve based on common product needs, adoption, and long\-term platform strategy.

 Product Management

 Director, Packaging Intelligence

 If so, we'd love to meet you.
   

  

**Why Esko?**
 Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. More than 25,000 customers across 140\+ countries rely on Esko to design, manage, manufacture, and deliver products found on store shelves every day. Packaging for 9 out of 10 major consumer brands is managed using Esko solutions.  Our vision is to create the industry's leading AI\-native Product Intelligence Platform. This modern, multi\-tenant cloud platform unifies product, packaging, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain data into a single intelligent ecosystem. By combining cloud\-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI\-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Product Manager for AI Services, you will own the product lifecycle for a shared foundation of AI capabilities that Esko's internal teams build on rather than re\-invent \- enabling them to solve customer problems that were previously out of reach with optimal speed and efficiency.
   

  

 Cross\-functional collaboration sits at the core of the role. You will coach internal teams, consolidate their needs to find common ground, work with technical and design stakeholders to agree the best approach, and document clear, testable requirements that are reviewed and approved before development begins. The result is a coherent, prioritized backlog and roadmap that reflects the combined needs of Esko's product teams and aligns with company strategy and AI transformation objectives.
   

  

 You will keep stakeholders updated as work progresses, then support them through acceptance testing, triage and implement change requests, and drive adoption of the services in production. Ongoing success management is central: keeping services aligned with evolving team and customer needs while maintaining a generalized approach and backwards compatibility, and growing capabilities in line with advances in technology and market expectations. You will track adoption and key performance metrics to demonstrate impact and identify where more focus is needed.
   

  

 As a key member of the Esko AI team, you will also help shape the strategic vision for Esko's AI initiatives through brainstorming, thought leadership, customer discussions and events.

* Help other teams to bootstrap their own AI initiatives on top of the shared capabilities: clarifying what already exists, what needs to be built, and how to get started.

* Define and maintain adoption / success metrics for the shared capabilities \- and use them to continually re\-prioritize the backlog and indicate risks and areas of additional focus.
* Communicate roadmap, priorities, and trade\-offs clearly across engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders.

* Native or fluent proficiency in English.
* Experience initiating, deploying, and scaling AI\-powered capabilities in production, with a track record of managing the development cycle from proof\-of\-concepts or early\-stage ideas into production capabilities that other teams depend on.
* Experience acting as a liaison in a large, global organization with multiple cross\-functional teams \- gathering and distilling requirements from varied stakeholders, aligning competing priorities, and driving toward a successful shared outcome.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to work fluently with both technical and business stakeholders alike.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in packaging graphics or the wider graphic arts industry is strongly preferred.

* AI services are clearly explained and documented, with measures taken to minimize any roadblocks or barriers to successful adoption.
* AI Services grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one\-off, team\-specific solutions.
