title: Product Lead - Opterra - Treasury
description:
**Company Overview**
 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
   

  

 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
   

  

 We are looking for a passionate and technically adept Product Lead to join the Treasury group within the Product Management team. The Treasury product portfolio covers critical post\-trade functions including collateral management, margin calculation, portfolio financing, and securities borrowing and lending. This group works with technology teams throughout the process lifecycle to specify, develop, and implement Arcesium’s treasury modules.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to define and design the next generation of treasury products on a platform used by some of the most sophisticated hedge funds and institutional asset managers in the world, and to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for Arcesium’s treasury product modules, focusing on delivering robust, scalable solutions for collateral management, margin, portfolio financing, and securities borrow/lend workflows.
* Rapidly prototype product ideas and validate hypotheses using AI tools and vibe\-coding techniques—building functional prototypes hands\-on to accelerate discovery, test feasibility, and communicate product intent to engineering and stakeholders.
* Distill the vision into product roadmap and product/feature specifications through requirement gathering, solutioning, and business analysis in close partnership with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with engineers and architects to translate product specifications into design and eventual product, ensuring core capabilities are effectively implemented and continuously improved.
* Rigorously and continuously evaluate the progress of products and features in flight by leveraging test cases and ensuring compliance with product specifications and the overall vision.
* Engage with both internal stakeholders and external users at client organizations to gather feedback, identify pain points, and prioritize impactful product improvements.
* Measure and analyze product usage data and user feedback to guide roadmap priorities and inform investment decisions.
* Conduct market research and competitive landscape analysis to stay ahead of industry trends in treasury and post\-trade technology.
* Articulate business cases, estimate timelines and budgets, and communicate with all stakeholders; prepare project plans, release notes, and other artifacts.
* Partner with product managers across other product groups on cross\-cutting programs and initiatives to provide comprehensive business solutions.


**What You’ll Need**
* 6\+ years of overall work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in product management preferably for financial technology products or platforms.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and vibe\-coding / rapid\-prototyping approaches to build working product prototypes. You should be comfortable going from idea to interactive demo without waiting for engineering.
* Customer empathy and a deep understanding of client needs, preferably with experience working directly with hedge funds or institutional asset managers.
* Adept at balancing technical requirements with user and stakeholder needs, both internally and at enterprise client organizations.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams in an agile software development environment.
* Outstanding academic background and a passion to work in a high\-tech software development environment.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Critical thinking and the ability to articulate standpoints and ideas and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple lines of execution with attention to detail and quality.
* A high level of personal maturity and a collaborative attitude.
* A healthy combination of resourcefulness, domain expertise, creativity, and execution prowess.
* Domain expertise in treasury and post\-trade processes such as collateral management, margin calculation, portfolio financing, securities borrow/lend, or related middle\- and back\-office functions, is optional but nice to have.


 Arcesium's Personal Data Privacy Notice for Candidates is linked here.

 Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. title: Oracle Eloqua - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle Eloqua \- Manager, you will lead the charge in optimizing operational efficiency for our clients by implementing and configuring Oracle's suite of applications. Your role will involve managing the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization, confirming seamless integration and utilization of business applications. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on delivering strategic solutions that align with client objectives and enhance their business processes.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will be responsible for supervising and developing teams, managing client service accounts, and driving client engagement workstreams. You will leverage your leadership skills to inspire your team, navigate complex situations, and deliver quality outcomes. Your role will involve strategic planning, mentoring junior staff, and maintaining accountability for project success. You are expected to embrace technology and innovation, using these tools to enhance delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will have the opportunity to deepen your understanding of business contexts and develop your personal brand. You will be instrumental in building meaningful client relationships and delivering solutions that meet their strategic needs.
   

  

**Experience**
* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands\-on and leadership experience in Oracle Eloqua / Oracle Marketing Cloud and enterprise marketing automation solutions.
* Experience leading multiple end\-to\-end Oracle Eloqua implementations, enhancements, integrations, and campaign transformation initiatives.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, campaign automation, CRM integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, campaign specialists, administrators, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Marketing Automation, CRM, Lead Management, Customer Journeys, Campaign Management, Analytics, Data Integration, and enterprise marketing technology ecosystems.


**Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, enhancement, and support of Oracle Eloqua marketing automation solutions.
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of marketing automation initiatives including demand\-generation programs, lead\-nurturing journeys, event campaigns, audience segmentation, email campaigns, landing pages, forms, and automated customer and prospect journeys.
* Translate business and marketing objectives into scalable and reusable Eloqua solution designs and automation strategies.
* Lead requirement\-gathering workshops and solution\-design sessions with Marketing, Business Development, CRM, Technology, Data, Analytics, and Operations teams.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and marketing stakeholders and recommend appropriate campaign designs, segmentation strategies, personalization approaches, lead\-management processes, and marketing automation capabilities.
* Own technical and functional design decisions and ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data\-governance, and marketing\-technology standards.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution designs, campaign specifications, integration mappings, testing strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Eloqua projects, campaigns, and workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, integration issues, campaign\-processing challenges, and platform limitations and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support, internal technology teams, application owners, and third\-party vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, integrations, and technical escalations.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and ensure clear communication on scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, CRM, Technology, Data, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Eloqua solution architecture and define scalable, reusable, secure, and maintainable solution patterns.Design end\-to\-end integrations and data flows across Eloqua, CRM, CDP, middleware, analytics, and third\-party applications.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and capability showcases to present Oracle Eloqua features and proposed solutions.Present architecture, campaign flows, integrations, and implementation approaches to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define suitable solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, and resource requirements
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Eloqua projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross\-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.


**Oracle Eloqua Technical Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of complex Eloqua Campaign Canvas and Program Canvas solutions.
* Design and manage campaign orchestration involving segmentation, decision rules, personalization, lead nurturing, lead scoring, routing, and automated communications.
* Oversee the creation and management of:
* Email campaigns
* Landing pages
* Forms
* Progressive profiling
* Segments
* Shared filters
* Contact fields
* Custom objects
* Campaign Canvas
* Program Canvas
* Lead\-scoring models
* Campaign reporting and dashboards
* Establish reusable campaign templates, design standards, naming conventions, folder structures, and asset\-management practices.
* Define and govern audience segmentation and personalization strategies based on customer, prospect, campaign, behavioral, and CRM data.
* Lead implementation of lead\-nurturing programs and automated journeys across different stages of the customer and prospect lifecycle.
* Design and manage lead\-scoring models and lead\-management processes, including qualification, routing, and hand\-off to CRM or sales teams.
* Ensure effective synchronization of contacts, leads, campaigns, responses, opportunities, and other marketing data between Eloqua and CRM applications.
* Establish campaign quality\-assurance processes covering configuration review, end\-to\-end testing, integration testing, data validation, deployment readiness, and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Monitor campaign processing, integration jobs, CRM synchronization, and data flows and proactively resolve failed\-processing or configuration issues.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for complex campaign, data, integration, synchronization, and platform issues and recommend sustainable solutions.
* Review overall Eloqua platform usage and recommend improvements related to scalability, performance, usability, and operational efficiency.


**Integration and Data Management**
* Lead and govern integrations between Oracle Eloqua and CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of campaign, contact, lead, opportunity, response, consent, and marketing\-preference data flows across integrated applications.
* Design and manage integrations between Eloqua and:
* Salesforce CRM
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Event\-management platforms
* Webinar platforms
* Websites
* Analytics platforms
* Data warehouses
* Customer Data Platforms
* Third\-party marketing applications
* Experience with REST APIs, web services, SFTP/file\-based integrations, middleware, batch integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Define source\-to\-target mappings and ensure appropriate data transformation, validation, synchronization, and error\-handling mechanisms.
* Promote data\-quality standards across Eloqua and connected marketing applications.
* Ensure appropriate management of customer consent, subscriptions, preferences, and marketing communication eligibility.


**Campaign Analytics and Optimization**
* Lead analysis of marketing and campaign performance, including:
* Email deliverability
* Open and click engagement
* Campaign responses
* Conversion performance
* Audience and segmentation effectiveness
* Lead\-nurturing performance
* Lead\-scoring effectiveness
* Campaign operational metrics
* Work with business and analytics teams to define campaign KPIs, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Translate campaign and engagement data into actionable recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness and customer engagement.
* Identify automation and optimization opportunities to reduce manual campaign activities and improve scalability.
* Evaluate new Eloqua capabilities, third\-party applications, and marketing technologies and recommend adoption based on business value.


**Platform Governance and Administration**
* Define and maintain Eloqua platform\-governance standards including:
* Naming conventions
* Folder structures
* Campaign standards
* Templates
* Asset\-management standards
* Documentation standards
* Access controls
* Environment housekeeping
* Oversee Eloqua user provisioning, role\-based access, permissions, and periodic access reviews.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of responsibilities and alignment with security and governance requirements.
* Establish Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), campaign checklists, solution documentation, reusable templates, and best\-practice frameworks.
* Drive platform\-health reviews and identify opportunities for cleanup, optimization, and standardization.
* Ensure campaign and platform processes align with applicable data privacy, consent, preference\-management, and digital\-marketing compliance requirements.


**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage a team of Associates, Senior Associates, developers, campaign specialists, and Eloqua administrators.
* Provide technical and functional guidance and act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Eloqua issues.
* Allocate work, manage priorities, monitor delivery, and ensure appropriate resource and capacity planning.
* Review team deliverables and ensure adherence to functional, technical, security, quality, and operational standards.
* Mentor team members through technical sessions, knowledge\-sharing, coaching, and hands\-on guidance.
* Provide regular performance feedback and support career and capability development within the team.
* Establish development, campaign, testing, integration, and deployment best practices across the team.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, requirement workshops, solution reviews, status discussions, and issue\-resolution sessions.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and mitigation plans clearly to business and technology leadership.
* Build strong relationships across Marketing, Business Development, CRM, Technology, Operations, Data, Analytics, and other stakeholder groups.
* Support resource planning, project estimation, workload management, delivery forecasting, and prioritization.
* Support proposals, solution estimations, technical presentations, demonstrations, and pre\-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, campaign accelerators, templates, frameworks, and automation components.
* Drive continuous improvement across Eloqua implementation, campaign delivery, platform administration, integrations, and support processes.
* Contribute to the broader Marketing Technology roadmap and recommend enhancements to platform capabilities, integrations, analytics, automation, and user adoption.


**Required Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Eloqua / Oracle Marketing Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of Campaign Canvas, Program Canvas, segmentation, email campaigns, forms, landing pages, contact management, custom objects, shared filters, lead scoring, and campaign reporting.
* Strong understanding of marketing automation concepts including demand generation, campaign orchestration, lead nurturing, personalization, segmentation, lead management, and campaign analytics.
* Strong experience integrating Oracle Eloqua with Salesforce, Oracle Sales, or comparable enterprise CRM applications.
* Strong understanding of marketing and CRM data models and data movement across integrated applications.
* Experience managing complex marketing automation programs involving multiple stakeholders, technologies, integrations, and dependencies.
* Strong experience in solution design, requirements analysis, testing, deployment, production support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform root\-cause analysis and recommend scalable solutions.
* Experience defining and monitoring marketing KPIs, operational metrics, dashboards, and campaign\-performance reporting.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, presentation, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a dynamic delivery environment.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and developing technical and functional team members.


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience with Oracle CX Sales Cloud / Oracle Fusion Sales, including REST/SOAP web services, integrations, Application Composer, Groovy scripting, and reporting.
* Experience with Salesforce CRM, particularly campaign, lead, contact, opportunity, and marketing\-integration processes.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, web services, SFTP/file\-based integrations, middleware, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with marketing analytics, BI/reporting, and data\-visualization platforms.
* Understanding of email deliverability, subscription and preference management, consent management, data privacy, and digital\-marketing compliance.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, testing, release management, and defect resolution.
* Oracle Eloqua or related Oracle Marketing / CX certifications are desirable.
* Exposure to Customer Data Platforms such as Oracle Unity and the activation of customer segments and attributes into Eloqua is an added advantage.

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**
* Own transition planning and service readiness for new or enhanced applications moving into production support.
* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.
* Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Programming in MS Visual C\#, Dot Net Framework
* Programming in RESTful API
* Coding SQL for Sql Server


**Software Engineering Processes**
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to lead delivery planning, sprint or milestone tracking, dependency management, issue resolution, and delivery governance.
* Experience establishing or enforcing engineering practices, documentation standards, quality gates, and release readiness controls.


**Design Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, design methodologies, design patterns, and anti\-patterns.
* Ability to review architectural requirements and guide teams in developing scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical designs.
* Experience assessing technical trade\-offs, long\-term maintainability, operational impact, and business value when recommending solutions.


**Requirements Engineering**
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, prioritization, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery roadmap, and operational support model.
* Experience managing requirement changes, business expectations, scope control, and impact assessment across project delivery phases.


**Configuration \& Release Management**
* Strong knowledge of source control, configuration management, environment management, release governance, and deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating CI/CD, build automation, deployment validation, version control, and rollback planning.
* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**

title: Engineering Lead – Power Electronics
description:
* **About the Role**
* We are looking for an Engineering Lead – Power Electronics to lead Leanwatts' Hardware, Firmware and Validation/Testing teams.
* The core responsibility of this role is to deliver new power electronics products from concept to production across:
* ● Low\-voltage EV chargers
* ● High\-voltage power modules and converters
* ● Hybrid and bidirectional inverters
* ● Future Leanwatts power electronics platforms
* You will own the complete engineering lifecycle: requirements, architecture, design, prototype, firmware integration, validation, certification and production release.
* **What You Will Do**
* ● Lead hardware, firmware and testing engineers across multiple product\-development programs.
* ● Own end\-to\-end development and release of new power electronics products.
* ● Define product architecture, engineering milestones, design reviews and release criteria.
* ● Review and guide power electronics hardware including PFC, LLC, PSFB, Dual Active Bridge (DAB), CLLC, bidirectional buck\-boost and active front\-end / bidirectional AC\-DC architectures.
* ● Guide magnetics, power stages, sensing, protection, PCB design and thermal architecture.
* ● Guide embedded firmware, digital control, communication, protection and diagnostics.
* ● Drive prototype bring\-up, debugging, EMI/EMC, thermal, safety and reliability validation.
* ● Establish structured EVT, DVT and PVT processes before production release.
* ● Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain to ensure products are manufacturable, reliable and scalable.
* ● Lead failure analysis, design improvements and continuous product cost/reliability optimisation.
* ● Mentor the engineering team and establish strong engineering and documentation practices.
* **What We Are Looking For**
* ● Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Power Electronics or a closely related field.
* ● Minimum 5\+ years of hands\-on power electronics product\-development experience.
* ● Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* ● Proven track record of taking power electronics products from concept to production.
* ● Strong experience in AC\-DC / DC\-DC converters, PFC, LLC, PSFB, DAB, CLLC and bidirectional power\-conversion systems.
* ● Strong understanding of magnetics, power semiconductors, digital control and firmware\-controlled power conversion.
* ● Hands\-on experience in prototype bring\-up, high\-power debugging, EMI/EMC, thermal and reliability testing.
* ● Experience with EV chargers, OBCs, DC\-DC converters, hybrid inverters, BESS PCS, V2G/V2H or similar bidirectional systems is preferred.
* **What Success Looks Like**
* You build an engineering team that can repeatedly deliver: Requirement → Design → Prototype → Validation → Production with faster development cycles, strong technical quality and reliable mass\-production performance

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**About SmartWinnr** 

  
 




 SmartWinnr is an enterprise\-grade sales enablement platform that helps organizations build sales readiness through AI sales roleplay, coaching, and certification at scale. The platform serves Fortune 500 clients including Boston Scientific, Johnson \& Johnson, and AstraZeneca, along with other major companies such as Abbott, Medtronic, HDFC Life, SBI Life, ICICI Prudential, and Aditya Birla to boost sales productivity. SmartWinnr has earned recognition from G2 as one of the top 50 sales products for two consecutive years, based on authentic customer reviews and feedback.
 



  





  





**Job Role:** 

 Product Marketing Manager
 




   
 



**Job Location:** 
 Hyderabad (On\-site)
 



  





  





**About the role:** 





 SmartWinnr is a revenue enablement platform for life sciences, serving pharmaceutical and medical device companies. Our customers include some of the largest life sciences organisations in the world, and most of our revenue comes from the United States.
 




  






 We are looking for our first product marketing hire. That means building from nothing: limited existing messaging, no competitive library, no case studies. It also means the person who takes this on defines how we talk about the product for the next several years.
 




  






 If you want to join a function that already runs, this is the wrong role. If you want to build one, it is a good one.
 




  





  





**What you will own:** 



* **Messaging and positioning.** 

 How we describe the product to each segment we sell to, from enterprise pharmaceutical companies to specialty biotech to medical device manufacturers. These audiences buy differently, and the messaging has to reflect that.
* **Competitive intelligence.** 

 Who we compete with and what they claim, and how our marketing and sales team should respond. Ongoing work rather than a one\-off deck.
* **Customer proof.** 

 Interviewing customers, building case studies, and maintaining a proof library that maps to the accounts we target. This is the single biggest gap we have today.
* **Sales enablement.** 

 The material our US sales team uses in live deals: battlecards, objection handling, one\-pagers, deal support.
* **Launch support.** 

 Bringing new capabilities to market internally and externally, working with Product.



  





  





  





**What the first 90 days look like:** 




  





**We will judge the role on output, not activity. By the end of the first quarter, we would expect:** 



* A messaging framework covering enterprise pharmaceutical and enterprise medical device buyers.
* A battlecard for our primary competitors, built from win and loss evidence rather than their website.
* Three customer stories published from US life sciences accounts.
* A proof point library mapped to the accounts our outbound program is targeting.



  





  





**What we are looking for:** 



* Five or more years in B2B SaaS product marketing.
* You have built messaging from scratch rather than maintained someone else's. We will ask you to walk us through one.
* Experience marketing to United States buyers, whether from India or elsewhere.
* Comfortable talking to customers directly. A good part of this role is interviewing people and finding the story inside what they tell you.
* Able to write clearly and with a point of view.



  





**Useful but not required:** 





 Experience in life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry. Familiarity with sales enablement, learning technology. We can teach the industry to someone who is good at crafts.
 




  





**What this role is not:** 





 It is not a content marketing role. We have people writing for the blog and for searching. It is not a demand generation role. And it is not a people management role, at least initially. You will be doing the work yourself.
 




  





**Practical details:** 





 You will be based in India and working on a market that is nine and a half hours behind. Some overlap with US hours is part of the job, particularly for customer interviews.

title: Project Manager (PMO)
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Project Manager to own delivery execution across our technology teams. You take the prioritized backlog and
 **make delivery happen** 
 planning and tracking the work, running the sprint process, keeping Jira clean, coordinating the people, and acting as the tech team's face to business stakeholders.
 



 This is a pure project management and delivery role. You are the person who keeps everyone aligned, unblocked, and on schedule, and who represents the technical team's status and constraints clearly to the business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Delivery planning \& tracking** 




 ·      Take the prioritized backlog and turn it into an executable sprint / release plan.
 



 ·      Track progress against timelines, milestones, and commitments; keep delivery on schedule.
 



 ·      Manage risks, dependencies, and blockers proactively surface slippage early with options.
 



  





**Jira \& project tooling management** 




 ·      Own Jira day to day boards, workflows, sprint setup, ticket hygiene, and accurate status.
 



 ·      Ensure every task moves through its states cleanly, and nothing stalls silently.
 



 ·      Maintain dashboards and delivery reports as a single source of truth for status.
 



  





**People \& team management** 




 ·      Coordinate developers and QA across workstreams; manage capacity, allocation, and follow\-ups.
 



 ·      Keep the team unblocked and accountable; drive tasks to completion.
 



 ·      Run the sprint ceremonies planning, stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
 



  





**Stakeholder communication (tech team's face to business)** 




 ·      Represent the technical team to business stakeholders communicate delivery status, timelines, and technical constraints in terms the business can act on.
 



 ·      Manage expectations on scope, timelines, and change; negotiate when capacity is tight.
 



  





**Quality \& release** 




 ·      Ensure testing and release readiness are planned in advance, not left to the last day.
 



 ·      Coordinate deployments and releases with Engineering and QA.
 



  





**Process \& governance** 




 ·      Establish and continuously improve lightweight delivery processes suited to a fast\-moving company.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 ·      Strong hands\-on experience with Agile and day\-to\-day
 **Jira management** 
 .
 



 ·      Proven track record coordinating cross\-functional teams and managing people to deliver on time.
 



 ·      Solid understanding of the software delivery lifecycle enough to hold credible conversations with engineers and QA and to explain constraints to the business.
 



 ·      Excellent written and verbal communication.
 



  





**Core Skills** 




 ·      Delivery planning, scheduling, and tracking.
 



 ·      Jira administration, sprint management, and delivery reporting.
 



 ·      People and team coordination; driving accountability.
 



 ·      Risk, dependency, and blocker management.
 



 ·      Stakeholder management and clear status communication.
 



 ·      Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities.
 



  





**Emotional Intelligence \& Behavioural Competencies** 




  





 ·
 **A two\-way bridge, and a balanced advocate.** 
 You carry the tech team's status and constraints to business stakeholders, and business context back to the team representing both sides fairly. You do not consistently push the pressure onto one side; you find the trade\-off that works for the goal.
 



  





 · 
 **Composed under pressure.** 
 When timelines, scope, and expectations collide, you stay calm and solution focused. You absorb pressure and convert it into clear next steps, rather than passing panic down to the team or frustration up to stakeholders.
 



  





 · 
 **Empathetic, and a genuine listener.** 
 You understand the real concerns behind what each side is saying the business's urgency and the team's constraints and you listen before you react.
 



  





 ·
 **A positive, ownership\-driven attitude.** 
 Proactive, accountable, dependable, and humble. You bring solutions, not just problems — and people trust you because both sides feel genuinely heard.
 



  





 · 
 **Resilient and adaptable.** 
 You stay steady and constructive through changing priorities and tight cycles.
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 · Experience in a startup or fast\-scaling environment.

* Lead a Value \& Adoption cadence track value at stake vs. value realized, adoption/utilization and decommissioning progress; hold business owners accountable and trigger corrective actions where value/adoption lags.
* Embed analytics and AI into core commercial decision processes (e.g., brand planning, customer engagement, omnichannel execution, launch excellence) and drive a data\-driven operating rhythm.

title: Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
**Role Summary** 




**Eze Perfumes** 

 is looking for a data\-obsessed, results\-driven
 
**Marketplace Growth Manager** 

 to join our Mumbai\-based global operations team. Your primary mission is to own the P\&L and scale our brand presence across major
 
**US marketplaces** 

 , with a primary focus on
 
**Amazon (FBA)** 

 and
 
**Walmart (WFS)** 

 .
 





 This role requires a unique individual who can sit in Mumbai but think like a US consumer. You will be responsible for the entire marketplace lifecycle—from strategic inventory planning and cross\-border logistics to high\-performance PPC advertising and AI\-driven listing optimization. You will act as the "CEO" of our US marketplace channels, ensuring Sawai’s heritage\-rich fragrances become a household name in the North American market.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Strategy \& P\&L Ownership** 



* **Revenue Accountability:** 

 Own the end\-to\-end P\&L for US marketplaces, including top\-line revenue, contribution margins, and platform\-specific fees.
* **GTM Execution:** 

 Develop and execute the Go\-To\-Market strategy for new product launches in the US, ensuring optimal pricing, positioning, and initial review velocity.
* **Growth Roadmaps:** 

 Build monthly and quarterly growth plans that balance aggressive customer acquisition with sustainable profitability.



**2\. Amazon \& Walmart Channel Mastery** 



* **Listing Excellence:** 

 Own the creation and optimization of SEO\-rich product listings, including titles, bullet points, and backend keywords tailored specifically to US search intent.
* **A\+ Content \& Storefronts:** 

 Work with the content team to ensure Amazon A\+ content and Brand Stores reflect a premium, luxury fragrance aesthetic.
* **Account Health:** 

 Monitor and maintain "Gold Standard" account health metrics, managing IPI scores, buyer\-seller messaging, and compliance with platform policies.



**3\. High\-Performance Advertising (PPC)** 



* **Campaign Management:** 

 Direct and optimize Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display ads to maintain a target ACOS/TACOS.
* **Competitor Conquesting:** 

 Implement aggressive keyword\-bidding strategies to capture market share from competitors in the premium fragrance and essential oil categories.
* **DSP \& External Traffic:** 

 Explore and manage Amazon DSP or external traffic drivers (Social to Amazon) to boost ranking and BSR.



**4\. Cross\-Border Logistics \& Inventory Planning** 



* **Demand Forecasting:** 

 Coordinate with the Mumbai and Silvassa teams to forecast US demand, ensuring stock is manufactured and shipped in time to avoid stockouts.
* **FBA/WFS Management:** 

 Manage shipments from India to US 3PLs or Amazon/Walmart fulfilment centers.
* **Efficiency:** 

 Optimize "Inventory Age" and minimize storage fees through strategic liquidation or promotional pulses.



**5\. AI\-Driven Operations** 



* **Automation:** 

 Implement AI tools for automated keyword research, sentiment analysis of customer reviews, and competitive price monitoring.
* **Content Scaling:** 

 Use LLMs to rapidly iterate on ad copy, A/B test listing titles, and automate routine reporting tasks.
* **Sentiment Analysis:** 

 Leverage AI to decode "Voice of Customer" data from reviews to inform the R\&D team in India for future product iterations.



**Technical Proficiencies \& Tools** 



* **Marketplace Core:** 

 Amazon Seller Central and Ads (Expert), Walmart Seller Center, eBay.
* **Analytics \& Research:** 

 Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Viral Launch.
* **Advertising Tech:** 

 Amazon Advertising Console, Pacvue, or Perpetua.
* **AI Stack:** 

 ChatGPT/Claude (for SEO \& Copy), Midjourney (for creative ideation), and Excel/Google Sheets (Advanced formulas \& Pivot Tables).
* **Operations:** 

 Experience with ERPs and cross\-border shipping documentation (ShipStation, etc.).



**Core Strengths** 



* **The "Global\-Local" Mindset:** 

 Ability to translate Indian manufacturing excellence into a brand voice that resonates with US luxury buyers.
* **Analytical Rigor:** 

 You don’t make guesses; you make data\-backed decisions based on click\-through rates, conversion rates, and session data.
* **Agility:** 

 The US marketplace landscape changes weekly (algorithm updates, fee changes); you must be able to pivot strategy instantly.



**The Ideal Fit** 



* You have a proven track record of managing a $1M\+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) portfolio on Amazon US.
* You are comfortable working hours that overlap with the US East Coast/West Coast to coordinate with partners and monitor live sales events (e.g., Prime Day).
* You have a passion for the fragrance/beauty industry and understand the nuances of selling "scent" through a digital screen.



**How to Apply** 





 If you are ready to take a heritage Indian brand to the global stage, send your resume and a summary of your biggest marketplace "win" to
 
**hr@incredibleindriya.com** 

 .
 




**Eze Perfumes** 

 is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate the intersection of Indian craftsmanship and global digital commerce.

description:
Join us as an “AVP – Macro BM” where Barclays has long been a recognised leader in rates and foreign exchange products, and we combine this strength with our focused commodities derivatives and local emerging markets businesses. Our teams, based in financial hubs across the globe, can assist clients with anticipating the impact of macro market moves and events on their portfolios. For example, the impact of central bank interest rate decisions on currency markets, or the relationship between the price of oil and the performance of emerging market currencies.
   

  

 To be a successful “AVP – Macro BM” role We strive to give clients the critical short\-term and thematic insights they need to effectively manage their portfolios, and partner with them to structure, buy and sell products to meet their hedging and investment goals. Our trading desks specialise in understanding flows across interest rates and FX in G10 and emerging market currencies, including: government bonds, agency and supra\-sovereign bonds, commercial paper, interest rate derivatives (including structured products), inflation\-linked products, cross currency derivatives, spot foreign exchange, foreign exchange forwards and options.
   

  

 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success role candidate would be supporting the Global Macro Business Management team as part of Macro Business Analytics team, Mumbai. Macro Business Analytics team in Mumbai is responsible for producing business critical MIS reports, Business Strategy presentations, Business Performance reviews, Revenue Forecasting Models, Budgeting Models and performing ad\-hoc customized analysis. The candidate would predominantly support the team based out of London \& New York and thus the role will require the candidate to primarily work during EMEA hours.
   

  

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**
* Produce and enhance Business Management MI, KPI reporting, and strategic presentations for senior management and key stakeholders.
* Develop and deliver insightful analysis of business performance, trends, and lead/lag indicators across revenue, sales credit, volumes, costs, market share, margins, RWA, LBS, Coalition, and other key business metrics.
* Conduct deep\-dive analytics to identify performance drivers, commercial opportunities, emerging risks, and areas requiring management focus.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and visualization solutions using Tableau, Streamlit, Power BI, Qlik, and other reporting tools to support data\-driven decision making.
* Leverage AI, automation, and analytical tools to streamline reporting processes, improve data quality, and enhance business insights.
* Partner closely with Business Managers, Front Office, Finance, Risk, Technology, and other stakeholders to provide actionable insights and support strategic initiatives.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis, management requests, and thematic reviews to support business strategy, resource allocation, and performance optimization.
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting frameworks, data governance, and analytical capabilities across the business.
* Translate complex datasets into concise executive\-level insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Contribute to strategic projects, business transformation initiatives, and process automation efforts aimed at improving efficiency and business outcomes.


**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**
* Flexibility to work in EMEA hours and adapt to business requirements.
* Strong understanding of Macro products, financial markets, and the broader Markets business.
* Proven experience in creating, enhancing, and delivering Business Management Information (MI) and reporting.
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools and platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, GitLab, Claude, and similar technologies.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, automation, and management reporting, with the ability to develop impactful presentations and executive\-ready materials using PowerPoint.
* Experience developing data visualization, analytics, and dashboard solutions using Tableau, Streamlit, Power BI, QlikView, Qlik Sense, or similar BI platforms.
* Strong programming and automation skills, with hands\-on experience in VBA and Python.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with a data\-driven approach to decision\-making.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders.


 This role will be based out of NKP, Mumbai.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To enable the success of the business and assist senior leaders navigate complex challenges, make informed decisions, and achieve their goals
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Collaboration with business and senior leadership to develop and implement business strategies that align with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Liaison between different business units and functions, fostering communication and collaboration.
* Management and coordination of strategic initiatives, projects, and change management efforts to optimize business processes and strengthen the control environment.
* Improvement of operational efficiency within the organisation including the identification of areas for improvement, streamlining of processes, and implementation of best practices to enhance productivity and effectiveness.
* Development of performance reporting for key metrics that reinforce the strategic objectives of the division and support the external commitments made. Involvement in aspects of financial analysis and budget management, including assistance in financial planning, forecasting, and monitoring of financial performance against targets.
* Support to business heads in partnership with HR on hiring, workforce planning, joiner/mover/leaver actions.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

title: Software Engineering - Executive Director - Parametric
description:
**About Morgan Stanley**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions, and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
   

  

**About Parametric**
 Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
   

  

 This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
   

  

**About Team**
 The Core Operations Platform is designed to build, integrate, and support a unified technology ecosystem that enables efficient, scalable, and controlled execution of Client and Market Operations processes.
   

  

 It serves as the central backbone for operational workflows, consolidating fragmented systems into a single, orchestrated platform that improves data integrity, reduces manual effort, and enhances operational transparency. This aligns with the broader vision of moving from multi\-system, manual processes to a unified, workflow\-driven model
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director, Software Engineering is responsible for providing technical leadership, project management, process development, training, support, and a technology vision for the Core Operation Platform. This team is responsible for multiple business processes namely Account Onboarding, Activities, Reconciliation and Reporting. The role will work with Data Services and Portfolio Management technology teams across the Direct Indexing business priorities, to design and develop technology solutions, and to improve business processes. This spans across core services to enable onboarding through our partners as well as business facing websites to allow the efficient onboarding and management of Accounts. These services will help streamline the rule\-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing allow for exception driven portfolio management.
   

  

 The Director will work closely with the Client Relationship Group and Market Operations for designing efficient applications to onboard accounts while minimizing risk. They will also work with the Digital Team developing services to that will be used by our Financial Advisor portal. In this role, the candidate will develop the appropriate software strategy, striking a balance between: (1\) alignment with the growth objectives of the Business; (2\) higher performance and consistently high quality; and (3\) cost effective application structure and use of new technologies.
   

  

 This leader will shape the long term product vision, drive engineering excellence, partner closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, intuitive user experiences across operational teams.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role accountable for setting direction, executing delivery, and building a high performing team that modernizes how users interact with operations platform and supporting data systems.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and execute the technology roadmap for the Core Operations Platform, aligning investments and capabilities with business priorities and long\-term growth objectives.
* Drive architecture and technology decisions that promote scalability, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to and help advance the AI and automation strategy for the Core Operations Platform, focusing on practical use cases that improve efficiency and decision\-making.


**Product \& Delivery Execution**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of technology solutions supporting account onboarding, operational workflows, reconciliation, reporting, and client servicing.
* Champion engineering best practices, including software quality, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


**Business Engagement \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Partner closely with Operations, Client Relationship Group, Digital, Data Services, and Portfolio Management Technology teams to identify and deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Translate business needs into technology strategies that improve user experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.


**People Leadership \& Organizational Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.


**Governance, Risk \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure technology solutions adhere to regulatory, security, and operational risk standards while maintaining platform stability and reliability.
* Establish strong governance, support, and change management practices that enable effective delivery and continuous operational improvement.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Asset management industry experience preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 7\+ years of Experience supervising and guiding software development teams and fostering an engaging, collaborative environment.
* 10\+ Years of Experience developing scalable solutions with advanced programming languages including .Net and Java framework.
* Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.
* Strong leadership skills including:
+ Vision and strategy
+ Influencing and consensus building
+ Communication
+ Total quality commitment
+ Ownership and accountability
+ Project management

* Successful track record of development and implementation of an innovative strategic vision and plans, and competence in building strategies to deliver technology to meet business goals and objectives. Ability to transform strategy into tactical plans and delivery.
* A creative, self\-confident self\-motivator with a "can do" orientation, along with the ability to function both independently and as a member of a team. Can work well in a fast paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Passionate, forward thinking and creative individual with high ethical standards and integrity.
* Ability to collaborate and partner as a business professional. The ability to facilitate, gain compromise and/or consensus within diverse teams.
* Assertiveness balanced with a sensitivity toward and concern for people. The ability to create strong work ethics and committed teams, foster open dialogue, and promote individual and team success.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills in customer and internal environment.
* Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation use cases to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.


 Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Product Manager – Mealawe
 



 📍 Pune
 



 💼 Experience: 5–9 Years
 



 💰 CTC: ₹25–35 LPA \+ Attractive ESOPs
 



  





 Mealawe is looking for a Senior Product Manager who can own a consumer product end\-to\-end — from customer insights and competitive analysis to product experience, pricing, P\&L, conversion, retention and growth.
 



 This is not a coordination\-only Product Manager role. We are looking for someone who has already independently owned a consumer\-facing product or business line and is comfortable taking decisions that directly impact customers, revenue, profitability and growth.
 



  





 What You Will Own
 



  





 • End\-to\-end ownership of Mealawe’s customer\-facing digital product
 



 • Product strategy, roadmap and continuous product improvement
 



 • Product P\&L, revenue, margins and unit economics
 



 • Pricing, offers, subscriptions and promotional strategy
 



 • Competitive analysis and market benchmarking
 



 • Customer research, feedback and behavioural analysis
 



 • Improving the complete customer purchase journey across mobile and web
 



 • Product discovery, selection, cart, checkout, payment, repeat purchase and retention
 



 • Identifying customer drop\-offs across the purchase funnel and driving improvements
 



 • Conversion, AOV, repeat rate, retention and customer experience
 



 • Working closely with UI/UX and Design teams to build simple, intuitive and high\-converting customer journeys
 



 • Coordinating closely with Performance Marketing and Growth teams on CAC, ROAS, conversion quality, customer cohorts and funnel performance
 



 • Translating campaign and customer data into product improvements
 



 • Working with Technology teams from problem identification through design, development, launch and post\-launch measurement
 



 • A/B testing across user journeys, pricing, offers, communication, landing pages and checkout flows
 



 • Analysing performance across cities, products, customer segments and acquisition channels
 



 • Identifying underperforming areas of the product and driving corrective action
 



 • Building dashboards and review mechanisms for faster decision\-making
 



 • Presenting product performance, customer insights, problems and action plans directly to senior leadership
 



  





 We Are Specifically Looking For
 



  





 ✅ 5–9 years of total professional experience
 



 ✅ Minimum 5 years of relevant Product Management / Consumer Product / Business Product experience
 



 ✅ At least 1 year of independent ownership of a product or business line
 



 ✅ B2C or D2C experience is mandatory
 



 ✅ Hands\-on experience managing a customer\-facing mobile app or web product where users discover, select and purchase products or services online
 



 ✅ Strong understanding of the complete consumer transaction funnel:
 



 Traffic → Landing → Discovery → Selection → Cart → Checkout → Payment → Repeat → Retention
 



 ✅ Candidates currently working in B2C/D2C will be strongly preferred
 



 ✅ Previous B2B experience is acceptable if your current/recent experience is strongly B2C/D2C focused
 



 ✅ Minimum 2–3 years in a startup, scale\-up or high\-velocity organisation
 



 ✅ Strong experience with P\&L, unit economics and profitability
 



 ✅ Hands\-on understanding of pricing, competition, customer behaviour and commercial metrics
 



 ✅ Experience working closely with Performance Marketing / Growth teams
 



 ✅ Experience collaborating with UI/UX, Product Design and Technology teams
 



 ✅ Strong data\-driven decision\-making ability
 



  





 Relevant Backgrounds
 



  





 We would particularly like to meet candidates from:
 



 Consumer Internet \| Food\-Tech \| Quick Commerce \| E\-commerce \| Marketplaces \| D2C \| Subscription Businesses \| Consumer Apps
 



  





 Experience in a high\-frequency transactional product — where customers regularly browse, purchase, pay and return — will be highly relevant.
 



  





 What Will Make You Stand Out
 



  





 You should be able to demonstrate measurable examples where you have:
 



 • Improved revenue or contribution margin
 



 • Improved conversion or retention
 



 • Built or scaled a consumer digital product
 



 • Improved product discovery, cart, checkout or payment journeys
 



 • Changed pricing or offers based on data
 



 • Reduced customer drop\-offs in the purchase funnel
 



 • Improved repeat purchase or subscription behaviour
 



 • Identified competitive gaps and acted on them
 



 • Worked with Performance Marketing to improve acquisition quality or conversion
 



 • Worked with UI/UX teams to materially improve customer experience
 



 • Built and measured successful product experiments
 



 • Turned around an underperforming consumer product or funnel
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 You should be able to answer questions such as:
 



 Why are customers dropping between landing and purchase?
 



 Which part of the app or web journey needs improvement?
 



 What are competitors doing better?
 



 Are we priced correctly?
 



 Which offers are actually improving incremental revenue?
 



 Why are some marketing campaigns bringing better customers than others?
 



 How can we improve conversion without destroying margins?
 



 How can we increase repeat purchase and retention?
 



 What should UI/UX, Technology and Performance Marketing teams work on next — and why?
 



 You will be expected to move from:
 



 Data → Insight → Decision → Execution → Measurement
 



  





 What We Offer
 



  





 💰 ₹25–35 LPA
 



 📈 Attractive ESOPs
 



 🎯 Significant product ownership and decision\-making responsibility
 



 🚀 Opportunity to directly influence product, customer experience, growth and business economics
 



 🤝 Direct exposure to senior leadership and high\-impact business decisions
 



  





 If you enjoy working at the intersection of Product \+ Consumer Behaviour \+ P\&L \+ Growth \+ Performance Marketing \+ UI/UX \+ Technology, we would like to hear from you.
 



 Apply through LinkedIn or share your profile with us.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Zendesk builds AI powered, customizable and simple to use service software crafted to improve customer relationships. Many of the world’s favorite brands leverage our products to engage you as a customer. We lead the industry with beautifully simple software, and you’ve almost certainly interacted with it without knowing it!**
**We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our Strategic Integrations and Connections capabilities which are used to connect, sync, and orchestrate across Zendesk and other systems.**
**In this role will have significant direct interaction with customers, partners, and executive sponsors. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams; engineering, design, product marketing, sales, and tech alliances to build and launch solutions. This position is well suited to an individual who has experience building partnerships to launch joint solutions. You are excellent at building relationships with stakeholders both inside and outside the org chart. Success in this role will be driven by your ability to balance priorities, manage expectations, rapidly execute on initiatives that meet customer needs, operate across many geographical distributed stakeholders, and work productively with external partners.**
****As a Senior Product Manager for Strategic Integrations and Connections you’ll…****
* Be capable of working without direction or regular oversight. You’re already experienced in the discipline of product management and comfortable leading product delivery teams, making decisions, and reporting back to leadership. You know what needs to be done and you’re independent and self\-driven enough to do it.
* Be a subject matter expert in your product area, and work with customers to further understand their needs and develop that expertise
* Be a strategic leader for this area, setting and articulating a vision and roadmap on which integrations to invest and divest.
* Work with Tech Alliances and partners to identify opportunities to grow partnerships and build solutions that create co\-marketing moments and solve joint\-customer’s problems
* Drive the direction of new capabilities and enhancements with engineering and design partners, ensuring that solutions built adequately capture the opportunity and solve the customer need. You don’t own the delivery, but you drive it.
* Where necessary, interact with executives to respond to customer escalations. Attend customer meetings with those executives and de\-escalate situations through your calm and controlled demeanor, bringing a plan to resolve issues and build trust and confidence with customers and executives.
* Possess exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to, champion and shape organizational decisions using your words and influence.
* Define OKRs, success metrics and review performance against those.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree, with 5 years of Product Management experience under your belt, delivering products that met business goals.
* Your work experience will include customer\-focused SaaS, designing and shipping “full\-stack” from front\-end, to back\-end, and APIs.
* A great collaborator that knows that to deliver anything of value is a team effort and likes to dig in with intelligent and passionate engineers to find the best solution to a problem.
* Ability to understand complex systems, and balance appropriate tradeoffs between performance, cost, and user experience.
* A self\-starter with a bias for action who is motivated to solve problems and deliver results with an owner mentality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for varying audiences: customers, engineering, marketing, program management, and executives.
* The drive to deeply understand our product, the market, our customers, and when to use the right data to measure success, using analytics tools to aid in decision\-making.


**Preferred Qualifications**

 Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
   

  

 Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration \- while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in\-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.
   

  

**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
 Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
   

  

 Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.
   

  

 As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.
   

  

 Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, \& inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here.
   

  

 Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e\-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.
