title: Product Consultant(T)
description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid role for an experienced product consultant focuses on designing enhancing and supporting manufacturing execution and billing solutions using C sharp Angular JS SQL scripting and Critical Manufacturing MES. The consultant will work in day shifts with no travel required engaging closely with stakeholders to optimize invoice adjustment and customer billing processes while ensuring operational efficiency and business value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end to end product consulting activities for manufacturing execution solutions by leveraging C sharp Angular JS and SQL scripting to deliver robust and scalable applications that optimize production performance and transactional accuracy.
* Drive detailed requirement discovery sessions with business stakeholders in customer billing and invoice adjustment domains to translate complex operational needs into clear product features and technical specifications within Critical Manufacturing MES.
* Design and configure MES workflows and data models that integrate seamlessly with authorization billing and invoice adjustment processes to improve accuracy turnaround time and compliance across large scale manufacturing environments.
* Develop high quality software components using C sharp and Angular JS that support intuitive user interfaces and reliable backend services enabling efficient management of customer billing events and adjustment authorizations.
* Create optimized SQL scripts and database procedures that ensure data integrity performance and traceability for transactions related to customer invoices adjustments and billing authorizations within enterprise systems.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional teams including business analysts architects and operations specialists to prioritize product backlog items that deliver measurable impact on revenue assurance and manufacturing efficiency.
* Provide expert guidance on the use of Critical Manufacturing MES capabilities such as production modeling data collection and integration interfaces to enhance visibility across the authorise customer billing and invoice adjustment lifecycle.
* Conduct rigorous testing validation and defect resolution activities for MES and billing related solutions ensuring that product enhancements meet quality standards regulatory requirements and organizational performance targets.
* Mentor junior consultants and technical team members in best practices for product configuration coding standards and solution troubleshooting to build a strong delivery culture and sustain operational excellence.
* Prepare detailed functional and technical documentation for MES configurations application components and SQL scripts so that support teams can maintain and evolve solutions with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Engage in continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing system usage metrics billing accuracy trends and production performance indicators to propose product changes that enhance customer satisfaction and societal value through efficient manufacturing.
* Support stakeholders during go live and post implementation phases by resolving complex incidents performing root cause analysis and recommending preventive actions that stabilize billing and manufacturing execution processes.
* Coordinate with security and compliance teams to ensure that MES and billing solutions adhere to organizational policies data protection standards and audit requirements while maintaining usability and process efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Bring nine to twelve years of progressive experience in product consulting or solution implementation with a focus on complex manufacturing and billing environments supported by large scale enterprise systems.
* Demonstrate strong hands on proficiency in C sharp including object oriented design patterns integration techniques and performance tuning practices relevant for production grade applications.
* Exhibit advanced capability in Angular JS for building responsive secure and maintainable front end interfaces that enable efficient execution of manufacturing and billing tasks by diverse user groups.
* Apply deep knowledge of SQL scripting and relational database concepts to design queries procedures and optimization strategies that support high volume transaction processing and analytical reporting.
* Show proven experience working with Critical Manufacturing MES including configuration integration and customization to align production workflows with customer billing and invoice adjustment requirements.
* Display solid understanding of authorize customer billing and invoice adjustment domain processes including validation controls exception handling and reconciliation practices across enterprise operations.
* Operate effectively in hybrid work settings demonstrating strong communication collaboration and documentation skills that ensure smooth coordination across onsite and remote stakeholders.

 Are you looking for a high\-impact career move that places you at the heart of global securities market infrastructure? Bring your expertise in technology strategy, portfolio governance, and investment planning to
 **Citi’s Global Custody Team** 
 .
   

  

 By joining Citi, you will become an integral part of a global organization whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to institutional clients by responsibly providing financial and custody services that enable growth, operational resilience, and market connectivity
   

  

**Team \& Role Overview**
 The
 **Investment Planning and Portfolio Oversight** 
 role sits within the Custody Business Execution team, and as part of the broader Investor Services business in Citi.
   

  

 This role is responsible for managing the technology budgeting process for the Custody business and overseeing the execution of the change book of work.

 **Investor Services**

 As the Custody Investment Planning and Portfolio Oversight Lead, you will drive the end\-to\-end global technology investment portfolio for Custody. * Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the trusted advisor and central point of coordination for senior business heads across Custody Product, Technology leads, Finance, Operations and the Investor Services team.

* Agility \& Analytical Rigour: Strong problem\-solving abilities with experience managing competing priorities under tight delivery and regulatory deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
* Digital and AI native: Embrace new and improved ways of working, putting AI\-capabilities at the centre of a process improvement agenda

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
 Director, Software Engineering
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 We are looking for Director – Software Engineering, to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem\-solving. Our solutions are built on the Digital Network Architecture, Cloud Native principles and in a Scaled Agile Framework. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.

title: Senior Manager, Product Management
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management to join our team within our Clinicals division. In this role you will be responsible for one or more product areas within the overarching product’s portfolio; understanding the market and customers, contributing to the product vision, developing business cases and ensuring a set of product features meet business requirements. You will help define how AI is responsibly integrated into clinical workflows, ensuring solutions are safe, trustworthy, and deliver measurable value to healthcare providers and patients.
   

  

 You will work closely with scrum teams defining and writing user stories, prioritizing product backlogs, and making trade\-off decisions between scope and schedule. Your work will span both strengthening our current solutions and delivering innovative, AI\-driven features that improve user experience and clinical decision\-making. Success in this role will be measured by improvements in provider efficiency, mobile adoption, workflow completion, user satisfaction, product quality, and safe adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Mobile team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve the efficiency and experience of healthcare providers. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI\-enabled solutions where they add value. The team collaborates closely to ensure products are usable, reliable, and aligned with clinical and business needs. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Drive product vision incorporating AI/ML capabilities, predictive insights, and automation opportunities
* Lead early\-stage discovery for features including: Identifying high\-value use cases for AI, Validating concepts with users and stakeholders, and Defining data requirements and feasibility
* Partner with UX, Analytics and Data Science teams to define measurement strategies for AI feature performance (e.g., validity, bias, data quality, adoption, impact)
* Translate product strategy into outcome\-based roadmaps that connect customer problems, business goals, delivery priorities, and measurable success criteria.
* Define product success metrics for each major initiative, including adoption, engagement, workflow efficiency, customer satisfaction, safety, and business impact.
* Own go\-to\-market strategies for products, including its AI\-enabled features
* Monitor post\-release performance and use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to guide iteration and prioritization.
* Work directly with scrum teams to prioritize work and ensure delivery of both core and AI\-enabled product capabilities
* Own ongoing maintenance of core products, including triaging production issues and managing enhancements
* Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to translate AI models into scalable product features
* Understand the market opportunity via user needs, market forces, applicable business models, emerging AI trends and competitive AI capabilities
* Drive the analysis of Product Area(s) of ownership including AI/ML\-driven products
* Define epics and user stories that clearly articulate: Functional requirements, User experience considerations, Data and model requirements, AI behavior expectations (e.g., explainability, confidence levels)
* Partner with UX and Engineering to design mobile experiences that are intuitive, accessible, performant, and reliable in fast\-moving clinical environments.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to manage the full AI/ML lifecycle, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree required: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or related field preferred
* 6\+ years of product management experience
* Understanding of US healthcare / health IT environment is strongly preferred
* Experience working in an Agile environment is strongly preferred
* Experience building or scaling mobile products, preferably iOS and Android applications in SaaS, healthcare, or enterprise environments.
* Understanding of mobile UX patterns, performance considerations, accessibility, release management, and app adoption strategies.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and productization of AI features
* Familiarity with: Model lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring), Data pipelines and data quality considerations, Experimentation frameworks
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model bias, and explainability
* Experience working on AI\-driven or data\-intensive products preferred
* Experience bringing products to market is needed
* Technical understanding (mobile, SaaS, data, APIs) – ability to check technical feasibility and timelines and remove technical development barriers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear business value


**Additional Information**
* Some travel to the US may be required for customer site visits, internal collaborations, and industry events (5%)


**About Athenahealth**
***Our vision:***
*In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*
***Our company culture:***
*Our talented*

We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*

title: Associate Delivery Manager
description:
Overview of 66degrees
   

  

 66degrees is an end\-to\-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
   

  

 At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
   

  

**Overview Of Role**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative Associate Delivery Manager with a strong Agile and Scrum background to support the successful delivery of customer\-facing technology programs across cloud, data, AI, analytics, and application development initiatives.
   

  

 This role is ideal for professionals with approximately 3\+ years of experience who have worked as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Agile Delivery Lead, Technical Project Coordinator, or Associate Project Manager and are looking to grow into broader Delivery Management responsibilities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will play a key role in facilitating Agile delivery, coordinating cross\-functional teams, removing delivery impediments, and ensuring timely execution of project milestones. You will partner closely with Delivery Managers, Product Owners, Architects, Engineering teams, and customers to deliver high\-quality technology solutions while continuously improving Agile maturity and delivery excellence. In addition to supporting larger and more complex programs, you will also have the opportunity to independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, taking ownership of planning, execution, stakeholder communication, and successful delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Coordination**
* Support the successful delivery of software, cloud, data, AI, and application development projects.
* Coordinate sprint execution, release planning, project tracking, and delivery milestones.
* Assist Delivery Managers in monitoring project health, risks, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Track project progress, team capacity, resource allocation, and delivery metrics.
* Escalate delivery risks and blockers proactively while driving timely resolution.
* Ensure project documentation, governance artifacts, and status reports are maintained accurately.
* Support multiple concurrent Agile projects and distributed engineering teams.
* Independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, owning end\-to\-end delivery including planning, execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and successful project outcomes.
* Balance responsibilities across independently managed engagements while providing delivery support to larger, strategic programs led by senior Delivery Managers.


**Agile Delivery \& Scrum Leadership**
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, Backlog Refinement, and Sprint Retrospectives.
* Coach Scrum teams on Agile principles, Scrum values, and continuous improvement practices.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy product backlogs and sprint priorities.
* Track sprint progress, velocity, burndown charts, and release readiness.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks and work with teams to remove impediments.
* Foster accountability, collaboration, transparency, and ownership across Agile teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on retrospective outcomes and delivery metrics.


**Project Governance \& Reporting**
* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and delivery metrics for stakeholders.
* Monitor sprint health, schedule adherence, defect leakage, resource utilization, and delivery milestones.
* Maintain project plans, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and action trackers.
* Ensure compliance with delivery governance standards and organizational processes.
* Support forecasting activities, release planning, and sprint commitments.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and customer teams.
* Communicate project status, delivery progress, risks, and mitigation plans effectively.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities to ensure alignment between business and engineering teams.
* Support customer meetings, sprint demos, governance reviews, and project updates.
* Serve as the primary Delivery Manager and customer point of contact for smaller engagements, ensuring effective stakeholder communication, governance, and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain a customer\-first mindset throughout project execution.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Promote Agile best practices across delivery teams.
* Encourage knowledge sharing, collaboration, and process improvements.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, predictability, and team productivity.
* Contribute to organizational Agile maturity initiatives.
* Support Delivery Managers in implementing operational excellence initiatives.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Project Coordinator, Associate Project Manager, Delivery Coordinator, or similar role, with demonstrated ability or readiness to independently manage smaller customer engagements.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum framework, Kanban, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and managing sprint execution.
* Hands\-on experience working with cross\-functional software engineering teams.
* Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of Agile metrics including Sprint Velocity, Burndown Charts, Cycle Time, Lead Time, Defect Leakage, Resource Utilization, Schedule Adherence, and Delivery Milestones.
* Experience coordinating multiple workstreams within Agile projects.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in fast\-paced, collaborative environments.
* Exposure to cloud technologies (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure) is preferred.
* Exposure to AI, Data, Analytics, or Application Development projects is an added advantage.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* Experience working in consulting, professional services, or customer\-facing organizations.
* Exposure to cloud migration, AI/ML, data modernization, analytics, or digital transformation projects.
* Experience supporting distributed or global engineering teams.
* Familiarity with delivery governance, release management, and Agile reporting.
* Experience independently managing small to mid\-sized customer engagements or end\-to\-end project delivery is preferred.
* Passion for coaching Agile teams and driving continuous improvement.


***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***
*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*
**AI Transparency \& Disclosure**
 As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.
   

  

 These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

title: NPDI Project Manager Products and Solutions - Engineering Specialist

 The Project Manager will be part of the INDIA PMO team which manages the development of Thermal management products.
   

  

 The Project Manager is responsible and accountable for the management of projects aimed at new products development, to the customization of existing products upon specific client requests (Engineered to Order) or for products transfer from region to region from inception to product launch, coordinating the efforts of all involved departments (engineering, product management, manufacturing engineering, operations, procurement, quality, order fulfillment, logistics, service, marketing, sales and other cross\-functional groups) to the successful completion of the project. The Project Manager has no direct reports but will manage people indirectly. The Project Manager is responsible for projects scope, schedule and budget. Project manager is also driving the team to achieve the objectives of product costs and Time to Market.
   

  

 The projects to be followed spans different manufacturing plants, in different regions.
   

  

 Project Manager must maintain continuous alignment of program scope with Company strategic business and other organizational objectives, make recommendations to modify the program to enhance effectiveness, highlight any possible situation hindering achievement of program results and elaborate a recovery plan.
   

  

 The context in which the Project Manager operates is characterized by complex relationships in an international and multicultural environment, typical of large organizations.
   

  

 The Project Manager therefore must be able to navigate complexities, foster relationships, and maintain communication with stakeholders at multiple levels, including those external to the organization.

* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities, with a proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.

title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

**Role Purpose**
 Responsible for leading the strategy to deliver quality products across the digital experience (Mobile, Hotel Website, or Revenue Management). This role coordinates among business stakeholders, software developers, technical engineers, designers, data analysts, and other functional subject matter experts to create a comprehensive and holistic roadmap that address both short term and long\-term needs. They guide in\-depth business reviews, communicate and present across all levels of the organization and support cross\-functional product teams. The Group Product Manager will also prioritize and activate their roadmap, ultimately managing the end\-to\-end product lifecycle from ideation to launch to adoption to optimization in an agile methodology, pivoting as needed in response to stakeholder and customer needs. The Group Product Manager is skilled and experienced in generating innovative ideas for growth within their respective areas and must exhibit the ability to lead senior\-level Product Managers and/or leads teams of Product Managers that are responsible for higher\-profile, more impactful products.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 Lead development and implementation of product strategy: future state based on deep understanding of how the business works, incorporating customer insights, markets, competition, and distribution capabilities as well as the potential “game changing” new functionality and capabilities IHG will require to compete. This should manifest itself in a roadmap of initiatives including small enhancement and content refreshments to existing products as well as new product needs.
   

  

 Identify product opportunities far in advance of obsolescence, drive strategic planning, and articulate topline business requirements
   

  

 Applies domain expertise to provide thought leadership and translate vision into action to drive business growth.
   

  

 Drives product development by reviewing performance and directing work efforts of product teams to ensure products are aligned with company, stakeholder and end\-user priorities
   

  

 Source data and craft test plans to ensure data\-driven decisioning; use insights to inform priority of work
   

  

 Proactively seek input from stakeholders to align the roadmap against business and customer needs
   

  

 Forecast ROI, regularly report on product performance post launch, drive product adoption, and lead the vision for the optimization plan
   

  

 Measure product performance and lead performance improvement initiatives.  Identify and understand the performance drivers and set up ongoing diagnostics and monitoring capabilities once implemented.
   

  

 Provides guidance on design of products while balancing dependencies and integration with other products across the enterprise
   

  

 Manage product lifecycles:  continually evaluate product performance and key customer insights and ensure new product needs are identified far enough in advance to address needs before product obsolescence.
   

  

 Communicate product information: including product roadmap, specifications, value proposition, sales tools training tools and competitive information to stakeholders.  Provide status updates to PMO for regular reporting cycles.
   

  

 Makes suggestions to drive operational excellence, create internal customer satisfaction and meet operational metrics
   

  

 Provide regular updates to leaders and partners, sometimes catering the message depending on audience

Demonstrated ability to present new concepts, research findings, and business outcomes to various groups including corporate clients, senior management, potential vendors, and industry consultants.
* Demonstrated program management experience with modern, established product management processes in organizing, planning and executing projects from conception through implementation. Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks/clients required.
* Demonstrated proficiency with MS Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

title: Group Product Manager (Supply Chain/Operations)
description:
**Job Description: Group Product Manager – Supply Chain \& Operations** 




**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 6 – 9 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 B2C E\-commerce / D2C / Logistics Tech / Quick Commerce
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Group Product Manager – Supply Chain \& Operations** 
 to own and lead the digital systems powering our end\-to\-end fulfillment, warehousing, and logistics network. In this role, you will lead a team of Product Managers and partner directly with Operations, Engineering, and Business leadership to build scalable backend technology that drives operational excellence, optimizes unit economics, and accelerates order\-to\-delivery cycles.
 



 Unlike consumer\-facing growth roles, this position is deeply anchored in internal platform architecture, operational workflows, inventory intelligence, and supply chain automation.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Product Strategy \& Roadmap
 


* Define the long\-term product vision, strategy, and execution roadmap for the Supply Chain \& Operations Tech stack (Order Management Systems, Warehouse Management Systems, Inventory Intelligence, Dispatch \& Delivery).
* Identify operational bottlenecks and convert complex ground\-level logistics challenges into scalable software solutions.



 2\. Team Leadership \& Mentorship
 


* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of Product Managers owning individual sub\-domains within supply chain and fulfillment.
* Establish product management best practices, key metrics frameworks, and operational governance across your team.



 3\. Core Platform Ownership
 


* **Order Management System (OMS):** 
 Build and scale order routing engines, split\-shipment logic, and order state machines.
* **Warehouse Management System (WMS):** 
 Optimize inbound receiving, putaway, picking, packing, staging, and inventory auditing workflows to drive warehouse throughput.
* **Inventory \& Procurement:** 
 Build real\-time inventory visibility systems, multi\-location stock replenishment algorithms, and vendor integration management.
* **Logistics \& Dispatch:** 
 Develop routing algorithms, middle\-mile/last\-mile dispatch engines, courier allocation logic, and real\-time tracking platforms.



 4\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Execution
 


* Work closely with Ground Operations, Warehouse Managers, Logistics Partners, and Category teams to build intuitive internal tools.
* Partner with Engineering and Data Science teams on system architecture, database scalability, and optimization models (e.g., route optimization, demand forecasting).



 Key Operational Metrics You Will Own
 


* **Fulfillment Speed \& SLA:** 
 Order processing time, dispatch SLA, and on\-time delivery (OTD) rates.
* **Warehouse Efficiency:** 
 Pick/pack speed, dock\-to\-stock duration, and labor productivity per warehouse.
* **Inventory Precision:** 
 Stock accuracy, shrinkage reduction, and wastage/spoilage rates.
* **Cost Efficiency:** 
 Shipping cost per order, warehouse operational cost per unit, and route density optimization.



**What We're Looking For** 



* **Experience:** 
 6–9 years overall experience with at least 4\+ years dedicated to building Supply Chain, Logistics, Warehousing, or Operations software in high\-scale e\-commerce, D2C, or 3PL environments.
* **Leadership:** 
 Prior experience managing and mentoring Product Managers or Associate PMs.
* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Deep hands\-on knowledge of WMS, OMS, TMS (Transportation Management Systems), inventory algorithms, and third\-party logistics (3PL) API integrations.
* **Technical Depth:** 
 B.Tech/B.E. degree or strong technical background required; ability to read API docs, evaluate system architecture, and collaborate effectively with senior engineering leaders.
* **Data\-Driven Problem Solver:** 
 Strong quantitative and analytical skills; fluent in SQL and telemetry/tracking tools to evaluate operational metrics.

* Product leaders from high\-scale B2C e\-commerce, D2C, quick commerce, retail\-tech, or third\-party logistics (3PL) platforms.

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.
   

  

 For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

**Job Description**
**Head of Software, Enterprise Solutions**
 This role leads a strategically important segment of S\&P Global Market Intelligence’s Enterprise Solutions Software business, spanning Corporate Actions, Tax Solutions, and Cappitech. The portfolio combines managed data services and enterprise technology platforms that help capital markets firms reduce risk, improve compliance, and streamline complex post\-trade, asset servicing, tax, and regulatory reporting workflows.

title: Decision Analyst
description:
Join us as a Decision Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
   

  

 The Decision Intelligence team at Barclays drives strategic business impact by applying advanced analytics and data science to solve complex challenges. Focused on enhancing profitability, customer experience, and operational efficiency, the team builds analytical capabilities to inform business strategies and case development. By uncovering growth opportunities, optimizing customer and digital strategies, and improving risk management, they deliver data\-driven and decision focused solutions in collaboration with stakeholders, fostering a culture of informed decision making and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
   

  

 To be a successful Decision Analyst, you should have experience in:
   

  

  

* Synthesizing business knowledge, market research, and analytics to drive strategic outcomes.
* Understanding value drivers across products and services, linking customer, operational, and financial levers.
* Breaking down complex challenges using frameworks such as MECE, hypothesis\-driven approaches, 5 WHYs, 80/20, and decision trees.
* Using Python, SQL, Excel, and Tableau to transform data into actionable insights.
* Generating insights that drive measurable business outcomes.
* Crafting compelling, data\-backed narratives for senior stakeholders and delivering powerful executive presentations.
* Coordinating cross\-functional teams and tracking benefits realization.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong communication and storytelling.
* Good at problem solving skills and strategic thinking.
* People leadership potential and guiding/coaching less experienced colleagues.
* AI Awareness/Adoption.


 You may be assessed on essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location is based out of Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To extract meaningful insights from complex data sets, developing robust decision models, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders across the departments.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Identification and extraction of relevant data from various internal and external sources.
* Performing sensitivity analysis and scenario planning.
* Monitoring and evaluation of the performance of existing models.
* Development and implementation of data quality control procedures.
* Building and validation of quantitative models to support decision\-making across different business areas.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. **Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. They are finally tested clinically for efficacy \& safety. This offering of Fresh Ayurveda has made a mark in the Indian personal care industry.
 



  





 Today \~60Lac customers trust us for their personal care needs. The founding team has a strong startup experience, is well funded and backed by tier 1 institutional investors.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Most entry\-level category hires start with a dashboard. This one starts with a phone call. The Category Associate's job is to build the category's understanding of its consumer from the ground up \- through call surveys, focus group discussions (FGDs) and in\-person interactions \- and turn that into insight that shapes what we make, how we sell it, and where we invest next. It's a research\-to\-execution role: you generate the insight, then help ship the decisions that follow from it.
 



  





**Why this starts with a real conversation, not a dashboard** 




 We won't pretend it's the easy part. Calling a stranger, running an FGD, or standing in front of a consumer and asking why she didn't repurchase is harder than pulling a report \- and most people this early in their career would rather stay behind a screen. We're asking you to do it anyway, because it's the one input nobody else in the building has.
 



  





 Secondary data \- sales, ratings, app analytics \- tells you
 *what* 
 happened. A consumer conversation tells you
 *why* 
 , often weeks before it shows up in a number. That gap is where category strategy actually gets built: which claim lands, which price point stings, which product idea is a real gap versus a nice\-to\-know. Skip the conversation and you're strategising on guesses.
 



  





 It's also the fastest route to real say in the business. The Category Associates who move quickest into P\&L ownership are the ones whose point of view the business trusts before the data catches up \- because they built it firsthand, one conversation at a time.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



1. **Consumer insight engine.** 
 Run structured call surveys, FGDs and in\-person consumer interactions (store visits, pop\-ups, cohort meetups) to build a live, ground\-up read of what the category's consumer wants, buys, and drops off on \- a standing system, not a one\-time project.
2. **Insight → action.** 
 Convert raw consumer feedback into structured insight \- need\-gaps, purchase triggers, objections, usage occasions \- that Product, Marketing and Ops can act on, and follow through to make sure it actually gets used.
3. **Category ops execution.** 
 Own the operational backbone of the category \- listings, pricing hygiene, catalog accuracy, promo execution, inventory flags, competitor tracking \- so nothing slips between insight and shelf.
4. **Data and dashboards.** 
 Track category KPIs (sales, conversion, repeat rate, ratings/reviews, NPS) and build or automate the reporting for them. The bar: build a workflow once, don't rebuild a report every week.
5. **Ground\-up category mapping.** 
 Build and maintain the category's core reference material \- competitor landscape, price\-value map, consumer segments, category taxonomy \- as living, reusable assets, not one\-off decks.
6. **Cross\-functional coordination.** 
 Work daily with Marketing, Creative, Ops and Supply to get category initiatives shipped on time.



  





**What great looks like in your first 90 days** 



* You've personally spoken to 50\+ consumers (calls, FGDs, in\-person) and turned it into one clear point of view on a real gap or opportunity in the category.
* You've built, or meaningfully improved, a self\-refreshing dashboard for the category's core KPIs \- no manual pull required.
* You know the category's competitive set cold: pricing, claims, reviews, what's winning and why.
* At least one of your insights has visibly changed a decision \- a listing, a claim, a promo, a launch input.



  





**What you bring** 



* 1\+ years of experience \- freshers welcome; internships or research/analytics projects count.
* You genuinely enjoy talking to consumers \- you'd rather run 10 calls than read 10 secondary reports.
* Strong with data: comfortable in Excel/Sheets at minimum; SQL or basic scripting is a real plus, and you're always looking for what can be automated rather than repeated by hand.
* Business\-first instinct \- you don't stop at "here's what the data says," you push to "here's what we should do about it."
* High ownership of ops execution \- as comfortable in the weeds of listings, pricing sheets and trackers as you are in a deck.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline \- research, consumer behaviour, business or a quant background all work well here.



  





 Location: Udyog Vihar, Gurgaon
 



 Website: www.nathabit.in
 



 Instagram: www.instagram.com/nathabit.in
