title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**About The Team**
 At Zillow, our mission is to give people the power to unlock life’s next chapter. The Elevate team powers the advertising experiences that connect brands and service providers to hundreds of millions of Zillow visitors each month.
   

  

 We operate at the intersection of consumer experience, marketplace dynamics, and revenue generation. Whether it’s scaling ad delivery platforms across search and home detail pages, integrating on\-site and off\-site media, or enabling experimentation and measurement at scale, Elevate plays a critical role in Zillow’s growth strategy.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact team where programs directly influence revenue, customer experience, and advertiser value.
   

  

**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead the delivery and ongoing success of technical advertising solutions. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Ad Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to turn defined goals into clear plans and coordinate programs from planning through launch.
   

  

 You will bring structure to complex work, maintain alignment across stakeholders, and help teams identify and address risks, dependencies, and decisions. You will use established program practices while identifying opportunities to improve how teams plan, communicate, and execute.
   

  

 The role focuses three primary areas:
   

  

* Program \& Platform Delivery Delivery: Lead the end\-to\-end execution of defined, cross\-functional technical programs. Translate product and technical requirements into clear, dependency\-aware plans; coordinate milestones and delivery activities; and proactively surface risks, decisions, and tradeoffs. Apply established program practices while identifying opportunities to improve how teams plan and execute.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Partner with stakeholders across consumer\-facing teams, revenue teams, and shared technical platforms to deliver cohesive advertising experiences. Build shared understanding of scope, priorities, responsibilities, and delivery expectations. Facilitate timely decisions and help teams navigate competing needs and dependencies.
* Operational Excellence \& Experimentation: Support reliable, measurable, and continuously improving program execution. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to coordinate experiment readiness, performance monitoring, release planning, and incident follow\-up. Use program and operational insights to identify execution gaps and recommend improvements.


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

 You are an organized and collaborative program leader who brings clarity and structure to complex technical work. You are comfortable leading programs with defined goals, managing dependencies across teams, and adapting plans as new information emerges.
   

  

 You combine disciplined execution with a continuous improvement mindset. You are comfortable working within established practices while recommending thoughtful improvements that reduce friction and help teams deliver effectively.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience managing technical programs or complex cross\-functional projects in agile environments
* Experience leading technical initiatives from planning through delivery
* Experience coordinating work across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, or other cross\-functional partners
* Strong program management skills, including planning, risk management, dependency tracking, release readiness, and stakeholder communication
* Ability to organize and synthesize complex information into clear plans, decisions, and updates
* Ability to understand technical concepts, system dependencies, and their connection to customer or business outcomes
* Experience identifying and implementing continuous improvements to program delivery processes, frameworks, and operating practices to strengthen execution
* Demonstrated ability to build alignment and influence outcomes without direct authority
* Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non\-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting experimentation, measurement, or data\-informed product development
* Experience working with advertising, media, or marketplace platforms, such as Google Ad Manager, Prebid, supply\-side platforms, demand\-side platforms, data management platforms, or programmatic infrastructure


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*
*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*
*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

 We are seeking a hands\-on Manager, Data Engineering to lead execution across a portfolio of Flight Safety data engineering work while also serving as a senior individual contributor. This role is responsible for prioritization, sequencing, and delivery coordination across competing needs, while providing technical leadership, coaching, and site\-level support for the local engineering effort. The role is expected to operate in a working\-leader model, with approximately 70–80% of time spent contributing directly to technical work and the remaining time focused on team coordination, coaching, and leadership responsibilities.
   

  

**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**
**What you need to succeed (minimum qualifications)**

* Accountable (A) for intake, prioritization, sequencing, and trade\-off decisions across the engineering portfolio. Defines execution priorities, clarifies ownership, escalates constraints, and aligns stakeholder demand with available capacity. May contribute to solution design and implementation but is distinct from the Data Engineer role in owning portfolio\-level direction and delivery decisions.
* Own intake, prioritization, sequencing, and execution visibility across Flight Safety data engineering work
* Provide day\-to\-day leadership for the engineering effort, including work assignment, coordination, follow\-through, and escalation of blockers
* Coach and support the Data Engineer while raising expectations for quality, maintainability, documentation, and disciplined execution
* Serve as the primary point of coordination between stakeholders, analysts, and technical partners on engineering scope, timing, and trade\-offs

* Establish lightweight operating rhythms for intake, prioritization, execution tracking, and decision follow\-up
* Provide hands\-on technical contribution where needed, especially in higher\-complexity or higher\-ambiguity work, while maintaining accountability for overall portfolio delivery
* Identify resource gaps, competing demands, and execution risks, and surface them early with practical options or recommendations
* Reinforce a sustainable engineering model that reduces single\-threaded dependency and increases repeatability over time
* Support site\-level leadership through local coordination, team support, and reinforcement of delivery standards and working norms


 Success Metrics
   

  

* Planning accuracy (planned vs. actual delivery timelines)
* Decision cycle time for prioritization and trade\-offs
* Reduction in blocked or ownerless work
* % of work with clear priority, owner, and expected outcome
* Throughput of completed work across the portfolio
* Reduction in rework caused by unclear scope or conflicting priorities
* Stakeholder clarity and confidence in engineering priorities
* Growth in team independence, consistency, and execution discipline


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Ability to champion a collaborative environment by empowering team members, demonstrating resilience, being inclusive, and building a culture of trust.
* Ability to build and sustain robust networks across internal and external stakeholders.
* Being a coach/mentor/advisor to drive continuous team development and growth.
* Use systemic thinking to drive business results and strategic decisions that enhance organizational outcomes.
* Ability to advocate for customer\-focused innovations, model empathy in decision\-making, inspiring others to approach problems from the customer’s perspective and decisions that reflect an uncompromising commitment to customer safety, fostering trust and loyalty.

 Data Engineering

title: Service Delivery Manager - Offshore
description:
**Company Description**
 Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Service Delivery Manager – MSP (SDM) is the focal point of driving the overall technical services delivery to any MSP customer from Day 1 as the project goes live. SDM is introduced as the SPOC from Technical Services at the beginning of the new logo implementation through any of the packages available with Nexthink. As the project enters the run phase, the SDM manages the delivery of scoped Managed Services (hereafter referred to as “Accelerate”) to Nexthink’s MSP Partner \& their end customer. They play a pivotal role in supporting the MSP \& their customer to realise value from the Nexthink platform. The SDM is supported by one or more Professional Services Consultants (PSC) as well as other support functions like Partner Success Manager, Product Managers, Product Support and more over, backend teams creating new content over the Nexthink platform. The objective of SDM is to ensure that Accelerate services are aligned with the customer success plan, and the value metrics being tracked for the customer, ensuring a continuous value delivery to the customer.
   

  

 The role will coordinate the daily activities of the assigned PSCs, along with the other supporting Accelerate teams located globally and focus on the highest priorities and the biggest impact to the customer, while providing quality assurance, and delivering within the agreed service levels.
   

  

 The role is a combination of technical and business skills; in which the candidate would work with the MSP \& their customer right from doing DEX Management planning, document mutually agreeable success parameters, assigning BAU tasks to Accelerate PSCs and setting a governance to track the achievements of set goals \& ultimately, document and present value achieved to the customer. The candidate should have the ability to assess technical requests, have meaningful discussions with customer on their objectives and map the same back to different product features / packages offered by Nexthink. SDM would be responsible to create and drive the Service Delivery Strategy for the customer and would work internal and external stakeholders across the customer and partner organizations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the Managed Service Provider (MSP) and their customer, overseeing all deliverables outlined in the Services contract.
   

  

 Participate actively in Customer Steering Group meetings, collaborating with the MSP to discuss Nexthink's role in the customer's Digital Experience (DEX) strategy, understand the partner / customer’s priorities and effectively, ensure timely and qualitative delivery of services.
   

  

 Provide guidance to the PSC \& MSP to drive the Business as Usual (BAU) operations. Recommend new business use cases and engage with the customer / MSP to increase adoption of Nexthink.
   

  

 Analyze customer’s business needs \& pain areas through regular connects, understanding of TCDs from Service Desk \& various data seen from Nexthink. Identify opportunities to increase automation of issues \& leverage existing as well as custom created contents to deliver value to the customer’s / MSP business.
   

  

 Gain a deep understanding of the customer's business goals and objectives as outlined in the MSP contract, aligning Nexthink's deliverables with these objectives.
   

  

 Comprehend the customer's DEX goals, strategic plans, pain points, and limitations to offer informed advice on leveraging Nexthink effectively.
   

  

 Conduct thorough analysis of Nexthink data and present actionable insights to the customer. Create well documented presentations, capturing insights from data and provide recommendations.
   

  

 Organize and coordinate for regular governance calls with MSP as well as bi\-monthly / quarterly business review meetings with a focus on getting things done, based on CSP and mutually agreed road\-map.
   

  

 Collaboratively plan the Customer Success Plan and strategy with the PSM, Sales team, PSC \& SC regularly; ensure to update the CSP based on the customer’s priorities.
   

  

 Lead and manage the PSC / PSCs assigned to specific projects, ensuring their tasks and goals align with the Customer's Success Plan (CSP).
   

  

 Identify and advocate for automation opportunities that bring value to the customer. Prioritize and request custom automation or report creation as needed, working backend with the other support teams of Accelerate.
   

  

 Develop content tailored to customer requirements, collaborating with the Shared Services team for custom scripting, reports using external tools with Nexthink data, custom NQL queries.
   

  

 Support customer initiatives related to Nexthink operations, including existing and upcoming projects. Encourage customer participation in Technical Previews of new features.
   

  

 Organize regular product roadmap workshops to keep customers informed about new features and modules.
   

  

 Meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and take prompt action, including internal escalations or partner notifications, in case of any impacts on SLO achievement.
   

  

 Identify and fulfill agreed\-upon use cases, consistently delivering results quarter after quarter.
   

  

 Validate any new service / content requirements from the partner and raise the records in JIRA ticketing system. Assign tasks to self or PSC, post validation.
   

  

 Establish and maintain a regular communication cadence with the MSP and customer through weekly, monthly, and quarterly meetings, ensuring that progress is tracked by PSCs.
   

  

 Maintain updated Action Trackers \& other relevant documents on OneDrive, including customer related insights and roadmap discussions. Update Salesforce records as required.
   

  

 Prepare all customer\-facing and internal deliverables, ensuring they meet high\-quality standards.
   

  

 Coordinate and communicate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Support, and Partner Success, to align Managed Services activities.
   

  

 Increase the footprint of Nexthink across different functions of the customer, within IT as well as non\-IT related usage. Enhance stickiness of Nexthink to ensure smooth renewal and possible product upsells.
   

  

 Escalate issues internally and externally when necessary to ensure prompt resolution. Follow\-up with Product Support or relevant resolver groups to ensure timely resolution of issues raised. Raise RED FLAGS to alert in case of any deviations.
   

  

 Stay informed about product development and releases at a level necessary to fulfill the above responsibilities, and inspire PSCs to innovate continuously to maximize Nexthink's value.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering preferred.


**Experience:**
* 8 \- 10 years of experience in technical consulting, analytics, and automation, with a preference for candidates with this background.
* Consulting\-based approach in previous roles coupled with good project management skills.
* Knowledge of Nexthink / competing products would be an advantage.
* Flexible to work in UK / US shifts


**Key Skills and Attributes:**
* Analytical Expertise: Proficient in analyzing data to identify pain points and opportunities, with a strong commitment to providing actionable insights and driving automation.
* Transformation Experience: Demonstrated experience in transformation projects, such as Win10 and O365 migrations.
* End User Computing (EUC) Mastery: Extensive technical knowledge of end user computing (EUC) management.
* Collaborative Aptitude: Skilled at collaborating with dispersed teams, including CTOs, product management, and support, to deliver the right solutions and innovate based on customer input.
* IT Operations Proficiency: Deep understanding of IT operations.
* Quick Learner: Ability to rapidly acquire knowledge of new technologies.
* Customer\-Centric: Proven ability to gather and manage customer feedback, comprehend customer pain points, and propose practical solutions.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a strong ability to engage with customers and collaborate effectively within a team.

title: Project Control Specialist II
description:
* We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
* Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
* Enjoy a varied \& challenging role.


**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
   

  

 Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
   

  

 We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data\-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
   

  

**The Role**

 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
* Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.
* Develop and finalise the Project Controls Plan as per Project requirements and interface with Client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.

* Preparation and analysis of Project performance statistics and analytics as appropriate.
* Lead to set up Project Cost reports, internal monitoring metrics and other reporting requirements.
* Monitoring \& controlling the cost by various analysis and time to time information Management about the risk areas.
* Performing Risk Analysis on the Schedule and provide inputs / recommendations.
* Generating various reports like Progress S\-curves, Lookahead Plan, Variance Analysis, Productivity Analysis.
* Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
* Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports.
* Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, Concerns, and recovery plans etc.

* Preparation of project cost reports and provide forecast analysis and trends of the project.

**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Engineering Manager** 




*Accelerate Performance.* 




  





**About CAI Software** 




 CAI Software builds purpose\-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. Our mission is to enable manufacturers to transform performance through a connected, AI\-assisted ecosystem that delivers visibility, control, and continuous improvement. We bring the deep operational expertise and enterprise infrastructure to be a true long\-term performance partner.
 



 With 6,200\+ active customers worldwide and a market\-leading position in every vertical we serve, CAI combines 45\+ years of industry expertise with modern AI\-driven execution \- helping businesses move faster, operate smarter, and perform at their peak. We work across 15\+ industries and 10\+ countries, guided by three values built into our name: Candor, Accountability, and Impact.
 



  





**CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve** 




  





 CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing \- aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company.
 



  





  





**CAI India** 




 CAI India is a strategic investment in the company’s future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support\-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery for the EDI Products engineering team, ensuring commitments made to Product Management and Product Owners are met on time and with quality.
* Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners to translate roadmap items, epics, and backlog priorities into a well\-sequenced, achievable engineering plan.
* Champion AI\-led development practices across the team — embedding AI\-assisted coding, testing, and documentation tools into day\-to\-day engineering workflows to improve velocity and code quality.
* Manage the team’s use of Azure DevOps (ADO) and ADO\-Git for work item tracking, sprint/iteration planning, branching strategy, pull requests, and release management.
* Collaborate with Product Management in Aha! to keep roadmap, initiatives, and feature\-level plans aligned with engineering capacity and delivery status.
* Ensure engineering standards, designs, and decisions are documented and kept current in Confluence for team and cross\-functional visibility.
* Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, backlog refinement) and drive continuous improvement in team process and delivery predictability.
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers; conduct performance reviews, set growth goals, and support career development within the team.
* Manage team capacity, staffing needs, and hiring in partnership with the VP of Engineering.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and quality issues early, and drive mitigation plans in collaboration with engineering and product stakeholders.
* Report delivery status, risks, and metrics to the VP of Engineering and other stakeholders on a regular cadence.
* Support and enforce secure, compliant engineering practices appropriate to EDI and manufacturing data integration workloads.



  





**AI\-Led Development** 




 This role requires active leadership in adopting AI\-assisted engineering practices as a core part of how the team builds and ships software, including:
 


* Guiding engineers in the effective use of AI coding assistants for implementation, code review, refactoring, and test generation.
* Establishing team norms and guardrails for responsible, secure use of AI tools with proprietary and customer\-related code and data.
* Measuring and reporting the impact of AI\-led development on delivery speed and quality, and continuously refining the approach.
* Staying current on AI\-assisted software development practices and evaluating new tools/approaches for team adoption.



  





**Tools \& Platforms** 



* Azure DevOps (ADO) and ADO\-Git
* Aha! (Product roadmap and planning alignment)
* Confluence (Engineering documentation and knowledge sharing)
* AI\-assisted development tooling as adopted by the organization



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years in an engineering management or team lead role.
* Proven experience managing software delivery using Azure DevOps (ADO) work items, boards, and ADO\-Git repositories/pull requests.
* Experience partnering directly with Product Managers and/or Product Owners to plan and prioritize engineering work.
* Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and a demonstrated interest in applying them to improve team output.
* Strong people\-leadership skills: coaching, performance management, and building a high\-trust, high\-accountability engineering culture.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical topics for non\-technical stakeholders.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with EDI, B2B integration, or manufacturing/supply\-chain software domains.
* Experience modernizing legacy systems or leading teams through technology migrations.
* Background in .NET, middleware/integration platforms, or ISAM/relational data systems.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Predictable, high\-quality delivery against roadmap commitments made with Product Management.
* Measurable adoption and impact of AI\-led development practices within the team.
* A well\-documented, well\-governed engineering process in ADO, Aha!, and Confluence that stakeholders trust.
* An engaged, growing engineering team with clear goals and strong retention.



  





  





**Why Join CAI** 




 At CAI, we are building something that matters. With 6,200\+ customers across 15\+ industries and active investment in AI\-driven performance tools, we are positioned to define what the next generation of manufacturing software looks like — and we are building the team to lead that work.
 



 Our four pillars define how we deliver for customers — and how we work:
 


* Built to Fit \- Fits how your business runs so performance comes standard
* Built to Expedite \- Speeds time to performance without heavy lifts or delays.
* Built to Deliver \- AI turns action and insights into measurable performance.
* Built to Scale \- Sustains and scales performance without disruption.

title: Operational Excellence Manager
description:
**Company Description**




  





 Vialto is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand\-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
 



 Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost\-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross\-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.
 



 Working at Vialto is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
 



 Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.
 



 To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast
 **On the Move** 
 to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the
 **latest news** 
 in the industry. You can also follow us on
 **LinkedIn** 
 and
 **Instagram.** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 The Operational Excellence Manager will drive the Operational Excellence agenda across VVN global mobility operations in India. A key priority will be to identify, adapt, and scale proven improvement practices from across Vialto, ensuring successful approaches are consistently embedded within local operations. The role will build organizational capability through continuous improvement training, methodologies, and tools, while partnering with operational leaders to standardize processes, establish governance, and implement performance measurement frameworks that enable sustainable improvements and measurable business outcomes.
 



 The role will support broader process improvement and automation initiatives by identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, improve efficiency, and enhance service delivery. Working closely with operational and functional stakeholders, the successful candidate will assess opportunities, develop business cases, define requirements, and coordinate the delivery of improvement initiatives. While experience with automation is advantageous, this is primarily a business\-facing role focused on opportunity assessment, solution design, stakeholder engagement, and benefits realization rather than hands\-on automation development.
 



 Reporting to the Operational Excellence Lead, this role is part of a broader enabling functions team that combines expertise in process improvement, automation, analytics, and other support capabilities.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead process improvement initiatives using structured Operational Excellence methodologies and project management disciplines.
* Design and deliver training on Operational Excellence methodologies, tools, and best practices, and coach teams in their practical application.
* Map end\-to\-end processes, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies, and drive process simplification and standardization.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Identify and assess improvement and automation opportunities, develop business cases, define business requirements, and support benefit tracking and realization.
* Identify, adapt, and promote proven improvement practices from across Vialto to drive consistency and accelerate outcomes.
* Oversee governance of the improvement portfolio, including initiative prioritization, benefit validation, progress tracking, risk management, and stakeholder reporting.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders to support consistent service delivery and continuous improvement across regions.



**Required Qualifications** 



* At least five years of experience in Operational Excellence, process improvement, continuous improvement, or a related field.
* Practical experience in process mapping, performance measurement, and operational standards development.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead multiple improvement initiatives simultaneously, including programs delivered through cross\-functional teams and subject matter experts.
* Experience designing and delivering training, workshops, or capability\-building programs for diverse audiences.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, business analysis, and data interpretation skills.
* Experience driving change adoption and influencing stakeholders across multiple levels of an organization.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or an equivalent recognized process improvement qualification.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience supporting clients or stakeholders across EMEA and/or the Americas.
* Experience in global mobility, professional services, or other knowledge\-based operational environments.
* Experience identifying and implementing automation opportunities in partnership with technical teams.
* Experience using Power BI or similar tools for operational performance reporting and productivity analysis.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification.



**Location and Working Arrangement** 




 This is a hybrid role based in
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka** 
 . The successful candidate is expected to work from the Bengaluru office at least two days per week.

title: Senior AI & Automation Manager

* Experience using AI to build agents that solve real\-world use cases using frameworks or custom tooling
* Hands\-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, Workato, or custom\-built automation solutions
* Strong systems thinking, with the ability to consider data flow, scalability, and downstream impact rather than focusing only on immediate outputs
* Experience using Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants to build or configure MCP servers

**Professional Competencies**
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured technical requirements
* High sense of ownership, self\-motivated, able to drive tasks end\-to\-end, and proactive in dentifying and communicating blockers
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, confident working with non\-technical stakeholders, able to present findings clearly, and effective with cross\-functional teams

title: Manager - AI/ML (Hybrid)
description:
**Date Posted:**
 2026\-09\-18
   

  

**Country:**
 India

 At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.
   

  

 Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.
   

  

**What You Will Do \***
 Our Business Units bring us hard engineering problems — design cycles that take too long, certification evidence that is assembled by hand, simulation campaigns that cannot be run exhaustively, decades of legacy documentation nobody can search. The Applied Research \& Technology (ART) organization exists to find out, quickly and honestly, which of those problems AI can actually solve.
   

  

 As an Engineering Manager you will lead one such team within the ART organization. You will run a portfolio of AI proof of concepts (PoCs) against BU\-sponsored problems, prove or disprove value fast, and then make the call that matters most: hand the successful PoC to a central organization such as Digital Technologies (DT) to scale it into a deployable product at a Collins level. Leaving out the ones that do not work is as much a part of the job as scaling the ones that do.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Lead the team


 Line\-manage and grow a team of 15–20 engineers spanning AI/ML engineering, software engineering, data engineering and domain\-facing solution engineers, typically organized into 3–4 pods.
   

  

 Set technical direction, allocate people across concurrent PoCs, and protect focus when demand exceeds capacity.
   

  

 Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development and retention for the team.
   

  

 Build a culture where a disproven hypothesis delivered in six weeks is treated as a good outcome, not a failure.
   

  

* Run the PoC portfolio


 Operate a structured intake process with Business Units: qualify incoming problems, challenge the framing, and convert vague asks into testable hypotheses with agreed success criteria before any code is written.
   

  

 Run PoCs on short, time\-boxed cycles (typically 8–12 weeks) with stage gates, explicit kill criteria and a named BU sponsor for each.
   

  

 Maintain a live portfolio view — what is in flight, what it costs, what it is expected to return, and what has been stopped and why.
   

  

 Ensure every PoC produces a defensible evaluation: baseline comparison, measured performance against BU\-relevant metrics, failure mode analysis, and an honest statement of what was not tested.
   

  

* Decide and execute the path after PoC


 Own the transition recommendation for each successful PoC, backed by a written assessment of production readiness, data dependencies, integration surface, run cost and ownership model.
   

  

 Transition to DT or another central organization: package the PoC for handover — architecture documentation, model cards, evaluation results, data lineage, known limitations, backlog — and stay engaged through a defined support period so the receiving team is not left holding an artefact they cannot maintain.
   

  

 Scale in\-house: where the capability is differentiating or too domain\-specific to hand over, stand up the engineering to take it to deployment — CI/CD, MLOps, monitoring, model lifecycle management, user support and a funded product roadmap.
   

  

 Negotiate ownership, funding and SLA boundaries with DT \& BU engineering leadership so that transitions are agreements rather than escalations.
   

  

* Technical governance and AI assurance


 Set engineering standards for the team: code quality, reproducibility, experiment tracking, data handling, evaluation rigour and documentation.
   

  

 Ensure AI usage in engineering workflows respects the assurance obligations of a safety\-critical environment — traceability of AI\-generated or AI\-assisted artefacts, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and alignment with applicable process standards (e.g. DO\-178C, ARP4754A) and emerging regulatory guidance (e.g. EASA AI roadmap, EU AI Act) where PoCs touch certification\-relevant work.
   

  

 Work with export control, information security, legal and IP functions on data classification, model and tool selection, and third\-party/vendor risk.
   

  

* Represent the team


 Act as the primary interface to BU engineering leadership; translate between engineering domain language and AI capability without overselling either.
   

  

 Report portfolio status, spend and realised benefit to R\&T and BU leadership.
   

  

 Build an external view of the field — vendors, open source, academia, industry consortia — and feed it back into what the team chooses to build versus buy.
   

  

**Qualifications You Must Have \***
 10\+ years in software, data or AI engineering, including 4\+ years managing engineers, with experience managing managers or pod/tech leads at a team size of 15 or above.
   

  

 Demonstrated delivery of AI/ML systems into production — not only prototypes. You can describe something you shipped, what broke, and what it cost to run.
   

  

 Hands\-on technical depth sufficient to review architecture and challenge your team's approach: modern ML and LLM\-based systems, RAG and agentic patterns, evaluation methodology, MLOps and cloud deployment.
   

  

 Track record of working directly with engineering domain users (design, analysis, test, manufacturing, certification) and turning their problems into working tools they actually adopt.
   

  

 Experience operating in a stage\-gated research or innovation portfolio, including making and defending stop/continue decisions.
   

  

 Proven ability to hand over or scale a capability across organizational boundaries, with the stakeholder management that requires.
   

  

**Qualifications We Prefer**
 Aerospace, defence, automotive or another regulated, safety\-critical engineering domain.
   

  

 Familiarity with the mechanical engineering toolchain — CAD, FEA/CFD, simulation, PLM, requirements management — and where AI genuinely helps in it.
   

  

 Exposure to AI assurance, explainability, or neuro\-symbolic and hybrid approaches for high\-integrity contexts.
   

  

 Experience with both cloud and edge/on\-premise deployment, including constrained or disconnected environments.
   

  

 Background in the engineering discipline the team serves (mechanical, systems, aerospace) alongside the software career.
   

  

 Prior experience building a function from a small team to a scaled one.
   

  

**How You Work**
 Honest about uncertainty. You distinguish between what the PoC proved, what it suggested, and what it did not test — to your team and to the sponsor.
   

  

 Decisive under ambiguity. You will not have complete data before a transition decision is due.
   

  

 Adoption\-focused. A tool nobody uses is not a delivery.
   

  

 Credible with engineers. You earn technical respect from a senior team without doing their work for them.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
**First 3 months** 
 — Team, portfolio and BU relationships mapped. Intake and stage\-gate process defined and agreed with sponsors. A clear view of which in\-flight PoCs should continue.
   

  

**First 6 months** 
 — Portfolio running to cadence with measurable throughput. At least one PoC concluded with a documented transition or scale recommendation accepted by leadership. Team structure and hiring plan in place.
   

  

**First 12 months** 
 — At least one capability successfully transitioned to DT or deployed in\-house and in real use by a BU. A repeatable PoC\-to\-production pathway that other teams reference. Demonstrable, quantified engineering benefit attributed to the team's work.

Be it keeping passengers safe with our emergency power generation systems or creating a positive in\-flight experience through reliable cabin pressure controls and quieter engines, Power \& Controls focuses on delivering a best\-in\-class experience to our customers. title: Manager AI-ML
description:
**Role Summary**
 As Manager – AI Engineering, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists delivering GenAI\-powered solutions, agentic AI systems, LLM\-integrated applications, machine learning models, and retrieval\-enabled intelligent products. This role combines technical leadership, people management, delivery accountability, and product ownership. You will be responsible for ensuring that the team delivers scalable, secure, supportable, and business\-relevant AI and ML solutions from discovery through production operation and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This is not a lightweight line\-management role. The successful candidate must be technically strong enough to guide senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads, make sound architectural and implementation trade\-offs, and raise the engineering bar of the team. You are expected to provide hands\-on technical direction across LLM\-powered systems, agent orchestration, RAG, ML model development, MLOps, cloud\-native application delivery, integrations, observability, and SDLC discipline, while also building a culture of accountability, ownership, experimentation rigor, and engineering excellence.

* Lead and mentor a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists across varying experience levels, including senior engineers and technical leads, ensuring strong delivery quality, modeling rigor, engineering discipline, and technical growth

* Coordinate with cloud platform, DevOps, Security, Integration, Architecture, and data teams to ensure enterprise readiness of all deployments

**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, AI / ML engineering, data science, solution engineering, or technology delivery, including strong experience building and operating production\-grade intelligent systems
* 4 to 5 \+ years of experience delivering or leading AI / ML / GenAI / LLM\-powered solutions in enterprise or product environments
* Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams or technical pods delivering LLM\-powered products, agentic AI workflows, machine learning models, or AI\-enabled application capabilities, with accountability for both technical quality and delivery outcomes
* Strong technical depth in Python, modern backend engineering, machine learning solution delivery, API\-first architectures, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud\-native application delivery
* Strong hands\-on or design\-level experience with LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent platforms used for enterprise GenAI delivery
* Strong experience designing or guiding implementations involving retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings pipelines, vector search, grounding strategies, and retrieval optimization using platforms such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or equivalent
* Strong understanding of machine learning model development, including feature engineering, model training, validation, tuning, evaluation, performance interpretation, and production\-readiness considerations
* Practical experience guiding or reviewing MLOps practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment automation, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, drift detection, retraining readiness, and reproducibility
* Experience building and deploying AI\- and ML\-enabled cloud\-native services using technologies such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, FastAPI, Docker, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes / AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, or equivalent engineering and deployment platforms
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, containerization, deployment automation, secure delivery practices, and operational readiness for AI\-driven and ML\-enabled systems
* Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent\-to\-agent (A2A) interaction models, memory / context management approaches, and other distributed AI coordination patterns
* Practical experience with observability and operational tooling such as Application Insights, Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry, Log Analytics, Datadog, New Relic, or equivalent platforms, including monitoring of reliability, latency, cost, runtime behavior, and model / workflow health
* Strong understanding of agentic AI implementation patterns, including multi\-step orchestration, tool calling, context management, and workflow decomposition
* Experience integrating AI\- and ML\-enabled solutions with REST APIs, enterprise systems, workflow platforms, event\-driven services, or downstream business applications
* Demonstrated ability to translate business and product needs into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI / ML engineering solutions, while guiding teams on implementation trade\-offs, experimentation choices, and delivery sequencing
* Strong SDLC ownership mindset across design, build, testing, deployment, support, reliability improvement, model lifecycle management, and long\-term maintainability
* Proven ability to raise engineering and data science quality through code reviews, model reviews, design guidance, architectural mentoring, coaching of senior engineers and data scientists, and reinforcement of reusable patterns and standards
* Strong people leadership capability, including coaching, feedback, performance management, capability development, and fostering accountability and engineering excellence
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data science, product, platform, architecture, DevOps, and business stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience leading implementations involving agentic AI workflows, multi\-agent coordination, tool\-enabled automation, reusable orchestration abstractions, or structured task delegation patterns
* Experience with AI observability, prompt safety, runtime guardrails, hallucination mitigation, evaluation frameworks, quality monitoring, and enterprise governance practices for GenAI systems
* Familiarity with broader enterprise AI and ML platforms such as Microsoft AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, PromptFlow, MLflow, Databricks, or equivalent AI / ML lifecycle and experimentation ecosystems

* Experience contributing to reusable GenAI accelerators, internal SDKs, orchestration templates, prompt frameworks, feature templates, evaluation patterns, modeling utilities, or shared engineering utilities
* Familiarity with enterprise integration landscapes involving SAP, ServiceNow, API management layers, workflow systems, event buses, and business process platforms
* Experience with cost\-aware AI and ML delivery, including token usage visibility, model selection trade\-offs, compute efficiency, scaling considerations, and engineering productivity optimization
* Ability to communicate complex technical and analytical decisions clearly to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, and to represent team direction confidently in leadership forums

* Knowledge of responsible AI, AI quality engineering, governance\-by\-design, model risk awareness, and compliance\-aware delivery in enterprise environments

* Monitor CM production progress, capacity, material readiness, and shipment status.

* Collaborate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Engineering, Project Management, and regional teams to resolve fulfillment issues.
* Influence cross\-functional teams and drive actions without direct authority.
* Risk Management \& Reporting
* Identify production, material, capacity, and logistics risks impacting customer delivery.
* Develop and track mitigation and recovery plans.
* Escalate critical risks with clear impact and recommended actions.
* Maintain fulfillment trackers, dashboards, and weekly status reports.
* Provide accurate visibility of order status, risks, and expected delivery dates.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in order fulfillment, supply chain, production planning, manufacturing, or operations.
* Experience working with Contract Manufacturers preferred.
* Experience with SAP/ERP systems and advanced Excel.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and influence cross\-functional teams.


**Core Competencies**
* End\-to\-End Order Fulfillment
* Master Production Scheduling (MPS)
* Material Planning \& Readiness
* Shipment \& Logistics Coordination
* Contract Manufacturer Management
* SAP / ERP \& Advanced Excel

Our expertise spans ERP Consulting, Implementation, and Managed Services, utilising cutting\-edge platforms which includes ERP Consulting, Implementation and Managed Services using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Cloud Consulting, Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Dynamics 365\. With a powerhouse team of over 120 professionals across ERBrains India, Dubai, UAE, and the USA, and over a decade of Microsoft Gold Competency in IT Service Management, we're primed to lead the charge into tomorrow's digital era!
   

  

**Job Description: Lead Finance Functional Consultant – D365 F\&O**
**Position or Title:** 
 Lead Finance Functional Consultant – D365 F\&O
   

  

**Department/Practice:** 
 D365 Finance \& Operations
   

  

**Experience:** 
 8–12 years in ERP, with deep hands\-on D365 F\&O Finance delivery
   

  

**Track Record:** 
 4\+ full\-cycle ERP implementations delivered, rapid\-implementation approach
   

  

**Engagement:** 
 Owns the finance workstream of a project single\-handedly, end\-to\-end
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Delivery Head / Practice Lead
   

  

**Work Location:** 
 Bangalore (hybrid) – with domestic \& international travel as projects require
   

  

**About This Role**
 This is not a seat on a large bench of consultants. We are looking for a senior finance consultant who can take a project's entire finance scope onto their own shoulders and deliver it — from the first requirement workshop through to a stable go\-live and the support that follows.
   

  

 You will be the single point of ownership for Finance on your projects. That means you personally run requirement gathering, design the solution, configure the system, drive testing, train the users, lead cutover and go\-live, and stand behind the result. You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the Supply Chain and Technical teams, and you will be the face of the finance solution in front of the customer.
   

  

**What Sets This Role Apart**
 We deliver fast. You should be comfortable running lean, rapid implementations — making confident design decisions, applying proven Microsoft and industry\-standard patterns, and driving a project to go\-live without needing a layer of people underneath you to get the work done.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* What you will own, end to end


 On every engagement, you carry the full finance delivery lifecycle yourself:
   

  

* 
+ Requirement gathering — run discovery and process workshops with the customer; capture, challenge and shape requirements into a clear finance solution design.
+ Fit\-gap \& solution design — map business processes to D365 capability, recommend best\-practice finance processes, and document the design.
+ Configuration \& build — configure the full finance footprint yourself; specify any RICEFW items needed and hand clean requirements to the technical team.
+ Testing — build and execute test scenarios across unit, CRP, SIT and UAT; own defect triage and resolution for the finance scope.
+ Training — prepare materials and train key users and the customer finance team to operate the solution confidently.
+ Cutover \& Go\-Live — plan and run data migration, opening balances, reconciliation and the finance cutover; lead go\-live and hypercare/stabilisation.
+ Documentation — produce the artefacts that make the delivery defensible — FRD/FDD, fit\-gap, configuration workbooks, test scripts, training guides and cutover plans.
+ Delivery ownership — own scope, timeline, risks and quality for the finance stream, and keep the customer and project leadership informed.
+ Core finance modules — hands\-on ownership


 You must be able to design, configure and deliver the following modules yourself, to production\-grade quality:
 

* 
+ General Ledger — chart of accounts, financial dimensions, ledger setup, multi\-entity, multi\-currency, period close
+ Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable — vendor/customer setup, invoicing, payments, settlement and posting profiles
+ Cash \& Bank Management — bank setup, reconciliation, payment formats and cash\-flow control
+ Fixed Assets — asset books, depreciation, acquisition/disposal and integration with the GL
+ Credit \& Collections — credit limits, ageing, collections process and customer follow\-up
+ Management Reporter / Financial Reporting — reporting trees, statutory and management report design
+ Electronic Reporting (ER) — configuring and adapting ER formats for statutory and regulatory output
+ Taxation — the D365 tax engine end\-to\-end: indirect tax (GST/VAT), withholding tax and country\-specific tax treatments
+ Financial setup across operational modules


 Finance Does Not Stop At The Finance Modules. You Own The Financial And Accounting Setup That Sits Behind The Operational Streams, Working Closely With The SCM Team On The Boundary
 

* 
+ Sales / Order\-to\-Cash — posting profiles, revenue and receivable postings, customer accounting.
+ Procurement / Procure\-to\-Pay — vendor posting, purchase accounting, accruals and invoice matching.
+ Production Control — manufacturing postings, WIP, variances and production accounting.
+ Landed Cost — cost components, apportionment and the resulting inventory and financial impact.
+ Inventory Management — inventory posting setup, costing methods (FIFO / Standard / Weighted Average) and inventory close.
+ Project Management \& Accounting — project cost and revenue postings, WIP, and project financial control.
+ Cross\-functional collaboration


 You will not work in isolation — you will work in full collaboration across the project teams:
 

* 
+ Supply Chain (SCM) team — partner closely on the finance\-to\-operations boundary so that sales, procurement, production, inventory and projects all post correctly and reconcile.
+ Technical team — translate finance requirements into clear specifications for customisations, integrations and reports (RICEFW); review designs and validate that the build meets the requirement.
+ Integrations — define finance\-side requirements for banks, payment providers, tax/e\-invoicing portals, Power BI and third\-party systems.
+ Localisation experience


 You should be comfortable delivering across multiple geographies. We expect genuine, hands\-on familiarity with at least 4–5 localisations, including:
 

* 
+ India (GST, TDS/TCS, e\-invoicing, statutory reporting)
+ United States (sales \& use tax, 1099, US GAAP considerations)
+ Europe (VAT, EU reporting, intrastat, country statutory formats)
+ Australia / New Zealand (GST, BAS/GST reporting and local statutory requirements)
+ Customer\-facing expectations


 You are the finance solution in the customer's eyes. We expect you to:
 

* 
+ Engage CFOs, Finance Controllers, Finance Managers and key users with confidence and credibility
+ Lead workshops, walkthroughs, training and steering updates clearly and professionally
+ Set expectations honestly, manage scope conversations, and drive issues to closure
+ Build trust so the customer is confident the finance stream is in safe hands


**Must\-have Qualifications**
* 
+ 4\+ full\-cycle ERP implementations delivered, with hands\-on finance ownership on each.
+ Rapid\-implementation delivery — a track record of taking finance to go\-live efficiently, applying proven patterns rather than reinventing each time.
+ Deep D365 F\&O Finance expertise across all the core modules listed above, configured personally and in production.
+ Multi\-entity, multi\-currency, multi\-tax delivery experience across at least 4–5 localisations.
+ Strong grasp of accounting and finance fundamentals and statutory/compliance requirements — not just the software.
+ Independent delivery — able to own and deliver a finance workstream single\-handedly, with minimal supervision.
+ Excellent communication and a structured, problem\-solving, customer\-first approach.


**Good to have**
* 
+ Power BI for finance reporting
+ Exposure to consolidation, intercompany, revenue recognition or lease/IFRS 15/16 accounting
+ Familiarity with implementation methodologies (Sure Step / LCS / Agile) and tooling (LCS, Azure DevOps, RSAT)
+ Experience with upgrades, rollouts and post go\-live assessments
+ Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g. MB\-310, MB\-300\)


 We provide a stimulating technical environment where you can work with the latest Microsoft technologies. You will play a key role in defining our technical standards and will have opportunities to lead major implementation projects.

description:
**Job Summary**
 Sr Consultant role requiring eight to ten years of experience in Property and Casualty Insurance focused on delivering high quality consulting outcomes in a hybrid work model during day shifts without travel requirements enabling clients to improve underwriting claims and policy servicing efficiency while supporting the organization mission of responsible and sustainable growth.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end consulting engagements for Property and Casualty Insurance clients to optimize underwriting rating and claims operations while aligning solutions with strategic business objectives and regulatory expectations.
* Analyze complex policy administration billing and claims processes to identify operational bottlenecks and design practical process improvements that enhance service quality and reduce handling time.
* Collaborate closely with client business stakeholders and technology partners to translate insurance domain requirements into clear functional specifications that guide solution design and implementation.
* Develop detailed requirement documents process maps and user stories that capture rating logic coverage structures and claims handling rules in a format that can be readily implemented by delivery teams.
* Guide clients through target operating model definition for Property and Casualty portfolios by assessing current capabilities identifying gaps and proposing phased roadmaps for transformation initiatives.
* Perform impact assessments for changes in underwriting guidelines regulatory mandates and product structures and recommend mitigation plans that minimize disruption to ongoing business operations.
* Configure and validate insurance platform solutions such as policy administration components rating engines or claims modules to ensure they reflect agreed business rules and coverage features.
* Conduct system and user acceptance testing of Property and Casualty solutions by preparing test scenarios executing test cases logging defects and validating fixes against business expectations.
* Prepare and deliver clear client ready presentations status reports and workshops that explain findings options and recommendations in a structured and actionable manner for various stakeholder groups.
* Support production rollout activities by coordinating user training process documentation and post implementation reviews to ensure stable adoption and measurable business benefits.
* Mentor junior consultants in Property and Casualty concepts artifacts and best practices enabling them to contribute effectively to client engagements and strengthen overall team capability.
* Work within hybrid teams across locations and time zones to ensure that design decisions configuration changes and defect resolutions are documented consistently and communicated promptly.
* Align all consulting activities with organizational policies on ethics compliance data privacy and risk management ensuring that client outcomes contribute positively to societal trust in the insurance ecosystem.


**Qualifications**
* Possess eight to ten years of hands on experience in Property and Casualty Insurance across areas such as underwriting policy administration claims or billing with a strong understanding of personal and commercial lines products.
* Demonstrate practical knowledge of core insurance concepts including rating factors coverage limits deductibles endorsements reinsurance and loss control practices applied in daily consulting work.
* Exhibit proven experience working on transformation or system implementation projects for insurance carriers managing requirements testing and rollout activities in a structured consulting environment.
* Apply strong analytical and problem solving skills to interpret data from policy systems claims repositories or financial reports and convert insights into actionable recommendations for clients.
* Utilize excellent communication and workshop facilitation skills to engage diverse stakeholders such as underwriters claims handlers actuaries and technology specialists in hybrid work settings.
* Show familiarity with modern insurance platforms or digital solutions such as policy administration suites claims management tools or customer service portals used in Property and Casualty initiatives.
* Display comfort with working in a hybrid work model that combines onsite and remote collaboration while maintaining productivity during day shifts without requiring travel.

title: Supply Chain Performance Specialist
description:
**Vestas has a prominent position in wind technology and a Defining\-force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas' core business comprises of Development, Manufacturing, Sales, Marketing and Service of Wind Turbines. Come and Join us at Vestas!**
**Technology \& Operations \> Supply Chain \> Performance Management**
 The SIOP Performance Management team improves operational performance and execution excellence across the Service Supply Chain. Acting as a bridge between Planning, Commercial, Logistics, Procurement, and Service functions, the team ensures alignment on business priorities and enables effective end\-to\-end execution.
   

  

 The department oversees performance management, Sales \& Operations Execution (S\&OE), data governance, process improvement, automation, and business intelligence. By combining cross\-functional collaboration with data\-driven insights, the team supports revenue enablement, service availability, and continuous improvement across the global Service organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Improve supply chain performance through effective master data governance, process optimization, and automation initiatives
* Analyze master data structures and business rules to identify opportunities for improved planning accuracy, inventory optimization, and service performance
* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, and Operations stakeholders to ensure data supports business objectives
* Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for supply chain performance issues linked to data, processes, or system setup
* Define and implement scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve process efficiency
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by leveraging digital tools, automation, and data\-driven decision making
* Govern key master data domains and ensure data quality standards across global supply chain processes
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize supply chain processes across regions and functions


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field
* 5\+ years of experience within Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, Master Data, or Performance Management
* Good understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes and their interaction with planning, inventory, and service performance
* Experience working in a global business environment
* History of improving processes and business results through data\-driven insights
* Experience working with ERP systems, SAP S/4HANA


**Competencies**
* Deep knowledge of master data management and its effect on supply chain performance
* Experience working with SAP master data objects and supply chain\-relevant data structures, including Material, Location, Vendor, and Customer Master Data
* Advanced Excel skills and experience using digital tools for business analysis
* Understanding of inventory management, planning concepts, and supply chain optimization
* Experience with automation tools, reporting solutions, or process digitization initiatives
* Ability to connect business requirements with system and data solutions
* Strategic mindset with the ability to connect operational details to business outcomes
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in a simple manner
* Curious and improvement\-oriented approach
* Highly organized approach marked by initiative and follow\-through
* Comfortable questioning established processes and helping bring about change
* Able to navigate ambiguity and work across organizational boundaries


**What We Offer**
 Our company offers an engaging position with great opportunities to grow both professionally and personally in an inspiring workplace at a top producer of wind turbines worldwide. We highly value initiative, responsibility and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. You will become part of a highly professional environment with a deep business commitment.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Your primary location will be in Chennai, India
   

  

 Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Sep 2026
   

  

 Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels
   

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
   

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\-recruitment\-process
   

  

**About Vestas**
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
   

  

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
   

  

 With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
   

  

 Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Windchill PTC – Consultant, Technical Transformation**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations improve business performance by connecting strategy, operations, and technology across product development, supply chain, and enterprise platforms. We work with clients to deliver digital transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and support scalable business outcomes.
   

  

 As part of this team, you will support Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and technical transformation efforts with a focus on Windchill and the broader PTC ecosystem. Our professionals help clients modernize product data, enhance engineering and change processes, and integrate PLM solutions with enterprise systems to drive more connected and effective operations.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Design, develop, and customize end\-to\-end Windchill product lifecycle management (PLM) solutions across migration, configuration, and integration workstreams
* Configure Windchill components including lifecycles, workflows, change management, business rules, and bill of materials management to support business requirements
* Develop and support integrations between Windchill and enterprise systems such as SAP, computer\-aided design (CAD) platforms, and visualization tools
* Build and support technical solutions using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition (J2EE), JavaScript, and Extensible Markup Language (XML) within Windchill environments
* Support testing, validation, and deployment activities across development, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production environments


**The team**
 Enterprise Performance
   

  

 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.
   

  

 The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high\-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements

 Required:
   

  

* 3\-6 years of experience in Windchill data migration using Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM) or custom migration utilities
* Experience delivering 2\-3 end\-to\-end Windchill implementation and data migration projects
* Experience with computer\-aided design (CAD) data migration for SolidWorks and AutoCAD
* Experience configuring Windchill 10\.x and 11\.x, including business configuration, change management, workflows, and bill of materials management
* Experience developing or supporting Windchill technical solutions using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition (J2EE), JavaScript, and Extensible Markup Language (XML)
* Experience reviewing or supporting PLM code, integration configurations, install scripts, build scripts, deployment scripts, cron jobs, and custom utilities across development, quality assurance, and production environments
* Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience with multiple product lifecycle management (PLM) frameworks
* Experience creating business solution assets
* Experience aligning PLM enterprise architecture to client roadmaps
* Experience using planning tools or enterprise resource planning platforms such as Oracle, SAP, o9, Kinaxis, or Anaplan
