And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D\&A) – Techno\-Functional Data Consultant – Insurance (Senior Con.)**
 As part of our EY\-GDS D\&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a highly motivated
 **Techno\-Functional Data Consultant** 
 to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams within our insurance data transformation and migration initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess strong data analysis and data modelling capabilities, coupled with a solid understanding of insurance business processes and data structures.
   

  

 This role will be responsible for translating business requirements into data solutions, supporting data migration and integration activities, defining data models, and ensuring data quality across strategic insurance platforms.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business \& Functional Analysis**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, SMEs, and product owners to understand business processes, data requirements, and reporting needs.
* Elicit, document, and validate functional and data requirements.
* Conduct impact assessments for business and regulatory changes affecting data assets.
* Facilitate workshops and act as a liaison between business and technical teams.


**Data Analysis \& Data Management**
* Perform detailed source\-to\-target data analysis and mapping.
* Analyse complex datasets to identify data quality issues, gaps, inconsistencies, and transformation requirements.
* Support data governance initiatives, including data lineage, data definitions, and business rules documentation.
* Define and validate data migration and reconciliation rules.


**Data Modelling**
* Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
* Develop entity relationship diagrams (ERDs) and data dictionaries.
* Define data structures, relationships, and business rules to support operational and analytical requirements.
* Ensure alignment between business processes and target data architecture.
* Collaborate with solution architects and development teams to implement data models.
* Work closely with ETL, Data Engineering, and Development teams to ensure requirements are accurately implemented.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Data Modelling Skills**
* Demonstrable experience in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling.
* Proficiency with data modelling tools such as ERwin, ER/Studio, SAP PowerDesigner, Lucidchart, Visio, or similar.
* Strong understanding of relational databases and data architecture principles.
* Experience creating and maintaining enterprise data models and data dictionaries.


**Functional Skills**
* Strong understanding of insurance business processes and data.
* Experience working on policy, customer, claims, underwriting, or broker data domains.
* Proven experience in requirements gathering, business analysis, and stakeholder management.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical and data specifications.


**Data Skills**
* Strong data analysis skills using SQL(mandatory) and related data tools.
* Hands\-on experience in data profiling, data quality assessment, and data mapping.
* Experience in data migration and system transformation projects.

title: ADMS Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As an ADMS Delivery Manager you will be a pivotal contributor to the successful delivery of ADMS Series 3 (DMS / OMS / SCADA) implementations and upgrades for electric utility customers across the MENAT and APAC regions. You will own the technical delivery of assigned projects across the full post\-sales lifecycle – from requirements and design through configuration, network model build, testing, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – working directly with customers and with cross\-functional GE Vernova teams.
   

  

 This role is dedicated to the Distribution GSL Series 3 delivery portfolio and operates under the direction of the regional ADMS Lead in MENAT as well as the HTC GDC leader . It combines deep ADMS technical expertise with customer\-facing delivery ownership, and contributes to building regional capability and reducing reliance on single points of expertise. Requiring a high level of operational and technical judgement, the expectation for this role is moderate autonomy.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Project Delivery Ownership
+ Act as the technical delivery lead for assigned ADMS Series 3 implementations, upgrades and installed\-base engagements across MENAT and APAC.
+ Own technical deliverables throughout the entire project lifecycle – requirements, functional and technical design, system configuration, distribution network model (DNAF) build and validation, integration, FAT/SAT, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – ensuring projects stay on track in terms of budget, time and customer expectations.
+ Plan and track delivery activities, effort and milestones for assigned projects; report progress, risks, issues and change requests to the regional Delivery Manager and project stakeholders.
+ Help to lay out proper staffing to cover all regional ADMS S3 deliveries and coordinate GE Vernova, HTC and partner resources assigned to the project to ensure all projects are successful.
+ Manage defects, change requests and technical actions through GE Vernova project tracking tools, maintaining accurate and auditable delivery records.

* Client Collaboration
+ Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer on assigned projects, explaining difficult or sensitive information and working to build consensus.
+ Work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored delivery strategies through site assessments and workshops.
+ Make standard recommendations on workflow, application, interface, reports, testing and data uploads to customers during the implementation process.
+ Ensure go\-live readiness and provide support, including post\-live checkups, to guarantee customer satisfaction.
+ Travel to customer sites in the regions as required by project phase, including extended on\-site presence during testing, cutover and go\-live windows.

* Technical Expertise and Installed Base Support
+ Provide hands\-on technical support and troubleshooting across the ADMS Series 3 stack (Habitat / SCADA, DMS applications, OMS / Enterprise OMS, DNAF and system interfaces), including production issue resolution for installed\-base customers.
+ Support upgrade planning and execution for the regional ADMS S3 installed base, including version assessments, configuration re\-verification and migration activities.
+ Contribute to solution design, sizing and effort estimation for change orders and new opportunities, supporting the regional sales and bid teams as required.

* Leadership and Mentorship
+ Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience; mentor regional engineers and support structured knowledge transfer to build redundancy and reduce reliance on a small number of senior SMEs.
+ Ability to work across all GEV silos – Product, Support, Sales, HTC and delivery partners – with a OneTeam mentality.
+ Ability to grow and mentor staff, understanding that not everyone learns and grows the same way.
+ Develop persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field.

* Best Practice and Quality Assurance
+ Develop specialized knowledge in your discipline and serve as a best practice / quality resource for the regional ADMS team.
+ Stay abreast of the latest technical developments in ADMS Series 3 and the GridOS platform, and contribute to delivery standards, runbooks and reusable assets.
+ Ensure delivery excellence within your area of responsibility.

* Decision\-Making and Problem Solving
+ Use judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of delivery, technology or engineering.
+ Take a new perspective on existing solutions and use technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations.
+ Utilize multiple internal and limited external sources outside of your own function to arrive at decisions.

* Market Awareness and Integration
+ Possess in\-depth knowledge of best practices and understand how your area integrates with others.
+ Have a working knowledge of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* Minimum of 15 years of experience implementing, upgrading or supporting ADMS / DMS / OMS / SCADA solutions for electric utilities, with significant hands\-on experience on GE Vernova ADMS Series 3\.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on utility software projects, including direct customer\-facing responsibility.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally to customer sites across MENAT and APAC as required by project phase.
* Based in Hyderabad, India, and aligned with HTC workplace guidelines.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Masters degree in electrical engineering / Power systems
* Deep experience with distribution network model (DNAF) build, validation, migration and data quality management.
* Experience with OMS / Enterprise OMS, Habitat / SCADA, eFEP and ADMS integrations (GIS, CIS, AMI, IVR, SCADA).
* Experience with ADMS Series 3 version upgrades and installed\-base support.
* Exposure to the GridOS platform is a plus.
* Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan and execute programs. Established project management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across time zones with regional customers and distributed GE Vernova teams.


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Amazon Freight
description:
**Description**
 We are building a large tech organization for Amazon Freight from scratch. Amazon Freight is now part of Amazon Supply Chain Services and is building an innovative transportation network with the vision of redefining shipping for its customers. To grow our Less\-Than\-Truckload (LTL) and Truckload (TL) business continues, we are looking to building state of the art and brand new (1\) network capabilities (2\) shipper/seller facing capabilities (3\) science capabilities execution optimization.
   

  

 The new team will be building foundational core capabilities around (1\) Shipment Execution\- Quoting and Booking, Carrier/Driver Workflow , Shipper Workflow ,shipper signals, Driver/Shipper Handoffs, 3P Site Intelligence, demand side Disruption Mgmt (2\) Trailer Operations \- Trailer Pool Mgmt. , Equipment Assignment, Quality \& Prep (3\) Scheduling \& Optimization \- Shipper Scheduling workflow, Cost\-Optimal Demand shaping, Cancellations/Reschedules (4\) Cost, Demand \& Volume Planning \- Cost Planning \& Prediction , Forecasting.
   

  

 This position requires strong business judgment, exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, is comfortable making data\-driven decisions in ambiguous environments and has experience translating complex transportation economics into scalable network execution strategies. If you are passionate about solving complex transportation problems, influencing cross\-functional partners, and building innovative supply chain capabilities that create value for customers while driving sustainable business growth, we'd love to speak with you
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and deliver large\-scale, cross\-organizational programs by identifying gaps between architectures, services, and organizations, decomposing complex problems into clear solutions, and driving alignment across engineering teams toward coherent technology strategies.
* Own technology roadmaps for broad sets of systems or manage a portfolio of programs, applying deep technical knowledge to evolve, improve, and simplify technologies while minimizing recurring engineering effort.
* Drive business and system\-level reviews, assess risk, and represent complex decisions and trade\-offs clearly to senior leadership, enabling informed decision\-making up to three levels above your role.
* Create, optimize, and drive adoption of mechanisms that ensure long\-term program success, proactively steering teams away from prior failure patterns and identifying when additional technical guidance is needed.
* Amplify impact across the organization by mentoring other program managers, sharing best practices, and contributing to talent development through assessments and community events.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You might start your morning reviewing a technical design document alongside senior engineers, asking pointed questions to uncover hidden dependencies. By midday, you could be facilitating a cross\-team alignment session to resolve competing priorities across multiple service owners. title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.
* Provide timely, accurate, and management\-ready updates on project progress, production issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Lead stakeholder workshops, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, implementation discussions, and operational readiness reviews.
* Build trusted relationships by demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, business understanding, technical credibility, and accountability.


**People Management \& Team Leadership**
* Lead, guide, mentor, and support developers, analysts, and support team members across project and operational activities.
* Allocate work, monitor progress, remove blockers, and ensure team deliverables meet agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify capability gaps, provide coaching, support knowledge transfer, and recommend training or development actions.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendor resources to ensure effective delivery performance and service continuity.


**Knowledge Management \& Organizational Learning**
* Own and maintain technical documentation, solution design records, support guides, runbooks, lessons learned, and reusable delivery assets.
* Establish knowledge\-sharing practices across project, development, and support teams to reduce dependency on individuals.
* Leverage lessons learned from previous projects and production issues to improve delivery effectiveness, solution quality, and operational stability.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, mentor team members, and ensure transition readiness for support and maintenance teams.
* Promote continuous learning, technical capability development, and standardization across applications and technology domains.


**Transition \& Service Readiness**
* Own transition planning and service readiness for new or enhanced applications moving into production support.
* Ensure operational documentation, support guides, monitoring requirements, escalation paths, and handover materials are complete.
* Lead knowledge transfer sessions for support, maintenance, operations, and vendor teams.
* Confirm service readiness before production transition, including support model, SLA expectations, issue ownership, and operational acceptance criteria.


**Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**
* Programming in MS Visual C\#, Dot Net Framework
* Programming in RESTful API
* Coding SQL for Sql Server


**Software Engineering Processes**
* Strong working knowledge of SDLC methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to lead delivery planning, sprint or milestone tracking, dependency management, issue resolution, and delivery governance.
* Experience establishing or enforcing engineering practices, documentation standards, quality gates, and release readiness controls.


**Design Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of architecture principles, integration patterns, design methodologies, design patterns, and anti\-patterns.
* Ability to review architectural requirements and guide teams in developing scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technical designs.
* Experience assessing technical trade\-offs, long\-term maintainability, operational impact, and business value when recommending solutions.


**Requirements Engineering**
* Strong experience in requirements elicitation, analysis, prioritization, documentation, traceability, and stakeholder validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery roadmap, and operational support model.
* Experience managing requirement changes, business expectations, scope control, and impact assessment across project delivery phases.


**Configuration \& Release Management**
* Strong knowledge of source control, configuration management, environment management, release governance, and deployment processes.
* Experience coordinating CI/CD, build automation, deployment validation, version control, and rollback planning.
* Ability to manage release dependencies, approvals, production readiness, and post\-release stabilization activities.


**Build \& Testing Practices**
* Strong understanding of build tools, development frameworks, automation techniques, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience defining test strategy, reviewing test coverage, supporting test automation, and managing defect resolution.
* Ability to ensure software quality through structured testing, quality checkpoints, and production readiness validation.


**Behavioral Competencies**
**Analytical Thinking**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate technical, operational, financial, and business impacts from multiple sources before recommending actions.
* Capable of assessing alternatives, facilitating alignment, and driving practical solutions under time, cost, and operational constraints.


**Communication**
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical or complex topics clearly in business terms for management, business users, vendors, and technical teams.
* Able to prepare clear status updates, escalation notes, decision papers, meeting summaries, and management\-ready communications.


**Planning \& Organization**
* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, resources, and operational demands in a dynamic environment.
* Proactively identifies risks, dependencies, constraints, and execution challenges, and drives mitigation with relevant stakeholders.
* Effective in planning, tracking, organizing, and coordinating deliverables across project phases, support activities, vendors, and cross\-functional teams.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Works effectively with senior stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, vendors, business users, and technical teams.
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, customer focus, business understanding, and delivery discipline.
* Builds trust through transparency, responsiveness, sound judgment, and consistent follow\-through on commitments.


 Supports a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and team development.
   

  

**Working Experience**
* Over 8 years of relevant IT experience, including experience in application delivery, technical leadership, stakeholder management, production support, vendor coordination and team management. Prior lead or manager\-level experience is preferred.

title: Ariba Catalog Enablement Specialist / Lead
description:
****About Carrier****
**Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.**
****About This Role / Job Summary****
**The Ariba Catalog Enablement Specialist / Lead will enable, maintain, test, adopt, and govern supplier catalogs within SAP Ariba. The role will manage supplier catalog onboarding, PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalog implementation, catalog configuration and troubleshooting, UAT and go\-live readiness, catalog adoption reporting, and stakeholder coordination with Procurement Operations, Supplier Management, Category Managers, AMS, Digital, IT, and suppliers.**
****Key Responsibilities****
**Supplier Catalog Enablement**
* Support supplier onboarding and enablement into the SAP Ariba catalog environment, including supplier Ariba Network relationship setup and registration coordination.
* Manage catalog implementation projects across categories and regions for PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalogs.
* Coordinate with suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master\-data teams to resolve missing information and enable go\-live readiness.
* Maintain implementation trackers, action logs, risks, dependencies, and escalation visibility.


**Catalog Configuration, Administration \& Issue Resolution**
* Manage incoming supplier catalogs, catalog subscriptions, catalog content updates, approver assignment checks, and catalog administration activities.
* Investigate catalog data issues, connectivity defects, price/content mismatches, transaction failures, and catalog escalations.
* Coordinate corrective actions with suppliers, AMS, master data, Ariba support, and internal business owners.
* Document standard operating procedures, configuration decisions, and lessons learned for repeatable catalog enablement.


**Testing, Deployment \& Go\-Live Support**
* Define and execute catalog test scenarios, UAT plans, transaction validation, supplier connectivity checks, and go\-live readiness validation.
* Coordinate test profiles, buyer / requester validation, issue tracking, defect closure, and deployment support.
* Support hypercare during launch and ensure operational handover to support teams after stabilization.
* Ensure catalog changes align with procurement channels, preferred supplier strategy, and business controls.


**Catalog Adoption, Reporting \& Governance**
* Drive catalog utilization, preferred supplier adoption, and spend reallocation toward approved catalog suppliers.
* Track and report catalog adoption KPIs, productivity metrics, supplier performance, catalog utilization, and spend analytics.
* Support contract expiration tracking, supplier contract alignment, and coordination with category managers.
* Create user training materials, quick reference guides, supplier communications, and adoption campaigns.


****Required Qualifications****
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, IT, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* 4\+ years of experience in procurement operations, SAP Ariba catalog enablement, supplier enablement, P2P, eProcurement, or catalog administration.
* Practical understanding of SAP Ariba catalog processes, PunchOut, CIF / hosted catalogs, supplier onboarding, UAT, and catalog troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master\-data stakeholders.
* Strong Excel / reporting, issue\-resolution, stakeholder management, documentation, and project\-tracking skills.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience in a global procurement CoE or shared\-services model supporting multi\-region catalog deployment.
* Knowledge of supplier master data, contract data, Ariba Network, Guided Buying, buying channels, and preferred supplier governance.
* Exposure to catalog analytics, spend leakage reduction, compliance monitoring, and adoption dashboards.
* Lean Six Sigma, SAP Ariba certification, project management, or Agile exposure preferred.
* Ability to translate catalog gaps into process fixes, training interventions, and adoption improvement plans.


**Success Measures / KPIs**
* Increased catalog utilization and preferred supplier adoption.
* On\-time catalog implementations with effective testing, go\-live readiness, and hypercare completion.
* Reduced catalog errors, escalations, non\-catalog buying, and supplier transaction defects.
* Improved visibility through adoption reporting, spend analytics, and implementation trackers.
* Stronger alignment between catalog coverage, supplier strategy, contracts, and procurement channels.


**Key Stakeholders**
* Procurement Operations and Global SCM CoE
* Category Management and Regional Procurement teams
* Digital / IT / SAP Ariba support teams
* Supplier Enablement, Master Data, Contracts, and Suppliers
* Business requesters and approvers across global regions

**What Friday is** 




 Friday is an AI operator platform for restaurants. Restaurant data sits scattered across the POS, aggregators, bank statements and half a dozen spreadsheets. Friday pulls it into one place so owners can actually run the business from it. Friday is built by Numerize, which automates end\-to\-end bookkeeping for restaurant chains.
 



**What you'll do** 




 You're placed with a restaurant chain after it goes live on Friday, and you work from inside their business.
 


* Understand how the business works internally: what happens between an order, an invoice, a payout and the books, and where it breaks.
* Rebuild those processes on Friday, and automate what can be automated.
* Work with the people who'll use it — the outlet manager, the accountant, the chef — until they actually use it.
* Sit in the leadership review and push Friday into daily use. You don't have to run the meeting; you have to leave it with people using the product.
* Feed what you learn back to our product team, so the next client gets it out of the box.



**Who you are** 



* **You did engineering but you're not an engineer.** 
  A technical degree, and a technical way of breaking a problem down, applied to business rather than to code.
* **You've spent 5–8 years in business roles:** 
  business analyst, business or revenue operations, strategy and planning, founder's office, category or programme management. Or you've run your own business.
* **You read internal processes quickly.** 
  Given access and a few days, you can map how work actually flows through a company and say where it breaks.
* **You're hands\-on with AI.** 
  You use it daily to get your own work done.
* **You have a business mind.** 
  You understand how a business works end to end: what makes it money, what wastes it, and why people do things the way they do. You don't need to be a finance person.
* **You can talk to anyone.** 
  A CEO and an accountant and a cashier, on the same day, with the same ease.
* **You're easy to be around.** 
  A kitchen at 8pm is chaos and a month\-end close is stressful. We want someone who stays calm, keeps it light, and doesn't create drama. The client lives with you day in, day out.



**Not for you if** 



* You're a core developer or an IT person. You won't write services, build integrations or own a tech stack here.
* You want a pure analysis job. You'll be sitting with the people who do the work, not sending them a report.
* You'd rather hand over a recommendation than get the thing used.



**Restaurant experience is not required.** 
  We'll teach you the business: time in the outlets, a stock count, a month\-end close with our bookkeeping team.
 



**How to apply** 




 Please fill in the application form: \*https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfLncQteIEQEY\-DPrXB0\_fRWVo3\_9utJUlsoA7jaOusNSFBMg/viewform\*
 



 It asks for your CV and a 2\-minute video:
 


1. A quick introduction — who you are and what you're doing now.
2. An internal process you changed, and how you got people to actually use it.
3. How you use AI in your own work.



 The video matters more than the CV. No need to dress it up; talk to us the way you'd talk to a colleague.
 



 Applications sent any other way won't be tracked, so please use the form.

title: Director- R&D Technical Head
description:
**Responsibilities**
 Technical Leadership \& Strategy (40%)
   

  

  

* Define and own the end\-to\-end chip design strategy, methodology, and technology roadmap across all design verticals — SoC, Analog, Digital, Product \& Test Engineering, Design Packaging, Verification and DFT.
* Establish design standards, best practices, and quality benchmarks to ensure silicon correctness, power\-performance\-area (PPA) targets, and first\-silicon success rates.
* Evaluate and adopt state\-of\-the\-art EDA toolchains (Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens EDA) and emerging design methodologies to maintain competitive advantage.
* Provide architectural guidance on SoC partitioning, IP integration, mixed\-signal co\-design, and design\-for\-manufacturability (DFM) across advanced process nodes.


 Team Management \& People Leadership (30%)
   

  

  

* Directly manage all vertical leads and engineering managers SoC, Analog, Digital, Product \& Test Engineering, Design Packaging, Verification and DFT.
* Set clear goals, conduct regular reviews, and create individual development plans to build a high\-performing, future\-ready engineering organization.
* Drive talent acquisition strategy in partnership with HR; define technical interview frameworks and competency benchmarks for senior engineering hires.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning across a team of 12–20\+ direct and indirect reports.


 Project Monitoring \& Cross\-Vertical Coordination (15%)
   

  

  

* Engage regularly with all vertical leaders and project managers to understand project status, interdependencies, resource constraints, and technical risks.
* Supervise and monitor all active R\&D projects from architecture definition through tapeout, ensuring milestones are met and technical blockers are resolved promptly.
* Facilitate cross\-functional design reviews, tapeout readiness reviews, and silicon bring\-up planning sessions to align all engineering verticals.
* Serve as the primary technical escalation point for critical design issues, guiding root\-cause analysis and resolution across SoC, analog, digital, physical, and DFT domains.


 Stakeholder Communication \& Reporting (10%)
   

  

  

* Prepare and present comprehensive R\&D project status reports, technical risk assessments, and resource utilization dashboards to senior leadership.
* Interface with global counterparts, foundry partners (e.g., TSMC, GlobalFoundries), and IP vendors to optimize design flows and process node qualifications.


 Other Duties (5%)
   

  

  

* Champion R\&D innovation initiatives; evaluate emerging technologies such as advanced packaging, chiplets, AI\-driven EDA, and next\-generation process nodes.
* Support IP strategy, design reuse frameworks, and internal knowledge management across the India R\&D center.
* Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned by executive leadership.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, VLSI Design, or a closely related field; Master’s degree (M.E. / M.Tech / M.S.) strongly preferred.
* 20\+ years of progressive experience in the semiconductor / VLSI industry, with a minimum of 5 years in a senior engineering leadership or technical management role.
* Proven, hands\-on expertise across the complete chip design flow: SoC Architecture, Physical Design, Analog Design, Product \& Test Engineering, Design Packaging, Verification Digital RTL Design, and DFT.
* Demonstrated experience managing and delivering multiple concurrent chip design projects from specification through GDS tapeout.
* Deep proficiency with industry\-standard EDA tools: Cadence Innovus/Virtuoso, Synopsys Design Compiler/IC Compiler/PrimeTime.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with demonstrated ability to present complex technical concepts to executive stakeholders.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Experience in leading R\&D organizations of 25\+ engineers across geographically distributed teams.
* Exposure to advanced packaging technologies (2\.5D/3D IC, chiplet architectures) and multi\-die integration methodologies.
* Familiarity with AI/ML\-assisted EDA flows and next\-generation design automation trends.
* Prior experience with automotive\-grade semiconductor design (AEC\-Q100, ISO 26262 / ASIL compliance) or high\-reliability industrial semiconductor products.
* Strong publication record or patents in semiconductor design, device physics, or related fields.
* Experience working with global foundry partners (TSMC, GlobalFoundries) on advanced process node qualification and PDK evaluation.
* Demonstrated track record in building and scaling engineering teams; prior exposure to HR processes including headcount planning, compensation benchmarking, and performance management.

title: Oracle Channel Revenue Management - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle Channel Revenue Management Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement Oracle's suite of applications, and provide training and support to validate seamless integration and utilization, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on Oracle's tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will build meaningful client connections and inspire your teams, navigating complex situations with confidence. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear. You will leverage a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will deepen your understanding of the business context, interpret data to inform insights, and uphold professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's purpose and values.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of Oracle Fusion Cloud Channel Revenue Management implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and support engagements, spanning sell\-side and buy\-side channel flows from discovery through design, build, test, deployment, and hypercare.
* Own the overall solution design and delivery approach for channel incentive processes, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, auditable, and aligned with business requirements, pricing policy, and revenue recognition standards.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales, and Finance stakeholders, translating commercial objectives into effective channel program strategies and recommending appropriate program structures, eligibility rules, accrual treatments, and settlement approaches.
* Lead the design and configuration of Customer Channel Management programs, including customer rebates, customer promotion programs, annual and tiered volume programs, customer volume programs, annual co\-op programs, lump sum payments, off\-invoice promotions, special price agreements, and royalty payments.
* Lead the design and configuration of Supplier Channel Management programs, including supplier rebates, supplier annual rebates, ship\-and\-debit programs, supplier claim submission and validation, accrual reconciliation, and Supplier Portal collaboration.
* Govern the design of Deductions and Settlement processes, including claims, deductions, overpayments, invoice deductions, non\-invoice deductions, manual claims, claim investigation, dispute handling, write\-offs, and settlement by credit memo, debit memo, chargeback, check, or Payables payment.
* Oversee configuration of core setup objects including channel settings, channel program types, claim types, claim reasons, claim sources and settlement methods, user statuses, customer trade profiles, supplier trade profiles, approval rules, and claim assignment and ownership rules.
* Provide functional and technical leadership for integrations between Channel Revenue Management and Oracle Order Management, Pricing, Receivables, Payables, Procurement, Inventory, Subledger Accounting, and General Ledger, with a strong understanding of accrual, claim, settlement, and accounting event data flows.
* Lead the design of pricing\-related configuration supporting channel programs, including qualifiers, custom qualifiers, modifiers, price lists, and net\-of\-rebate conditions within Oracle Fusion Pricing.
* Own the accrual and liability management design, including trade fund budgets, fund allocation, accrual creation and adjustment, accrual balances, earnings versus payments reconciliation, pay\-over\-earnings thresholds, and period\-end close support.
* Manage multiple concurrent workstreams, projects, and stakeholder priorities while ensuring agreed quality, scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables are effectively managed.
* Establish and enforce quality assurance and release management processes, including configuration reviews, unit testing, SIT, UAT, integration testing, regression testing for quarterly Oracle updates, deployment readiness, and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Lead data migration and conversion strategy for programs, accruals, claims, trade profiles, master data, and open transactional balances using FBDI, ADFdi, CSV loaders, REST services, and other Oracle Cloud data\-loading mechanisms.
* Provide oversight for operational execution of scheduled processes such as accrual generation, claim settlement, mass settle and mass update claims, and accounting event sweeps, and proactively resolve data, integration, configuration, performance, and failed\-processing issues.
* Lead analysis of channel performance and operational metrics, including program effectiveness, accrual accuracy, claim ageing, deduction recovery rates, settlement cycle times, and unclaimed rebate exposure, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Partner with business and technology teams to define and enhance reporting, dashboards, and KPIs using OTBI, BI Publisher, and analytics platforms to provide visibility into channel program performance and financial exposure.
* Assess new Oracle Channel Revenue Management capabilities delivered through quarterly updates and recommend adoption of features that improve automation, control, scalability, and user experience.
* Establish and maintain solution governance standards, including configuration workbooks, naming conventions, change control, environment management, documentation, and access management.
* Promote appropriate data quality, master data, and control practices across customer, supplier, item, pricing, and program data supporting channel processes.
* Develop standard operating procedures, solution documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, reusable accelerators, and best\-practice frameworks to improve consistency and reduce delivery effort.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation, reducing manual claim handling and settlement activities and improving overall efficiency and scalability of channel operations.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for complex order, pricing, accrual, claim, settlement, and accounting integration issues, coordinating with internal technology teams, Oracle Support, and other stakeholders as required.
* Manage and mentor a team of Associates and Senior Associates, providing technical guidance, work allocation, quality reviews, coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities.
* Review team deliverables and provide appropriate oversight to ensure implementations meet expected functional, technical, quality, security, and operational standards.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, requirement workshops, design and solution reviews, status discussions, issue\-resolution sessions, and leadership updates.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and recommended mitigation actions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support pursuits, proposals, solution demonstrations, estimation, and capability building as required.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Overall experience of 8\-12 years in Oracle applications, with strong hands\-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Channel Revenue Management across at least 2\-3 end\-to\-end implementations or equivalent large\-scale support and enhancement engagements.
* Strong hands\-on configuration experience across Customer Channel Management, Supplier Channel Management, and Deductions and Settlement, including channel settings, program types, claim types, claim reasons, settlement methods, and customer and supplier trade profiles.
* Deep domain understanding of channel incentive processes, including customer and supplier rebate management, trade promotions, accrual management, claims management, deductions and settlement, and indirect sales management.
* Strong understanding of the Order\-to\-Cash and Procure\-to\-Pay process flows and the integration of Channel Revenue Management with Order Management, Pricing, Receivables, Payables, Procurement, and General Ledger.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Pricing, including price lists, qualifiers, modifiers, and custom pricing rules supporting channel programs.
* Understanding of Subledger Accounting, accounting events, accrual accounting, credit and debit memo processing, write\-off treatment, and period\-close implications of channel transactions.
* Experience managing complex implementations involving multiple business stakeholders, Oracle pillars, integrations, and dependencies.
* Demonstrated experience in requirements gathering, fit\-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, data migration, testing, deployment, production support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency in Oracle Cloud data\-loading and integration mechanisms, including FBDI, ADFdi, CSV loaders, REST and SOAP web services, and file\-based integrations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform root\-cause analysis and recommend sustainable solutions rather than tactical fixes.
* Experience defining and monitoring operational metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and performance reports for channel and trade processes.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business\-relevant information.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and stakeholders in a dynamic delivery environment.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and developing team members and reviewing technical and functional deliverables.


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience with adjacent Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM modules such as Order Management, Global Order Promising, Inventory Management, Procurement, and Supply Chain Financial Orchestration.
* Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite Channel Revenue Management and Trade Management, including chargebacks, third\-party accruals, budgets and offers, and claims, particularly in EBS\-to\-Cloud migration scenarios.
* Industry experience in consumer goods, distribution, high tech, industrial manufacturing, or life sciences where trade promotions, chargebacks, and gross\-to\-net processes are material.
* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), middleware, EDI transactions, and enterprise integration patterns supporting partner and distributor data exchange.
* Experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, Oracle Analytics Cloud, or comparable reporting and data visualization solutions.
* Understanding of revenue recognition, trade spend governance, financial controls, audit requirements, and segregation\-of\-duties considerations for channel programs.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, including requirements management, sprint planning, backlog management, testing, release management, and defect resolution.
* Oracle Cloud SCM, Order Management, or Channel Revenue Management certifications are desirable.


 Manager\-Level Leadership Expectations
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to operate beyond configuration and demonstrate ownership across people, delivery, technology, and stakeholder management. The individual should be able to independently manage complex workstreams, provide direction to delivery teams, challenge and refine requirements, identify risks early, recommend scalable solutions, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
   

  

 The Manager should also contribute to building the capability of the wider team through coaching, knowledge sharing, standardization, reusable solutions, quality governance, and continuous improvement, while maintaining a strong focus on delivery excellence and business outcomes.

description:
**Job Description:**
**Job Description**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Possesses knowledge in a specialized function or skill gained through work experience or formal training. Supervisory role with responsibility to deliver critical to quality metrics for the lines of businesses that he/she supports. May recommend solutions to moderately complex problems, lead or train other associates and/or supervise highly routine work. Possesses leadership, communication \& problem solving skills. Typical span of control would range from 7\-12 people. May perform a specialist role in a support function performing routine transactions or functional activities. Incumbents would be Graduates / Post Graduates with 48 \- 60 months of work experience with at least 12 months experience of leading a team.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Business Information caters to research and information needs of various groups in the Bank. The primary objective of the group is to help requestor optimize time spent on Data Analysis and Client Interactions by leveraging the expertise of BI team in Data Collation. The primary customers include Global Corporate \& Investment Banking, Global Business \& Financial Services, Debt Capital Raising Administration and Enterprise Technology \& Delivery.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Individual will be executing \& delivering high quality of business research including complex industry requests. Information will be gathered using secondary sources including syndicated sources, public domain and information sources, to effectively address business objectives. Additional responsibilities include work flow management and mentoring junior researchers.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Deliver high quality research output on all types of research requests including complex/niche industry research request
* Willingness to work in a 24\*7 (Rotational Shift) set\-up as well as on Indian holidays
* Provide next level training to upcoming researchers and guide junior researcher on complex research queries
* Ensure high quality and deadline is met on all research requests
* Ability to understand the financial and market terminologies and provide the relevant information in short notice
* Liaise with bankers to understand their requirement and to resolve quality issues
* Perform root cause analysis on negative feedbacks from Bankers
* Proficiency in Workflow Management


**Requirements\***
**Education** 
 \- Post Graduate (MBA's / Masters) degree in Finance or Business Administration
   

  

 Certifications if any \- Any certification related to research is preferred, but not mandatory
   

  

**Experience Range** 
 \- Overall experience of 5 to 7 years in Business Research/Information Research kind of teams with at least 3 years of Industry level research experience is required (Prior work flow management experience is desired)
   

  

**Foundational Skills** 
 \*
   

  

* Hands\-on experience of Industry/Market level databases such as Gartner, Wood Mackenzie, IDC, BMI, EMIS, Frost \& Sullivan, Euromonitor, SNL, Nielsen, etc.
* Advanced working knowledge on sources such as Factiva, Bloomberg, FactSet, Thomson Eikon, Capital IQ, EIU, Autex, SDC, Merger Market, VentureSource, etc. for performing News runs, Advanced Screenings, Extracting data to excel using formulae builders/excel plug\-ins, Extracting complex documents (Indentures, Credit Agreements), Country/Economy research, Trading data on Securities, Proficiency in M\&A, ECM, DCM, PIBs, etc
* Should have experience in managing workflow including assigning requests based on the knowledge level of the associate, negotiating deadlines with bankers, etc.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint including formatting, hyperlinking, deep linking techniques along with good verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work under pressure with high attention to detail and ability to maintain confidentiality


**Desired Skills\***
* Personal motivated and ability to function as a team player
* Proactive and flexible
* Strong work ethics


**Work Timings\***
 The team functions in staggered shifts with coverage starting from 6:30 am and ending at 7:30 am the next day. Working in all shifts including the night shift starting is mandatory requirement. The team provides coverage on weekends as well and hence; the prospective candidates should be flexible to work on Saturday and Sunday.

title: Project Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
   

  

 This Position reports to:
   

  

 Senior Engineering Manager
   

  

  

  

  

**Your role and responsibilities:**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost\-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects.
   

  

 This role is contributing to the Electrification business Distribution Solutions division in Hyderabad, India
   

  

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
* Design, develop, and implement Substation Automation Systems, including SCADA, PLC, and RTU\-based control, monitoring, and communication systems, ensuring reliable, efficient, and secure operation of electrical power networks.
* Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot PLC programs (ABB AC500 and Emerson PAC System) for electrification and substation automation applications.
* Design and configure HMI using ABB CP600 and Emerson Quick Panel. Design and configure SCADA systems using ZENON and ZEE600 platforms for monitoring, control, alarm management, and system visualization.
* Prepare and maintain project engineering documentation, including System Architecture Diagrams, I/O Lists, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), IP Address Lists, Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) documents, Site Acceptance Test (SAT) documents, and other project deliverables.
* Select and specify appropriate hardware components, including PLCs, RTUs, communication equipment, networking devices, HMIs, and associated control system components, based on project requirements.
* Provide remote technical support for testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and system integration activities, ensuring successful project execution and customer satisfaction.


**Qualifications for the role:**
* B.E or Diploma in Electrical with 8\+ years experience, Proficient in electrical distribution and automation, power systems, and substation automation.
* PLC programming in accordance with the IEC 61131\-3 standard, preferably on Emerson PAC system PLC (PAC Machine Edition) and ABB AC500 PLC (Automation Builder) platform.
* HMI designing using Emerson Quick Panel and ABB Panel Builder.
* SCADA development on GE Cimplicity, Copadata ZENON and ABB ZEE600 Platform.
* LV and / or MV switchgear knowledge and knowledge of Communication and Network Architecture designing.


**More about us:**
 ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment\-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium\-voltage link between high\-voltage transmission systems and low\-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium\-voltage air\- and gas\-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low\-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

 ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.
   

  

 View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

title: Associate Manager - Supply Chain
description:
**Overview**
 This position is responsible for working with Business Units, Functional teams, and IT support teams on various IDOC message types related to Supply Chain operations. The role involves monitoring, analyzing, and resolving IDOC failures related to Master Data, OTC (Order to Cash), Sales \& Distribution, and other supply chain processes.
   

  

 In addition to core responsibilities, the role actively contributes to process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder management, and operational governance to ensure smooth business operations and system reliability.
   

  

 The position also supports incident resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous monitoring of IDOC flows to ensure business continuity and SLA adherence across supply chain processes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work closely with Business Units, field users, and IT support teams to understand operational requirements and deliver efficient and innovative solutions to support supply chain processes.
* Monitor and manage high volumes of IDOC transactions, ensuring timely resolution of failures within defined SLAs while minimizing operational disruptions.
* Act as a key coordination point between Business and IT teams for resolving complex system issues related to SAP Master Data, OTC processes, and Sales \& Distribution transactions.
* Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to reduce manual work and enhance operational efficiency using tools such as Power BI, Power Query, Excel automation, and Winshuttle.
* Design and maintain operational dashboards to monitor process performance, track incidents, and provide real\-time visibility to stakeholders.
* Lead root cause analysis discussions for recurring IDOC failures and collaborate with IT teams to implement permanent solutions rather than temporary fixes.
* Manage and execute Winshuttle scripts to automate PID document posting and settlement processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* Monitor operational dashboards and reporting systems to ensure smooth process flow and proactive issue identification.
* Act as a Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for business escalations, supporting urgent operational queries from Business Units and stakeholders.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system changes, automation tools, and new functionality implementations within supply chain systems.
* Develop and deliver process documentation, SOPs, and training materials to support knowledge transfer and operational standardization.
* Coordinate team activities and provide operational guidance, ensuring effective collaboration and seamless shift handovers.
* Ensure clear communication between teams during operational transitions, maintaining continuity of critical supply chain activities.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and process optimization, contributing ideas that improve productivity, reduce turnaround time (TAT), and enhance reporting transparency.
* Support governance, compliance, and audit readiness activities by maintaining process documentation and operational records.
* Ensure proactive monitoring and resolution of incidents affecting supply chain operations, minimizing business impact.
* Maintain strong collaboration with cross\-functional teams including Planning, Supply Chain, IT, and Business stakeholders to support operational goals.


**Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of SAP systems including SAP ECC / SAP S4 HANA and IDOC processing
* Experience in Supply Chain processes including Order Management, Master Data, and OTC flows
* Strong working knowledge of Excel, Power Query, Power BI, VBA automation, and reporting tools
* Hands\-on experience with automation tools such as Winshuttle for transaction automation
* Ability to manage high transaction volumes and ensure SLA adherence
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills
* Ability to communicate technical and operational issues clearly to both business and IT teams

title: Independent Testing Manager - AI Execution
description:
**Job Description**
**About this role:**
 Wells Fargo is seeking an Independent Testing Manager
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage a team of managers in cross\-functional teams in accomplishing goals and priorities
* Develop and design methodologies and standards for review activities across the Enterprise in alignment with the Risk Management Framework
* Ensure effective and appropriate testing, validation, and documentation of review activities for risk programs, risks, and controls according to standards and other applicable policies
* Develop, maintain, and execute the Annual Plan
* Assess, document, and communicate emerging risks, themes and identified issues to leadership and risk partners in a timely manner
* Ensure issues are identified and documented
* Identify potential corrective actions, and follows through on reporting, escalation, and resolution
* Perform moderate to high risk quality reviews
* Lead implementation of complex and strategic initiatives with moderate risk and complexity
* Ensure plan includes targeted reviews based on risk and meets internal past due benchmarks
* Lead moderate to high risk or complexity review activity engagements
* Escalate any critical or high risk issues to appropriate leadership
* Manage communication and collaboration with business heads, Legal, Audit, and regulators on risk related topics
* Provide status updates to key stakeholders on programs and specific reviews where warranted
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Independent Testing
* Mentor and guide talent development of direct reports and assist in hiring talent


**Required Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of experience in Independent Testing experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2\+ years of Leadership experience


**Desired Qualifications:**
* 10\-15\+ years of experience across risk, compliance, audit, assurance, or regulatory functions, with a strong emphasis on AI Strategy, Execution, and Optimization within large, regulated financial institutions.
* Demonstrated experience or strong foundational understanding of Generative AI principles, prompt engineering, and the common failure modes of LLMs (e.g., hallucinations, input token drift, constraints). Experience setting up performance testing protocols for automated or AI systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with managing API\-driven architectures, user workspace platforms, execution engines, or model benchmarking tools.
* Proven track record of drafting procedural documentation, scaling governance functions, and bringing operational clarity to ambiguous, fast\-moving technical environments. Ability to synthesize local data into high\-level global strategy inputs.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Risk Management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Proven experience in project and program delivery, including managing complex, high\-risk initiatives and regulatory\-driven timelines.
* Strategic, forward\-looking mindset with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.
* Strong project management and delivery experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work in complex, matrixed organizations and partner across diverse stakeholders.


**Job Expectations:**
 Wells Fargo is seeking an Independent Testing AI Manager to join the AI Execution (AIE) within Independent Testing \& Validation (IT\&V), Corporate Risk.
   

  

 This position is responsible for overseeing a proprietary prompt execution platform, collaborating closely with cross\-functional development teams, leading an advanced Quality Control (QC) validation process, and maintaining strict governance standards to minimize operational risk and provide process clarity. Furthermore, this leader will manage in\-house platform for cross\-functional prompt prototyping, manage AI performance testing, and actively contribute validation expertise to the company's global AI strategy.
   

  

 The ideal candidate blends technical understanding of Generative AI (GenAI) and API architectures with exceptional people leadership capabilities to cultivate a high\-performing validation organization.
   

  

* Lead and manage a team of AI Execution professionals to deliver Independent Testing objectives.
* Design and maintain AI\-enabled testing methodologies and standards aligned to the Risk Management Framework.
* Execute and oversee testing, validation, and documentation of risk programs, risks, and controls in accordance with enterprise standards and policies.
* Provide credible, independent challenge to lines of business across programs and risk themes.
* Perform and oversee quality reviews, including assessments of high\-risk work.
* Identify recurring issues, emerging risks, and common themes; ensure appropriate documentation, escalation, and tracking.
* Triage critical or high\-risk issues and determine appropriate next steps and escalation paths.
* Lead initiatives with enterprise\-wide or multi\-line\-of\-business impact.
* Manage resource allocation (people and financial) to ensure appropriate coverage during peak testing periods.
* Provide regular status updates to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Mentor, coach, and develop talent; support hiring and succession planning.
* Drive efficiencies, automation opportunities, and continuous improvement in analytics, metrics, and reporting.


**Proprietary AI Platform Management \& API Execution**
* Oversee the daily operations, maintenance, and long\-term scaling of the team's proprietary platform integrated via APIs to execute AI prompts.
* Ensure high platform availability, seamless API performance, and robust technical infrastructure capable of supporting enterprise\-level prompt execution.
* Coordinate with internal technical assets to prioritize platform updates, feature optimization, and technical performance enhancements.


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Prompt Onboarding**
* Serve as the primary operational partner to the cross\-functional AI Prompt Development team and related business units.
* Define and manage the end\-to\-end workflow for onboarding newly created business process prompts onto the GenAI module of the platform.
* Facilitate clear communication channels to ensure business requirements, prompt behavior expectations, and engineering changes are perfectly aligned between development and testing.


**Quality Control (QC) \& AI Output Validation Framework**
* Directly lead and expand the AI Execution (AIE) QC team tasked with checking and validating prompt outputs.
* Establish comprehensive, objective validation methodologies to evaluate model outputs across diverse parameters, including hallucination detection, data input sufficiency, contextual accuracy, bias, and performance thresholds.
* Implement structured logging, performance dashboards, and actionable feedback loops to assist prompt developers in optimization.


**AI Performance Testing \& Benchmarking**
* Design and execute structured AI performance testing parameters to continuously measure, evaluate, and benchmark model responses.
* Track critical performance indicators including response latency, throughput under load, prompt execution speed, and token usage optimization.
* Partner with engineering teams to diagnose performance bottlenecks and maintain stable, scalable user experiences across all modules.


**AI Strategy**
* Deliver strategic testing data, performance benchmarks, and governance metrics to contribute meaningfully to the organization's overarching global AI strategy.
* Act as a subject matter expert to ensure localized validation procedures align seamlessly with global AI ethical guidelines, risk appetites, and technical deployment roadmaps.
* Identify emerging industry trends in AI validation to keep the enterprise at the cutting edge of safe AI adoption.


**Governance \& Procedure Management**
* Manage a dedicated Governance team focused on bringing clarity, standardization, and structural rigor to the team's operating environment.
* Author, implement, and maintain clear standard operating procedures (SOPs), validation criteria, and testing policy frameworks.
* Ensure the team's testing procedures align fully with enterprise risk controls, compliance guidelines, and evolving external AI regulatory frameworks.


**People Leadership \& Team Development**
* Recruit, mentor, and develop a diverse, high\-performing team composed of QC validation analysts, technical platform operators, and governance specialists.
* Foster a collaborative, growth\-oriented culture centered on accountability, continuous technical learning, and psychological safety.
* Set transparent performance goals, deliver regular constructive feedback, and map professional development pathways for team members.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
