title: Sr Manager, Security Analytics & Operations Senior (PL)
description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 The SOC Manager is the leader and program manager of the Security Operations Center, responsible for overseeing the entire 24/7 SOC program from a strategic and managerial level. This role ensures that the SOC’s people, processes, and technologies work in unison to detect and respond to cybersecurity threats effectively, especially critical in a high\-stakes financial environment where customer trust and regulatory compliance are paramount. The SOC Manager defines the SOC’s strategy and operating procedures, aligns the team’s objectives with the organization’s risk management and business goals, and communicates the SOC’s status and needs to executive leadership. In a financial industry context, the SOC Manager also plays a key role in ensuring compliance with industry regulations (such as PCI\-DSS or FFIEC guidelines) through well\-documented processes and by coordinating with risk and compliance teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Direction: Develop and drive the SOC’s strategy and roadmap. Define the scope of the SOC’s services (e.g., which threats to monitor, which assets to protect) in alignment with the organization’s business objectives and risk appetite. Regularly assess and update this strategy to address evolving cyber threats, new business initiatives, and changes in regulatory requirements.
* Team Leadership \& Development: Build and manage the SOC team to ensure 24/7 operational coverage and high performance. Oversee recruitment, training, and professional development of SOC personnel (analysts and team leads). Establish clear performance goals and career progression paths for team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and strong teamwork. Provide coaching and conduct performance evaluations.
* Operational Oversight: Oversee daily SOC operations and ensure the incident response program is functioning effectively at all times. Verify that the SOC is appropriately staffed, and that incident response playbooks and processes are well\-documented, tested, and adhered to during incidents. Organize regular drills or simulations (like cyber incident tabletop exercises) to test and improve the team’s readiness for various attack scenarios.
* Metrics \& Reporting: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for the SOC, such as Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), incident volume trends, and analyst efficiency. Use metrics to gauge the SOC’s effectiveness and identify areas for improvement. Prepare and deliver regular reports and executive summaries highlighting the SOC’s activities, major incidents, and value delivered (e.g., threats detected and prevented) to senior management and other stakeholders. Communicate the organization’s security posture in business terms, translating technical details into risk and impact language that executives can understand.
* Process Improvement \& Technology: Continuously improve SOC processes and technology stack. Champion the integration of advanced security tools and automation to streamline operations (for instance, deploying a SOAR platform to automate repetitive tasks and orchestrate incident response actions). Evaluate and implement new security monitoring solutions or threat intelligence services to enhance detection capabilities.
* Regularly review and update incident response playbooks and SOPs for efficiency and relevance.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with peer teams and stakeholders across the organization. Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application owners, compliance and legal departments, fraud investigation units, and others to ensure a unified approach to security. For example, collaborate with the Threat Intelligence team to ingest relevant threat intel into the SOC, or with Compliance/Legal in the event an incident has regulatory reporting implications. Foster strong communication channels so that the SOC is aware of upcoming changes (new systems, major business initiatives) and can adapt its monitoring appropriately.
* Risk \& Compliance Management: Ensure SOC activities meet regulatory and compliance requirements. In the financial sector, this includes maintaining robust audit trails of incidents, adhering to data privacy laws, and possibly reporting certain incidents to regulators. Develop and enforce policies and procedures that align with frameworks/standards (like NIST CSF, ISO 27001\) and industry regulations. Support internal and external audits by providing evidence of SOC controls and effectiveness.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Experience: 7–10\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with several years in a leadership role managing security operations or incident response teams. A background that includes climbing the ranks (e.g., from analyst to senior/lead) is ideal, as it provides both hands\-on technical experience and insight into effective SOC processes. Experience in the financial services industry or other large enterprises is highly valuable, given the scope and regulatory environment.
* Leadership \& Management Skills: Proven experience in leading and developing teams. This includes setting objectives, performance management, and mentoring. The SOC Manager should have experience managing a team with 24/7 responsibilities and an understanding of how to maintain team morale and effectiveness in a high\-pressure environment. Strong project management skills to drive initiatives (such as tool deployments or new process rollouts) from concept to completion.
* Technical Knowledge: Broad and deep understanding of security technologies and operations. Expertise with SIEM, EDR, and other incident response tools from an administrative/management perspective (e.g., ensuring proper deployment and health of these systems). Familiarity with network architecture, system administration, and security best practices across on\-premises and cloud environments. While the SOC Manager may not be involved in day\-to\-day analysis, they should be capable of understanding technical issues encountered by the team and providing guidance or resources.
* Strategic and Business Acumen: Ability to develop security operations strategies that align with business needs and risk management goals. This includes knowledge of risk assessment methodologies and understanding of how cybersecurity incidents can impact business operations, finances, and reputation. The SOC Manager should be adept at justifying investments in the SOC through metrics and business cases (e.g., demonstrating how improved detection and response reduces potential financial loss).
* Certifications: Security management or leadership certifications are strongly preferred, such as CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) or CISM (Certified Information Security Manager). These indicate a solid grasp of security governance, program management, and risk management. Relevant technical certifications at the expert level (e.g., GIAC GSLC/GSED, or vendor\-specific expert certifications) can also underscore the candidate’s technical credibility. An MBA or master’s degree in cybersecurity/information assurance can be a plus, reflecting further leadership and business training.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Financial Industry Expertise: Prior experience working in or with financial institutions’ security operations, acknowledging the unique threat landscape (e.g., fraud, insider threats, nation\-state actors) and stringent regulatory requirements (such as SOC audits, SOX, PCI, GLBA). Understanding of financial industry compliance and audit standards is extremely beneficial.
* Change Management \& Scaling Experience: Demonstrated success in scaling and maturing a SOC – for instance, having expanded a team, introduced new tiers, or improved a SOC from a basic operation to an advanced one. Experience leading organizational change (new processes, technology rollouts, or restructuring) in a security context is a strong plus.
* Innovation: A track record of implementing automation, machine learning, or other innovative solutions in security operations to improve efficiency and effectiveness. For example, deploying a new SOAR system or integrating advanced analytics into the SOC workflow.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Proven ability to work with and present to senior leadership (CISO, CIO, risk officers) and potentially external regulators or auditors. Comfort in providing assurance about the organization’s security posture and justifying SOC needs (budget, staffing) at the executive level.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

This workstream includes the migration of Strategic Sourcing to Oracle, the replacement of the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) system from Coupa to Aravo, and the implementation of a new Zip orchestration layer designed to unify and simplify the end\-to\-end sourcing, procurement, and payment experience for business users.
 



 This is a highly visible role requiring a proactive self\-starter who can manage complex, interdependent workstreams while communicating clearly and confidently with senior stakeholders, including steering committee members and executive sponsors. The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding of source\-to\-pay processes with the polish and presence needed to lead discussions with senior audiences.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the project plan, milestones, RAID log, and deliverables for the S2P workstream, spanning Strategic Sourcing (PeopleSoft), TPRM (Aravo), and the Zip orchestration layer.
* Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, and TPRM teams to define future\-state processes, requirements, and system configurations.
* Coordinate configuration, testing, and validation activities across PeopleSoft Sourcing, Aravo TPRM, and Zip orchestration, ensuring seamless integration and a cohesive end\-to\-end user experience.
* Manage vendor master data cleanup, mapping, and migration activities in close coordination with the Data workstream.
* Proactively identify gaps, dependencies, and risks across the three underlying platforms before they impact timelines, and drive resolution through appropriate program channels.
* Schedule and facilitate S2P status meetings, domain working sessions, workshops, and steering committee updates.
* Prepare clear, executive\-ready status reports and presentation materials, and confidently present progress, risks, and decisions to senior TIAA leadership and steering committee members.
* Track, escalate, and drive resolution of risks and issues per program governance standards.
* Coordinate UAT planning and execution with business process owners across sourcing, AP, and TPRM functions.
* Support organizational change management, stakeholder communications, and training for S2P end users, ensuring adoption of new processes and the Zip orchestration experience.
* Demonstrate meticulous attention to detail in tracking deliverables, documenting decisions, and validating configuration and testing outcomes.



**Program\-Level Responsibilities (applicable to all six workstream PM roles)** 



* Adhere to AmpliFi program governance, PMO standards, and reporting templates/cadence.
* Participate in cross\-workstream coordination meetings to proactively identify and manage interdependencies with other AmpliFi workstreams.
* Escalate risks and issues through defined program governance channels in a timely manner.
* Support overall cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and post\-go\-live stabilization for the S2P domain.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field.
* 6–10 years of project management experience, including at least 3 years leading procurement, sourcing, accounts payable, or TPRM transformation initiatives.
* Direct, hands\-on familiarity with at least two of the following: PeopleSoft (Sourcing/Procurement), Coupa, Aravo, Zip, or comparable sourcing, TPRM, or orchestration platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of end\-to\-end source\-to\-pay processes, including strategic sourcing, purchase order creation, three\-way matching, invoice\-to\-pay, and third\-party/vendor risk management, ideally within a large international financial services organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-system, multi\-stakeholder workstreams with significant interdependencies.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification preferred.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively and with authority to senior/executive audiences, including experience preparing and delivering steering committee\-level presentations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and drive alignment across Sourcing, AP, TPRM, Vendor Management, IT, and Data teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business language.
* High attention to detail, particularly in tracking configuration decisions, testing outcomes, and data migration accuracy across multiple platforms.
* Proficiency in project management and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Teams, SharePoint).
* Ability to work proactively and independently across time zones with global stakeholders (onshore/offshore coordination).
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Prior experience with ERP transformation programs, particularly upgrades or replacements involving sourcing, procurement, or TPRM systems.
* Experience with orchestration or workflow layers designed to unify disparate procurement systems into a single user experience.



 Experience working within regulated financial services environments, with an understanding of associated compliance and audit requirements

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone.  Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows

title: Engineering Group Manager
description:
**Overview**
 SSOE is seeking an accomplished engineering leader to lead and scale our India Engineering organization as a strategic Global Capability Center (GCC) supporting our U.S. business operations.
   

  

 This role presents a unique opportunity to build and lead one of SSOE's key global engineering organizations. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing a high\-performing multidisciplinary engineering team, managing complex projects, strengthening technical excellence, fostering leadership capability, and establishing India as a trusted extension of SSOE's global delivery model.
   

  

**AI and Innovation**
 At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Quality**
* Provide strategic and operational leadership for all engineering disciplines within the India office
* Ensure consistent application of engineering standards, design procedures, quality processes, and best practices across all disciplines

* Facilitate technical reviews, peer reviews, and quality assurance processes for major projects and deliverables

* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned, and best practice adoption across the enterprise.


**Global Capability Center Leadership**
* Lead the development and growth of SSOE's India Engineering Capability Center.
* Partner with U.S.\-based engineering, operations, and business leaders to align India capabilities with business needs.
* Establish India as a trusted, high\-performing extension of SSOE's global engineering organization.
* Drive standardization and consistency in engineering delivery across global teams.
* Build organizational capabilities that enable increased project execution from India.
* Promote collaboration, transparency, and accountability across geographically distributed teams.
* Strengthen cross\-border relationships that improve project outcomes and client satisfaction.


**People Management \& Talent Development**
* Manage, mentor, and coach engineers, designers, section managers and department managers within the group, providing regular feedback, guidance, and support.
* Identify strengths and development areas of team members; create and execute individual development plans and career paths in partnership with HR and corporate Training \& Development.
* Partner with Department Managers, Section Managers, Operations, and HR on hiring, onboarding, performance management, and staffing decisions for your engineering team.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, safety, quality, and accountability, where team members are engaged and empowered to contribute ideas.
* Lead, coordinate, and participate during talent review process for the DMs, SMs and engineering / designers’ group.
* Build a strong leadership pipeline capable of supporting organizational growth


**Resource Planning, Scheduling, and Workload Management**
* Work closely with Operation Managers, Project Managers, Section Managers and Department Managers to solve scheduling and resource allocation challenges.
* Facilitate development with inputs from relevant stakeholders. Monitor project work schedules and departmental workload forecasts, ensuring alignment between staffing, skill sets, and project priorities.
* Use your technical expertise to ensure the proper staff are allocated effectively across multiple projects, disciplines, and business units, balancing workload to maximize efficiency.
* Explore ways to prioritize workstreams and resolve resource bottlenecks to maintain high operational standards and exceed client expectations.
* Monitor delivery performance and implement corrective actions as necessary.
* Support operational excellence initiatives that improve productivity, efficiency, and project outcomes.


**Cross\-Office Collaboration \& Best Practices**
* Coordinate with other SSOE international offices to ensure that project teams can share resources, tools, and best practices.
* Help standardize workflows and improve inter\-office communication, ensuring that all teams are aligned toward common objectives.
* Champion knowledge\-sharing practices, including post\-project reviews, lessons learned, and reusable content/templates.


**Business Performance, Budgeting, and Proposals**
* Support senior leadership in achieving key business goals, including financial performance and profitability.
* Monitor profitability at the client, project, and (where applicable) department level; work with teams to identify operational inefficiencies and implement improvements without sacrificing quality.
* Play an integral role in the annual business planning and budgeting process for your area, including forecasting resource needs, anticipating challenges, and proposing realistic budgetary solutions.
* Support proposal development through technical guidance, staffing strategies, risk assessments, and execution planning.


**Technology, Tools, and Innovation**
* Partner with Corporate \& Information Systems (C\&IS) and other stakeholders to drive decisions regarding hardware, software, and emerging technology needs for your team.
* Ensure teams are equipped with modern tools that enhance productivity, coordination, and engineering precision.
* Promote thoughtful adoption of AI\-assisted tools (e.g., Copilot, Abacus) and other automation to continuously improve efficiency and quality.


**Project Sponsorship \& Client Relationships**

**Continuous Improvement \& Lessons Learned**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from a recognized university is required.
* Master's Degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Administration, or related field is preferred.
* Professional Engineer (PE), Chartered Engineer (CEng), or equivalent professional registration is desirable


**Experience**
* 25\+ years of progressive engineering consulting, design, and project delivery experience.
* Minimum 10 years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience in technical leadership roles, leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and/or project managers including developing leadership teams
* Experience supporting global engineering delivery models, shared services organizations, or engineering capability centers is highly desirable

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills
* Proven change management and organizational transformation experience.
* Cultural awareness and effectiveness in global working environments
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills, with the ability to navigate complex engineering and operational challenges.

* Proven experience:
+ Managing or contributing to budgets and financial performance for projects or departments.
+ Implementing or improving engineering standards, processes, and quality control
+ Hiring, coaching, and developing engineering talent; conducting performance discussions and creating development plans.

* Proactive and self\-motivated, with the ability to work independently and in a team\-oriented environment.

**Travel**

**What Success Looks Like (18–24 Months)**

* A high\-performing, engaged engineering team with clear standards, defined roles, and consistent delivery quality within the Facilities SBU.

**Benefits**

 Compensation – as per market standards
   

  

* Eligibility for performance\-based bonuses, incentives, and recognition programs.

description:
**About Morgan Stanley**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions, and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
   

  

**About Parametric**
 Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
   

  

 This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
   

  

**About Team**
 The Core Operations Platform is designed to build, integrate, and support a unified technology ecosystem that enables efficient, scalable, and controlled execution of Client and Market Operations processes.
   

  

 It serves as the central backbone for operational workflows, consolidating fragmented systems into a single, orchestrated platform that improves data integrity, reduces manual effort, and enhances operational transparency. This aligns with the broader vision of moving from multi\-system, manual processes to a unified, workflow\-driven model
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director, Software Engineering is responsible for providing technical leadership, project management, process development, training, support, and a technology vision for the Core Operation Platform. This team is responsible for multiple business processes namely Account Onboarding, Activities, Reconciliation and Reporting. The role will work with Data Services and Portfolio Management technology teams across the Direct Indexing business priorities, to design and develop technology solutions, and to improve business processes. This spans across core services to enable onboarding through our partners as well as business facing websites to allow the efficient onboarding and management of Accounts. These services will help streamline the rule\-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing allow for exception driven portfolio management.
   

  

 The Director will work closely with the Client Relationship Group and Market Operations for designing efficient applications to onboard accounts while minimizing risk. They will also work with the Digital Team developing services to that will be used by our Financial Advisor portal. In this role, the candidate will develop the appropriate software strategy, striking a balance between: (1\) alignment with the growth objectives of the Business; (2\) higher performance and consistently high quality; and (3\) cost effective application structure and use of new technologies.
   

  

 This leader will shape the long term product vision, drive engineering excellence, partner closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, intuitive user experiences across operational teams.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role accountable for setting direction, executing delivery, and building a high performing team that modernizes how users interact with operations platform and supporting data systems.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and execute the technology roadmap for the Core Operations Platform, aligning investments and capabilities with business priorities and long\-term growth objectives.
* Drive architecture and technology decisions that promote scalability, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to and help advance the AI and automation strategy for the Core Operations Platform, focusing on practical use cases that improve efficiency and decision\-making.


**Product \& Delivery Execution**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of technology solutions supporting account onboarding, operational workflows, reconciliation, reporting, and client servicing.
* Champion engineering best practices, including software quality, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


**Business Engagement \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Partner closely with Operations, Client Relationship Group, Digital, Data Services, and Portfolio Management Technology teams to identify and deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Translate business needs into technology strategies that improve user experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.


**People Leadership \& Organizational Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.


**Governance, Risk \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure technology solutions adhere to regulatory, security, and operational risk standards while maintaining platform stability and reliability.
* Establish strong governance, support, and change management practices that enable effective delivery and continuous operational improvement.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Asset management industry experience preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 7\+ years of Experience supervising and guiding software development teams and fostering an engaging, collaborative environment.
* 10\+ Years of Experience developing scalable solutions with advanced programming languages including .Net and Java framework.
* Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.
* Strong leadership skills including:
+ Vision and strategy
+ Influencing and consensus building
+ Communication
+ Total quality commitment
+ Ownership and accountability
+ Project management

* Successful track record of development and implementation of an innovative strategic vision and plans, and competence in building strategies to deliver technology to meet business goals and objectives. Ability to transform strategy into tactical plans and delivery.
* A creative, self\-confident self\-motivator with a "can do" orientation, along with the ability to function both independently and as a member of a team. Can work well in a fast paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Passionate, forward thinking and creative individual with high ethical standards and integrity.
* Ability to collaborate and partner as a business professional. The ability to facilitate, gain compromise and/or consensus within diverse teams.
* Assertiveness balanced with a sensitivity toward and concern for people. The ability to create strong work ethics and committed teams, foster open dialogue, and promote individual and team success.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills in customer and internal environment.
* Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation use cases to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.

Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services.

 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. **Summary**
 We are seeking a
 **Business Program \& Operations Analyst – UAT \& Implementation** 
 to support a highly visible, enterprise\-wide refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation initiative being deployed across approximately 7,530 retail locations. This large\-scale program is transforming a traditionally manual temperature\-checking and logging process through sensor technology, automated data collection, temperature alerts, and work\-order automation.
   

  

 The program is designed to provide greater visibility into refrigeration equipment performance, identify potential equipment and temperature issues earlier, reduce product loss, support compliance requirements, improve preventive and corrective maintenance processes, and generate significant operational efficiencies and cost savings.
   

  

 In this role, you will help ensure the program is successfully implemented across the store network by supporting business requirements, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), process and SOP validation, training, operational readiness, implementation quality, and go\-live activities. You will work cross\-functionally with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and other program resources to ensure solutions meet business requirements and implementations remain on schedule without compromising quality.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst or program implementation experience, with hands\-on exposure to UAT, business process testing, requirements validation, training, and implementation readiness. Experience supporting retail, facilities, store operations, or large\-scale multi\-site implementations would be especially valuable.

 Position Overview
 



**Reporting to: Vice President \- Procurement** 




**Location:** 
 The Leela Corporate Office, Mumbai
 



 The Manager / Senior Manager – Procurement \& Contracts (Civil) will be responsible for managing procurement and contracting activities related to civil and interior works across project developments. This role involves leading the procurement lifecycle for construction packages, evaluating technical and commercial requirements, managing contract finalization, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and project requirements.
 



  





 The incumbent will work closely with project teams, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to support the successful delivery of project procurement objectives. The role requires strong expertise in contract management, commercial negotiations, technical evaluation of civil and interior packages, and a thorough understanding of construction industry practices and standards.

**Procurement \& Contract Finalization** 



* Lead procurement and contract finalization activities for moderate\-value civil and interior work packages.
* Manage sourcing, bid evaluation, commercial discussions, and award recommendations for project\-related procurement requirements.
* Review technical and commercial submissions to ensure alignment with project objectives and contractual requirements.
* Support the preparation, negotiation, execution, and administration of contracts.

**Technical Evaluation \& Commercial Assessment**

**Contract Administration**

**Education**

**Experience**

**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise**

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Business Consulting QAS\- Quantitative Trading Book (QTB)**
**Profile: Senior Consultant \- Model Validator \- Generative AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading‑book market risk \& counterparty credit risk, banking‑book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front‑to‑back\-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision‑making for clients with capital‑markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high‑impact capital‑markets engagements across global banks, broker‑dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
   

  

 EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large\-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* MRM (SR 11\-7 experience) / Model Audit / Model governance along with Gen AI / Traditional AI
* Deep understanding of various neural network architectures, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), transformers, and generative adversarial networks (GANs), along with their applications in supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
* Proficiency in the development / validation of state\-of\-the\-art generative AI models, including RAG structures, as well as experience with natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs), with skills in data preprocessing, model training, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation metrics specific to generative tasks for creative content generation and data synthesis.
* Utilize leading AI platforms like OpenAI, Azure GPT, Google Gemini, LLaMA, or Mistral, with proficiency in at least one platform.
* Conduct comprehensive testing and evaluation of AI models on tasks such as text summarization, content generation, and other NLP applications.
* Experience in performance testing of AI models, including evaluation for hallucinations, toxicity, bias, robustness, adversarial attacks, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI model development and deployment.
* Demonstrate ability to learn and apply new concepts, specifically in the area of financial risk management.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PySpark and PyTorch. Knowledge in AutoML tools which are used for automating the machine learning pipeline and Auto Kubernetes for managing containerized applications.
* Experience with cloud\-based platforms for building, training, and deploying machine learning models, such as AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Cloud AI.
* Experience is writing validation reports as per MRM practices.


**What We Look For**
* Undergraduate (4\-year degree) or master’s or Ph.D. in Mathematics, Engineering, Computational Finance, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field with hands\-on experience.
* Relevant certifications in AI/RAI from GARP/ Quantitative courses such as CQF.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Clinical Lead
description:
**About Lyra**
 Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer\-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer\-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life\-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI\-powered platform combining the highest\-quality care and technology solutions.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Clinical Governance \& Quality Assurance
* Framework Implementation: Lead the implementation and ongoing adherence to Lyra’s global clinical governance framework and quality standards within the Indian context.
* Policy Development: Develop, review, and update local clinical policies and protocols to ensure full compliance with Indian mental health regulations (e.g., Mental Healthcare Act 2017\), ethical guidelines, and best practices.
* Quality Oversight: Design and oversee robust quality assurance activities, including systematic clinical audits, in\-depth case reviews, and continuous outcome monitoring (CORE\-10/Work Impact).
* Incident Management: Lead investigations into serious clinical incidents and formal complaints, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure corrective actions and systemic learning.
* Senior Escalation: Act as the final clinical escalation point for complex queries, ethical dilemmas, and high\-risk situations, providing expert guidance and resolution.
* Clinical Delivery Oversight \& Team Management
* Team Leadership: Provide senior clinical oversight and leadership to teams responsible for direct service delivery, including Intake Counselors, Clinical Case Managers, and Structured Counselors.
* Fidelity \& Pathways: Ensure consistent application of Lyra’s clinical pathways, standardized assessment tools, and evidence\-based intervention protocols across all delivery teams.
* Capacity Planning: Contribute to strategic planning regarding clinical team capacity and resource allocation to align with service demand and operational efficiency.
* Professional Development: Oversee onboarding and continuous professional development programs, focusing on clinical fidelity and the sophisticated use of Lyra’s methodologies.
* Mentorship: Foster a high\-performance environment by providing direct mentorship and supervision to Clinical Team Leaders.
* Case Management Excellence
* Clinical Integrity: Maintain overall responsibility for the clinical integrity and effectiveness of the case management function.
* Data\-Driven Optimization: Analyze aggregate case management data and trends to identify areas for process refinement and improved client outcomes.
* High\-Acuity Consultation: Provide direct clinical guidance on high\-acuity or highly sensitive cases requiring senior\-level review and intervention.
* Care Coordination: Ensure rigorous adherence to best practices in care coordination, inter\-provider collaboration, and referral pathways across the service spectrum.
* Interdepartmental Collaboration \& Strategic Input
* Network Partnership: Partner with the Network Operations Manager to ensure the provider network aligns with Lyra’s standards, providing clinical input on recruitment criteria and performance expectations.
* Strategic Advisory: Provide essential clinical expertise to Product Development, Commercial, and Client Success teams to inform service evolution and market strategy.
* Thought Leadership: Represent Lyra’s clinical approach and quality standards in external forums, conferences, and industry discussions.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in a clinical field (e.g., Clinical Psychology, Counseling, Social Work).
* Optional: Valid and current professional registration/licensure to practice independently in India (e.g., RCI registration for Clinical Psychologists or equivalent recognized national bodies).


**Experience**
* Several years of extensive post\-qualification clinical experience in mental health, including direct assessment, diagnosis, and evidence\-based interventions.
* Several years of progressive experience in a clinical leadership, supervisory, or programmatic oversight role within India.
* Deep understanding of the Indian mental healthcare landscape and regulatory compliance.
* Fluency in English and Hindi is essential; knowledge of other major regional languages is a significant advantage.


**About You**
* Clinical Acumen: Exceptional clinical understanding and the advanced ability to identify, assess, and manage high\-level clinical risk and complex psychological presentations.
* Problem Solver: Highly analytical with superior problem\-solving skills, capable of navigating intricate clinical and operational challenges independently.
* Autonomous \& Accountable: Able to work independently without close supervision, while ensuring all key issues are escalated appropriately and critical decisions are clinically sound.
* Detail\-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy of data, maintaining strict confidentiality, and adhering to complex clinical procedures.
* Communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex clinical concepts clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders internationally.
* Proactive \& Adaptive: Strong continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to innovate and refine clinical processes. Flexible, adaptable, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Organized: Highly organized with exceptional ability to plan, prioritize, and manage a high\-volume, complex clinical function effectively.
* Collaborative: A strong team player who readily accepts change and collaborates effectively with internal and external partners.


**Miscellaneous**
* Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra’s core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy.
* Task Ownership: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed\-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Process Optimization: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency and care outcomes.
* Workshop \& Content: Lead the delivery of onsite or online workshops and contribute to the development of training manuals and affiliate\-facing materials.
* Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events and webinars to promote Lyra’s transformative care model and clinical research.

title: DTS Business Analyst
description:

 Videojet Technologies, Inc. is the global leader in the manufacturing of coding, printing and marking products. This high technology product prints variable information, such as expiration dates on grocery products, packaged goods, pharmaceuticals or catalogues. Our industry is pivotal in ensuring end users consume their food, beverage and pharmaceutical products safely. As the market share leader, we have operations in over 30 countries with 4,000 employees worldwide. A wholly owned subsidiary of Veralto, Videojet is the core of the $1 billion Product Identification Platform. We offer a results\-oriented, multicultural environment that promotes both diversity and inclusion throughout the organization, team\-centered, customer\-focused and quality\-focused, guided by the successful Veralto Enterprise System. Working at Videojet gives you access to a robust career development process and exciting opportunities.
   

  

**Our Core Values**
 We empower creativity and ground\-breaking thinking to help us uncover breakthrough solutions and accelerate the pace of innovation. We believe with conviction that diversity helps us uncover more powerful customer insights and ultimately creates an advantage in the markets we serve. And we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Your Challenge**
 This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast\-growing organization. In this role, you will support internal projects and implement technology solutions for the Digital \& Technology Solutions (DTS) organization, working with Salesforce and other business applications as the technology landscape evolves in the coming years. You will partner with teams across the business to improve process efficiency, drive revenue and profitability, enhance customer support, and strengthen the technology that enables Videojet’s commercial functions.
   

  

 You will support leadership\-led initiatives to enhance business systems, tools, and processes. Success in this role requires the ability to evaluate technical solutions and assess their fit within Videojet’s IT infrastructure, manage product\-related work while meeting project timelines, and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. A strong aptitude for learning and developing expertise in these systems is essential.
   

  

**Your responsibilities as a** 
**DTS Business Analyst at Videojet** 
**include:**
**Project Coordination**
* Coordinate between local service and commercial business teams, integration systems, and global development teams to successfully launch Salesforce projects and maintain post\-launch support.
* Coordinate positive and fruitful interaction between various business stakeholders and functional teams to deliver results.
* Guide and oversee project contributors’ work, provide feedback, and execute strategically towards business goals.
* Be the representative of the global IT team and coordinate with the local regional businesses and DTS teams to ensure two\-way communication and cooperation.


**Business Support**
* Develop new and/or adapt existing SOP, standard work, and training for the local business organizations.
* Assist in creating, monitoring, and driving KPIs to increase productivity through Salesforce reports and dashboards.

**Systems Development**
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications while incorporating system constraints and balancing cost\-reward relationships
* Develop new features, bring in new/emerging technology, and enhance existing features to increase the functionality of business applications and other system environments
* Create and modify logic\-based business rules, email alerts, and process flows to support continuous improvement and increased automation initiatives
* Understand the user’s experience and predict use\-cases to architect and implement usable solutions across multiple organizations, systems, and tools


**Systems Support**

**Systems Administration**

* Management of mobile\-device imaging, deployments, and inventory/spare stock
* Analysis and optimization of systems\-related operating expenses and expenditures
* Maintenance of localized customizations and functions

* 3\-5 years relevant experience and superior understanding of new, emerging, and existing technological capabilities in software and IT, and ability to apply solutions within Videojet
* Successfully deliver results while quickly adapting to changing priorities and unforeseen challenges
* Ability to work in a global environment, with team members and users around the world
* Highly computer literate and internet savvy (Excel, browser, search engine, web applications and technology in general)
* Strong deductive reasoning and quantitative analysis. Analytical approach to provide hands\-on troubleshooting and issue resolution
* Previous experience in Salesforce required. CRM and/or ERP experience desired (Oracle, Navision)
* Experience in requirement gathering, translating requirements to functional design documents and the development and execution of tests. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* A focus on the user and the user experience and solid understanding of how to run user tests and perform user research

**Role Location:**

 Being part of a dynamic team in which there is a high focus on delivering results and continuous improvement, but also where having fun and teamwork are very important. title: Finance Automation Specialist
description:
**About Bhavin** 




 Bhavin Turakhia is a serial entrepreneur and has founded multiple successful companies. His companies are unique in several ways \- (1\) all bootstrapped and self\-funded (2\) with an intense Focus on profitability (3\) delivering High ROCE (4\) serving Global Markets (6\) in Enduring Categories (7\) with Majority stake still owned by Bhavin.
 



  





 A
 **bout the Companies** 




**Zeta** 
 is a Next\-Gen Banking Tech company that empowers banks and fintechs to launch banking products for the future. Its flagship processing platform \- Zeta Tachyon \- is the industry’s first modern, cloud\-native, and fully API\-enabled stack that brings together issuance, processing, lending, core banking, fraud \& risk, and many more capabilities as a single\-vendor stack. Zeta is actively working with the largest Banks and Fintechs in multiple global markets transforming customer experience for multi\-million card portfolios. Zeta has over 1700\+ employees \- with over 70% roles in R\&D \- across locations in the US, EMEA, and Asia. We raised $50 million at a $2\.0 billion valuation from Optum and other investors in 2025\.
 



  





**Titan** 
 is the first customer\-centric email suite created specifically for professionals and small business owners, with features designed to enable deeper, more meaningful relationships with customers. Available through leading web hosts, site builders, and domain registrars, Titan provides dynamic tools needed to effectively build customer relationships over email. In 2021, Titan received a $30M investment from Automattic, parent company of WordPress, Your Way, valuing Titan at $300M.
 



  





**Radix** 
 is one of the world's largest domain registries; and the owner of the most premium Top Level Domain extensions including .store, .inline, .tech, .online, .website, .site, .space etc. Radix is profitable, lean and was valued at over $1 billion.
 



  





**Neo** 
 is an AI\-native work platform built by Bhavin, bringing work, knowledge management, and AI execution together into a single connected workspace so AI participates directly in everyday workflows rather than sitting beside them as a separate tool.
 



  





**About Finova Work Platform** 




 Finova, our business support and analytics centre, supports multiple organisations like Neo, Ryze and other group entities. The finance function is being built from the ground up with a clear mandate: eliminate manual dependency, achieve real\-time financial visibility, and create a systems\-driven backbone for business decisions.
 



 We are hiring a Finance Automation Specialist to own this transformation end\-to\-end — implementing and extending Zoho Books/ERP systems, building integrations with vendor and operational tools, and automating finance workflows across all platforms.
 



  





**About the role** 




 This role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and independent program delivery. You will understand finance requirements directly from stakeholders, translate them into automation or ERP solutions, and either build them yourself using Zoho\-native tools or brief a coding, data analytics, or DevOps team for anything beyond your direct build capability. You will drive the full process end\-to\-end — from requirement to live, working automation — with minimal supervision. You report to the Finance Lead.
 



 This is an independent owner of finance automation and ERP integration — someone who understands both the finance process and the technical path to automate it, and can drive delivery without being told each step.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Requirement Understanding \& ERP Ownership** 



* Independently understand, identify, and document automation and digitisation requirements directly from Finance Leadership and functional stakeholders (AP, AR, GL, Recons, Fixed Assets, Compliance, FP\&A).
* Own the Zoho Books/ERP implementation and administration across all entities — configuration, multi\-currency, user access, and ongoing system health.
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for all digital and automation requirements within the finance function.



**2\. Integration \& Automation Delivery** 



* Design and build integrations between Zoho Books/ERP and vendor systems — billing gateways, HRMS, procurement tools, banking feeds, and platform\-specific technology partner data sources.
* Build automations directly using Zoho Deluge, Zoho Flow, and Blueprint for anything achievable without custom development.
* For requirements beyond Zoho\-native capability, convert finance requirements into clear technical specifications and work with the coding, data analytics, or DevOps team to deliver — while retaining ownership of the outcome.
* Automate repetitive accounting tasks — reconciliations, journal postings, MIS generation, variance analysis — across all platforms.



**3\. End\-to\-End Project Delivery** 



* Drive each automation or integration project independently from requirement gathering through to live deployment, without needing close supervision.
* Maintain a clear project plan for all assigned use cases — sequencing, dependencies, and timelines — and proactively flag risks or blockers to the Finance Lead.
* Deliver all use cases directly assigned, while proactively identifying additional automation opportunities as platforms evolve.



**4\. Analytics \& Reporting Automation** 



* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting layers (Zoho Analytics or equivalent) for consolidated financials, FP\&A modelling, and platform\-specific KPIs (e.g., collection efficiency dashboards for Finova).
* Ensure reporting automation reduces manual MIS preparation and moves the organisation toward real\-time or near\-real\-time visibility.



**5\. Governance \& Enablement** 



* Support implementation of SOPs, accounting manuals, and process documentation for all automated workflows.
* Train finance team members on new systems and automated processes so operations are not dependent on a single person.
* Maintain integration and automation documentation as a living reference for the team.



  





**Skills** 




**Required** 



* Zoho Books / Zoho One – Setup, administration, multi\-entity and multi\-currency environments, AP/AR management, and reconciliation
* Zoho Deluge Scripting – Building custom functions and workflow logic beyond standard platform automations
* Zoho Flow / Blueprint – Designing no\-code/low\-code automations that connect Zoho modules with external systems
* REST APIs \& Webhooks – Reading and implementing API documentation, OAuth authentication, JSON payload handling, and Postman testing
* ERP Requirement Gathering – Translating finance and business needs into actionable ERP configurations or technical briefs
* Finance Process Depth – Hands\-on experience across AP, AR, GL, reconciliations, fixed assets, and month\-end close
* Project \& Program Delivery – Proven ability to own timelines, manage stakeholders, and drive end\-to\-end delivery independently



  





**Preferred** 



* Zoho Analytics / BI Tools – Building dashboards, supporting FP\&A modelling, and tracking KPIs
* Python / SQL – Data transformation and automation scripting beyond Deluge
* ERP Breadth – Exposure to platforms such as NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Xero, or QuickBooks, particularly relevant to our US\-based fintech accounting stack



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* B.Tech
 
 (IT/CS/ECE) — preferred; brings the systems and API thinking this role needs.
* MBA (Finance) or equivalent — a strong plus, especially combined with a technical degree.
* CA background with genuine hands\-on systems/automation exposure — welcomed



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 5 years in finance automation, ERP implementation, or digitisation\-focused roles.
* Hands\-on Zoho Books/Zoho One experience strongly preferred; exposure to NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Xero, or QuickBooks is a plus.
* Demonstrated experience independently driving ERP or automation projects end\-to\-end — not just supporting one.
* Experience automating routine finance tasks such as MIS generation and variance analysis.
* Experience in a startup or a PE\-backed environment is an advantage.



  





***While the job appears to be with Neo, this role would be for Bhavin Turakhia's Family Office***

 The ideal candidate will play a key role in facilitating Agile delivery, coordinating cross\-functional teams, removing delivery impediments, and ensuring timely execution of project milestones. You will partner closely with Delivery Managers, Product Owners, Architects, Engineering teams, and customers to deliver high\-quality technology solutions while continuously improving Agile maturity and delivery excellence.
