title: Manufacturing Excellence Analyst
description:
Job Characteristics
   

  

 This individual contributor role will focus on driving program deployment, adoption, governance, and scale\-up of a global Manufacturing Excellence Platform and Digital Manufacturing Cell. The role will enable best\-in\-class manufacturing operations through Digital \& AI, manufacturing KPI control tower capabilities, paperless shop\-floor execution, and scalable loss\-elimination solutions. The Program Deployment Analyst will partner with Manufacturing, TPM, HPN, Digital, AI, Engineering, Quality, Safety, Finance, and site leadership teams to convert the manufacturing digital vision into coordinated pilots, deployment waves, sustainment routines, and measurable business outcomes across Ecolab plants globally.
   

  

 Education / Work Experience
   

  

 Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Operations, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field of study. 8\+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing, supply chain, operational excellence, digital transformation, analytics, or technology\-enabled process improvement.
   

  

 Independence Level / Reports To
   

  

 Operates as an individual contributor with limited supervisory support from the leader and independently owns assigned deployment workstreams, analyses, deliverables, and stakeholder coordination. Interfaces directly with global and regional manufacturing leaders, plant managers, Digital \& AI teams, TPM / HPN partners, Finance, Quality, Safety, Engineering, technology development resources, and deployment teams. Normally reports to Manufacturing Excellence / Digital Manufacturing program leadership or Planning / Operations leadership, depending on final organization design. This role does not have direct people\-management responsibility.
   

  

**About Global Supply Chain**
 Our Global Supply Chain is a network of more than 100 manufacturing plants, distribution centers and other facilities designed and located to support our direct sales, marketing and distribution activities. We enable company growth by delivering savings through more efficient operations and high levels of service that create competitive advantage while earning and keeping customers' trust.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a Program Deployment Analyst \- Manufacturing Excellence Platform / Digital Manufacturing Cell to drive deployment of the Manufacturing Cell program from pilot through global scale\-up as an individual contributor. The role will coordinate implementation of the manufacturing KPI control tower, paperless factory workstream, EKODE and related digital tools, and AI\-enabled loss\-elimination applications. The Program Deployment Analyst will independently manage stakeholder alignment, deployment wave planning, site readiness, training, adoption, risks, and benefits tracking for assigned workstreams to ensure the program delivers measurable improvements in productivity, compliance, data quality, and manufacturing loss reduction.
   

  

 What's in It for You
   

  

* Opportunity to drive deployment of a global manufacturing digital transformation agenda across Ecolab plants as a senior individual contributor.
* Exposure to manufacturing excellence, Digital \& AI, TPM / HPN, operations, engineering, quality, safety, finance, and site leadership stakeholders.
* Ability to scale solutions that reduce manual work, improve shop\-floor productivity, strengthen compliance, and accelerate loss elimination.


 What You Will Do
   

  

* Own and drive end\-to\-end deployment activities for the Manufacturing Excellence Platform across pilot sites, scale\-up waves, and sustainment phases for assigned workstreams.
* Coordinate implementation of the manufacturing KPI control tower, including replacement of legacy KPI tools, single\-point KPI entry, standard KPI definitions, and integrated data flows.
* Develop and manage deployment plans covering site readiness, stakeholder engagement, training, change management, cutover, issue resolution, and adoption tracking.
* Partner with plant managers and manufacturing teams to validate current pain points, Wave\-1 KPI priorities, data requirements, paperless opportunities, and practical deployment constraints.
* Drive paperless factory deployment by assessing site activities, mapping manual touchpoints, identifying quick wins, and converting paper\-based processes into digital, touchless, and audit\-ready workflows.
* Conduct and support digital maturity assessments across sites using common process mapping, maturity scoring, prioritization matrices, effort\-benefit analysis, and deployment sequencing.
* Coordinate deployment of automation and digital solutions including EKODE, eQMS, ERP, Power Automate, Copilot Agent, OCR\-based tools, barcode / QR code scanning, machine vision, and AI\-enabled loss\-elimination use cases.
* Work with technology development resources, data engineers, developers, AI teams, and business stakeholders to translate program requirements into deployable solutions and practical rollout plans.
* Establish and maintain governance cadence for assigned workstreams, including weekly working sessions, monthly progress reviews, quarterly program reviews, stakeholder feedback forums, and steering committee updates.
* Track deployment milestones, adoption metrics, risks, issues, dependencies, resource needs, and decision points across active workstreams.
* Partner with Finance and business teams to quantify and monetize KPI improvements, productivity gains, compliance risk reduction, and manufacturing loss\-elimination benefits.
* Prepare leadership\-ready status updates, deployment roadmaps, benefits trackers, risk / issue logs, action trackers, and decision materials for program reviews.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Operations, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field of study.
* 5\+ years of applicable experience in manufacturing, supply chain, operational excellence, digital transformation, project / program delivery, analytics, or technology\-enabled process improvement in a manufacturing environment with global or multi\-site operations.
* Demonstrated experience independently driving deployments, pilots, scale\-up waves, change management, training, adoption, and sustainment of business or digital solutions.
* Advanced proficiency with ERP, reporting, workflow, collaboration, and productivity tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Power Automate, Planner, and related enterprise systems.
* Proven ability to conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis, synthesize inputs from multiple stakeholders, and make practical recommendations to Manufacturing and Supply Chain leadership.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, teamwork, influencing, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver outcomes through cross\-functional collaboration without direct authority.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong program delivery skills with a track record of independently delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives against schedule, quality, adoption, and business impact expectations.
* Experience with manufacturing excellence, TPM, HPN, Lean, Six Sigma, loss elimination, OEE / OPE / OLE, productivity, material loss, first\-pass quality, or related manufacturing KPIs.
* Experience deploying digital manufacturing tools, paperless workflows, automation, data visualization, AI use cases, or manufacturing control tower solutions.
* Familiarity with EKODE, eQMS, ERP, EBS, EPM, Power BI, workflow automation, OCR, barcode / QR code scanning, or machine vision technologies.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, APICS, or similar certification preferred.
* Advanced Degree preferred.


**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

title: Senior GIS Migration Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long\-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.
   

  

 TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader.
   

  

 We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Data Migration Lead will oversee and execute the migration of geospatial data from legacy systems such as GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri's Utility Network (UN). This role requires expertise in Esri technologies, Utility Network configuration, and data transformation tools like FME. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in utilities (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and experience managing complex data migration projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end data migration projects from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri Utility Network.
* Analyze legacy data models and design migration strategies to align with Esri Utility Network schema and best practices.
* Configure and implement Esri Utility Network models, including network rules, topologies, and asset configurations.
* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) workflows using FME and Python (ArcPy).
* Perform data quality assessments and validations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness during migration.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define migration objectives, and ensure alignment with business needs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data compatibility, schema mapping, and network topology during migration.
* Optimize migration processes for performance and scalability, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity.
* Document migration workflows, methodologies, and lessons learned for future reference.
* Provide training and support to teams on Esri Utility Network and post\-migration processes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 8\-12 years of experience in GIS, with at least 4\-6 years in data migration projects.
* Strong expertise in Esri technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and Utility Network.
* Hands\-on experience with data migration from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri platforms.
* Proficiency in FME (Feature Manipulation Engine) for data transformation and automation.
* Advanced Python scripting skills (ArcPy) for geoprocessing and data migration tasks.
* In\-depth knowledge of utility network models (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and their operational workflows.
* Experience with spatial databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills to manage cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Esri Utility Network configuration, including network rules, subnetwork management, and tracing.
* Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies and tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of GE Smallworld data structures and migration challenges.
* Experience with large\-scale enterprise GIS implementations and integrations.
* Certification in Esri technologies or FME is a plus.


 EEO Statement
   

  

 TRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
   

  

 The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.
   

  

 TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

description:

title: Manager Engineering
description:
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud\-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
   

  

 Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co\-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
   

  

 Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
   

  

**Summary**
 The Manager, Engineering reports to the Director, Engineering and leads a team of software engineers who build and sustain the products Armor’s customers depend on. This is a hands\-on leadership position: the manager writes production code, opens and reviews pull requests, and ships alongside the engineers they lead. The role exercises independent judgment and discretion in setting technical direction, making architecture decisions, prioritizing defects and feature work, directing incident response, and developing engineering talent. Armor is looking for a technical leader with a track record of building and shipping high\-quality software with AI\-assisted development tools, and with the engineering judgment to raise the bar on architecture, delivery speed, and engineering ownership. This is a full\-time in\-office role based in Pune, India; on\-site presence five days a week is required.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)**
* Lead and manage a high\-performing AI\-native software engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, and hands\-on guidance while building a culture of engineering ownership.
* Contribute directly to architecture, design, code reviews, and implementation of complex software, working in the repository alongside the team rather than reviewing from a distance.
* Own day\-to\-day delivery for the assigned product areas, including feature work, defect triage, regression prevention, and customer escalations, and keep the Director, Engineering current on status and risk.
* Drive end\-to\-end engineering execution with minimal reliance on product management, translating business objectives into working software.
* Execute release management discipline set by the Director, Engineering, including change windows, rollback criteria, and release readiness for the team’s work.
* Put AI\-assisted development tools into daily engineering practice, measure the effect on delivery speed and quality, and hold the team to production\-grade standards for AI\-generated code.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, developer tools, and cloud technologies, balancing rapid experimentation against production\-grade engineering discipline.
* Hire and build the team, including defining the technical hiring bar, running interview loops, and onboarding new engineers.
* Manage relationships with third\-party technology vendors by evaluating platform usage, monitoring cost and performance, assessing alternatives, and providing technical recommendations that support renewals, negotiations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams, ensuring clear communication, knowledge sharing, and alignment across distributed engineering teams.
* Manage team performance through regular one\-on\-one meetings, goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and career development planning.
* Serve as the escalation point for production incidents and customer\-impacting issues, coordinating rapid response, running post\-incident reviews, and feeding the findings back into engineering practice.


**Required Skills**
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production software that customers depend on. Show us the work; we do not screen on years on a resume.
* Experience leading or managing software engineers, including performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Hands\-on production experience delivering software with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Strong frontend and backend development skills using technologies such as React, TypeScript, C\#, Node.js, Python, or Go, with demonstrated ability to contribute directly to code, architecture, and technical problem\-solving.
* Excellent software architecture skills, with the ability to set architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and promote practices that improve security, quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Production experience with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform, including deploying and operating applications in cloud environments.
* Proven ability to combine hands\-on development with leadership responsibilities without sacrificing either.
* Strong defect management and quality engineering instincts, including the ability to distinguish a regression from a customer\-found defect from a product gap, and to treat each one differently.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable application delivery.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Strong experience with relational, non\-relational, and AI\-enabled data platforms, including SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases, data modeling, performance tuning, and scalable data architectures for AI applications.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role, providing both technical advice and strategic direction to help customers reach their goals.
* Git proficiency including branching strategies, code review workflows, and CI/CD pipeline integration.
* Understanding of AI/LLM security risks including prompt injection, data leakage, and model limitations.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy and security implications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams and time zones.
* Preferred: bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
* Preferred: experience with virtualization, infrastructure, and data protection technologies such as VMware vSphere, Proxmox, NSX\-T, FortiMonitor, Zerto, and Rubrik.
* Preferred: cybersecurity background covering XDR, MDR, SIEM, SOC tooling, endpoint detection and response, threat detection, incident response, and security monitoring.


**WHY ARMOR**
 Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.
   

  

**ARMOR CORE VALUES**
* Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges.
* Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency \+ honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances.
* Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection.
* Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes.
* Follow\-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. The work environment can be either in an office setting or remotely from anywhere.

* Coordinate with security and compliance teams to ensure that MES and billing solutions adhere to organizational policies data protection standards and audit requirements while maintaining usability and process efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Bring nine to twelve years of progressive experience in product consulting or solution implementation with a focus on complex manufacturing and billing environments supported by large scale enterprise systems.

* Operate effectively in hybrid work settings demonstrating strong communication collaboration and documentation skills that ensure smooth coordination across onsite and remote stakeholders.

title: IT Audit - Global Markets, Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
 The Business Aligned IT Auditor, Assistant Vice President, will be responsible for working on audit engagements that focus on business risk and related application technology for specific business divisions and/or functions. Team members work to understand business risks and related IT general controls, including interface controls, logical access controls, change management, backup and recovery, and application controls (e.g systematic validations, interfaces). The main objective of an audit is to provide management with independent, objective assurance regarding the design and operating effectiveness of the system of internal controls to mitigate both business and IT\-related risks. The audit follows a collaborative approach, with business and IT audit team members jointly conducting the majority of internal and client\-facing planning, control assessment, testing, and reporting activities.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, stakeholders rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role, you will strive for cutting\-edge solutions that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 As an Integrated Auditor, Assistant Vice President you will
   

  

* Serve as the lead for technology focused audit areas, but also work on operational audits
* Plan and/ or execute audits according to a risk based methodology in line with division and industry standards.
* Supervise and direct the execution of risk and control assessments, along with effective and efficient testing of key controls.
* Review documentation of audit work and conclusion of audit tests results and overall effectiveness of controls.
* Draft audit reports in accordance with division standards to clearly communicate key risks and core audit issues.
* Work in partnership with business area management to communicate expectations and manage any project issues that may arise throughout the audit.
* Escalate audit issues to senior management and interact with business line and senior managers to develop and negotiate solutions.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of audits and assigned functions, including utilization of technology, products, organizational activities, and systems.
* Establish and maintain strong and effective client relationships within the business and supporting IT organizations and assist management in the understanding and adaptation of internal control principles.
* Contribute to change initiatives by participation in system and business process change initiatives with strategic corporate significance by providing input on operational and technological risk issues.
* Invest in your development by expanding, maintaining and applying current knowledge of audit industry best practices, regulatory expectations, and subject matter.
* Support the development and training of more junior staff assigned to projects, including reviewing their workpapers


**What We Value**
 These skills will help you succeed in this role
   

  

* Strong team leadership skills which include creating an environment of trust, soliciting diverse views from team members and supervising, coaching and developing staff.
* High degree of professionalism.
* Able to manage complexity, multi\-task and work independently in non\-routine situations.
* Effective communication skills (both written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
* Proven ability to research, interpret and apply regulatory requirements.
* Interest in developing as a leader within Corporate Audit.
* Ability to comprehend both technology and operational risks.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science and/or Business Administration.
* CISA, CPA, CIA or other applicable certification preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience with assessment and testing of technology and operational controls, including 2\+ years leading and supervising audit engagements.
* Experience in either public accounting or financial services internal audit preferred.
* Working knowledge of global markets or banking regulatory frameworks preferred


**Additional Requirements**
* Travel up to 15% may be required.


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Vice President - Data Architect
description:
Join us at Barclays as a Vice President \- Data Architect. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping and evolving our data architecture strategy, helping to enhance our trading applications across the organization enabling consistency, scalability, and better decision making across teams.
   

  

 To succeed as a Vice President \- Data Architect, you should have experience in the following:
   

  

  

* Investment Banking, including Financial Markets, Expertise Strong understanding of Investments Banking and Financial Markets, including end\-to\-end trade lifecycles, market structures, and the flow of data across front‑to‑back processes (from client onboarding, trade capture through post\-trade processing).
* Enterprise Data Modelling \& Architecture Leadership Proven experience designing and driving adoption of unified data models (e.g., Client, Banking \& Trade data representation), including shaping proposals and supporting their implementation across complex environments.
* Advanced Data Architecture Capability


**Deep Expertise In Data Architecture Disciplines, Including**
* Data flow design
* Logical and physical data modelling
* Translating business and data requirements into scalable, implementable solutions


* Engineering Collaboration \& Delivery Enablement Ability to work closely with engineering teams to deliver architectural outcomes across both upstream (trade capture) and downstream (post\-trade) systems, ensuring alignment between design and implementation.
* End\-to\-End Stakeholder Engagement


**Strong Stakeholder Management Skills, Including**
* Engaging with business and technical teams to understand current\-state trade capture and processing
* Partnering across the value chain to drive alignment and adoption of data architecture standards.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is in Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, implement, and maintain conceptual, Logical and Physical data models that meet business data/process and technology requirements, by using designs and data strategies across a wide selection of platforms.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Analysis and documentation of business requirements to translate them into data models aligned with organisational goals.
* Development and maintenance of data dictionaries and glossaries to define data elements and their usage.
* Analysis and monitoring of data usage patterns to identify opportunities for data optimisation and improvement, in partnership with the Data Base Administrator.
* Strategic architecture definition and product selection.
* Production of logical designs in relevant subject area (technical, data, operational), showing for example: processes, objects, data flows, inputs, stored data and outputs. Identifying common components.
* Implementation of architectures and Identification, ownership and resolution of design related issues.
* Definition and documentation of data architectures standards, principles and strategies.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Continuous Improvement Manager
description:

We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027\. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices.  The Continuous Improvement Manager will manage, plan, coordinate and lead the deployment of the Continuous Improvement Framework, Industry 4\.0, Eaton Lean \& Six Sigma System throughout the Plant facility in support of strategic goals and objectives.
   

  

* Lead the deployment of the Continuous Improvement (CI) Framework, Lean, Six Sigma, and Industry 4\.0 initiatives across the plant.

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and corporate stakeholders to implement best practices and standardize improvement processes.

description:

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)

description:

 \- Cofounder, leads business, Ex Oyo, TravelTriangle, IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee.

* **We are a team of believers.** 

 At the same time, we are constantly learning and growing. We are on an audacious mission and have a rock\-solid belief we can get there.

 , yet we start small and start quickly. We are not deterred by the extra effort needed to relentlessly execute, iterate, and execute to realise our dreams.

 , united by a common goal. We are a single team, where every member is important.

 roles and freedom to execute ideas are the two foundational values for aggressive growth.
* **We constantly protect and** 

 evolve our culture. As a super energetic and experienced team, we want to enjoy the time we spend together.



  





**Your Mission** 




  






 Own the end\-to\-end delivery of TravClan's events and BTL activations — from concept, planning and budgeting to on\-ground execution and post\-event evaluation. **What we are looking for:** 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 

 :
 




  




* Build and own an events and activations calendar linked to business priorities, then deliver large\-scale events, conferences, partner meets, exhibitions and BTL activations end to end.
* Translate event objectives into detailed plans covering format, audience, venue, production, logistics, staffing, travel and communication; close statutory permissions, safety, compliance and contingency requirements before execution.
* Create and manage event budgets; negotiate with venues, production partners and other vendors while protecting quality and commercial outcomes.
* Personally lead on\-ground execution, solve real\-time issues and ensure every stakeholder understands deliverables, dependencies and timelines.
* Coordinate across Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance and leadership teams to obtain decisions early and drive all pre\-event and post\-event actions to closure.
* Track registrations, attendance, engagement, leads, cost per participant/lead and other agreed success metrics; prepare clear post\-event ROI reviews with learnings and next actions.
* Build repeatable event checklists, vendor standards and operating processes that improve speed, reliability and cost efficiency across future events.



  





**Check if you fit in the role\-** 




  





**You Must** 




  




* Have 3\+ years of hands\-on event/BTL experience with direct ownership of large\-scale events.
* Have strong project management, commercial judgement and vendor negotiation skills.
* Understand permissions, venue compliance, safety protocols and contingency planning.
* Be calm under pressure, detail\-oriented and comfortable with travel and non\-standard hours



  





**You Can** 




  




* Deliver large events on time, within budget and at expected quality.
* Anticipate risks and resolve on\-ground issues without avoidable escalation.
* Coordinate multiple stakeholders and hold vendors accountable through closure.
* Measure event outcomes and use learnings to improve future events.



  





**You Want to** 




  




* Own events end\-to\-end, from planning through on\-ground execution.
* Work in a high\-ownership environment where execution quality is visible and measurable.
* Make quick decisions and solve problems on the ground.



  





**This role is not ideal for someone who is** 




  




* Your experience is limited to small internal activities, weddings/social events, or supporting someone else who owned the overall event.
* You prefer strategy or creative ideation without direct accountability for budgets, logistics and on\-ground delivery.
* You are uncomfortable with travel, intensive event timelines or resolving last\-minute operational issues.



  





**The Recruitment Process:** 




  






 1\.
 
**Aptitude Test:** 

 The first step of the recruitment process is a basic 50\-minute aptitude test.
 





 2\.
 
**Group Discussion:** 

 If you clear the Aptitude Test, the second step of the recruitment process would be a 20\-30\-minute group discussion round.
 





 3\.
 
**Personal Interviews:** 

 2\-3 video interviews. Detailed discussions about the job profile, company \& candidature are discussed in these rounds.
 





 4\.
 
**Extending an offer:** 

 On successfully clearing the interview rounds, the job offer is extended to the candidate. This includes financial benefits and many other benefits.
 




  





**Important Points:** 




  




* Office Location\- Connaught Place, Delhi
* Work Timings \-
 
**You are considering joining a startup. Building anything of value takes time.**

title: Assistant Project Coordinator- (Research)/Senior Researcher - Delhi
description:
Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research) / Senior Researcher
 



 Indian Police Foundation \| Internal Police Reforms Project
 



  





 Organisation: Indian Police Foundation
 



 Project: Internal Police Reforms Project
 



 Location: Indian Police Foundation HQ, New Delhi (C\-8, 8758, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi \- 110070\)
 



 Number of Positions: 1
 



 Tenure: Contractual. Offered initially for 1 year but extendable till the completion of the project (2027\-2028\).
 



 Remuneration: Rs. 75,000 per month (Assistant Project Coordinator \- Research) / Rs. 60,000 per month (Senior Researcher), including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance.
 



 Last date to apply: 5 October 2026, till 4:00 PM only.
 



  





 OVERVIEW
 



  





 Applications are invited for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher on a contractual basis.
 



  





 Candidates possessing a minimum of 3 years or more of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator (Research). However, candidates shortlisted with less than 3 years of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Senior Researcher.
 



  





 Although the position is in Delhi, the APC\- Research/Senior Researcher is expected to travel to various (3 states) both for research as well as project implementation and monitoring.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 The role of the Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher involves coordinating both the research and operational components of the Internal Police Reforms Project. Working closely with the Project Director (PD), Project Coordinator (PC), and State Supervisors, the he/she will play a key role in project planning, research, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and documentation across three states (Punjab, Telangana \& Tamil Nadu).
 



  





 ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 \- Educational Qualification: M.A in Social Sciences/Police Sciences/Criminology/Public Safety or any other related field. However, candidates with Ph.D. in relevant domains will be preferred.
 



 \- Researcher/Consultant with experience of 3 years or more in social research in universities, other research institutes, NGOs, think tanks, or consulting firms. (Minimum experience may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Project Director).
 



 \- Experience in Independent Research Study Design and leading/mentoring research team.
 



 \- Proficiency \& experience in developing and conducting Baseline, Midline and Endline evaluation study.
 



 \- Proficiency in Research Tool Development for empirical data collection.
 



 \- Proficiency in mixed\-data \- quantitative and qualitative \- analysis \& and knowledge of quantitative data analysis software (advance excel, SPSS/STATA).
 



 \- Ability to understand and communicate the meaning of field\-based data and writing research report.
 



 \- Strong management, coordination and leadership skills for engagement with senior police officers, trainers, research staff and other research institutions.
 



 \- High level of proficiency in computer skills.
 



 \- Willingness and good health to undertake field visits (as and when required).
 



 \- Good command over English and Hindi.
 



 \- Attend the IPF office at Vasant Kunj, Delhi, on a regular basis.
 



  





 DESIRABLE
 



  





 \- Previous experience of working with Police organisations.
 



 \- Familiarity with criminal laws (major \& minor).
 



 \- Familiarity with relevant Supreme Court judgments \& NHRC directives.
 



 \- Familiarity with MHA and State Government circulars related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Familiarity with recommendations of various police commissions, including the National Police Commission (1979\-81\), related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Publications of Research papers/articles in various journals/magazines/Newspapers.
 



  





 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Research and Data Analysis
 



  





 \- Head the research team, provide guidance to Research Associates both in Headquarters \& States, and monitor their work.
 



 \- Guide Research Associates in data analysis for various stakeholders for both quantitative and qualitative data collected through three tools (structured questionnaires, FGDs, and in\-depth interviews).
 



 \- Coordinate with and visit the external agencies engaged for data analysis \& report writing (Centre for Economic \& Social Studies, Hyderabad \& Centre for Good Governance, Hyderabad).
 



 \- Guide and Supervise Research Associates in desk research, including analysis of reports of the National Police Commission and other committees on police reforms.
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to State DGP on Public Grievances in 3 states based on data analysis.
 



  





 2\. Formulation of Change Manual
 



  





 \- Assist in the Formulation of Change Manual \& its action plan for all the 3 states based on the Project Focus areas, namely improving Compliant / FIR Registration and Police Response, improving Citizen Services and Community Engagement, prevention of Harassment by Police, and improving Police Conduct and Behaviour.
 



 \- Presentation of Change Manual to the respective state DGPs in 3 States.
 



  





 3\. Baseline and Endline Evaluation
 



  





 \- Work on evaluation parameters, selection of police stations for evaluation, training of field enumerators, and ensure that the data required by the agency for conducting baseline and endline evaluations is provided in a timely manner.
 



 \- Guide in the formulation of Data Collection Tools by evaluation agencies.
 



 \- Support and monitor the execution of Baseline and Endline evaluations by independent agency in selected police stations across Punjab, Telangana, and Tamil Nadu.
 



 \- Review and scrutinize the reports prepared by the evaluation agencies.
 



  





 4\. Engagement with Experts
 



  





 Assist the Project Director and Project Coordinator in engaging with Experts for vetting and finalization of the following activities:
 



  





 \- Finalization of Research Methodology
 



 \- Evaluation Parameters for (Baseline and Endline Evaluation)
 



 \- Change Manual prepared for all 3 states
 



 \- Baseline \& Endline Reports prepared by Evaluation agencies
 



 \- Final Project report (combined report for all 3 States)
 



  





 5\. Training
 



  





 \- Assist in the preparation of state\-specific training manual \& training materials.
 



 \- Support and participate in the conduct of training programmes for police office in all 3 states.
 



  





 6\. Project Implementation and Monitoring

 7\. Coordination

title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)

 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

 Senior delivery leader responsible for executing low\-voltage / fiber projects on time and on budget while maintaining change control, client confidence, and clean turnover.
