* Drive lessons learned, resource planning, and standardized delivery practices as the service line scales across multiple accounts or campuses.


**Required Skills and Knowledge:**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Strong project leadership record delivering data center or other mission\-critical infrastructure programs with live\-facility constraints.

* Working knowledge of low\-voltage and fiber build scope, including phased cutovers, testing and certification, labeling and documentation, and turnover requirements.
* Ability to enforce MOP and SOW discipline, manage competing priorities across concurrent jobs, and lead recovery plans when conditions change.

title: Chief Track Expert- BID Position
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems.
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water \& Environment for public and private organizations.
   

  

 Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost\-effective and made\-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
   

  

 SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know\-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
   

  

 SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know\-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).
   

  

 Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork \& Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling \& Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re\-modelling etc.
   

  

 Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
   

  

 Currently, we are bidding for Semi High Speed Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Track Expert is the key position in these BIDs
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Permanent Way Design and Specification: Lead the detailed design and engineering of the permanent way (track structure), including the selection of components like rails, sleepers, fastenings, and ballast/slab track systems, ensuring they meet the technical requirements for semi\-high speeds and high axle loads.
* Geometric Alignment and Survey Control: Finalize the horizontal and vertical track alignment (geometric design) based on approved feasibility studies. Establish and maintain the high\-precision survey control network to ensure the construction tolerances for high\-speed operation are strictly achieved.
* Track Construction and Quality Assurance (QA/QC): Oversee all phases of track construction, including formation, track laying, welding, and stressing. Implement and manage a rigorous Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) program to verify that all materials and construction methods comply with national and international railway codes.
* Integration of Special Trackwork: Direct the design and installation of special trackwork, such as switches, crossings (turnouts), and expansion joints, paying particular attention to their geometry and material specifications to ensure smooth and safe train movements at high speeds.
* Track Maintenance Strategy (LCC): Develop the long\-term track maintenance and renewal strategy (Life\-Cycle Cost or LCC) and specify the mechanized maintenance equipment needed. Establish the track monitoring and inspection protocols to ensure long\-term track safety and geometry standards.
* Coordination and Technical Compliance: Coordinate with other disciplines (Civil, Bridge, Signaling, OHE) to ensure seamless interface design. Ensure all track designs and construction practices strictly comply with the relevant Railway Permanent Way Manuals and safety regulations.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Qualification: Graduate in Engineering with working knowledge of reading, writing and speaking in English \[additional marks for PG in Engineering]
* Minimum Experience: 20 years post minimum qualification in any Rail based Passenger Transit system \[additional marks for more experience in any Rail based Passenger Transit system\*]
* Relevant Experience: 10 years’ experience for Design or Installation of Ballast\-less Track system including Track Alignment for MRTS /Regional Rail /High Speed Rail as Chief Track Expert or equivalent position \[additional marks for more experience; experience in position one level below allowed with less weightage]
* Eligible Assignment\*\*(see below): Must have experience of 1 Eligible Assignment as Chief Track Expert or equivalent position full\-time continuous deployment of not less than 2 years \[additional marks for more Eligible Assignments; less weightage for position one level below]
* Rail\-based Passenger Transit System shall mean
* High Speed Transit System / Regional Rail Transit System (with operational speed of 160kmh and above) OR
* Urban/Suburban/Intercity/Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS) \[excluding LRT with design PHPDT less than 20000/Tram/Monorail Systems]
* Shall mean experience of working as a personnel of General Consultant / Project Management Consultant / Employer’s Personnel in a work / project in a Rail based Passenger Transit System with operational speed of 80 kmph or more comprising:
* Construction of Civil structures (at\-grade/elevated/underground) AND
* Installation of Systems (Track, Rolling Stock, Traction \& Power Supply, Signalling)


 Including Detailed Design or Proof checking of designs; Bid Process Management; Project and Interface Management; Construction Supervision and System Installations and Testing \& Commissioning
   

  

 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!

title: Event Executive
description:
Event Executive
 
**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 2–4 Years
 



  




**About the Role:\-** 

  





 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on
 **Event Executive** 
 who can manage events
 **end\-to\-end — from initial planning and coordination to on\-ground execution and post\-event closure** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in event planning, client coordination, vendor management, logistics, budgeting, and event execution. The candidate must be comfortable taking ownership of events and coordinating with multiple stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
 



  




**Key Responsibilities:\-** 

  




* Manage events end\-to\-end, from
 **planning and preparation to execution and closure** 
 .
* Understand client requirements and develop event plans accordingly.
* Plan event timelines, schedules, budgets, manpower, logistics, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate with clients, vendors, suppliers, event partners, and internal teams.
* Source, negotiate with, and manage vendors for event\-related requirements.
* Handle venue setup, branding, décor, equipment, hospitality, transportation, and other logistics.
* Prepare event checklists and ensure all requirements are completed within timelines.
* Manage on\-ground event operations and coordinate teams during the event.
* Handle last\-minute challenges and ensure smooth execution under pressure.

 **corporate events, tournaments, private functions, brand activations, and social events** 
 .
* Manage customer enquiries, bookings, registrations, and event\-related communication.
* Support sponsorships, partnerships, and brand collaborations when required.
* Track event expenses and coordinate with the finance team for payments and settlements.
* Conduct post\-event follow\-ups, vendor closures, feedback collection, and reporting.
* Maintain proper documentation of event plans, vendor details, quotations, and event reports.



  




**Requirements:\-** 

  




* **2–4 years of hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end event management.**
* Proven experience managing events from
 **planning to final execution and closure** 
 .
* Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.
* Excellent client communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Good problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to manage teams and vendors on\-ground.
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and basic event documentation.
* Energetic, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, weekends, and travel to
 **Delhi NCR and other cities** 
 for events when required.



  




**What We’re Looking For :\-** 

  




* A hands\-on event professional who can
 **take complete ownership of an event** 
 .
* Someone who can independently manage multiple aspects of an event without constant supervision.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver events within timelines and budgets.
* A candidate with practical experience in
 **planning, coordination, vendor management, logistics, and on\-ground execution** 
 .

title: Head of Operations / Factory Operations Head
description:
**Craft \& Glory** 
 \| Foxglove Lifestyles Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana \|
 **Full\-Time** 
 \| Monday–Saturday
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Craft \& Glory is looking for a hands\-on manufacturing operations leader to take ownership of our factory and production operations across footwear, leather goods and apparel.
 



**This is a factory/production operations role — not a general corporate Operations role.** 




  





 We are specifically looking for someone who combines strong factory\-floor execution \+ PPC \+ MIS/Excel \+ team management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




1. Own end\-to\-end factory and production operations, from planning to finished\-goods dispatch.
2. Lead PPC, production planning, capacity planning, manpower planning and WIP tracking.
3. Track orders, production targets, WIP, capacity and delivery timelines through structured MIS.
4. Plan raw\-material requirements and coordinate with procurement and vendors to avoid production delays.
5. Manage production teams and department/section heads, ensuring accountability for targets and timelines.
6. Identify factory bottlenecks and drive immediate corrective actions and process improvements.
7. Build and implement SOPs, trackers, MIS dashboards and operational systems.
8. Monitor quality, wastage, productivity, inventory and manufacturing efficiency.
9. Support team building and ERP/MRP implementation as operations scale.



  





**Must\-Have Profile** 




 Please apply only if you meet the core requirements below:
 



  




* 8–15 years of experience in manufacturing / factory / production operations.
* Strong preference for footwear manufacturing. Leather goods, bags, apparel, accessories, export or other labour\-intensive manufacturing experience is also relevant.
* Current/previous roles such as Factory Manager/Head, Operations Manager, Production \& Operations Manager, PPC Head or Senior Production Manager.
* Strong hands\-on experience in PPC, production planning, factory\-floor execution and capacity management.
* Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, MIS, production trackers and operational reporting.
* Experience handling raw materials, procurement, vendors, POs and inventory.
* Proven experience managing multiple production teams/department heads and driving accountability.
* Ability to independently identify bottlenecks, analyse data and take corrective action.
* Experience building SOPs, systems and reporting structures.
* Immediate joiners / short notice candidates preferred.



  





**Who Should NOT Apply** 




 Please do not apply if your experience is primarily in:
 



  




* Corporate/Business Operations
* Sales or Business Development
* Logistics/Transportation Operations only
* Customer/Service Operations
* General Administration
* Pure Supply Chain without hands\-on factory/production experience



  





 We are specifically looking for a hands\-on Factory / Production Operations professional.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 You should be someone who is visible on the factory floor, strong with numbers and MIS, and highly execution\-oriented.
 



 You should be able to connect:
 



**Production Plan** 
**→** 
 Raw Materials
 **→** 
 PPC
 **→** 
 WIP
 **→** 
 Production
 **→** 
 Quality
 **→** 
 Finished Goods
 **→** 
 Dispatch
 



 while simultaneously building the systems, SOPs and accountability required to scale the operation.

title: US Proposal Specialist / Proposal Writer
description:
**US PROPOSAL SPECIALIST** 




  





 Acro Service Corporation, Bid and Proposal Team
 



  





**Experience: 3\+** 
 Years
 



**Shift:** 
**Night Shift (7:30 PM \-4:30 AM IST)** 




**Location:** 
 Noida Sector 68 (Onsite)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Acro Service Corporation (Acro) is seeking an experienced Proposal Specialist to join its Bid and Proposal team, supporting Acro's US staffing, MSP, VMS, and workforce solutions business from India. The Proposal Specialist is a hands\-on individual contributor and full member of the proposal team, responsible for managing assigned Complex and Express RFx opportunities from initial review through final submission. This is a fast paced, high ownership role covering the full response lifecycle, from initial solicitation assessment and Go No Go input through response planning, strategy sessions, content development, reviews, and final compliance and submission.
 



 Complex RFx are large, formal solicitations, typically from state and local governments and large commercial buyers, that require a full response plan, strategy sessions, and multiple contributors. Express bids are smaller, quick turn solicitations that one person can typically assess, assemble, and submit within a few days.
 



 The role calls for strong project management, judgment, and follow through: anticipating what is needed next, following up independently with contributors, and moving assigned responses forward without continuous direction, while working within Acro's proposal SOPs and escalating when a leadership decision is required. Solicitations carry strict compliance and submission requirements, and a single missed instruction can disqualify a bid, so close reading and attention to detail are essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



1. **Manage assigned Complex and Express RFx responses from beginning to end.** 
 Review the solicitation, build the compliance checklist and response plan, coordinate meetings and inputs, develop the response from approved Acro content tailored to the issuer's requirements, and drive it through final submission.
2. **Contribute to Go No Go and response strategy.** 
 Conduct the initial opportunity review, facilitate assigned strategy discussions, and recommend relevant Acro capabilities, experience, and proof points.
3. **Apply proposal and workforce solutions expertise.** 
 Build working knowledge of Acro's staffing, MSP, VMS, RPO, technical and consulting, and related services; use standard content only where it actually answers the requirement; and escalate pricing, contractual, legal, or significant solution decisions to the appropriate owner.
4. **Project manage assigned responses within the proposal SOP.** 
 Own timelines, dependencies, reviews, and approvals; anticipate bottlenecks; and apply the team's checklists, templates, and quality controls consistently.
5. **Manage proposal meetings and SME contributions.** 
 Facilitate kickoff, strategy, working, and review sessions, and obtain complete input from leadership, business development, operations, finance, legal, and subject matter experts, following up persistently until it is received.
6. **Develop, tailor, and integrate proposal content.** 
 Draft and edit clear, accurate, persuasive content aligned to the evaluation criteria, and integrate input from multiple contributors into one consistent response.
7. **Ensure compliance, quality, and submission readiness.** 
 Track every mandatory requirement, form, and submission instruction, and conduct thorough final compliance and quality reviews before submission.
8. **Track and interpret solicitation changes.** 
 Monitor amendments, addenda, and Q\&A, summarize their impact, and update the response accordingly.
9. **Maintain proposal content, references, and document control.** 
 Keep proposal content, templates, references, and past performance current, and maintain SharePoint organization, version control, and RFx Tracker status for assigned bids.
10. **Support continuous improvement and team priorities.** 
 Recommend practical process and content improvements, contribute to business development collateral, and collaborate on other team responses during peak periods.



  





**Requirements** 








* Demonstrated experience managing bids or proposals from solicitation review through content coordination, compliance, production, approvals, and final submission.
* Ability to manage both quick turn and complex responses with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and shifting deadlines.
* Experience facilitating proposal kickoff, strategy, and review meetings and converting decisions into actions and content.
* Strong critical thinking and judgment, with the ability to interpret requirements and evaluation criteria, identify gaps and risks, and recommend practical next steps.
* Excellent written English with strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, and the ability to adapt tone and level of detail to different buyers.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, including experience with compliance matrices and formal submission requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to obtain information from busy subject matter experts and drive accountability respectfully.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, tables, and templates, and working proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Ability to work U.S. Eastern business hours and communicate clearly and promptly with U.S. based colleagues.

title: Project Control Specialist I
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

***As a Project Control Specialist II with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
* Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.
* Develop and finalise the Project Controls Plan as per Project requirements and interface with Client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.
* Actively participate in Schedule development and guide the team to the required Planning and scheduling requirements.
* Conduct / lead Schedule workshops, IAP sessions and focus discussions on Schedule baselining and forecast exercises as required.
* Review, Tracking \& monitoring Schedule \& Critical areas through LEM and Scrums, raising the flag for the delays \& areas of concerns.
* Establish WBS and CBS required for the project as per the reporting requirements in line with the Client discussions.
* Interact with Project and department stakeholders in functional discussions and support required in delivering the Projects assigned.
* Preparation and analysis of Project performance statistics and analytics as appropriate.
* Lead to set up Project Cost reports, internal monitoring metrics and other reporting requirements.
* Monitoring \& controlling the cost by various analysis and time to time information Management about the risk areas.
* Performing Risk Analysis on the Schedule and provide inputs / recommendations.
* Generating various reports like Progress S\-curves, Lookahead Plan, Variance Analysis, Productivity Analysis.
* Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
* Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports
* Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, Concerns, and recovery plans etc.
* Work closely with the Project and Engineering managers to ensure proactive approach on addressing project performance and recovery measures all times.
* Mentor and guide junior team members and impart knowledge transfer time to time.
* Participate internal innovative forums and contribute for the Digital growth in project delivery wherever possible.
* Preparation of project cost reports and provide forecast analysis and trends of the project.
* Liaise effectively with multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaborative relationships, and ensuring alignment between planning, execution, and project objectives.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Tertiary qualifications in Graduate in Engineering/Technology.
* 8\+ years of experience in Working for similar type Projects/Industry experience.
* Proven leadership and communication skills
* Extensive experience in Oil \& Gas, energy sector \& Chemicals.
* Sound knowledge of Planning, Cost control and Monitoring.
* A dedication to client satisfaction
* Excellent relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
* You will be an enthusiastic team player, with excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive thinking and solution\-oriented delivery.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Senior Engineer – Bridges
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
   

  

 Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
   

  

 CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High\-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
   

  

 CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2\.
   

  

 CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi\-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
   

  

 We are seeking applications for the position of Sr. Lead Engineer \- Bridges for Delhi/Bangalore/Ahmedabad/Kolkata.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Take responsibility for Rail/Road bridge design, viaduct \& Structure design.
* Having experience designing steel structures/bridges with joint detailing.
* Prepare reports and calculations in line with Network Rail standards.
* Should take lead for team of 4\- 5 Junior Engineer’s / Draftsman.
* Plan and deliver bridge surveys and inspections, including recording of all relevant information
* Complete bridge assessment calculation and reporting.
* Manage delivery of projects – take responsibility for budget and resource deployment on projects.
* Where required take responsibility for project delivery to agreed budgets.
* Where required prepare estimates for work items.
* Identify scope change items.
* Manage resources at a project level to ensure utilization and productivity is maintained.
* Ensure compliance of the Systra Group policies, particularly on ethics, safety and adherence to Company ISO Standards.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* BE\-Civil \+ M.Tech in Structural Engineering
* 5 to 10 years of experience into relevant field.
* Experience on Software requirement Sofistick, Midas, Oasys.
* Actively working towards Professional qualification.
* Ability to work in a collaborative multi\-discipline design team.
* Ability to complete assigned tasks with minimal supervision and provide support and mentoring to others.
* Ability to travel to client sites and other SYSTRA offices will be required.


 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!

title: Manager Operations
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Manager Operations** 
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**
* Asset Servicing team is part of the Markets and Securities Services Operations functions. AS team processes all voluntary and mandatory corporate action (including Income processing) across various UK, Europe and MENA jurisdiction.
* The department is also responsible for data validation for Equity and UK income collectives and capital mandatory corporate action. Team is divided into mainly three sub\-groups \- corporate action team (processes all capital voluntary \& mandatory corporate action), Income processing team (processes for Dividend, Coupon interest payment \& Pool factor processing) and corporate action validation team (validates corporate action for Equity, UK Income collectives, Capital mandatory corporate action).
* Ensure high\-quality service to the business area in terms of funds ensuring that risks are minimized and profit is maximized through effective management of costs. Ensure that process and procedures are continually reviewed and improved and the changes are communicated and implemented effectively. The job also entails checking on internal audits and measures undertaken and regularly reviews them in order to maintain quality and productivity at the optimum level.
* Responsible for managing performance and deliveries of funds/client sign offs to valuation teams. Contribution towards sustainable savings in relation to Process Efficiencies
* Supporting each global product on a regional basis by function or market. To plan for standardization of Asset Servicing processes by sharing the best practices across the various markets with the aim to enhance cost effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Role will be of individual contributor in nature and will not have team reporting to the role. Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures.
* High level variation and specific manual processes required by Product/System/Client/jurisdiction/ client
* To be aware of the Operational Risk scenario associated with the role and to ensure that all actions during your employment with HSBC take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring. Ensure effective escalation process is in place.


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Bachelor’s degree in commerce or qualifications in accounting/finance industry or relevant experience. Detailed understanding of single sub\-process, control points, end to end process risk.
* Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting. Excellent knowledge of ICON/Geneva/Multifonds as accounting system.
* Excellent knowledge and relevant experience in Asset Servicing with clear understanding of the E2E Fund Accounting Model.
* Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds and reconciliations.
* 3\-5 years of relevant Funds administration experience. Excellent Team Management skills with ability to handle personnel issues and strong team bonding.
* Efficient Time Management and ability to multitask work and priorities to meet defined deadlines. Ability to build excellent rapport and working relationships with other departments and jurisdiction thus ensuring smooth operations.
* Should have demonstrated behavior in line with HSBC values throughout. Strong working knowledge on MS Office
* Will be expected to maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, together with any issues raised by external regulators. Must be aware of the operational risk scenarios associated with this role and act upon pertinent risk (if any).


**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
 www.hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible work and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis

* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.

* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ \& IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on\-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: FS-RISK CONSULTING-DR-ITCA-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting –** 
 Manager, IT Controls Advisory
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in shape to your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 As a TR\-ITC manager, you’ll contribute technically to Risk Assurance client engagements and internal projects. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with stakeholders as required.
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer(client/onshore). As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Participate in IT Risk and Assurance engagements.
* Proficiency in using audit software tools, data analytics techniques, and IT auditing techniques. Strong analytical skills are necessary for interpreting technical data, identifying patterns, anomalies, and areas of concern.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards related to IT governance, data protection, privacy, and cybersecurity. This includes regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and industry frameworks like COBIT and NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Knowledge of IT governance principles, structures, and processes to ensure that IT activities align with business objectives, comply with regulations, and mitigate risks appropriately.
* Proficiency in identifying, assessing, and managing IT\-related risks to ensure that adequate controls are in place to mitigate potential threats to the organization's information assets, systems, and operations.
* Familiarity with IT auditing principles, techniques, and tools to assess the effectiveness of IT controls, identify control deficiencies, and recommend remediation actions.
* Proficiency in understanding IT systems, networks, applications, and infrastructure to design and implement controls effectively. This includes knowledge of common technology platforms, such as operating systems, databases, cloud services, and cybersecurity tools.
* Strong project management skills are necessary for planning, coordinating, and executing internal control initiatives effectively. This includes managing resources, timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure that control objectives are achieved in a timely and efficient manner.
* The ability to lead and mentor a team of IT control professionals, providing guidance, support, and development opportunities. Strong leadership qualities include decision\-making, delegation, conflict resolution, and fostering a collaborative work environment.
* Building and maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders, including senior management, IT leadership, internal auditors, external auditors, and regulatory authorities. This involves understanding stakeholder expectations, managing communications, and addressing concerns in a collaborative and constructive manner.
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience in application controls and Information security experience.
* Ability to build relationships with key stakeholders across different levels of seniority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for the team.


**Required Qualifications**
* Preferably Bachelor’s degree in (Finance/Accounting, Electronics, Electronics \& Telecommunications, Comp. Science)/MBA/M.Sc./CA
* Minimum of 7\-8 years of experience in internal controls and Internal Audit
* Enterprise risk services with specific focus on IT and related industry standards
* IT Risk Assurance framework
* Control frameworks such as COSO, internal control principles and related regulations including SOX and J\-SOX
* Preferred security skills related to a broad range of operating systems, databases or security tools, e.g., UNIX, Linux, Windows 2000 and NT, firewalls and IDS systems
* Familiarity with IT analysis, delivery and operations methods, including ITGC, ITAC,SDLC, PAM and CM
* Familiarity with security and risk standards such as ISO 27001\-2, PCI DSS, NIST, ITIL, COBIT
* Experience of security testing methods and techniques including network, operating and application system configuration review
* Application controls and security experience:
+ sensitive access and SOD testing
+ controls testing
+ Knowledge of data analysis tools like MS Excel, MS Access, MS SQL Server, ACL, Monarch, etc.

* Preferred Certifications: CISA


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: TC-CS-Cyber Architecture- OT and Engineering-infrastructure and Cloud Security- Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**IT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Senior Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and scale the Zero Trust Security Portfolio across EY GDS. This role will be responsible for leading complex client programs, building high\-performing teams, and driving innovation across Infrastructure Security capabilities.
   

  

 The Senior Manager will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, helping organizations transition from traditional security to Zero Trust Security. The role requires deep experience in cybersecurity architecture, network security, and zero trust security in cyber.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise \& cloud environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in zero\-trust and micro\-segmentation solutions including Zscaler, Guardicore and Illumio.
* Define logical patterns \& develop use cases for zero trust capabilities across Network, Identity \& Access Management, Device, Application and other security domains
* Work in multiple domains of security technologies viz Network segmentation, Application gateways, security automation, Firewalls, VPN, SDN, SD\-WAN, IAM solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Good exposure in requirement understanding, security frameworks, technical documentation, designing HLDs and LLDs.
* Well\-versed in encrypting all end\-to\-end communication regardless of the location, authorizing access to resources on a per\-session basis, enforcing the temporary and dynamic nature of authentication and authorization.
* Monitoring all assets to be in the most secure state possible and maintaining visibility into the security of the entire network and business's resources.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of zero trust market needs/challenges and assist in the planning, design and development of go\-to\-market solutions.
* Understand SaaS based technologies and identity\-based micro\-segmentation for cloud workloads and their implications for the enterprise.
* Document or enhance documentation on zero\-trust architecture requirements.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s Zero Trust, Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of experience across Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Expertise in Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (NIST 800\-207, NIST 800\-53, ZT DoD, CISA ZTMM).
* Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.
* Deep technical understanding of zero trust architecture and solutioning of zero trust security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for zero trust security including governance and operating models.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem\-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Engage with CISOs, CIOs, plant leadership, OT operations teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

 In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Core Data practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.

+ Own end\-to\-end data migration strategy and execution — covering discovery, profiling, cleansing, transformation, load, and validation

+ Design solutions across multi\-org, multi\-cloud, and hybrid data environments

* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering model across your delivery team.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise\-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.

* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders.
* Champion an AI\-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.

**Minimum Requirements**
* 10\-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors, with a strong data focus.
* 5\+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Proficiency with data integration tools (Informatica, Talend, or similar)
* Solid understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, SOQL, Python, data loading tools, and Salesforce governor limits.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly CDP)
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, Salesforce Industries Cloud (Comms, H\&I or FSC OR RCA/RCB) with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Data360 and Agentblazer Legend
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Sharing and Visibility (Good to have)
* Platform Security (Good to have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security (Good to have)

**Preferred Requirements**

* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.

* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in paperwork and compliance.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills for coordinating with cross\-functional teams and external partners.
* Ability to work independently on\-site in Kolkata, handle multiple shipments simultaneously, and make timely operational decisions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, International Trade, Logistics, or a related field; advanced certifications in export\-import management are an advantage.
* Prior experience in export operations or documentation management in a managerial or supervisory capacity is strongly preferred.

description:
This role exists to protect one person's time and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll be the right hand to the Operations Head — managing his calendar, capturing what happens in meetings, and making sure every internal and marketing project moves forward without him having to chase it.
 



 This is not just scheduling and note\-taking. You are the person who knows the status of everything, reminds the right people at the right time, and keeps the operation organized while leadership focuses on growth. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility role — you'll see how a 90\-person company runs from the inside.
 



  





*This role is for someone who enjoys:* 



* Holding the full picture of what's happening across a busy leader's world
* Turning conversations into clear, owned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Following up firmly and politely until things actually get done
* Being trusted with confidential, high\-stakes information



  





 If you're someone who's naturally organized, doesn't let things slip, and wants a front\-row seat to how a growing company operates, this role will suit you well.
 



  





**What you'll really be doing** 




  





**1\. Calendar \& Inbox Management** 



* Own and organize the Operations Head's calendar end to end — schedule, reschedule, resolve conflicts, protect focus time
* Coordinate across time zones, primarily India and US
* Manage email triage: flag what needs attention, draft routine replies, keep the inbox under control



  





**2\. Meeting Support** 



* Attend designated internal, marketing, and leadership meetings to capture minutes, decisions, and action items
* Convert discussions into clear, assigned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Distribute notes promptly and make sure owners know what they committed to



  





**3\. Internal \& Marketing Project Coordination** 



* Keep all internal and marketing projects organized and current in the project management system
* Track status, deadlines, and blockers across active work
* Follow up with team members on tasks assigned by the Operations Head — proactively, before things slip
* Surface what's overdue or at risk before it becomes a problem



  





**4\. Follow\-Up \& Accountability** 



* Maintain a live view of every open commitment across the team
* Remind people on pending items and close the loop
* Be the system that ensures "I asked someone to do this" actually gets done



  





**Who will thrive in this role** 



* You hold many threads at once without dropping any of them
* You follow up firmly and politely — you don't let things go quiet
* You can work independently from week one with minimal supervision
* You're discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information
* You communicate clearly and confidently with US\-based leadership and partners



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Experience** 



* 4–5 years minimum as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Project Coordinator — experience within an IT services company is a must



  





**Must Have Skills** 



* Strong written and spoken English — you'll be communicating with a US\-based leadership team and US agency partners
* Highly organized, detail\-obsessed, and able to hold many threads at once
* Comfortable following up firmly and politely until things are done
* Able to work independently from week one with minimal supervision
* Discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information



  





**Tools \& Platforms** 



* Notion — documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base
* Google Calendar \& Gmail — scheduling and inbox management
* Slack — internal communication
* Fathom — meeting transcription and notes



*Experience with project management tools is required. Direct experience with this exact stack is a plus, not a dealbreaker.* 




  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience supporting a founder, COO, or senior operations leader
* Exposure to a digital agency or multi\-company setup
* Familiarity with AI tools for productivity — meeting summarization, task tracking, or inbox management



  





**What this role offers** 



* A high\-trust, high\-visibility seat next to leadership
* Direct exposure to how a 90\-person company runs day\-to\-day
* Ownership over the systems that keep the operation from slipping
* Room to grow into broader operations responsibility over time

title: Independent Director
description:
**The mandate through a project’s life** 




  





 The company designs and manufactures process equipment used in food\-production environments. The Board needs an Independent Director who can govern the entire obligation created when an engineered system is sold—from interpretation of process requirements through fabrication, site integration, performance acceptance and long\-term service. Success cannot be measured only by dispatch: an apparently complete project can still carry unresolved hygiene, performance, documentation or margin exposure.
 



  





**Gate one: accepting the problem** 




  





 Before a bid becomes a contract, management must understand the customer’s product, process conditions, cleaning method, utilities, interfaces, throughput assumptions and acceptance criteria. The Director will challenge bid governance where requirements are incomplete, guarantees are broad or the proposed solution relies on untested assumptions. Commercial urgency should not bypass engineering review, capacity confirmation, site\-risk assessment or a clear allocation of interface responsibility.
 



  





 The Board should receive visibility into contractual exposure for delay, performance shortfall, contamination, consequential loss, intellectual property and changes in customer scope. Risk premiums and contingencies must be grounded in the actual project rather than applied mechanically.
 



  





**Gate two: freezing a cleanable design** 




  





 The appointee will seek assurance that hygienic design principles are built into equipment geometry, material choice, seals, welds, drainage, accessibility, instrumentation and cleaning validation. Design review should involve manufacturing, quality, service and commissioning, not remain isolated within engineering.
 



  





 Changes after design freeze need controlled technical and commercial assessment.
 



  





 Where digital controls or remote connections form part of the system, the Board must understand software ownership, access privileges, patching, data use and safe fallback. A cyber event that changes a process parameter can become a product\-safety event.
 



  





**Gate three: fabricating what was approved** 




  





 Material identity, surface condition, welding practice, outsourced treatment, calibration and inspection evidence all influence fitness for use. The Director will review how the company qualifies special processes, controls non\-conformance and preserves traceability. Schedule pressure must not move unfinished or conditionally accepted work downstream without named accountability and an agreed closure path.
 



  





 Management information should connect shop loading, material availability, engineering releases, rework and subcontractor performance. Reported project progress should represent earned completion, not expenditure or physical presence on the shop floor.
 



  





**Gate four: integrating at site** 




  





 Installation and commissioning often expose assumptions that were invisible during design. The Director will question site\-readiness checks, change control, safety planning, customer dependencies and escalation routes. Acceptance tests should be objective, witnessed and tied to the contracted duty. Punch lists must distinguish cosmetic completion from issues that prevent safe or hygienic operation.
 



  





 Revenue recognition, retention, warranty provision and project closure should reflect substantive acceptance and remaining obligations. The finance view and the project view must reconcile.
 



  





**Gate five: learning through service** 




  





 Warranty calls, spares demand, cleaning difficulties and repeat interventions contain product\-development intelligence. The appointee will encourage a closed loop from service into design standards, supplier decisions and commercial qualification. Aftermarket strategy should create genuine availability and performance value, not dependency through inaccessible information or restrictive practices.
 



  





**The enterprise decisions surrounding the gates** 




  





 The Director will participate in capacity, technology and market choices. They will evaluate whether modularisation, standard platforms, automation or strategic sourcing can improve delivery without concealing customer\-specific engineering. Working\-capital oversight will cover advances, milestone billing, long\-lead purchases, work in progress, claims and retentions. The Board will expect candid scenario analysis before expanding facilities or entering unfamiliar applications.
 



  





 Leadership review will include engineering authority, project\-management capability, quality independence, service responsiveness and succession for scarce technical roles. Safety, environmental performance and contractor governance will be treated as operating fundamentals.
 



  





**Experience and temperament** 




  





 The ideal candidate has senior responsibility in process equipment, food manufacturing, capital projects, industrial engineering, quality, operations, finance or project\-based business. Experience governing hygienic design, complex commissioning, contract risk or lifecycle service will be useful. The Board needs a person who can explore a technical issue deeply while preserving the distinction between oversight and execution.
 



  





 Candidates must be financially literate, conflict\-free and actively registered in the IICA Independent Directors Databank. Any relationship with customers, engineering consultants, component suppliers, contractors or competing equipment businesses must be declared.
 



  





**Candidate response** 




  





 Applications through India ID Exchange should include the Board profile, IICA confirmation and a brief explanation of how the candidate would determine whether a delayed project is suffering from execution weakness, defective commercial assumptions or both.
