title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow\-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world\-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long\-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer\-centric, operationally excellent, and high\-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business\- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer\-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations\- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People\-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial \- Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock\-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation\-to\-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow\-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.

title: Java Module Lead
description:
*Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*




*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*




*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*



**Job Description**

  

  





**Module Lead – Java**




**Eurofins IT Solutions, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India**
  

  

  

 With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.
   

  

  

  

 The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building next\-generation applications, LIMS platforms, and enterprise systems. As a Tech Lead – Java, you will play a hands\-on leadership role in designing, developing, and modernizing scalable, high\-performance platforms.
   

  

  

  

 You will drive solution design, architecture decisions, and technical direction, while ensuring delivery excellence. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver robust, secure, and reliable solutions aligned with business goals.
   

  

  

  

 This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges



**Required Skills**



* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns



**Experience**



* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies



**Tech Stack**



* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube



******Additional Information******




**Required Qualifications:**
  

 Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent
   

  

  

  

**Personal Skills:**



* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.



****Additional Information****




**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**



* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* •24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more



**The Location:**




 Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.
   

  





**Why Should You Apply?**



* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.



**Start date: ASAP**




 Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

title: GDS Cyber - DPP - Manager - AI Data Protection Engineering
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer\-embedded technical ownership and end\-to\-end production deployment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud\-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/data protection tooling such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Purview, DSPM platforms, Python, and related enterprise engineering tools.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a professional services, solutions engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed model.
* Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated\-industry depth.
* Experience with pricing inputs, solution estimation, and technical deal shaping.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world.  **SAP FSCM Senior Consultant**

* Should be able to independently handle complex technical PO requirements.
* Should be good in Communication both written and verbal

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

 : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Riafy Technologies partners with leading global brands to think, ideate, build, and grow digital products that create meaningful impact. Its consumer apps are used by over 100 million people in 160 countries and 23 languages, and trusted by partners such as Google, Apple, Siemens, Sony, major banks, airlines, and FMCG leaders. Riafy’s apps rank in the top 1% globally, with multiple recognitions from Google, including Editor’s Choice and Top Developer badges, and repeated showcases at Google I/O. The company’s proprietary Generative AI platform, R10, powers enterprise\-grade AI agents across sectors like banking, aviation, automotive, telecom, healthcare, beauty, FMCG, and manufacturing. Riafy fosters a culture of belonging, inclusion, and diversity, has tripled in size in recent years, and was honored with the Google Partner Award 2023 for DEI in APAC.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Project Coordinator role at Riafy Technologies is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kochi. This role involves coordinating project activities, tracking timelines and deliverables, and ensuring clear communication among cross\-functional teams such as product, engineering, design, and client stakeholders. The Project Coordinator will assist in preparing project plans, status reports, and documentation, and will help identify risks and dependencies to keep initiatives on schedule and within scope. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include organizing meetings, maintaining task lists and project dashboards, supporting resource allocation, and following up on action items. The role also includes contributing to process improvements, supporting quality assurance efforts, and helping ensure that projects align with partner expectations and Riafy’s standards for innovation and impact.

* Strong project coordination and organizational skills, including experience with scheduling, task tracking, and maintaining project documentation.
* Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with diverse stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on meeting deadlines and quality standards.
* Comfort working in fast\-paced, cross\-functional environments; ability to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

 Graduation in any discipline.
 



 Professional certification in Facilities/Property Management will be an added advantage.

 6 to 8 Years of experience in property management, facilities management, real estate, hospitality, commercial buildings, residential projects or a similar environment. **Digital Marketing Delivery Manager** 





 For Digital Marketing Agency located in Kochi
 




  




**Purpose of the Role**

This role combines deep technical domain knowledge with operational discipline \- ensuring campaigns ship on\-time and on\-scope, while remaining hands\-on to troubleshoot setups, audit strategy, quality, review analytics and optimize internal team throughput.

**Reporting** 

**Reports to:** 
 COO / Managing Director
 



**Works with:** 
 Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.
 


**Core Responsibilities** 

**1 Proven experience in Digital Marketing industry standard scope delivery** 




  





 ·    End to end knowledge of holistic digital marketing industry standard scope of work execution successfully.
 



 ·    Ability to take ownership, translate strategies, align with expectations and ensure effective execution, take proactive, corrective and preventive measures throughout workflow process with
 
 ROI focus.
 



 ·    Be hands\-on and actively perform technical audits on paid campaigns and content strategies prior to launch, step in directly to fix technicalities, tracking, campaign structure, or workflow blockers, do overall reviews and provide inputs to SEO, setups, to creatives, for development team etc.

 **,** 
 popular tools, CRM platforms etc.
 



 ·    Knowledge of AI tools and its leverage to expedite productivity and faster turn arounds.
 



 ·    Strong analytical skills – ability to translate data into clear strategy.
 


**2 Own on\-time delivery across all accounts** 

 •   Hold end\-to\-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.
 



 •   Own scope and maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.
 



 •   Be hands on and streamline productivity and strive for efficiency – individuals and team.
 


**3\. Plan capacity, resource, control workflow, priorities and scope** 

 •   Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over\-allocation
 **before** 
 it causes slippage.
 



 •   Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.
 



 •   Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.
 



 •   Run a disciplined workflow process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.
 



 •   Implement operational frameworks (Agile/Kanban) to maximize team output per hour. Monitor billable vs. non\-billable time and eliminate operational drag across the offshore team.
 



 •   Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade\-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.
 


**5\. Run the delivery cadence** 

 •   Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup \+ weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.
 



 •   Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.
 



 •   Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.
 


**6\. Enforce quality** 

 •   Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.
 



 •   For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA\-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).
 



 •   Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.
 


**7\. Report to clients and leadership** 

 •   Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.
 



 •   Give leadership an honest, data\-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.
 



 •   Standardize daily use of tools (Portal, CRM etc) to maintain 100% visibility into account velocity and resource capacity.
 


**8\. Build the delivery system** 

 •   Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.
 



 •   Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.
 



 •   Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.
 



  




**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)** 

 Scope Delivery health is measured, reviewed biweekly / monthly, and owned by this role:
 



**Metric** 




**Target** 




 On\-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
 



 Rework rate \< 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
 



 Client\-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
 



 Team utilization 80–90% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
 



 Scope Deliverables/SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
 



 Delivery visibility and Reporting 100% of scope and active work tracked in one live source of truth
 




 with daily, weekly reporting.
 




 Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after.

 •   Proven track record of aligning with client requirements, add value by improving quality and scaling on\-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.
 



 •   Strong knowledge of Google ads, social media ads, creatives, blogs, email marketing, content, analytics and working knowledge of SEO ,video production, web development \- to get hands on and to judge productivity, quality and timelines.
 



 •   Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.
 



 •   Be updated with latest trends and developments in the digital marketing domain.
 



 •   Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.
 



 •   Organized and Strong on digital marketing workflow design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.
 



 •   Effective English communication skills (spoken and written).
 



 •   Ability to work independently and as part of team, effectively manage priorities and productivity
 



  




**Ideal Candidate** 

 The one who makes digital marketing scope delivery boringly predictable as per stakeholder expectations. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good work ship on time \- every account, every time.

This is not a support\-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities**

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Product Management \- Manager, you will lead the charge in developing innovative software solutions that drive digital transformation and enhance business performance. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will combine technical experience with creative thinking to deliver software products that revolutionize industries and provide exceptional user experiences. This role involves designing, coding, and testing applications that meet the evolving needs of clients.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style by motivating, developing, and inspiring your team to deliver quality results. You will be responsible for coaching and leveraging team members' unique strengths to meet client expectations. With your growing business acumen, you will play a crucial role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values meaningfully. Embracing technology and innovation, you will enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will also address conflicts or issues, engaging in difficult conversations with clients, team members, and other stakeholders, while upholding professional and technical standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leading the development and implementation of innovative software solutions to drive digital transformation
* Managing and mentoring teams to enhance their skills and deliver quality software products
* Designing, coding, and testing applications using programming languages such as Java, Python, and C\#.NET
* Overseeing the application of software development methodologies and lifecycle management
* Collaborating with stakeholders to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications
* Utilizing API management and microservices to enhance software integration and functionality
* Conducting code reviews and quality assurance testing to maintain software standards
* Implementing continuous integration and delivery practices to streamline software deployment
* Encouraging the adoption of AI\-human collaboration and digital tooling to improve software development processes
* Addressing and resolving conflicts or issues within the team and with clients to maintain project timelines and deliverables


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 8 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Strong product fundamentals \& product sense — owns a product surface end\-to\-end: discovery, roadmap, prioritization, launch, iteration.
* Can defend why this problem, this quarter.
* 6\+ years in product management, including a zero\-to\-one product.
* Requirements and stakeholder craft — elicits needs from business and technical stakeholders, writes clear PRDs and acceptance criteria, and manages senior stakeholders and clients with honesty and calibration.
* Hands\-on with AI tools in their own workflow — has used AI\-assisted tooling to produce working prototypes, wireframes, or internal tools themselves. \- Practical understanding of how AI products behave knows outputs are probabilistic, has thought about how to tell whether a model's answers are actually good, and can talk sensibly about accuracy, cost, latency, and where AI is the wrong tool.
* Data\-informed decision\-making — defines metrics before building, runs experiments, reads a funnel, and connects product decisions to business outcomes.


 Good\-to\-have
   

  

* Design and UX instinct — comfortable producing high\-fidelity interactive wireframes and reasoning about interaction patterns.
* Domain expertise— financial services, healthcare, energy, manufacturing, public sector.
* Depth in AI evaluation — has built or specified test sets and quality benchmarks for generative \&agentic features.
* Technical background — engineering, data, or solution\-architecture history; enough code fluency to read a PR and challenge an architecture.
* Demonstrating advanced skills in software engineering and product innovation \- Utilizing AI fluency and AI\-human collaboration in strategic advising
* Applying analytical thinking and strategic questioning to solve complex problems
* Leading teams through ambiguity with composure and sound judgment
* Excelling in client management and delivering impactful messages
* Innovating processes with continuous integration and delivery methodologies
* Utilizing AI fluency and AI\-human collaboration in project management
* Excelling in software engineering with a focus on microservices
* Leveraging analytical thinking for business process improvement
* Managing client relationships with effective communication and feedback
* Embracing change and innovation in software development methodologies

 India

 At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.
   

  

 This role provides on‑the‑ground leadership for the Application Modernization \& Transformation (ATE) team in India. The Lead oversees a growing team of analysts \& developers and ensure high‑quality delivery across modernization initiatives. This position maintains alignment with global digital transformation priorities, strengthens collaboration across ES Applications, and drives consistent DT practices throughout the portfolio.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities:
   

  

 Manage India‑based resources supporting ATE priorities and ensure strong execution across modernization and transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Coordinate work assignments, prioritize activities, and support future team expansion as program needs evolve.
   

  

 Guide the team in delivering clear insights into portfolio health, modernization opportunities, performance trends, and application lifecycle considerations.
   

  

 Solid technical understanding of cloud technologies, digital transformation practices, and emerging AI capabilities to support modernization initiatives.
   

  

 Partner closely with the RTX India ES team to identify future transformation opportunities, while promoting ATE capabilities to other ES‑aligned teams in India to expand engagement and drive broader adoption.
   

  

 Promote continuous improvement, best practices, and standardization across the team to ensure consistent, scalable, and high‑quality delivery.
   

  

 Required Qualifications:
   

  

 Strong understanding of cloud technologies, modern application architectures, digital transformation concepts, and key modernization practices such as refactoring, re‑platforming, and process digitization.
   

  

 Familiarity with emerging AI capabilities and the ability to interpret complex application portfolios to guide teams on health, lifecycle, and modernization opportunities.
   

  

 Proven ability to lead and grow delivery teams, manage workload allocation, and coordinate multiple workstreams in fast‑moving environments.
   

  

 Ability to drive standardization, best practices, and continuous improvement while collaborating effectively with global and cross‑functional teams.
   

  

 Experience working with business and technology leaders to align delivery with strategic priorities, promote modernization solutions, and support adoption of consistent transformation practices across portfolios.
   

  

 Required Education:
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

 5\+ years of experience in application modernization, digital transformation, or enterprise technology delivery.
   

  

 5\+ years of experience leading technical or cross‑functional teams, preferably in a global delivery model.

 Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
   

  

 Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.

title: Senior Software Technologist I - Testing
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Senior Software Technologist I \- Testing
   

  

**Job Description**
 Philips is a global leader in health technology, dedicated to improving lives through meaningful innovation. This role sits within
 **Hospital Patient Monitoring (HPM),** 
 which provides advanced monitoring solutions for acute care settings. From bedside and transport monitors to centralized systems, HPM helps clinicians identify at\-risk patients and intervene quickly.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced
 **System Verification Lead** 
 who combines
 **strong system\-level thinking with hands\-on verification expertise and technical leadership** 
 . The successful candidate will understand complex system integration points, translate product and system risks into effective verification strategies, and lead a verification team through planning and execution across multiple projects and releases. This is a
 **Technical Lead** 
 role with no direct people\-management responsibility, but it requires
 **strong ownership, influence, coaching, and cross\-functional coordination** 
 .
   

  

**Your Role**
 This role provides
 **technical leadership for system verification across multiple projects and releases** 
 , driving verification strategy, execution, risk management, and test automation to
 **ensure high\-quality, compliant product delivery** 
 . The position coordinates verification planning, mentors team members, resolves technical challenges, oversees verification documentation and Design History File deliverables, and collaborates closely with cross\-functional stakeholders including engineering, quality, security, and regulatory teams. The role also focuses on
 **improving verification efficiency through automation, AI\-driven practices, continuous improvement, and proactive communication of quality, risk, and release readiness metrics.**
* Automation Expertise:
+ Strong experience in Java automation using Selenium.
+ Hands\-on experience with BDD frameworks (development and maintenance).
+ Proficiency in web service automation testing (REST/SOAP).

* Test Design \& Strategy:
+ Identifies potential system\-level risks through system analysis and designs test scenarios to mitigate these risks, contributing to early defect detection and preventing critical issues from reaching later stages of the development process.
+ Demonstrates flexibility and adaptability by adjusting test strategies based on system complexity and evolving requirements by creating new test cases, modifying existing ones, or prioritizing tests to ensure focus on critical functionalities.
+ Contributes to increased efficiency by supporting the creation of test automation frameworks for repetitive tasks by identifying suitable automation tools, developing reusable test scripts, and collaborating with colleagues to integrate automation into the overall testing process.
+ Ability to define and execute test cases for functional, performance, reliability, and scalability testing.
+ Skilled in log analysis and identifying problem areas to accelerate defect resolution.

* Technical Knowledge:
+ Knowledge of CI/CD, continuous testing, automation integration, source control, and pipeline practices.
+ Good understanding of IT infrastructure, virtualization, networking, cloud technologies, system integration environments, and laboratory setup.
+ Experience with log analysis and tools used for requirements, test, and defect management, such as JIRA or ALM.

* Reporting \& Documentation:
+ Ability to generate test reports compliant with quality management systems.
+ Strong understanding of defect management processes and tools (e.g., JIRA, ALM).

* Additional Skills:
+ Experience with AWS, JMeter, Postgres, AngularJS is a plus.
+ Familiarity with SAFE Agile methodology.
+ Exposure to cybersecurity verification, system hardening, authentication and authorization, network security, or secure deployment configurations.


**You're The Right Fit If**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology
* 10\-13 years of experience in software or system verification, including test strategy, system integration testing, manual testing, and test automation.
* Strong Systems thinking, Execution leadership, technical influence, Quality ownership, Continuous improvement mindset and Adaptability is required to be successful in the role.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, planning, and problem\-solving skills.


**How We Work Together**
 We believe that we are better together than apart. This is an office\-based role, which means working in person at least 3 days per week.
   

  

**About Philips**
 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
   

  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.


 If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is Seeking a Software Engineering Manager.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage, coach, and develop a team of individual contributor engineer roles with low to moderate complexity and less experienced managers who are responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
* Ensure adherence to the Banking Platform Architecture, and meeting non\-functional requirements with each release
* Engage with architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture to enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example, cloud readiness, application modernization and data strategy
* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross\-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team exist to ensure device and application customers have delightful experiences using the product by enabling swift, precise, and privacy\-compliant observability and issue resolution across all devices and applications. Our mission is to transform vast amounts of device data into actionable insights that drive product stability and customer satisfaction. To achieve this mission, we provide comprehensive technology solutions spanning the entire observability lifecycle. This includes on\-device crash and log management, high\-scale data ingestion services, advanced analytics dashboards, and intuitive troubleshooting interfaces.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager for the Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services team, you will drive critical initiatives that enhance the detection, diagnosis, and resolution of issues across Amazon's device ecosystem. This high\-visibility role requires exceptional leadership in coordinating across several engineering teams, data engineers, applied scientists,BIEs and senior stakeholders to deliver scalable troubleshooting solutions that improve customer experience. You will be responsible for influencing feature priorities and getting buy in from engineering teams for delivery of large cross\-organization programs. You will leverage your technical knowledge to drive technical trade\-off decisions. You will represent difficult trade\-off decisions and solutions clearly to technical and business leaders to help them understand decisions and options. As a Technical Program Manager, you will be one of the key leaders on the team and have an impact by defining strategy \& requirements, developing processes \& schedules, and driving forward progress on major initiatives.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will bring strong project management skills to systematically drive programs and deliver results. You possess good technical skills to deal with ambiguous programs to drive clarity in scope and execution. You are have demonstrated ability in driving programs with multiple stakeholders, use escalation mechanisms and negotiation skills to drive the right outcomes. You have good communication skills, both written and verbal and are adept in communicating with stakeholders and executives with right level of detail and clarity.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will drive key business collaborations critical to improving the customer experience with Amazon Devices.
   

  

* You will partner with Senior Leaders within Amazon Devices to identify opportunities to increase device stability, reduce device resource utilizations, save costs and improve efficiency.
* You will define and implement strategical partnerships that enables businesses in Amazon Devices scale faster, save costs, and improve efficiency.
* You will establish mechanisms and processes that drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
* You will establish metrics and design self\-serve reports to keep stake\-holders informed and excited about the progress


 A day in the life
   

  

 This role will drive engagement across different product lines to design and drive programs that will improve the stability, reduce the resource utilization of the devices. You will also help build mechanisms to prevent duplication of tools across teams for troubleshooting and analysis. As a direct result, this role offers the challenge as well as the opportunity to bring structure and clarity to a fast\-moving space. This high visibility role is inherently cross\-organizational in nature. You will be a champion of this product to senior leadership.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services (ADTS) team ensures that troubleshooting is quick, easy, and privacy\-centric for device and application teams, so that end customers have delightful experiences with their Amazon Devices. We provide a single place for device and application teams to troubleshoot known issues, uncover emergent trends or regressions, and quantify the impact in the context of the customer journey. We build technology to deliver high\-quality user experiences for troubleshooting and analysis, ensure stability of the device, and proactively present critical issues and root causes to relevant teams based on a wide range of health and customer journey data.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering
* Experience managing technical programs across cross\-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience managing communication with geographically distributed teams

****Job Description:****

 **Whitefield, Bangalore\-KA , India**
****What You Will Do:****
 As an integral part of the Continuous Improvement (CI) Center of Excellence, specifically focused on standardization, optimization and digitalization, the candidate will support the execution of our continuous improvement framework within the Global business service scope, with focus, but not exclusively, on the Invoice\-to\-Pay processes (ITP)

* Knowledge and understanding of the mechanics in the ITP process stream and how these fit into the end\-to\-end financial process environment.
* Project Management skills
* People leadership/management experience
* Diagnostic capabilities to identify improvement opportunities

****Skills Desired:****

**Level Extensive Experience:**

**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Uses emotional contagion to affect the mood of group members, tone of group and group processes.

 Knowledge of the policies and techniques to manage a set of related projects within a program; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control the set of projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve program objectives.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Evaluates risks and vulnerabilities, and creates contingency plans.

* Conducts regular and ad\-hoc program reviews with project managers, team and clients.
* Coaches others in maintaining open communication among project managers and interested parties.

* Plans, estimates, staffs, organizes and monitors a set of projects within a program.


**Change Control:** 
 Knowledge of the processes and procedures by which a change is identified, evaluated, approved, monitored and documented; Ability to manage changes in the production environment and processes effectively\+
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Train others in how to review a proposed change and assesses the potential impact of the change on the organization or environment.
* Manages change control processes to ensure each change is evaluated and dispositioned at the proper authority level.
* Oversees the development of organizational change management policies and procedures.
* Develops and publishes comprehensive change and contingency plans.
* Defines and communicates change risks, contingency alternatives and associated benefits and drawbacks.
* Coordinates the implementation of change in diverse and complex production environments.

 Knowledge of project control and reporting; ability to monitor the vital signs of an IT project while managing its progress and delivery schedule.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Justifies varying and appropriate levels of scrutiny for differently experienced team members.
* Advises on the selection of tools and techniques used for monitoring progress and presenting reports to stakeholders.
* Communicates with managerial, technical and business stakeholders on progress reporting.
* Controls multiple IT projects: monitoring progress, probing and repairing delays.
* Consolidates the progress of many IT projects into a single progress report.
* Consults on the principles of Earned Value Analysis across multiple IT projects.


**IT Project Management:** 
 Knowledge of project management; ability to plan, organize, monitor and control IT projects using appropriate technical resources.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Controls quality standards and budgeting in an ongoing IT project.
* Estimates and appropriately addresses potential issues and risks in IT projects.
* Ensures that technical objectives and functional requirements align in all IT projects.
* Builds IT related templates for demand analysis and functional reports.
* Monitors every step in an IT project to ensure all aspects of the project are delivered on\-time.
* Directs team members in analyzing client requirements in an appropriate manner.


**IT Standards, Procedures \& Policies:** 
 Knowledge of Information Technology (IT) standards and policies; ability to utilize a variety of administrative skill sets and technical knowledge to manage organizational IT policies, standards, and procedures.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Evaluates the effectiveness of IT policies through professional group discussions.
* Designs organizational IT policies, standards and procedures.

* Monitors the implementation of IT standards and procedures in IT projects or services.

**Problem Management:** 
 Knowledge of the processes involved in problem control, error control and the production of management information or computer hardware; ability to identify the root cause of problems in a timely and accurate manner and bring them to a successful resolution.
   

  

**Level Extensive Experience:**
* Monitors and improves problem reporting, tracking, escalation and resolution.

title: Lead/Senior SQA Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
**Our Mission:**
 We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high\-value content.
   

  

**About Us**
 Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high\-value content \- technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives.
   

  

 Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Quality Ownership \& Technical Leadership**
* Own end\-to\-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment.
* Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk\-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas.
* Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions.
* Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements.
* Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality.
* Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements.


**Test Strategy \& Coverage**
* Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly.
* Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content.
* Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e.g., S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance.
* Perform accessibility testing (WCAG \& EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases.


**Automation \& CI/CD Excellence**
* Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium.
* Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows.
* Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation.
* Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing.
* Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers.
* Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks.
* Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage.


**Functional \& Workflow Testing**
* Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions.
* Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows.
* Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes.
* Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services.
* Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle.


**XML and Publishing Validation**
* Perform validation of XML\-based content processing pipelines.
* Verify XML structures (e.g., DITA maps, topics, etc.), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms.
* Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows.
* Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules.
* Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats.
* Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines.


**Data Layer Testing**
* Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures.
* Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes.
* Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases .
* Develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules.
* Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories.
* Ensure data consistency across systems and environments.


**API and Integration Testing**
* Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services.
* Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications.
* Test webhook\-based integrations and event\-driven workflows.
* Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system\-to\-system communication.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation across integrated platforms.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points.


**Performance and Reliability Testing**
* Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads.
* Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories.
* Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance.


**Collaboration \& Execution**
* Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams.
* Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance.


**Experience And Skills**
**Mandatory Requirements \& Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

* Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills.
* Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes.
* Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management.
* Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML\-based publishing pipelines.
* Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content.
* Hands\-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery\-based validation scripts.
* Experience testing modern APIs.
* Experience testing asynchronous, event\-driven, and webhook\-based workflows.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.
* Expertise in Playwright (JS/TS), JMeter, Azure DevOps, and Jira.
* Minimum of 10 years’ experience in SQA, specifically testing XML based systems. .
* Proven experience defining enterprise QA strategy, establishing testing standards, and driving quality initiatives across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product, engineering, and architectural decisions through quality leadership.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers and leading quality efforts without direct supervision.
* Track record of improving release quality, automation maturity, and testing efficiency at an organizational level.
* Deep understanding of SDLC/STLC with proven Agile/Scrum experience.
* Strong skills in test data creation, maintenance, and management.

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

description:

The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
* Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in\-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
* Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
* Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals
* Provide in\-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
* Serve as advisor or coach to mid\-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
