title: Finacle Product Engineer | CMS & API Integrations
description:
**Job Summary**
 Synechron seeks a seasoned Finacle Product Engineer to lead the design, customization, integration, and ongoing support of Finacle\-based banking solutions. This role combines deep subject\-matter expertise in Finacle 11X core banking with hands\-on testing and integration capabilities. The candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, QA, and IT to deliver robust, scalable, and compliant solutions across CMS, core banking, and payments modules, driving modernization and operational excellence within a regulated environment.
   

  

**Software Requirements**
**Required Skills (Essential)**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Finacle core banking solutions, preferably on Finacle 11X
* In\-depth exposure to Finacle modules such as CMS, FAS, LMS, TRAMS, ITS, and related components
* Experience with Finacle scripting and log validation techniques
* Proficiency in designing, configuring, and integrating REST APIs and Finacle interfaces
* Working knowledge of SQL databases (Oracle, with related validation and data manipulation skills)
* Experience participating in business discussions, creating BRDs/IA/Gap analyses, and providing architectural input
* Proficiency with SDLC/Agile methodologies and cross\-functional collaboration
* Strong communication and documentation skills for stakeholder reporting and compliance artifacts


**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to testing automation and CI/CD processes within Finacle environments
* Banking/regulatory awareness and data security considerations

**Overall Responsibilities**

**Development Tools and Methodologies**

**Security Protocols**

**Day\-to\-Day Activities**
* Engage with stakeholders to capture business and technical requirements for Finacle projects
* Design and implement Finacle customizations, interfaces, and CMS enhancements
* Collaborate with QA, product, and operations teams to ensure testability and deployment readiness
* Review and contribute to architecture documents, BRDs, and test plans
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement fixes
* Maintain test data, runbooks, and deployment procedures
* Mentor junior teammates and drive continuous improvement


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
* Finacle experience in CMS and core banking modules is essential
* Certifications in Finacle, banking technology, or related disciplines are advantageous
* Commitment to ongoing professional development in banking technology and Finacle updates


**Professional Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and advanced problem\-solving for complex banking projects

* Clear communication and effective stakeholder management across technical and business audiences

title: Principal Scrum Master
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

 The team is hiring a Principal Scrum Master to strengthen governance, controls, documentation, and auditability processes supporting the ServiceNow platform for Enterprise Change, Incident, and Problem Management. The role will partner closely with stakeholders across the organization to drive Agile delivery, improve operational efficiency, and ensure adherence to governance standards within a highly regulated financial services environment
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Manage bi\-weekly sprint execution and delivery tracking.
* Coordinate and communicate with multiple stakeholders regarding deliverables, dependencies, and approvals.
* Identify, track, and remove impediments impacting delivery.
* Manage backlog intake, user stories, and sprint reporting.
* Maintain documentation, governance controls, and audit trails.
* Drive process improvements and adoption of Agile best practices.

**Talents Needed For Success**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent Scrum certification.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Jira.
* Experience working as a Scrum Master within a large financial services organization or major financial institution.
* Proven stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience managing Agile delivery, sprint processes, and backlogs.
* Strong governance, controls, documentation, and auditability mindset.
* Experience supporting regulated environments with compliance requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to ServiceNow.
* Experience supporting Change Management, Incident Management, or Problem Management functions.
* Background implementing Agile best practices and improving team efficiency.

title: Specialist, Business Agility
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Scrum Master with experience leading cross\-functional teams to support business functions. In this role, you’ll facilitate agile delivery across a broad range of initiatives including data platform enhancements, dashboard development, automation, and data product delivery. The ideal candidate combines agile expertise with strong communication skills and a foundational understanding of data life cycles, analytics tooling, and enterprise project delivery.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Serve as Scrum Master for 1–3 Agile teams focused on delivering data and analytics solutions.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews.
* Collaborate with Product Owners to groom and maintain a well\-defined backlog aligned to business priorities.
* Remove blockers and support teams in achieving sprint goals and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate across stakeholders in IT and different business teams.
* Track team metrics (velocity, burn\-down, etc.) and report progress to leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, agility, and transparency.
* Ensure alignment to Agile best practices, scaling frameworks (e.g., SAFe), and delivery standards.
* Support onboarding of new team members and promote team engagement.


**What Should You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or any related field.
* 3\-7 years of experience as a Scrum Master in a technology or data environment.


**Primary Skills (must\-have)**
* Hands\-on experience with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally)
* Strong facilitation, communication, and servant leadership skills
* Exposure to data projects (e.g., data pipelines, BI dashboards, data governance, reporting)
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional teams across IT and business units
* Scrum Master Certification (CSM, PSM, or equivalent)


**Secondary Skills (nice To Have)**
* Relevant certifications
* Experience in large enterprise settings or highly regulated industries (e.g., pharma, finance)
* Understanding of back\-office operations (e.g., finance reporting cycles, HR metrics)
* Familiarity with data tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake, or Databricks
* Experience with Agile\-at\-scale frameworks (e.g., SAFe, LeSS)


**Who We Are**
 We are known as Merck \& Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

**What We Look For**
 Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

**About GHX**
 GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) is a leading healthcare technology company on a mission to simplify the business of healthcare and improve patient outcomes. Founded in 2000, GHX has built the GHX Global Network — the world’s largest cloud\-based supply chain community connecting healthcare providers, suppliers, distributors, and partners to automate key processes, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency. **About The Role**
 GHX is seeking a hands\-on Engineering Manager with expertise in software engineering, release management, artificial intelligence and cross\-functional collaboration. The work blends modern software practices with pragmatic AI to reduce manual exceptions, improve matching accuracy, and enhance the invoice processing end\-to\-end.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

**Technical Skills**
* Experience with development languages such as Java, Springboot, Node.js
* Familiarity with frontend frameworks, including Angular (12\+) and strong proficiency with JavaScript or TypeScript
* Proficiency with AWS cloud and cloud‑native services
* Practical experience with Relational and NoSQL databases, such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or cloud‑native data stores.
* Proficiency with CI/CD and infrastructure automation tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Bamboo).
* Knowledge of Testing tools like Selenium, Playwright, Postman or similar
* Familiarity with AI‑powered engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to enhance development velocity and code reliability.


**Soft Skills**
* History of handling multiple concurrent projects
* Ability to effectively communicate across organizational levels and with a variety of stakeholders, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Strong strategic thinking that prioritizes long term outcomes over emergent distractions.
* Ability to make difficult decisions and to drive decisions into actuality

title: Supervisor, Applications Delivery
description:
**Job Description**
 The person in this role is responsible for leading the design, delivery, implementation, and ongoing support of high\-quality application solutions. At lead/manager level, the role is accountable not only for technical execution, but also for delivery ownership, team coordination, stakeholder alignment, quality governance, operational stability, and continuous improvement across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
   

  

 The person in this role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional delivery teams to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, maintainable, and business\-aligned technology solutions. The role is expected to provide technical leadership, guide team members, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure successful delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Delivery Leadership, Requirements Analysis \& Estimation**
* Lead requirement analysis discussions with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Translate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements into solution scope, technical approach, delivery plan, and implementation priorities.
* Own or review effort estimation, delivery planning, resource requirements, and execution timelines for assigned initiatives.
* Identify delivery risks, dependencies, assumptions, and constraints, and drive mitigation plans with stakeholders.
* Ensure requirement documents, user stories, solution notes, and technical specifications are complete, clear, and aligned with agreed scope.


**Solution Design**
* Provide technical leadership in converting enterprise architecture and business needs into detailed solution designs and implementation plans.
* Review and approve design artifacts, workflows, integration approaches, technical specifications, and solution documentation.
* Evaluate design alternatives and guide the team toward scalable, secure, high\-performing, maintainable, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Ensure solution designs comply with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, data governance expectations, and engineering best practices.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with architects, vendors, project teams, and support teams.


**Application Development**
* Lead and guide application development, enhancement, configuration, integration, and maintenance activities.
* Review key technical deliverables to ensure quality, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with agreed standards.
* Provide technical direction to developers and support team members, including code review guidance, design clarification, and issue resolution support.
* Drive reuse of components, utilities, frameworks, and automation capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.
* Balance hands\-on technical contribution with oversight of team delivery, ensuring work is completed on time and with expected quality.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance**
* Define and oversee testing strategy, test coverage, quality checkpoints, and defect management for assigned solutions.
* Ensure unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing activities are planned and executed effectively.
* Review high\-impact defects, support root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented before production release.
* Promote test automation, continuous quality improvement, and proactive quality assurance practices across the delivery team.
* Ensure solutions meet functional, non\-functional, compliance, and operational readiness expectations before deployment.


**Architecture \& Technical Governance**
* Lead or actively govern application architecture, technical design, and solution review activities for assigned applications or projects.
* Ensure delivery teams follow architectural guidelines, technology standards, security policies, coding standards, and documentation expectations.
* Participate in governance forums and provide clear recommendations on solution risks, trade\-offs, dependencies, and mitigation options.
* Drive technical decision\-making in alignment with enterprise architecture, business priorities, operational impact, and long\-term maintainability.


**Release, Deployment \& Implementation**
* Own or coordinate release planning, environment readiness, deployment preparation, and implementation activities.
* Manage release risks, change approvals, production validation, rollback planning, and go\-live readiness with project and support teams.
* Coordinate application rollouts, stakeholder communication, hypercare planning, and post\-deployment stabilization.
* Ensure project is completed with proper documentation, monitoring, support handover, and minimal operational risk.


**Production Support \& Maintenance**
* Lead production support coordination for assigned applications, including incident triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, and service restoration.
* Review critical incidents, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor application stability, performance, SLA adherence, operational risks, and recurring issue patterns.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, vendors, business users, and support teams to resolve issues within agreed timelines.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring incidents, improve support efficiency, and strengthen operational resilience.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, customers, vendors, project managers, and support teams for assigned applications or delivery scope.
* Facilitate effective communication between business and IT teams, ensuring expectations, priorities, risks, and decisions are clearly understood.

title: Digital Customer Engagement Scrum Master
description:
**Job Description**
 Operates as the Scrum Master, leading cross\-functional, digital product teams to deliver high\-impact web and content solutions within a Product\-Oriented Delivery (POD) model. Acts as a facilitative leader and coach, guiding the Content POD from ideation through content design, development, and publishing. Has ongoing accountability for optimizing team velocity, facilitating agile ceremonies, managing content dependencies, and removing roadblocks to ensure seamless delivery. Collaborates closely with Product Owners, UX/UI designers, content creators, and developers to continuously improve our agile digital delivery methodology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Level Of Expertise**
* Agile Facilitation \& Delivery: Leads and coaches the Content POD in Scrum or hybrid agile frameworks. Facilitates sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives tailored to content lifecycle cadences.
* Operational Independence: Plans, coordinates, and prioritizes team workflows and resources with minimal direction. Expected to operate independently, managing complex cross\-functional dependencies across creative, technical, and marketing teams.
* Continuous Improvement: Oversees, evaluates, and refines processes within the Content POD. Actively contributes to the evolution of our Product\-Oriented Delivery (POD) playbook, modifying methods to optimize digital publishing workflows.
* Problem Solving \& Roadblock Removal: Uses extensive agile knowledge to solve complex delivery issues, proactively identifying and mitigating bottlenecks unique to content production (such as translation, legal compliance, design sign\-offs, and development releases).
* Influence \& Thought Leadership: Demonstrates strong thought leadership, serving as a go\-to agile resource internally. Mentors team members, champions agile best practices, and aligns stakeholders (both creative and technical) on delivery goals.


**Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Marketing, Communications, or a related equivalent field.
* Experience: Typically, at least 8\+ years of relevant experience in project management, agile delivery, or digital operations, with a proven track record of leading cross\-functional teams.
* Agile Track Record: Minimum of 3–5 years specifically acting as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach, ideally within a digital, marketing, or web product environment.


**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Digital Content Experience (preferred): Deep understanding of web development lifecycles, content workflows, and the digital publishing process (including experience with CMS platforms like Adobe Experience Manager).
* Agile Tool Proficiency: Expert\-level experience using Agile management tools (such as Jira and Confluence) to track progress, build dashboards, and manage backlogs.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to facilitate alignment between creative roles (UX/UI designers, content writers, SEO specialists) and technical roles (front\-end/back\-end developers, QA).
* Stakeholder Management: Strong communication and negotiation skills, with a track record of managing expectations with business stakeholders and Product Owners.

 This job has a full time weekly schedule.

description:

 **Real Living Wage** 
 employer, ensuring everyone is paid fairly for the great work they do!
   

  

**Our Product \& Engineering Team:**
 Liberis is building the embedded finance platform that lets partners around the world offer innovative funding products to their small business customers. We're a growth\-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data \& Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! Our teams solve real\-world problems for small businesses, shaping products that unlock opportunity at scale.
   

  

 Engineering is going through an AI\-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.
   

  

 Our Salesforce Team:
   

  

 You’ll join the Salesforce engineering team within Liberis’ wider Technology function. The team owns and evolves the Salesforce platform that underpins how Liberis acquires, onboards, and supports merchants and partners across 15 markets. They also work closely with other engineering development teams, product teams, and business functions such as commercial and operations to turn business needs into reliable, well\-built Salesforce solutions.
   

  

 The role:
   

  

 As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you’ll take ownership of complex Salesforce solutions from discovery through to production. You’ll work across both code and configuration, making informed technical decisions around architecture, automation, integrations, security, and maintainability.
   

  

 You’ll be trusted to take ambiguous or complex requirements, work with stakeholders to understand the underlying problem, and shape a solution that is scalable and aligned with the wider Salesforce platform.
   

  

 You’ll remain hands\-on with Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and declarative tooling, while also acting as a technical point of reference for other members of the team. You’ll review code and designs, support colleagues through challenging technical problems, and help improve the engineering practices that underpin how Salesforce changes are developed and released.
   

  

 Success in the role means consistently delivering high\-quality solutions with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions, and having a positive impact on both the platform and the engineers around you.
   

  

 What you’ll get to do:
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, and declarative tools such as Flow, validation rules, and Salesforce configuration.
* Own complex features and technical changes end to end, from understanding the business problem and shaping the technical approach through to testing, release, and production support.
* Make and contribute to technical design decisions across areas such as object modelling, automation, security and sharing, integrations, and platform architecture.
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code and automated tests, and provide thoughtful code reviews that improve both the solution and the capability of the wider team.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, investigate root causes, and help improve platform resilience and observability.
* Work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and other engineering teams to challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure solutions address the underlying business need.
* Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices across the team, including Git\-based development, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, testing, release management, and documentation.
* Support and mentor other developers and admins, sharing knowledge and helping raise technical standards across the team.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions, reduce technical debt, improve platform performance, and make Salesforce easier to maintain and evolve.
* Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision\-making so that knowledge is shared effectively across the team.


 What we think you’ll need:
   

  

* Proven success in a hands\-on Salesforce development role, with experience delivering and owning complex Salesforce solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL/SOSL.
* Strong Salesforce configuration skills, including Flow, object modelling, validation rules, security, and sharing.
* Experience making or contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions, rather than only implementing predefined solutions.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or similar integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and code review practices.
* Experience working with Git\-based version control and modern Salesforce development and deployment practices.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical or production issues.
* Strong communication skills, with experience working directly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly.
* A collaborative approach and experience supporting, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other developers.
* Good judgement around when to use code versus declarative Salesforce functionality, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and platform health.


**Next steps** 
 If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on chess.crossley@liberis.com
   

  

 Career development is really important to us here at Liberis, with progression opportunities for both individual contributors and people managers. You can have a look through our Engineering Career Framework via this link
   

  

**Our hybrid approach**
 Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self\-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee\-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high\-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*
**Job Description**
 Ares is seeking a highly motivated, detail\-oriented Associate Vice President to join the Fund Launch, Onboarding and Wind Down (“FLOW”) team and act as the business liaison to technology \[across multiple initiatives supporting the fund launch lifecycle for Private Credit, Real Estate, Private Equity, and Secondaries funds,]. In this role, the successful candidate will help bridge the gap between the business and technology by analyzing interconnected operational processes, documenting requirements, and supporting the full development lifecycle, including release testing and change management.
   

  

 This position is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting ideas, documenting and improving business processes, working with data, and solving problems creatively. The role focuses on implementing practical, high\-impact solutions that strengthen business operations across the firm.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is collaborative, agile, innovative, and proactive and must possess the ability to think critically and holistically while maintaining strong attention to detail.
   

  

**Process Improvements**
 PRIMARY FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES \-
   

  

* Collaborate with stakeholders across operational teams to understand workflows, identify team\-specific and intersectional opportunities for improvement, and translate requirements into development\-ready enhancements
* Bridge the gap between the business and technology to effectively execute on stakeholder\-driven system enhancements from documenting requirements through testing to final release
* Help to design, document and execute User Acceptance Test plans to validate enhancements as well as periodic regression testing to validate end\-to\-end business workflows, ensure functional requirements and performance standards and surface any defects post release
* Help to standardize processes and increase adoption through change management efforts, including by creating clear documentation for workflows, SOPs, and system processes, including maintaining an internal knowledge base and cross\-functional training, as requested


**Data, Reporting, AI**
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and document key data related to their processes
* Analyze data sets across stakeholder workflows and systems to identify opportunities for standardization, including documenting stakeholder or related system data dictionaries, use cases and opportunities for unifying data initiatives to ensure data integrity
* Document reporting requirements and related data, including sourcing, ownership, definitions, and maintenance of knowledge base to ensure consistent data usage
* Work with stakeholders and technology to identify, document, and implement use cases for AI tools across systems, including automation, self\-service portals, data and reporting to increase efficiencies and speed to execution
* Provide support for data integration between systems, including analysis, audits and backfill projects, as needed


**Qualifications\-**
 Education: BS/BA with degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or General Business preferred, with outstanding academic record
   

  

**Experience And Skills Required**
* 7\+ years of relevant work experience in a business analyst or project management role, preferably within asset management
* Proven ability to effectively translate and document business and technology requirements and adjust communication style to fit the audience
* Strong problem\-solver with ability to identify and resolve issues before they become issues
* Self\-motivated and able to operate independently, proactively seeking clarity in ambiguous situations
* Highly adaptable and able to pivot quickly in response to changing priorities
* Analytical thinker with proven history of surfacing actionable insights to inform prioritization of process and data improvements across systems and enhancement requests
* Highly adaptable and able to reassess and pivot in response to quickly changing priorities
* Familiar with Agile, Scrum or other iterative product management style
* Able to leverage excellent interpersonal and inter\-cultural skills to drive execution and adoption of new systems and processes


**Strongly Preferred**
* Experience in the asset management industry, legal and/or fund operations a plus
* Demonstrable knowledge of workflow, data mastering and other business applications within the corporate tech stack: Salesforce, DealCloud, Coupa, Sharepoint, GEMS or equivalent
* Experience with APIs, SQL, XL Connector, Power Automate


**Reporting Relationships**
 Vice President, Fund Launch, Onboarding and Wind Down

title: Manager, Software Engineering (Java, Cloud, Microservices, Architecture)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Manager, Software Engineering (Java, Cloud, Microservices, Architecture)
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard is a technology company in the Global Payments Industry. We operate the world’s fastest payments processing network, connecting consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments and businesses in more than 210 countries and territories. Mastercard products and solutions make everyday commerce activities – such as shopping, travelling, running a business and managing finances – easier, more secure and more efficient for everyone.
   

  

 Data Distribution and Analytics (DDA) program of Data \& Analytics business unit, looking for Manager in Software Engineering to lead, mentor and coach software engineering teams to build, enhance and deliver internal or market\-facing Product, and Platforms. Someone who combines deep technical experience with great people management skills and can help elevate our teams and our approach to engineering.
   

  

 We are looking for a candidate that has proven experience in coding, architecture leadership, and leading engineers in a fast\-paced environment. This position is a mix of hands\-on development, process engineering, and management responsibilities with a strong emphasis on technical leadership. The candidate will work with cross\-functional teams and business stakeholders in developing product platforms. The ideal candidate should be passionate about design thinking, customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.
   

  

 Join our team and help shape the future of data and analytics!
   

  

 As a Manager, Software Engineering – a typical day might include:
   

  

* Forefront of working on the Services/APIs that power our business as we build the near real time data access solution to drive our customer experience to the next level.
* Perform code reviews, retrospectives, and manage the acceptance of Pull Requests using Git.
* Coach your team in engineering best practices, including 12\-factor app design.
* Recruit and hire the right talent, always bringing in someone better than at least half the individuals in the role.
* Collaborating with business leaders across the company to ensure our software products align with business objectives and meet the latest API standards in the industry
* Leading our engineering teams in an agile team structure to advance high level strategies like cloud enablement and streaming analytics
* Emulate and drive Mastercard Way behaviors through their behavior, recognitions, coaching, and employee engagement
* Provide strategic thinking and leadership related to a wide range of applications and systems, or software\-development methodologies
* Working with Senior Leadership to advance our Big Data Strategy for On\-Cloud and On\-Prem.
* Benchmark and drive engineering productivity, quality, and technology policy compliance in the areas of ownership
* Ability to thrive under pressure and function effectively in a fast\-paced work environment
* Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills and ability to communicate with all levels of management.


**All About You**
* 9\-12\+ years of experience in Java development, out of which 2\-3 years of experience in designing platform solution
* People management / managing a team end to end experience is a must
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and live site operations.
* Have knowledge and demonstrate experience in \- Enterprise level asynchronous/event\-based communication and integration. Microservices topologies, including operational concerns such as resiliency, observability, discovery and routing, etc.
* Hands on experience in designing complex, highly scalable and performing microservices in a distributed environment and to have deep technical skills in the following areas: Java 11 and above, Spring framework, React\-Spring, Spring Batch, OpenAPI (Swagger), SQL, CI/CD, Docker, Serverless technologies.
* You have a strong commitment towards quality and continuous improvement of processes and software; you're well\-versed with software engineering practices. (e.g. Continuous Integration, Build/Deploy, Unit Testing, Regression Testing, Test \& Staging Environments, object\-oriented design and development)
* Able to independently come\-up with different approaches and solution, prepare high\-level and low\-level designs and create documentation.
* Approaches to Architecture governance and high\-volume data access and evolution in practice.
* Good to have knowledge of any cloud technology (Azure, AWS, PCF)
* Plan, design and develop technical solutions and alternatives to meet business requirements in adherence with MasterCard standards, processes and best practices.
* Accountable for full systems development life cycle including creating design and other technical artifacts including but not limited to detailed test strategy/test design, performance benchmarking, release rollout and deployment plans, contingency/back\-out plans, feasibility study, cost and time analysis and detailed estimates.
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers.
* Responsible for the analysis, design, development, and delivery of software solutions.
* BE/B.Tech in Computer Science


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Manager Engineering
description:
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud\-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
   

  

 Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co\-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
   

  

 Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
   

  

**Summary**
 The Manager, Engineering reports to the Director, Engineering and leads a team of software engineers who build and sustain the products Armor’s customers depend on. This is a hands\-on leadership position: the manager writes production code, opens and reviews pull requests, and ships alongside the engineers they lead. The role exercises independent judgment and discretion in setting technical direction, making architecture decisions, prioritizing defects and feature work, directing incident response, and developing engineering talent. Armor is looking for a technical leader with a track record of building and shipping high\-quality software with AI\-assisted development tools, and with the engineering judgment to raise the bar on architecture, delivery speed, and engineering ownership. This is a full\-time in\-office role based in Pune, India; on\-site presence five days a week is required.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)**
* Lead and manage a high\-performing AI\-native software engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, and hands\-on guidance while building a culture of engineering ownership.
* Contribute directly to architecture, design, code reviews, and implementation of complex software, working in the repository alongside the team rather than reviewing from a distance.
* Own day\-to\-day delivery for the assigned product areas, including feature work, defect triage, regression prevention, and customer escalations, and keep the Director, Engineering current on status and risk.
* Drive end\-to\-end engineering execution with minimal reliance on product management, translating business objectives into working software.
* Execute release management discipline set by the Director, Engineering, including change windows, rollback criteria, and release readiness for the team’s work.
* Put AI\-assisted development tools into daily engineering practice, measure the effect on delivery speed and quality, and hold the team to production\-grade standards for AI\-generated code.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, developer tools, and cloud technologies, balancing rapid experimentation against production\-grade engineering discipline.
* Hire and build the team, including defining the technical hiring bar, running interview loops, and onboarding new engineers.
* Manage relationships with third\-party technology vendors by evaluating platform usage, monitoring cost and performance, assessing alternatives, and providing technical recommendations that support renewals, negotiations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams, ensuring clear communication, knowledge sharing, and alignment across distributed engineering teams.
* Manage team performance through regular one\-on\-one meetings, goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and career development planning.
* Serve as the escalation point for production incidents and customer\-impacting issues, coordinating rapid response, running post\-incident reviews, and feeding the findings back into engineering practice.


**Required Skills**
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production software that customers depend on. Show us the work; we do not screen on years on a resume.
* Experience leading or managing software engineers, including performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Hands\-on production experience delivering software with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Strong frontend and backend development skills using technologies such as React, TypeScript, C\#, Node.js, Python, or Go, with demonstrated ability to contribute directly to code, architecture, and technical problem\-solving.
* Excellent software architecture skills, with the ability to set architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and promote practices that improve security, quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Production experience with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform, including deploying and operating applications in cloud environments.
* Proven ability to combine hands\-on development with leadership responsibilities without sacrificing either.
* Strong defect management and quality engineering instincts, including the ability to distinguish a regression from a customer\-found defect from a product gap, and to treat each one differently.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable application delivery.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Strong experience with relational, non\-relational, and AI\-enabled data platforms, including SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases, data modeling, performance tuning, and scalable data architectures for AI applications.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role, providing both technical advice and strategic direction to help customers reach their goals.
* Git proficiency including branching strategies, code review workflows, and CI/CD pipeline integration.
* Understanding of AI/LLM security risks including prompt injection, data leakage, and model limitations.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy and security implications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams and time zones.
* Preferred: bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
* Preferred: experience with virtualization, infrastructure, and data protection technologies such as VMware vSphere, Proxmox, NSX\-T, FortiMonitor, Zerto, and Rubrik.
* Preferred: cybersecurity background covering XDR, MDR, SIEM, SOC tooling, endpoint detection and response, threat detection, incident response, and security monitoring.


**WHY ARMOR**
 Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.
   

  

**ARMOR CORE VALUES**
* Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges.
* Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency \+ honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances.
* Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection.
* Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes.
* Follow\-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. The work environment can be either in an office setting or remotely from anywhere.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer** 
 \- it is the policy of the company to comply with all employment laws and to afford equal employment opportunity to individuals in all aspects of employment, including in selection for job opportunities, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.

title: Process Coordinator
description:

 Technical Skills

 Core Competencies

title: Product Engineer for Collateral and Derivatives
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we're saying, keep reading!
   

  

 WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US
   

  

 As a Product Engineer with 10 years of experience, you sit at the intersection of product thinking and engineering execution. You own the full arc of a feature — from understanding the problem, to building a working prototype, shipping and delivering its outcome. You bring both the business knowledge of what to build and the technical depth to ensure it is built well, with a personal stake in quality at every stage
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 Product Value Delivery
   

  

* Translate business goals and user needs into product opportunities with clear value hypotheses.
* Prototype solutions early and often — directly, to validate ideas before committing to full build
* Define scope collaboratively with stakeholders, keeping scope anchored to user value rather than feature count.
* Track and communicate the impact of what ships; deliver outcome, not just the output.


 Engineering Quality
   

  

* Write and review technical requirements and acceptance criteria that leave no ambiguity at implementation time.
* Assess feasibility early and frame build\-vs\-integrate trade\-offs in terms of delivery impact, risk, and value — enabling informed decisions across product and engineering.
* Be the last line of defense on quality: review and test deliverables against requirements, run validation, and hold the bar.
* Identify and highlight technical debt and systemic risks before they become delivery blockers.
* Keep system documentation live and accurate — treated as a product asset, not an afterthought.


 AI\-Enabled Development
   

  

* Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, and others) fluently as part of your everyday working routines.
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated artifacts — verify correctness and architectural fit before accepting.
* Guide your team on responsible AI usage: when to trust it, when to override it, and how to review it carefully
* Identify where AI can accelerate prototyping cycles and reduce low\-value work in the team.


 Team Agile Practices
   

  

* Maintain a healthy, prioritized product backlog — each item sized, scoped, and ready for the team.
* Work closely with software engineers during implementation — unblock, review, and course\-correct in real time
* Be the connective tissue between stakeholders and the delivery team: clear in both directions.


**What We Are Looking For**
 An experienced Product Engineer doesn’t wait for a spec to be handed to them — they shape it. They prototype before they present, validate before build, and measure after ship. They push back on scope that doesn't serve users, and they focus on quality that does. They make the team faster by removing ambiguity, not by adding process.
   

  

**Skills Experience**
* Strong software engineering fundamentals in development and testing disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to move from problem statement to working prototype quickly.
* Experience writing precise technical requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Hands\-on quality assurance: test design, validation, and defect triage.
* Experience working directly with clients or external counterparties.
* Solid grounding in financial instruments — Repos, Derivatives, or related collateral/securities product
* Comfortable running demos, gathering requirements from business users, and translating business workflows into system behaviour.
* Ability to frame engineering decisions in terms of user and business value.
* Comfort working in ambiguity and structuring problems before solving them.
* Strong stakeholder communication — able to translate freely between technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) in a professional context.
* Demonstrated critical evaluation of AI\-generated outputs — not just accepting but interrogating them.
* Understanding of AI limitations relevant to software delivery: hallucination, context loss, security blind spots.
* Agile practitioner: fluent in Scrum ceremonies, backlog management, and iterative delivery.
* Strong documentation habits; treats the knowledge base as part of the product.
* Collaborative by default, decisive when needed.


**Benefits**
* Global hybrid work policy — We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation — Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team, or the organization.
* Self\-Direction — High degree of self\-organization. Each team member has a high degree of freedom to plan, organize, and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work\-life balance — We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment — We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.


 NEXT STEPS
   

  

 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready
   

  

 to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.
   

  

 We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

title: TD- PM Solutions Senior- Non-US
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Transformation Delivery – Senior Consultant**
 The Transformation Delivery practice @ EY provides a rewarding career opportunity, targeted toward becoming a professional in complex business, technology and infrastructure transformation, not simply being a generalist. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in today’s marketplace, come join our dynamic TD\&E team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Our clients are seeking and hiring a new type of Transformation Delivery expert – one who provides strategic guidance but is also deeply embedded in the delivery and success of their programs. Traditional suppliers, such as strategy houses, systems integrators and engineering project management consultants, cannot provide the complete service our clients now demand. Our insights and capabilities across all portfolio levels in planning, analysis and delivery are integrated into our core offerings, and this exemplifies our unique viewpoint over traditional program management. We also offer services that focus on 'bridging the gap’ between execution and strategy primarily by designing and implementing frameworks and solutions that allow companies to make data\-driven decisions to optimize and manage portfolios and programs/projects. With digital transformations being a focus of EY, we have incorporated technology into our processes, automating manual work and enabling us to provide greater insights and value to our clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 A successful Transformation Design and Execution Senior will work with our clients to design and establish Transformation Management Office (TMO), Program Management Office (PMO) or Project Portfolio Management business processes and solutions to manage high profile complex programs by applying proven EY frameworks and methodologies based on industry recognized global standards.
   

  

 You will partner with engagement leadership to design and establish core processes and support a delivery team in planning, controlling, and executing complex programs, PMO’s and Transformation Offices. In your role, you will gain valuable insights and help drive strategic conversations with key stakeholders.
   

  

 You will also work closely with our Technology Solutions team to creatively leverage technology to support processes as part of the overall solution design.
   

  

 Key deliverables that you will work on are:
   

  

* Assessments and Process Design
* Roadmap Development and Execution
* PMO Setup \& Run
* Sustainable Templates and processes
* Dashboards and Automations


**Responsibilities, Skills, And Attributes For Success**
* Active listener, passionate learner with a creative and high\-performance mindset. Committed and driven towards helping and supporting the team in every aspect possible
* Having a successful and proven track record in some or all of below areas:
+ Business analysis
+ Transformation Management, Project Management, Change Management
+ Problem Solving, Design Thinking, root cause assessment
+ Process improvement, business improvement
+ Supporting cross\-functional teams

* Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills as a standard \- problem solving, critical thinking, conceptualizing, communication, leadership, presentation, workshop facilitation, storytelling, etc.
* Flexible, willing to work in hybrid model and open to support time zones
* Strong communication and presentation skills and be able to express yourself effectively, by breaking down complex structures into digestible and relevant points for a diverse set of clients and colleagues, at all levels
* Team player that collaborates well in a group setting to quickly and effectively accomplish tasks
* Flexibility in embracing and adapting to change
* Be able to strive in ambiguous environments and use analytical and creative thinking to find and develop innovative solutions to complex problems.
* Be curious and pay attention to detail, exercise active listening and be to anticipate and identify risks and escalate issues as appropriate
* Foster an innovative and inclusive team\-oriented work environment and demonstrate leadership by playing an active role in counselling and mentoring junior consultants within the organization
* Possess good business acumen and remain current on new developments in consulting capabilities and industry trends
* Demonstrate in\-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge.
* Develop and maintain long\-term client relationships and networks
* Develop and maintain relationships with team members across EY practices to serve client needs
* Cultivate and participate in business development opportunities. Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess/present ways to serve clients.
* Support planning activities for large, complex client programs
* Own tracking activities for key milestones and deliverables to ensure project stays on track according to plan
* Develop key reports and communicate relevant client insights


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree (BE \- B. Tech / MCA) and a minimum of 6\-9 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and a minimum of 4 years of related work experience
* Approximately 6\+ years’ experience on large scale complex programs providing consulting services in at least one of the following areas:

+ PMO maturity assessment, PMO Setup \& Operations
+ Transformation Office design/set up and delivery, Value/Benefit realization
+ End\-to End Portfolio Management implementation – intake and demand management, portfolio prioritization, portfolio selection, financial management
+ End\-to End ERP implementation

* Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills
* Flexible to work in US and UK time zones
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)

* Understanding of Agile concepts

* Experience supporting and participating in pursuit efforts. Experience with the end\-to\-end RFP process (RFP, Response, Proposal, Client Presentation, SOW and Execution) and understanding of client procurement processes

 We look for people who can develop and implement creative solutions to challenging problems and work well with teams to accomplish it. title: Internal Project Coordinator
description:
This role exists to protect one person's time and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll be the right hand to the Operations Head — managing his calendar, capturing what happens in meetings, and making sure every internal and marketing project moves forward without him having to chase it.
 



 This is not just scheduling and note\-taking. You are the person who knows the status of everything, reminds the right people at the right time, and keeps the operation organized while leadership focuses on growth. This is a high\-trust, high\-visibility role — you'll see how a 90\-person company runs from the inside.
 



  





*This role is for someone who enjoys:* 



* Holding the full picture of what's happening across a busy leader's world
* Turning conversations into clear, owned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Following up firmly and politely until things actually get done
* Being trusted with confidential, high\-stakes information



  





 If you're someone who's naturally organized, doesn't let things slip, and wants a front\-row seat to how a growing company operates, this role will suit you well.
 



  





**What you'll really be doing** 




  





**1\. Calendar \& Inbox Management** 



* Own and organize the Operations Head's calendar end to end — schedule, reschedule, resolve conflicts, protect focus time
* Coordinate across time zones, primarily India and US
* Manage email triage: flag what needs attention, draft routine replies, keep the inbox under control



  





**2\. Meeting Support** 



* Attend designated internal, marketing, and leadership meetings to capture minutes, decisions, and action items
* Convert discussions into clear, assigned, time\-bound follow\-ups
* Distribute notes promptly and make sure owners know what they committed to



  





**3\. Internal \& Marketing Project Coordination** 



* Keep all internal and marketing projects organized and current in the project management system
* Track status, deadlines, and blockers across active work
* Follow up with team members on tasks assigned by the Operations Head — proactively, before things slip
* Surface what's overdue or at risk before it becomes a problem



  





**4\. Follow\-Up \& Accountability** 



* Maintain a live view of every open commitment across the team
* Remind people on pending items and close the loop
* Be the system that ensures "I asked someone to do this" actually gets done



  





**Who will thrive in this role** 



* You hold many threads at once without dropping any of them
* You follow up firmly and politely — you don't let things go quiet
* You can work independently from week one with minimal supervision
* You're discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information
* You communicate clearly and confidently with US\-based leadership and partners



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Experience** 



* 4–5 years minimum as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Project Coordinator — experience within an IT services company is a must



  





**Must Have Skills** 



* Strong written and spoken English — you'll be communicating with a US\-based leadership team and US agency partners
* Highly organized, detail\-obsessed, and able to hold many threads at once
* Comfortable following up firmly and politely until things are done
* Able to work independently from week one with minimal supervision
* Discreet and trustworthy with confidential business information



  





**Tools \& Platforms** 



* Notion — documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base
* Google Calendar \& Gmail — scheduling and inbox management
* Slack — internal communication
* Fathom — meeting transcription and notes



*Experience with project management tools is required. Direct experience with this exact stack is a plus, not a dealbreaker.* 




  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience supporting a founder, COO, or senior operations leader
* Exposure to a digital agency or multi\-company setup
* Familiarity with AI tools for productivity — meeting summarization, task tracking, or inbox management



  





**What this role offers** 



* A high\-trust, high\-visibility seat next to leadership
* Direct exposure to how a 90\-person company runs day\-to\-day
* Ownership over the systems that keep the operation from slipping
* Room to grow into broader operations responsibility over time
