title: Java Module Lead
description:
*Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*




*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*




*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*



**Job Description**

  

  





**Module Lead – Java**




**Eurofins IT Solutions, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India**
  

  

  

 With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.
   

  

  

  

 The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building next\-generation applications, LIMS platforms, and enterprise systems. As a Tech Lead – Java, you will play a hands\-on leadership role in designing, developing, and modernizing scalable, high\-performance platforms.
   

  

  

  

 You will drive solution design, architecture decisions, and technical direction, while ensuring delivery excellence. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver robust, secure, and reliable solutions aligned with business goals.
   

  

  

  

 This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges



**Required Skills**



* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns



**Experience**



* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies



**Tech Stack**



* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube



******Additional Information******




**Required Qualifications:**
  

 Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent
   

  

  

  

**Personal Skills:**



* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.



****Additional Information****




**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**



* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* •24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more



**The Location:**




 Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.
   

  





**Why Should You Apply?**



* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.



**Start date: ASAP**




 Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

 Define how complex employee data, permissions, workflows, and product relationships are organised. Help users understand where they are, what requires their attention, and how their actions affect other parts of the platform.

 Work directly with PMs, engineers, and business counterparts; defend design decisions with evidence and trade\-off thinking.
* **Revamp inherited systems.** 
 Improve established workflows that need to support changing customer, product, or regulatory requirements.
* **Design quality and craft standards.** 
 Set the bar for what good UX looks like on the HRIS team, working within the company's established design system.

* **Simplified complex enterprise products.**

* **Built for global, multi\-segment user bases.** 
 You have designed for different user groups, such as administrators, employees, managers, and executives, across multiple markets or compliance environments.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Note:** 
 Hiring for an
 **Antler\-funded startup**

 **next\-generation fashion \& apparel space** 
 .
 



  





**Role: Graphic Designer** 




**Location: Bangalore** 




**Budget: 7 \- 10 LPA** 




  





**About Us** 




 We’re building a Gen\-z
 **fashion brand powered by AI** 
 .
 



 Our mission is to reinvent fashion for a generation that values
 **individuality over trends and self\-expression over mass production** 
 .
 



 We’re building a brand that lives where Gen\-z lives \- Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest and the platforms shaping culture next.
 



 And we’re looking for a designer who doesn’t just make things look good, but understands
 **why they should look that way.** 




  





**The Role** 




 As a
 **Graphic Designer** 
 , you’ll work closely with the founders, creative and marketing teams to build the visual identity of a new generation fashion brand from the ground up.
 



 You’ll work across
 **social media, campaigns, product launches, performance marketing, website, creator collaborations and brand communication** 
 .
 



 This is a hands\-on startup role. You’ll be expected to take an idea from
 **“here’s what we’re thinking” → concept → design → execution** 
 , often with very little hand\-holding.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design creatives for
 **Instagram, social media, digital campaigns and brand communication**
* Develop visual concepts for product launches, campaigns and seasonal collections
* Create
 **static creatives, carousels, social assets, campaign KV and digital banners**
* Work with the content and influencer team to create assets for social platforms
* Translate brand and marketing ideas into compelling visual stories
* Collaborate with founders, marketers, content creators and fashion/design teams
* Maintain consistency across the brand's visual language while constantly evolving it
* Create multiple creative directions and iterate quickly based on feedback and performance
* Work on both
 **brand\-building and performance\-oriented creatives**
* Understand how design changes depending on the objective — whether it's building aspiration, driving clicks, communicating price or selling a product
* Keep up with
 **fashion, Gen\-z aesthetics, social trends, typography, visual culture and emerging design formats**
* Build and maintain a strong visual system as the brand scales



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **2–5 years of experience** 
 in graphic design or visual design
* **Startup experience is a MUST**
* Experience working in
 **fashion, beauty, lifestyle, D2C or consumer brands** 
 is a strong advantage
* Strong portfolio demonstrating
 **real\-world design work** 
 , not just template\-based social media creatives
* Strong command of tools such as
 **Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.**
* Strong understanding of
 **composition, typography, colour, hierarchy and visual storytelling**
* Ability to work quickly and handle multiple projects in a fast\-moving environment
* Strong attention to detail
* Someone who can take feedback without losing the intent behind the design



  





 We Care About Your Thinking, Not Just Your Portfolio
 



 We will look at your portfolio and ask you
 **why you made certain design decisions.** 




  





 For example:
 



**Imagine we have two dresses — one priced at ₹1,999 and another at ₹4,999\.** 




 How would you make the two products feel different visually?
 



 Would you change the typography?
 



 The photography treatment?
 



 The background?
 



 The colour palette?
 



 The amount of whitespace?
 



 The styling?
 



 The messaging?
 



 There isn't necessarily one correct answer.
 **We want to understand your thinking.** 




  





 If you can explain the relationship between
 **design, audience, positioning, price perception and business objective** 
 , you'll do well here.
 



  





**You'll Thrive Here If You...** 



* Think beyond
 **“Does this look nice?”** 
 and ask
 **“What is this design trying to achieve?”**
* Can explain the reasoning behind your creative choices
* Understand that design is both
 **art and communication**
* Have strong visual taste and an even stronger point of view
* Know what works on Instagram without simply copying what's trending
* Can move fast without compromising on quality
* Enjoy working in ambiguity and figuring things out yourself
* Want significant ownership rather than a narrowly defined design role
* Are excited by the opportunity to help shape the visual identity of a brand
 **from Day 1**



  





**Important** 



* **Startup experience is mandatory**
* Candidates with frequent
 **year\-on\-year job changes/hopping** 
 may not be a fit for this role
* **Immediate joiners or candidates with ≤30 days notice period preferred**
* A
 **strong portfolio is mandatory**
* Be prepared to walk us through your portfolio and explain the
 **thinking behind your design decisions**



**If you believe great design isn't just about making something beautiful, but making people feel, understand and act, we'd love to see your work.**

title: Senior Vice President, Product Design
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Vice President, Product Design**
 We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Product Design, Platform, AI Hub to join our team. This role is located in Pune.
   

  

 The way products are built has changed. If you know how an .md file becomes experience design, this role may be for you.
   

  

**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**
* We believe the shifts happening with AI are enabling us to spend more time on what design is actually for: crafting deeply user\-centric experiences with deliberate outcomes. We're changing quickly, and we're doing it on purpose. The person in this role doesn't just adapt to that shift; they help lead it.
* Own platform design strategy. Define and maintain the design vision for a complex platform. Operate from first principles when needed. Bring coherence to experiences that have grown up across many teams and many years.
* Demonstrate before you describe. Use prototyping and rapid concept work to make design strategy tangible. In a world where AI tools can close the gap between intent and working experience, the best design leaders don't wait for resourcing. They show the possibility first.
* Work at the intersection of systems and users. Connect workflows, data, and interaction patterns across the platform. Know when to zoom in on a specific friction point and when to step back and redesign the underlying model.
* Lead design in a cross\-functional environment. Partner with product and engineering as a peer, not as a hand\-off point, but as a co\-creator. Influence product strategy and technical decisions by grounding them in user evidence and design quality.
* Shape a design system built for how design works now. The design system on this team is structured as machine\-readable infrastructure. Tokens carry semantic meaning. Components encode the reasoning behind when and how they apply. AI agents consume it alongside human developers. At the SVP level, you're not just contributing to this grammar, you're shaping how it's defined and ensuring it reflects the quality and intent of the experiences we're building.
* Set a high bar and transfer it. Provide feedback and mentorship that raises the work quality of everyone around you. Cultivate a design culture where rigor, curiosity, and user\-centricity are defaults, not aspirations.
* Communicate design at the executive level. Make the case for design decisions to senior stakeholders. Use visual storytelling to connect design choices to user impact and platform health, not as a presentation exercise, but as a leadership function.


**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**
* Typically 10\+ years of experience designing digital products, with meaningful exposure to complex, enterprise, or regulated systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading design for complex, large\-scale platforms, ideally in regulated, high\-stakes, or enterprise environments.
* Preferred \- You've already incorporated AI\-assisted tools into how you design and prototype, not as a curiosity, but as a working method
* Ability to learn new domains rapidly and design effectively without being a subject\-matter expert before day one.
* Systems\-level thinking: you see the whole experience, not just the screen in front of you.
* Strong design craft alongside strategic design thinking. These aren't separate skills for you.
* Proven track record of influencing product and engineering decisions through design, not around them.
* A portfolio is required, but what we most want to see may not look like a traditional design portfolio. The most compelling thing you can share is evidence of how you create products: working in real partnership with product and engineering, where design isn't a handoff but a shared act of building. Show us a process that reflects how you actually work, not a polished artifact of something you handed off. If you've worked from a shared codebase or unified source of truth with a cross\-functional team, bring that to life. If you've used AI\-assisted tools to demonstrate strategy through working prototypes rather than decks, bring that to life.
* Beyond that, we want to see what you'd expect at this level: platform\-scale thinking, systems that you shaped and why, evidence of design leadership that made work better around you. We care far more about the thinking and the impact than the format or the polish.


**About Us**
 At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting\-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.
   

  

 Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation \& Role:**
 You will be part of the Consumer Experience Engineering organisation responsible for building fast, intuitive, accessible and premium digital experiences across web and mobile. The organisation owns the web \& mobile platforms, engineering delivery for consumer\-facing journeys, shared design systems, performance, accessibility and AI\-native engineering practices that help product teams deliver consistent, reusable, high\-quality consumer experiences across the globe.
   

  

 The Lead Engineer (Web) is responsible for defining frontend architecture, providing technical leadership, and delivering scalable, reliable, accessible, and high\-performing consumer\-facing digital experiences.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of large\-scale consumer\-facing web applications.
* Define frontend engineering standards, architectural principles, reusable patterns, and development best practices.
* Provide technical direction for solutions built using ReactJS, TypeScript, Next.js, and GraphQL.
* Design scalable, modular, maintainable, secure, and reliable frontend application architectures.
* Lead frontend system design and evaluate architectural trade\-offs aligned with business and engineering goals.
* Define API\-first and headless architecture patterns for integrating commerce, content, and enterprise platforms.
* Partner with Product, Design, Architecture, Quality Engineering, and Platform teams to deliver optimized consumer journeys.
* Drive frontend performance engineering with a strong focus on Core Web Vitals and real\-user experience.
* Define strategies for rendering, code splitting, lazy loading, asset optimisation, caching, and bundle management.
* Apply CDN and edge technologies to improve application performance, scalability, and global availability.
* Ensure digital experiences meet WCAG accessibility standards and inclusive design principles.
* Partner with UX and Design teams to develop reusable components and evolve enterprise design systems.
* Support feature flagging, experimentation, A/B testing, and data\-driven optimisation of consumer journeys.


 Mentor frontend engineers and provide technical guidance on architecture, design, coding, testing, and troubleshooting
   

  

**YOUR TALENT:**
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience with significant expertise in frontend application development.
* 3\+ years of experience leading a technical capability, project or engineering team.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js, and GraphQL.
* Deep understanding of browser fundamentals, rendering behaviour, web standards, and frontend application lifecycles.
* Proven expertise in frontend system design, application architecture, and modern engineering patterns.
* Experience designing scalable, modular, reliable, secure, and maintainable frontend applications.
* Strong knowledge of server\-side rendering, static generation, client\-side rendering, and hybrid rendering strategies.
* Strong understanding of application state management, data\-fetching, caching, and synchronisation patterns.
* Experience designing reusable components, shared libraries, and scalable frontend platforms.
* Strong understanding of secure frontend development, authentication, authorization, and consumer data protection.
* Proven experience improving Core Web Vitals, page\-load performance, responsiveness, and runtime efficiency.
* Strong knowledge of CDN, edge computing, browser caching, asset optimisation, and content delivery strategies.
* Strong understanding of consumer journeys, conversion optimisation, personalization, and digital experience quality.
* Practical knowledge of WCAG standards, semantic HTML, keyboard accessibility, and assistive technology compatibility.
* Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flags and A/B testing.
* Strong understanding of design systems, reusable component libraries, responsive design, and UX engineering principles.
* Proven ability to influence architecture and engineering practices across multiple teams without direct authority.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.
* Experience designing or delivering headless and composable commerce solutions is preferred.
* Proven ability to drive architectural decisions, influence technical direction and mentor engineers.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred.


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
   

  

 At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
   

  

 PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**About Maersk**
 As an international business on a high\-tech journey, we don’t just transport millions of tons of cargo. We’re leading a digital revolution in global trade, creating opportunities for millions of customers around the world through new technology, data science, and artificial intelligence.
   

  

 Growing your skills with Maersk means growing global trade and reinventing our industry, creating a digital foundation that moves the world. But it also means creating life\-enhancing prosperity for people and communities through exciting initiatives.
   

  

 We are in the midst of a large\-scale digital transformation journey, and HR technology is a key enabler of this shift. As a
 **Software Engineer** 
 , you will be part of our global people technology team, playing a pivotal role in building scalable, future\-ready solutions that help support Maersk’s people strategy.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Maersk offers a unique opportunity to join a global People Technology team focused on optimising and evolving HR technology solutions. As a Software Engineer, you will work across modules including Recruitment, Compensation, Benefits supporting both frontend and backend technologies such as the Maersk Career Site, Workday ecosystem. Beyond application support and enhancement, you will partner with the People Function as a trusted advisor, translating complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions. The role also drives AI and automation initiatives to streamline HR processes, improve employee experiences, enhance decision\-making, and increase operational efficiency across the HR technology landscape.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and enhance applications across frontend and backend technologies using various programming languages and development tools to support business needs.
* Develop AI\-driven automation solutions by building Generative AI applications, copilots, and autonomous agents that streamline HR operations, enhance employee experiences, and provide intelligent decision support.
* Responsible for the quality design and implementation (supportable, maintainable, scalable, performant, secure) of APIs delivering business value
* Configure, enhance, and support Workday Recruitment, Compensation, and Benefits modules, including business process design, security, eligibility rules, integrations, validations, reporting, and system optimisation to meet evolving business requirements.
* Ensure code quality and adherence to development standards, CI/CD practices, code management strategies, and Workday configuration best practices, maintaining scalable, secure, and supportable solutions.
* Contribute to team capability growth through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and constructive feedback.
* Advisory to Product Owners to identify and manage risks, debt, issues and opportunities for the technical improvement
* Participate in strategic projects implementing new features, enhancements and additional systems.
* Manage change requests by impact assessing, solution design, testing and delivering.
* Perform Day\-to\-day operational tasks on incident management, managing mass loads, supporting HR Operations.
* Work agile in Scrum teams.


**Required Qualifications**
* 4 – 6 years experience in building and supporting applications on .NET stack
* Hands on experience on frontend frameworks: Vue
* Hands\-on experience in developing scalable and robust RESTful APIs, with basic understanding of OAuth2\.0 authentication protocols and OWASP security best practices
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, including micro services architecture, App Services, API Management/Gateways, cloud\-native development, and system integrations.
* Strong DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines (GitHub), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and containerized deployment using Docker
* Any database knowledge: NoSQL, MongoDB
* Good understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI/ML concepts, with hands\-on experience developing LLM\-based solutions, including prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and model fine\-tuning. Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar AI platforms is desirable.
* Knowledge of Cache based system
* Experience with Behaviour\-Driven Development (BDD) and Test\-Driven Development (TDD) practices, including developing effective unit and integration test cases using appropriate testing frameworks
* Good understanding of UX \& UI principles and should be able to apply them while building solutions.
* Experience with Workday, with expertise in one or more of the following modules: Core HCM, Recruitment, Compensation, or Benefits. Participation in a Workday implementation or transformation project is a strong advantage.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Practical experience working in Agile Scrum teams and sprint\-based delivery environments.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate HR functional needs into technical requirements


 Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
   

  

 We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Graphic designer
description:
**Company Description**
 Prometteur is a leading global systems integrator and business transformation consulting organisation. Prometteur helps companies innovate and transform by leveraging its unique insights, differentiated services, and flexible partnering models. The company is among the Top mobile application development companies in India, and also a pioneer in web application development and Automation Testing. Prometteur has gained the trust of more than 300 offshore clients from 30\+ countries worldwide and has become a trustworthy software partner.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About Prometteur**
**Prometteur is a people\-centric global technology and business transformation company that believes in innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We provide employees with opportunities to work on cutting\-edge mobile, web, and automation technologies for clients across 30\+ countries. With a supportive and growth\-driven work culture, we encourage creativity, skill development, and career progression. Trusted by 300\+ global clients, Prometteur offers a dynamic environment where employees can build impactful digital solutions and grow professionally.**
**Job Title**
**Graphic Designer**
**Experience: 3\+ Years**
**Employment Type: Full\-time**
**About The Role**
**We are looking for a highly creative and visually driven Graphic Designer who can turn ideas, problems and business requirements into compelling visual solutions.**
**Who can think creatively, understand the problem behind a brief, explore different possibilities and deliver a strong final outcome.**
**The ideal candidate combines strong visual design, creative thinking, visual storytelling and UX/design thinking. They should be comfortable working across different types of creative challenges and should have the judgement to decide what visual approach, format and tool is best for the problem at hand.**
**We care more about the quality of your thinking and the final outcome**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**What You'll Do**
**Creative \& Concept Development**
* Translate briefs, ideas, business objectives, and abstract concepts into strong visual directions.
* Develop original creative concepts rather than simply following existing design patterns.
* Explore multiple visual approaches and identify the strongest direction for a given problem.
* Create compelling visual storytelling through composition, typography, imagery, colour, motion, and other visual elements.
* Bring fresh ideas and creative perspectives to projects across brand, product, marketing, and digital communication.
* Challenge conventional approaches when a better creative solution exists.


**Visual \& Experience Design**
* Create high\-quality visual assets across digital and brand touchpoints.
* Apply strong principles of typography, composition, hierarchy, colour, spacing, imagery, and visual balance.
* Consider the audience, context, purpose, and user behaviour behind every design decision.
* Apply UX thinking to ensure that designs are not only visually strong but also clear, intuitive, and effective.
* Collaborate with UX, product, marketing, content, and development teams where required.
* Adapt creative concepts across different formats and platforms without losing their core idea or quality.


**Ownership \& Execution**
* Take ownership of projects from initial idea through final delivery.
* Present and explain creative decisions clearly.
* Respond to feedback without losing the core creative intent.
* Manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining a high standard of creative quality.
* Maintain attention to detail across final deliverables.
* Continuously experiment with new creative approaches, technologies, and workflows.


**Tools \& Workflow**
**We are tool\-agnostic.**
**We do not require strong proficiency in any particular design software.**
**You may use Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Affinity, Procreate, After Effects, AI tools, or any other tools you are comfortable with.**
**What matters to us is:**
**Your thinking → Your creative direction → Your execution → The final outcome.**
**The ability to learn and adapt to new tools is more important than expertise in a specific software.**
**AI \& Emerging Creative Tools**
* Use AI and emerging creative technologies where they can improve ideation, exploration, experimentation, or productivity.
* Know how to combine AI\-assisted workflows with human creative judgement.
* Maintain originality, quality, brand consistency, and design intent when using AI.
* Be willing to experiment with new creative technologies and workflows.


**Portfolio**
**A strong portfolio is mandatory.**
**We are particularly interested in portfolios that demonstrate:**
* Strong creative concepts
* Original visual thinking
* Visual storytelling
* Branding and identity
* Digital experiences
* UX/design thinking
* Campaign or communication design
* Ability to solve different kinds of creative problems
* Strong attention to detail and quality of execution


**We want to understand how you think, not just how polished your final designs look.**
**Qualification**
* 3\+ years of professional experience in graphic/visual design or a related creative role.
* Degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon \- WeWork, Cybercity (in\-person, 6 days)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Founding team
 



**Compensation:** 
 ₹15 LPA \+ meaningful equity (0\.5–2%)
 



  





**About Switch** 




 Businesses in India lose money every day someone doesn't show up. A restaurant short two waiters on a Friday night, a warehouse missing four loaders before a festive spike, a store with no one to run the counter \- the current fix is a WhatsApp group, an agency that takes a cut and disappears, or the owner working the floor themselves.
 



 Switch is building the layer that fixes this. Shops, restaurants, warehouses, offices, and event venues book Aadhaar\-verified staff \- helpers, guards, cooks, drivers, riders, housekeeping, event crew \- in three taps, often deployed the same day. No advance, replacement guaranteed, clean invoices. On the other side, we give workers real, repeat, dignified income instead of standing at a labour chowk hoping for a day's work.
 



 We're live in Gurgaon, running real shifts for real businesses. We're small, pre\-seed, and moving fast.
 



  





**The role** 




 You'd be our first engineer. Not the first engineer on a team \- the engineering team.
 



 Today a lot of Switch runs on human effort: matching, confirmations, replacements, and support all lean on the ops team and WhatsApp. That's the right way to start and the wrong way to scale. Your job is to turn what ops does by hand into software that does it in seconds, and to build the product surface \- worker app, business app, internal tools \- that lets us go from one city to many.
 



 You will write the code, choose the stack, ship it, and be on the hook when it breaks at 9pm on a Saturday during someone's dinner rush. In return you get real ownership of the technical direction and a front\-row seat to everything else: pricing, ops, hiring, fundraising.
 



  





**What you'll actually build (first 6 months)** 



* Matching engine. Turn a booking into the right worker — availability, location, skill, reliability history, price \- fast enough that "same day" becomes "same hour."
* Worker app. Shift discovery, one\-tap accept, check\-in/check\-out with geofencing, attendance proof, payouts and earnings history.
* Business app \+ web. Booking flow, live shift status, replacements, subscription management, GST\-clean invoicing.
* Ops console. The internal tool that lets one ops person run what currently takes three \- exception queues, no\-show detection and auto\-replacement, escalations.
* Payments and payouts. Collections, worker payouts, reconciliation, refunds \- via UPI and standard PGs.
* Trust infrastructure. Aadhaar/KYC verification flows, background\-check pipeline, ratings, fraud and proxy\-attendance detection.



  





**You're probably a fit if you** 



* Have 2\-6 years shipping production software, and can point at systems you built end\-to\-end \- schema through UI \- that real users depended on.
* Are genuinely full\-stack: comfortable in a backend language and framework of your choice, a modern frontend, a mobile framework (React Native / Flutter / native), SQL, and enough AWS/GCP to run it all without a DevOps hire.
* Have built for scrappy, real\-world conditions: flaky networks, ₹8,000 Android phones, users who won't read instructions, workflows that live in Hindi and WhatsApp.
* Ship fast and ruthlessly scope. You know which corners are safe to cut at pre\-seed and which ones will burn you.
* Will sit with an ops teammate for an afternoon, watch them do a job manually, and go build the thing that deletes it.
* Want to be in the room. This is an in\-person role \- the speed comes from the whiteboard, the desk next to you, and the field visits.



  





**Nice to have, not required** 



* Marketplace, gig\-economy, logistics, or on\-demand experience (Zomato/Swiggy/Urban Company/Rapido/Porter\-shaped problems).
* Payments, UPI, KYC, or fintech integration work.
* Blue\-collar or Bharat\-focused products; vernacular UX.
* You've been early at a startup before and know what year one really feels like.



 The honest part
 



 Pre\-seed means uncertainty. Some of what you build will be thrown away. You'll do things that aren't engineering \- sit in on sales calls, go to a client's warehouse at 7am, help onboard workers. There is no platform team, no on\-call rotation, no one to hand a bug to. Runway is finite and the equity is a bet, not a guarantee.
 



 If that reads as a warning, this isn't your role. If it reads as the interesting part, keep going.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Competitive cash for a pre\-seed startup, plus founding\-level equity.
* Full technical ownership \- stack, architecture, hiring the team under you.
* Direct work with the founders, no layers.
* Health insurance and a laptop of your choosing.
* A product where you can watch the impact the same week you ship it \- in shifts filled, and in what a worker took home.



  





**How to apply** 




 Email hr@switchlocally.com with the subject "Founding Engineer" and include:
 


1. Your GitHub, portfolio, or the most interesting thing you've shipped \- and what your specific contribution was.
2. A short answer: You have one week and no data science team. How would you decide which worker to send to a booking? A paragraph is plenty. We care about how you think, not the right answer.
3. Anything you've built that people outside your company actually used.



 We move fast: intro call, a paid take\-home or a day working with us on a real problem, founder conversation, offer. Typically under two weeks.

title: User Experience Designer
description:
**Role:** 
 UX Designer
 



**Function:** 
 Product Design / UX
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, India (In\-office)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 AI, Medical SaaS, Dental Technology
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company builds medical AI SaaS for the U.S. dental market.
 



 Its all\-in\-one platform serves thousands of dental practices with analytics, scheduling, communications, payments, and marketing automation. It was founded in 2015 by a practicing dentist, a data strategist, and a PhD technologist.
 



 The team is mission\-driven, execution\-oriented, and moves fast to ship real value.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 This is a hands\-on individual contributor role owning end\-to\-end product design — from problem framing and user flows through to high\-fidelity UI and developer handoff. You'll be the design presence in Gurugram, embedded with local PMs and engineers, and reporting to the Senior Designer in the US. The work spans a complex, multi\-tenant platform used by dentists, front\-desk staff, and office managers who need to complete tasks in seconds under real\-time pressure.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Translate product requirements and user problems into flows, information architecture, wireframes, and high\-fidelity UI in Figma — covering web, responsive web, mobile, and kiosk surfaces including empty, loading, error, and permission states
* Prototype interactions to validate and communicate intent before engineering begins; redesign and incrementally improve existing screens as a core part of the workload
* Talk to internal stakeholders (CX, support, sales) and end users to understand workflows before designing them; run lightweight usability tests and use findings to change designs, not justify them
* Use product analytics and support tickets as active inputs to design decisions
* Work within and contribute to the design system — components, patterns, tokens — and produce clear handoff specs covering states, responsive behaviour, edge cases, and interaction details
* Review built implementations against designs and close gaps directly with engineering; apply accessibility fundamentals including contrast, hierarchy, keyboard navigation, and touch targets
* Partner with Product Management from problem statement onward, surface edge cases early, and present design decisions with clear reasoning to distributed US and India teams



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 2\+ years of core UX design experience at an internet or software product company (B2B/B2C SaaS, consumer internet, or product\-led platform)
* Portfolio with 2–3 case studies showing the problem, process, decisions made, and shipped outcome — applications without a portfolio will not be considered
* Strong command of Figma — components, variants, auto layout, prototyping, and shared libraries
* Demonstrated ability to design data\-dense screens: tables, dashboards, filters, and settings
* Experience designing within an existing design system rather than inventing per screen
* Ability to communicate design decisions clearly in written and verbal English to US\-based stakeholders
* Willingness to work in\-office in Gurugram with overlap into US hours (until 9–11 PM IST) as needed



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Formal design education — B.Des / M.Des in Interaction, Communication, or Product Design, or HCI
* B2B SaaS or multi\-tenant product experience; healthcare, fintech, or other regulated\-domain products
* Experience with conversational or voice interface design
* Contributed to building or maintaining a design system
* Working knowledge of HTML/CSS sufficient to assess implementation cost; exposure to AI\-assisted design tooling



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end design ownership across a complex, widely\-used platform — web, mobile, and kiosk
* Direct collaboration with US\-based Senior Designer and cross\-functional teams, with high visibility into product decisions
* Fast release cadence (two releases per month) with real, measurable impact on how dental practices operate
* Autonomy and flexible scheduling within a mission\-driven, execution\-oriented team

title: Sr. Brand Designer
description:
**About Leena AI**
 Leena AI is the world's largest independent employee\-facing Agentic AI company. Our platform lets employees get answers and get work done across every business system through a single conversation — cutting IT, HR, and finance ticket volume by around 70% at the enterprises that deploy us.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and headquartered in New York, we serve 500\+ customers across 90\+ countries — including Nestlé, MongoDB, Coca\-Cola, and Etihad Airways — with 200\+ integrations and support for 100\+ languages. We've raised $40M\+ from Greycroft, Bessemer Venture Partners, B Capital, and Y Combinator.
   

  

**The role**
 We're adding a second senior voice to our design team. You'll work alongside our Principal Graphic Designer, who sets the overall standard, and take real ownership of the work that shouldn't have to wait for his review — with the authority to direct it, unblock other designers on it, and hold the quality bar yourself.
   

  

 Roughly 70% of this role is static design and 30% is motion and video. Your primary charter within the static work is digital and paid marketing creative — LinkedIn ads above all, which you'll own outright — plus website design, sales enablement assets, and campaign systems. The motion work runs two ways: minor pieces you build yourself in After Effects and Premiere Pro, and major pieces our motion designers build that you art\-direct and elevate.
   

  

 We also want you to bring an aesthetic we don't already have. If you join and simply match our existing style, we've hired the wrong person. We're looking for a sharply current point of view and someone who will argue for pulling our work forward.
   

  

**What you'll own: Digital and paid marketing creative — your primary charter**
* Own LinkedIn ad creative end to end — static, carousel, document, and video ads, at the volume paid social actually demands.
* Partner with performance marketing on creative testing: hypotheses, variant systems, and reading what the numbers say is working.
* Design landing pages, display, email, and organic social so a campaign holds together from first impression to conversion.
* Bring craft to a discipline that usually doesn't get it. Most B2B paid creative is ugly. Ours shouldn't be.


**Website**
* Design new pages and sections of leena.ai — hero moments, product pages, feature modules, campaign landing pages — thinking in components and breakpoints, not artboards.
* Produce web\-ready assets: product imagery, illustrations, animated GIFs, UI mockups. Hand off cleanly to whoever builds it.


**Brand, sales, and campaign collateral**
* Design the docs that carry our biggest deals: sales narratives, pitch decks, executive presentations.
* Produce high\-craft reports, whitepapers, eBooks, case studies, and one\-pagers for print and digital, plus event and booth collateral.
* Translate abstract product concepts — agents, workflows, integrations — into visuals an enterprise CHRO or CIO understands immediately, without glowing\-brain AI clichés.


**Motion and video**
* Hands\-on: short\-form motion in After Effects — product feature animations, explainers, social cutdowns, UI motion, kinetic type, GIFs. Editing webinars, customer interviews, and event recaps in Premiere Pro, including pacing, captions, color, and audio cleanup.
* Directorial: art\-direct our motion designers upstream of the animation — storyboards, frame design, review — so what they ship looks gorgeous, not merely finished.
* Maintain reusable intros, outros, lower thirds, and title systems so every video looks like it came from the same company.


**Craft, systems, and speed**
* Be the go\-to reviewer when the Principal Designer is heads\-down — clear, useful, unsentimental feedback. Help other designers get to what they were trying to make rather than taking the work off them.
* Build template and component libraries in Figma and After Effects so recurring work gets faster and stays consistent.
* Bring judgment about what deserves a bespoke design, what should be templated, and what shouldn't be made at all.


**How We Work With AI**
 Leena AI is an AI\-first company, and that applies to how we make things, not just what we sell. We use AI research, rethink and re\-strategize, and to compress everything repeatable — resizing and ad variants, background cleanup, rotoscoping, transcription and captioning, first\-pass storyboards, asset versioning — so human hours go into concept, taste, and craft. The parts only a person can do.
   

  

 We expect you to be fluent here and to keep getting more fluent. Designers who use these tools well ship several times more work at a higher standard. Designers who avoid them will struggle here — and so will designers who let AI output ship when it only looks finished. We want both: the speed and the judgment to know when it isn't good enough.
   

  

**What We're Looking For Non\-negotiable**
* Deep, fluent Figma. Not "I can use Figma." Components, variants, auto\-layout, design systems, and libraries other people can build on. This is where the team lives; there's no version of this role where you're slow in it.
* Exceptional, current taste. Well\-composed, well\-typeset, restrained, and unmistakably of this moment. Our highest\-weighted criterion, judged from your portfolio and not your résumé.


**Requirements**
**Must\-haves**
* 4\-6 years of professional design experience, with meaningful time in\-house or at an agency serving B2B or technology clients.
* Real paid\-social and digital ad experience. You've designed ads that ran, at volume, and you understand how creative behaves in a feed.
* Advanced Adobe Creative Suite — Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign.
* Working proficiency in After Effects — you can independently take a concept from storyboard to a finished 30\-90 second piece with confident timing and easing.
* Working proficiency in Premiere Pro — 60 minutes of raw webinar footage into a tight, captioned, well\-paced edit without help.
* Web design capability — you've designed responsive pages, not just static comps.
* Presentation design as a genuine skill — you can take a dense, unstructured narrative and make it land visually.
* Active AI fluency — generative and AI\-assisted tools are already part of how you work, and you can tell shippable output from output that merely looks finished.
* The temperament to give and take feedback well. You'll review peers' work without authority over them, which takes more tact than managing does.
* Speed with judgment — several projects at once, a clear sense of a two\-hour job versus a two\-day job, dates hit without negotiating away quality.
* Clear communication in American English — you take written direction well and defend a design decision with a reason, not a preference.


**Nice to have**
* Experience marketing to enterprise HR, IT, finance, or procurement buyers.
* Illustration or 3D chops (Blender, Spline, Rive). Comfort in Webflow or a similar CMS. Sound design instincts for video.


**Not screened for**
 We don't require a specific degree. Design, animation, and fine arts backgrounds are welcome, and so is a self\-taught one. Your portfolio decides this.
   

  

**Your portfolio**
 Required — applications without one won't be reviewed. Send a link (website, PDF, Behance, or Dribbble; include a password if gated). Make it easy for us to say yes by including:
   

  

* Paid social or digital ad work, ideally a set of variants, so we can see how you hold quality across volume.
* One full presentation or long\-form document you designed end to end — not just the cover slide.
* Two motion pieces you animated yourself in After Effects, and one video you edited.
* One piece of web or brand work shown across multiple surfaces.
* A sentence or two per project: what the brief was, what you decided, and why.


**How We'll Evaluate**
**Portfolio screen — we review your work before any call.Craft conversation with the hiring manager — 45 minutes through two or three projects in depth.Design exercise — a real, scoped brief covering both static and motion, roughly a week to complete.Exercise review with the Principal Designer and marketing team — 60 minutes presenting and pressure\-testing your thinking.Leadership conversation and offer.**
 We aim to close in two to three weeks and to give you a clear answer either way.
   

  

**Details**
* Location: Gurugram, India — 5 days in\-office with the marketing and design team.
* Hours: Full\-time, with some overlap with US time zones given our customer and leadership base.
* Compensation: Competitive and benchmarked to senior design talent in the market; we'll discuss range on the first call.


 Leena AI is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants on craft and capability, and we welcome candidates from every background.
   

  

**Benefits**
**What We Offer:**
* Competitive compensation
* Opportunity to work in a fast\-growing, global enterprise Agentic AI platform
* Continuous learning and development opportunities
* Collaborative and inclusive company culture.

title: Design Technologist, eShop
description:
**Description**
 Help shape the future of AI\-powered creative production at Amazon. As a GenAI Design Technologist, you will pioneer the intersection of Generative AI and creative production \- shipping tools and workflows that transform how product images and videos are created at scale.
   

  

 We are operationalizing Generative AI for visual content creation. This team partners with world\-class artists and scientists to push what's possible with image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal AI systems. You will work at the rare intersection where creative craft meets technical depth.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop, optimize, and scale Generative AI workflows and pipelines for production\-grade visual content
* Act as the bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering \- translating artistic intent into scalable technical solutions
* Build automation that removes bottlenecks and enables content creators to focus on what they do best
* Evaluate emerging foundational models and translate the latest research breakthroughs into production\-ready capabilities
* Partner with engineers and scientists on prompt engineering frameworks and centralized GenAI tooling


 This role is ideal for someone who's equal parts technologist and creative problem solver \- someone who can evaluate output quality with a trained eye while optimizing the pipeline that produces it. You will ship work that directly impacts the shopping experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop, test, and optimize Generative AI workflows and pipelines for visual content production using inference platforms and services
* Act as a bridge between creative teams and AI/ML engineering \- translating production needs into technical requirements and delivering working solutions
* Build and maintain automation scripts and tools that resolve workflow bottlenecks, improve content quality, and increase creator productivity
* Evaluate AI\-generated output for visual quality, brand consistency, and production readiness \- applying both technical metrics and creative judgment
* Support the fine\-tuning, testing, and evaluation of foundational models and LLMs for image generation, video synthesis, and multimodal content creation
* Design and implement prompt engineering frameworks that enable consistent, high\-quality results at scale across content types
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists to contribute to a centralized suite of GenAI tools used across visual content workflows
* Research and prototype emerging Generative AI capabilities \- assessing production viability and recommending adoption paths to creative leadership
* Develop batch processing solutions and content pipelines that enable teams to generate, review, and publish AI\-created assets efficiently
* Document workflows, best practices, and technical specifications to enable partner teams to adopt generative workflows independently
* Participate in cross\-functional reviews to align AI tooling development with evolving creative standards and business requirements


 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, you will move between creative and technical work. You might review AI\-generated image outputs \-tuning prompts and parameters to improve quality and consistency. Then shift to prototyping a workflow with a creative lead and ML engineer, translating a creative brief into a scalable technical solution. You could also be evaluating a new foundational model for production readiness or helping a partner team adopt your automation pipeline. Throughout it all, you will collaborate closely with creative directors, applied scientists, and content producers \- solving the gap between what AI can technically generate and what meets the visual quality bar at scale.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team builds how hundreds of millions of customers see products \- through photography, video, CGI, and increasingly through Generative AI. We are a global network of creatives, technologists, and scientists unified by one mission: make every product look its best, at extraordinary scale. Our culture values builders who are curious, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. We ship fast, learn from what breaks, and believe the best creative work happens when art and technology push each other forward.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science or equivalent
* 3\+ years of experience in front\-end technology, engineering, or UX prototyping
* Coding samples in front\-end programming languages
* Available online portfolio demonstrating relevant work
* Experience with web, mobile web, or mobile app front\-end development
* Experience with UI design for complex workflows and for end users
* Experience building scripts, tooling, and automation for large\-scale computing environments
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques for content generation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of technologies such as JavaScript/Node.js, HTML/CSS, Responsive/Adaptive Design
* Knowledge of Python, JavaScript, and source control (Git)
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team
* Knowledge of video production, live streaming technologies, studio workflows, edit and post\-production techniques, production calendars and staffing

title: Product Engineer for Collateral and Derivatives
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
 Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
   

  

 At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
   

  

 If you like what we're saying, keep reading!
   

  

 WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US
   

  

 As a Product Engineer with 10 years of experience, you sit at the intersection of product thinking and engineering execution. You own the full arc of a feature — from understanding the problem, to building a working prototype, shipping and delivering its outcome. You bring both the business knowledge of what to build and the technical depth to ensure it is built well, with a personal stake in quality at every stage
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 Product Value Delivery
   

  

* Translate business goals and user needs into product opportunities with clear value hypotheses.
* Prototype solutions early and often — directly, to validate ideas before committing to full build
* Define scope collaboratively with stakeholders, keeping scope anchored to user value rather than feature count.
* Track and communicate the impact of what ships; deliver outcome, not just the output.


 Engineering Quality
   

  

* Write and review technical requirements and acceptance criteria that leave no ambiguity at implementation time.
* Assess feasibility early and frame build\-vs\-integrate trade\-offs in terms of delivery impact, risk, and value — enabling informed decisions across product and engineering.
* Be the last line of defense on quality: review and test deliverables against requirements, run validation, and hold the bar.
* Identify and highlight technical debt and systemic risks before they become delivery blockers.
* Keep system documentation live and accurate — treated as a product asset, not an afterthought.


 AI\-Enabled Development
   

  

* Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, and others) fluently as part of your everyday working routines.
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated artifacts — verify correctness and architectural fit before accepting.
* Guide your team on responsible AI usage: when to trust it, when to override it, and how to review it carefully
* Identify where AI can accelerate prototyping cycles and reduce low\-value work in the team.


 Team Agile Practices
   

  

* Maintain a healthy, prioritized product backlog — each item sized, scoped, and ready for the team.
* Work closely with software engineers during implementation — unblock, review, and course\-correct in real time
* Be the connective tissue between stakeholders and the delivery team: clear in both directions.


**What We Are Looking For**
 An experienced Product Engineer doesn’t wait for a spec to be handed to them — they shape it. They prototype before they present, validate before build, and measure after ship. They push back on scope that doesn't serve users, and they focus on quality that does. They make the team faster by removing ambiguity, not by adding process.
   

  

**Skills Experience**
* Strong software engineering fundamentals in development and testing disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to move from problem statement to working prototype quickly.
* Experience writing precise technical requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Hands\-on quality assurance: test design, validation, and defect triage.
* Experience working directly with clients or external counterparties.
* Solid grounding in financial instruments — Repos, Derivatives, or related collateral/securities product
* Comfortable running demos, gathering requirements from business users, and translating business workflows into system behaviour.
* Ability to frame engineering decisions in terms of user and business value.
* Comfort working in ambiguity and structuring problems before solving them.
* Strong stakeholder communication — able to translate freely between technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Regular use of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) in a professional context.
* Demonstrated critical evaluation of AI\-generated outputs — not just accepting but interrogating them.
* Understanding of AI limitations relevant to software delivery: hallucination, context loss, security blind spots.
* Agile practitioner: fluent in Scrum ceremonies, backlog management, and iterative delivery.
* Strong documentation habits; treats the knowledge base as part of the product.
* Collaborative by default, decisive when needed.


**Benefits**
* Global hybrid work policy — We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation — Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team, or the organization.
* Self\-Direction — High degree of self\-organization. Each team member has a high degree of freedom to plan, organize, and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work\-life balance — We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment — We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.


 NEXT STEPS
   

  

 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
   

  

 If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready
   

  

 to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
   

  

 We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
   

  

 SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.
   

  

 SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.
   

  

 We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Delhi Public School Dwarka Expressway, Gurugram
 




  






 About the Role
 




  






 Delhi Public School Dwarka Expressway is looking for a creative, detail\-oriented, and experienced Senior Graphic Designer to lead and execute high\-quality visual communication across the school’s digital and offline platforms.
 




  






 The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of visual storytelling, branding, social media design, campaign creatives, and institutional communication, along with the ability to translate ideas and content into compelling visual experiences.
 




  






 Key Responsibilities
 




  






 Creative \& Visual Communication
 




  






 \- Develop creative concepts and visual identities for school campaigns, events, celebrations, and initiatives.
 





 \- Design engaging creatives for social media, digital campaigns, websites, presentations, newsletters, brochures, posters, standees, certificates, and print collateral.
 





 \- Create visually compelling communication for admissions, academics, student achievements, events, and school initiatives.
 





 \- Develop carousel posts, reels covers, stories, banners, infographics, and other digital assets.
 





 \- Maintain consistency across all school communication while ensuring designs remain fresh and contemporary.
 




  






 Branding \& Design Systems
 




  






 \- Ensure adherence to the school’s visual identity, brand guidelines, typography, colour palette, and overall design language.
 





 \- Develop templates and reusable design systems to improve consistency and efficiency.
 





 \- Work closely with the communications and leadership teams to maintain a cohesive brand presence across platforms.
 




  






 Campaign \& Event Design
 




  






 \- Conceptualise and execute creative campaigns for admissions, school events, festivals, awareness days, parent engagement initiatives, and institutional announcements.
 





 \- Design event\-specific collateral including invitations, backdrops, digital screens, certificates, brochures, and promotional material.
 





 \- Translate campaign objectives into strong visual concepts that connect with parents, students, educators, and the wider school community.
 




  






 Photography \& Visual Content
 




  






 \- Collaborate with photographers, videographers, content writers, and social media teams to create cohesive visual campaigns.
 





 \- Provide creative direction for photoshoots and image\-based campaigns when required.
 





 \- Select, retouch, colour\-correct, and prepare images for digital and print use.
 





 \- Use AI\-assisted creative tools where appropriate to develop concepts, visual references, and production\-ready assets.
 




  






 Team \& Project Management
 




  






 \- Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality.
 





 \- Review and guide the work of junior designers or external creative partners.
 





 \- Coordinate with internal stakeholders to understand briefs, gather feedback, and deliver final creatives.
 





 \- Take ownership of projects from concept development to final execution.
 




  






 Required Skills
 




  






 \- Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
 





 \- Working knowledge of Figma, Canva, After Effects, Premiere Pro, or similar tools is an advantage.
 





 \- Strong understanding of typography, composition, colour theory, visual hierarchy, and layout.
 





 \- Excellent knowledge of social media design and current visual trends.
 





 \- Ability to create both digital and print\-ready artwork.
 





 \- Strong image editing and photo\-retouching skills.
 





 \- Good understanding of branding and visual communication.
 





 \- Ability to develop original concepts rather than relying solely on templates.
 





 \- Familiarity with AI\-based creative and design tools is desirable.
 




  






 What We’re Looking For
 




  






 \- 4–7 years of relevant graphic design experience, preferably in an education, media, advertising, branding, or creative environment.
 





 \- A strong and diverse portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking and execution quality.
 





 \- Excellent attention to detail and a strong sense of aesthetics.
 





 \- Ability to understand briefs and independently convert ideas into visual concepts.
 





 \- Strong communication and collaboration skills.
 





 \- Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.
 





 \- A proactive mindset with the ability to suggest creative improvements rather than simply execute instructions.
 





 \- Experience in creating communication for schools, institutions, brands, or premium organisations will be an advantage.
 




  






 Key Attributes
 




  






 Creative Thinking \| Visual Storytelling \| Attention to Detail \| Brand Sensibility \| Ownership \| Collaboration \| Adaptability \| Deadline Management
 




  






 Why Join Us?
 




  






 \- Opportunity to shape the visual identity of a growing educational institution.
 





 \- Work across diverse creative formats, campaigns, events, and digital platforms.
 





 \- Collaborate with educators, leadership, communications, and creative teams.
 





 \- Opportunity to experiment with contemporary design trends and emerging creative technologies.
 




  






 Application
 




  






 Interested candidates are invited to share their updated CV and portfolio showcasing relevant design work.
 




  






 Position: Senior Graphic Designer
 





 Organisation : Delhi Public School Dwarka Expressway, Gurugram
 





 Experience: 4–7 Years
 





 Location: Gurugram, Haryana
