title: Sharepoint Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Power Apps \& SQL , Altreyx**
**Position Details**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team’s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY’s core Assurance practice, you’ll develop a deep Audit related technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.
   

  

 Ever\-increasing regulations require audit departments to gather, organize and analyses more data than ever before. Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever\-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. Effectively and efficiently handling the variety and volume of data is often extremely challenging and time consuming for a company.
   

  

 EY's GDS Assurance Digital team members work side\-by\-side with the firm's partners, clients and audit technical subject matter experts to develop and incorporate technology solutions that enhance value\-add, improve efficiencies and enable our clients with disruptive and market leading tools supporting Assurance.
   

  

 GDS Assurance Digital provides solution architecture, application development, testing and maintenance support to the global Assurance service line both on a pro\-active basis and in response to specific requests.
   

  

**Requirements (including Experience, Skills And Additional Qualifications)**
* A bachelor’s degree (BE/BTech/MCA \& MBA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Accounting, Finance or a related field with adequate industry experience.


**Technical Skills Requirements**
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in SharePoint development, including experience with SharePoint Online and SPFx.
* Strong experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, and the broader Power Platform.
* Proficiency in web development technologies, including React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Design and develop robust, scalable Power Apps and SharePoint Online solutions using the SharePoint Framework (SPFx) and other modern development practices.
* Lead the technical design sessions, architecting solutions that fulfill business requirements while aligning with EY's technology standards and best practices.
* Develop custom web parts, extensions, and applications using SPFx, React, TypeScript, and other modern web technologies.
* Implement complex workflows and business processes using Power Automate and integrate them with Power Apps and SharePoint Online.
* Ensure seamless integration of Power Apps and SharePoint solutions with other Microsoft 365 services and third\-party systems.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide expert guidance and support to project teams, stakeholders, and end\-users, including documentation, training, and troubleshooting.
* Stay abreast of the latest developments in Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and SharePoint technologies to drive innovation and thought leadership within EY.
* Experience with Azure services, REST APIs, and external data sources integration.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Microsoft certifications in Power Platform and/or SharePoint.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph API.
* Knowledge of SharePoint PnP (Patterns and Practices).
* Prior consulting experience or experience working in a professional services firm.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
* An ability to quickly understand complex concepts and use technology to support data modeling, analysis, visualization or process automation
* Selects appropriately from applicable standards, methods, tools and applications and uses accordingly
* Ability to work within a multi\-disciplinary team structure, but also independently
* Demonstrates analytical and systematic approach to problem solving
* Communicates fluently orally and in writing and can present complex technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Able to plan, schedule and monitor work activities in order to meet time and quality targets
* Able to absorb rapidly new technical information, business acumen, and apply it effectively
* Ability to work in a team environment with strong customer focus, good listening, negotiation and problem\-resolution skills


**Additional skills requirements:**
* The expectations are that a Senior will be able to maintain long\-term client relationships and network and cultivate business development opportunities
* Provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing engagement manager of engagement status, and managing staff performance.
* Must have presentation skills ' ability to create PowerPoint deck to communicate solution architecture to various stakeholders.
* Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices
* Excellent business communication, Consulting, Quality process skills
* Must be a team player


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Job type: Full time (Onsite)** 




**Experience: 3\-5 years** 




  





**Roles \& responsibilities** 




 A Senior Graphic Designer is a skilled professional responsible for leading and executing the visual design of various projects, ensuring they align with brand guidelines, convey the desired message, and meet high standards of quality. This role typically involves both creative leadership and hands\-on design work. Here are the key roles and responsibilities typically associated with a Senior Graphic Designer
 



  





**Key Roles and Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Creative Direction and Strategy** 




**Visual Conceptualization:** 
 Develop and execute creative concepts and visual designs that align with project objectives and brand identity.
 



**Design Strategy:** 
 Collaborate with stakeholders to develop design strategies that support marketing, communication, and business goals.
 



  





**2\. Design Execution** 




**Graphic Design:** 
 Create compelling visual materials, including but not limited to logos, marketing collateral, brochures, infographics, digital and print advertisements, social media assets, and presentations.
 



**Typography and Layout:** 
 Ensure effective use of typography, layout, and color theory to enhance visual appeal and readability.
 



  





**3\. Project Management** 




**Project Oversight:** 
 Manage multiple projects from concept through completion, ensuring deadlines and budget constraints are met.
 



**Client Interaction:** 
 Communicate with clients to understand their requirements, present design concepts, and incorporate feedback to achieve client satisfaction.
 



  





**4\. Team Leadership and Collaboration** 




**Team Management:** 
 Lead and mentor junior designers, providing guidance, feedback, and professional development opportunities.
 



**Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with copywriters, marketers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure cohesive and integrated design solutions.
 



  





**5\. Quality Assurance** 




**Design Standards:** 
 Maintain and enforce brand and design standards across all projects, ensuring consistency and quality.
 



**Review and Feedback:** 
 Conduct design reviews, provide constructive feedback, and approve final designs before delivery.
 



  





**6\. Creative Innovation and Trends** 




**Industry Trends:** 
 Stay informed about current design trends, techniques, tools, and best practices to innovate and enhance design output.
 



**Innovation:** 
 Introduce new ideas and creative solutions to elevate the visual impact and effectiveness of design deliverables.
 



  





**7\. Technical Skills and Tools** 




**Design Software Proficiency:** 
 Expert proficiency in graphic design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Sketch, Figma, or other relevant tools.
 



**Print and Digital Expertise:** 
 Familiarity with both print and digital design processes, including knowledge of file formats, color management, and printing techniques.
 



  





**Skills and Qualifications:** 




**Design Expertise:** 
 Extensive experience in graphic design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating a range of design projects and styles.
 



**Leadership Skills:** 
 Proven ability to lead and inspire a design team, with excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 



**Project Management:** 
 Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple deadlines.
 



**Creativity:** 
 Strong creative and conceptual thinking, with a keen eye for detail and aesthetics.
 



**Problem\-Solving:** 
 Ability to solve design challenges effectively and adapt designs to meet changing project requirements.
 



**Client Management:** 
 Experience in client\-facing roles, with the ability to understand client needs and deliver solutions that exceed expectations.

title: Graphic Designer (Performance Ads)
description:
Snugs is an Indian baby products brand. We make carriers, wraps and babywear in Kochi using export\-grade, toxin\-free fabrics, and we have served 30,000\+ parents. We are hiring a designer who will own the static creative that carries our paid social.
 



  





**What you will do** 




**You will design static ads for Meta and Google, in volume. Not one polished post a week, but a steady stream of concepts on a daily basis built to be tested against each other. Every ad has a job: stop the scroll, land one benefit, earn the click.** 




  




* Build static ad creative for Meta and Google: single images, carousels, collages, graphic layouts, before and after frames
* Turn product benefits into visual hooks that hold up on a small screen
* Use AI image tools as part of your workflow so we can produce many distinct concepts quickly
* Retouch and composite product photography from our in\-house shoots
* Set on\-image text and typography within our brand system
* Build variations of winning concepts and keep a clear library of what has run
* Work closely with the growth team on what to test next and what the results say



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 2\+ years designing for paid social, ecommerce or D2C brands
* A portfolio of ad creative, not only brand or print work. We want to see layouts that were made to sell
* Strong typography and layout instincts, and an eye for clean product imagery
* Fluent in Photoshop, Illustrator or Figma, and Canva
* Hands\-on with AI image tools such as Gemini, Midjourney, Higgsfield or similar
* Comfortable producing at pace without losing quality
* Interest in why ads perform, and a willingness to read the numbers behind your work



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience running or assisting on Meta Ads
* Basic motion or video editing skills
* Experience in baby, apparel, wellness or lifestyle categories



  





**Why this role** 




**You will see exactly how your work performs, week after week. Most designers never get that feedback loop. Here it will shape what you make next.** 




**Details** 




**On\-site at our Kochi office. Full\-time.** 




  





**Salary** 




 Rs.30,000\-40,000/month

title: Graphic Designer

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Graphic Designer role based at FemiSafe’s office in Kochi. title: Users Retention Manager (Product Growth)
description:
**Retention Manager – Product Growth** 




 Location: Bangalore (Office – HSR Layout)
 



 Department: CRM / Growth
 



  





**About AppsForBharat** 




 AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir App) is building beautifully crafted, AI\-first consumer experiences that help millions of Indians connect with spirituality and culture. We’re backed by Peak XV Partners, Elevation, Fundamentum, and other top\-tier investors, and are one of India’s fastest\-growing Series C consumer\-tech companies.
 



 Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, is the world’s largest platform for Hindu devotees, powering rituals, teachings, personalized recommendations, and a thriving devotional community. India’s $44B devotion economy is still largely offline, and we’re bringing structure, accessibility, and meaning to this massive market, where design and data play a central role in shaping user behavior at scale.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Retention Manager – Product Growth to own one of our most important growth problems: how do we get users to come back, transact more frequently, and build a long\-term relationship with Sri Mandir?
 



 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Growth, CRM and Data. You will use user behaviour, cohort insights and experimentation to identify retention opportunities and turn them into scalable product, engagement and lifecycle interventions.
 



 This is not a traditional CRM/campaign role. You will own the retention problem, while working with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to determine the right levers to solve it.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* **Retention Strategy:** 
 Build and drive the retention roadmap across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value user cohorts.
* **User \& Behaviour Insights:** 
 Deep\-dive into user behaviour, cohorts, frequency, repeat patterns and LTV to identify the biggest retention opportunities.
* **Product\-led Retention:** 
 Design and scale interventions such as subscriptions, loyalty/reward systems, personalisation, pricing/discounting and repeat\-use experiences.
* **Experimentation:** 
 Build a continuous experimentation pipeline — identify hypotheses, define success metrics, launch experiments and measure incremental impact.
* **Reactivation \& Frequency:** 
 Identify opportunities to bring dormant users back and increase the frequency of existing users through product and engagement interventions.
* **Cross\-functional Execution:** 
 Partner closely with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to take retention initiatives from insight → PRD/experiment → launch → measurement → scale.
* **Retention Measurement:** 
 Build frameworks to understand the impact of retention initiatives on repeat rate, frequency, revenue, contribution margin and LTV.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Diagnose Retention Problems** 



* Analyse retention and repeat behaviour across user, category, product, deity, geography, platform, acquisition source and other relevant dimensions.
* Identify where and why users drop off across their lifecycle.
* Translate data into clear behavioural insights and actionable opportunities.



**2\. Build Retention Solutions** 



* Convert insights into product, loyalty, personalisation and lifecycle hypotheses.
* Work with Product and CRM teams to design solutions that address specific user needs and behavioural gaps.
* Prioritise opportunities based on expected user and business impact.



**3\. Run a Strong Experimentation Engine** 



* Own the retention experimentation roadmap.
* Define hypotheses, control/treatment groups, success metrics and measurement frameworks.
* Evaluate experiments based on
 **incremental impact** 
 , not just engagement metrics.
* Scale successful interventions and quickly learn from unsuccessful ones.



**4\. Improve Repeat \& Lifetime Value** 



* Develop strategies to increase repeat transactions and user frequency.
* Identify opportunities to move users from first transaction → repeat → high\-frequency behaviour.
* Build interventions that improve long\-term user value rather than short\-term conversion alone.



**5\. Build Retention Intelligence** 



* Develop and maintain retention dashboards and reporting frameworks for daily/weekly decision\-making.
* Track key metrics including retention, repeat rate, frequency, reactivation and LTV.
* Establish clear measurement frameworks for major retention initiatives.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **6–8 years of experience** 
 in growth, retention, product growth, lifecycle, consumer internet or related roles.
* Strong experience solving
 **consumer retention and engagement problems** 
 through data and experimentation.
* Strong analytical ability with hands\-on experience in
 **cohort analysis, funnel analysis, retention metrics and LTV/business impact analysis** 
 .
* Strong product sense — able to identify user problems and translate them into product or growth opportunities.
* Experience running
 **A/B tests and growth experiments** 
 end\-to\-end.
* Understanding of CRM/lifecycle marketing and how communication can complement product\-led retention.
* Comfortable working with
 **SQL, product analytics and dashboards** 
 such as Mixpanel, Metabase, Superset or equivalent tools.
* Strong cross\-functional skills — able to work effectively with Product, Data, Design, CRM and Business teams.
* Bias towards action, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and independently identify and solve high\-impact problems.



  





**What Will Make You Successful** 




 You should naturally think in a loop:
 



**Understand user behaviour → Identify the retention problem → Form a hypothesis → Build the right intervention → Experiment → Measure incremental impact → Scale** 




 You should be equally comfortable discussing:
 


* Why a user did not return
* What behavioural segment is most valuable
* What product change could improve repeat behaviour
* Whether a subscription/loyalty intervention will actually create incremental retention
* How CRM can amplify a product intervention
* Whether an experiment genuinely moved LTV or simply shifted existing demand



  





**Key Deliverables** 



* **Retention Opportunity Roadmap** 
 across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value cohorts
* **Retention \& Cohort Intelligence Dashboard** 
 for ongoing decision\-making
* Continuous
 **Retention Experimentation Pipeline** 
 with clear hypotheses and measurement
* Successful rollout and optimisation of
 **product\-led retention initiatives**
* Measurable improvement in
 **repeat rate, retention, frequency, reactivation and LTV**
* Clear post\-launch measurement and learning framework for all major retention initiatives



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Sri Mandir serves users across very different spiritual needs, behaviours and frequencies. The next phase of growth is not only about acquiring more users — it is about
 **understanding what brings users back and building experiences that make the next spiritual action easier, more relevant and more meaningful.** 




 This role will be at the centre of that problem —
 **building the systems, insights and experiments that turn one\-time users into long\-term users.** 




  





**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys**

title: SPE-Media Intelligence
description:
**Job Summary**
 Serve as a media intelligence specialist focusing on content management customer voice analysis and customer service performance for a global organization. Interpret media and customer interaction data to generate actionable insights that improve service quality. Collaborate across teams in a rotational shift office environment to enhance customer experiences and operational decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze large volumes of customer interactions across media channels to identify recurring themes emerging issues and improvement opportunities that enhance satisfaction and loyalty.
* Manage digital content repositories by organizing tagging and maintaining knowledge articles that enable faster and more accurate responses to customer inquiries.
* Monitor customer feedback and sentiment from multiple sources to translate qualitative input into structured insights that guide service process refinements.
* Create concise insight reports and dashboards that summarize customer voice trends for operations product and quality teams enabling data informed decision making.
* Coordinate closely with customer service teams in rotational shifts to validate findings gather contextual details and ensure that insights reflect real service scenarios.
* Optimize knowledge base content by reviewing usage patterns feedback and resolution outcomes to keep articles current relevant and easy to consume.
* Develop and maintain categorization frameworks and taxonomies for customer issues and media topics that improve the precision of analysis and reporting.
* Collaborate with quality assurance and training functions to convert customer voice insights into improved scripts guidance and service playbooks.
* Utilize media listening and content management tools to track flag and escalate critical issues that may impact brand reputation or operational stability.
* Support root cause analysis for recurring customer pain points by combining media intelligence operational metrics and frontline feedback to propose practical remedies.
* Document repeatable analysis methods templates and checklists that increase consistency and efficiency in media intelligence activities across rotational shifts.
* Partner with product and process owners to prioritize enhancements that are strongly backed by customer evidence and that align with broader business objectives.
* Ensure compliance with information security and data privacy policies when handling customer data media assets and insight reports created in the office environment.


**Qualifications**
* Showcase proven experience in content management for service operations by curating updating and structuring knowledge assets that support frontline agents.
* Demonstrate hands on exposure to capturing and interpreting customer voice across channels including surveys calls chats and social or digital media touchpoints.
* Exhibit practical experience in customer service environments with rotational shifts understanding operational metrics and the realities of live customer interactions.
* Apply strong analytical thinking and attention to detail to transform unstructured comments into clear themes and prioritized improvement recommendations.
* Use collaboration skills to work effectively with customer service quality and product stakeholders in a fast paced office based setting.
* Leverage proficiency with common office productivity tools and media or knowledge platforms to build structured reports trackers and content libraries.
* Communicate findings clearly through written summaries and verbal updates that can be easily understood by non technical teams and decision makers.
* Adapt quickly to changing customer expectations and evolving media trends while maintaining a consistent focus on measurable service improvements.


**Certifications Required**
 Certified Customer Experience Professional or equivalent certification in customer service analytics or content management

 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Address routine queries of stakeholders, requestors and end service users

* Strong communication and project management skills.
* Experience of working with global, regional and local insights professionals required

+ Demonstrated skills with written communication – especially in PowerPoint and email

title: Content & UI Specialist
description:
Job Type: Permanent \- Full Time
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

  

 Job Category: IT
   

  

**Job Description**
 Are you ready to grow your career in our global tech hub?
   

  

 Zurich Cover\-More Group helps people travel safely across the globe every day. We are there at every step of a traveller’s journey, to keep them safe and help them out if something goes wrong. We are committed to providing reliable, fast, flexible and bespoke services for our customers as well as the many well\-known brands we partner with, such as travel agencies, airlines, banks and major sporting clubs!
   

  

 In the post\-pandemic world, travel insurance is more important than ever. We are committed to delivering an exceptional service for our customers and we want you to be part of that journey.
   

  

**So, what’s the job?**
* You'll proactively partner with stakeholders to develop, manage, and maintain digital content across CMS platforms, ensuring quality, accuracy, and consistency at every stage.
* You'll lead the creation and management of pages supporting product, feature, and campaign launches.
* You'll establish, advocate for, and enforce content standards and best practices across CMS platforms.
* You'll manage site authors by overseeing access permissions, governance processes, and CMS training initiatives.
* You'll conduct regular site audits to identify broken links, outdated content, and UX issues while driving continuous content improvements.
* You'll optimise web pages for usability, accessibility, and search engine optimisation (SEO).
* You'll collaborate with UX/UI designers across multiple geographies and time zones to implement intuitive interfaces, improve user journeys, and enhance overall site usability.
* You'll partner with developers, product teams, and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into polished, user\-friendly digital experiences.
* You'll design and implement features and workflows that improve efficiency in content management processes.
* You'll ensure all digital experiences meet responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll build feasibility analyses and proof\-of\-concept (POC) solutions for optimisation initiatives using ZCM's standard CMS component set.
* You'll plan, build, and execute A/B and multivariate tests using ZCM's test\-and\-learn toolset.
* You'll validate optimisation rules and audience segment configurations to ensure accurate test delivery.
* You'll analyse test results and convert insights into actionable recommendations, effectively communicating outcomes to stakeholders across locations.
* You'll lead UAT and QA processes to ensure accurate, high\-performing, and compliant digital experiences across web and app touchpoints.
* You'll validate content, functionality, device responsiveness, and WCAG compliance across partner and owned digital properties.
* You'll coordinate QA activities across distributed teams to ensure comprehensive testing and smooth go\-live execution.
* You'll act as the subject\-matter expert on ZCM's CMS, optimisation toolset, and digital platforms, providing first\-level support to the Rapid Learning Lab team globally.
* You'll document requirements for CMS component enhancements and communicate effectively with developers and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* You'll demonstrate strong asynchronous communication practices, keeping remote and onshore stakeholders informed, engaged, and unblocked between scheduled touchpoints.
* You'll work closely with Content, UX Design, Engineering, and broader business teams to deliver cohesive, high\-quality digital outcomes.
* You'll align Rapid Learning Lab and travel partner requirements to maximise technology capabilities, optimise user experiences, and drive sales performance.
* You'll write and debug CSS to create high\-quality web experiences, including resolving specificity and cascade conflicts, leveraging CSS custom properties, and translating design mockups into responsive, production\-ready web pages.
* You'll apply modern CSS layout techniques, including Flexbox and CSS Grid, to build responsive interfaces that provide an optimal experience across devices and screen sizes.
* You'll use browser Developer Tools to inspect, troubleshoot, and resolve styling, layout, and markup issues in live environments.
* You'll utilise vanilla JavaScript for DOM manipulation, including element selection, content updates, class management, and basic interactive functionality.
* You'll create, update, and manage website content using Web Content Management Systems (CMS), ensuring accurate and engaging digital experiences.
* You'll build and manage A/B and multivariate tests on Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) websites using Adobe Target and similar experimentation platforms to optimise user experience and business outcomes.
* You'll apply front\-end development skills to implement, customise, and support website enhancements, experiments, and digital initiatives.
* You'll maintain a strong understanding of website architecture, functionality, and best practices to support effective digital delivery.
* You'll ensure websites meet WCAG and ADA accessibility standards by identifying, addressing, and preventing common accessibility issues.
* You'll apply SEO best practices, ensuring websites are optimised for search engine visibility, performance, and discoverability.
* You'll design and develop responsive web experiences that follow industry best practices and deliver consistent functionality across a range of devices and screen sizes.
* You'll implement and validate web analytics and advertising tracking tags using tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, and related marketing technologies to support measurement and optimisation activities.
* You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure tracking, experimentation, accessibility, SEO, and front\-end development requirements are effectively delivered and maintained.


**And what are we looking for?**
* You'll bring a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Digital Marketing, Web Design, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field.
* You'll have 18 months or more of hands\-on, business\-side experience managing content within a CMS for a public\-facing website.
* You'll demonstrate experience working within offshore, distributed, or globally dispersed teams, successfully managing deliverables and communications across multiple time zones.
* You'll have hands\-on experience with one or more enterprise CMS platforms, such as Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Tridion, or Ektron.
* You'll possess experience using multivariate and A/B testing tools and methodologies, including platforms such as Adobe Target, Optimizely, Google Optimize, or similar solutions.
* You'll have a solid technical understanding of HTML, CSS, and web publishing principles.
* You'll demonstrate a strong understanding of content optimisation, technical SEO principles, and digital best practices.
* You'll have proven experience creating and managing web pages designed for a global audience.
* You'll possess strong knowledge of responsive design, device and browser compatibility, and WCAG/ADA accessibility standards.
* You'll have experience leading or supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Quality Assurance (QA) processes for digital products.
* You'll stand out with experience using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
* You'll bring knowledge of additional Adobe Digital Marketing tools, such as Adobe Target and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
* You'll have familiarity with digital environments within the travel or insurance industries.
* You'll have exposure to analytics and reporting tools that support optimisation and test performance analysis.
* You'll be exceptionally detail\-oriented, with outstanding proofreading skills and a commitment to content accuracy and test quality.
* You'll be a clear and proactive communicator who keeps remote and onshore stakeholders informed, aligned, and engaged.
* You'll work confidently and independently, managing priorities across multiple time zones with minimal day\-to\-day supervision.
* You'll thrive in a fast\-paced environment, seamlessly switching between priorities while consistently meeting deadlines without compromising quality.
* You'll be self\-motivated, responsive, and committed to delivering high\-quality digital experiences regardless of team location.
* You'll be highly collaborative and team\-oriented, recognising that exceptional digital experiences are built through strong global partnerships.
* You'll be naturally curious and improvement\-focused, constantly seeking opportunities to enhance digital experiences and outcomes.


**So, why choose us?**
 We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability and determination.
   

  

 We have more than 2600 employees worldwide: we’re a global group of digital natives, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts and customer service professionals. We share a global mission to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
   

  

 Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid work week policy ensures our employees maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
   

  

 Career growth. We want you to continue to learn, develop and bring your ideas to the table. We want to hear what you think, and we want you to work with the business \- not for the business!
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. So whatever walk of life you wander, just be you and come as you are.
   

  

 Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need, when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, covid leave (to get vaccinated and for when you’re sick), volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
   

  

**We also offer some other perks including:**
* Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
* Coverage under group personal accident insurance
* Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
* Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
* An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.

**Summary**
 We are seeking a
 **Business Program \& Operations Analyst – UAT \& Implementation** 
 to support a highly visible, enterprise\-wide refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation initiative being deployed across approximately 7,530 retail locations. This large\-scale program is transforming a traditionally manual temperature\-checking and logging process through sensor technology, automated data collection, temperature alerts, and work\-order automation.
   

  

 The program is designed to provide greater visibility into refrigeration equipment performance, identify potential equipment and temperature issues earlier, reduce product loss, support compliance requirements, improve preventive and corrective maintenance processes, and generate significant operational efficiencies and cost savings.
   

  

 In this role, you will help ensure the program is successfully implemented across the store network by supporting business requirements, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), process and SOP validation, training, operational readiness, implementation quality, and go\-live activities. You will work cross\-functionally with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and other program resources to ensure solutions meet business requirements and implementations remain on schedule without compromising quality.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst or program implementation experience, with hands\-on exposure to UAT, business process testing, requirements validation, training, and implementation readiness. Experience supporting retail, facilities, store operations, or large\-scale multi\-site implementations would be especially valuable.
   

  

**Click Apply Now To Join The Chamberlain Experience.**
**What You Will Be Accountable For**
* Support the implementation and deployment of a large\-scale refrigeration temperature monitoring and automation program across approximately 7,530 retail locations.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, define, document, clarify, and validate business and operational requirements.
* Ensure new processes, system functionality, and implementations align with established business requirements and operational needs.
* Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test execution, business process validation, issue identification, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Validate system functionality, workflows, and business processes prior to deployment.
* Review and validate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure processes are accurate, practical, and aligned with business requirements.
* Identify gaps, defects, process issues, or operational risks uncovered during testing and implementation and coordinate with appropriate stakeholders through resolution.
* Support store and end\-user readiness for implementation and go\-live.
* Develop and/or support training materials, process documentation, job aids, and other resources associated with the new program.
* Facilitate or support end\-user and service\-related training to drive understanding and successful adoption of new processes.
* Support implementation and training activities associated with facilities and work\-order management processes.
* Coordinate with project managers, refrigeration engineers, facilities teams, vendors, store stakeholders, and other program resources throughout the rollout.
* Help ensure installations and implementations are completed correctly and meet established business and quality standards.
* Support data validation activities to ensure information captured during implementation is accurate and complete.
* Track testing activities, implementation issues, dependencies, readiness items, and stakeholder deliverables through completion.
* Balance an aggressive implementation timeline with the need for high\-quality testing, validation, and execution.
* Support successful go\-live activities and the transition of new processes into ongoing business operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes, implementation effectiveness, operational consistency, and user adoption.


**What Qualifications You Need**
* Approximately 2–3 years of relevant Business Analyst experience, including business analysis, program/project implementation, business operations, or a related area.
* Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Hands\-on experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and/or business process testing.
* Experience gathering, documenting, clarifying, and validating business requirements.
* Experience supporting implementation projects and validating that solutions meet established business and operational requirements.
* Experience identifying issues during testing or implementation and coordinating with cross\-functional stakeholders through resolution.
* Exposure to SOP/process validation, operational readiness, training, or go\-live activities strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify process gaps, risks, and inconsistencies.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple activities, deadlines, and stakeholders within a fast\-paced implementation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across business, technical, vendor, facilities, and operational teams.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining highly engaged with a cross\-functional project team.
* Ability to maintain a strong focus on both implementation timelines and quality within a highly visible program.
* Must be available to work primarily during 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST business hours, with some flexibility to start approximately one hour earlier or later.
* Ability and willingness to travel to Deerfield, IL up to approximately three times during the nine\-month engagement.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting retail, retail facilities, store operations, refrigeration, facilities operations, or other multi\-site environments.
* Experience supporting large\-scale program implementations or enterprise rollouts across multiple locations.
* Experience working with facilities or work\-order management processes and platforms.
* Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for project, testing, issue, or implementation tracking.
* Exposure to ServiceChannel or similar facilities/work\-order management systems.
* Experience with data collection tools or platforms used to support implementation and validation activities.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the ability to organize, review, validate, and analyze implementation or operational data.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with external vendors and cross\-functional implementation teams.

title: Brand Marketing- Digital Product Engineering & AI
description:
**Brand Marketing\- Digital Product Engineering \& AI** 




  





**BOMBAYDC \| Mumbai, Andheri West (onsite)** 




  





**About BOMBAYDC** 




 BOMBAYDC is a digital product engineering company that helps enterprises grow revenue, improve customer adoption and reduce the cost of doing business through digital products, platforms, engineering and AI.
 



 We work differently from traditional technology and design companies.
 



 Rather than starting only with a business or technology problem, we start with the customer: what they are trying to accomplish, where the experience is failing them, and what is preventing them from taking the desired action. We work backwards from these customer needs into business strategy, experience, intelligence and engineering.
 



 Our work spans digital banking, commerce, enterprise platforms and consumer products for some of India's leading organisations.
 



 As technology and AI reshape the digital services industry, we are now looking for a sharp marketer who can help us build the next chapter of the BOMBAYDC brand.
 



  





**The Role:** 



* We are looking for a Marketing Lead who can position BOMBAYDC as a leading digital product engineering company and build sustained visibility for the firm among enterprise decision\-makers.
* This is not a social media management role.
* We need someone who understands technology, digital products, engineering and AI well enough to turn our capabilities, work and thinking into a compelling market narrative.
* You will own how BOMBAYDC presents itself to the outside world, across our website, content, social media, search, PR, events and thought leadership.
* The mandate is simple: Make the right people understand what BOMBAYDC does, why we are different, and why they should consider us for important digital product and engineering mandates.



  





**What You Will Own:** 




**1\. Positioning \& Brand Narrative** 



* Own and continuously sharpen BOMBAYDC's positioning as a digital product engineering company, moving market perception beyond UI/UX or design.
* Translate our capabilities across customer strategy, AI, experience and engineering into a clear and differentiated proposition.
* Build strong narratives around our core practices, including BFSI, Commerce and Enterprise/Consumer Products.
* Ensure that everything we communicate reinforces one consistent market position.



**2\. Website \& Digital Presence** 



* Own the BOMBAYDC website as our most important marketing asset.
* Continuously improve its structure, messaging, practice pages, case studies and content to reflect where the company is headed.
* Ensure that new work, client wins, launches, capabilities, leadership perspectives and company news are always current.
* Work with our internal design and engineering teams to continuously improve the website rather than treating it as a one\-time project.



**3\. Content \& Thought Leadership** 



* Build and run a strong content engine for BOMBAYDC.
* Identify topics where we should have a point of view across AI, digital products, banking, commerce, customer experience and engineering.



 Turn internal knowledge and client work into:
 



 ● Case studies
 



 ● Articles and POVs
 



 ● White papers and reports
 



 ● LinkedIn content
 



 ● Leadership content
 



 ● Client conversations and interviews
 



 ● Videos and other relevant formats You will not be expected to personally write everything. You will, however, be expected to know what we should be talking about, why it matters, and ensure it gets produced well.
 



**4\. Social \& Leadership Presence** 



* Build a consistent and high\-quality presence for BOMBAYDC and its leadership, particularly on LinkedIn.
* Move beyond routine company posts and create formats that demonstrate our thinking and expertise.
* This could include conversations with CXOs, client roundtables, industry perspectives, project stories, engineering insights, AI experiments and leadership viewpoints.



**5\. PR \& Industry Visibility** 



* Build relationships with relevant technology, business, marketing and industry publications. Identify stories worth taking to the media: major launches, client work, new capabilities, AI initiatives, research and leadership perspectives.
* Drive a steady rhythm of meaningful media visibility rather than occasional press releases.



**6\. Search, SEO \& AI Discoverability** 



* Own BOMBAYDC's organic discoverability.
* Improve our visibility for the areas in which we want to build business, across traditional search as well as AI\-driven discovery/GEO.
* Work towards BOMBAYDC appearing when enterprise decision\-makers research digital product engineering partners, AI\-led digital transformation, banking platforms, commerce transformation and related capabilities.
* Track what is driving qualified traffic and continuously improve it.



**7\. Events \& Market Engagement** 



* Identify the right conferences, industry forums, awards, roundtables and networking opportunities for BOMBAYDC.
* Evaluate where we should attend, speak, participate, partner or host. Create our own opportunities to bring together clients and industry leaders through roundtables, conversations and focused events.



  





**Who We Are Looking For:** 




 Someone with approximately 6–10 years of B2B marketing experience, ideally within:
 



 Digital product engineering, technology services, digital transformation, IT services, product consulting, enterprise SaaS or a similar business.
 



  





**You should:** 




 ● Understand how technology services companies sell to enterprises.
 



 ● Be comfortable discussing digital products, engineering, AI and customer experience.
 



 ● Be able to simplify complex capabilities into sharp market propositions.
 



 ● Have strong writing and storytelling judgment.
 



 ● Understand content marketing, LinkedIn, SEO and digital distribution.
 



 ● Have exposure to PR, events and thought leadership.
 



 ● Be comfortable working directly with founders, business leaders, designers and engineers.
 



 ● Be extremely hands\-on. This is not a role for someone who only manages agencies and reviews presentations.
 



 ● Have strong ownership and execution discipline.
 



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




 Within the first 12 months, we should see:
 



**A clearer market position** 



* People increasingly understand BOMBAYDC as a digital product engineering company rather than primarily a UI/UX or design firm.



**A stronger digital footprint** 



* Our website becomes current, deeper and more representative of our capabilities and practices.



**A consistent content engine** 



* High\-quality case studies, perspectives, articles and leadership content go out consistently.



**Greater discoverability** 



* Improved visibility across Google and AI\-led discovery for strategically important topics.



**Stronger industry visibility** 



* More relevant media coverage, speaking opportunities, roundtables and industry participation.



**Commercial impact** 




 Marketing increasingly contributes to conversations, opportunities and inbound enquiries from the kind of enterprise clients BOMBAYDC wants to work with.
 



  





**Most Important:** 




 We are not looking for someone to simply run our social media calendar.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can understand the business deeply, identify what makes BOMBAYDC relevant in a rapidly changing technology market, turn that into a sharp narrative, and then make sure that narrative reaches the people who matter.
 



  





 If you enjoy figuring out what a company should stand for and then building the machinery that makes the market notice it, we would like to speak with you.

 Full\-time
 



**Department:** 
 Command Centre – Social Media Intelligence \& ORM
 



**Experience:** 
 2–4 Years
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a
 **Senior Social Listening / ORM Analyst** 
 who can independently manage social intelligence and online reputation management projects. The role involves analysing digital conversations, managing brand reputation, leading reporting, monitoring and responding to customer conversations, identifying potential crises, and translating data into meaningful business and communication insights.
 



 The role will involve
 **project ownership, ORM operations, report development, quality control, client coordination, crisis monitoring, and mentoring junior analysts.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Independently handle
 **Social Listening and ORM projects** 
 for brands, campaigns, competitors, and industry categories.
* Monitor brand conversations across
 **social media, news, blogs, forums, review platforms, and other digital channels** 
 .
* Analyse customer sentiment, emotions, perceptions, opinions, intent, and behavioural patterns.
* Interpret the
 **Voice of the Customer (VoC)** 
 and identify key drivers behind positive and negative conversations.
* Identify and categorise
 **complaints, queries, appreciation, feedback, opinions, and potential reputation risks** 
 .
* Manage
 **response management workflows** 
 , ensuring customer conversations are acknowledged and responded to within defined SLAs/TATs.
* Ensure appropriate
 **escalation, follow\-up, and closure** 
 of customer complaints and critical conversations.
* Conduct manual monitoring to identify relevant conversations that may be missed by listening/ORM tools.
* Identify emerging themes, reputational risks, misinformation, conversation spikes, and potential crises.
* Support and manage
 **real\-time crisis monitoring and war\-room operations** 
 , including escalation of high\-risk conversations.
* Conduct campaign analysis, competitor benchmarking, share\-of\-voice analysis, perception analysis, and category intelligence.
* Own the preparation of
 **daily, weekly, monthly, campaign, audit, ORM, and crisis intelligence reports** 
 .
* Develop comprehensive reports with
 **executive summaries, key insights, business implications, and actionable recommendations** 
 .
* Create
 **client\-ready presentations** 
 supported by relevant data, evidence, findings, and recommendations.
* Review reports and ORM trackers prepared by analysts to ensure
 **accuracy, consistency, completeness, and quality** 
 .
* Guide junior analysts on
 **sentiment validation, conversation categorisation, response management, escalation protocols, data interpretation, and insight writing** 
 .
* Identify gaps in
 **data coverage, categorisation, sentiment accuracy, response management, and platform performance** 
 .
* Coordinate with client and internal teams for timely resolution of customer complaints and reputation\-related issues.
* Collaborate with
 **strategy, creative, client servicing, technology, and leadership teams** 
 on insights, reputation management, and crisis situations.



  





**Required Skills** 



* 2–4 years of experience in
 **Social Listening, Online Reputation Management (ORM), Digital Research, Consumer Insights, Social Media Intelligence, or Response Management** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **ORM workflows, response management, escalation matrices, SLA/TAT management, and complaint resolution** 
 .
* Ability to identify and differentiate between
 **complaints, queries, feedback, opinions, appreciation, reputation risks, and potential crises** 
 .
* Strong understanding of sentiment, emotion, perception, consumer behaviour, and narrative analysis.
* Ability to connect digital conversations and data with
 **business, brand, customer experience, and communication impact** 
 .
* Strong report writing, data storytelling, and presentation skills.
* Experience in preparing
 **client\-facing reports and presentations** 
 based on business requirements.
* Strong proficiency in
 **Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint** 
 .
* Experience with listening/ORM tools such as
 **Talkwalker, Meltwater, Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Konnect Insights** 
 , or similar platforms.
* Strong written communication skills and understanding of
 **brand tonality and customer communication** 
 .
* Ability to mentor junior team members and manage multiple client deliverables simultaneously.
* Ability to work effectively in a
 **fast\-paced environment, especially during reputation issues and crisis situations** 
 .



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 Someone who can manage both sides of the Command Centre —
 **listening to what customers are saying and helping brands act on those conversations** 
 .
 



 You should be able to go beyond reporting metrics to understand
 **what is driving conversations, how they are shaping brand perception, which conversations require immediate action, and what the brand should do next** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can combine
 **social intelligence, customer understanding, ORM execution, and crisis awareness** 
 to help brands listen, respond, protect, and strengthen their reputation.

title: Business Process Architect
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Business Process Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Analyze and design new business processes to create the documentation that guides the implementation of new processes and technologies. Partner with the business to define product requirements and use cases to meet process and functional requirements. Participate in user and task analysis to represent business needs.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM)
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a ServiceNow BPC, a typical day involves analyzing and designing innovative business processes to develop comprehensive documentation that supports the implementation of new processes and technologies. This role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders to define product requirements and use cases that align with both process and functional needs. Additionally, the position involves engaging in user and task analysis to accurately represent business demands, ensuring that solutions are well\-tailored to organizational objectives and operational efficiency.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment of business processes with organizational goals.
* Continuously evaluate existing processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on process design and documentation.
* Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather detailed business requirements and validate process designs.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM).
* Strong analytical skills to assess and improve business processes effectively.
* Experience in documenting business processes and creating clear, actionable process maps.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into functional specifications.
* Excellent communication skills to engage with diverse stakeholders and facilitate collaboration.
* Familiarity with user and task analysis methodologies to accurately capture business needs.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM).
* This position is based at our Pune office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Senior Manager, Product Management
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management to join our team within our Clinicals division. In this role you will be responsible for one or more product areas within the overarching product’s portfolio; understanding the market and customers, contributing to the product vision, developing business cases and ensuring a set of product features meet business requirements. You will help define how AI is responsibly integrated into clinical workflows, ensuring solutions are safe, trustworthy, and deliver measurable value to healthcare providers and patients.
   

  

 You will work closely with scrum teams defining and writing user stories, prioritizing product backlogs, and making trade\-off decisions between scope and schedule. Your work will span both strengthening our current solutions and delivering innovative, AI\-driven features that improve user experience and clinical decision\-making. Success in this role will be measured by improvements in provider efficiency, mobile adoption, workflow completion, user satisfaction, product quality, and safe adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Mobile team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve the efficiency and experience of healthcare providers. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI\-enabled solutions where they add value. The team collaborates closely to ensure products are usable, reliable, and aligned with clinical and business needs. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Drive product vision incorporating AI/ML capabilities, predictive insights, and automation opportunities
* Lead early\-stage discovery for features including: Identifying high\-value use cases for AI, Validating concepts with users and stakeholders, and Defining data requirements and feasibility
* Partner with UX, Analytics and Data Science teams to define measurement strategies for AI feature performance (e.g., validity, bias, data quality, adoption, impact)
* Translate product strategy into outcome\-based roadmaps that connect customer problems, business goals, delivery priorities, and measurable success criteria.
* Define product success metrics for each major initiative, including adoption, engagement, workflow efficiency, customer satisfaction, safety, and business impact.
* Own go\-to\-market strategies for products, including its AI\-enabled features
* Monitor post\-release performance and use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to guide iteration and prioritization.
* Work directly with scrum teams to prioritize work and ensure delivery of both core and AI\-enabled product capabilities
* Own ongoing maintenance of core products, including triaging production issues and managing enhancements
* Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to translate AI models into scalable product features
* Understand the market opportunity via user needs, market forces, applicable business models, emerging AI trends and competitive AI capabilities
* Drive the analysis of Product Area(s) of ownership including AI/ML\-driven products
* Define epics and user stories that clearly articulate: Functional requirements, User experience considerations, Data and model requirements, AI behavior expectations (e.g., explainability, confidence levels)
* Partner with UX and Engineering to design mobile experiences that are intuitive, accessible, performant, and reliable in fast\-moving clinical environments.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to manage the full AI/ML lifecycle, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree required: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or related field preferred
* 6\+ years of product management experience
* Understanding of US healthcare / health IT environment is strongly preferred
* Experience working in an Agile environment is strongly preferred
* Experience building or scaling mobile products, preferably iOS and Android applications in SaaS, healthcare, or enterprise environments.
* Understanding of mobile UX patterns, performance considerations, accessibility, release management, and app adoption strategies.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and productization of AI features
* Familiarity with: Model lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring), Data pipelines and data quality considerations, Experimentation frameworks
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model bias, and explainability
* Experience working on AI\-driven or data\-intensive products preferred
* Experience bringing products to market is needed
* Technical understanding (mobile, SaaS, data, APIs) – ability to check technical feasibility and timelines and remove technical development barriers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear business value


**Additional Information**
* Some travel to the US may be required for customer site visits, internal collaborations, and industry events (5%)

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. title: Research & Consulting Intern
description:
**Company Description** 




 Candor Capital is a boutique financial advisory firm with a niche in the management of complex portfolios, risk advisory, and transaction advisory for individuals and corporations. With a focus on evaluating financial products, offering regulatory support, and negotiating within the economic and financial ecosystem, we position ourselves as a trusted partner for clients navigating intricate financial landscapes. We adopt a long\-term perspective in managing, structuring, and safeguarding assets to ensure the preservation and growth of capital.
 



  





 The firm was founded by time\-served investment and banking professionals to dispense well\-researched and verified information along with globally accepted services to the investor community. We are dedicated to transparency and integrity, fostering an open communication system that equips our clients with a clear understanding of industry risks and processes.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated and enthusiastic individual to join our IB \& Consulting team as a
 **Research \& Consulting Intern** 
 . This role is perfect for individuals who are passionate about corporate finance and the fundraising process and will allow you to gain hands\-on experience in the investment banking domain.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 I. Research \& Strategy:
 


* Map licensing, compliance, and tax frameworks across target geographies; create concise regulatory roadmaps and risk registers.
* Size markets, segment customers, benchmark competitors, and identify whitespace opportunities; translate findings into go\-to\-market (GTM) recommendations.
* Conduct audience research, develop value\-proposition statements, and advise on naming, messaging hierarchy, and brand architecture.



  





 II. Implementation \& Execution:
 


* Draft company charters, HR handbooks, data\-privacy policies, and SOPs that meet local regulations and global best practices.
* Source and negotiate with marketing agencies, tech partners (CRM, ERP), and other third\-party vendors; coordinate timelines and quality checks through launch.
* Oversee activation of digital campaigns, website/app builds, and martech integrations; track deliverables and troubleshoot issues in real time.



  





 III. Financial Consulting \& Performance Management:
 


* Build zero\-based budgets, rolling forecasts, and sensitivity models for internal monitoring and reporting.
* Define and monitor commercial and operational industry metrics; produce performance dashboards with variance analysis.
* Capital Allocation Advisory: Evaluate funding options, craft investor materials, and support negotiations for debt/equity financing.



  





**Qualifications** 




 • Education: Final\-year student pursuing graduation or a recent graduate (less than 1 year of work experience). 
 



 • Background in Finance, Economics, Commerce or related fields preferred.
 



 • Skills Required: Strong analytical skills, excellent communication, attention to detail, and proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint and who can sit on desk for long hours.
 



 • A genuine interest in knowing and learning.
 



  





**Other Details** 




 Location: East of Kailash, New Delhi (On\-site)
 



 Duration: 3 Months
 



 Stipend: Rs. 7,500 per month
 



  





*Note: This internship could lead to a full\-time opportunity based on performance and organizational requirements.*
