title: Mechanical Sales & Marketing Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Jergens India Private Limited, founded in 2009, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Jergens Inc. (Ohio) that focuses on manufacturing efficiency solutions for industrial and machine\-tool applications. The company supplies advanced workholding, specialty fastening, and lifting products designed to improve productivity and precision. Its portfolio includes quick\-change fixturing systems, five\-axis vises, power clamping, and micro clamps tailored to modern manufacturing needs. As part of a global organization, Jergens India offers exposure to international standards, technologies, and customers in the engineering and manufacturing sectors.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time remote role for a Mechanical Sales \& Marketing Engineer. The role involves promoting workholding, fastening, and lifting solutions to existing and prospective customers, providing technical guidance on product selection, and preparing proposals and quotations. The Mechanical Sales \& Marketing Engineer will conduct product demonstrations, support application engineering, and collaborate with customers to understand their manufacturing processes and requirements. Daily tasks include managing customer inquiries, coordinating with internal technical and operations teams, maintaining CRM records, and contributing to sales and marketing campaigns, presentations, and technical documentation. The role also includes market research, competitor analysis, and participation in webinars or virtual events to strengthen brand presence and sales performance.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Mechanical Engineering and familiarity with industrial or machine\-tool applications.
* Experience with Maintenance and Inspection activities related to mechanical systems or manufacturing equipment.
* Proficiency in Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) tools for interpreting drawings and supporting application\-based solutions.
* Exposure to Automotive or related manufacturing sectors, with an understanding of production processes and quality standards.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers and stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Sales and marketing aptitude, including customer relationship management, basic negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Comfort working remotely, with good time management, self\-organization, and digital communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline; prior experience in technical sales or application engineering is an advantage.

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
**Join us at Entrust**
 At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely.
   

  

  

  

**Get to Know Us**
 Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity\-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting\-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You'll be joining the team leading Entrust's Identity portfolio, including the solutions formerly Onfido (AI\-powered digital identity solution). With the completed acquisition, Entrust now provides the industry's most comprehensive portfolio of AI\-powered, identity\-centric security solutions.
   

  

 Our technology helps businesses verify real identities using AI and biometrics, ensuring secure remote customer and business onboarding. By assessing government\-issued IDs and facial biometrics with innovative dashboards and fraud signals, we provide companies with the assurance they need to operate securely while allowing people to access services quickly and safely.
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Our Customer Support Engineers have a deep understanding of our products and services and are constantly aware of their state. When they receive a request, they assess its priority, establish its impact, and come with a strategy to resolve it. They communicate efficiently and empathetically with our customers, understanding the context and capturing the required details for a timely resolution. Their focus is on response time and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Entrust is expanding our Support team focused on the Onfido product suite to improve customer experience and satisfaction. One of your roles will be in identifying recurrent issues and trends, and partnering with our Product and Developer teams in addressing their root causes. The perfect candidate enjoys making customers happy and has a keen eye for investigation and detail.
   

  

 This role is part of a global team that provides
 **24x7x365 support** 
 to our customers. Coverage for customer support may require work on some public holidays.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product understanding \- Developing a deep understanding of the Onfido product suite and how it is used by our customers, collaborating with support engineers, product managers, software engineers, and mentors. Show confidence when demonstrating solutions.
* Demonstrate a Customer Experience mindset \- Holistic understanding of customer experience, and what drives and impacts customers at each stage of their onboarding journey. All\-encompassing approach to customer support, adapting your language to fit the audience.
* Problem solving \- Supporting the team as they investigate, debug, reproduce and fix any technical issues customers are facing when using our services.
* Product improvement \- You know what works well and what needs some tweaking. You will work with Product Managers in defining the product roadmap, by surfacing customer feedback and learnings from past requests. You will help maintain accurate product documentation and will constantly try to improve internal processes.
* Tooling \- You're constantly looking for opportunities to automate support tasks, by using scripts and by developing custom tools that will make the job easier.


**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications**
* A minimum 2 years of experience as a Technical Support Engineer in a Customer Service or software support role
* Empathy, and desire to help others.
* Pragmatic problem\-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Diligence, patience and friendliness under time pressure.

title: EDI Support Analyst
description:

title: Learning and Change Transformation - Senior Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \| PEOPLE CONSULTING \| LEARNING \& CHANGE**
**Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation \& Change**
 Own the workstream. Shape the solution. Accelerate client adoption.
   

  

**ROLE SNAPSHOT**
**Role:** 
 Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation \& Change
   

  

**Portfolio:** 
 Learning \& Development, People Consulting MENA
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7–9 years, including substantial client\-facing L\&D consulting experience
   

  

**Capability profile** 
 Learning consulting with deployable organisational change management capability
   

  

**Engagement model** 
 Workstream ownership; proposal solutioning; client\-facing delivery
   

  

**Travel:** 
 India\-based with willingness for short\- or long\-term deployment across KSA, UAE and Qatar
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 The Senior Consultant is a founding delivery and pursuit hire for the growing MENA Learning \& Change capability. The role translates complex client and RFP requirements into practical learning, adoption and capability\-building solutions, then owns key workstreams through delivery.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine Learning \& Development consulting, organisational change management, proposal development, facilitation and responsible AI usage. The role supports MENA priorities, with KSA as the primary growth market and government, energy and financial services as sector priorities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client delivery and workstream ownership**
* Own one or more learning and change workstreams across scope, quality, schedule, effort, dependencies, risks and client communication.
* Lead discovery interviews, focus groups, learning needs analyses, skills\-gap assessments, stakeholder workshops and design sessions.
* Translate business outcomes into capability frameworks, curriculum architectures, blended learning journeys, facilitator\-led experiences and measurement plans.
* Produce and quality\-review client\-ready strategies, roadmaps, workshop packs, recommendations, dashboards and implementation plans.
* Facilitate stakeholder and learner sessions and present workstream recommendations to client managers and senior stakeholders.
* Coach Staff Consultants and coordinate specialists, designers, facilitators and technology contributors across the workstream.


**Learning transformation and change management**
* Design integrated learning and adoption approaches covering audience analysis, impacts, readiness, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, reinforcement and sustainment.
* Apply instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM to learning journeys, curricula, academies, leadership programmes and capability\-building interventions.
* Develop learning operating model, managed learning services, governance, intake, content operations and performance\-measurement components where relevant.
* Support leadership assessment\-led development assignments, including administration and interpretation when appropriately accredited, and convert insights into development pathways.
* Use evaluation and analytics approaches to measure participation, learning transfer, adoption and business impact.


**Pursuits, proposals and business development**
* Independently draft solution approaches, proposal narratives, methodologies, workplans, staffing models, delivery plans, assumptions, risks and effort estimates.
* Analyse RFP requirements, develop compliance matrices and help create differentiated win themes and client\-specific solution stories under tight turnaround times.
* Create proposal slides, capability showcases, credentials, case studies, benchmarks and sector research for MENA partner and account teams.
* Participate in partner reviews, solution workshops and oral presentation preparation; present assigned sections confidently when required.
* Identify follow\-on opportunities during delivery and shape them into a clear problem statement, proposed response and indicative scope.


**AI\-enabled learning and technology**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal development, learning design and content acceleration in line with firm policies.
* Design AI\-enabled learning use cases, with particular emphasis on a learning content generation accelerator, personalised journeys and analytics\-assisted decisions.
* Apply human review, factual verification, accessibility, privacy, confidentiality, intellectual property and quality controls to AI\-assisted output.
* Bring working knowledge of LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces, LMS ecosystems and learning analytics to solution design.
* Guide Staff Consultants in effective prompt design, AI\-assisted production and responsible review practices.


**Capability building and internal contribution**
* Build and maintain reusable proposal content, credentials, case studies, research, methods, templates and delivery assets.
* Convert project learning into portfolio intellectual property and support capability demonstrations and internal roadshows.
* Contribute to recruitment assessments, onboarding, coaching, certification pathways and community\-of\-practice activity.
* Balance client delivery with pursuit and capability commitments in a lean, growth\-stage team.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting judgement: structures ambiguous problems, forms hypotheses, makes evidence\-based recommendations and knows when to escalate.
* Dual capability: can lead both a learning design conversation and a change/adoption conversation without treating them as separate disciplines.
* Proposal craft: writes clear, persuasive and executable solutions rather than generic capability statements.
* Facilitation and design thinking: designs productive workshops and moves diverse stakeholders towards decisions.
* Client communication: produces director\-ready documents and communicates confidently in virtual and in\-person settings.
* AI fluency: uses AI to increase speed and quality while retaining human accountability and professional scepticism.
* Builder mindset: creates reusable capability while meeting immediate delivery requirements.


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 7–9 years of relevant experience across L\&D consulting, learning transformation and organisational change management.
* Demonstrated client\-facing consulting experience and independent ownership of learning or change workstreams.
* Evidence of contribution to RFPs, solution approaches, proposal writing, effort estimation and presentation development.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Practical experience in change impacts, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands\-on use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals or learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline. PREFERRED
* GCC or MENA delivery or proposal experience, especially in government, energy or financial services.
* Big Four or global consulting experience.
* Experience in managed learning services, learning operating models, leadership development or leadership assessment\-led development.
* Exposure to LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces and learning analytics.
* Experience with SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, EdCast or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of Articulate Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Camtasia, Captivate or comparable content tools.
* Experience on digital transformation, ERP, AI adoption or workforce transformation programmes.


**CERTIFICATIONS**
**Required At Joining Or Within Agreed Development Plan**
* PROSCI or an equivalent recognised change management certification.
* Design thinking / human\-centred design / workshop facilitation credential or demonstrable equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI credential.
* One recognised learning credential or structured pathway towards APTD, CPTD or equivalent.


**Preferred / Differentiating**
* CCMP.
* Kirkpatrick learning evaluation credential.
* Hogan, SHL or Korn Ferry practitioner accreditation.
* Agile, Scrum or SAFe certification.
* Learning analytics, LMS, LXP or talent\-platform certification.


**WAYS OF WORKING**
**INITIAL RAMP\-UP**
* 50% client delivery.
* 30% pursuits and proposal support.
* 10% capability building.
* 10% internal initiatives.


**ONCE STAFFED ON A BILLABLE ENGAGEMENT**
* 70% client delivery.
* 30% pursuits, proposal support and agreed capability contribution.
* Allocation remains subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.


**INDICATIVE SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**
**Dimension**
* Delivery
* Pursuits
* Billable deployment
* Capability assets
* AI and innovation
* People


**Indicative measure**
* Own at least one significant learning or change workstream and achieve agreed scope, quality, schedule and client\-feedback expectations.
* Make material contributions to priority MENA proposals, including independent ownership of assigned solution and delivery sections.
* Transition into billable client delivery as demand permits, targeted within the first 2–3 months of joining.
* Create or materially improve reusable credentials, case studies, methods, proposal content or delivery assets.
* Demonstrate responsible AI use in proposals and delivery and contribute to the learning content generation accelerator or another client\-facing use case.
* Coach assigned Staff Consultants and provide timely, documented review and development feedback.


**Evidence**
* Workplan, quality reviews and client feedback.
* Pursuit tracker and proposal records.
* Staffing and utilisation records.
* Controlled repository and reuse evidence.
* Demo, use\-case record or client deliverable.
* Coaching records and work\-product improvement.


**What Ey Offers**
* Exposure to live MENA learning, change and workforce transformation programmes.
* A role combining workstream delivery, solution shaping, proposal support and capability building.
* A development path across learning consulting, organisational change, facilitation, AI and emerging learning technology.
* The opportunity to shape a growing MENA Learning \& Change capability rather than inherit a fixed operating model.


**Recruitment note:** 
 This JD is intentionally designed to filter for consulting capability, not training administration alone. Selection must be based on role\-relevant skills and experience.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Location: HSR Layout, Bangalore** 




  





**About BrightCHAMPS** 




  





 BrightCHAMPS is a holistic skill\-building and learning platform on a mission to bridge the gap between traditional education and the real\-world skills kids need to thrive, offering expert\-designed courses in Coding, Financial Literacy, Math, Robotics, AI, and Communication. Founded in 2020 by Ravi Bhushan, the company has rapidly expanded to over 30 countries, delivering 200,000\+ live classes every month, and is one of the fastest\-growing EdTech companies in the world, teaching coding, robotics, financial literacy, and STEM skills to over a million children. BrightCHAMPS is backed by $63M in funding at a $650M valuation, with investors including Premji Invest, GSV Ventures, 021 Capital, Beenext, and Binny Bansal. The company operates across four core learning verticals —CodeCHAMPS (coding), RoboCHAMPS (robotics and artificial intelligence), FinCHAMPS (financial literacy), and LingoCHAMPS (communications) — and has grown to a team of 700\+ employees across fivecontinents.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a high\-energy, target\-driven Sales professional with proven team handling and P\&L ownership experience to join our growing Sales team. This role is central to driving revenue growth by converting inbound/outbound leads (parents of K12 students) into paying customers through consultative, needs\-based selling, while building and managing high\-performing sales teams. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience in EdTech K12 sales, is comfortable with high\-volume outreach, and thrives in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 ● Own the end\-to\-end sales cycle — from lead engagement to counseling parents/students and closing enrollments for BrightCHAMPS programs.
 



 ● Own the P\&L for the assigned team/region/vertical — driving revenue, managing cost per acquisition, and ensuring profitable growth against budget.
 



 ● Conduct structured discovery calls with parents to understand their child's learning needs and present BrightCHAMPS' offerings as the right\-fit solution.
 



 ● Drive and exceed monthly/quarterly revenue targets through consistent pipeline management andfollow\-ups.
 



 ● Conduct regular performance reviews, call audits, and coaching sessions to improve team conversion rates and pitch quality.
 



 ● Deliver product demos and counseling sessions (video/phone) that build trust and clearly articulatevalue to parents.
 



 ● Maintain accurate and updated records of leads, conversations, and conversions in the CRM; track team performance dashboards.
 



 ● Collaborate with Marketing to give feedback on lead quality and campaign performance.
 



 ● Work closely with the Academic/Curriculum team to stay updated on product offerings and articulate them effectively to prospects.
 



 ● Analyze sales funnel metrics (connect rate, conversion rate, average deal size, CAC) and identify areasfor improvement.
 



 ● Manage team\-level P\&L, including incentive payouts, cost optimization, and forecasting against revenue targets.
 



 ● Partner with leadership on sales strategy, pricing, and process improvements to scale revenue.
 



  





**Requirements (Common Across Levels)** 




  





 ● Prior experience in EdTech K12 sales is mandatory — inside sales, business development, or academic counseling for K12\-focused ed\-tech companies.
 



 ● Demonstrated team handling experience — hiring, onboarding, coaching, and performance management of sales teams is a must (except at entry Manager level, where at least some team\-lead exposure is required).
 



 ● P\&L management experience — comfortable owning and reporting on revenue, cost, and margin metrics for their unit (level of ownership scales with seniority, as detailed above).
 



 ● Strong communication, persuasion, and objection\-handling skills; comfortable speaking with parents and making a compelling case for learning outcomes.
 



 ● Data\-driven approach to sales — comfortable working with CRM tools (e.g., LeadSquared, Salesforce, Zoho) and analyzing funnel metrics.
 



 ● Proven ability to work in a high\-intensity, target\-driven environment with daily/weekly/monthly KPIs.
 



 ● Bachelor's degree required; MBA preferred
 



 ● Willingness to work in a fast\-paced startup environment, including weekend availability (standard for parent\-facing EdTech sales roles).

 Sales · Customer Experience · Experience Drives · Growth

 You'll be out in the field, hosting experience drives, closing conversations with customers, planning campaigns, and learning how businesses actually win in competitive markets. title: Department Manager

**Job Description**

You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.
   

  





 ​
   

  





**WHO YOU ARE** 
**​**




*We are looking for people with…* 
 ​
   

  




* Experience in retail management and operations.
* Strong leadership skills, with a passion for coaching and developing teams while exemplifying company values and culture.
* Expertise in sales planning, analysis, and follow\-up, using customer\-centric tools and reporting.



  

  





*And people who are…* 
 ​
   

  




* Strong and confident leaders who inspire, coach, and develop their teams with integrity.
* Thriving in collaborative, dynamic environments, with a solution\-focused mindset.
* Motivated to create great customers experiences while promoting and selling our products.
* A keen interest in fashion trends, commerciality, and competitor insights to drive sales.
* Effective communicators, creative, and curious.
* Flexible, analytical, and achievement\-oriented, with the ability to manage statistics and work with numbers.



 ​
   

  





**WHO WE ARE** 
**​**




 H\&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​
   

  





 ​
   

  





 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​
   

  





 ​
   

  





**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE** 
**​**




  

  

 At H\&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
   

  





 · We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.
   

  





 · We pride ourselves on being a values\-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.
   

  





 · We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
   

  





 · You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.
   

  





 · We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.
   

  





 · You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H\&M group.
   

  





 · We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.
   

  





  

  





**JOIN US** 
**​**




 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​
   

  





 ​
   

  





 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​
   

  





 ​
   

  





*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*



**Additional Information**

 This is a full\-time position for our stores in Bangalore. The position reports to the Store Manager.
   

  





 To manage the high volume of applications for roles with leadership responsibilities, we use an online assessment method. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H\&M Group.
   

  

 After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.
   

  

 If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment\_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

title: Sales Account Executive
description:
**About Chargebee** 




 Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
 



  





 Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2\.
 



 With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.
 



  





**About the role (Job Summary)** 




 You'll be talking to founders. Early\-stage, fast\-moving, often pre\-revenue. They've booked a meeting with us because they know billing is a problem they need to solve. Your job is to confirm that, show them exactly what they need to see, and close.
 



  





**What you’ll do (role and responsibilities)** 



* Running inbound discovery and closing calls with early\-stage startup founders across the US and EMEA — companies with fewer than 10 employees, often pre\-revenue or under $100K ARR.
* Qualifying prospects fast, identifying the right offer, and closing deals in one call wherever possible.
* Working multiple lead sources — inbound demo bookings, form applications, high\-growth trial accounts, and warm handoffs — each with a different approach.
* Positioning Chargebee not as a product but as growth infrastructure — something founders set up once and grow into, not something that slows them down.
* Handling objections with clarity and confidence, not scripts — especially the tough ones around pricing, complexity, and why not just use the free plan.
* Managing a high volume of accounts without losing the personal touch that closes early\-stage founders.



  





**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)** 




  




* You have a good grasp of the product — you don't need to be an expert on every feature, but you understand what we solve and for whom
* You have 2\-4 years of work experience
* Good problem solving skills — ability to simplify complex problems and provide solution to the customers
* Understand what a good customer conversation looks like
* You can run a focused, story\-driven conversation — you sell the outcome, not the feature list
* You're comfortable making quick decisions — which offer to lead with, when to push, when to listen
* You write clearly and concisely — a lot of this motion runs on sharp emails that move deals forward without scheduling unnecessary calls
* You manage your time well independently — this is a high\-volume role and things move fast

 Prinalto is an advisory\-first, buyer\-centric property consulting firm that supports clients in making informed real estate decisions through data\-backed analysis and expert insights. The firm works across premium residential properties, strategic land investments, and high\-yield commercial assets, offering comprehensive guidance tailored to each client’s needs. Prinalto also conducts rigorous risk and regulatory due diligence to ensure transparent, secure transactions. By eliminating broker bias and reducing the risk of buyer’s remorse, Prinalto helps clients build confident, well\-structured property portfolios. **Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Executive role based in Navi Mumbai. We enable enterprises across India to procure certified, performance\-tested refurbished laptops, desktops, and servers \- delivering up to 50–70% cost savings versus new hardware, without any compromise on quality, reliability, or compliance.
 



 With a rapidly growing enterprise client base spanning BPO, BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, and Education verticals, we are now expanding our North India footprint and are looking for a sharp, networked sales professional to own the Maharastra and North India territory.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 This is a hunter\-first, relationship\-driven enterprise sales role. As BDM \- Enterprise for North India, you will own the full sales cycle \- from market mapping and cold/warm outreach to pitching, negotiation, and closure.
 



 You will leverage your existing network within target industries to drive qualified pipeline, meet decision\-makers on\-ground, and build NewJaisa's brand presence in the region through client visits and offline events.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in the field, is commercially sharp, and can independently drive revenue without hand\-holding.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Own end\-to\-end enterprise sales for the Maharastra \& North India territory \- from lead identification through to deal closure.
* Proactively map the market to identify high\-potential enterprise accounts across BPO, BFSI, Healthcare, and Retail verticals.
* Leverage existing professional network to generate warm leads and referrals from Day 1\.
* Run outbound prospecting via LinkedIn, industry databases, cold calling, and direct visits to target accounts.
* Identify and engage procurement managers, IT heads, CFOs, and CXOs who influence or own hardware purchase decisions.
* Conduct in\-person meetings, presentations, and product demos to key decision\-makers at enterprise accounts.
* Manage the complete sales lifecycle \- discovery, solution mapping, proposal, negotiation, and closure.
* Develop and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with enterprise accounts to drive repeat business and upsell opportunities.
* Plan and execute offline client events, roundtables, and business networking meets in Maharastra NCR and across North India.
* Represent NewJaisa at industry forums, IT procurement events, and vertical\-specific gatherings.
* Work with the marketing team to drive regional ABM (Account\-Based Marketing) campaigns and BTL activations.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of leads, opportunities, and client interactions in the CRM.
* Provide weekly pipeline updates and monthly sales forecasts to reporting management.
* Track competitor activity, pricing trends, and market intelligence and relay inputs to the central team.
* Coordinate with the inside sales, pre\-sales, and operations teams to ensure smooth order processing and post\-sale fulfilment.
* Collaborate with the marketing team on collateral, case studies, and account\-specific materials.
* Share ground\-level market feedback to help refine product positioning and go\-to\-market strategy.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




**Must\-Have** 




**Experience:** 
 2\-5 years of B2B / enterprise sales.
 



**Communication:** 
 Fluent in English, Marathi and Hindi (spoken \& written) \- non\-negotiable.
 



**Education:** 
 Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Business, Engineering, or related fields preferred.
 



**Location:** 
 Based in Maharastra or willing to relocate immediately.
 



**Travel:** 
 Willing to travel extensively across North India (50%\+ of working time).
 



**Mindset:** 
 Self\-starter \- able to independently generate, qualify, and close leads.
 



**Attitude:** 
 Agile, adaptable, and comfortable in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
 



  





**Good to Have** 



* Prior experience selling IT hardware, managed services, SaaS, or technology solutions to enterprise clients.
* An existing contact network within BPO, BFSI, Healthcare, or Retail organisations in North India \- especially with IT, procurement, or operations decision\-makers.
* Understanding of the IT asset lifecycle, enterprise procurement processes, and bulk hardware buying cycles.
* Experience planning or participating in corporate events, trade shows, or client meets.
* Proficiency with any CRM tool (Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar).
* Exposure to sustainability\-led or ESG\-aligned sales pitches (green IT, circular economy).



  





**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU** 



* Work with a publicly listed, fast\-growing company in India's sustainable technology sector.
* Full ownership of a high\-potential territory \- Maharastra and North India \- with real scope to grow.
* Competitive fixed CTC \+ attractive performance\-linked incentives (structured for field sales).
* Opportunity to fast\-track into a Senior BDM or Regional Sales Lead role based on performance.
* Join a sharp, entrepreneurial team with a strong culture of ownership and execution.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:

* Owns commercial performance across the assigned market, delivering sales, profitability and growth objectives. Drives margin improvement through disciplined pricing, value selling, cost management and effective management of receivables and working capital.

* Identifies, develops and converts new business opportunities within existing and adjacent markets. Supports and guides distribution partners to drive profitable growth and maximize market penetration. Maintains opportunity pipelines and CRM discipline.
* Acts as the market expert by monitoring competitors, market trends, regulatory developments and technology changes. Provides market insights and demand forecasts to support business planning, S\&OP and strategic decision\-making.
* Collaborates with Marketing, Product Management, R\&D and Operations to influence product development, pricing and supply priorities. Represents the region in global and regional initiatives, product launches and strategic discussions.
* Manages reporting, compliance requirements, internal meetings, training, travel, process improvements and other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Education should be Graduate / Bachelor any discipline
* 8\+ years sales experience in chemical sector, preferable Paints \& Coatings.
* Strong sales/Business development skills
* Sound understanding of specialty chemicals and market dynamics, and the ability to develop strategic customer relationships

**Microbial Control Solutions (MCS)** 
 focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home \& Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints \& Coatings and Material Protection.
   

  

**Nutrition, Care \& Environmental (NCE)** 
 provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high\-performance applications.

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Maritime**
 We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.

description:
**Company Description**
 Fairmont Hotels \& Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. Famous for its engaging service, awe\-inspiring public spaces, locally inspired cuisine, and iconic bars and lounges, Fairmont also takes great pride in its pioneering approach to hospitality and leadership in sustainability and responsible tourism practices. **CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION**

description:
**Team Lead — Corporate Events \& Sales \| Pune GSS** 




**Location: Pune, India** 




**Work Mode: Work from Office, 5 days a week** 




**Experience: 6–10 years** 




**Team: 7 Corporate Event Planners \+ 1 Operations Executive** 




**Working Hours: Aligned to UAE business hours** 




**Weekly Off: Any 2 days of the week** 




  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for a Team Lead to lead our corporate events team and own its commercial performance.
 



 You will manage 7 planners and 1 operations executive, with your primary focus on hitting revenue and margin targets, improving conversion, coaching planners to sell better, and maintaining high delivery standards.
 



 This is a player\-coach role. You will personally stay close to important opportunities and client situations while helping the team consistently perform at a higher level.
 



 You don't need to build a large operations function. You need to build a high\-performing sales and event\-planning team.
 



  





**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Own Team Revenue \& Performance** 




 • Own monthly team targets for revenue, gross margin, conversion and productivity.
 



 • Break targets into clear individual planner goals and track performance through live dashboards.
 



 • Identify performance gaps early and put corrective actions in place.
 



 • Run regular pipeline, conversion and performance reviews.
 



 • Escalate risks with a diagnosis and proposed solution, not just the problem.
 



**2\. Coach the Team to Sell Better** 




 • Coach planners on qualification, discovery, proposals, pricing, negotiation, follow\-up and closing.
 



 • Review live opportunities and help unblock difficult deals.
 



 • Identify what separates high performers from low performers and replicate those behaviours across the team.
 



 • Develop underperforming planners through clear expectations, coaching and follow\-through.
 



 • Build a culture of ownership, urgency and commercial discipline.
 



**3\. Stay Close to Clients \& Sales** 




 • Personally handle selected high\-value opportunities and important client escalations.
 



 • Support the team on complex negotiations and strategic accounts.
 



 • Ensure planners are selling profitable events, not just chasing topline revenue.
 



 • Maintain strong client relationships and drive repeat business.
 



**4\. Maintain Event\-Planning Quality** 




 • Use your event and venue expertise to challenge proposals, commercials and delivery plans where required.
 



 • Help planners anticipate operational risks before they reach the client.
 



 • Ensure strong handover from sale through event delivery and closure.
 



**5\. Help us Improve Through AI \& Product** 




 • Drive adoption of our AI tools across the team.
 



 • Identify where AI, automation or better workflows can improve sales productivity and conversion.
 



 • Share structured feedback with Product based on real planner and client problems.
 



 • Help the team adapt quickly as our systems and workflows evolve.
 



  





**Must Have** 




 • 6–10 years of total experience
 



 • 2–3\+ years managing a team of 6\+
 



 • Experience in corporate events, MICE, hospitality, hotel banquets, event production, travel, events agencies or another relevant customer\-facing commercial environment
 



 • Proven experience personally owning a sales/revenue target
 



 • Experience coaching and improving sales performance within a team
 



 • Strong understanding of revenue, gross margin and conversion
 



 • Strong spoken and written English
 



 • Comfortable working with dashboards, CRM and performance data
 



 • Strong problem\-solving mindset and comfort operating without a perfect playbook
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • UAE / GCC / international B2B client exposure
 



 • Experience leading event planners or corporate\-event sales teams
 



 • Strong venue, supplier or MICE network
 



 • Experience using AI meaningfully in day\-to\-day work
 



 • Experience working with Product, technology or automation teams
 



 • Experience building or improving sales processes and SOPs
 



  





**Please apply only if the shift pattern and non\-weekend weekly off genuinely work for you.**

**What You’ll Do**
*AllianceBernstein’s Request for Proposal (RFP) team is in search of a RFP writer to contribute to business development and client service through the completion of RFPs, RFIs, as well as some due diligence requests for AllianceBernstein’s Fixed Income Strategies. The Writer will specialize in writing RFPs for our Fixed Income Strategies in a timely and accurate manner, while also contributing, where needed, to the completion of other projects and requests. The Writer will be expected to be able to work effectively with the firm’s Senior RFP Writers and Management Team, Product Managers and Portfolio Managers, as well as our Sales Teams, to write and maintain (keep updated) original and technical product\-specific content to support our Fixed Income platform, and, importantly, to be able to effectively customize that content for specific sales situations as needed.*
*This position will provide an opportunity to develop knowledge in the entire new business development process: from the initial screening of an RFP, to the organization and project management of an RFP, to the actual content creation and updating of RFP language and then, finally, to the follow\-up and tracking of our RFPs. description:
Job Title
   

  

 Spare Parts Package Coordinator
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Title \- Spare Parts Package Coordinator
   

  

**Job Description**
 Your department
   

  

 The Global Spare Parts Department is part of the Business Unit Supply. The Global Spare Parts team is end\-to\-end responsible for the spare parts activities for Vanderlande’s Customer Centers (CC’s) and their customers. Global Spare Parts department is creating a Center of Competence in our Global Capability Center at Pune, India. Global Spare Parts is organized in three departments.
   

  

 Global Spare Parts
   

  

* Spare Parts Marketing manages the spare parts product portfolio to improve the parts value proposition to the Vanderlande CC’s and Customers. The activities include Product Life Cycle management with a strong focus on digitalization and B2B e\-commerce. The team manages the global pricing, product content and builds a strong relation with in\- and external stakeholders.
* Global Support supports the global customer base with spare parts offerings throughout the life\-time of the material handling assets. This includes the development of initial spare parts packages and day to day technical and commercial spare parts support. The department advises customers to optimize the on\-site stock availability.
* Spare Parts Logistics manages the central parts warehouse and is responsible for all in\- and outbound warehouse activities. They manage stock\-levels, lead\-times and on\-time shipment and delivery of parts from suppliers and deliveries to the global Vanderlande customer base


 Your position
   

  

 You will be the first point of contact for the customers’ spare parts related questions and requests. You will own the ordering process and will keep the customer up to date with the delivery information.
   

  

 Where necessary, you will also check the technical documentation (Bill of Material) in order to find out what parts are needed for the customer.
   

  

 Tasks And Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage customer\-specific spare parts package activities from project initiation through completion.
* Collect, validate, and maintain supplier spare parts data, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Identify portfolio gaps, create missing material master records, prepare BIT files, and maintain installed base information.
* Develop and maintain Bills of Material (BOMs), spare parts package structures, and related master data.
* Prepare preliminary budgets and customer quotations using SPARQ, FileMaker (CAP), SCCT, and manual quotation processes.
* Process SQ quotations, spare parts orders, SD/OD orders, and associated project documentation.
* Plan and monitor spare parts deliveries, ensuring timely execution and follow\-up within JDE.
* Partner with Project Managers to align spare parts deliverables with project schedules and implementation milestones.
* Prioritize project activities, monitor progress, and ensure on\-time completion of assigned deliverables.
* Serve as the primary liaison for regional Spare Parts Coordinators, promoting effective collaboration and knowledge sharing.
* Standardize global spare parts processes, templates, and governance while supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive operational excellence through process optimization, automation, and best\-practice implementation.
* Collaborate with Service, Sales, Supply Chain, and Project teams to deliver customer\-focused lifecycle support solutions.
* Perform installed\-base and bottleneck analyses to identify operational risks and recommend optimized spare parts strategies.
* Develop customer\-specific stocking concepts and lifecycle service recommendations to improve equipment availability and reliability.
* Support strategic initiatives that enhance lifecycle services, increase spare parts revenue, improve customer retention, and strengthen long\-term customer value.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and global teams to ensure seamless communication and execution.
* Uphold Toyota Automated Logistics values by demonstrating customer focus, collaboration, accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.


**Requirements**
* At least a bachelor’s degree, preferably Business Administration or a similar
* Relevant 5\-7 years' experience in a B2B techno\-commercial environment.
* Experience in Spare Parts Order Management.
* Knowledge of Material Planning and Inventory Management
* Must have general technical knowledge of spare parts \& able to read technical data sheets and drawings
* Good negotiation skills to develop local buying
* Strong administrational skills with knowledge of Microsoft Office (specifically MS Excel)
* Experience with ERP
* Good command of the English language (Speaking and Writing)
* Experience in handling multiple tasks in a high\-energy office
* Proactive and customer service\-minded
* Strong work ethic and initiative, who would like to grow and develop within the organization
* Takes full ownership and responsibilities of their assignments
* Believe in Self\-alignment with all stake holders


 Diversity \& inclusion
   

  

 Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

 CCH Tagetik, the corporate performance management (CPM) platform from Wolters Kluwer, is scaling rapidly in India . Demand from India's largest banks, NBFCs, insurers, manufacturers, and conglomerates is outpacing our current coverage capacity.
   

  

 We are hiring an Account Executive to own a named\-account territory and drive net\-new ARR growth. This is a high\-visibility, quota\-carrying role in a business that has delivered strong year\-on\-year growth and a decisive shift to cloud/SaaS. You will sell a unified platform for financial consolidation, planning, regulatory reporting, and operational transfer pricing to CFOs and finance leadership at India's most sophisticated enterprises.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own a named\-account territory across manufacturing, and large conglomerates, with full responsibility for pipeline generation, deal execution, and bookings attainment
* Sell to the CFO's office — engage CFOs, financial controllers, heads of FP\&A, and CIOs on high\-stakes problems: long close cycles, complex group consolidation, regulatory compliance, and planning transformation
* Run complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise cycles (6–12 months, six\- and seven\-figure ACV) from qualification through negotiation and close, with disciplined forecasting and CRM hygiene
* Co\-sell with the Big 4 partner ecosystem — build deal\-level alignment with EY, Deloitte, PwC, and Accenture practices, leveraging our strategic Centre of Excellence relationships to source and accelerate opportunities
* Position the unified platform advantage against point solutions and legacy incumbents (Oracle EPM/PBCS, Anaplan, OneStream, SAP BPC), anchoring value in regulatory readiness, finance ownership, and total cost of change
* Expand new product lines, into net\-new and installed\-base accounts
* Orchestrate the extended team — pre\-sales, inside sales, marketing, services, and partner resources — to run coordinated account campaigns
* What We Are Looking For
* 8–12 years of enterprise software sales experience, with at least 4 years selling EPM/CPM, ERP, analytics, or adjacent office\-of\-the\-CFO solutions into large Indian enterprises
* A verifiable track record of quota attainment on net\-new enterprise business, with deal sizes in the ₹1 Cr\+ ACV range
* Fluency in the finance domain — you can hold a credible first meeting with a CFO on consolidation, close, planning, and regulatory reporting without a pre\-sales resource in the room
* Experience co\-selling with Big 4 or large SI partners, and the maturity to manage partner dynamics at deal level
* Strong command of value\-based, executive\-register selling — structured discovery, business case construction, and multi\-threaded stakeholder management
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or CA/finance background is an advantage
* Based in Mumbai, with willingness to travel across the territory as needed
* Why This Role
* Category momentum: India's regulatory agenda is forcing CFO\-office modernization — you will sell into genuine, board\-level urgency, not discretionary budgets
* Platform differentiation: A single unified platform spanning consolidation, planning, regulatory reporting, ESG, and transfer pricing — a materially stronger story than stitched\-together point tools
* Partner leverage: Committed Big 4 Centre of Excellence investment means real, partner\-sourced pipeline — not cold territory
* Backing of Wolters Kluwer: A €5B\+ global leader in professional information and software, with the brand credibility to open CFO doors
* Growth\-stage economics in an established company: A rapidly scaling India business with leadership visibility, uncapped earning potential, and a clear path to expanded scope
* Wolters Kluwer is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

**Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating\-cooling system)** 




**Zehnder Group \| Represented in India by T\&A Consulting** 




**Location: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru** 




  





**About Zehnder Group** 




 Zehnder Group is a Swiss headquartered provider of world\-leading solutions for a comfortable, energy\-efficient and healthy indoor climate. The products and services of the Group include heating, cooling, indoor ventilation and air cleaning. The Group develops and manufactures its products at its own factories in Europe, China, and North America.
 



 As part of its international growth strategy, Zehnder is now entering the Indian market and is looking to appoint Country Manager – India.
 



**More about Zehnder Group on www.zehndergroup.com** 




 Zehnder has partnered with
 **T\&A Consulting** 
 to support its India market entry and leadership hiring.
 



  





**About T\&A Consulting** 




 T\&A Consulting is a global advisory firm, with extensive experience of working with government, economic development agencies, businesses and academic institutions across Europe, Asia, and the Americas towards their expansion in the international markets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Country Manager – India who will be responsible for building Zehnder’s business in India from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional sales role. It is a
 **market\-entry, business development and category\-building role** 
 for a senior commercial professional who can create demand for premium indoor climate solutions in India.
 



 The role requires someone who can position Zehnder as a premium ventilation, fresh\-air and indoor air quality brand in India, build specification\-led demand, develop a strong project pipeline, create the right partner ecosystem, and secure early reference projects.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating in a lean, entrepreneurial setup where brand awareness, channels, installer capability and market acceptance need to be built from scratch.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. India Market Entry \& Business Build\-Up** 



* Establish Zehnder’s presence in India.
* Develop and execute a practical go\-to\-market plan for India.
* Identify priority customer segments, geographies and project types.
* Build Zehnder’s visibility among architects, consultants, developers, contractors and premium project decision\-makers.
* Generate qualified project pipeline and secure early reference projects.
* Provide regular market intelligence, competitor insights and customer feedback to Zehnder’s global leadership team.



  





**2\. Ventilation, Fresh\-Air \& Indoor Climate Business Development** 



* Lead market development for Zehnder’s balanced energy recovery ventilation systems
 **(ERV/ HRV, fresh air)** 
 with focus on the residential market.
* Build demand around the need for healthy indoor air, controlled ventilation, humidity management, energy efficiency and premium indoor comfort.
* Educate the market on the difference between air purification, air\-conditioning and engineered balanced energy recovery ventilation systems.
* Position Zehnder as a premium, technically superior and performance\-led indoor climate solution provider.



  





**3\. Premium / Luxury Project Sales** 



* Identify and develop opportunities in premium and luxury building projects.
* Target relevant segments such as luxury residential developments, branded residences, HNI villas, premium apartments, wellness spaces, high\-end hospitality, international schools, healthcare and select green building projects.
* Build relationships with premium developers, architects, interior designers, consultants, villa owners, project owners and HNI\-focused ecosystem partners.
* Sell on value, performance, comfort, health, acoustics, energy efficiency and lifecycle benefit, not on price alone.



  





**4\. Specification \& Project Sales** 



* Drive specification\-led selling by engaging architects, MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, green building consultants, PMCs, developers and contractors.
* Influence projects at the design and specification stage, before tendering and commercial negotiation.
* Develop technical presentations, concept notes and project\-specific value propositions.
* Support the creation of BOQ inputs, specification language, product comparisons, technical submittals and project proposals.
* Ensure that Zehnder is positioned as a system solution, not merely a product or equipment supplier.



  





**5\. Partner Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate and develop suitable channel partners, system partners, installers, integrators and commissioning partners.
* Build a limited but high\-quality partner network capable of selling, installing and servicing premium ventilation systems.
* Train partners on Zehnder’s product value proposition, installation standards, commissioning discipline and customer experience expectations.
* Ensure that partners have the capability to support premium projects and maintain Zehnder’s brand standards.
* Develop a partner model that protects pricing, service quality, installation quality and long\-term customer satisfaction.



  





**6\. Technical Selling \& Customer Education** 



* Explain Zehnder’s solutions convincingly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate the benefits of balanced ventilation, fresh\-air supply, energy recovery, humidity control, filtration, low\-noise operation and indoor air quality.
* Conduct presentations, seminars, consultant meetings, architect discussions, CPD\-style sessions and industry engagements.
* Build awareness among the market that premium indoor climate is about air quality, comfort, health and performance \- not only cooling.



  





**7\. Brand Representation \& Executive Presence** 



* Act as the face of Zehnder in India.
* Represent the company in senior client meetings, industry forums, trade events, consultant interactions and partner discussions.
* Build credibility with Indian stakeholders while maintaining alignment with Zehnder’s European quality, brand and business standards.
* Communicate clearly with Zehnder’s global leadership team on India market realities, opportunities, challenges and progress.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





**Experience** 



* 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, ventilation, building technology, indoor air quality, air filtration, fresh\-air systems, ERV/HRV, heat recovery, energy recovery, related technical building solutions.
* Experience in premium or specification\-led project sales is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to international companies, European brands, premium technical products or MNC environments will be an advantage.
* Experience in building a new business vertical, product category, region, partner network or market from an early stage will be highly valued.



  





**Product / Sector Exposure** 




 The ideal candidate should have exposure to one or more of the following:
 


* **Balanced energy recovery ventilation systems (ERV/ HRV, fresh air)**
* **Residential ventilation systems**
* Heat recovery / energy recovery
* Indoor air quality solutions
* Air filtration / clean\-air solutions
* Premium HVAC systems
* Green building / energy\-efficient building solutions



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a commercially strong, self\-driven professional with a builder mindset. The right candidate will be someone who has the maturity of working with international companies, but also the agility, ownership, and entrepreneurial drive required to build a business in a new market.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 ▪ Strong business development and pipeline creation capability
 



 ▪ Ability to build markets, channels, and partnerships from the ground up
 



 ▪ Commercially sharp and opportunity\-driven
 



 ▪ Strong network in HVAC / ventilation / building technology ecosystem
 



 ▪ Good understanding of specification\-led and project\-led sales
 



 ▪ Ability to work independently with limited local infrastructure
 



 ▪ High ownership, initiative, and accountability
 



 ▪ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 



 ▪ Comfortable working with international leadership teams
 



 ▪ Strategic thinking with hands\-on execution capability
 



  





**Why This Role Is Exciting**

 ▪ First commercial leadership role for Zehnder in India
 



 ▪ High ownership and visibility with global leadership
 



 ▪ Opportunity to shape market strategy, channel structure, and early business growth
 



 ▪ Ideal role for a professional who enjoys building, not just managing.

 **slow\-moving, non\-moving, obsolete and excess inventory** 
 .
* Define SKU\-wise liquidation priorities based on ageing, value, demand and margin.
* Monitor inventory turnover and ensure continuous stock movement.
* Develop mechanisms to prevent inventory from becoming stagnant.



  




 2\. Data \& Inventory Analytics
 * Analyse
 **inventory ageing, stock holding, sell\-through, inventory turnover, sales velocity and SKU performance** 
 .
* Prepare regular MIS and dashboards for inventory movement and liquidation.
* Identify dead stock and excess inventory through data\-driven analysis.
* Analyse customer purchase patterns and historical sales to identify potential buyers for specific inventory.
* Track liquidation value, recovery value, discount impact and margin realization.



  




 3\. Customer \& Market Development
 * Build and maintain a strong network of
 **distributors, dealers, retailers, workshops and other trade customers** 
 .
* Proactively approach customers for specific slow\-moving or excess SKUs.
* Map available inventory against customer demand and market requirements.
* Develop alternate sales channels for products with low regular movement.
* Maintain strong market intelligence on pricing, demand and competitor activity.



  




 4\. Pricing \& Discount Management
 * Design
 **SKU\-wise/customer\-wise discount structures** 
 for inventory liquidation.
* Determine appropriate discount levels based on stock ageing, purchase cost, market price and expected recovery.
* Balance liquidation speed with
 **gross margin and contribution margin** 
 .
* Develop promotional/bulk\-buying offers for ageing inventory.
* Monitor the impact of discounts on inventory recovery and profitability.



  




 5\. Commercial \& Working Capital Management
 * Focus on reducing
 **working capital blocked in inventory** 
 .
* Monitor inventory value versus sales velocity.
* Identify opportunities to convert dormant inventory into cash.
* Coordinate with Finance, Sales, Purchase and Warehouse teams for liquidation decisions.
* Recommend purchase controls based on inventory performance and demand trends.



  




 6\. Process \& Control
 * Establish SKU\-level inventory movement targets.
* Create ageing buckets and liquidation action plans.
* Set up regular review mechanisms for
 **30/60/90/120\+ day inventory** 
 .
* Develop escalation processes for high\-value and long\-ageing inventory.
* Maintain accurate records of liquidation activities, pricing approvals and customer conversions.



  




 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Inventory Turnover Ratio
* Reduction in 90\+/120\+ day ageing inventory
* Slow \& Non\-Moving Inventory Reduction
* Inventory Liquidation Value
* Inventory Recovery %
* Stock\-to\-Sales Ratio
* Gross Margin / Contribution Margin
* Discount vs. Recovery Analysis
* Working Capital Released
* SKU Sell\-Through Rate
* Reduction in Dead Stock



  




 Candidate Profile
 * **5–12 years of relevant experience** 
 in inventory liquidation, inventory management, commercial operations, sales or stock optimization.
* **Mandatory experience in Auto Spare Parts \& Accessories industry.**
* Strong understanding of
 **automotive spare parts, accessories, brands, applications and aftermarket distribution** 
 .
* Strong customer and market network in the automotive aftermarket.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **inventory ageing and liquidation strategies** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of pricing, discounting, margins and commercial negotiations.
* Advanced Excel/MIS and strong data interpretation skills.
* Experience working with
 **ERP/inventory management systems** 
 .
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take commercially sound decisions.



  




 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate is someone who understands that
 **inventory is not an asset if it is not moving** 
 . The person should be commercially strong, highly data\-driven and well connected with the automotive aftermarket, with the ability to convert
 **ageing and excess inventory into sales and cash while protecting margins** 
 .

We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 Operating at the intersection of logistics and tech has allowed Flexport to develop a unique value proposition that customers all over the globe love, resulting in exponential growth over the last 10 years. As part of our mission to make global trade easy for everyone, we are expanding and growing our sales organization in the India Subcontinent region.

You'll be part of a high\-performing team and in the driver's seat to establish our presence in the region, while providing tech\-enabled freight solutions that address customer needs.
   

  

**You Will Be:**

**You Should Have:**

title: Brand Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Us** 




  





**Tooused** 
 powers circularity for India's leading brands, retailers, textile producers, and households.
 



  





**Tooused's** 
 vision is to divert 1 billion textiles from landfill by 2030, recycling them for a second life instead, and we’re on track to do it with India's first full\-stack textile recycling platform. This platform is setting the course for the future of the industry, connecting textile waste to responsible end\-of\-life options, meaningfully addressing the textile waste crisis, and redefining the sustainability narrative for the next generation – to one that is win\-win\-win for brands, consumers, and our planet.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 We are building
 **TakeBack** 
 for Brands. It gives a brand everything it needs to run its own take\-back programme without building any of it, including reverse logistics across the country, chain of custody on every garment, and the reporting brands will need as India's textile EPR rules take shape.
 



  





 We already have early interest from brands like NewMe, No Nasties, Mahina and Debaans. What we do not have yet is one person who owns this line end to end. That is this role.
 



  





 You will be the first commercial hire on
 **TakeBack** 
 . You will find the brands, run the pitch, close the deal, and then stay on to get the programme live with our ops and tech teams. This is not a role where you hand off after signature. At our stage, the person who sells it is the person who makes it work.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Build and run the brand pipeline, from cold outreach and events to inbound and referrals
* Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, pitch, commercials, negotiation and close
* Design each brand's take\-back programme with them, covering collection format, customer incentive, logistics flow and reporting
* Work with our ops and tech teams to launch signed brands and keep them running
* Be the brand's main point of contact after go\-live, and own renewal and expansion
* Build the pitch materials as you go, including decks, pricing models, and case studies
* Track what is and is not working in the funnel and tell us plainly
* Keep on top of EPR and textile regulation in India, and translate it into a reason for brands to act now



  





**What we are looking for** 





 This is a hands\-on commercial role with responsibility for building the pipeline, winning business, and getting programmes live.
 




  




* **2 to 5 years** 
 in B2B retail sales, partnerships, key accounts, or category management
* Background in fashion, retail, D2C, sustainability
* **Create opportunities proactively:** 
 You will research brands, identify decision\-makers, initiate outreach, and follow up consistently. The founders will support important conversations; you will own keeping opportunities moving.
* **Work towards agreed outcomes:** 
 We will set targets for qualified brand conversations, proposals, signed agreements, and programme launches. A qualified conversation should establish a relevant need, the decision\-making process, and a clear next step.
* **Keep the pipeline current:** 
 Record meaningful activity in our shared CRM or tracker by the next working day. Every active opportunity should show the contact, latest discussion, stage, next action, and follow\-up date.
* **Make progress and blockers visible:** 
 Share a weekly update covering what moved forward, what stalled, why, and what support you need. Raise risks early and recommend a next step.
* **Own delivery with the team:** 
 Confirm operational and technical feasibility before making commitments. After signature, coordinate the launch, track open issues, and keep the brand informed until they are resolved.
* **Ensure continuity:** 
 When an account changes hands or your engagement ends, provide an organised handover covering contacts, commitments, documents, pending actions, and timelines. Another team member should be able to continue the work from those records.



  





**What we are not looking for** 




  




* Someone who only wants to work warm inbound
* Someone who needs a fully built product, a fixed price list, and a finished deck on day one
* Someone who treats sustainability as a talking point rather than an operating problem



  





**Why this is worth your time** 




  





 Textile EPR is coming to India. When it lands, every mid and large apparel brand in the country will need a take\-back partner, and very few will want to build the infrastructure themselves. We already have the grid running. This role is the person who turns that into a business before the rules force everyone to catch up.
 



  





 You will report directly to the founder, and you will own the line rather than a slice of it. If it works, you build the team under it.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Fixed salary plus performance\-linked incentive on signed and launched brands. ESOPs on the table for the right person. We will talk numbers openly in the first call.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 Send your CV to hello@tooused.com with a short note on one brand you think should be running a take\-back programme in India and how you would get to them. We read those notes.
