**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Technical Lead \- SAP Global Trade System
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req26707**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Technical Lead in this position will be offering the full scale of global functional SAP Global Trade System services to corporate and regional units around the globe. Also, provide support and define global trade processes, manage embargoes, and offers a solution for Denied Party Screening of Linde’s business partners.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* In this role, you will proactive consulting services based on industry practices leveraging previous project experiences in the SAP GTS areas as described (incl. e.g. user authorisations, reports, jobs, table structures, new functionality, system integration/interfaces)
* You will be part of Business projects and enhancements/continuous improvements lik analysis of user requirement received from customer/work effort estimation/create functional specification documenting the solution
* Create the functional solution design which includes SAP standard customizing as well as technical specifications delivered by the development team by using SAP SolMan as Change Management system
* And Perform unit testing, system integration\- \& functional (IT\-) testing
* Supporting customer during user acceptance testing and regression testing. Resolve defects identified during the testing cycles. Support cut over planning/execution and hyper care phase after go\-live
* Conducting workshops and training sessions to gather requirements and provide knowledge transfer
* You will be contributing to Incident Management / Service requests (3rd Level Support) incl. analyzing and resolving the reported issue
* Supporting to perform system upgrades, integrations, and testing


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* Must have at least 7\+ years of experience in a SAP GTS solution based functional role.
* Academic degree in Business Administration or – Informatics or a certificated IT education min. 10\+ year professional experience in IT processes and ITIL
* Also, practical experience of IT Service Management Processes such as software change and/or release management or application management experience
* You must have the ability to debug SAP code to a certain extent to resolve low level incidents.
* Experience in SAP GTS Edition for Hana with debugging, integration knowledge with other SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Also, effective communication skills are required to influence stakeholders to achieve support and consistency of the overall IT strategies and policies, specifically in their own subject areas.
* Must have excellent analytical skills, together with the ability to think "outside the box".
* Foreign Trade Zone handling within GTS incl. Material balancing


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde Plc. is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2024 sales of $33 billion and 65,000 employees spread across multiple countries. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
   

  

 We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
   

  

 Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

title: Senior Sales Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Pascal Switchcare India Pvt. Ltd., founded in 2007, is a leading manufacturer of medium voltage indoor and outdoor vacuum circuit breakers, control relay panels, and IEC\-61439 compliant TTA LV panels. The company has supplied over 60,,000 panels to more than 500 customers across India and international markets, reflecting strong industry trust and reach. Pascal’s designs strictly follow IEC guidelines, ensuring safety, performance, reliability, and seamless interoperability with other systems. The organization emphasizes advanced technology integration and high\-quality standards to deliver efficient, reliable solutions. Guided by the motto “We Care More..We Try Harder,” Pascal focuses on close client collaboration, commissioning support, and responsive service to minimize downtime and enhance customer satisfaction.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Senior Sales Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Gurgaon\-Haryana, The role involves identifying and developing business opportunities for medium voltage and LV panel solutions, conducting technical and commercial discussions with clients, and preparing proposals, quotations, and technical documentation. The Senior Sales Engineer will provide pre\-sales technical support, participate in product demonstrations and site visits, and liaise with engineering and production teams to ensure accurate solutions and timely delivery. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include managing key accounts, handling customer queries, coordinating commissioning and after\-sales support, and maintaining detailed records of opportunities, forecasts, and sales activities. The role also requires continuous market research, competitor analysis, and contribution to sales strategies to achieve revenue and growth targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in Sales Engineering and Sales for electrical equipment, panels, or related industrial products.
* Hands\-on experience in Technical Support, including pre\-sales consultations, solution design inputs, and coordination during commissioning.
* Demonstrated skills in Communication and Customer Service for managing client relationships, negotiations, and issue resolution.
* Proven ability to work with cross\-functional teams (engineering, production, service) to deliver tailored solutions within agreed timelines.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field; advanced technical certifications are an advantage.
* Knowledge of medium voltage systems, control relay panels, and IEC standards; experience in panel manufacturing or power distribution industry preferred.
* Comfort with on\-site visits, field work, and travel within the region as required.
* Strong analytical, presentation, and documentation skills, with proficiency in common office and CRM software.

title: Sales Marketing Coordinator
description:
**Company Description** 
 JB Electronics, founded in 2019 by Jay Jani, is a growing provider of electrical automation solutions, panel manufacturing, and custom PCB design. The company supports industries, OEMs, and machinery manufacturers with high\-quality control panels, Multispan instruments, and custom\-designed panels that prioritize safety, efficiency, and precision. As an Authorized Dealer of Multispan Instruments, JB Electronics offers genuine products backed by technical support. The business is expanding into wire harness and cable connector assemblies, aiming to be a one\-stop solution for electrical integration and automation. With a customer\-first approach, JB Electronics focuses on long\-term partnerships through quality, timely service, and tailored technical support.

 The Sales Marketing Coordinator is a full\-time hybrid role based in Ahmedabad, with a mix of on\-site work and some work\-from\-home flexibility. title: Area Sales Manager

Royal Tint’s products are designed to meet and set industry standards, offering innovative options for a wide range of applications.

Day\-to\-day tasks include identifying and engaging potential customers, conducting product presentations and demonstrations, negotiating contracts and pricing, and ensuring timely follow\-up on leads. The Area Sales Manager will collaborate with the operations and customer support teams to ensure smooth order fulfillment and high\-quality service. The role also involves tracking sales performance, preparing reports, analyzing market trends, and contributing to regional sales strategies.

* Candidates should possess strong sales and business development skills, including lead generation, account management, and negotiation.

* Candidates should possess market research and strategic planning skills to identify opportunities, analyze competition, and support regional growth plans.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field is desirable.
* Ability to travel within the region, work independently, and meet sales targets consistently.

 **YOU MAKE MONEY** 
 . Period.
 



 Most freshers are looking for a "safe" job. This is not that job. Safe is boring. Safe doesn't build empires.

 We are looking for an Associate Career Consultant.
 **Basically, we are looking for a Future Leader. Someone who is smart, dangerously ambitious,** 
 and believes they can figure out the answer to
 
*any* 
  question on Earth. You will be personally trained by the Founders. You will not be served coffee; you will be taught how to think, sell, and strategize like a CEO.

 , an Executive Career Management Firm. We don't just "advise" or "fix resumes"; we engineer careers. We believe in
 **unlocking potential, fostering growth, and guiding individuals towards career success.**

 . We don’t expect you to know everything from day one;

 You will be working directly with the
 **Founders** 
 , learning the art of
 **American business strategy** 
 while disrupting the

 .
 



  





**"Don't just find a job. Help us fix the system."** 




  





**Team Culture:** 




 We’ve created a
 **fun, safe space** 
 for you to
 **brainstorm** 
 , ask questions, and find solutions. Everyone is encouraged to share their
 **ideas for positive change** 
 , no matter what role or level.
 



  





**We support and lift one another** 
 and help each other become better. Recognition, integrity, and the desire to help others are our winning combination.
 



  





**Who We’re Looking For?** 




 We value
 **skills over titles and potential over experience.** 
 If you identify with the following traits, we encourage you to apply:

  You will be talking to US\-based clients. You cannot just be "fluent"; you must be articulate, persuasive, and confident.

  If we ask you a question you don't know, your answer isn't "I don't know." It is

* **Researcher –** 
 Whether it’s understanding industry trends, job markets, or professional growth strategies, you know how to find and present valuable insights.

title: Territory Business Associate
description:
**About Aipri Lifesciences LLP** 




 Established in 2025 and headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Aipri Lifesciences is an emerging, fast\-growing medical device company dedicated to delivering high\-quality surgical solutions. Founded and led by a medical doctor with extensive cross\-functional experience in clinical research and pharma medical affairs, Aipri bridges the gap between clinical necessity and technical excellence.
 



  





**What We Do** 




 We specialize in the technical design, material specification, and commercialization of premium surgical consumables, including advanced braided sutures (like Aicryl Polyglactin 910\) and surgical skin glue. Driven by a commitment to superior patient outcomes, we are aggressively expanding our product portfolio into a wider array of advanced medical instruments and devices.
 



  





**Our Vision \& Culture** 




 Our vision is to build Aipri into a highly respected, successful brand with a global reach. We are grounded in the core values of honesty, humility, intelligence, and kindness. At Aipri, we maintain a positive, realistic, and dependable work environment that respects the balance between ambitious business growth and personal peace of mind.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 Working at Aipri means joining a forward\-thinking, doctor\-led enterprise where your contributions directly impact the healthcare ecosystem. We offer structured compensation models, a clear strategic roadmap, and a collaborative environment where disciplined, dependable, and intellectually driven professionals can thrive and build a meaningful career.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Operation Theater (OT) Engagement:** 
 Spend active time in hospital OT environments, supporting surgeons and OT teams during product evaluation to build clinical confidence in Aipri’s suture portfolio.



  




* **Surgeon \& Specialty Coverage:** 
 Build and maintain direct relationships with key surgeons across multiple specialties (General Surgery, OB\-GYN, Orthopedics).



  




* **Territory \& Account Management:** 
 Map private hospitals, nursing homes, and day\-care surgical centers in assigned Ahmedabad clusters; identify new accounts and drive repeat orders.



  




* **Institutional \& Purchase Coordination:** 
 Engage Hospital Purchase Managers, Procurement Teams, and OT Sisters\-in\-Charge to facilitate product code listings, vendor registration, and seamless ordering.



  




* **Supply \& Delivery Support:** 
 Coordinate with the internal operations team to ensure direct, next\-day product delivery to hospital clients and manage local inventory needs.



  




* **Market \& Competitor Intelligence:** 
 Track local surgeon preference shifts, competitor activity, and hospital procurement dynamics, reporting field insights directly to leadership.



  





**Candidate Profile \& Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy (B.Pharm / M.Pharm), Biotechnology, or related fields.
* 1 to 3 years in Surgical Devices, Medical Consumables, OT Products, or Clinical Hospital Sales in Ahmedabad.
* Fully comfortable working within the Operation Theater (OT) environment and interacting directly with surgical teams.
* Existing contacts with surgeons, OT staff, and hospital purchase departments across key Ahmedabad surgical clusters.
* Strong scientific learning aptitude, relationship\-building skills, commercial negotiation ability, and high integrity.
* Must own a two\-wheeler with a valid driving license for daily local territory coverage.



  





**Field Working Structure \& Culture** 



* Working Days: Monday to Saturday.
* Field Timings: Aligned with surgeon availability and OT schedules (starts at 9:30 AM; flexible field wrap\-up based on daily doctor appointments and hospital rounds).
* Compensation: Competitive fixed salary (commensurate with experience) \+ Daily Local Conveyance Allowance (TA/DA) \+ Incentives.

This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). **Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.
* Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go\-live, and post\-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace.
* Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields.
* Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud\-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/data protection tooling such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Purview, DSPM platforms, Python, and related enterprise engineering tools.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated\-industry depth.
* Experience with pricing inputs, solution estimation, and technical deal shaping.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. title: Marketing Lead
description:
**Company Description** 
 iTCart is a technology company focused on transforming how modern enterprises operate by embedding intelligence, accountability, and operational discipline into core business execution. Its flagship platform, AiXHub™, is an AI\-native operating system that delivers governed autonomy, real\-time SLA enforcement, and clear explainability for high\-stakes organizational workflows. AiXHub™ is built to work across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, and hybrid environments, helping enterprises manage complexity, scale, and compliance. iTCart is led by experienced technologists and industry leaders across sectors such as IT, manufacturing, insurance, healthcare administration, financial services, and public\-sector shared services. The company serves mid\-sized and large organizations that require precision, traceability, and strong governance in their day\-to\-day operations.
 



  





  





**Marketing Lead** 




  





 Role title Marketing Lead, AiXMarketing
 



 Team AiXMarketing, iTCart (IT Cart Private Limited)
 



 Reports to \[Insert \- Founder / CEO / CMO]
 



 Direct reports Content Writer \& Strategist, Social Media Executive, AEO/SEO/GEO Executive, design and apprentice roles
 



  





 Experience : 3 \- 4 years in B2B marketing, including at least 2 leading a team
 



 Employment type : Full\-time
 



 Location: Bengaluru
 



 Markets served India and United States (Northwest Ohio focus)
 



  





 THE ROLE :
 



 We are looking for someone who can hold the whole picture: seven product lines, two geographies, several brand ecosystems and a small team, and then make hard decisions about where to concentrate rather than spreading everything thin.
 



  





 The first job is diagnosis. Before anything gets planned, we want someone who will audit what exists, sit with sales, talk to buyers, look honestly at where our marketing is absent versus where our buyers actually are, and tell us plainly what is broken. The plan comes after that, not before.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on leadership role in a company where marketing is expected to contribute to pipeline, not just to awareness. You will build the strategy and you will still write, edit and review real work.
 



  





 What you will do :
 



  





 Strategy and prioritisation
 



 • Own the annual and quarterly marketing plan across product lines and both geographies.
 



 • Build the positioning and messaging architecture \- what each product claims, for whom, and how it is different from what else the buyer is looking at.
 



 • Decide where we concentrate and, just as importantly, what we stop doing. A plan that covers everything covers nothing.
 



 • Set the budget and defend how it is allocated.
 



  





 Market research and gap analysis
 



 • Run structured category and competitor research \- how rivals position, price, message and where they are weak.
 



 • Define and keep sharpening the ideal customer profile and the buying committee for each product line.
 



 • Conduct gap analysis: where buyers are looking versus where we appear, which questions we do not answer, which formats and channels we are absent from, and which segments are under\-served.
 



 • Feed win and loss reasons back into positioning, working directly with sales rather than from a dashboard.
 



 • Track category shifts \- including how AI\-driven search and answer engines are changing where buyers discover vendors \- and adjust before it costs us visibility.
 



  





 Demand generation and pipeline
 



 • Design and run campaigns that produce qualified pipeline, not just traffic.
 



 • Agree funnel definitions and handoff rules with sales, and hold both sides to them.
 



 • Run account\-based work for named enterprise targets, including our Northwest Ohio focus accounts.
 



 • Own webinars, events and partner activity where they earn their cost.
 



  





 Brand, content and channels
 



 • Set the editorial direction and hold the quality bar on everything published.
 



 • Maintain brand consistency across iTCart and associated brand ecosystems.
 



 • Build the leadership team into visible voices in the category \- founder and executive thought leadership is often the highest\-return channel in B2B.
 



 • Oversee SEO, AEO and GEO, website, LinkedIn, email and paid where it is justified.
 



 • Enforce claim discipline, particularly for healthcare and BFSI audiences where a published claim is read as a commitment.
 



  





 Team and operations
 



 • Hire, coach and retain a small, high\-output team across content, social, search and design.
 



 • Set KPIs and KRAs, run review cadences, and give feedback that people can act on.
 



 • Manage agencies, freelancers and vendors, including negotiation and performance review.
 



 • Build the reporting rhythm \- monthly to leadership, with honest accounting of what failed and what changed as a result.
 



  





 What success looks like
 



  





 Horizon : What we expect
 



 First 30 days : A completed audit of current marketing across channels, products and both markets. Time spent with sales and with at least a few customers. A baseline set of numbers. A written diagnosis of the three biggest gaps, presented to leadership.
 



  





 First 90 days : A prioritised plan with an explicit list of what we are not doing this quarter. Team KPIs and review cadence in place. Positioning and messaging tightened for at least the two highest\-priority product lines. Monthly reporting running.
 



  





 Six months : Measurable marketing contribution to pipeline, with an agreed definition of what that means. A team producing quality work without daily direction. Sales pulling marketing assets rather than asking for them. A clear point of view in the market that did not exist before.
 



  





 What we are looking for :
 



  





 Essential
 



 • 3 \- 6 years in B2B marketing, with at least two years leading people.
 



 • You have owned a full marketing plan, not just a channel. You can walk us through one you built, what you cut from it, and what happened.
 



 • Real research capability. Competitive analysis, category research and gap analysis that produced a decision, not a slide deck.
 



 • Fluency with enterprise sales cycles and genuine working alignment with a sales team \- including the difficult conversations about lead quality.
 



 • Data literacy. GA4, CRM, LinkedIn and campaign data at a level where you can interrogate the numbers yourself rather than waiting for a report.
 



 • Experience marketing to both Indian and international buyers, and an understanding that the difference is proof and procurement, not spelling.
 



 • Strong writing, and the editorial judgement to improve someone else’s draft without rewriting it into your own voice.
 



 • Current on AI\-era discovery \- AEO and GEO, how answer engines cite sources \- and on AI tooling in a marketing workflow.
 



  





 Nice to have
 



 • Enterprise AI, SaaS or IT services background.
 



 • Marketing into regulated sectors \- healthcare, banking and financial services, or the public sector.
 



 • Account\-based marketing experience against named enterprise targets.
 



 • US mid\-market experience, particularly outside the coastal metros.
 



 • Agency\-side experience, or having built a marketing function from a standing start.
 



 • Experience managing multiple brands or sub\-brands simultaneously.
 



  





 Who this role is not for
 



  





 We would rather be honest now than lose you a few months in.
 



 • If you want to run brand and communications without being accountable for pipeline, this is not that role.
 



 • If you need a large budget and a big team to be effective, you will struggle here. The resourcing is real but modest, and prioritisation is the core skill.
 



 • If you no longer want to write or edit, this will not suit you. It is a hands\-on lead role.
 



 • If you prefer to keep a plan intact rather than change it when the data disagrees, we will find that difficult.
 



  





 How we hire
 



  





 Stage : Format : What we are looking at
 



 1 : Application \- review Track record, scope of what you have owned, the note you send with your CV
 



  





 2 : Screening call (30 minutes) \- Scope, team size, motivation, compensation expectations
 



 3 : Panel interview (75–90 minutes) \- Strategy, research and gap analysis, sales alignment, team leadership
 



 4 : Second Round Interview \- Final round of interview with Head of the Department. Evaluating Technical proficiency \& Team fit.
 



 5 : Leadership conversation and references \- Fit with founders, expectations, offer
 



  





 To apply
 



 Send your CV and a short note answering one question: what is the single biggest gap you see in how iTCart markets itself today, and what would you do about it first?
 



 One well\-argued page will get further with us than a full audit. We are interested in how you think, and specifically in whether you can identify what matters before you have all the information.
 



  





 Applications to aixstaffing@itcart.ai

 **PMT practice**
 CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or trainings.
   

  

**YOUR TEAM.**
 This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with innovative marketers to execute on brand awareness and lead generation campaigns across industry verticals and buyer roles. You will work cross\-functionally with our U.S. based marketing team and business units, and external developers to execute campaigns and the digital roadmap.
   

  

**WHY COHNREZNICK?**
 At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.
   

  

 We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning \& development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE.**
 This full time, direct hire position offers the opportunity to collaborate with innovative marketers to execute on brand awareness and lead generation campaigns across industry verticals and buyer roles. In this role, you will be responsible for executing a comprehensive website strategy, optimizing for both on\-page and off\-page SEO/AEO/GEO, and managing day\-to\-day website operations and enhancements. This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in shaping CohnReznick’s online presence and driving our digital marketing initiatives. The ideal candidate for this role is passionate about website management, detail oriented, and thrives when given the opportunity to be hands\-on and test new ideas.
   

  

 This role will work directly with the digital marketing team and manager based in Chennai. You will collaborate with key internal stakeholders to maintain and execute projects to enhance our digital presence through showcasing our corporate, thought leadership, and recruiting content.
   

  

 You will report to the Digital Manager and collaborate with other members of the marketing team to manage content development, update the site and organize ongoing enhancements to the user experience. Current efforts include performing daily content updates to CohnReznick’s site, updating landing pages on the site, creating new pages, analyzing metrics, staying current with industry best practices, and being comfortable juggling multiple projects simultaneously.

* Design and build conversion rate optimized web pages to maximize lead generation and customer acquisition.

* Collaborate with U.S. based content and creative team to execute and optimize campaigns.

* Ability to troubleshoot and solve technical issues quickly
* Experience with Optimizely or similar CXP platform to manage website content and SEO.
* Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple projects
* Highly analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Strong organizational skills and superior attention to detail
* Tech savvy with interest in learning new programs and proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint

 **Universal Job Standards.**

At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.

title: GROWTH EXECUTIVE
description:
Growth Executive – Student Engagement \& Memberships
   

  

* Reports to the Success Manager


 We're hiring someone whose whole job is to bring people back.
   

  

 Every fitness company talks about new sign\-ups. Fewer talk about the student who trained hard for four months, then life happened — a project, a move, a bad week — and hasn't logged in since.
   

  

 That student is who this role is for.
   

  

 Why this role exists
   

  

 In 2026, our growth is driven as much by the students already with us as by new sign\-ups. Attendance, re\-activation and renewals are where the next chapter is won.
   

  

 You'll design comeback campaigns for students who've gone quiet, work with our coaches to understand why people drop off, own renewals end to end, and make sure the membership experience — plan changes, payments, the lot — feels seamless.
   

  

 It's a role for someone who can invent a campaign on Monday and cheerfully chase a pending payment on Tuesday. Creative and operationally disciplined. Warm on the phone, sharp in the spreadsheet.
   

  

 You'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our coaching team, because engagement problems are rarely just data problems. They're human ones.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

 Engagement \& re\-activation
   

  

* Plan and run engagement campaigns for inactive, low\-attendance and at\-risk students
* Design creative re\-engagement initiatives — comeback programmes, challenges, win\-back offers, milestone moments
* Work closely with coaches to understand why students drop off, and turn that into
* interventions that actually move attendance


 Memberships \& renewals
   

  

* Communicate with current and past students on attendance, renewals and plan options
* Support membership growth through renewals and relevant cross\-sell and up\-sell conversations — consultative, never transactional
* Own renewal payment follow\-ups end to end. This is a critical part of the role


 Data \& reporting
   

  

* Track and analyse engagement, attendance and membership data to support decisions
* Maintain accurate membership and engagement records in our CRM
* Produce regular reports on engagement, renewals and revenue against quarterly targets


 How you'll work
   

  

* Use CRM tools and Google Workspace to track every effort — nothing lives only in your head
* Look for the automation, then keep the human touch on top of it
* Bring a growth mindset and a start\-up mentality


 What we need from you
   

  

* 2\+ years in customer success, account management, community management, inside sales or a closely related role. Exceptional freshers with the right temperament are welcome to apply
* Strong English communication, verbal and written. You'll write campaign copy and have renewal conversations on the same day
* Comfort owning payment and renewal follow\-ups — persistent, organised, and never awkward about it
* High proficiency with Google Workspace / MS Office, and hands\-on experience with an online CRM
* Ability to read data and turn it into an action, not just a chart
* Creative thinking paired with operational discipline — you can invent a campaign and also run the checklist that ships it
* A calm, patient, empathetic manner with students. Many of the people you'll speak to left because life got hard
* Based in Chennai and able to work on\-site with the coaching team


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience in a B2C, subscription or membership\-led business
* Background in fitness, sports, wellness or education
* Hands\-on with marketing automation or CRM workflow building — WhatsApp or email journeys, lifecycle campaigns
* Spreadsheets beyond the basics — pivots, cohort views, retention curves
* A training practice of your own. It helps you speak our students' language


 Your first 90 days
   

  

 First 30 days You know our membership plans, CRM and student segments cold. You've run your first re\-activation outreach list and sat in on classes with the coaching team. By day 60 You own the renewals follow\-up cycle independently. A first comeback campaign is designed, shipped and measured. By day 90 You're reporting engagement, renewals and revenue on a regular cadence, and you've brought a measurable lift in attendance or renewal rate on at least one student segment.
   

  

 What you get
   

  

* A balanced, respectful work culture that respects your life outside work
* Free membership at The Quad — train with coaches who've transformed thousands of lives
* Health insurance, annual health checkups and wellness support
* Industry\-standard salaries and a generous leave policy
* The chance to positively affect someone's health every single day


 How to apply
   

  

 Use the form below. Along with your details, send us a short note on a time you brought a lapsed customer, member or student back. That note matters more to us than a cover letter.
   

  

 We read every application, and you'll hear from us either way.
   

  

 The Quad is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on capability, character and fit with how we coach.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER
description:
StrongHer by The Quad
   

  

* Reports to the Marketing Manager


 Every post is a chance to get one more woman to believe she can get strong.
   

  

 StrongHer is a brand under The Quad, built with one mission: get 10,000 women strength training. Not "fit" in the vague, generic sense — strong.
   

  

 We built StrongHer around the real constraints women face — cost, time, location — which is why the programme is entirely virtual, designed to fit into a woman's life instead of asking her to rearrange it around fitness.
   

  

 We need someone who can carry that mission online.
   

  

**What This Role Is About**
 This is end\-to\-end ownership of StrongHer's social media — the content, the calendar, the voice, and the conversations that happen in the comments and DMs.
   

  

 You'll design, edit and write content that makes women stop scrolling and start believing StrongHer is for them. You'll sit with our students, hear where they started and what changed, and turn that into something honest.
   

  

 You don't need years behind you. You need range, taste, and opinions you're willing to say out loud.
   

  

 What you'll be doing
   

  

* Owning the content calendar — planning what goes out, when, and why, so content is consistent and intentional, not last\-minute
* Designing posts, carousels and social creatives that are clean, aesthetic and instantly easy to consume — Canva or equivalent should be second nature
* Editing organic videos and reels that hook fast, hold attention and tell a story. Use whatever software you like, as long as the result is on brand and has a clear narrative
* Writing scripts, captions and story content that sound like a real woman talking to another woman — not brand copy
* Staying on top of Instagram — new formats, algorithm shifts, what's trending and what's dying — and bringing that into the content rather than reacting to it after the fact
* Meeting StrongHer students to learn their real stories — their starting point, their struggles, their wins — and bringing those to life as testimonials, transformation stories and behind\-the\-scenes content
* Responding to DMs, comments and community engagement. You're often the first, and the most human, touchpoint someone has with StrongHer
* Tracking performance — keeping the social media dashboard updated, and reading the numbers to shape what gets made next, not just to report on what already happened
* Supporting shoots for paid ad content. Our performance agency owns paid strategy and creative; you'll help bring their scripts to life on the ground


 What we're looking for
   

  

 Must\-haves
   

  

* A portfolio showing both design and video work. Range matters more than years of experience — if you're just starting out, show us what you can do
* Strong writing samples — captions, scripts or story content that show you can connect, not just construct sentences
* A real understanding of Instagram — what makes someone stop, watch and follow
* Comfortable working with data — reading numbers and translating them into content decisions


 Good to have
   

  

* Prior content experience in fitness, wellness or a mission\-driven brand
* Familiarity with AI tools for design or video editing


 The kind of person we're looking for
   

  

* Sees value in the mission
* Into fitness, or curious to get into it. You don't need to be training already, but you should want to understand why strength training changes lives
* Has opinions and says them — "here's what I'd do and why", not just "sent for approval" Empathetic enough to sit with a student, hear her story, and turn it into something honest rather than polished into blandness
* Takes ownership without needing to be chased


 What you get
   

  

* A balanced, respectful work culture that respects your life outside work
* Free membership at The Quad
* Health insurance, annual health checkups and wellness support
* Industry\-standard salaries and a generous leave policy
* Work that visibly changes how women see themselves. You'll see it in the DMs


 How to apply
   

  

 Use the form below, and send us your portfolio — design work and video, both. If you've written captions or scripts you're proud of, include those too. We read every application, and you'll hear from us either way. The Quad is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Oracle CDP/Unity- Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle CDP/Unity Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on working with Oracle's suite of applications and tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, marketing automation, and customer experience solutions to meet the specific needs of an organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Implementing and configuring Oracle lead management, sales automation, and marketing automation solutions to optimize client operations
* Analyzing client needs to develop tailored software solutions that enhance customer experience and satisfaction
* Providing training and support for seamless integration and utilization of Oracle applications
* Managing the entire customer journey from lead generation to revenue realization using Oracle's suite of tools
* Building meaningful client connections and fostering relationships to understand and anticipate client needs
* Navigating complex situations and using critical thinking to solve problems and generate new ideas
* Upholding professional and technical standards, including PwC's code of conduct and independence requirements
* Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
* Collaborating with teams to deliver quality and strategic objectives in business application consulting
* Embracing change and leveraging digital tooling to enhance client service delivery


 What You Must Have
   

  

* Overall experience of 8–12 years, with strong hands\-on and leadership experience in Oracle Unity Customer Data Platform (CDP) implementations.
* Experience leading at least 2–3 end\-to\-end Oracle Unity/CDP implementations.
* Good working experience with Oracle Eloqua Marketing Automation, particularly integrations between Unity, Eloqua, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, data modelling, integrations, delivery management, stakeholder management, and team leadership.
* Ability to lead teams comprising developers, consultants, administrators, data engineers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Customer Data Platforms, Customer 360, CRM, Marketing Automation, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, Data Warehouses, and enterprise integrations.


**Role And Responsibilities**
* Lead the overall solution design, architecture, implementation, and support of Oracle Unity solutions.
* Work closely with business, marketing, sales, service, IT, data, and architecture teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Unity solutions.
* Own technical design decisions and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, integration, data governance, and performance standards.
* Lead requirement\-gathering and solution\-design workshops and provide recommendations based on Oracle Unity capabilities and best practices.
* Review and approve technical requirements, solution design documents, integration specifications, source\-to\-target mappings, test strategies, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Manage multiple Unity workstreams and ensure delivery within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and business expectations.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, training, feedback, and guidance to developers, consultants, administrators, and end business users.
* Perform solution and design reviews and establish reusable development, integration, and configuration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, data\-quality issues, integration challenges, and performance bottlenecks and drive them to resolution.
* Coordinate with Oracle Support and other vendors for product issues, enhancements, patches, and technical escalations.
* Work with marketing teams to define how customer segments and attributes from Oracle Unity can be activated through Oracle Eloqua campaigns and marketing programs.
* Manage key business and technology stakeholders, align priorities, and communicate scope, risks, dependencies, and delivery status for Oracle Unity initiatives.Build strong relationships across Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM, Data, Analytics, Security, Architecture, and Operations teams.
* Own the overall Oracle Unity solution architecture and define scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable CDP solution patterns.Design end\-to\-end data ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, integration, and Customer 360 architecture across enterprise systems.
* Lead solution demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and capability showcases for Oracle Unity use cases and platform features.Present Customer 360, identity resolution, segmentation, intelligent attributes, dashboards, integrations, and activation flows to business and technical stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities including discovery sessions, solutioning, effort estimation, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and client presentations.Work with sales and delivery teams to define Unity solution approaches, scope, timelines, assumptions, integrations, and resource requirements.
* Manage resource planning, allocation, capacity, utilization, workload, and delivery commitments across multiple Oracle Unity projects and workstreams.Identify skill gaps, support hiring and onboarding, and drive training, cross\-skilling, mentoring, and capability development within the team.


**Oracle Unity / CDP Technical Responsibilities**
* Design the overall Oracle Unity data architecture, including source systems, ingestion strategy, data models, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and downstream integrations.
* Design and configure data feeds and ingestion jobs to bring customer, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and other enterprise data into Oracle Unity.
* Define and review source\-to\-target mappings between source systems, data warehouses, Oracle Unity, CRM, Marketing, Service, Loyalty, Analytics, and other downstream platforms.
* Configure and extend Oracle Unity data models based on business, reporting, analytical, and activation requirements.
* Maintain strong understanding of Oracle Unity data objects, relationships, attributes, metadata, and query capabilities.
* Design and configure Identity Resolution rules, including match rules, survivorship rules, master entity identification, and resolution of duplicate or conflicting customer records.
* Review and troubleshoot MCPS queries and optimize queries for performance and scalability.
* Design and create Intelligent Attributes and use them in calculations, segmentation, personalization, analytics, and activation use cases.
* Define and implement customer segmentation strategies using demographic, transactional, behavioral, engagement, and predictive attributes.
* Create, configure, and manage Data Science and Machine Learning models available within Oracle Unity and assess their applicability to business use cases.
* Configure and manage address validation, standardization, enrichment, and data\-quality processes.
* Design and develop Customer 360 dashboards using rules, sub\-rules, data source views, calculated attributes, and custom widgets.
* Develop dashboards for customer engagement, segmentation, campaign performance, customer behavior, and other business KPIs.
* Design and manage integrations between Oracle Unity and enterprise applications such as Oracle Sales, Salesforce, Oracle Service, Oracle Loyalty, Oracle Eloqua, Oracle Infinity, Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, Analytics platforms, and third\-party systems.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Unity REST APIs, batch integrations, outbound activation mechanisms, webhooks, and integration patterns.
* Define and manage Access Control, users, roles, permissions, and security governance within Oracle Unity.
* Establish data\-governance standards covering data ingestion, customer identity, data quality, data privacy, retention, consent, security, and downstream data activation.
* Monitor Unity ingestion jobs, data pipelines, identity\-resolution processes, segmentation jobs, calculations, data\-science processes, and integrations.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and drive resolution of data\-processing, integration, identity\-resolution, API, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Review platform usage and recommend performance, scalability, and operational improvements.
* Define customer\-data activation patterns to support Customer 360, personalization, lead generation, cross\-sell, up\-sell, churn management, customer engagement, and next\-best\-action use cases.


**Oracle Eloqua Exposure**
* Good understanding of Oracle Eloqua architecture, campaign management, contacts, custom objects, segments, forms, landing pages, and lead\-nurturing programs.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with Oracle Eloqua for customer segmentation, campaign activation, audience synchronization, and marketing personalization.
* Understand the data flow between Unity, Eloqua, CRM/Salesforce/Oracle Sales, and other downstream marketing systems.
* Support marketing teams in using Unity customer attributes, Intelligent Attributes, and segments within Eloqua campaigns.
* Good understanding of Eloqua integrations, APIs, native connectors, and data synchronization mechanisms.
* Support troubleshooting of data synchronization, campaign activation, contact\-management, and integration issues between Unity and Eloqua.
* Understand lead management, lead scoring, campaign responses, and lead hand\-off processes between Eloqua and CRM systems.


**Integration And Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Oracle Unity REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Oracle Unity with:
* Oracle Sales / Fusion CRM
* Salesforce
* Oracle Service
* Oracle Loyalty
* Oracle Eloqua
* Oracle Infinity
* Data Warehouses
* Enterprise Data Lakes
* Analytics platforms
* External marketing and customer\-engagement platforms
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, middleware, batch interfaces, scheduled integrations, and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Good understanding of SQL/query concepts, data modelling, data transformation, and data\-quality principles.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration, data\-processing, API, identity\-resolution, segmentation, and performance issues.
* Understanding of customer\-data activation from Oracle Unity into Eloqua and other marketing channels.


**Leadership And Management Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage a team of Oracle Unity developers, consultants, administrators, and data specialists.
* Estimate effort, prepare delivery plans, allocate resources, and monitor project execution.
* Mentor team members and develop Oracle Unity technical capabilities through knowledge\-sharing, technical sessions, and hands\-on guidance.
* Review deliverables and ensure adherence to technical, documentation, security, integration, and architecture standards.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and key technical decisions.
* Facilitate design workshops and technical discussions with business, enterprise architecture, security, integration, data, analytics, and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with marketing and Eloqua teams to define customer activation and campaign integration strategies.
* Support project planning, solution estimation, proposals, technical presentations, demos, and pre\-sales activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to create reusable solutions, accelerators, frameworks, automation, and implementation best practices.
* Drive continuous improvement across Oracle Unity implementation, support, data governance, and operational processes.
* Act as the escalation point for complex Oracle Unity technical and functional issues.


**Preferred Skills**
* Strong understanding of Customer 360, Customer Data Platforms, customer identity, data unification, segmentation, personalization, and activation.
* Good understanding of Marketing Automation and Oracle Eloqua concepts.
* Understanding of customer consent, privacy, security, retention, and enterprise data\-governance requirements.
* Experience designing enterprise\-scale customer\-data solutions with high data volumes and multiple source systems.
* Experience supporting customer\-data activation across CDP, CRM, Eloqua, and digital marketing channels.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining delivery quality.
* Experience working with geographically distributed and cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to communicate complex Oracle Unity and integration concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:** 
 Digital Marketing Specialist
   

  

**About Finnovate:** 
 Finnovate is a holistic financial planning and wealth advisory platform. We are passionate about transforming the way Indians get personal finance advice. Our team is dedicated to providing comprehensive financial solutions that cater to the unique needs of our clients.
   

  

**The Role:** 
 This is a performance\-driven digital marketing role. You will own paid advertising, lead nurturing, email marketing, lead management, and brand campaigns, working closely with the content and design teams to execute with consistency and intent.
   

  

 You are not here to just run ads. You are here to build a digital growth engine: one that generates quality leads, nurtures them across channels until they are ready to engage, and hands them to the right advisor at the right time. Over time, you will build and lead a small marketing team.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Andheri, Mumbai (Primary) and Wadala, Mumbai (Occasionally)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Paid Advertising and Retargeting
* Plan, execute, and optimise paid campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads (Search and Display), and LinkedIn.
* Build and manage retargeting audiences including website visitors, video viewers, and email lists across Meta and Google to move prospects through the funnel.
* Own ad spend allocation. Every rupee must be tracked against a measurable outcome.
* Analyse campaign performance weekly and present data\-backed recommendations to the AVP.
* Lead Nurturing
* Build and manage multi\-channel nurture journeys for all digital leads across email, WhatsApp, and paid retargeting.
* Map nurture flows to the lead's stage of awareness: cold leads receive education\-first content; warm leads receive proof and process content.
* Use retargeting ads to reinforce messaging for leads who have engaged but not yet converted.
* Set up WhatsApp touchpoints for timely, relevant follow\-up without being intrusive.
* Monitor nurture performance and refine sequences based on open rates, click throughs, and lead progression in Zoho CRM.
* The goal is simple: no digital lead should go cold due to lack of follow\-up.
* Email Marketing
* Own end\-to\-end email marketing: list management, segmentation, campaign creation, A/B testing, and reporting.
* Build automated drip journeys for new leads, client onboarding, and re\-engagement.
* Work on Zoho Marketing, Getresponse, or Mailerlite depending on campaign requirements.
* Lead Management and CRM
* Review incoming leads for quality by connecting with the lead owner to understand context and intent.
* Assign leads to the appropriate advisor or caller based on profile, product fit, and capacity.
* Track and report on lead conversion at two stages: lead to meeting, and meeting to conversion.
* Maintain lead data hygiene in Zoho CRM and flag drop\-offs and patterns that need attention.
* Work closely with the sales team to close the feedback loop between marketing input and sales output.
* Brand Awareness Campaigns
* Lead digital brand awareness initiatives: define the audience, select the channels, set the message, and measure reach and recall.
* Coordinate cross\-channel campaigns where paid, email, nurture, and content work together toward a unified objective.
* Competitor Analysis and Weekly Reporting
* Monitor competitor digital activity including ad creatives, messaging, channel mix, and positioning on an ongoing basis.
* Bring specific, actionable recommendations from competitor analysis to the weekly review.
* Prepare and present a structured weekly performance report covering paid campaigns, email, lead nurturing, lead funnel, and brand metrics.
* Own the marketing dashboard as the single source of truth for digital performance.
* Design Collaboration and Content Mix
* Brief the design team on visual requirements for all campaigns: ads, landing pages, emailers, and nurture creatives.
* Provide clear, specific feedback on design outputs to ensure alignment with campaign goals and brand standards.
* Recommend the content format mix (video, static, or carousel) for each campaign based on platform behaviour and audience stage. Recommendations go to the AVP for approval.
* Participate in creative discussions with the content team on ad copy, hooks, and messaging angles.
* Content Team Coordination
* Work with the content team to align ad creatives and campaign messaging with the broader content calendar.
* Coordinate briefing, review, and sign\-off of all ad\-related content before launch.
* Ensure all paid and branded content meets Finnovate's tone, positioning, and compliance standards.


**Must\-Have Skills**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 3 to 5 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience, ideally in fintech or financial services.
* Proven track record running Meta and Google Ads campaigns with measurable outcomes.
* Solid working knowledge of retargeting: pixels, custom audiences, lookalikes, and funnel sequencing.
* Experience building multi\-channel lead nurture journeys across email, WhatsApp, and paid channels.
* Experience with email marketing platforms and marketing automation workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Zoho CRM or a comparable CRM tool.
* Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 and the ability to build clear, actionable reports from data.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You will review content that goes out under the Finnovate brand.
* Strong organisational skills. You will manage campaigns, a lead pipeline, nurture sequences, and a weekly reporting cycle simultaneously.


**Good to Have**
* Familiarity with financial services content compliance (SEBI guidelines, AMFI standards).
* Experience with LinkedIn Ads targeting senior professionals or niche audiences.
* Understanding of landing page principles and conversion rate optimisation.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.


**Life at Finnovate**
* Health Insurance: coverage including options for dependents.
* Paid Time Off: vacation days and public holidays with full pay.
* Parental Leave: paid leave for maternity, paternity, and adoption.
* Professional Development: training, workshops, and conference access.
* Performance\-Based Incentives: variable pay tied to outcomes, not just activity.
* Employee Referral Programme: bonuses for bringing in great people.
* Team Events: regular outings and team\-building activities.
* Sunday Comp Off: employees working Sundays are eligible for a compensatory day off.


**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Saturday (Alternate Saturdays off)
   

  

**Working Hours:** 
 9:30 am to 6:30 pm

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Company:** 
 Procedure
   

  

**Website:** 
 Visit Website
   

  

**LinkedIn:** 
 Visit LinkedIn
   

  

**Business Type:** 
 Small/Medium Business
   

  

**Company Type:** 
 Product \& Service
   

  

**Business Model:** 
 B2B
   

  

**Funding Stage:** 
 Bootstrapped
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Information Technology
   

  

**Salary Range:** 
 ₹ 6\-13 Lacs PA
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a sharp, hands\-on
 **digital marketer** 
 to join our
 **Marketing team** 
 at Procedure. We're an engineering services company built with AI at our core since day one, not bolted on later. Before we dive into the job description, allow us to introduce ourselves.
   

  

 Our team is a mixed bag. Of the smart and the hard workers. Of the organised and slightly chaotic. Of the early risers and the burners of the midnight oil. We appreciate diversity and truly like having differing perspectives in the room.
   

  

 We pride ourselves on being early adopters of the latest tools, libraries and frameworks while delivering business value all the time. People who work with us fall in love with their craft. We have changed the definition of "work" for them.
   

  

**Here Are Some Of Our Beliefs About Work**
* Work is only 1 part of your life and not your entire life. We treat it as such.
* Weekends are sacred and not to be messed around with. You won't be asked to work on one.
* Commuting is a waste of time. Working from home saves you additional time. Go crazy with it.
* Asynchronous by\-default. Synchronous communication is expensive, so we default to writing docs and literature to enable async communication.


**Apart from work, we continually invest in growing you as a professional and a human.**
* Book club — broaden your horizons by picking up a book every month and have fun doing so
* P1, The Half Yearly Tech Conference — here's where we explore futuristic themes to keep you informed about what's happening in the tech space outside our office.
* Mumbai Meets AI (MMAI) — our quarterly community meetup where engineers and AI practitioners come together. You'll help shape how we take this to market.


**Growth requires mentorship**
 We believe choosing a mentor is more important than choosing a company. You'll work directly with our marketing lead, who'll mentor you on building a marketing engine from first principles — not from a playbook someone else wrote.
   

  

**What's It Like Here**
 We love debating over tools and strategies. Ahrefs or Semrush? Long\-form or programmatic? DR or traffic first? If you have opinions about why most B2B content is forgettable and how to fix it, you'll fit right in. Continuous improvement is at the heart of everything we do at work and outside.
   

  

**This sounds good. But what exactly will you work on?**
**Role**
 This isn't a "post on social media and send the weekly report" role. You'll own the systems that drive organic visibility and inbound leads for a B2B engineering consultancy targeting decision\-makers in the US and India. Here's what that looks like:
   

  

**Content SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**
 You'll own the organic pipeline end\-to\-end. That means keyword research, SERP gap analysis, on\-page optimization, and making sure our content gets cited by LLMs like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude, not just ranked on Google. We care deeply about being the answer, not just being on page one.
   

  

 You'll work with our content and engineering teams to ensure every blog, service page, and technology page is structured for both human readers and AI retrieval. Think: FAQ schema, AEO short\-answer blocks, clean heading hierarchy, internal link architecture.
   

  

**Backlink Outreach and DR Growth**
 You'll run outreach campaigns to grow our Domain Rating. That means identifying high\-DR targets, managing outreach sequences, building relationships with editors and publishers, and finding creative ways to earn editorial backlinks that actually move the needle.
   

  

 You should be comfortable reading a referring domains report in Ahrefs and knowing exactly what to do next.
   

  

**GA4, GTM, and Dashboards**
 You'll own our measurement stack. GA4 property setup, GTM container management, custom event tracking, conversion goals, and reporting. We use Looker Studio for dashboards. You'll build and maintain dashboards that the team actually uses to make decisions: traffic by channel, AI referral tracking, content performance, lead attribution.
   

  

 If you've set up custom channel groups in GA4 (like tracking AI assistant referral traffic separately), we'll get along well.
   

  

**What You Won't Be Doing**
* You won't be writing blog posts. We have a content writer and a structured editorial pipeline for that.
* You won't be designing carousels or editing videos. We have a designer for that.
* You won't be posting on LinkedIn and X. We have someone handling social execution.
* Your job is the engine underneath all of it: the data, the visibility, the systems, and the growth.


**Here's What We Expect From You**
* 3\-4 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience, preferably in a B2B or tech services context. You've done this before, not just read about it.
* SEO is second nature to you. You understand keyword difficulty, search intent, content gaps, internal linking strategy, and technical SEO basics (crawlability, canonical tags, structured data). You've moved the needle on organic traffic for a real website.
* You've done AEO and GEO, not just read about them. Answer Engine Optimization and Generative Engine Optimization are not buzzwords to you. You've structured content that got cited by LLMs, tracked that traffic, and tied it back to pipeline. You've had targets around AI\-driven MQLs and you've hit them. We want someone who's proven this works, not someone who's still tinkering.
* You've set up GA4 properties from scratch, configured GTM containers, created custom events, and built dashboards in Looker Studio (or similar). You can trace a lead from first touch to form submission.
* You've done backlink outreach. You know the difference between a directory listing and an editorial backlink. You've used Ahrefs (or Semrush/Moz) to analyze competitor backlink profiles and find opportunities.
* You can build dashboards people actually look at. Looker Studio, Google Sheets with data connectors, or similar. You know that a dashboard nobody checks is worse than no dashboard at all.
* You've worked on websites and landing pages. You've been involved in building, optimizing, or managing website pages and landing pages that convert. You understand what makes a high\-intent page work: structure, copy, CTAs, page speed, and how it all ties back to the funnel.
* You use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT as thinking partners. For research, for ideation, for breaking down complex problems. Not for copy\-pasting AI\-generated fluff. You know the difference, and it shows in your work.
* You write clearly. Not blog posts, but briefs, reports, Slack messages, outreach emails. Clear thinking shows up in clear writing.


**Tools you'll work with**
* SEO/AEO: Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog
* Analytics: GA4, GTM, Looker Studio
* AI: Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus (premium licenses provided)
* Ops: Notion, Slack
* Outreach: Email (your preferred tool), LinkedIn


**The fine print**
* Experience: 3\-4 years
* Location: Mumbai (Bhandup West, Hybrid)
* Reports to: Marketing Head
* Team: You'll collaborate daily with our content writer, social media manager, designer, and engineering team.


 If you've read this far and thought "this is exactly the kind of marketing I want to do," we should talk. Apply now.

title: Marketing Associate
description:
Marketing Associate – Envision Overseas Education Consultants LLP
 



  





 About Envision Overseas
 



  





 Envision Overseas Education Consultants LLP is a study\-abroad education consultancy
 



 helping students pursue international education opportunities. We work closely with students
 



 throughout their overseas education journey—from university selection and applications to
 



 admissions and visa guidance.
 



 We are looking for a Marketing Associate who can support and execute marketing initiatives
 



 that strengthen our brand presence, generate quality student enquiries, and contribute to business
 



 growth.
 



  





 Work Location: Lower Parel
 



 Working Days : Monday to Saturday
 



 Working Hours: 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 The Marketing Associate will be responsible for supporting the planning, execution, and
 



 monitoring of marketing activities for Envision Overseas.
 



  





 The role requires a combination of digital marketing, social media, content coordination, lead
 



 generation, event marketing, campaign execution, and market research.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should understand how marketing can be used to attract prospective students,
 



 engage parents and students, generate enquiries, and build a strong and credible education brand.
 



  





 You will work closely with the Counselling, Admissions, Management, and other internal
 



 teams to ensure marketing activities are aligned with business objectives.
 



  





 1\. Digital Marketing \& Campaign Execution
 



  





 \-Assist in planning and executing digital marketing campaigns for study\-abroad programs
 



 and services.
 



 \-Support campaigns across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, Google, YouTube,
 



 LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
 



 \-Coordinate with internal teams or external agencies for campaign creatives,
 



 advertisements, landing pages, and promotional material.
 



 \-Monitor campaign performance and assist in identifying opportunities for improvement.
 



 \-Track marketing spends, campaign outcomes, enquiries, and other relevant metrics.
 



 \-Support the execution of lead\-generation campaigns to increase student enquiries.
 



  





 Social Media Management
 



  





 \-Assist in managing and maintaining Envision's social media presence.

 \-Coordinate with the design/content team for posts, reels, stories, videos, student
 



 testimonials, achievements, and promotional creatives.
 



 \-Identify relevant trends, topics, formats, and content opportunities within the education
 



 and study\-abroad industry.
 



 \-Monitor engagement, reach, followers, and other social media metrics.
 



 \-Ensure content is consistent with the company's brand image and communication
 



 standards.
 



  





 Content \& Marketing Communication
 



 Assist in creating and coordinating marketing content for students and parents.
 



 Develop or coordinate content around:
 



 o Study\-abroad destinations
 



 o Universities and courses
 



 o Intakes and deadlines
 



 o Scholarships
 



 o Student success stories
 



 o Visa updates
 



 o Events and seminars
 



 o Application and admission processes
 



 Work with the counselling team to identify frequently asked student questions and
 



 convert them into useful marketing content.
 



  





  





 Lead Generation \& Student Acquisition
