 Coordinate with the counselling team to understand lead quality and campaign
 



 effectiveness.
 



 \-Monitor the flow of enquiries generated through different marketing channels.
 



 \-Maintain campaign\-wise lead data and prepare basic performance reports.
 



 \-Analyse which channels, campaigns, and content generate better engagement and
 



 enquiries.
 



 \-Suggest new ideas to improve student acquisition and conversion opportunities.
 



 Assist in remarketing and follow\-up campaigns for prospective students.
 



  





 Events, Seminars \& Offline Marketing
 



  





 \-Assist in planning and promoting education fairs, university events, seminars,
 



 webinars, workshops, and student counselling sessions.
 



 \-Coordinate promotional activities before, during, and after events.
 



 \-Assist with registrations, promotional material, event communication, and attendee
 



 engagement.
 



 \-Coordinate with universities, representatives, vendors, and internal teams wherever
 



 required.
 



 \-Explore local marketing opportunities to increase brand visibility and student walk\-ins.
 



 \-Support branch\-level marketing activities and promotional initiatives
 



  





 Market Research \& Competitor Analysis
 



  





 \-Research current trends in the overseas education industry.
 



 \-Monitor competitor marketing activities, campaigns, offers, events, and social media
 



 strategies.
 



 \-Track changes in student preferences, popular destinations, courses, and emerging
 



 markets.
 



 \-Identify new marketing opportunities and channels.
 



 \-Share relevant market insights and recommendations with the management/marketing team.
 



  





 Reporting \& Performance Tracking
 



  





 Maintain regular marketing activity reports.
 



  





 Track key marketing metrics such as:
 



 o Leads generated
 



 o Cost per lead
 



 o Campaign performance
 



 o Social media reach and engagement
 



 o Website/landing page enquiries
 



 o Event registrations
 



 o Lead source performance
 



 Prepare weekly/monthly marketing performance summaries.
 



 Identify gaps and recommend corrective actions.
 



 Maintain proper records of campaigns, creatives, content, and marketing activities.
 



  





 Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



  





 \-Work closely with the Counselling, Admissions, Visa, and Management teams.
 



 \-Understand business requirements and translate them into relevant marketing activities.
 



 \-Collect feedback from counsellors regarding lead quality and student interests.
 



 \-Coordinate with designers, video editors, content writers, agencies, vendors, and other
 



 marketing partners when required.
 



 \-Ensure marketing activities are completed within agreed timelines.
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 Education
 



 \-Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business Administration,
 



 \-Digital Marketing, or a related field.
 



 \-Candidates with relevant certifications in Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing,
 



 \-Google Ads, Meta Ads, or related areas will be preferred.
 



  





 Experience
 



 \-1–3 years of experience in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Lead
 



 \-Generation, Education Marketing, or a related field.
 



 \-Experience in the study\-abroad / overseas education / EdTech industry will be an
 



 added advantage.
 



 \-Freshers with strong practical knowledge, internships, or demonstrated marketing
 



 projects may also be considered.

title: Social Media & Digital Marketing Professional
description:
🚀 Job Opening: Social Media \& Digital Marketing Professional
 



  





 📍 Location: Ghatkopar, Mumbai (Work from Office)
 



 💼 Experience: 3–6 Years (Agency or Premium Brand experience preferred)
 



 💰 Salary: ₹35,000 \- ₹40,000 per month \+ PF \& Benefits

**Marketing \& Brand Manager** 




**About Surreal** 





 Surreal creates experiences designed to be remembered — from large\-scale installations and seasonal environments
 





 to brand activations, entertainment experiences and public spaces.
 





 Alongside our client work, we're also building our own experiences and IPs, including World of Christmas, as platforms
 





 with the potential to grow into larger consumer\-facing brands.
 





 We're looking for someone to help shape how Surreal — and the brands we create — show up in the world.
 




**The Role** 





 We're looking for a Marketing \& Brand Manager to own and grow Surreal's brand, content and communications, while
 





 also driving the marketing of Surreal's own IPs and experiences.
 





 You'll work closely with leadership, business development, design and project teams to turn what we create into
 





 compelling stories — and make sure those stories reach the right clients, collaborators and audiences.
 





 For our IPs, you'll help translate the experience itself into a brand people want to discover, engage with and return to.
 





 This role sits between brand thinking, commercial thinking and hands\-on execution.
 




  





**What you'll be doing** 





  Develop and drive Surreal's overall marketing and communications strategy and calendar.
 





  Shape and maintain a strong, consistent Surreal brand across all channels.
 





  Own content across LinkedIn, Instagram, the website and other relevant platforms.
 





  Turn completed projects into compelling case studies and stories — from concept and making through to the final experience.
 





  Work with project teams to identify and capture the right content during design, fabrication and installation.
 





  Coordinate photographers, videographers, designers, agencies and other creative partners.
 





  Manage and continually develop Surreal's website and project portfolio.
 





  Develop credentials, presentations, case studies and market\-specific collateral alongside Business Development.
 





  Identify and manage relevant PR, editorial, award and industry opportunities.
 





  Support exhibitions, international fairs, launches and major company announcements.
 





  Develop and execute marketing strategies for Surreal\-owned IPs, including World of Christmas.
 





  Build seasonal campaign calendars across digital, social, PR and on\-ground touchpoints for Surreal IPs.
 





  Drive audience awareness, engagement and growth for the IPs.
 





  Support ticketing/e\-commerce, partnerships, sponsorships and other commercial initiatives from a marketing perspective.
 





  Coordinate IP content, shoots, campaigns, creators/influencers, PR and external agencies.
 





  Use performance insights to improve future campaigns, audience growth and brand development.
 





  Help build Surreal's IPs as brands in their own right, not simply individual events.
 




  





**What we're looking for** 





  5–8 years' experience across brand, marketing, communications or related creative roles.
 





  Experience within experiential, creative/design, architecture, entertainment, lifestyle, retail or another visually driven business is strongly preferred.
 





  Experience working across both B2B and consumer\-facing brands would be a strong advantage.
 





  Strong understanding of brand positioning, visual storytelling and integrated campaigns.
 





  Excellent writing and communication skills.
 





  Strong visual judgement and an eye for good creative work.
 





  Experience managing content, social media, websites and external creative partners.
 





  Ability to turn complex creative projects into simple, engaging stories.
 





  Strong project\-management skills and ability to take ideas from strategy through execution.
 





  Comfortable working across multiple brands, campaigns and priorities.
 





  Curious, proactive and genuinely interested in design, culture, experiences and consumer behaviour.This is not a purely digital/performance marketing role. We're looking for someone who understands how brands are
 





 built — and is equally comfortable developing the thinking and making sure it gets executed.
 




  





**In short:** 

 you make sure the work we create becomes the brand people know Surreal for — and that the experiences
 





 we own become brands people actively want to be part of.
 




  





**Ideal candidate profile** 





  5–8 years' experience with meaningful ownership of brand, content or communications.
 





  Understands creative work, visual storytelling and how to build narratives around physical experiences/projects.
 





  Can work across B2B corporate/studio marketing and B2C audience marketing.
 





  Has created campaigns, case studies, websites/content, PR or award submissions rather than only managing media budgets.
 





  Strong enough visually to brief and judge photography, film, design and social content.
 





  Comfortable managing agencies/freelancers while remaining hands\-on.
 





  Commercially aware enough to connect brand activity with audience growth, ticketing/e\-commerce, partnerships and sponsorships for IPs.
 





  Proactive about spotting stories and content opportunities during the making of a project, not only after completion.
 




  





**Priority talent pools** 





  Experiential / brand experience / creative agencies.
 





  Spatial design, retail design and visual merchandising studios.
 





  Architecture, interior and multidisciplinary design practices.
 





  Entertainment, festivals, attractions, museums and ticketed experience businesses.
 





  Luxury, lifestyle and retail brands with strong experiential/brand functions.
 





  Creative studios and culturally driven businesses with strong project storytelling.

**Ad → Landing Page → Lead → CRM → Sales → Payment → Customer** 




 Your responsibilities include:
 


* Design and optimize marketing funnels for different products.
* Work with the website team to create high\-converting landing pages.
* Identify where potential customers drop off during the purchase journey.
* Run A/B tests on advertising creatives, landing pages, headlines, offers, and calls to action.
* Improve lead\-to\-sale and website\-to\-purchase conversion rates.
* Develop lead nurturing and remarketing strategies.
* Optimize checkout journeys to reduce abandoned purchases.
* Work closely with the sales team to understand customer objections and improve marketing communication.



 C. Marketing Analytics \& Reporting
 



 You will be responsible for maintaining complete visibility into marketing performance.
 



 Track and report the following metrics:
 



 MetricWhat You Will TrackAd SpendDaily and monthly marketing expenditureLeads GeneratedTotal leads across campaignsCost Per Lead (CPL)Acquisition cost per leadQualified LeadsLeads meeting defined qualification criteriaLead\-to\-Sale ConversionPercentage of leads becoming customersCustomer Acquisition Cost (CAC)Total acquisition cost per paying customerRevenue GeneratedRevenue attributed to marketing campaignsReturn on Ad Spend (ROAS)Revenue generated relative to advertising expenditureFunnel ConversionConversion rates across customer journey stages
 



**Daily reporting is mandatory.** 




 You should be able to explain where money was spent, what results it generated, which campaigns performed well, and what needs improvement.
 



 Reports must translate data into clear, actionable business decisions.
 



  





 D. Creative Strategy \& Content Marketing
 


* Work closely with designers, video editors, and content creators to develop high\-performing advertising creatives.
* Research customer motivations, pain points, buying triggers, and objections.
* Develop creative briefs for static advertisements, video advertisements, reels, and landing pages.
* Write or guide the development of persuasive advertising copy, hooks, headlines, and calls to action.
* Test multiple creative concepts and identify the messaging that resonates with different audiences.
* Analyze competitor campaigns and identify opportunities for differentiation.
* Continuously refresh creatives to maintain campaign performance.



 You are not expected to personally design every creative, but you must understand what makes an advertisement convert.
 



  





 E. CRM, Automation \& Lead Nurturing
 


* Work with the sales and CRM teams to ensure every lead is captured, assigned, and followed up.
* Build automated lead nurturing journeys using WhatsApp, email, and other relevant channels.
* Segment leads based on their interests, behaviour, and purchase readiness.
* Develop re\-engagement campaigns for inactive leads.
* Monitor lead response times and follow\-up effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead\-to\-customer conversion.
* Ensure accurate tracking of customer acquisition sources.



 F. Growth Experiments \& New Opportunities
 


* Identify and test new customer acquisition channels.
* Develop referral, affiliate, partnership, and organic growth initiatives.
* Experiment with new offers, pricing communication, and promotional strategies.
* Research customer behaviour and market opportunities.
* Build repeatable growth systems that can scale across different products and markets.



 You should consistently bring new ideas to the table, test them, measure their performance, and scale what works.
 



  





 3\. What We Expect You to Achieve
 



 Your success will be measured by business outcomes, not simply marketing activity.
 



**First 30 Days: Understand, Audit \& Establish** 



* Understand our products, customers, pricing, and sales process.
* Audit existing marketing campaigns and customer acquisition funnels.
* Establish accurate tracking for advertising expenditure, leads, conversions, and revenue.
* Identify immediate opportunities to improve campaign performance.
* Implement a daily marketing performance dashboard.



**Days 31–60: Optimize \& Experiment** 



* Improve lead quality and customer acquisition efficiency.
* Launch structured creative and audience experiments.
* Optimize landing pages and lead nurturing journeys.
* Identify the most effective customer acquisition channels.
* Establish a repeatable campaign optimization process.



**Days 61–90: Scale \& Build** 



* Scale campaigns demonstrating sustainable acquisition economics.
* Build predictable customer acquisition funnels.
* Develop growth strategies for new products and markets.
* Establish a structured marketing experimentation framework.
* Present a clear growth roadmap for the next quarter.



 Specific revenue, CAC, and acquisition targets will be established based on product economics, available budgets, and historical performance.
 



  





 4\. Who We're Looking ForRequired Skills \& Experience
 


* 2–5 years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, or customer acquisition.
* Demonstrated experience managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns.
* Strong understanding of marketing funnels, conversion optimization, and customer acquisition economics.
* Experience working with landing pages, CRM systems, and marketing automation tools.
* Ability to analyze campaign data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Strong copywriting and creative strategy skills.
* Experience managing advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for measurable business outcomes.
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and execution skills.



 Preferred Experience
 


* Experience in EdTech, education, D2C, or other consumer\-facing businesses.
* Experience with Shopify and online payment funnels.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking.
* Experience using WhatsApp marketing and CRM automation.
* Understanding of regional marketing and Marathi\-speaking audiences.
* Experience scaling campaigns across multiple products or geographical markets.



 5\. The Mindset We Value
 



 We are looking for someone who:
 



**Thinks like a business owner.** 
 Understands that marketing success is measured by customer acquisition, revenue, and sustainable growth.
 



**Takes complete ownership.** 
 Does not wait for instructions to identify problems or improve campaign performance.
 



**Is data\-driven.** 
 Makes decisions based on evidence, experiments, and customer behaviour rather than assumptions.
 



**Moves fast.** 
 Can execute campaigns, test ideas, and implement improvements without unnecessary delays.
 



**Understands customers.** 
 Can translate customer motivations, concerns, and aspirations into compelling marketing communication.
 



**Is comfortable with accountability.** 
 Can clearly explain campaign performance, acknowledge what is not working, and recommend corrective actions.
 



  





 6\. What Makes This Opportunity Different?
 



 You will work directly with the founder and play an important role in building the growth engine of an expanding education business.
 



 This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of marketing strategy, experiment with new ideas, influence product growth, and build scalable customer acquisition systems.
 



 You will have the opportunity to work across multiple education products, customer segments, and markets.
 



 We value initiative, independent thinking, measurable results, and the ability to turn ideas into execution.

 **up to ₹5 lakh**



 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **performance marketer who is obsessed with numbers, experiments and growth.** 




**Someone who doesn't just know how to** 
*run Meta Ads* 
 — but understands
 **why an ad wins, why it loses, how many creatives to test, which audiences to explore, when to kill an ad, when to scale it, and how to turn paid acquisition into a predictable growth engine. Meta should be your deepest area of expertise** 
 .
 



 You should have experience scaling a brand or working with an agency where you have managed significant budgets and contributed to
 **$1M\+ in attributable revenue** 
 or equivalent scale, with a strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, contribution margin and profitability.
 



  




 What you'll own:
 
  




 1\. META ADS — THIS IS YOUR CORE JOB
 
 You will own the entire Meta performance engine.
 



 Not just campaign execution.
 



 You will be responsible for:
 


* Campaign architecture and account structure
* Prospecting vs retargeting strategy
* Audience discovery
* Broad vs interest vs lookalike strategies
* Creative testing frameworks
* Hook testing
* Copy testing
* Offer testing
* Landing\-page testing
* Budget allocation
* Campaign scaling
* Retargeting
* Frequency management
* CAC / ROAS optimisation
* Attribution analysis
* Daily performance monitoring
* Weekly growth analysis



  





 You should be able to answer questions like:
 


**How many creatives should we launch this week?** 
**Which 5 audiences should we test next and why?** 
**When do you kill an ad?** 
**When do you increase budget by 20%, 50% or 2X?** 
**Is the problem the creative, audience, offer, landing page or product?** 
**Why did CPM increase?** 
**Why is CTR falling?** 
**Why is Meta giving us cheap clicks but expensive purchases?** 
**What is our real CAC after considering contribution margin?** 

  





  




 2\. Build a creative testing machine:
 
 You will work closely with the creative team to create a systematic testing engine.
 



 You will decide:
 


* What creatives need to be made
* How many variants to test
* Which hooks to test
* Which angles to test
* Which formats to test
* Which audience each creative is intended for
* Which winning creatives should be scaled
* Which losers should be killed



 For example:
 



**10 hooks × 3 visual executions × 2 offers** 




 should not be random experimentation.
 


 You should be able to build a
 **structured testing matrix** 
 and understand which variable is actually driving performance.
 
  





**3\. Creative Intelligence** 




 You won't just consume creatives.
 



 You'll help
 **create them.** 




 You should be comfortable with:
 


* Canva
* AI image generation
* AI video tools
* ChatGPT
* AI copywriting tools
* Basic Photoshop / Figma is a plus
* Meta Creative tools
* Rapid static ad creation



 You should be capable of saying:
 



 “This concept needs to be tested today.”
 



 …and then actually making a usable first version yourself rather than waiting two days for a designer.
 



  





**4\. Google Ads** 




 You will also manage / work closely on:
 


* Google Search
* Performance Max
* Shopping
* Brand vs non\-brand
* Keyword research
* Search intent
* Negative keywords
* Conversion tracking
* Budget allocation
* ROAS / CAC optimisation
* Landing\-page optimisation



 Meta will be your
 **specialisation** 
 ; Google should be a strong secondary capability.
 



  





**5\. Amazon Ads** 




 Hands\-on experience with Amazon advertising is required.
 



 You should understand:
 


* Sponsored Products
* Sponsored Brands
* Sponsored Display
* Keyword strategy
* Search term analysis
* Product targeting
* Competitor targeting
* Amazon ROAS / TACoS
* Organic \+ paid interaction
* Product detail page optimisation



  





**6\. Quick Commerce** 




 Experience with platforms such as:
 


* Blinkit
* Zepto
* Swiggy Instamart
* Amazon Fresh / other relevant platforms



 You should understand how paid visibility, search placement, product availability, pricing, promotions and conversion interact on quick\-commerce platforms.
 



  





**7\. Competitor \& Market Intelligence** 




 This is another area I would make a
 **core responsibility** 
 , because it differentiates this role.
 



 You should constantly be researching:
 



**Competitor Ads** 



* What are competitors advertising?
* Which creatives are they repeatedly running?
* What hooks are they using?
* What offers are they pushing?
* Which products are they promoting?
* How are they positioning themselves?



**Competitor Products** 



* Pricing
* Bundles
* Offers
* Reviews
* Ratings
* Product positioning
* Claims
* Landing pages
* Amazon listings



**Audience Intelligence** 



* Who are competitors speaking to?
* What problems are they addressing?
* What objections are consumers raising?
* What language are customers using?



**Tools** 




 You should be comfortable using relevant tools such as:
 


* Meta Ads Library
* Similarweb
* SEMrush / Ahrefs
* Google Trends
* Amazon research tools
* Social listening tools
* Ad intelligence platforms
* Competitor tracking tools
* AI research tools



**You don't need to know every tool. You need to know how to find the answer.** 




  





**8\. Data \& Analytics** 




 You should live inside numbers.
 



 Track and analyse:
 



**CTR** 




**CPC** 




**CPM** 




**Hook Rate** 




**Hold Rate** 




**CVR** 




**CAC** 




**CPA** 




**AOV** 




**ROAS** 




**MER** 




**LTV** 




**Contribution Margin** 




**Frequency** 




**iROAS** 




 And importantly:
 



**Understand the relationship between them.** 




 For example:
 



 CPM ↑ → CTR ↓ → CPC ↑ → CVR ↓ → CAC ↑
 



 You should be able to identify
 **where the actual problem is** 
 instead of simply saying:
 



 “Meta performance has gone down.”
 



  





**9\. Scaling** 




 We are specifically looking for someone who has
 **actually scaled campaigns** 
 , not someone who has only managed ₹2–5 lakh/month budgets.
 



 You should have experience with:
 


* Scaling winning campaigns
* Increasing spend without destroying efficiency
* Creative fatigue
* Audience saturation
* Budget reallocation
* Geographic expansion
* New product launches
* New customer acquisition
* Retention / remarketing
* Scaling from ₹X/day → ₹X lakh/day



 We want someone who can demonstrate:
 



**“This was the starting point.** 




**This was the budget.** 




**This was the CAC/ROAS.** 




**This is what I changed.** 




**This is where we reached.”** 




  





**10\. Build the Performance Marketing Dashboard** 




 You will own weekly performance reporting.
 



 Not vanity reports.
 



 Every week you should be able to tell the founders:
 



**WHAT HAPPENED?** 




**WHY DID IT HAPPEN?** 




**WHAT DID WE LEARN?** 




**WHAT ARE WE TESTING NEXT?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE PUT MORE MONEY?** 




**WHERE SHOULD WE STOP SPENDING?** 




  





**The Person We Are Looking For** 




**You might be the right person if:** 



* You genuinely enjoy Meta Ads.
* You spend time inside Ads Manager even when nobody asks you to.
* You understand creative performance.
* You obsess over CAC and ROAS.
* You have personally scaled campaigns.
* You know how to structure experiments.

* You are comfortable with large budgets.

**You are probably NOT the right person if:** 



* Your primary skill is simply campaign setup.

* You only know boosted posts.
* You cannot explain why an ad won.
* You have never personally scaled spend.
* You report impressions and reach but don't understand unit economics.
* You need someone else to tell you what to test.



  





**Mandatory Experience** 




 I'd make these requirements quite specific:
 



**Required:**

* Experience with either a
 **D2C brand or performance marketing agency**

**Preferred:**

* Takes responsibility to deliver and can be counted on to deliver results in the right way

title: Content Creator
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Spur (https://spur.so) is an agentic CRM for businesses that sell to consumers over chat. 600\+ businesses across 50\+ countries run on Spur, around 5 million conversations a month: ecommerce brands first, and increasingly anyone whose customers message them on WhatsApp and Instagram, from real estate and travel to education, clinics and services. Every WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email and live chat message lands in one inbox with AI handling most of it, and the same platform runs their campaigns, lead follow\-up, abandoned cart recovery and website conversion.
 



  





 We're bootstrapped and profitable. Zero external funding, zero marketing spend. Every customer we have today came from product quality and word of mouth. We're 12 people.
 



  





 Now we scale, aggressively. The next number is 6,000 brands, and the four roles we are hiring right now are how we get there. This is the best time to join Spur.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 We have never spent a rupee on marketing, and we've never had a creator. 600\+ brands found us anyway.
 



  





 The reels on our Instagram are made by the two founders, Royal and Rohan. We write them, shoot them, cut them and post them ourselves, in between running the company, and several have gone viral. Watch a few before you apply: instagram.com/spurnow\_com. That is the bar, and it is being cleared by two people doing it on the side. The job is what happens when it is somebody's whole day.
 



  





 You'll make short video about Spur, about ecommerce, and about the merchants we work with, every day: reels, talking heads, screen recordings of the product doing something clever, whatever the idea needs. Shoot it, write it, edit it, post it, read the numbers, do it again on Monday. You own the accounts and you decide what gets made. Nobody here is going to hand you a content calendar, and nobody is going to approve your hooks line by line.
 



  





 The reason this works at Spur is access. Five people in customer success hear what merchants are struggling with all day. The sales lead hears every objection in the market. Both founders will sit with you, and will get in front of the camera when the idea needs them. You'll never have to invent what to talk about.
 



  





**You'll probably be a fit if you** 




  




* Have an audience you built yourself, roughly 10,000 to 50,000 followers, on any platform that matters
* Shoot and edit your own video. No crew, no agency, no waiting on anyone
* Are genuinely good with tools: editing, scheduling, analytics, AI, and whatever launched last month that you already tried
* Publish consistently rather than in bursts, and can show us ninety days of proof
* Live in Delhi NCR, or are moving here



  





**Bonus points** 




  




* You've made content for an ecommerce or D2C brand, or run your own store
* You've been the face of something, not just the editor behind it
* You've built a newsletter, a community, or an audience somewhere that isn't a social feed



  





**Logistics** 




  




* Five days a week in our Green Park, Delhi office. This one genuinely needs to be in person: the content comes out of the room
* Appraisals every 12 months. Our motto: if Spur grows, the team should be the first to benefit
* Bonuses and international trips with the team are on the table. We spent a month in Thailand in 2025, and a month in Bali in 2024



  





 We read every response ourselves, and you'll hear back either way.

As a Creative Strategist in a fast\-paced e\-commerce environment, you should be tech\-savvy, a critical thinker, and a proactive problem solver. You should have a willingness to broaden your expertise, go the extra mile, and demonstrate a passion for growth and success.
 



 You will be responsible for creating, managing, and improving content across various marketing channels in specific European geographies, directly

 • Conduct in\-depth primary and secondary research across European markets to understand customer preferences, needs, behaviours, and emerging trends.

 • Create data\-driven creative briefs by analyzing key performance metrics such as CTR, hook rate, thumb\-stop rate, CPA, ROAS, frequency, and creative fatigue signals.
 



 • Develop platform\-native creative concepts, including UGC, expert\-led content, problem\-solution storytelling, before\-and\-after narratives,

 • Brief and direct creators, editors, designers, freelancers, agencies, and UGC partners, ensuring deliverables align with strategic objectives and are delivered on time.

 • Proofread, edit, and refine content to maintain accuracy, quality, and brand consistency across all touchpoints.

 • Ensure all marketing activities comply with copyright laws, data protection regulations, and other relevant legal requirements.
 



  





**Requirements** 




 • Excellent English writing skills with strong attention to detail.
 



 • Ability to take initiative and work independently.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with MS Office, particularly Excel.
 



 • Strong communication skills, a cooperative attitude, and a willingness to go the extra mile.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 At HUFT, creators are more than just a media channel. They are how pet parents discover, learn about, trust and shop with us.
   

  

 As an
 **Influencer Manager** 
 , you’ll build and manage creator relationships and turn them into meaningful brand and business outcomes. You’ll work across creators, agencies and internal teams to take campaigns from
 **creator identification to content going live and measuring results** 
 .
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who understands the creator ecosystem, has a good eye for content, knows how to build relationships and is comfortable with campaign numbers and performance.
   

  

 The North Star
   

  

**Build a creator ecosystem that helps more pet parents discover HUFT, trust HUFT and choose HUFT.**
 What You’ll Do 1\. Find \& Build the Right Creator Network
   

  

* Identify, evaluate and onboard creators relevant to HUFT and pet parents.
* Build long\-term relationships with creators, talent managers and agencies.
* Evaluate creators beyond follower count — audience fit, content quality, credibility and influence.
* Negotiate commercials, deliverables and timelines.


* Plan \& Run Campaigns
* Manage influencer campaigns end\-to\-end — from creator selection and briefing to go\-live and closure.
* Work with Brand, Social, Creative, E\-commerce and Marketplace teams to create strong briefs.
* Manage product seeding, calendars, content submissions, approvals and go\-lives.
* Keep multiple creators, campaigns and timelines moving.
* Execute campaigns around launches, seasonal moments and commerce events.
* Ensure Content Feels Right
* Work with creators to develop content that feels natural to their voice while staying true to HUFT.
* Review content for brand alignment, quality and campaign objectives.
* Partner with Creative and Social teams to improve content continuously.
* Proactively solve issues instead of waiting for them to escalate.
* Drive Business Through Influencer Marketing
* Drive creator\-led commerce through affiliate links, coupon codes and other attribution models.
* Execute campaigns across HUFT.com, Amazon, Blinkit and other commerce platforms.
* Track metrics such as:
+ Reach \& Impressions
+ Engagement
+ EMV
+ CPM
+ CTR
+ Conversions
+ Revenue
+ ROAS

* Build post\-campaign reports with clear learnings and next steps.
* Identify high\-performing creators and formats for repeat partnerships.
* Own Budgets \& Partnerships
* Manage influencer and campaign budgets.
* Optimise spends towards high\-performing opportunities.
* Coordinate with agencies, talent partners and vendors.
* Track commercials, invoices, payments and deliverables.
* Ensure campaigns stay within budget and timelines.
* Stay Close to the Creator World
* Keep up with emerging creators, formats, platforms and social trends.
* Understand what pet parents are watching, sharing, saving and discussing.
* Track competitor activity and bring new ideas to HUFT.
* Continuously discover new creators and communities.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 3–4 years of experience in Influencer Marketing, Creator Partnerships, Social Media or Digital Marketing.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, YouTube and emerging platforms.
* Good understanding of the Indian creator ecosystem.
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship\-building skills.
* Good project management and organisational skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple campaigns and timelines.
* Comfortable with Excel, campaign reporting and performance metrics.
* Ability to balance creative thinking with commercial thinking.
* Affiliate marketing / creator\-led commerce experience is a plus.
* Experience in pet, lifestyle, fashion, beauty, FMCG or consumer brands is a plus.
* Genuine interest in pets and understanding of the pet\-parent ecosystem.


 You’ll Feel at Home at HUFT If You…
   

  

* Know that the right creator isn’t always the one with the biggest following.
* Build relationships, not just databases.
* Care about authentic content, not just getting deliverables out.
* Can move from a creator conversation to a performance dashboard comfortably.
* Don’t wait for a playbook — you spot opportunities and figure things out.
* Are comfortable with the fast\-moving, sometimes messy nature of social.
* Like experimenting, learning and improving with every campaign.
* Believe that when people and pets find each other, good things happen.


 KPIs / What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Influencer\-attributed revenue and conversions
* ROAS / ROI
* Affiliate sales and conversion
* Campaign reach, engagement and EMV
* CTR and CPA
* Creator performance and repeat performance
* Growth of a high\-quality creator network
* Cost efficiency and budget utilisation
* Campaigns delivered on time and to brief
* Quality and relevance of creator content
* Contribution of influencer marketing to launches and key campaigns

title: Brand Strategist
description:

 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of brand positioning, consumer behaviour, market trends, campaign strategy, content direction, and digital marketing. You will work closely with the creative, social media, performance marketing, and account management teams to develop impactful brand solutions for clients.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Develop brand and communication strategies aligned with client objectives and target audiences.
* Research brands, competitors, markets, and consumer trends to identify actionable insights.
* Define brand positioning, communication pillars, messaging, and campaign direction.
* Develop strategic briefs and campaign concepts for creative and content teams.
* Work closely with creative, social media, performance, and account teams to translate strategy into execution.
* Prepare strategy presentations, creative briefs, campaign proposals, and client decks.
* Participate in client discussions and confidently present strategic recommendations.

* Excellent presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to create effective creative and campaign briefs.
* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and market trends.
* Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.

title: International SEO, AEO & GEO Specialist
description:
**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Salary Budget:** 
 Up to INR 50,000 per month
 



**Experience:** 
 4\-7 Years
 



 Reporting To Head of Digital Marketing
 



  





**About the Role** 




 C3S Business School is looking for an experienced International SEO, AEO \& GEO Specialist to strengthen organic visibility and qualified student lead generation across global markets. The role combines international SEO strategy, technical SEO, country\-level opportunity analysis, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), semantic SEO and AI\-search visibility.
 



 The successful candidate will identify markets where C3S Business School has search demand but limited organic visibility, then build and execute measurable plans to improve rankings, traffic, enquiries and lead conversion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**International SEO Strategy** 



* Develop and execute international SEO strategies across multiple countries and regions.
* Identify countries where C3S Business School has strong search demand but limited organic traffic, rankings or enquiries.
* Conduct country\-level keyword research, SERP analysis and opportunity sizing.
* Build country\-specific SEO plans based on search behaviour, competition, demand and conversion potential.
* Analyse international competitors in higher education, business schools and student recruitment.
* Identify keyword gaps, content gaps, authority gaps, internal\-linking gaps and backlink gaps.
* Prioritise opportunities by commercial value, search intent, ranking difficulty and expected lead impact.



  





**Technical SEO** 



* Conduct recurring technical SEO audits and maintain a prioritised implementation roadmap.
* Monitor crawling, indexing, canonicalisation, redirects, duplicate content and website architecture.
* Improve Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile SEO, structured data, XML sitemaps and robots.txt configuration.
* Review internal linking, pagination, indexation signals and template\-level technical issues.
* Work closely with developers to define, test and validate technical SEO fixes.
* Monitor Google Search Console, GA4 and relevant webmaster or SEO platforms for anomalies and opportunities.



  





**AEO \- Answer Engine Optimisation** 



* Optimise content for featured snippets, People Also Ask results and conversational search experiences.
* Develop question\-led content, FAQ frameworks and concise answer structures for prospective students.
* Implement and improve relevant schema markup and structured data.
* Map high\-intent questions across programme discovery, fees, admissions, eligibility, careers and studying in Barcelona.



  





  





**Required Skills** 



* Advanced International SEO and technical SEO.
* Keyword research, search intent analysis and competitor analysis.
* AEO, GEO, semantic SEO and AI\-search optimisation.
* Google Search Console, GA4 and SEO reporting.
* Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, SEMrush or equivalent tools.
* Schema markup, internal linking and technical auditing.
* SEO content strategy and conversion\-focused organic growth.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 4\-7 years of professional SEO experience with evidence of measurable organic growth.
* Strong experience managing international or multi\-country SEO campaigns.
* Demonstrable experience improving organic traffic, rankings and leads.
* Strong technical SEO knowledge and ability to work with development teams.
* Good understanding of emerging AI\-driven search behaviour and generative search.
* Ability to independently analyse data, prioritise work and build action plans.

title: Senior Social Media Executive
description:
Job Title: Social Media Executive
   

  

 Location: Coimbatore
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Social Media Executive is responsible for planning, creating, scheduling and optimising organic social media content across our 13 TPFG brands.
   

  

 Working closely with Brand Managers, they will build a strong understanding of each brand’s identity, audiences, points of difference and campaign priorities. They will use this knowledge to create individual campaign calendars and ensure each brand has a distinctive, relevant and consistent social presence.
   

  

 The role owns the full content process, from campaign planning and idea generation through to copywriting, creative production, approvals, scheduling and publishing. With approximately 13 posts required each working day, the successful candidate must be a highly organised self\-starter who can manage a demanding workload and maintain strong attention to detail.
   

  

 They will use approved AI tools and structured workflows to increase the speed and scale of content production without compromising brand individuality, quality or accuracy. The role will also monitor performance, identify trends and turn findings into practical improvements.
   

  

 This is primarily an organic social media role, although an understanding of paid social media would be beneficial.
   

  

**Deliverables**
* Work with Brand Managers to understand brand positioning, audiences and campaign activity.
* Develop and maintain campaign calendars for all 13 brands.
* Plan, create, schedule and publish approximately one organic post per brand each working day.
* Produce engaging copy and support the creation of compelling imagery and creative assets.
* Protect each brand’s individual tone of voice and identity across social platforms.
* Use AI\-supported workflows for content planning, drafting, adaptation, repurposing and analysis.
* Review and quality\-check all AI\-assisted content before publication.
* Manage content approvals, deadlines and scheduling across multiple concurrent campaigns.
* Monitor organic social media performance, including reach, engagement, traffic and audience growth.
* Use performance data to test, optimise and improve future content.
* Report key findings and recommendations to Brand Managers and the wider marketing team.
* Maintain an awareness of paid social media and how it can complement organic activity.


**Skills And Experience**
* Highly organised and able to manage a large volume of activity.
* Proactive, self\-motivated and comfortable taking ownership.
* Strong copywriting and creative content skills.
* Able to work across multiple brands without producing generic or repetitive content.
* Confident using social media publishing, scheduling and reporting tools.
* Experienced in using AI tools and developing repeatable content workflows.
* Data\-led, with the ability to turn performance insights into action.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to brand quality.

title: Product Marketing and GTM Campaigns Manager
description:
**Role: Product Marketing and GTM Campaigns Manager** 




 Location: HSR Layout, Bangalore
 



 Prev. Experience: 5\-7 yrs
 



  





**About Qoruz** 
 , the Journey, and Life at Qoruz: https://bit.ly/TheQoruzLife
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is a hands\-on GTM role responsible for turning Qoruz’s product priorities and market problems into campaigns that create enterprise demand.
 



 When we identify an opportunity, launching a new product, building leadership around a category, responding to competition, or changing how the market perceives Qoruz: you will own how we take on that problem in the market.
 



 You will design and run these programs end\-to\-end across narrative, content, video, web, PR, distribution, sales enablement, ABM, and other relevant touchpoints.
 



 You will be measured on whether these programs create qualified enterprise attention, interest and influence over the pipeline, not based on the number of activities executed.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




  




* Turn a clear business goal or product priority into a campaign plan and take it live
* Own major product and category campaigns end\-to\-end, from the initial idea and messaging to launch, distribution, and results
* Decide what each campaign needs across medium \- website, content, videos, reports, customer stories, PR, email, sales material, and other formats, and drive them to completion
* Work with PR, SEO, and design teams, to make sure every part of the campaign works together
* Equip ABM and Sales with the narratives, assets, proof, and campaign hooks required to create and progress enterprise opportunities
* Track whether campaigns are creating qualified interest, sales opportunities, and pipeline, and improve them based on what works



  





**Right fit** 



* 5–7 years of experience across B2B SaaS product marketing, GTM, demand generation, integrated marketing, or enterprise marketing
* Has independently taken campaigns or product launches from a broad business brief to a complete market\-facing program
* Strong at turning a business problem into a campaign idea, narrative, content plan, distribution strategy, and execution roadmap
* Comfortable coordinating multiple teams and specialists while remaining personally accountable for the final outcome
* Commercially minded and comfortable being measured on qualified demand, opportunities, and pipeline contribution
* Can think strategically about where Qoruz should show up while still being hands\-on with execution



  





**Not a Right fit** 



* Needs a detailed campaign brief before being able to start execution
* Experience is primarily in managing individual channels only (social, emails, content or PR)
* Previous KRAs were largely limited to content creation only. (blogs or sales collateral)
* Has primarily coordinated agencies or specialists without personally owning the campaign



  





 If you think in systems, care about outcomes, and want to build a real revenue engine, we’d love to move this quick.

title: Senior Manager, Product Marketing
description:
**Why this role exists** 




  





 We are looking for a Senior Manager \- Product Marketing to build and lead the Product Marketing function at JustCall, SaaS Labs' flagship B2B SaaS product.
 



  





 This is a high impact Product Marketing and GTM leadership role for someone who can translate market insights, customer needs, competitive intelligence and complex product capabilities into compelling positioning and revenue driving GTM strategies.
 



  





 You will work closely with Product, Sales, Growth, and Customer Success to define how JustCall is positioned in the market, drive product launches and adoption, enable Sales, strengthen competitive differentiation and connect Product Marketing initiatives directly to pipeline, win rates, revenue and customer growth.
 



  





 This role is ideal for a B2B SaaS Product Marketing leader who combines strategic thinking with strong execution and thrives in a fast paced, high ownership environment.
 



  





**What you'll actually do** 




  




* Own product positioning and messaging for JustCall, ensuring our value proposition and differentiation are clear across customer touchpoints, buyer personas and sales stages.
* Build and maintain a structured competitive intelligence and market intelligence function, including competitor tracking, alerts, battlecards, market insights, pricing, packaging and messaging analysis.
* Lead GTM strategy and product launches end to end \- from market research and positioning to launch planning, sales enablement, adoption and performance tracking.
* Partner closely with Sales and Enterprise Sales teams to strengthen outbound motions, customer conversations, objection handling, competitive positioning and win loss strategies.
* Develop compelling sales enablement content, battlecards, messaging frameworks, pitch narratives and other tools that help Sales teams win more effectively.
* Translate complex AI, SaaS, and technology products into clear, differentiated customer narratives that resonate with technical and business buyers.
* Connect Product Marketing programs to measurable business outcomes including pipeline generation, win rates, competitive displacement, product adoption, expansion, retention and revenue growth.
* Partner with Product, Growth, and Customer Success on product adoption, expansion, and retention initiatives across the customer lifecycle.
* Use customer insights, market research, data, and competitive signals to continuously refine positioning, messaging and GTM strategy.
* Build scalable Product Marketing playbooks, launch frameworks, processes, and sales enablement programs that improve with every launch and GTM cycle.



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* 10\+ years of experience across Product Marketing, GTM Strategy, Growth or related B2B SaaS functions.
* Strong experience in B2B SaaS Product Marketing, particularly in roles involving close partnership with Sales and measurable revenue impact.
* Proven expertise in product positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, GTM strategy, product launches and sales enablement.
* Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect Product Marketing initiatives to pipeline, win rates, product adoption, customer expansion and revenue.
* Experience working with enterprise SaaS or outbound sales teams, with a strong understanding of complex B2B buying journey.
* Strong market and competitive orientation, with the ability to identify changes in competitor products, pricing, packaging, positioning and messaging.
* Excellent storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex AI and SaaS products into compelling value propositions.
* High ownership and a strong builder mindset \- comfortable creating processes and programs from the ground up in a fast growing organization.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to use customer research, market data, competitive intelligence and business metrics to inform decisions.
* Ability to operate independently, influence senior stakeholders, and work effectively across Product, Sales, Marketing, Growth and Customer Success.



  





**Edges that help** 




  




* You've built a competitive intelligence function or system from scratch, rather than simply maintaining competitor slides.
* You've directly influenced Sales strategy, customer conversations, win rates, competitive displacement, or deal outcomes through Product Marketing.
* You have experience marketing AI SaaS, AI powered products, platform products, or technically complex B2B software.
* You've built scalable Product Marketing playbooks, GTM frameworks, product launch processes and sales enablement programs.
* You can identify market opportunities, customer pain points, and positioning gaps independently and turn those insights into action.
* You've operated in a high growth SaaS environment where speed, ambiguity, ownership and measurable outcomes matter.



  





**How we work** 




  




* Outcomes over output: We measure Product Marketing impact through win rates, pipeline influence, product adoption, competitive displacement, and revenue, not the number of decks produced.
* High ownership: You'll build and shape the Product Marketing function rather than inherit a fully established one.
* Fast\-paced execution: We work in short cycles, embrace ambiguity, and expect strong market judgment combined with execution rigor.
* Cross\-functional by design: You'll work closely with Product, Sales, Growth, Marketing and Customer Success to drive business outcomes.
* Commercial impact: Your work will directly influence how we position, sell, launch and grow JustCall.



  





**The bigger picture** 




  





 JustCall is SaaS Labs' flagship product \- used by 6,000\+ businesses across 70\+ countries to run their customer conversations. We're backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners, have crossed $40M ARR, and are building toward $100M with the team, the product, and the infrastructure to get there.
 



  





 If this is the role you've been waiting to find \- let's talk.
 



  





 SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to making hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

title: Users Retention Manager (Product Growth)
description:
**Retention Manager – Product Growth** 




 Location: Bangalore (Office – HSR Layout)
 



 Department: CRM / Growth
 



  





**About AppsForBharat** 




 AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir App) is building beautifully crafted, AI\-first consumer experiences that help millions of Indians connect with spirituality and culture. We’re backed by Peak XV Partners, Elevation, Fundamentum, and other top\-tier investors, and are one of India’s fastest\-growing Series C consumer\-tech companies.
 



 Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, is the world’s largest platform for Hindu devotees, powering rituals, teachings, personalized recommendations, and a thriving devotional community. India’s $44B devotion economy is still largely offline, and we’re bringing structure, accessibility, and meaning to this massive market, where design and data play a central role in shaping user behavior at scale.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a Retention Manager – Product Growth to own one of our most important growth problems: how do we get users to come back, transact more frequently, and build a long\-term relationship with Sri Mandir?
 



 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Growth, CRM and Data. You will use user behaviour, cohort insights and experimentation to identify retention opportunities and turn them into scalable product, engagement and lifecycle interventions.
 



 This is not a traditional CRM/campaign role. You will own the retention problem, while working with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to determine the right levers to solve it.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* **Retention Strategy:** 
 Build and drive the retention roadmap across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value user cohorts.
* **User \& Behaviour Insights:** 
 Deep\-dive into user behaviour, cohorts, frequency, repeat patterns and LTV to identify the biggest retention opportunities.
* **Product\-led Retention:** 
 Design and scale interventions such as subscriptions, loyalty/reward systems, personalisation, pricing/discounting and repeat\-use experiences.
* **Experimentation:** 
 Build a continuous experimentation pipeline — identify hypotheses, define success metrics, launch experiments and measure incremental impact.
* **Reactivation \& Frequency:** 
 Identify opportunities to bring dormant users back and increase the frequency of existing users through product and engagement interventions.
* **Cross\-functional Execution:** 
 Partner closely with Product, CRM, Data, Design and Business teams to take retention initiatives from insight → PRD/experiment → launch → measurement → scale.
* **Retention Measurement:** 
 Build frameworks to understand the impact of retention initiatives on repeat rate, frequency, revenue, contribution margin and LTV.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Diagnose Retention Problems** 



* Analyse retention and repeat behaviour across user, category, product, deity, geography, platform, acquisition source and other relevant dimensions.
* Identify where and why users drop off across their lifecycle.
* Translate data into clear behavioural insights and actionable opportunities.



**2\. Build Retention Solutions** 



* Convert insights into product, loyalty, personalisation and lifecycle hypotheses.
* Work with Product and CRM teams to design solutions that address specific user needs and behavioural gaps.
* Prioritise opportunities based on expected user and business impact.



**3\. Run a Strong Experimentation Engine** 



* Own the retention experimentation roadmap.
* Define hypotheses, control/treatment groups, success metrics and measurement frameworks.
* Evaluate experiments based on
 **incremental impact** 
 , not just engagement metrics.
* Scale successful interventions and quickly learn from unsuccessful ones.



**4\. Improve Repeat \& Lifetime Value** 



* Develop strategies to increase repeat transactions and user frequency.
* Identify opportunities to move users from first transaction → repeat → high\-frequency behaviour.
* Build interventions that improve long\-term user value rather than short\-term conversion alone.



**5\. Build Retention Intelligence** 



* Develop and maintain retention dashboards and reporting frameworks for daily/weekly decision\-making.
* Track key metrics including retention, repeat rate, frequency, reactivation and LTV.
* Establish clear measurement frameworks for major retention initiatives.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* **6–8 years of experience** 
 in growth, retention, product growth, lifecycle, consumer internet or related roles.
* Strong experience solving
 **consumer retention and engagement problems** 
 through data and experimentation.
* Strong analytical ability with hands\-on experience in
 **cohort analysis, funnel analysis, retention metrics and LTV/business impact analysis** 
 .
* Strong product sense — able to identify user problems and translate them into product or growth opportunities.
* Experience running
 **A/B tests and growth experiments** 
 end\-to\-end.
* Understanding of CRM/lifecycle marketing and how communication can complement product\-led retention.
* Comfortable working with
 **SQL, product analytics and dashboards** 
 such as Mixpanel, Metabase, Superset or equivalent tools.
* Strong cross\-functional skills — able to work effectively with Product, Data, Design, CRM and Business teams.
* Bias towards action, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and independently identify and solve high\-impact problems.



  





**What Will Make You Successful** 




 You should naturally think in a loop:
 



**Understand user behaviour → Identify the retention problem → Form a hypothesis → Build the right intervention → Experiment → Measure incremental impact → Scale** 




 You should be equally comfortable discussing:
 


* Why a user did not return
* What behavioural segment is most valuable
* What product change could improve repeat behaviour
* Whether a subscription/loyalty intervention will actually create incremental retention
* How CRM can amplify a product intervention
* Whether an experiment genuinely moved LTV or simply shifted existing demand



  





**Key Deliverables** 



* **Retention Opportunity Roadmap** 
 across new, repeat, dormant and high\-value cohorts
* **Retention \& Cohort Intelligence Dashboard** 
 for ongoing decision\-making
* Continuous
 **Retention Experimentation Pipeline** 
 with clear hypotheses and measurement
* Successful rollout and optimisation of
 **product\-led retention initiatives**
* Measurable improvement in
 **repeat rate, retention, frequency, reactivation and LTV**
* Clear post\-launch measurement and learning framework for all major retention initiatives



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Sri Mandir serves users across very different spiritual needs, behaviours and frequencies. The next phase of growth is not only about acquiring more users — it is about
 **understanding what brings users back and building experiences that make the next spiritual action easier, more relevant and more meaningful.** 




 This role will be at the centre of that problem —
 **building the systems, insights and experiments that turn one\-time users into long\-term users.** 




  





**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys**

title: Growth Manager
description:
Job Title: Program Manager \- New Store Growth
 



 Function: Growth
 



 Level: Manager
 



 Location: HQ / Regional HQ
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a Program Manager to own and drive demand\-led growth for new stores and expanding cities, with a relentless focus on maximising total orders. This role will sit at the intersection of Growth, Category, Supply, Brand, Monetisation, and Product, ensuring that newly launched stores scale rapidly, capture high order volumes, and build sustainable demand momentum from day one.
 



 The person will strategise and execute targeted demand generation initiatives designed specifically to drive order growth. The role requires someone who is deeply strategic and capable of leading high\-stakes cross\-functional execution to scale order throughput across new store networks and city expansions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Define, strategise, and execute end\-to\-end demand growth playbooks for new stores and city expansions, centered on accelerating total order volume.
2. Partner with Monetisation teams to unlock high\-yield brand partnerships, sponsored placements and co\-marketing budgets that directly fuel order growth in new launch zones.
3. Collaborate with Category and Supply teams to ensure campaign SKUs are fully stocked and available in dark stores ahead of launch.
4. Work alongside Brand, Performance Marketing, and CRM teams to design the communication strategy for the new stores.
5. Run daily and weekly demand governance cadences, tracking execution timelines, cross\-functional dependencies, and order targets for new store launches.
6. Track demand\-side metrics including traffic, conversion, repeat behavior, and customer funnel drop\-offs.
7. Conduct root cause analyses on underperforming stores, designing corrective action plans across functions to recover the lost order potential.
8. Prepare weekly business reviews with insights, root causes, actions, owners, timelines, and impact tracking.
9. Develop repeatable, cross\-functional playbooks for new store openings to streamline launch execution, minimise time\-to\-scale, and ensure consistent order ramp\-up across new catchments



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 



1. 1\-2 years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, revenue operations, business development, category growth, or program management.
2. Strong analytical skills with hands\-on comfort in Excel / Google Sheets, SQL, dashboards, and BI tools.
3. High ownership, structured problem solving, and strong follow\-through.
4. Strong stakeholder management across Growth, Category, Supply, Operations, Product, Analytics, and City teams.
5. Comfortable working with store\-level, SKU\-level, category\-level, and funnel\-level data.
6. Proven ability to identify root causes from data and drive cross\-functional action.
7. Ability to manage multiple stores / cities / categories simultaneously in a fast\-paced operating environment.
8. Prior experience in quick commerce, e\-commerce, grocery, retail, FMCG, food delivery, marketplace, or hyperlocal businesses will be preferred.

**Description**
 Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. The Category Manager will work on offering dedicated support to top\-tiered brands to grow with Amazon by identifying and improving key customer inputs for growth such as content, marketing and stock availability among others. Apart from this, the Category Manager will also help brands leverage Amazon’s tools and programs to improve on their business inputs.
   

  

 We are seeking creative, goal\-oriented and highly entrepreneurial people to join our exciting and fast\-paced team.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Category Managers at Amazon have end to end responsibility of the customer experience and growth of their category. Amazon strives to present its customers with the widest selection of products at the best prices. Category managers anticipate their customer needs and incorporate them into the business roadmap and own end\-to\-end execution with stakeholders including brands and sellers. They will also drive major changes or enhancement for customer experience influencing category needs based on their knowledge of competitive trends in the marketplace and other macro environment data.
   

  

 Responsibilities Include
   

  

 The successful candidate will be the business owner, with responsibility for signing the right mix of selection in partnership with sellers, adding unique selection, driving traffic conversion, relevant promotion constructs while delivering top notch customer experience on catalog as well. She/he must be an effective leader and communicator working with our most important partners, as well as with internal colleagues and groups. She/he will have strong business judgment with a track record of strong ownership values and relationship management skills. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work on a new business challenge.
   

  

 As a Category Manager in Shoes, you will focus on delivering a world\-class customer experience and exceptional sales and margin growth for the sub\-categories that you are responsible for as we rapidly expand and grow our selection from around the world.
   

  

 The person who joins this team in this position must share our passion and commitment for serving our customers. This ideal candidate should have experience in forging and building stakeholder relationships. Some understanding of planning product cycles and selling online is preferred. The right candidate will be flexible, action and results oriented, self\-starting and have strong analytical skills. He or she must have a proven track record in taking ownership, driving results and moving with speed to implement ideas in a fast\-paced environment. He should be entrepreneurial with the confidence to make independent, data\-driven decisions.
   

  

**The Candidate Must Demonstrate The Ability To Succeed At**
 Defining and implementing strategies
   

  

 Driving an online business
   

  

 Managing internal and external stakeholders
   

  

 Planning and forecasting
   

  

 He or she must be able to develop clear thinking and business rationale for new features \& services to bring customers ease\-of\-use and innovation with a razor sharp focus on solving for the customer while driving operational excellence in execution. The candidate must be an effective communicator in working with some of Amazon’s most important partners and vendors, as well as with internal colleagues and groups. The candidate must have a desire to participate in change and appreciate a dynamic environment with rapidly changing priorities. We are seeking someone with demonstrated history of successful project ownership using customer data to identify and prioritize opportunities.
   

  

 Candidate will own one of the critical businesses for Footwear business responsible for success of both immediate as well as long term strategy.

* 3\+ years of with Excel experience
* 5\+ years of retail, operations, product or program management, or business management/consulting with negotiations and delivering results experience
* Experience with financial analysis and P\&L ownership


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements
* Experience in vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion, inventory management, and product development

**Important:** 
 CPL will not be the primary success metric.

 07 — Creative Strategy

**Hook × Audience × Offer × Creative × Landing Page**

 Sipaara is an AI\-powered BeautyTech platform focused on personalized beauty intelligence.

 **AI skin analysis, personalized product recommendations, virtual try\-on, beauty discovery and B2B AI APIs**

 **equity/co\-founder terms to be mutually agreed based on the candidate's investment, experience, network and contribution.**

* Build acquisition and retention strategies

* Establish Sipaara as a recognized AI BeautyTech brand

* Build and lead the growth, marketing and business development team

* Participate in strategic company decisions
* Work directly with the founder on company vision and execution
* Participate in future fundraising and investor discussions
* Help build the company's leadership team
* Take ownership of growth and revenue outcomes


 👤 Who We're Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 


* An entrepreneur, growth leader, founder or senior business executive
* Experienced in
 **startup growth, consumer technology, D2C, SaaS, AI, BeautyTech or e\-commerce**
* Strong in customer acquisition and business development
* Comfortable building from 0 → 1 and 1 → 10
* Highly networked within the beauty, retail, technology or investment ecosystem
* Comfortable speaking with investors, founders and senior executives
* Data\-driven but highly execution\-oriented
* Willing to take significant ownership and responsibility


 ⭐ Ideal Candidate
 
 You could be a great fit if you have:
 


* Built or scaled a startup/business
* Led significant revenue or user growth
* Strong B2B/B2C growth experience
* Experience raising capital or working with investors
* A strong network of brands, retailers, creators or strategic partners
* Experience entering new markets
* An entrepreneurial mindset and long\-term vision


 💎 What You Get
 * **Co\-Founder\-level position**
* Meaningful equity/ownership opportunity
* Opportunity to shape Sipaara's growth strategy
* Direct involvement in strategic decisions
* Opportunity to build and lead the growth organization
* Participation in future fundraising and expansion
* Opportunity to build a global AI BeautyTech company from an early stage


 💰 Investment \& Equity
 
**Investment commitment: ₹1 Crore** 




 The ₹1 Crore investment is a requirement for this specific co\-founder opportunity.
 



 The investment and equity structure will be discussed transparently and mutually agreed based on:
 


* Capital contribution
* Relevant experience
* Strategic network
* Growth expertise
* Level of involvement
* Long\-term contribution to Sipaara


 🌎 Our Vision
 
 Our vision is to build Sipaara into an
 **AI intelligence layer for the global beauty ecosystem** 
 — connecting consumers, brands, retailers and beauty platforms through personalized AI.
 



 If you believe the future of beauty is

 Sr. Director Product Management
   

  

 At Capital One, we think big and do bigger things. We were the first company to develop and offer mass customization and personalization of credit card, auto loans and other financial services products, and we have been innovating relentlessly ever since. Today, we are a progressive financial services powerhouse spanning Credit Cards, Auto Loans, Savings, and Commercial Banking and at the same time a high tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a well recognized brand all in one. We are a passionate and entrepreneurial team with heart, a team that embraces bold ideas, fosters collaboration, and delivers world class products and services impacting over 65 million customer accounts.
   

  

 Still founder\-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change.
   

  

****Team Description:****
**Capital One Software** 
 is a new line of business within Capital One that provides software to allow regulated Enterprises to unleash data to safely empower innovation. Capital One Software launched Slingshot, an AI assisted Data warehouse optimization product and Databolt, a data management and protection platform with many more innovations still in progress. Customers want to enable safe use of proprietary data to allow agents and AI models to build differentiated business offerings. Capital One Software is a catalyst for this change and Capital One India is fueling the innovation and next generation of products and services for Capital One Software. Our bold entrepreneurial initiative to build the Data Management and protection platform for an AI first world where data, specifically proprietary and sensitive data, becomes the key enabler for an Enterprise business.
   

  

****About the Role:****
 Capital One Software in India is looking for senior product leadership to spearhead our foray into the next generation of Capital One Software in an AI native world. This role involves working backwards from customers, working with product leaders to define the precise problem we are solving, and leading Engineering teams to build impactful products that delight customers. The role encompasses recruiting, developing, and motivating an exceptional team that is drawn from elite campuses in India and abroad, and focused on our mission to develop world class data products.
   

  

****In this role, you will be expected to demonstrate proficiency in four key areas:****
****Human Centered****
* You’ll deeply immerse yourself in knowing your internal and/or external customer(s) needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions.
* You’ll be challenged to discover customer needs and inspire innovative solutions or products in light of industry trends, emerging technologies and business and customer insights.


****Business Focused****
* You’ll be the leader to develop a compelling portfolio or product vision for our organization to deliver capabilities that empower differentiated customer experiences and deliver breakthrough business value.
* You’ll lead a team that translates vision into strategic product roadmaps with an agile delivery approach in partnership with Tech while managing cyber, operational and/or regulatory risks.


****Technology Driven****
* You’ll partner with Technology leaders to influence end state architecture and drive secure, resilient, performant and scalable technology solutions that solve material customer and business problems.
* You’ll be responsible for making technology investments decisions by assessing opportunities for reusing Enterprise solutions or for and building new ones with extensibility \& enterprise scalability in mind.


****Transformational Leadership****
* You’ll influence a broad set of senior executives across the enterprise and your organization who are stakeholders or delivery partners to successfully deliver on your portfolio/product vision.
* You’ll establish a long term product portfolio strategy, informed by customer and business needs, to gain alignment, secure resources and overcome impediments.
* You’ll attract, grow, empower, and inspire top product talent as they develop and deliver on their local product strategy.


****The Ideal Candidate:****
****Intellectually Curious:****
 You’re comfortable navigating between the big ideas and executional realities to create an achievable strategic product vision. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges.
   

  

****A Strong Communicator \& Influencer:****
 You’re comfortable influencing a group of executives as well as communicating your product vision clearly to your associates and partners. You can be open to different communication styles and listen carefully to diverse sets of ideas.
   

  

****A Do\-er with Action Oriented:****
 You’re biased toward action, and are willing to make commitments and trade offs with other leaders to remove impediments for your team; you are a leader obsessed with delivering valuable in an iterative way focusing on minimum viable product.
   

  

****Passionate \& Customer Focused:****
 You care about growing others and bringing them together around what’s possible. You have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needs and build long lasting relationships.
   

  

****Growth Mindset:****
 You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when exploring unknown technologies; you will seek for internal solutions before building new ones.
   

  

****A Team Player:****
 You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You are also able to coach others and be a mentor in product development.
   

  

****Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:****
* Develop and communicate the product vision and strategy for your area of responsibility.
* Partner with business and technology leadership to align on prioritization of key problems to be solved to maximize business and customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with teams in India and USA to drive alignment with different teams working on the platform.

* Maintain a healthy backlog of work and play a critical role in many agile ceremonies.

We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Senior Manager in Product Management, you will lead the charge in developing innovative software solutions within our Technology Consulting practice. You will be at the forefront of driving digital transformation and enhancing business performance, using your skills to design, code, and test applications that revolutionize industries and deliver exceptional user experiences. As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and network to deliver quality results, motivating and coaching teams to solve complex problems. You will apply sound judgment, recognizing when to take action and when to escalate, while developing and sustaining high\-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will focus on strategic advising and problem\-solving, crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story. You will validate outcomes with clients, share alternative perspectives, and act on client feedback. Your ability to direct teams through complexity, demonstrating composure in challenging situations, will contribute to the success of our firm. This position offers the opportunity to deepen your skills and evolve your professional capabilities, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
