* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to identify and address software development challenges
* Overseeing the deployment of scalable software solutions and confirming their integration with existing systems
* Promoting the use of advanced methodologies like Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
* Validating software quality through rigorous testing and debugging processes
* Directing teams through complex problem\-solving scenarios, demonstrating composure in ambiguous situations
* Applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities for improvement
* Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story to stakeholders and clients


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 12 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Strong product fundamentals \& product sense — owns a product surface end\-to\-end: discovery, roadmap, prioritization, launch, iteration.

* 6\+ years in product management, including a zero\-to\-one product.

title: Brand & Social Lead
description:
**About 4 Degrees of U (4DU)** 




 4DU (https://4degreesu.com/) is a women\-first wellness brand building products around the different ways women want to feel and show up in their lives \- stronger, more focused, more balanced, and more confident in how they look and feel.
 



  





 Our current portfolio includes daily nutrition bars and functional protein powders. Our larger ambition is to build a modern wellness brand that supports women from the inside out.
 



  





 We are now looking for a \*\*Brand \& Social Lead\*\* to shape how 4DU shows up on social media, in culture and across brand\-led communication.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is not just a content calendar management role.
 



  





 You will be the internal owner of 4DU’s social media and day\-to\-day brand expression—turning business priorities, product stories and cultural insights into content that feels distinctly 4DU.
 



  





 You will work closely with the founders, growth team, marketing advisors, performance team and external creative partners. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, direct creative work and build the systems required to help our content engine move faster.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




  





**Social Media Strategy** 



* Define monthly and quarterly social priorities
* Build and evolve our content pillars
* Translate brand and business objectives into strong social narratives
* Identify relevant cultural conversations, trends and emerging formats
* Balance brand\-building, product storytelling, education and entertainment
* Build a differentiated social identity for 4DU



  





**Brand and Creative Direction** 



* Become a strong custodian of 4DU’s positioning, voice and visual world
* Develop briefs for campaigns, reels, carousels, shoots and creator content
* Improve hooks, storytelling structures, formats and visual treatments
* Give agencies, designers and creators clear, actionable feedback
* Build repeatable content franchises that audiences associate with 4DU
* Maintain a healthy mix of planned and reactive content



  





**Agency and Partner Management** 



* Lead our relationship with social media and creative partners
* Set clear creative direction, expectations and timelines
* Review concepts and executions
* Work with creators, photographers, designers, freelancers and production partners
* Build systems that help external teams understand and deliver the 4DU brand more independently



  





**Social Operations** 



* Own the content calendar and publishing schedule
* Maintain a rolling 2–3 week content pipeline
* Manage production timelines, approvals and deliverables
* Build workflows for planned and reactive content
* Lead weekly and monthly social reviews
* Create processes that allow content volume to scale without compromising quality



  





**Performance and Learning** 



* Track which messages, hooks, formats and consumer benefits resonate
* Use comments, objections and audience behaviour to improve content
* Work closely with the growth and performance teams
* Build a continuous feedback loop between organic and paid content
* Use data to sharpen creative decisions without allowing metrics alone to dictate the brand



  





**Campaigns and Launches** 



* Develop narratives for product launches and brand initiatives
* Build pre\-launch, launch and post\-launch content plans
* Create social\-first campaign ideas
* Work with creators and partners to bring campaigns to life
* Ensure launches feel culturally relevant—not purely transactional



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




  





 You may be a strong fit if you:
 


* Have approximately 3–5 years of experience across brand, social media, creative or content
* Have worked with a strong consumer, D2C, FMCG, beauty, wellness or lifestyle brand or at an excellent creative or social agency
* Understand both long\-term brand building and fast\-moving social media
* Have a strong instinct for culture, trends and internet behaviour
* Can distinguish between content that is simply viral and content that meaningfully builds a brand
* Have excellent creative judgement and can defend a point of view
* Can turn strategy into clear, actionable briefs
* Can manage agencies and creative partners effectively
* Are highly organised and comfortable running multiple content streams
* Can move quickly, make decisions and take ownership



  





 This Role May Not Be for You If:
 


* You see social media primarily as filling a monthly calendar
* Your default strategy is replicating trending reels
* You prefer executing briefs rather than shaping them
* You are uncomfortable giving direct creative feedback
* You need multiple layers of approval before making decisions
* You believe brand and performance marketing should operate independently



  





**Why Join 4DU?** 




  





 4DU is still early in its journey, which means this role will have meaningful influence over how the brand develops.
 


* There will be strategy \- but there will also be doing.
* There will be processes \- but you will help build them.



  





 Most importantly, you will have the opportunity to help a new consumer brand find its voice, build a distinctive identity and earn a place in culture.

**Job Description: Associate Key Account Manager (Fashion)**
**Role Objective**
 To drive growth, profitability, and customer experience for a designated set of fashion brands on the marketplace. You will be the primary point of contact for brand partners, helping them scale their business through data\-driven insights, selection optimization, and strategic promotion.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Account Management \& Relationship Building
* Act as the "Business Consultant" for brands, conducting weekly and monthly business reviews (MBRs).
* Onboard new brands and ensure their catalog is live, optimized, and visually appealing.
* Negotiate commercial terms, including commissions (Take Rate), marketing budgets, and exclusive launches.

* Own the Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) and revenue targets for your portfolio.
* Analyze sales data to identify "White Spaces" (gaps in the current collection) and advise brands to fill them.
* Monitor key metrics: Conversion Rate (CVR), Average Order Value (AOV), and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* Inventory \& Operations
* Manage Stock Cover and Inwarding; ensure brands have sufficient depth in "Hero SKUs" (best\-sellers).
* Collaborate with logistics teams to reduce RTO (Return to Origin) and improve fulfillment speed.
* Monitor pricing competitiveness to ensure your brands are winning the "Buy Box" or staying relevant against competitors.
* Marketing \& Merchandising
* Plan and execute the promotional calendar (e.g., End of Reason Sale, Diwali events, Flash Sales).
* Allocate premium "On\-Property" visibility (banners, search ads) to brands based on performance and ROI.
* Advise brands on improving digital assets (images, videos, descriptions) to boost organic discovery.


**Requirements \& Skills**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or Fashion Management (MBA preferred).
* Experience: 1–3 years in E\-commerce, Category Management, or Retail Buying.
* Analytical Rigor: Advanced proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) and data visualization tools (Tableau/SQL is a plus).
* Fashion Instinct: A strong pulse on current trends and seasonal cycles in the Indian/Global fashion market.
* Soft Skills: High\-stakes negotiation skills and the ability to influence C\-suite stakeholders at brand houses.

 Marketplace

* Launch a referral program that turns happy customers into predictable introductions (clear qualification criteria \+ simple rewards).
* Capture customer outcomes quickly and consistently (lightweight story capture and proof points to support campaigns, sales, and market leadership claims).
* Partner with AM/CX to launch lifecycle plays that drive expansion (usage nudges, add\-on prompts, QBR/ROI packaging).
* Coordinate onboarding communications and adoption motions across teams to improve activation, onboarding speed, and onboarding NPS.
* Own a closed\-loop NPS/CSAT rhythm (collection → insights → actions → follow\-up), ensuring customers see their feedback drive action.



  





**Field Marketing \& Experiences (Pipeline \+ Content)** 



* Own the FY26 events and experiences operating plan aligned to Roofing pipeline goals and content needs.
* Operationalize a monthly “Roofing Momentum” go\-live celebration \+ local meetup series that improves customer experience while generating local demand.
* Run a monthly webinar program with strong conversion paths (demo bookings \+ nurture).
* Execute a Roofing\-first field event portfolio (regional \+ national) with a focus on consistent pipeline creation and healthy unit economics.
* Implement an event measurement \+ follow\-up SLA (lead capture → routing → outreach → SAL) in partnership with Sales/RevOps.
* Work with Partner Marketing on co\-event motions (co\-hosted webinars or in\-person activations) to drive Partner/Alliances pipeline.
* Support production of our regular “Raise the Roof” Facebook livestream events by managing guest roster, run\-of\-show planning, and assets.



  





**Scale Through Systems \+ AI** 



* Use AI and templates to increase throughput (event comms, run\-of\-show, segmentation drafts, nurture copy, landing pages, post\-event reporting, VOC synthesis) without increasing headcount.
* Build repeatable playbooks so programs become easier and more scalable over time.



  





**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERS YOU’LL WORK WITH** 




 Customer Experience, Account Management, Partner Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Product.
 



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (EXAMPLES OF METRICS)** 



* Roofing Momentum program running monthly with consistent attendance, customer advocacy participation, and measurable pipeline influence.
* Reduced time\-to\-reference and increased reference utilization by Sales.
* Predictable referral\-driven introductions from qualified customer advocates.
* Webinar and field event programs generating demo bookings and pipeline at target unit economics.
* Documented event measurement and follow\-up SLA with improving conversion to Sales Qualified Lead.
* Increased volume and velocity of customer proof assets (short clips, quotes, mini\-stories) used by Sales and Marketing.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* 5\+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including meaningful ownership in two or more of: customer marketing/advocacy, field marketing/events, lifecycle/retention marketing, community, partner marketing.
* Proven ability to run programs end\-to\-end: strategy → planning → execution → measurement → iteration.
* Strong event execution chops (webinars, meetups, field events) with a bias toward measurable pipeline outcomes.
* Strong writing/storytelling skills: customer comms, event comms, proof points, nurture messaging.
* Comfort using AI tools and templates to scale output and move faster.
* Highly organized operator: able to manage a calendar of recurring programs and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Seattle\-area residency (required) and ability to host local activations; willingness to travel monthly for regional/national events.



  





**NICE TO HAVE** 



* Experience marketing to roofing \& exteriors, trades, field service, or similar SMB industry verticals.
* Experience building customer advocacy programs (references, referrals, community) from the ground up.
* Experience partnering closely with Sales/RevOps on lead routing, attribution, and SLAs.



  





**TRAVEL** 



* Expected travel is monthly and program\-dependent (e.g., local/regional/national events, VIP dinners/roundtables, customer roadshows).

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive adoption of digital tools or automation capabilities within operational environments.
* Strong analytical and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate performance insights into clear recommendations.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, ITIL, Service Management) are advantageous.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.
   

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working for you**
**Benefits**
 We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
   

  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home \-office \- home (applies in Chennai)


**About The Business**
 A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.
   

  

**We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Partner & Channel Sales Director,Resellers, VARs, Distributors
description:
Job description:
   

  

**Job Description** 

**The Opportunity** 




 Denodo is looking for a creative, focused, well\-organized and highly\-motivated individual to drive their Partner and Channel Sales. In this role you will win, maintain and expand relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting and technology partners and be responsible for achieving indirect sales targets, partner readiness and partner recruitment objectives.
 



 The role carries a partner sales quota and requires working closely with the Partner Marketing team to drive joint demand\-generation and with Direct Sales colleagues to develop and accelerate opportunities through partners.
 



 Operating at a strategic level, the candidate will define the partner strategy in his territory to build comprehensive partner coverage in the market. 
 


**Job Responsibilities \& Duties** 

**Responsibilities** 




**Partner Recruitment, Enablement, Development** 



* Proactively recruits new qualified partners.
* Establishes productive, professional relationships with key personnel in assigned partner accounts.
* Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates partner needs, gaps and requirements to be successful on an ongoing basis.
* Coordinates with other company teams to deliver adequate partner training for business and technical skills.
* Helps partners to develop solutions for /with Denodo DV to address client’s needs and further penetrate the market



**Partner Sales Planning and Execution** 



* Proactively leads a joint partner planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones associated with a productive partner relationship.
* Coordinates the involvement of company personnel, including direct sales, marketing, support, services, and management resources, in order to meet partner performance objectives and partners’ expectations.
* Meets assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned territory and partner accounts.
* Assists partners in their customer engagements to help position, promote and sell Denodo.
* Builds a strong partner pipeline through co\-marketing programs, account mapping of company and partner.
* Provides regular governance, reporting, and management of indirect and joint/co\-selling activities.



**General Partner Management** 



* Manages potential channel conflict with other partners or sales channels by fostering excellent communication internally and externally, and through strict adherence to channel rules of engagement.
* Ensures partner compliance with partner agreements.
* Drives adoption of company programs among assigned partners.
* Monitors performance of partners and coaches them to higher levels of success.
* Assists the global Partner Channel and Sales unit in developing efficient partner processes and workflows, company and partner performance reporting, partner marketing and support activities to enhance the partner program.



**Accountabilities and Performance Measures** 



* Achieves assigned sales quota (Indirect / Partner Sourced Sales) in the territory. Achieves intermediate metrics for partner\-driven sales activity, client meetings, and opportunities.
* Develops and executes partner account plans that meet company standards.
* Maintains high partner satisfaction ratings that meet company standards.
* Completes required training and development objectives within the assigned time frame.
* Achieves assigned goals for growing Denodo\-certified consultants in partner firms.



**Organizational Alignment** 



* Reports to the Regional Head of Partner and Channel Sales.
* Enlists the support of territory direct sales, inside sales, marketing, service resources and other sales and management resources as needed.


**Desired Skills \& Experience** 

**Desired Skills \& Experience** 



* Bachelors / Masters Degree in Business Administration.
* Fluent in English is required. Other languages will be a plus.
* 5\+ years of demonstrated experience in a similar role with a strong focus on indirect sales and channel development for a software product company.
* Track record of achieving targets with partner recruitment, enablement, opportunity generation and revenue.
* Excellent knowledge and experience of the workings of reseller, systems integrator and consulting ecosystem. Past relationships and network is a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and able to interact with technical and business counterparts both within and outside the company.
* Experience with “Data or Application Integration” will be preferred and knowledge / experience in the field of Big Data and/or Analytics will be an advantage.
* Willingness to travel around 25\-50%.
* Team player with positive attitude.
* Nice to have experience in leveraging Employee Advocacy and Social Media to network with industry peers, share thought leadership content, and enhance brand visibility to support sales engagement and relationship building.

title: Business Development Operations Manager
description:
Manager – Business Development, Projects \& Operations
 



  





 Spartek Group \| Chennai
 



  





 Experience: 3–5 Years
 



 Qualification: B.E./B.Tech / MBA / PGDM
 



 Function: Business Development \| Projects \| Operations
 



 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 About Spartek Group
 



 Spartek Group is a diversified building materials and construction solutions
 



 group with businesses across Tiles \& Sanitaryware, Precast Construction,
 



 Flooring Solutions, Construction Chemicals, Prefabricated Building Solutions
 



 and related construction products.
 



 We are looking for a dynamic professional who can work across business
 



 development, project execution and operations, helping identify
 



 opportunities, convert projects and ensure successful execution.
 



 Role Overview
 



 The role will involve working closely with the Chairman’s Office, Business
 



 Heads, Sales, Technical, Operations and Finance teams to drive business
 



 opportunities and projects from lead generation through execution and
 



 closure.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced
 



 entrepreneurial environment and should possess a combination of commercial
 



 understanding, technical orientation, project management capability and
 



 strong execution skills.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Business Development \& Sales
 



 • Identify and develop new business opportunities across construction,
 



 infrastructure, industrial and institutional segments.
 



  





 2
 



 • Build relationships with architects, consultants, contractors, developers,
 



 project owners and channel partners.
 



 • Generate and qualify leads and convert them into enquiries, proposals
 



 and orders.
 



 • Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify new
 



 opportunities.
 



 • Prepare commercial proposals, presentations, quotations and project
 



 submissions.
 



 • Support the development of new markets, products and business
 



 verticals.
 



 2\. Project Development \& Execution
 



 • Understand project requirements, technical specifications, BOQs and
 



 timelines.
 



 • Coordinate with customers, consultants, site teams, vendors and
 



 internal technical teams.
 



 • Track projects from enquiry → technical discussion → quotation → order
 



 → execution → billing → collection.
 



 • Monitor project schedules, material requirements, quality and execution
 



 milestones.
 



 • Identify project risks, delays and operational bottlenecks and coordinate
 



 corrective actions.
 



 • Participate in customer meetings, site visits and project reviews.
 



 3\. Operations \& Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 • Coordinate with procurement, production, logistics, finance, sales and
 



 project execution teams.
 



 • Ensure timely availability of materials and resources required for
 



 projects.
 



 • Monitor order fulfilment, dispatches, installations and project
 



 completion.
 



 • Develop MIS reports and dashboards covering enquiries, orders,
 



 revenue, project status and collections.
 



 • Improve processes, documentation and operating systems across
 



 business functions.
 



  





 3
 



  





 4\. Commercial \& Financial Responsibilities
 



 • Understand project costing, pricing, gross margins and contribution
 



 margins.
 



 • Support preparation of project\-level financial evaluations and business
 



 cases.
 



 • Track project profitability against approved budgets.
 



 • Coordinate with Finance for invoicing, receivables and collections.
 



 • Identify opportunities to improve project profitability and reduce
 



 operating costs.
 



 5\. Strategic Initiatives
 



 • Work with senior management on new business initiatives and market
 



 expansion.
 



 • Support feasibility studies for new products, projects and business
 



 verticals.
 



 • Prepare management presentations, business plans and opportunity
 



 assessments.
 



 • Support partnerships, JV/franchise opportunities and strategic customer
 



 acquisition.
 



 • Take ownership of special projects assigned by the Chairman’s Office /
 



 Management.
 



 Desired Candidate Profile
 



 • 3–5 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Sales,
 



 Projects, Operations, Construction, Infrastructure or Building Materials.
 



 • B.E./B.Tech with MBA/PGDM preferred.
 



 • Candidates from Engineering \+ MBA backgrounds will be preferred.
 



 • Strong commercial and business understanding.
 



 • Good project management and execution capabilities.
 



 • Ability to understand technical drawings, BOQs, specifications and
 



 project requirements.
 



 • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and business reporting.
 



 • Willingness to travel for customer meetings and project/site visits.
 



 • Strong ownership, analytical thinking and problem\-solving ability.
 



 • Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple teams.
 



  





 4
 



  





 Key Performance Indicators
 



 • New business opportunities generated
 



 • Enquiry\-to\-order conversion
 



 • Revenue and order value generated
 



 • Project execution and completion timelines
 



 • Gross/EBITDA margin achieved
 



 • Customer acquisition and relationship development
 



 • Collection and receivables performance
 



 • Operational efficiency and cost optimisation
 



 • Successful execution of strategic projects
 



 What the Role Offers
 



 • Opportunity to work directly with senior management and the
 



 Chairman’s Office.
 



 • Exposure across Business Development, Projects, Operations, Finance
 



 and Strategy.
 



 • Opportunity to work across multiple emerging business verticals of
 



 Spartek Group.
 



 • High ownership and decision\-making exposure in a growing
 



 organisation.
 



 • Career progression into Business Head / Project Head / Business
 



 Development leadership roles based on performance.
 



 Ideal Candidate: A commercially minded Engineer/MBA who can identify
 



 opportunities, understand the technical requirements, build the business
 



 case, coordinate execution and drive the project to closure.

description:

title: Senior Product Technology Manager
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C\+\+, Python).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
* 10 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer\-side web technologies.
* 10 years of experience with data analysis and SQL/MySQL.
* 10 years of experience in a customer\-facing role.
* 10 years of experience in operations management (i.e. process improvement, operational reviews, optimizing workflows, etc).
* 10 years of experience working with Unix or Linux operating systems/commands.


**About The Job**
 As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross\-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.
   

  

 You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.
   

  

 Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
   

  

 To learn more about gTech, check out our video .
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with internal stakeholders to establish technical road maps that accomplish our business objectives.
* Understand complex, ambiguous, open\-ended business problems and produce an actionable, results\-oriented strategy to solve those problems.
* Build and action product architectures and solution roadmaps, including the design of infrastructure necessary to support the business objectives of our stakeholders.
* Create launch programs with partners to ensure that new products and feature releases are tested before broad\-scale deployment.
* Perform implementation reviews, advocate for new product features and ensure the prompt and proper resolution of technical issues.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: SAP GSI Alliances / Channel Manager
description:
We are looking for a GSI Alliances Manager to build and lead Avantra’s regional alliance strategy with Global System Integrators (GSIs) across India. This is a high\-visibility, senior individual contributor role: you will build a partner program from the ground up, developing executive, sales, technical, and delivery relationships that turn strategic partnerships into predictable, partner\-generated pipeline and revenue.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Build and own executive and field relationships across assigned GSIs, engaging partner stakeholders across sales, SAP, AMS, and delivery organisations.
* Design and deliver partner enablement programmes, including workshops, technical training, and certification, to grow a network of partner sellers, architects, and consultants who recommend Avantra.
* Develop and execute joint account plans and go\-to\-market strategies with strategic partners to build a qualified, partner\-generated pipeline.
* Influence and close of partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced revenue, working closely with Solutions, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success.
* Plan and run regional go\-to\-market initiatives, such as Innovation Days, executive briefings, partner events, and customer workshops, to expand Avantra’s presence and brand awareness.
* Create a repeatable alliance engagement model that can be replicated across other regions, including AMS, EMEA, and APJ.


**Qualifications And Requirements**
* 10\+ years of Alliance, Channel, Partner Sales, Business Development, or GSI management experience
* Proven track record of building executive\-level GSI relationships and generating measurable partner\-sourced pipeline and revenue.
* Strong understanding of SAP ecosystems (S/4HANA, SAP Managed Services, RISE with SAP, SAP Basis), and direct experience partnering GSIs
* Experience with Observability, AIOps, ITOM, Monitoring, Automation, or Cloud Ops platforms;
* background in partner enablement or certification programmes
* Familiarity with Salesforce or PRM platforms.


**About Avantra**
 Avantra is a high growth tech company with 26 years of Swiss precision engineering coupled with the energy of a start\-up. Our product is the leading AIOps platform for SAP operations, enabling customers to achieve hyperautomation success. Our customers are large multinational enterprises and household names, including national and global managed service providers. We have teams based across Switzerland, Germany, UK, US, Eastern Europe \& India.
   

  

 Our culture is something we are incredibly proud of and strive to protect. We live our values of Be Caring, Embrace Challenge and Stay Curious every day through company mindfulness sessions, wellbeing days and retaining a family feel. If this sounds like a good fit for you, why not say hello?
   

  

**Benefits**
 This exciting role offers the opportunity to be involved in a high growth software company and will present significant opportunities for personal growth:
   

  

* Competitive Salary
* Competitive holiday \& benefits package
* Remote working
* 1 Avantra wellbeing holiday day
* Learning \& development programme


**Location**
 This role is intended to be a remote role.
   

  

 Occasional travel for customer visits, company and team gatherings is likely.

title: Senior Manager - Revenue Management
description:
**Overview**
 ICC is a growing function within PepsiCo that leverages one strategy and common approach to introduce new, technology\-driven capabilities and elevate service quality while meeting current and future business needs. PEP RGM is a key priority function where transformation, technology, strategy and capabilities enablement are aimed to be the best in class, and to be standardized and deployed globally. The vision is to develop playbook to develop analytic packs with insights across Brand Ladders, Channel PPA, In\-Market Pack Price realization, Trade Investment Strategy, Promo ROI and Mix Management. This work will accelerate growth through efficient positioning across price tiers, optimized channel\-based package types, right pricing, well directed commercial strategy and increase promotional ROI driven by enhanced and standardized insights.
   

  

 This position will be part of the ICC \- Revenue growth Management organization. This position contributes to the success of the company and contribute to growth through strategy development, and implementation of RGM frameworks. The incumbement will work for different markets across the globe and work with different stakeholders to develop RGM playbooks and ensure analytics execution
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Functional Responsibilities
   

  

* ICC RGM analyst will be responsible for conducting data analyses across all RGM levers \- Pricing, Promotion, Assortment Mix and Trade Investment
* Lead data aggregation and harmonization that will form the backbone of RGM analytics
* Collaborate with Market Cluster Leads to understand market dynamics and incorporate market feedback into analyses
* Bring out Next Gen Revenue Management insights by implementing advance analytics
* Integrate insights comprehensive summaries for RGM Tower Lead and RGM leader
* Improve understanding of pricing, promotions, pack architecture and trade investments through use of data analytic tools and visualization tools
* Improve processes of analyses and data management across category business units and marketing functions
* Develop observations/insights for each analysis in the RGM playbook and synthesize insights across analyses to create a storyline of opportunities
* Implement continued improvements and simplifications of processes, standardization of reporting and optimal use of technology
* Create an inclusive and collaborative environment
* Adavanced Analytics – Price Elasticity, Promotion Effectiveness and knowledge of Python, R, Tableau/Power Bi


 Key Activities
   

  

* Perform granular level analysis to identify growth opportunities
* Prepare data for the analyses to be performed (Data Pre\-processing Tools – Alteryx/KNIME exp preferred)
* Understand the nuances of the product category and market to tailor the output according to business needs
* Run the analyses and create visualizations (Power BI and Tableau experience preferred); prepare drill down analyses to derive insights
* Create a storyline out of various analyses output for the business to comprehend the output
* Meet the service level agreements and perform QC of the end\-to\-end analysis
* Expand playbook analytic pack scope to include additional analyses upon alignment with market


**Qualifications**
* \+7 years of experience in Retail Analytics/Category Management/Revenue Management
* 2\-3 years of relevant professional experience working with large data sets and experience in CPG /Consulting / ICC Organizations
* Experience in any of the RGM lever practices\- Pricing, Promo, Assortment, Trade Investment
* Strong analytics skills with expertise in data analytics and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI
* Strong Advanced Analytics acumen, Agile ways of working, managing high end data science
* Prior experience in data analytics to derive data driven insights and consolidate them to generate recommendations
* Experience in developing data\-driven models for sales and marketing function
* Ability to handle multiple work streams simultaneously and to tight deadlines in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with stakeholders in North America, LATAM, APAC, or EMEA markets (preferred)
* Very strong analytical skills – excellent competency in MS Excel is a must, as is experience of managing complex, incomplete \& inconsistent datasets and defining strategic analytics (market sizing/growth forecasts etc).
* Experience in Tableau / Power Bi is preferred
* Proven experience using PowerPoint and ability to producing visually compelling presentations (i.e. beyond just operating the software) that are impactful with a senior audience
* Clarity in communication (English language) to enable production of a very high standard of commentary that is impactful and credible amongst our most senior audiences.
* Bachelor’s in commerce/business administration/Engg., Master’s degree is a plus
* Best\-in\-class time management skills, ability to multitask, set priorities and plan

 10\+ years

title: Regional Launch Director SIR
description:
**Job Description Summary**
* Job Description


 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the
   

  

 launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional
   

  

 collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional
   

  

 launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing
   

  

 mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the
   

  

 short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close
   

  

 collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and
   

  

 support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Purpose:**
 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Proactively lead the development and implementation of strategic regional launch readiness.
* Monitor the launch performance, competitive environment to quickly identify plan changes.
* Manage ROI assessments of tactical programs \& through collaboration with Commercial Leadership, develop and execute action plans to address competitive threats and/ or exogenous market events, maximizing pipeline value.
* Engage with other functional teams to ensure operational launch readiness of Region SIR launches and ensure E2E coordination to maximize commercial opportunities.
* Collaborate with Platforms on critical issues related to market commercialization, aligning as appropriate to their global product launch strategy.
* Together with Supply Chain and Platforms, drive decisions for regional product allocations if needed, at\-risk manufacturing and API purchases to optimize upsides and mitigate risk.
* Provide leadership to the market team and extended functional launch team members including coaching, advising, and developing team members
* Ensure compliance with Sandoz policies and procedures and full integration into the Sandoz culture and support resources
* Perform other duties as required by the Region from time to time.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* A minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in the GLP\-1 or Biosimilar field
* Sales/commercial leadership and mindset
* Sound Project Management experience (min 5 years)
* Hands\-on approach combined with business acumen, strategic thinking, and pragmatism
* Experience in managing/leading cross\-functional matrix teams
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills
* Stakeholder engagement with respect for different cultures and diverse groups.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human rightof access to good healthcare.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

**Skills Desired**
 Agility, Brand Awareness, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Data Strategy, Digital Marketing, Go\-To\-Market Strategy, Influencing Skills, Inspirational Leadership, Marketing Strategy, Media Campaigns, People Management, Product Marketing, Product Roadmap, Return on Investment (ROI), Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Marketing

 A person in this role within 2 years will build a deep understanding of how the business functions and successfully scale any business in the future.

 is looking for a data\-obsessed, results\-driven
 
**Marketplace Growth Manager**

**US marketplaces**

**Walmart (WFS)**

 This role requires a unique individual who can sit in Mumbai but think like a US consumer. You will be responsible for the entire marketplace lifecycle—from strategic inventory planning and cross\-border logistics to high\-performance PPC advertising and AI\-driven listing optimization. You will act as the "CEO" of our US marketplace channels, ensuring Sawai’s heritage\-rich fragrances become a household name in the North American market.
 




**Key Responsibilities**

 Own the end\-to\-end P\&L for US marketplaces, including top\-line revenue, contribution margins, and platform\-specific fees.
* **GTM Execution:** 

 Develop and execute the Go\-To\-Market strategy for new product launches in the US, ensuring optimal pricing, positioning, and initial review velocity.

 Build monthly and quarterly growth plans that balance aggressive customer acquisition with sustainable profitability.



**2\. Amazon \& Walmart Channel Mastery** 



* **Listing Excellence:** 

 Own the creation and optimization of SEO\-rich product listings, including titles, bullet points, and backend keywords tailored specifically to US search intent.

 Work with the content team to ensure Amazon A\+ content and Brand Stores reflect a premium, luxury fragrance aesthetic.
* **Account Health:** 

 Monitor and maintain "Gold Standard" account health metrics, managing IPI scores, buyer\-seller messaging, and compliance with platform policies.



**3\. High\-Performance Advertising (PPC)** 



* **Campaign Management:** 

 Direct and optimize Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display ads to maintain a target ACOS/TACOS.
* **Competitor Conquesting:** 

 Implement aggressive keyword\-bidding strategies to capture market share from competitors in the premium fragrance and essential oil categories.
* **DSP \& External Traffic:** 

 Explore and manage Amazon DSP or external traffic drivers (Social to Amazon) to boost ranking and BSR.



**4\. Cross\-Border Logistics \& Inventory Planning** 



* **Demand Forecasting:** 

 Coordinate with the Mumbai and Silvassa teams to forecast US demand, ensuring stock is manufactured and shipped in time to avoid stockouts.
* **FBA/WFS Management:** 

 Manage shipments from India to US 3PLs or Amazon/Walmart fulfilment centers.
* **Efficiency:** 

 Optimize "Inventory Age" and minimize storage fees through strategic liquidation or promotional pulses.



**5\. AI\-Driven Operations** 



* **Automation:** 

 Implement AI tools for automated keyword research, sentiment analysis of customer reviews, and competitive price monitoring.
* **Content Scaling:** 

 Use LLMs to rapidly iterate on ad copy, A/B test listing titles, and automate routine reporting tasks.
* **Sentiment Analysis:** 

 Leverage AI to decode "Voice of Customer" data from reviews to inform the R\&D team in India for future product iterations.



**Technical Proficiencies \& Tools** 



* **Marketplace Core:** 

 Amazon Seller Central and Ads (Expert), Walmart Seller Center, eBay.
* **Analytics \& Research:** 

 Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Viral Launch.
* **Advertising Tech:** 

 Amazon Advertising Console, Pacvue, or Perpetua.
* **AI Stack:** 

 ChatGPT/Claude (for SEO \& Copy), Midjourney (for creative ideation), and Excel/Google Sheets (Advanced formulas \& Pivot Tables).
* **Operations:** 

 Experience with ERPs and cross\-border shipping documentation (ShipStation, etc.).



**Core Strengths** 



* **The "Global\-Local" Mindset:** 

 Ability to translate Indian manufacturing excellence into a brand voice that resonates with US luxury buyers.
* **Analytical Rigor:** 

 You don’t make guesses; you make data\-backed decisions based on click\-through rates, conversion rates, and session data.
* **Agility:** 

 The US marketplace landscape changes weekly (algorithm updates, fee changes); you must be able to pivot strategy instantly.



**The Ideal Fit** 



* You have a proven track record of managing a $1M\+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) portfolio on Amazon US.
* You are comfortable working hours that overlap with the US East Coast/West Coast to coordinate with partners and monitor live sales events (e.g., Prime Day).
* You have a passion for the fragrance/beauty industry and understand the nuances of selling "scent" through a digital screen.



**How to Apply** 





 If you are ready to take a heritage Indian brand to the global stage, send your resume and a summary of your biggest marketplace "win" to
 
**hr@incredibleindriya.com** 

 .
 




**Eze Perfumes** 

 is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate the intersection of Indian craftsmanship and global digital commerce.

title: Independent Director
description:
More choice can disguise duplication, poor differentiation and trapped working capital. The Director will challenge the architecture of categories, opening price points, premium ladders, private labels and seasonal ranges. Management should demonstrate which customer missions each range serves, how products earn space online and in stores, and when a slow\-moving item will be marked down, returned, repurposed or exited.
 



  





 Board reporting must connect assortment breadth with availability, margin, inventory age, fulfilment complexity and customer satisfaction. Revenue growth that depends on proliferating low\-productivity stock\-keeping units should be recognised early.
 



  





 Items used for cooking, storage and household organisation can create safety, durability and disclosure obligations. The Director will examine supplier qualification, material declarations, product testing, labelling, complaint investigation, batch traceability and recall readiness. Private\-label ambition must be matched by clear ownership of specification and quality—not delegated informally to the supplier.
 



  





 When an adverse signal appears, the Board needs a decision process that protects customers before legal certainty is complete. The appointee will ask whether marketplace sellers, imported ranges and exclusive products are governed to comparable standards.
 



  





 The Director will help the Board look beyond gross billing to realised margin after discount, funding, payment cost, fulfilment, returns, damage, loyalty benefits and clearance. Supplier rebates and promotional support should be recognised only when the underlying conditions are evidenced. Channel teams must not shift inventory or cost between stores, digital operations and marketplaces to make one route appear successful.
 



  





 The Board will expect the appointee to probe price integrity, personalised offers, dark patterns, misleading scarcity messages and the fairness of refund or exchange practices.
 



  





 An omnichannel promise depends on accurate location\-level stock, dependable reservation and a rational fulfilment decision. The Director will oversee management’s response to phantom inventory, cancelled orders, split shipments, store\-pick failures, shrinkage and reverse\-logistics leakage. Investment proposals for automation, distribution capacity or new stores should be tested against demand density and the full cost to serve.
 



  





 The appointee will insist on decision\-ready store economics: mature versus ramp\-up performance, occupancy burden, local catchment, cannibalisation, labour productivity, omnichannel contribution and exit costs. Lease commitments need downside cases and explicit approval limits. A flagship’s strategic value may be real, but it must be articulated and reviewed rather than used indefinitely to excuse poor economics.
 



  





 Loyalty and personalisation can improve relevance, but they also create privacy, consent and security duties. The Director will question what data is collected, why it is retained, how models shape offers, and whether customers can exercise meaningful choice. Technology partners, payment providers, delivery networks and marketplace channels should be subject to risk\-based oversight and incident responsibilities that are understood before failure.
 



  





**The Board contribution beyond oversight** 




  





 The new Director will participate in annual strategy, capital\-allocation and leadership reviews. They should help management balance store expansion, digital capability, supply\-chain resilience, private\-label development and brand investment. The Board wants independent thinking on customer proposition and disciplined experimentation: pilots need hypotheses, decision dates and stopping rules.
 



  





 The appointee may serve on audit, risk, stakeholder or nomination and remuneration committees. They will support succession planning for merchandising, operations, technology and supply\-chain leadership; review incentives for unintended behaviours; and seek direct assurance where management information does not reconcile with customer or employee experience.
 



  





**The person sought** 




  





 The mandate suits a former chief executive, chief operating officer, commercial leader, supply\-chain leader, finance leader or digital\-retail executive who has governed a multi\-category consumer business.
 



  





 Experience with sourcing, private labels, inventory, store economics, e\-commerce or consumer protection is strongly relevant. The candidate must be comfortable moving from a customer complaint to its systemic operational and financial implications.
 



  





 Independence, curiosity and willingness to visit operations are essential. Applicants must hold active IICA Independent Directors Databank registration and disclose current interests involving suppliers, marketplaces, landlords, logistics providers, payment companies or competing retailers.

****Job Requirements****




 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Business Administration; MBA or advanced degree will be an advantage.
   

  





 Minimum 8\+ years of experience across sales, application engineering, strategy or product management, with sales experience being mandatory.
   

  





 At least 5\+ years of experience in an industrial grease\-selling multinational organization in ISEAM.
   

  





 Strong understanding of Industrial Grease portfolios, applications, technical product aspects and customer requirements.
   

  





 Strong understanding of the ISEAMn Industrial Grease market, including competitive dynamics, customer segments and channel landscape.
   

  





 Proven track record in sales, business development, product strategy or portfolio management.
   

  





 Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to build business cases and make commercially sound decisions.
   

  





 Strong analytical skills, with the ability to collect, interpret and visualize complex data to support strategy and decision\-making.
   

  





 Strategic thinker with an outside\-in mindset and the ability to translate market insights into practical growth actions.
   

  





 Strong collaboration, facilitation, influencing and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a matrix and cross\-functional environment.
   

  





 Proactive, open\-minded team player with the ability to drive change, inspire others and influence stakeholders at different levels.
   

  





 Interested, please share your updated profile – prachi.chourasia@skf.com

title: Senior Manager, Product Management
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management to join our team within our Clinicals division. In this role you will be responsible for one or more product areas within the overarching product’s portfolio; understanding the market and customers, contributing to the product vision, developing business cases and ensuring a set of product features meet business requirements. You will help define how AI is responsibly integrated into clinical workflows, ensuring solutions are safe, trustworthy, and deliver measurable value to healthcare providers and patients.
   

  

 You will work closely with scrum teams defining and writing user stories, prioritizing product backlogs, and making trade\-off decisions between scope and schedule. Your work will span both strengthening our current solutions and delivering innovative, AI\-driven features that improve user experience and clinical decision\-making. Success in this role will be measured by improvements in provider efficiency, mobile adoption, workflow completion, user satisfaction, product quality, and safe adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Mobile team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to improve the efficiency and experience of healthcare providers. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI\-enabled solutions where they add value. The team collaborates closely to ensure products are usable, reliable, and aligned with clinical and business needs. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Drive product vision incorporating AI/ML capabilities, predictive insights, and automation opportunities
* Lead early\-stage discovery for features including: Identifying high\-value use cases for AI, Validating concepts with users and stakeholders, and Defining data requirements and feasibility
* Partner with UX, Analytics and Data Science teams to define measurement strategies for AI feature performance (e.g., validity, bias, data quality, adoption, impact)
* Translate product strategy into outcome\-based roadmaps that connect customer problems, business goals, delivery priorities, and measurable success criteria.
* Define product success metrics for each major initiative, including adoption, engagement, workflow efficiency, customer satisfaction, safety, and business impact.
* Own go\-to\-market strategies for products, including its AI\-enabled features
* Monitor post\-release performance and use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to guide iteration and prioritization.
* Work directly with scrum teams to prioritize work and ensure delivery of both core and AI\-enabled product capabilities
* Own ongoing maintenance of core products, including triaging production issues and managing enhancements
* Collaborate with data science and engineering teams to translate AI models into scalable product features
* Understand the market opportunity via user needs, market forces, applicable business models, emerging AI trends and competitive AI capabilities
* Drive the analysis of Product Area(s) of ownership including AI/ML\-driven products
* Define epics and user stories that clearly articulate: Functional requirements, User experience considerations, Data and model requirements, AI behavior expectations (e.g., explainability, confidence levels)
* Partner with UX and Engineering to design mobile experiences that are intuitive, accessible, performant, and reliable in fast\-moving clinical environments.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to manage the full AI/ML lifecycle, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree required: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or related field preferred
* 6\+ years of product management experience
* Understanding of US healthcare / health IT environment is strongly preferred
* Experience working in an Agile environment is strongly preferred
* Experience building or scaling mobile products, preferably iOS and Android applications in SaaS, healthcare, or enterprise environments.
* Understanding of mobile UX patterns, performance considerations, accessibility, release management, and app adoption strategies.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and productization of AI features
* Familiarity with: Model lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring), Data pipelines and data quality considerations, Experimentation frameworks
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model bias, and explainability
* Experience working on AI\-driven or data\-intensive products preferred
* Experience bringing products to market is needed
* Technical understanding (mobile, SaaS, data, APIs) – ability to check technical feasibility and timelines and remove technical development barriers
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear business value


**Additional Information**
* Some travel to the US may be required for customer site visits, internal collaborations, and industry events (5%)

description:

 Full\-Time

 Delhi

 6–10 Years
 


 About Steelbuild Infra Projects Limited
 
 Steelbuild Infra Projects Limited is a growing Pre\-Engineered Building (PEB) and structural steel solutions company delivering warehouses, factories, industrial buildings, manufacturing facilities and infrastructure projects across India.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Brand Manager – Industrial \& Marketing** 
 to strengthen our corporate brand, enhance market visibility and lead integrated marketing initiatives across digital, content, industrial marketing, events and sales enablement.
 


 Key Responsibilities / KRAs1\. Brand Strategy \& Positioning
 * Develop and execute the overall brand and marketing strategy for Steelbuild.

* Build consistent messaging around engineering expertise, manufacturing capabilities, quality, reliability and project execution.
* Maintain consistency in brand identity, communication and tone across all channels.
* Conduct competitor and market analysis to identify positioning opportunities.

 2\. Industrial \& B2B Marketing
 * Develop targeted B2B marketing strategies for industrial customers and decision\-makers.
* Plan sector\-specific campaigns for manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, automotive, FMCG, pharmaceuticals, food processing and related industries.
* Understand industrial customer journeys and develop relevant communication for different buying stages.

 3\. Corporate Communication \& Content

* Convert technical and engineering information into clear, compelling business communication.

 4\. Digital Marketing \& Website
 * Lead digital marketing across website, search engines, social media and paid campaigns.

* Plan and monitor Google Ads and other relevant digital campaigns.

 5\. Social Media \& Content Marketing

* Plan corporate, festival, awareness and milestone campaigns while maintaining professional brand standards.
* Build engagement with customers, consultants, architects, industry professionals and decision\-makers.

 6\. Lead Generation \& Sales Enablement
 * Collaborate with Sales and Business Development teams to generate qualified enquiries.

* Support account\-based marketing initiatives for high\-value prospects.

 7\. Project \& Site Branding
 * Develop standardized branding guidelines for projects and manufacturing facilities.

* Ensure consistent Steelbuild branding across offices, plants and project locations.
* Coordinate documentation, photography and videography of completed and ongoing projects.

 8\. Events \& Exhibitions
 * Plan participation in relevant industrial exhibitions, conferences and trade shows.
* Manage stall concepts, branding, collateral, presentations and promotional materials.
* Coordinate pre\-event and post\-event marketing campaigns.
* Support Sales teams in capturing and following up event\-generated enquiries.
* Identify relevant sponsorship and industry networking opportunities.
* Evaluate event performance based on visibility, engagement and lead generation.


 9\. PR \& Corporate Reputation
 * Support PR and corporate reputation initiatives.
* Develop press releases and corporate announcements for projects, milestones and company developments.
* Identify opportunities for leadership and technical teams to contribute to industry publications and forums.
* Maintain consistent external communication and professional brand representation.
* Monitor industry and competitor communication for emerging opportunities.


 10\. Marketing Analytics \& Performance
 * Establish measurable KPIs for branding and marketing activities.
* Track website traffic, SEO performance, social engagement, campaign leads and qualified enquiries.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly marketing performance reports.
* Analyze campaign effectiveness, conversions and marketing ROI.
* Identify high\-performing channels and optimize campaigns based on data.

 11\. Budget \& Vendor Management
 * Prepare and manage marketing budgets.

* Negotiate vendor commercials while maintaining quality standards.
* Monitor campaign timelines, deliverables and expenditure.
* Ensure activities are completed within approved budgets and timelines.


 12\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 * Collaborate with Sales, Engineering, Design, Manufacturing, Projects, Quality, HR and senior management.
* Gather accurate technical and project information for marketing communication.
* Support Sales with effective customer\-facing materials.
* Coordinate with HR on employer branding and corporate communication when required.
* Maintain effective coordination between internal teams and external partners.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Growth in qualified marketing\-generated enquiries.
* Improvement in brand visibility within target industrial sectors.
* Website traffic, SEO visibility and conversion performance.
* Digital campaign effectiveness and cost efficiency.
* Social media reach, engagement and audience quality.
* Quality and frequency of project case studies and marketing assets.
* Effectiveness of sales\-enablement campaigns and collateral.
* Event and exhibition lead generation.
* Brand consistency across digital and offline channels.
* Marketing campaign execution and budget utilization.

 Preferred Skills
 * Brand Management \& Brand Strategy
* Industrial \& B2B Marketing
* Corporate Branding \& Communication
* Digital Marketing
* Content Strategy \& Corporate Storytelling
* SEO \& Google Ads
* LinkedIn \& Social Media Marketing
* Lead Generation
* Website Marketing \& Optimization
* Marketing Analytics

* Sales Enablement

 in brand management, industrial marketing, B2B marketing or corporate marketing.
