**Job Description:**
**Job Description**
 The Talent Business Advisor \- Manager is the accessible, on\-the\-ground HR partner for employees and leaders within assigned India Business Units (BU). This is an integral role in managing the execution of people\-related initiatives and programs that enhance the employee experience for India talent. Reporting to the U.S. Talent Business Advisor team and working with the India Talent Director and local leadership, this role supports the operational and logistical needs of key talent processes and employee matters helping ensure a consistent, efficient, and people\-centered approach to talent delivery.
   

  

 This role collaborates with a range of stakeholders across the Talent Solutions team and business units to execute core HR functions such as onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, and workforce logistics. This position offers a unique opportunity to broaden and deepen experience in talent operations while learning how HR strategy is implemented in a professional services environment.
   

  

**Required Responsibilities**
* Serve as the first point of contact for employees and leadership on talent, HR policy and procedures.
* Build trusted relationships with BU leaders and provide practical counsel on business unit needs, employee matters and emerging talent risks. Work closely with India Talent Director and peers.
* Partner globally with U.S. Talent Business Leader and U.S. Advisors to manage the implementation of core talent processes across the employee lifecycle (e.g., onboarding, offboarding, performance management, absences, rewards processes, and employee engagement initiatives).
* Provide accurate local and Firm context, recommendations and regular status updates and visibility to the US Talent Business Leader; seek direction or approval for BU\-specific or sensitive matters.
* Translate agreed guidance into clear stakeholder actions, establish owners and timelines, and follow each matter through resolution and formal closure.
* Create insightful reporting and analytics, with recommendations that inform leadership talent decisions.
* Identify recurring employee themes or policy misunderstandings and support targeted communications and consistent practices across India BUs.


**Capabilities**
* Demonstrated HR advisory, HR business partnering or generalist experience supporting both employees and business leaders in India.
* Experience handling employee concerns and workplace matters, including fact gathering, risk assessment, documentation, escalation and follow\-through.
* Practical knowledge of India\-specific HR policies, employment practices, governance and local requirements, with sound judgment on when specialist or legal guidance is needed.
* Experience operating across the employee lifecycle and coordinating with specialist teams such as Employee Relations, HR operations, etc.
* Strong stakeholder management in a matrixed environment, including the ability to work effectively with local leaders and remotely based business or talent leaders.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain policy, provide concise and proactive updates, surface risk and communicate sensitive decisions appropriately.
* High levels of discretion, empathy, organization and accountability, with a consistent record of driving actions to closure.
* Strong Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, HR technology platforms such as Workday, reporting tools, and approved AI\-enabled resources.


**Professional Expectations**
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, professionalism, and independent execution and management of assigned responsibilities.
* Exercise sound judgment in prioritizing work, identifying risk, recognizing matters requiring escalation, and protecting confidential information.
* Produce accurate, organized, and high\-quality work products with strong attention to detail and data integrity.
* Anticipate needs, proactively address operational challenges, and approach change with a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Build strong working relationships through responsive communication, follow\-through, and service excellence.


**Education And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field preferred.
* 7\-10 years of human resources, talent management, employee experience, people operations, business operations, or related professional experience preferred.
* Experience in a multinational, shared\-services or globally matrixed organization.
* Experience partnering with US\-based or other international HR and business stakeholders across time zones.
* Exposure to talent reviews, succession, career development, recognition, engagement and retention programs.
* Experience supporting organizational movement, promotions, role changes, mobility and employee exits.
* Experience identifying workforce themes and turning recurring issues into targeted manager or employee communications.

title: GB/G Head of HR Services
description:
We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future.
   

  

 We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress.
   

  

 Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background. At BASF, careers develop from opportunities.
   

  

 Head of HR Services India will lead all HR Services activities for the Service Delivery Unit (SDU) in India, strategic and operational HR services owning delivery of transactional, strategic and platform\-based HR services (HR operations, HRIS, payroll interfaces, service management, case resolution, and vendor management). This role combines strategic leadership, operational HR management, process optimization, and people leadership to enable data\-driven decisions and alignment with global HR standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Service delivery leadership
+ Own end\-to\-end HR Services delivery for the SDU
+ Ensure consistent, high\-quality service through defined SLAs, KPIs, and service\-level reporting.

* Operations \& process excellence
+ Design, implement, and optimize standardized, scalable HR processes and operating procedures aligned with global HR policies.
+ Drive continuous improvement initiatives (automation, RPA, workflow redesign) to increase efficiency, reduce error rates, and shorten turnaround times.
+ Manage capacity planning, workload balancing, and operational resilience for peak cycles (e.g., payroll, year\-end processes).

* HRIS \& technology stewardship
+ Champion adoption of HR technology, self\-service portals, and automation to improve employee and manager experience.
+ Oversee reporting and analytics for service performance, data quality, and business insights.

* Vendor \& partner management

* Change \& transition management

+ Support global HR transformation programs by providing delivery expertise, implementation planning, and stakeholder coordination.

description:
**Here’s a Summary Of The Role**
 Our People team is growing, and we're looking for an HR Business Partner to serve as a key link between HR, the business, and cross\-functional teams. In this role, you'll lead critical people and performance initiatives that reflect and reinforce our strong company culture and values. As a trusted advisor, you'll support regional business units by designing and implementing commercially focused HR solutions. You'll collaborate closely with fellow HRBPs and Centres of Excellence to deliver strategic projects, while continuing to provide comprehensive generalist HR support to the business.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Business Partnership
* Partner with senior business leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned to business objectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor on organizational design, workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, and leadership effectiveness.
* Use data and insights to diagnose organizational challenges and recommend strategic solutions.
* Coach and influence leaders to build high\-performing, engaged, and inclusive teams.
* Talent \& Organizational Development
* Lead talent reviews, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
* Partner with leaders to identify critical capabilities and establish talent development plans.
* Drive performance management processes and build a culture of accountability and continuous feedback.
* Support organizational effectiveness initiatives, including team structure design and change management.
* Employee Relations \& Risk Management
* Provide expert guidance on complex employee relations matters.
* Navigate disciplinary cases, grievances, performance concerns, and organizational restructuring with sound judgment and risk awareness.
* Ensure compliance with local employment laws and regulations across APAC markets.
* Partner with Legal and other stakeholders on sensitive investigations and workforce matters.
* Change \& Transformation
* Lead people\-related aspects of organizational change initiatives.
* Support reorganizations, business expansions, and workforce transformation projects.
* Develop change management strategies that maximize employee adoption and business outcomes.
* Regional HR Leadership
* Build strong partnerships with Centers of Excellence, Talent Acquisition, Rewards, Learning \& Development, and People Operations teams.
* Influence and support regional people initiatives across APAC.
* Ensure alignment between global people practices and local market requirements.


 These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview:
   

  

* Strong knowledge of regional employment legislation and experience managing employee relations, including unions or works councils
* Proven HR business partnering experience with the ability to balance strategic insight and day\-to\-day HR operations
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to influence, persuade, and build strong partnerships
* Demonstrated ability to lead through change, manage ambiguity, and handle multiple priorities under pressure
* Innovative mindset with a willingness to challenge norms and drive continuous improvement
* Experience working in a matrixed environment and collaborating across teams, while also operating independently
* Solid understanding of all HR functions with deep expertise in at least one area (e.g., talent, performance, or org development)


 It would be great if you had these to, but we’ll support you if you don’t:
   

  

* HR qualifications (e.g., CIPD, SHRM\-CP/SCP, PHR/SPHR)
* Minimum 8\+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience in multinational organizations.
* Minimum 3\+ years supporting multiple APAC markets in a regional HRBP capacity.
* Demonstrated experience supporting leaders and employees in Singapore and Australia.
* Experience partnering with Senior leadership populations.

title: Human Resources Consultant
description:
We're looking for an HR / OD Consultant. But not the "write a policy manual" kind.
 



 This is a 4\-month project assignment. It is not a permanent position.
 



  





 At SHANBHAGS, we are in the middle of an important internal transformation.
 



 The vision is clear. The intent is clear. Now comes the harder part: making it real.
 



 Because organisations do not change because a presentation says they should. They change when intent translates into clear behaviours, operating disciplines, systems and SOPs that people can actually follow — and managers can actually manage.
 



  





 We are looking for a senior HR / Organisation Development Consultant who has done this before — at scale. Someone who can understand the organisation, work closely with leadership and employees, and help build the frameworks and SOPs that make the transformation live every day.
 



 Not just define what should happen. Design it. Implement it. Make it stick.
 



  





 You should bring:
 


* 10–15\+ years of serious HR / OD experience
* Proven experience designing AND successfully implementing organisation\-wide SOPs, operating frameworks and people/culture systems
* Experience working with large and complex organisations
* Ability to translate organisational intent into specific, practical, measurable and repeatable behaviours and processes
* Strong experience across performance management, capability building, accountability, leadership, cross\-functional working, employee development and culture implementation
* The ability to work with leadership while understanding what actually happens on the ground
* A healthy intolerance for beautifully written documents that collapse the minute real life begins



 One thing matters enormously: You must have implemented what you designed.
 



  





 This is not recruitment. Not an HR audit. Not policy polishing. And certainly not another employee handbook nobody reads. It is about helping us build the operating DNA for the next phase of Shanbhag Engineering Company.
 



  





 We also welcome former CHROs, HR Heads and senior OD leaders who may have stepped away from full\-time corporate life but still enjoy solving difficult organisational problems. Perhaps you no longer want the title or a 9\-to\-9 — but still miss rolling up your sleeves once in a while. For someone like that, this could be a very satisfying four months — a chance to solve a real organisational problem and build something that lasts well beyond the assignment.
 



  





 Interested? Write directly to hr@shanbhags.com with:
 


* A brief profile and relevant work experience
* One organisation\-wide system / transformation you designed and successfully implemented
* Your expected professional fee for the 4\-month assignment



  





 Learn more about us at https://shanbhags.com

description:
**Company Description** 
 Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters, Bakehouse and Fine Cacao is a purpose\-driven brand spotlighting specialty coffee, elevated baking, and fine cacao from the Indian Subcontinent. The company combines traditional “daily bread” culture with innovative, risk\-taking flavor profiles, crafting distinctive coffees, breads, viennoiserie, and cacao products. Subko’s mission is to build a genuinely Asian specialty coffee and cacao movement and represent the region on a global platform. Through a “Cherry to Cup,” “Crop to Craft,” and “Pod to Bar” ethos, Subko focuses on meticulous sourcing, processing, and production to set new quality standards. The team is driven by craft, curiosity, and a commitment to reshaping how people experience coffee, bakehouse offerings, and cacao.

 The Learning and Development Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for designing and leading learning initiatives across Subko’s coffee, bakehouse, and cacao operations. This role oversees the end\-to\-end learning lifecycle, including needs analysis, program design, delivery, and evaluation for both frontline and corporate team members. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include creating training curricula, facilitating workshops and on\-the\-job training, managing learning content and systems, and partnering with managers to build role\-specific capabilities. The Learning and Development Manager will collaborate closely with leadership to develop talent pipelines, support performance and leadership development, and ensure training aligns with Subko’s craft\-focused culture and growth plans. The role also involves monitoring training effectiveness, maintaining learning documentation, and continuously improving learning strategies based on feedback and operational metrics.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong skills in Training \& Development and Learning Management to design, implement, and track comprehensive learning programs.
* Candidates should possess skills in Training and Instructional Design to create engaging, role\-relevant content and deliver effective in\-person sessions.
* Candidates should possess skills in Leadership Development to support manager capability\-building, succession planning, and talent growth.
* Experience with hospitality, food \& beverage, specialty coffee, or retail environments is beneficial.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities, with a collaborative, hands\-on working style.
* Proven experience in a Learning and Development or similar HR role, preferably 4–7 years, with responsibility for end\-to\-end training programs.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Business, Psychology, or a related field; relevant certifications in L\&D or instructional design are an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site in a fast\-paced, craft\-driven environment and aligning learning initiatives with business goals and brand values.

title: HRIS Analyst - Oracle Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 The HRIS Analyst \- Oracle Specialist will serve as a functional subject matter expert (SME) for the Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) / Oracle Fusion HCM platform, with primary responsibility for the configuration, optimization, support, and expansion of HR technology capabilities across a multinational operating environment. This role will lead the design, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Oracle HRMS solutions and act as a key partner to HR, IT, Payroll, and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands\-on Oracle HRMS expertise and a strong track record supporting global HR processes across Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, Oracle Time and Labor (OTL), and related modules.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM and provide day\-to\-day support, configuration, enhancement, and optimization across key HR modules.
* Lead system design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and production support activities for Oracle HRMS in a multinational environment.
* Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into scalable Oracle HRMS solutions, and recommend best\-practice system designs.
* Support and optimize Oracle HRMS modules, including Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, and Oracle Time and Labor (OTL).
* Research, configure, and document solutions that address global business requirements, local country requirements, and process standardization opportunities.
* Coordinate and support system upgrades, patches, releases, and enhancements, including impact assessments, test strategy, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
* Maintain system configuration, tables, security roles, workflow setup, and related controls to ensure system reliability, usability, and compliance.
* Develop, validate, and support reports, dashboards, and analytics that enable HR decision\-making and improve operational visibility.
* Ensure data integrity through audits, controls, interface monitoring, issue resolution, and process improvements.
* Train and support end users, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders on reporting, system functionality, and process changes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, improve user experience, and strengthen HR operational effectiveness through Oracle HRMS.


**What You Will Need**
 Education and Experience
   

  

* BA/BS in MIS, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* Strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM required.
* Significant progressive HRIS experience, including hands\-on experience supporting Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM.
* Demonstrated experience with Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, enhancements, implementations, testing, and production support required.
* Experience supporting global or multinational HR operations and country\-specific process requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting HR and/or Payroll systems, self\-service platforms, and related integrations preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Deep functional expertise in Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, workflows, security, testing, troubleshooting, system maintenance, upgrades, and release support.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle HRMS business processes across Core HR, recruiting, compensation, benefits, talent, time and labor, and payroll\-related workflows.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Oracle HRMS solutions with strong attention to process design and user impact.
* Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, and large\-scale enhancements in a complex business environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data validation skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve system and process issues effectively.
* Advanced reporting skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and complex Microsoft Excel functions; Power BI experience is a plus.
* Strong customer\-facing, consulting, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across HR, IT, Payroll, and business teams.
* Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, and control requirements related to HR data.
* Experience in a high\-volume, transactional environment preferred.
* Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM reporting, dashboarding, and analytics experience preferred.
* Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality \& Environmental Management System.


**Reporting Relationships**
 The incumbent reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position. This position does not have any direct reports.
   

  

**About Us**
 We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
   

  

 ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting\-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever\-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

 ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non\-work\-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation & Integration-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration\-1
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration supports strategic payroll initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), P\&C Modernization programs, system implementations, and process improvement efforts. This role serves as a key execution resource responsible for coordinating testing activities, validating payroll and employee data, supporting implementation readiness, and assisting with solution deployments across payroll operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 M\&A Integration Support
   

  

* Support payroll workstreams during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and organizational restructures.
* Assist with payroll integration planning and execution activities.
* Coordinate employee data collection, validation, and migration activities.
* Prepare implementation documentation and integration trackers.
* Support payroll readiness assessments and integration milestones.
* Monitor project tasks, risks, issues, and action items.
* Assist in stabilization activities following acquisitions.


 P\&C Modernization Implementation Support
   

  

* Participate in payroll\-related activities supporting Workday and P\&C Modernization initiatives.
* Support configuration validation and business process testing.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to evaluate payroll impacts of system changes.
* Coordinate payroll requirements gathering and documentation.
* Support process redesign and standardization initiatives.


 Testing \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Execute end\-to\-end payroll testing activities for system implementations and enhancements.
* Develop and assist with unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll testing, regression testing
* Validate payroll calculations and outputs.
* Reconcile testing results and identify variances.
* Document, track, and help resolve defects.
* Verify successful implementation of payroll requirements.


 Process Improvement \& Documentation
   

  

* Create and maintain standard test scripts, process documentation, standard operating procedures
* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and implementation methodologies.
* Contribute to payroll implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Support operational readiness reviews.


 Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Collaborate with Payroll Operations, P\&C teams, Benefits, Technology teams, Third\-party payroll providers
* Participate in project meetings and provide implementation status updates.
* Escalate risks, issues, and testing concerns as necessary.
* Support communication and change management activities.


 Post\-Go\-Live Stabilization
   

  

* Assist with issue resolution following implementations.
* Monitor payroll processing and implementation outcomes.
* Validate corrective actions and system fixes.
* Transition completed solutions to operational payroll teams.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of payroll, payroll implementation, or payroll operations experience.
* Experience supporting payroll system implementations or upgrades.
* Understanding of payroll processes, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with testing methodologies and issue management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Experience supporting M\&A integrations.
* Experience with Workday, ADP, or other payroll platforms.
* Experience participating in large\-scale HR or payroll transformation programs.
* Knowledge of payroll compliance, tax, benefits, and time management processes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: HRIS Analyst
description:
The HRIS Support Specialist provides operational support for the organization’s global HR systems, primarily Workday, UKG and Workforce. This temporary role is responsible for Tier 1 ticket handling (Ivanti and Workday “Request” tickets), reporting, audits, Workday security troubleshooting, global support activities, and extensive process documentation. This position requires proven experience supporting multiple countries and a high level of Workday Security knowledge. Strong communication skills, global customer service experience, and a high degree of accuracy are essential.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities HRIS Support \& Ticket Management**
* Serve as the first point of contact for: o Ivanti HRIS tickets o Workday “Request” tickets
* Provide Tier 1 support for Workday and Workforce (navigation, data entry, troubleshooting).
* Triage and escalate complex issues based on established HRIS processes.
* Support end\-users across multiple regions and time zones within a global HR operating model.


**Ticket Analysis \& Knowledge Management**
* Track weekly ticket volume, types, trends, and resolutions across all countries supported.
* Analyze ticket patterns to identify recurring issues, training needs, and knowledge gaps.
* Produce insights and recommendations to reduce repeat issues.
* Create high\-quality documentation, job aids, and solutions that can be added to an internal knowledge base library.
* Maintain and continuously improve the HRIS knowledge repository for global use.


**Workday Security Support**
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting on Workday security issues (access, roles, security groups).
* Validate access\-related requests and route complex issues appropriately.
* Document recurring security issues to support future process improvements. HR Data Quality \& Auditing
* Conduct recurring and ad\-hoc data audits across multiple countries.
* Identify and document data discrepancies and partner with HR to correct issues.
* Maintain logs and documentation of audit results and follow\-up actions.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Run, validate, and distribute scheduled Workday reports.
* Build and maintain simple to intermediate\-level reports in Workday Report Writer.
* Support ad\-hoc reporting needs from global HR and business partners.


**HR Transactions \& Data Uploads**
* Prepare templates and execute routine EIB data uploads in Workday.
* Validate upload results and maintain detailed tracking and documentation. Process Documentation (Focus Area)
* Create, update, and maintain SOPs, process maps, and workflow documentation across all HRIS processes.
* Document procedures for handling tickets, audits, reports, EIB uploads, and recurring tasks.
* Develop user\-friendly guides and reference materials for HR partners globally.
* Ensure documentation is always accurate, standardized, and up to date.


**Testing \& Release Support**
* Assist with Workday bi\-annual release testing (UAT), including test cases, tracking results, and retesting.
* Support communication and training efforts for global system enhancements.


**General Administrative Support**
* Maintain logs and trackers for tickets, audits, documentation updates, and recurring tasks.
* Provide timely and professional communication to HR and business partners worldwide.
* Perform additional HRIS operational duties as assigned. Knowledge,


**Experience \& Skills Required Qualifications**
* 2–3 years of Workday experience in HR operations, HRIS support, or shared services.
* Proven experience supporting multiple countries and global HR teams.
* Strong, demonstrated Workday Security knowledge (roles, access troubleshooting, security groups).
* Experience creating and maintaining intermediate and complex Workday reports.
* Strong English communication skills (written and spoken).
* Excellent attention to detail, especially in data and documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, global environment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Workforce Time \& Attendance systems.
* Experience using Ivanti or similar ticketing platforms.
* Experience performing Workday EIB uploads.
* Previous experience developing SOPs or knowledge base documentation.
* Experience in global HR or shared services environments.


 If you are a current CANPACK employee, please apply through your Workday account.
   

  

 CANPACK Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or not related to job requirements, unless such distinction is required by law.

title: Assistant Manager People and Culture
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring an Assistant Manager, People and Culture for our corporate office in New Delhi.
 



  





  





  





 We operate a portfolio of boutique and experiential hotels — wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, heritage properties — many of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros. The corporate office is small and senior; the People and Culture function is being built now, and this is its first operating role.
 



  





  





  





**The Role** 




  





  





  





 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.
 



  





 • Engagement execution and reporting — town halls, festivals, birthdays, milestones, offsites, internal communication; monthly people MIS (headcount, open positions, time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, attrition, leave liability, payroll cost).
 



  





  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





  





  





 • 3–6 years in HR operations, payroll and recruitment — hands\-on experience running a payroll cycle and screening candidates independently
 



  





 • MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent; a graduate with strong HR operations experience will also be considered; hotel management education is an advantage
 



  





 • Hospitality experience preferred; multi\-location or distributed\-workforce exposure is valued
 



  





 • Payroll command — confident with attendance inputs, deductions, settlements and statutory schedules
 



  





 • Strong Excel and systems skills; comfortable on an HRMS and with digital record\-keeping
 



  





 • Screening judgment — able to assess fit on a first call and write a screening note someone else can act on
 



  





 • Documentation discipline — methodical, complete, consistent; nothing filed late or half\-finished
 



  





 • Clear written and spoken English and Hindi
 



  





 • Absolute discretion with salary and personal data
 



  





  





  





**Measures of Success** 




  





  





  





 • Payroll processed and disbursed on the committed date every month, with nil correction entries
 



  





 • No duplicates, no unnamed records, no stale summaries — database verifiable at any time without notice
 



  





 • Applications screened and first rounds completed within agreed timelines; candidates never left waiting
 



  





 • Every employee file and statutory register complete and audit\-ready at all times
 



  





  





  





 Location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope covers the corporate office and all properties. Occasional travel for onboarding drives, audits and engagement events.
 



  





  





  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the role.
 



  





  





  





 Selection process: telephonic screening → in\-person interview at the New Delhi corporate office → reference checks → offer.
 



  





  





  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

title: Manager/Sr Manger
description:
We are looking for a dynamic
 **Manager/ Senior Manager \- Corporate Relations** 
 for
 **Pearl Academy** 
 to drive our student placement initiatives, strengthen industry, alumni partnerships, and career development programs. This role is crucial in bridging academia with industry, ensuring students have the necessary opportunities, skills, and networks for successful career outcomes.
 



**1\. Placements:** 



* Initiate and manage the campus recruitment and placement process, ensuring successful job placements for graduating students in Undergraduate, Post Graduate \& Professional courses.
* Collaborate with faculty to prepare students for interviews, including resume writing, mock interviews, profiling and skill assessments.
* Maintain a database of job opportunities, internships, and co\-branded programs from industry partners.
* Analyze placement trends, monitor student employment outcomes, support MIS with correct \& timely data and generate reports for senior leadership.
* Organize and host career fairs, Pre\-placement talks, networking events, and on\-campus recruitment drives.



**2\. Alumni Relations:** 



* Prioritize alumni network to provide recruitment to maximum graduating students.
* Develop and maintain a regular alumni engagement strategy to strengthen the institution’s network of successful graduates.
* Collaborate with alumni to create mentorship programs, guest lectures, and networking opportunities for current students.
* Organize alumni reunions, conferences, and recognition events to maintain active engagement.
* Track alumni career progressions and use their success stories to inspire current students and promote the institution’s reputation.



**3\. Industry Partnerships:** 



* Getting industry to the campuses.
* Identify and cultivate new partnerships with companies, industry leaders, and professional organizations to create job, internship, graduation projects and masterclasses/mentorship opportunities for students.
* Strengthen existing relationships with corporate partners, ensuring a pipeline of opportunities for students across various courses. Keeping the record of the same on daily basis.
* Develop collaborative \& financially beneficial projects with industry partners to create hands\-on learning opportunities for students under faculty led projects.
* Stay informed about industry trends, hiring needs, and workforce developments to ensure alignment of student skillsets with market demand.
* Assist in managing advisory board meetings \& members



**4\. Career Development Initiatives:** 



* Work closely with faculty and the career services team to organize workshops, seminars, and guest lectures focused on career readiness.
* Track \& ensure alignment with School For Life (SFL) to deliver training sessions for students on professional development \& industry\-specific skills.
* Collaborate with academic departments to align curriculum with industry needs, ensuring students are well\-prepared for their careers.



**5\. Project Management:** 



* Manage tasks provided in projects.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to design and implement new initiatives that enhance revenue generation \& institute promotion.
* Develop and track timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure successful completion of projects.
* Monitor and evaluate the impact of programs, providing data\-driven insights to inform continuous improvement.



**Additional Responsibilities** 




 ✔️
 **Facilitating Employment:** 



* Convince companies to recruit students through campus placements and internships.
* Ensure strong presence on professional networking platforms to enhance employer engagement.



 ✔️
 **Soft Skills \& Technical Proficiency:** 



* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation abilities.
* Strong analytical skills for placement data interpretation and reporting.
* Expertise in MS Office (Excel, Advanced Excel, Power BI, PPT).



 ✔️
 **Operational \& Strategic Coordination:** 



* Willingness to travel and manage stretched timelines.
* Handle student counseling, resolve queries, and maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of academic curricula.

title: Contract Logistics Human Resources Specialist
description:
**It's more than a job**
 As part of the Contract Logistics team at Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in designing, managing, and optimizing solutions that keep goods moving efficiently. Whether you’re leading a team, engineering processes, or driving projects, your work ensures that our customers’ products are stored, handled, and delivered with precision. From everyday essentials to seasonal items, what we do in Contract Logistics impacts businesses and communities around the world. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your contribution goes far beyond the warehouse—it helps shape the flow of global trade.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 You will be part of our Contract Logistics team, adding your expertise \+ skills to support Customer \+ Operational Excellence by ensuring Labour Law compliance and Statutory adherence across all warehouses and offices.
   

  

 Your primary objective will be to ensure compliance with labour laws and statutory requirements, supporting smooth operations and minimizing compliance risks across sites.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* To ensure compliance with central and state labour laws including CLRA, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishment, PF, ESI, etc.
* To manage and monitor contract labour compliance, including vendor documentation, statutory validations, and adherence checks
* To maintain and update statutory registers, records, filings, and compliance trackers across all locations
* To support execution of internal and external audits, including documentation, site readiness, and closure tracking of observations
* To track and manage audit findings and ensure timely closure in coordination with site teams
* To support statutory licensing processes, including applications, renewals, and documentation management
* To track and update labour law changes and regulatory requirements, ensuring timely communication and implementation support
* To coordinate with government authorities and inspectors for documentation, inspections, and follow\-ups
* To support payroll compliance checks, including validation of minimum wages, statutory deductions, and contractor compliance
* To monitor and validate vendor compliance documentation on an ongoing basis
* To support incident reporting and RCA coordination, including tracking closure timelines and documentation
* To assist in execution of training and awareness programs on labour law and compliance requirements
* To support compliance readiness for new customer onboarding, including documentation, checklist validation, and site\-level coordination


**What we would like you to bring**
* 10–12 years of experience in Labour Compliance and Industrial Relations (IR) within logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, or supply chain environments.
* Strong knowledge of labour laws including CLRA, PF, ESIC, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, Factory Act, and Labour Codes.
* Experience managing contract labour and manpower vendor compliance.
* Proven ability to conduct statutory and labour compliance audits across multiple sites.
* Hands\-on experience handling employee grievances, labour disputes, strikes, and workforce disruptions.
* Strong liaison and relationship management with labour authorities, government bodies, and external stakeholders.
* Experience validating payroll compliance, statutory deductions, and employee remuneration.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage customers, vendors, and operations teams.
* Willingness to travel extensively and support on\-site operational requirements.
* LLB/LLM or Labour Law qualification preferred; experience with large logistics or e\-commerce organizations is highly desirable.


**What's in it for you**
* Work with a Global Leader – Join one of the world’s top logistics companies with a strong international presence and reputation.
* Career Development – Access structured growth opportunities, professional training, and internal mobility within a global organization.
* Attractive Compensation – Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives and benefits.
* Collaborative Work Culture – Be part of a supportive, ethical, and compliance\-driven team environment.
* Local Role, Global Impact – Influence regional business growth while working with global tools, systems, and best practices.


**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

 , and
 **driving ER governance, risk mitigation, and process excellence** 
 .
   

  

 The role acts as a
 **trusted advisor to HR and business leadership** 
 , with a strong focus on
 **fairness, compliance, and risk management** 
 .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Employee Relations \& Case Management**
* Independently manage complex and sensitive ER cases, including misconduct, grievances, ethical concerns, and policy violations.
* Lead end‑to‑end investigations (fact finding, interviews, documentation, assessment, recommendations, and closure).
* Handling sensitive cases involving mental health issues, police matters, court proceedings, and similar concerns.
* Recommend and execute appropriate disciplinary actions, not limited to warnings, final actions, or terminations.
* Ensure timely, fair, and consistent resolution of cases while minimizing business, reputational, and legal risk.
* Participate in change management initiatives that require strategic involvement from ER.


**Policy Interpretation \& Advisory**
* Provide expert interpretation of HR policies, Code of Business Ethics, and internal governance standards.
* Advise HRBPs and business leaders on policy application, employee risk, and ER strategy.
* Drive policy communication, awareness, and adherence across the organization.


**Stakeholder \& Leadership Engagement**
* Interact directly with senior HR leaders and business leadership as a trusted ER advisor.
* Exercise independent judgment on ER decisions with significant day‑to‑day and long‑term impact.
* Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Ethics, and CI teams, including BEL and litigation‑sensitive matters.


**Risk Mitigation \& Governance**
* Proactively identify trends, repeat risks, and systemic issues to prevent escalations and litigations.
* Ensure timely escalation to Legal for potential or active litigation matters.
* Participate in ER governance, audits, internal controls, and compliance reviews.
* Drive process improvements, audit closures, and action plan management.


**Behavioral Assessment \& Human‑Centered Approach**
* Apply behavioral insight to assess intent, context, and conduct
* Differentiate capability, behavior, and misconduct concerns
* Lead empathetic, professional employee interactions
* De\-escalate sensitive situations effectively
* Promote fair and dignified outcomes within HR boundaries


**People \& Team Responsibilities**
* Manage and guide a medium‑sized ER team (directly or matrixed – organization decision).
* Coach and support team members, including acting as a buddy or back‑up during leadership absence.
* Ensure workload management, quality, consistency, and capability uplift within the team.


**Decision‑Making Authority**
* Acts independently on ER decisions within defined governance.
* Decisions have lasting impact on employees, teams, and organizational risk posture.
* Solutions are not limited to disciplinary actions and may include corrective, preventive, or restorative approaches.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
**Functional**
* Strong expertise in Employee Relations, Investigations, and HR Policies
* Solid understanding of employment law principles and internal compliance
* Risk assessment and mitigation
* Documentation and case articulation


**Behavioral / Psychology‑Driven**
* Strong emotional intelligence and active listening
* Ability to assess behavior, motivation, and situational context
* Calm, grounded handling of sensitive or distressing scenarios
* Balanced application of empathy and accountability


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Typically 8–12 years of HR / ER experience, with significant hands‑on ER exposure
* Experience or academic background as a counseling psychologist is preferred
* Education or experience in Psychology, Counseling, Social Work, or Behavioral Sciences (preferred)
* Prior experience managing complex investigations and senior‑stakeholder cases
* Experience working in large, matrixed organizations
* HR / Law background preferred (not mandatory)


**Level Indicators (L8\)**
* Operates with minimal supervision
* Manages complex cases and teams (organization discretion)
* Influences outcomes beyond own scope
* Recognized as a subject‑matter expert in ER \& Policies


**Role Boundaries (Important Clarity)**
* The role does not provide clinical counseling or therapy
* Psychology background is applied to better decision‑making, conversations, and outcomes, not medical or therapeutic intervention
* All actions remain within HR, policy, and governance frameworks

description:

 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un·e recruteur·e TI bilingue (français/anglais) basé(e) en Inde pour se joindre à notre équipe nord\-américaine d’acquisition de talents. Il s’agit d’un poste entièrement en télétravail, soutenant les activités de recrutement au Canada et aux États\-Unis. La personne retenue devra être disponible pour travailler principalement selon les heures de bureau du fuseau horaire de l’Est (HE) afin de collaborer efficacement avec les gestionnaires d’embauche, les candidats et les partenaires internes partout en Amérique du Nord.
   

  

 Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de l’ensemble du cycle de recrutement pour des postes en TI. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires afin d’attirer, d’évaluer et d’embaucher les meilleurs talents. La personne idéale est passionnée par le recrutement, s’épanouit dans un environnement dynamique et le travail d’équipe et sait bâtir des relations de confiance tout en offrant une expérience candidat exceptionnelle.
   

  

**Responsabilités**
* Collaborer avec les gestionnaires afin de définir les besoins d’embauche, les descriptions de poste, les responsabilités, les qualifications et les compétences recherchées.
* Rédiger des affichages de poste attrayants et les publier sur les plateformes de recrutement internes et externes.
* Gérer les bassins de candidats et maintenir des données de recrutement exactes dans le système de suivi des candidatures (ATS).
* Assurer l’ensemble du processus de recrutement, incluant :
* Le sorucing de candidats à l’aide de différents canaux de recrutement
* Le tri des CV et les présélections téléphoniques / visio
* La conduite d’entrevues RH et l’évaluation des candidats
* La préparation des comptes rendus d’entrevue et des recommandations
* La mise à jour des systèmes de recrutement et le maintien d’une documentation précise
* Les communications et suivis auprès des gestionnaires, des candidats et des partenaires internes tout au long du processus de recrutement
* La coordination des entrevues et le soutien au processus de sélection
* La présentation des offres d’emploi et, au besoin, la négociation des conditions d’embauche
* La gestion de l’acceptation des offres jusqu’aux activités précédant l’intégration
* Effectuer de manière proactive la recherche de candidats passifs à l’aide de LinkedIn Recruiter et d’autres outils de recherche de talents.
* Développer et maintenir de solides relations avec les équipes d’embauche en agissant à titre de conseiller(ère) de confiance en acquisition de talents.
* Travailler en équipe, collaborer avec les autres partenaires du recrutement et réaliser les entrevues de présélection.
* Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de recrutement en partenariat avec la direction afin de soutenir la croissance de l’entreprise.
* Utiliser des techniques de recrutement innovantes, notamment LinkedIn, les médias sociaux, le réseautage, les programmes de recommandation et d’autres canaux de recrutement.
* Agir à titre de principal point de contact entre les candidats, les gestionnaires d’embauche et les partenaires des ressources humaines tout au long du processus de recrutement.
* Fournir régulièrement à la direction des mises à jour sur les recrutements, les indicateurs de performance et les tendances du marché.
* Veiller au respect des lois du travail, des politiques de l’entreprise et des meilleures pratiques en matière de recrutement.
* Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de recrutement en identifiant des occasions d’optimisation et d’amélioration de l’expérience candidat.
* Soutenir les initiatives liées à la marque employeur Fujitsu


**Exigences**
* Être basé(e) en Inde et être en mesure de travailler à distance.
* Être disponible et disposé(e) à travailler principalement selon les heures de bureau du fuseau horaire de l’Est (Canada/États\-Unis).
* Plus de 8 ans d’expérience en recrutement TI de cycle complet, avec une capacité démontrée à prendre en charge l’ensemble du processus de recrutement, de bout en bout.
* Expérience éprouvée auprès de clients ou d’organisations aux États\-Unis et/ou au Canada, idéalement dans un environnement corporatif ou d’entreprise.
* Expérience pratique du recrutement de postes permanents ainsi que de postes contractuels/temporaires.
* Solide expérience en recrutement technique dans les domaines des logiciels, de l’infrastructure, du cloud, de la cybersécurité, de l’architecture, des données et des technologies connexes.
* Bonne connaissance du marché des talents aux États\-Unis et au Canada, notamment des dynamiques du marché du travail, des pratiques de recrutement ainsi que des lois et réglementations applicables en matière d’emploi et de travail.
* Bilingue français et anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
* Capacité démontrée à gérer de façon autonome plusieurs requisitions ainsi que des recherches complexes et difficiles à pourvoir dans un environnement dynamique.
* Solide expertise en sourcing, notamment une expérience pratique avec LinkedIn Recruiter et d’autres plateformes de recherche de talents.
* Excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes, communication, influence et développement de relations professionnelles.
* Expérience avec les systèmes ATS ainsi que dans la gestion de données et de la documentation de recrutement précises et à jour.
* Expérience dans l’utilisation de technologies de recrutement propulsées par l’IA afin d’améliorer l’efficacité du sourcing et du processus de recrutement.
* Baccalauréat en ressources humaines, administration des affaires ou dans une discipline connexe, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience.

* Act as the primary liaison between candidates, hiring managers, and Human Resources throughout the recruitment process.
* Provide regular recruitment updates, pipeline metrics, and market insights to leadership.
* Ensure compliance with employment legislation, company policies, and recruitment best practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to optimize recruitment processes and enhance the candidate experience.

**Requirements**
* Based in India and able to work remotely
* Ability and willingness to work primarily during Eastern Time (Canada/U.S.) business hours.
* 8\+ years of full\-cycle IT recruitment experience, with demonstrated ownership of end\-to\-end recruiting.
* Proven experience supporting U.S. and/or Canadian clients or organizations, preferably in a corporate or enterprise environment.

* Based in India and able to work fully remotely, primarily during North American ET business hours.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple requisitions and complex, hard\-to\-fill searches in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong sourcing expertise, including hands\-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and other talent platforms.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, influencing and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience using ATS platforms and maintaining accurate recruitment data and documentation.
* Experience leveraging AI\-powered recruitment technologies to enhance sourcing and recruiting effectiveness.
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline, or equivalent education and experience.

 Head / Senior Officer – Training \& Placement
 



**About the Role** 




 Kingston Educational Institute (KEI) is seeking a dynamic, proactive, and result\-oriented
 **Training \& Placement Officer** 
 to support and strengthen the activities of the Training \& Placement and Corporate Relations Cell.
 



 The incumbent will be responsible for coordinating student training programs, internships, campus recruitment drives, employer interactions, career development initiatives, and placement\-related activities across various academic departments. The role requires strong communication, coordination, networking, documentation, and follow\-up skills, along with the ability to work closely with students, faculty members, management, and corporate recruiters.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Training \& Student Development** 



* Coordinate and support training programs designed to improve students' employability and industry readiness.
* Organize aptitude training, soft\-skills training, communication skills, interview preparation, group discussions, and other career development programs.
* Coordinate workshops, seminars, guest lectures, industry sessions, career counselling programs, and pre\-placement talks.
* Identify students' training requirements in coordination with academic departments.
* Maintain records of student participation, attendance, performance, and training outcomes.



**2\. Placement \& Recruitment Coordination** 



* Coordinate campus recruitment drives from initial communication with recruiters through completion of the recruitment process.
* Assist in identifying and inviting companies for campus placement and internship opportunities.
* Coordinate student registration, eligibility verification, shortlisting, and communication with candidates.
* Schedule aptitude tests, group discussions, technical rounds, HR interviews, and other recruitment activities.
* Ensure timely communication of recruitment schedules, instructions, and requirements to students and concerned departments.
* Support recruiters during campus visits and ensure smooth execution of placement activities.



**3\. Corporate \& Employer Relations** 



* Develop and maintain professional relationships with HR professionals, recruiters, corporate organizations, and industry representatives.
* Assist in identifying new companies and industry partners for placements, internships, training, and institutional collaborations.
* Maintain an updated database of recruiters, corporate contacts, placement partners, and industry organizations.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with recruiters regarding placement opportunities and recruitment requirements.
* Assist in coordinating corporate meetings, industry visits, MoUs, and other institutional\-industry engagement activities.



**4\. Internship Coordination** 



* Coordinate internship opportunities for students with suitable organizations.

title: Senior People Partner (HRBP)
description:
SmartBear delivers application integrity for modern tech stacks, ensuring continuous, measurable assurance that software just works as intended with governance to operate at AI speed and scale. SmartBear offers deep test automation, API lifecycle management, and observability capabilities. With integrations across the SDLC, it sets a new quality standard for application delivery teams.
   

  

 SmartBear is trusted by developers, testers, and software engineers across 32,000 organizations, including 75% of the largest financial institutions and industry leaders such as Adobe, JetBlue, and Microsoft. SmartBear’s open source tools are downloaded more than 100 million times a month and have earned over 30,000 GitHub stars from the developer community. With its best\-loved brands, including Swagger, TestComplete, Reflect, QMetry, Zephyr, and more, SmartBear meets customers where they are to make our technology\-driven world a better place. Learn more at
 
 www.smartbear.com
 
 , or follow us on
 
 LinkedIn
 
 ,
 
 X
 
 , and
 
 Reddit
 
 . 
   

  

 At SmartBear, you will be part of a dynamic team solving one of the most critical challenges facing modern businesses: ensuring the integrity of software in an AI\-driven world. Whether you are working directly with customers, driving go to market strategies, supporting operations, building products, or enabling teams, your contributions help shape the future of software quality for organizations worldwide. Join us in our mission.
 



**Senior People Partner (HRBP)** 




 This is a pivotal role for SmartBear's India operations, combining hands\-on HRBP partnership with company\-wide accountability for statutory compliance. As HRBP to your assigned function, you'll partner with senior business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with business priorities, coach leaders on talent, performance, and organizational effectiveness, and drive strategic people initiatives that build high\-performing, engaged, and inclusive teams. You'll also serve as India's statutory compliance expert, owning alignment with Indian labor law across all India\-based SmartBear employees including those outside your HRBP client group, regardless of function or reporting line, in partnership with our Sr. Director of Global People Operations. 
 



**About the Role:** 



* Partner with business leaders to align People \& Culture strategies with organizational goals and translate business priorities into actionable people plans.
* Coach and advise managers on performance management, employee development, organizational design, compensation, and employee relations.
* Analyze employee engagement survey results and develop action plans with leaders.
* Develop and implement talent retention strategies that enhance employee experience.
* Serve as a trusted advisor, influencing leaders through data, business insight, and People \& Culture expertise.
* Collaborate across the People \& Culture organization to deliver consistent, scalable, and impactful people programs.
* Partner with global People \& Culture teams to adapt enterprise\-wide programs to local legal and cultural context.
* The successful candidate will work from our Ahmedabad, India office in hybrid model.



**India Statutory Compliance (all India employees):** 



* Own compliance with Indian labor law — including the Industrial Relations Code, Shops \& Establishments Act, and related regulations — for every India\-based employee, regardless of which function or HRBP they are otherwise supported by, serving as SmartBear's go\-to expert on India employment regulation.
* Partner with the Director of Global People Operations, Legal, and other HRBPs to maintain visibility into employment actions (hiring, compensation changes, terminations) across functions, so compliance risk is caught even outside your direct client group.
* Serve as the single point of accountability and escalation for India regulatory questions raised by other HRBPs or business leaders.



**We are looking for you if you have:** 



* 8\+ years of experience in a senior People Partner or HR Business Partner role, ideally within a high\-growth technology environment.
* Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to develop and implement strategic People \& Culture initiatives.
* Strong expertise in performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness.
* Experience analyzing employee engagement data and translating insights into measurable action plans.
* Excellent communication, coaching, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* A passion for building inclusive, high\-performing teams and creating exceptional employee experiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labor law, statutory compliance, and HR regulatory requirements is required, given this role's company\-wide compliance ownership.
* Experience working as part of a global, distributed People \& Culture team is a plus.
* A background in people operations — including HR systems, processes, and policy administration — is a plus.



**Why you should join the SmartBear crew:** 
  
 


* You can grow your career at every level.
* We invest in your success as well as the spaces where our teams come together to work, collaborate, and have fun.
* We love celebrating our SmartBears; we even encourage our crew to take their birthdays off.
* We are guided by a People and Culture organization \- an important distinction for us. We think about our team holistically – the whole person.
* We celebrate our differences in experiences, viewpoints, and identities because we know it leads to better outcomes.



**Did you know?** 



* Our main goal at SmartBear is to make our technology\-driven world a better place.
* SmartBear is committed to ethical corporate practices and social responsibility, promoting good in all the communities we serve.
* SmartBear is headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices across the world including Galway Ireland, Bath, UK, Wroclaw, Poland and Bangalore, India.
* We’ve won major industry (product and company) awards including B2B Innovators Award, Content Marketing Association, IntellyX Digital Innovator and BuiltIn Best Places to Work.



*SmartBear is committed to creating an inclusive workplace for employees where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under applicable laws. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that reflects a diversity of thought and experience as well as our values of being smart, open, driven, accountable, and curious.*

title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow\-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world\-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long\-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer\-centric, operationally excellent, and high\-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business\- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer\-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations\- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People\-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial \- Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock\-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation\-to\-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow\-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.
