title: Learning and Change Transformation - Senior Consultant
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \| PEOPLE CONSULTING \| LEARNING \& CHANGE**
**Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation \& Change**
 Own the workstream. Shape the solution. Accelerate client adoption.
   

  

**ROLE SNAPSHOT**
**Role:** 
 Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation \& Change
   

  

**Portfolio:** 
 Learning \& Development, People Consulting MENA
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7–9 years, including substantial client\-facing L\&D consulting experience
   

  

**Capability profile** 
 Learning consulting with deployable organisational change management capability
   

  

**Engagement model** 
 Workstream ownership; proposal solutioning; client\-facing delivery
   

  

**Travel:** 
 India\-based with willingness for short\- or long\-term deployment across KSA, UAE and Qatar
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 The Senior Consultant is a founding delivery and pursuit hire for the growing MENA Learning \& Change capability. The role translates complex client and RFP requirements into practical learning, adoption and capability\-building solutions, then owns key workstreams through delivery.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine Learning \& Development consulting, organisational change management, proposal development, facilitation and responsible AI usage. The role supports MENA priorities, with KSA as the primary growth market and government, energy and financial services as sector priorities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client delivery and workstream ownership**
* Own one or more learning and change workstreams across scope, quality, schedule, effort, dependencies, risks and client communication.
* Lead discovery interviews, focus groups, learning needs analyses, skills\-gap assessments, stakeholder workshops and design sessions.
* Translate business outcomes into capability frameworks, curriculum architectures, blended learning journeys, facilitator\-led experiences and measurement plans.
* Produce and quality\-review client\-ready strategies, roadmaps, workshop packs, recommendations, dashboards and implementation plans.
* Facilitate stakeholder and learner sessions and present workstream recommendations to client managers and senior stakeholders.
* Coach Staff Consultants and coordinate specialists, designers, facilitators and technology contributors across the workstream.


**Learning transformation and change management**
* Design integrated learning and adoption approaches covering audience analysis, impacts, readiness, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, reinforcement and sustainment.
* Apply instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM to learning journeys, curricula, academies, leadership programmes and capability\-building interventions.
* Develop learning operating model, managed learning services, governance, intake, content operations and performance\-measurement components where relevant.
* Support leadership assessment\-led development assignments, including administration and interpretation when appropriately accredited, and convert insights into development pathways.
* Use evaluation and analytics approaches to measure participation, learning transfer, adoption and business impact.


**Pursuits, proposals and business development**
* Independently draft solution approaches, proposal narratives, methodologies, workplans, staffing models, delivery plans, assumptions, risks and effort estimates.
* Analyse RFP requirements, develop compliance matrices and help create differentiated win themes and client\-specific solution stories under tight turnaround times.
* Create proposal slides, capability showcases, credentials, case studies, benchmarks and sector research for MENA partner and account teams.
* Participate in partner reviews, solution workshops and oral presentation preparation; present assigned sections confidently when required.
* Identify follow\-on opportunities during delivery and shape them into a clear problem statement, proposed response and indicative scope.


**AI\-enabled learning and technology**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal development, learning design and content acceleration in line with firm policies.
* Design AI\-enabled learning use cases, with particular emphasis on a learning content generation accelerator, personalised journeys and analytics\-assisted decisions.
* Apply human review, factual verification, accessibility, privacy, confidentiality, intellectual property and quality controls to AI\-assisted output.
* Bring working knowledge of LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces, LMS ecosystems and learning analytics to solution design.
* Guide Staff Consultants in effective prompt design, AI\-assisted production and responsible review practices.


**Capability building and internal contribution**
* Build and maintain reusable proposal content, credentials, case studies, research, methods, templates and delivery assets.
* Convert project learning into portfolio intellectual property and support capability demonstrations and internal roadshows.
* Contribute to recruitment assessments, onboarding, coaching, certification pathways and community\-of\-practice activity.
* Balance client delivery with pursuit and capability commitments in a lean, growth\-stage team.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting judgement: structures ambiguous problems, forms hypotheses, makes evidence\-based recommendations and knows when to escalate.
* Dual capability: can lead both a learning design conversation and a change/adoption conversation without treating them as separate disciplines.
* Proposal craft: writes clear, persuasive and executable solutions rather than generic capability statements.
* Facilitation and design thinking: designs productive workshops and moves diverse stakeholders towards decisions.
* Client communication: produces director\-ready documents and communicates confidently in virtual and in\-person settings.
* AI fluency: uses AI to increase speed and quality while retaining human accountability and professional scepticism.
* Builder mindset: creates reusable capability while meeting immediate delivery requirements.


**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**
* 7–9 years of relevant experience across L\&D consulting, learning transformation and organisational change management.
* Demonstrated client\-facing consulting experience and independent ownership of learning or change workstreams.
* Evidence of contribution to RFPs, solution approaches, proposal writing, effort estimation and presentation development.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Practical experience in change impacts, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands\-on use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals or learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, HR, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline. PREFERRED
* GCC or MENA delivery or proposal experience, especially in government, energy or financial services.
* Big Four or global consulting experience.
* Experience in managed learning services, learning operating models, leadership development or leadership assessment\-led development.
* Exposure to LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces and learning analytics.
* Experience with SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, EdCast or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of Articulate Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Camtasia, Captivate or comparable content tools.
* Experience on digital transformation, ERP, AI adoption or workforce transformation programmes.


**CERTIFICATIONS**
**Required At Joining Or Within Agreed Development Plan**
* PROSCI or an equivalent recognised change management certification.
* Design thinking / human\-centred design / workshop facilitation credential or demonstrable equivalent experience.
* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI credential.
* One recognised learning credential or structured pathway towards APTD, CPTD or equivalent.


**Preferred / Differentiating**
* CCMP.
* Kirkpatrick learning evaluation credential.
* Hogan, SHL or Korn Ferry practitioner accreditation.
* Agile, Scrum or SAFe certification.
* Learning analytics, LMS, LXP or talent\-platform certification.


**WAYS OF WORKING**
**INITIAL RAMP\-UP**
* 50% client delivery.
* 30% pursuits and proposal support.
* 10% capability building.
* 10% internal initiatives.


**ONCE STAFFED ON A BILLABLE ENGAGEMENT**
* 70% client delivery.
* 30% pursuits, proposal support and agreed capability contribution.
* Allocation remains subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.


**INDICATIVE SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**
**Dimension**
* Delivery
* Pursuits
* Billable deployment
* Capability assets
* AI and innovation
* People


**Indicative measure**
* Own at least one significant learning or change workstream and achieve agreed scope, quality, schedule and client\-feedback expectations.
* Make material contributions to priority MENA proposals, including independent ownership of assigned solution and delivery sections.
* Transition into billable client delivery as demand permits, targeted within the first 2–3 months of joining.
* Create or materially improve reusable credentials, case studies, methods, proposal content or delivery assets.
* Demonstrate responsible AI use in proposals and delivery and contribute to the learning content generation accelerator or another client\-facing use case.
* Coach assigned Staff Consultants and provide timely, documented review and development feedback.


**Evidence**
* Workplan, quality reviews and client feedback.
* Pursuit tracker and proposal records.
* Staffing and utilisation records.
* Controlled repository and reuse evidence.
* Demo, use\-case record or client deliverable.
* Coaching records and work\-product improvement.


**What Ey Offers**
* Exposure to live MENA learning, change and workforce transformation programmes.
* A role combining workstream delivery, solution shaping, proposal support and capability building.
* A development path across learning consulting, organisational change, facilitation, AI and emerging learning technology.
* The opportunity to shape a growing MENA Learning \& Change capability rather than inherit a fixed operating model.


**Recruitment note:** 
 This JD is intentionally designed to filter for consulting capability, not training administration alone. Selection must be based on role\-relevant skills and experience.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine:
   

  

* Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains
* Polished technical communications
* Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer
* Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience
* A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers


 The TAM’s primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account\-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time.
   

  

 The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs.
   

  

 This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB.
   

  

 Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Why MongoDB is a fantastic place to work and build your career
   

  

* Be a part of the company that’s reinventing the database, focused on innovation and speed
* Enjoy a fun, inspiring culture that is engineering focused
* Work with exceptionally skilled people around the globe
* Learn, contribute, and make a positive impact on the product and community


 Cool things you’ll do
   

  

 MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB
   

  

 As a Technical Account Manager, you’ll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions \- resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between
   

  

 You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB
   

  

 You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem
   

  

 What you need
   

  

 You should have 7\+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self\-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi\-faceted
   

  

 It’s crucial for every candidate to check these boxes:
   

  

* Communicator:
+ Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAM’s portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations)
+ Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience
+ The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability

* Collaborator
+ Ability to work independently as well as cross\-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met
+ Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will
+ Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; ability to secure commitments and lead collaborative efforts

* Problem Solver:
+ Comfort thinking on your feet, solving problems in real\-time, and reducing pressure and anxiety through calm, authoritative technical leadership; ability to keep your cool and project command presence during escalated situations where tensions and anxiety may be high
+ Ability to design, communicate, and follow a structured approach to solving complex problems based loosely upon the scientific method
+ Experience analyzing and pursuing issues holistically in the enterprise; spanning multiple technologies, customer teams and silos

* Technical Expert
+ Experience building, maintaining, tuning, and troubleshooting sophisticated mission\-critical production database systems
+ Familiarity with modern service architectures and the implications on development teams, their structures and the development lifecycle
+ Experience with the technologies and development patterns typical of a large\-scale enterprise customer
+ Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP

* Builder
+ Develop, document, and help implement techniques, tools and procedures for optimizing MongoDB’s technical relationship with marquee customers

* Product evangelism
+ The TAM helps customers understand how the MongoDB developer data platform is well\-suited to solve a wide variety of their problems


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
* Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures
+ Microservices/Serverless architectures
+ CI/CD tools and approaches
+ Containerization, orchestration and management tools
+ Enterprise Identity platforms

* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
* Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, virtualization, clustering


 Success Measures
   

  

* In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training
* In 6 months, you will be confident working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
* In 12 months, you will be directly and independently engaged in technical account management, ensuring customers are successful and happy with MongoDB and see our developer data platform as the de facto standard for new projects


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

True to our motto – ‘Moving big things to zero’ – we help key industries in the global economy to reduce hard\-to\-abate emissions. Our technologies have a measurable impact on the success of the global energy transition. Headquartered in Germany, Everllence employs around 15,000 people across more than 140 sites worldwide.
   

  

**Head of PrimeServ STG**

 The role will drive service strategy, operational excellence, revenue growth, and customer satisfaction across local and global markets. The position oversees field service execution, service bidding, order management, and aftersales support, ensuring high\-quality service delivery and profitable service operations.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement comprehensive business and sales strategies to achieve organizational objectives and drive revenue growth for the PrimeServ STG service business.
* Identify and capitalize on new service opportunities, including maintenance, repairs, retrofits, upgrades, and long\-term service agreements for both company products and third\-party OEM equipment.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify emerging trends, market opportunities, and potential business risks.
* Oversee the preparation, review, and submission of service bids, proposals, and tenders, ensuring technical accuracy, competitiveness, and profitability.
* Lead commercial negotiations with key customers, closing high\-value deals and securing long\-term service contracts.
* Establish sales and service targets, monitor performance metrics, and ensure achievement of business objectives.
* Oversee the planning and execution of field service activities, ensuring compliance with safety standards, quality requirements, and project timelines.
* Ensure effective coordination of service delivery, order management, and project execution to meet customer expectations and operational targets.
* Lead, mentor, and manage cross\-functional teams including sales professionals, field service engineers, bid management, order management, and aftersales support teams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and long\-term business partnerships.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer experience, service quality, and repeat business.
* Prepare and present regular performance reports, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior management.
* Work closely with engineering, supply chain, product development, project management, and finance teams to ensure alignment and successful execution of business and service initiatives.

* Excellent strategic planning and organizational abilities.

**Job Description**
 As a Manager of Technical Support at Alation you will lead the day to day operations of a team of Technical Support Engineers. You are leading a customer\-facing team as a key leader in the customer success organization. You will be responsible for directly monitoring, reporting, and driving improvements to team\-level metrics and KPIs, acting as an escalation point with customers and internal teams, and optimizing and developing support processes and tools. Your work will be cross\-functional and will involve working with engineering, QA, DevOps, product management, and sales. Location is Chennai (Hybrid Model).
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Manage a team of senior\-level Technical Support Engineers

* Drive the scaling, onboarding, and ongoing specialization of the team
* Implementing innovative process to increase support efficiency and increasing overall customer satisfaction
* Handle customer escalations and assist with troubleshooting and triaging incidents
* Manage the backlog and ensure that Support SLAs and KPIs are met
* Partner with Engineering \& Product to prioritize issues and product improvements
* Ready to work in shifts to be aligned with customer timezones.


**You Should Have**
* 8\-12 years of enterprise application support or operations experience, supporting customers in On Premise, Cloud, and Hybrid setups.
* Open to work in shifts to cover our global customers.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of people management experience.
* Excellent communication skills, with a strong ability to discuss complex technical concepts with customers, engineers, and product managers
* Prior experience managing a team of frontline and senior\-level Support Engineers
* Solid understanding of data platforms, data management, analytics or the BI space
* Excellent communication skills, with a strong ability to discuss complex technical concepts with customers, engineers, and product managers
* Self\-starter with strong creative problem\-solving, facilitation and interpersonal skills
* First\-hand leadership experience working in a global organization and partnering with regional managers and leads to ensure a seamless customer experience
* Experience troubleshooting Linux and running shell commands
* Understanding of Relational Databases, such Oracle and Postgres. SQL is a must.


**A big plus if you have experience in the following areas:**
* Postgres (DB internals)
* Elasticsearch, NoSQL, MongoDB
* Hadoop Ecosystem (Hive, HBase)
* Cloud technologies and frameworks such as Kubernetes and Docker
* Experience scoping or building tooling to improve the support experience

 Oversees day\-to\-day support activities for specific products and services.

 Ensures that workforce is adequately staffed to meet customer support requirements. Identifies tasks, assigns and coordinates resources.
   

  

 Ensures that adequate records and systems are maintained and problems are resolved. Ensures full compliance with the service agreement in effect.
   

  

 Serves as a point of escalation for all issues that require special attention. Leads a team in the support process through organizational development and resource management; gives professional guidance throughout the planning and delivery process.
   

  

**Skill Descriptors**
 Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision\-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Differentiates assumptions, perspectives, and historical frameworks.
* Evaluates past decisions for insights to improve decision\-making process.
* Assesses and validates decision options and points and predicts their potential impact.
* Advises others in analyzing and synthesizing relevant data and assessing alternatives.
* Uses effective decision\-making approaches such as consultative, command, or consensus.
* Ensures that assumptions and received wisdom are objectively analyzed in decisions.


**Effective Communications** 
 : Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
* Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
* Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.
* Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.
* Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement.
* Maintains focus on the topic at hand.


 Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem\-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem\-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem\-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide\-impact problems.


 Organizational Leadership: Knowledge of leadership concepts and ability to use strategies and skills to enlist others in setting, embracing and achieving objectives.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Employs various group decision\-making methods depending on the situation.
* Promotes efficacy through monitoring, coaching \& motivating subordinates, intervention, etc.
* Translates vision into specific functional or departmental initiatives.
* Uses emotional contagion to affect the mood of group members, tone of group and group processes.
* Uses a normative decision model (with leadership styles and situational variables) to select style.
* Initiates structure: role clarification, setting standards, holding subordinates accountable, etc.


 Customer Interaction: Knowledge of the principles and techniques of communicating with a customer; ability to utilize tools and techniques for customer interaction.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Provides customer support on difficult problems.
* Teaches techniques for transitioning from problem solving to sales opportunities.
* Analyzes the characteristics of threats and selects the proper plan of action for handling them.
* Evaluates techniques for face\-to\-face, telephone and web\-based interactions.
* Advises on methods for identifying leads and procedures for turning them over.
* Implements tactics to de\-escalate problem situations immediately.


 Customer Support Policies, Standards and Procedures: Knowledge of the organization's customer support policies, standards and procedures; ability to guide customers on all company interactions.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Collaborates with other functions on establishing and documenting joint standards.
* Develops quality assurance and monitoring mechanisms.
* Advises on the development of customer support policies and practices.
* Implements cross\-functional standards and procedures.
* Evaluates the impact of standards and policies across functional specialties.
* Analyzes existing and evolving procedures for their efficiency and effectiveness.


 Software Release Management: Knowledge of strategies, practices and tools for managing versions and distribution of software products and enhancements; ability to evaluate and improve release management practices and tools.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Participates in the development and testing of back\-out procedures and recovery strategies.
* Oversees all aspects of release management for the entire installed customer base.
* Develops and disseminates communications about new release training.
* Drafts communications about product release delays.
* Develops distribution dates based on development, testing (QA), validation, packaging activities.
* Conducts impact analysis for major releases or critical applications; assesses benefits and risks.


 Software Reliability Management: Knowledge of software reliability management; ability to develop and use principles, methodologies and metrics that increase software product performance and reliability.
   

  

****Level Extensive Experience:****
* Discusses variables used in standard reliability metrics and their impact on a given metric.
* Identifies methods to improve product performance and recommends design changes.
* Gathers information on product failures to be used for product redesign or enhancement.
* Demonstrates experience with reliability engineering practices for a range of products.
* Uses probability and statistical measures to assess products, estimate and monitor reliability.
* Participates in the definition of success criteria for products and tests.

title: Customer Value Lead
description:
**Do you have experience in managing innovation projects?**
**Are you a team Player?**
**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly

title: GROWTH EXECUTIVE
description:
Growth Executive – Student Engagement \& Memberships
   

  

* Reports to the Success Manager


 We're hiring someone whose whole job is to bring people back.
   

  

 Every fitness company talks about new sign\-ups. Fewer talk about the student who trained hard for four months, then life happened — a project, a move, a bad week — and hasn't logged in since.
   

  

 That student is who this role is for.
   

  

 Why this role exists
   

  

 In 2026, our growth is driven as much by the students already with us as by new sign\-ups. Attendance, re\-activation and renewals are where the next chapter is won.
   

  

 You'll design comeback campaigns for students who've gone quiet, work with our coaches to understand why people drop off, own renewals end to end, and make sure the membership experience — plan changes, payments, the lot — feels seamless.
   

  

 It's a role for someone who can invent a campaign on Monday and cheerfully chase a pending payment on Tuesday. Creative and operationally disciplined. Warm on the phone, sharp in the spreadsheet.
   

  

 You'll work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our coaching team, because engagement problems are rarely just data problems. They're human ones.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

 Engagement \& re\-activation
   

  

* Plan and run engagement campaigns for inactive, low\-attendance and at\-risk students
* Design creative re\-engagement initiatives — comeback programmes, challenges, win\-back offers, milestone moments
* Work closely with coaches to understand why students drop off, and turn that into
* interventions that actually move attendance


 Memberships \& renewals
   

  

* Communicate with current and past students on attendance, renewals and plan options
* Support membership growth through renewals and relevant cross\-sell and up\-sell conversations — consultative, never transactional
* Own renewal payment follow\-ups end to end. This is a critical part of the role


 Data \& reporting
   

  

* Track and analyse engagement, attendance and membership data to support decisions
* Maintain accurate membership and engagement records in our CRM
* Produce regular reports on engagement, renewals and revenue against quarterly targets


 How you'll work
   

  

* Use CRM tools and Google Workspace to track every effort — nothing lives only in your head
* Look for the automation, then keep the human touch on top of it
* Bring a growth mindset and a start\-up mentality


 What we need from you
   

  

* 2\+ years in customer success, account management, community management, inside sales or a closely related role. Exceptional freshers with the right temperament are welcome to apply
* Strong English communication, verbal and written. You'll write campaign copy and have renewal conversations on the same day
* Comfort owning payment and renewal follow\-ups — persistent, organised, and never awkward about it
* High proficiency with Google Workspace / MS Office, and hands\-on experience with an online CRM
* Ability to read data and turn it into an action, not just a chart
* Creative thinking paired with operational discipline — you can invent a campaign and also run the checklist that ships it
* A calm, patient, empathetic manner with students. Many of the people you'll speak to left because life got hard
* Based in Chennai and able to work on\-site with the coaching team


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience in a B2C, subscription or membership\-led business
* Background in fitness, sports, wellness or education
* Hands\-on with marketing automation or CRM workflow building — WhatsApp or email journeys, lifecycle campaigns
* Spreadsheets beyond the basics — pivots, cohort views, retention curves
* A training practice of your own. It helps you speak our students' language


 Your first 90 days
   

  

 First 30 days You know our membership plans, CRM and student segments cold. You've run your first re\-activation outreach list and sat in on classes with the coaching team. By day 60 You own the renewals follow\-up cycle independently. A first comeback campaign is designed, shipped and measured. By day 90 You're reporting engagement, renewals and revenue on a regular cadence, and you've brought a measurable lift in attendance or renewal rate on at least one student segment.
   

  

 What you get
   

  

* A balanced, respectful work culture that respects your life outside work
* Free membership at The Quad — train with coaches who've transformed thousands of lives
* Health insurance, annual health checkups and wellness support
* Industry\-standard salaries and a generous leave policy
* The chance to positively affect someone's health every single day


 How to apply
   

  

 Use the form below. Along with your details, send us a short note on a time you brought a lapsed customer, member or student back. That note matters more to us than a cover letter.
   

  

 We read every application, and you'll hear from us either way.
   

  

 The Quad is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on capability, character and fit with how we coach.

Working closely with Customer Success, Sales and cross\-functional partners, you will deliver a seamless renewal experience, proactively manage commercial risk, and help customers realize continued value from their investment in Seismic.

****Quality \& Compliance****

* Audit delivery quality prior to handoff for customer use.
* Confirm the presence of exhaustive documentation for every delivery project.
* Uphold strict adherence to established project governance protocols.


****Success Milestones****

* Establish robust partnerships with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success stakeholders.
* Show mastery of delivery frameworks, governance standards, and project tools.

****Within 12 Months****

* Shorten onboarding cycles by implementing workflow efficiencies.
* Guide new team members in mastering delivery best practices.
* Achieve tangible gains in client satisfaction during the implementation phase.
* Serve as a reliable consultant for both internal teams and customer partners.


****Within 18 Months****
* Direct high\-stakes implementation efforts across various global regions or business segments.
* Lead the charge on standardizing delivery processes and driving operational excellence.
* Add value to the implementation framework and internal best practice repositories.
* Optimize delivery predictability and client happiness through data\-driven process changes.

****Measures of Success****
* Ratio of projects completed within the originally committed timeframes.
* Customer sentiment scores specifically related to the implementation journey.
* Volume of successful live production environments launched.
* Frequency and severity of project delays or stakeholder escalations.
* Delivery quality indicators, such as post\-launch issue frequency.

******Your Team Will:******

******About You:******

title: Oracle Channel Revenue Management - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle Channel Revenue Management Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement Oracle's suite of applications, and provide training and support to validate seamless integration and utilization, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on Oracle's tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will build meaningful client connections and inspire your teams, navigating complex situations with confidence. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear. You will leverage a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will deepen your understanding of the business context, interpret data to inform insights, and uphold professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's purpose and values.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of Oracle Fusion Cloud Channel Revenue Management implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and support engagements, spanning sell\-side and buy\-side channel flows from discovery through design, build, test, deployment, and hypercare.
* Own the overall solution design and delivery approach for channel incentive processes, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, auditable, and aligned with business requirements, pricing policy, and revenue recognition standards.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales, and Finance stakeholders, translating commercial objectives into effective channel program strategies and recommending appropriate program structures, eligibility rules, accrual treatments, and settlement approaches.
* Lead the design and configuration of Customer Channel Management programs, including customer rebates, customer promotion programs, annual and tiered volume programs, customer volume programs, annual co\-op programs, lump sum payments, off\-invoice promotions, special price agreements, and royalty payments.
* Lead the design and configuration of Supplier Channel Management programs, including supplier rebates, supplier annual rebates, ship\-and\-debit programs, supplier claim submission and validation, accrual reconciliation, and Supplier Portal collaboration.
* Govern the design of Deductions and Settlement processes, including claims, deductions, overpayments, invoice deductions, non\-invoice deductions, manual claims, claim investigation, dispute handling, write\-offs, and settlement by credit memo, debit memo, chargeback, check, or Payables payment.
* Oversee configuration of core setup objects including channel settings, channel program types, claim types, claim reasons, claim sources and settlement methods, user statuses, customer trade profiles, supplier trade profiles, approval rules, and claim assignment and ownership rules.
* Provide functional and technical leadership for integrations between Channel Revenue Management and Oracle Order Management, Pricing, Receivables, Payables, Procurement, Inventory, Subledger Accounting, and General Ledger, with a strong understanding of accrual, claim, settlement, and accounting event data flows.
* Lead the design of pricing\-related configuration supporting channel programs, including qualifiers, custom qualifiers, modifiers, price lists, and net\-of\-rebate conditions within Oracle Fusion Pricing.
* Own the accrual and liability management design, including trade fund budgets, fund allocation, accrual creation and adjustment, accrual balances, earnings versus payments reconciliation, pay\-over\-earnings thresholds, and period\-end close support.
* Manage multiple concurrent workstreams, projects, and stakeholder priorities while ensuring agreed quality, scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables are effectively managed.
* Establish and enforce quality assurance and release management processes, including configuration reviews, unit testing, SIT, UAT, integration testing, regression testing for quarterly Oracle updates, deployment readiness, and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Lead data migration and conversion strategy for programs, accruals, claims, trade profiles, master data, and open transactional balances using FBDI, ADFdi, CSV loaders, REST services, and other Oracle Cloud data\-loading mechanisms.
* Provide oversight for operational execution of scheduled processes such as accrual generation, claim settlement, mass settle and mass update claims, and accounting event sweeps, and proactively resolve data, integration, configuration, performance, and failed\-processing issues.
* Lead analysis of channel performance and operational metrics, including program effectiveness, accrual accuracy, claim ageing, deduction recovery rates, settlement cycle times, and unclaimed rebate exposure, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Partner with business and technology teams to define and enhance reporting, dashboards, and KPIs using OTBI, BI Publisher, and analytics platforms to provide visibility into channel program performance and financial exposure.
* Assess new Oracle Channel Revenue Management capabilities delivered through quarterly updates and recommend adoption of features that improve automation, control, scalability, and user experience.
* Establish and maintain solution governance standards, including configuration workbooks, naming conventions, change control, environment management, documentation, and access management.
* Promote appropriate data quality, master data, and control practices across customer, supplier, item, pricing, and program data supporting channel processes.
* Develop standard operating procedures, solution documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, reusable accelerators, and best\-practice frameworks to improve consistency and reduce delivery effort.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation, reducing manual claim handling and settlement activities and improving overall efficiency and scalability of channel operations.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for complex order, pricing, accrual, claim, settlement, and accounting integration issues, coordinating with internal technology teams, Oracle Support, and other stakeholders as required.
* Manage and mentor a team of Associates and Senior Associates, providing technical guidance, work allocation, quality reviews, coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities.
* Review team deliverables and provide appropriate oversight to ensure implementations meet expected functional, technical, quality, security, and operational standards.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, requirement workshops, design and solution reviews, status discussions, issue\-resolution sessions, and leadership updates.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and recommended mitigation actions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support pursuits, proposals, solution demonstrations, estimation, and capability building as required.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Overall experience of 8\-12 years in Oracle applications, with strong hands\-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Channel Revenue Management across at least 2\-3 end\-to\-end implementations or equivalent large\-scale support and enhancement engagements.
* Strong hands\-on configuration experience across Customer Channel Management, Supplier Channel Management, and Deductions and Settlement, including channel settings, program types, claim types, claim reasons, settlement methods, and customer and supplier trade profiles.
* Deep domain understanding of channel incentive processes, including customer and supplier rebate management, trade promotions, accrual management, claims management, deductions and settlement, and indirect sales management.
* Strong understanding of the Order\-to\-Cash and Procure\-to\-Pay process flows and the integration of Channel Revenue Management with Order Management, Pricing, Receivables, Payables, Procurement, and General Ledger.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Pricing, including price lists, qualifiers, modifiers, and custom pricing rules supporting channel programs.
* Understanding of Subledger Accounting, accounting events, accrual accounting, credit and debit memo processing, write\-off treatment, and period\-close implications of channel transactions.
* Experience managing complex implementations involving multiple business stakeholders, Oracle pillars, integrations, and dependencies.
* Demonstrated experience in requirements gathering, fit\-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, data migration, testing, deployment, production support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency in Oracle Cloud data\-loading and integration mechanisms, including FBDI, ADFdi, CSV loaders, REST and SOAP web services, and file\-based integrations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform root\-cause analysis and recommend sustainable solutions rather than tactical fixes.
* Experience defining and monitoring operational metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and performance reports for channel and trade processes.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business\-relevant information.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and stakeholders in a dynamic delivery environment.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and developing team members and reviewing technical and functional deliverables.


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience with adjacent Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM modules such as Order Management, Global Order Promising, Inventory Management, Procurement, and Supply Chain Financial Orchestration.
* Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite Channel Revenue Management and Trade Management, including chargebacks, third\-party accruals, budgets and offers, and claims, particularly in EBS\-to\-Cloud migration scenarios.
* Industry experience in consumer goods, distribution, high tech, industrial manufacturing, or life sciences where trade promotions, chargebacks, and gross\-to\-net processes are material.
* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), middleware, EDI transactions, and enterprise integration patterns supporting partner and distributor data exchange.
* Experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, Oracle Analytics Cloud, or comparable reporting and data visualization solutions.
* Understanding of revenue recognition, trade spend governance, financial controls, audit requirements, and segregation\-of\-duties considerations for channel programs.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, including requirements management, sprint planning, backlog management, testing, release management, and defect resolution.
* Oracle Cloud SCM, Order Management, or Channel Revenue Management certifications are desirable.


 Manager\-Level Leadership Expectations
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to operate beyond configuration and demonstrate ownership across people, delivery, technology, and stakeholder management. The individual should be able to independently manage complex workstreams, provide direction to delivery teams, challenge and refine requirements, identify risks early, recommend scalable solutions, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
   

  

 The Manager should also contribute to building the capability of the wider team through coaching, knowledge sharing, standardization, reusable solutions, quality governance, and continuous improvement, while maintaining a strong focus on delivery excellence and business outcomes.

description:

 Financial technology is a high\-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status\-quo and prompt major transformation.  Arcesium seeks an experienced Solution Architect to join our Client and Partner Development team as a Forward Deployed Solution Architect. As a Forward Deployed Solution Architect, you will bridge the gap between Arcesium platform and clients' business requirements. You will show the customer value quickly and turn insights into scalable and repeatable long\-term solutions. Forward Deployed Solution Architects work directly with Arcesium customer stakeholders and Arcesium product teams to solve sophisticated data problems in the investment management businesses.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Guide customer top stakeholders (CTO, CDO) on the best ways to accelerate customer data strategy through Arcesium
* Decompose customer problem into component parts, design scalable solution using platform capabilities as building blocks
* Present solutions to customers verbally as well as written proposals, rich materials and illustrations
* Work with prospective clients to define the scope and success criteria of PoC projects
* Lead various projects including Proof of Concepts, Implementations and beyond
* Manage stakeholder expectations, highlights project risks and mitigations, and lead governance meetings
* Collaborate with Forward Deployed Software Engineers, Data Strategists, Project Managers and Product for project success
* Synthesize and note client requirement for fund and investor allocation business.
* Work on various methods of calculating Management and incentive fees across complex fund structures.
* Think critically to suggest improvements to the process, which may reduce costs, drive product innovation and result in increased sales conversion
* Closely work with client developers getting them up to speed on Arcesium’s data architecture, platform overview, hands\-on training, data flow (ingress/egress) across applications

 You'll work closely with a large portfolio of SMB clients — high in volume, though individually low in ticket size — to ensure they adopt Grexa deeply, see real business outcomes, and continue growing with us through renewals, upsells and cross\-sells. * Champion the voice of the client by collecting detailed feedback and translating it into actionable insights for product and service innovation.
* Own the client journey end\-to\-end, ensuring satisfaction, expansion, and long\-term revenue growth.



  





**Requirements** 



* 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in SaaS Account Management, SMB Customer Success, or Sales roles.
* Proven experience managing a high\-volume portfolio of low ticket\-size/low AOV accounts, comfortable operating at scale rather than managing a handful of large accounts.
* Demonstrated track record of driving client renewals and retention, along with upselling and cross\-selling.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with a bias for execution and outcomes.
* Comfortable interacting directly with clients and managing multiple accounts simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and able to solve on\-ground problems in real time.
* Working knowledge of CRM systems, Excel/Google Sheets, WhatsApp APIs, and marketing or SaaS tools.
* Experience in a startup or fast\-paced environment is a strong plus.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* A high\-growth environment with real ownership from Day 1 — this role directly impacts revenue and client success.
* Work closely with founders and cross\-functional teams on meaningful client journeys and product feedback loops.

* Structured processes with the energy and agility of a startup.
* Strong mentorship, fast learning, and clear growth paths.

title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the maritime/offshore industry, with exposure to ship and MOU operations, classification requirements, and customer\-facing roles.
* Driven, goal\-oriented, and results\-focused professional with a proactive approach to achieving business objectives.

title: Account Manager - Strategic Sales
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role in a Nutshell**
 The Strategic Account Manager role is focused on owning, retaining, and expanding a defined book of strategic executive through structured farming, deep customer engagement, and long\-term value creation. This role emphasizes account growth with success driven by multi\-product expansion, renewal strength, and durable executive relationships.
   

  

 You will work with complex, global accounts within engineering\-led organizations, partnering closely with internal teams to unlock expansion opportunities across usage, teams, and product lines. This role reports to the Sales Manager.
   

  

**Desired Experience**
 We are looking for a seasoned Account Manager with a strong track record of expansion\-led revenue ownership in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environments.
   

  

* 5\-8 years of B2B SaaS experience, with 2\-3 years of experience in a farming / Account Management focused role
* Demonstrated success achieving and exceeding expansion, renewal, and net revenue retention targets
* Recent experience explicitly aligned to Account Management, Farming, Expansion, Upsell / Cross\-sell
* Willingness to work region\-aligned time zones, based on customer coverage
* Passionate about tech and SaaS; extreme customer centricity and empathy; strong desire to work in a fast\-paced, self\-directed start\-up environment
* Solid understanding of Software SaaS/ SaaS adjacent business models and a high degree of comfort and skill in selling to and engaging with technical audiences and executive\-level stakeholders.
* Global Market Experience (Preferred): Previous exposure or success in international sales and account management will be considered a significant plus.
* Bachelor’s degree required; Engineering / Technology background preferred


**What Will You Do?**
****Account Ownership, Expansion \& Lifecycle Expertise****
* Own a portfolio of strategic customers with accountability for long\-term revenue growth and retention.
* Strong understanding of upsell, cross\-sell, and renewal mechanics across multi\-product SaaS portfolios
* Proven ability to identify expansion levers using usage data, customer maturity, org structure, and business goals


**Executive \& Technical Engagement**
* Ability to engage confidently with engineering leaders, technical stakeholders, and economic buyers
* Strong grasp of SaaS business models and comfort selling into technical organizations


**Own \& Grow Strategic Accounts and Build Customer Partnerships**
* Engage customers through regular in\-person meetings, including onsite visits, to strengthen relationships and accelerate account growth
* Own a defined book of strategic accounts with full responsibility for retention, expansion, and net revenue growth
* Develop trusted relationships with technical user, and executive stakeholders


**Drive Renewal \& Retention Excellence**
* Ensure predictable renewals by reinforcing value, outcomes, and ROI ahead of contract milestones.
* Identify and mitigate renewal or contraction risks in partnership with Internal teams.


****Operate Cross\-Functionally with Rigor****
* Act as the central point of ownership across internal teams
* Maintain strong Salesforce hygiene to support forecasting and decision\-making


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents\-in\-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual \& Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life\-event leaves
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

title: VP Sales and Distribution
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Business Descriptor**
 HSBC’s Asset \& Wealth Management is primarily responsible for driving mutual fund sales through distributor networks and client relationships, while ensuring compliance and delivering market insights to advisors and investors.
   

  

 A HSBC Mutual Fund Sales Representative (often titled Sales \& Distribution, Relationship Manager, or Product Specialist in HSBC’s Asset \& Wealth Management) is primarily responsible for driving mutual fund sales through distributor networks
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Distributor \& IFA (Independent Financial Adviser(s)/) channel development: Build and manage relationships with banks, IFAs, and national distributors; expand the IFA network and deepen penetration in the assigned region.
* Sales targets \& assets under management (AUM) growth: Own quarterly/annual sales budgets, focus on AUM growth, and meet/exceed mutual fund sales targets.
* Client/advisor engagement: Present fund strategies, market views, and portfolio solutions to IFAs, relationship managers, and institutional clients; support them in client conversations and portfolio reviews.
* Training \& enablement: Conduct internal/external training sessions, product workshops, and webinars for internal teams and advisors; create sales plans around “focus funds” and campaigns.
* Market intelligence: Gather feedback from the field, share competitor and flow trends, and work with product teams to refine positioning and campaigns.
* Compliance \& documentation: Ensure all sales activities adhere to SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) /AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India) guidelines, KYC (Know Your Customer )/AML(Anti\-Money Laundering ) norms, and internal risk/compliance policies; maintain accurate records and reporting.


**Requirements**
 Experience: 5\+ years; prior experience in mutual fund distribution, wealth sales, or private banking is preferred.
   

  

 Certifications: NISM VA certification is mandatory
   

  

 Education: Graduate/postgraduate in finance, business, or related fields.
   

  

 Skills: Strong relationship management, negotiation, presentation skills; comfort with sales pipelines, Excel/CRM reporting, and basic portfolio analytics.
   

  

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.


**Note**
 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

**Eligibility Criteria**
