title: Brand Partner
description:
**Company Description** 
 Digixellence is a dynamic digital marketing and video content agency where creativity is guided by clear strategy. The team helps businesses grow in the digital space through compelling storytelling and innovative campaigns. By crafting engaging content tailored to each brand, Digixellence focuses on capturing audience attention and driving measurable results. The agency collaborates closely with clients to bring their brands to life and build long\-term impact across digital channels.
 



  




 About the Role
 
 As our
 **Brand Partner – Pune** 
 , you will be the local face of Digixellence.
 



 Your role will be to build relationships with business owners, founders and decision\-makers, identify new opportunities, develop client relationships, and establish Digixellence as a trusted digital growth partner in Pune.
 



 You will work closely with our
 **Nagpur\-based strategy and execution team** 
 , creating a bridge between the Pune market and our centralized delivery operations.
 



 Our Nagpur team will support you across:
 



**Strategy \| Social Media \| Content \| Creative \| Video \| Performance Marketing \| SEO \| Design \| Reporting \| Operations** 




 You focus on
 **building the market, relationships and business** 
 — our team supports you with the strategy and execution.
 



  




 What You’ll Be Responsible For
 
 • Building Digixellence’s presence across the Pune market
 



 • Identifying and developing new business opportunities
 



 • Building relationships with founders, business owners and decision\-makers
 



 • Generating and nurturing qualified leads
 



 • Conducting initial discussions and discovery meetings
 



 • Understanding client requirements and business challenges
 



 • Presenting relevant Digixellence solutions
 



 • Coordinating with our Nagpur team for strategies and proposals
 



 • Supporting negotiations and business closures
 



 • Managing and nurturing Pune\-based client relationships
 



 • Identifying opportunities for client growth and upselling
 



 • Building local partnerships, collaborations and networking opportunities
 



 • Coordinating on\-ground requirements such as client meetings, shoots and events
 



 • Ensuring smooth communication between Pune clients and our Nagpur team
 



  




 Who We’re Looking For
 
 We’re looking for someone with an
 **entrepreneurial mindset** 
 who wants to build something rather than simply take up another job.
 



 You could be:
 



 → A Digital Marketing Professional
 



 → A Business Development Professional
 



 → An Independent Digital Marketing Consultant
 



 → A Freelancer with an established client network
 



 → A Social Media / Marketing Professional
 



 → An Agency Owner looking to collaborate and grow
 



 → An Entrepreneur with a strong business network in Pune
 



  




 Qualifications \& Skills
 
**You should have:** 




 • Strong understanding of digital marketing and its ecosystem
 



 • Excellent communication and presentation skills
 



 • Confidence in speaking with business owners and decision\-makers
 



 • Strong relationship\-building and networking abilities
 



 • Experience in business development, sales or client acquisition
 



 • Ability to understand business requirements and identify relevant solutions
 



 • Strong client\-handling and negotiation skills
 



 • Professionalism, ownership and accountability
 



 • An entrepreneurial and growth\-oriented mindset
 



  





**Good to have:** 




 • Existing network among Pune businesses, founders or entrepreneurs
 



 • Experience working with a digital marketing agency
 



 • Existing client\-handling experience
 



 • Experience selling marketing retainers or digital services
 



 • Experience running a freelance business or agency
 



 • Good understanding of the Pune business ecosystem
   




 What You’ll Get to Build
 
 This opportunity goes beyond managing leads or handling clients.
 



 You’ll have the opportunity to
 **help build an entire market for Digixellence** 
 .
 



 With the support of our Nagpur\-based strategy and execution team, you’ll be able to focus on:
 



**Business Development → Relationships → Partnerships → Client Experience → Market Expansion** 




 As the Pune business grows, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility and build a deeper, long\-term association with Digixellence.
   




 Compensation \& Payout
 
 This is a
 **performance and partnership\-oriented opportunity** 
 .
 



 The compensation and payout structure will be discussed with shortlisted candidates
 **after the initial profile review and selection process** 
 .
 



 The final structure will be based on the candidate’s:
 



 • Relevant experience
 



 • Professional network
 



 • Business development capabilities
 



 • Scope of responsibility
 



 • Expected contribution
 



 • Overall fit with Digixellence
 



 We’re open to creating a structure that supports
 **mutual growth and long\-term value** 
 .
   




 Work Model
 
 The Brand Partner will be
 **Pune\-based** 
 and will work on a
 **hybrid model** 
 .
 



 The role will require availability for client meetings, networking, business development and other on\-ground activities whenever required.
 



 Our core strategy, creative and execution team will continue to operate from
 **Nagpur** 
 .
   




 Why Join Digixellence?
 
 You won’t be joining us simply to fill a position.
 



 You’ll be joining at an important stage of our growth and have the opportunity to:
 



 • Represent an established digital marketing agency in a new market
 



 • Build relationships with businesses and founders
 



 • Work alongside our centralized strategy and execution team
 



 • Develop the Pune market with the leadership team
 



 • Expand your professional and entrepreneurial network
 



 • Take ownership of a market and contribute directly to its growth
 



 • Build a potential long\-term partnership with Digixellence
   




 Who Should Apply?
 
 If you enjoy
 **meeting people, understanding businesses, creating opportunities and building relationships** 
 — and you’re looking for an opportunity where your contribution can directly shape a growing market — we’d like to hear from you.
 



**If you believe you can help Digixellence build a strong presence in Pune, let’s start a conversation.**

Today, we proudly serve 400\+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

**Great People \| Great Food \| Great Experience \| Greater Good**

**Are you excited to join our team as Associate Manager – Vending Operations?**

 As an
 **Associate Manager – Vending Operations** 
 at SmartQ, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing day\-to\-day vending operations to ensure service excellence, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. You will coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams, monitor machine performance and inventory, and drive continuous improvements to support business growth.
 



  





 Do you possess all these skills and wish to make an impact in the world of food and technology? Join us now!
 



  





**Roles and responsibilities:** 



* Manage end\-to\-end operations of vending machines across assigned client locations.
* Ensure high machine uptime through preventive maintenance and timely breakdown resolution.
* Oversee inventory planning, stock replenishment, and minimize stock\-outs across vending machines.
* Coordinate with warehouse, procurement, logistics, and maintenance teams for uninterrupted operations.
* Lead and manage field executives, refill staff, and service technicians to achieve operational KPIs.
* Monitor vending sales, inventory movement, machine performance, and operational dashboards.
* Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with operational SOPs, food safety, and hygiene standards.
* Resolve client escalations promptly and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.
* Track service requests and ensure SLA adherence for maintenance and issue resolution.
* Analyze sales and consumption trends to optimize product assortment and inventory levels.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives and improve operational efficiency.
* Support new machine deployments, client onboarding, and expansion projects.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management review.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, statutory requirements, and safety standards.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 2– 4 years of experience in operations management.
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Hospitality, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in vending operations, retail operations, food service, FMCG distribution, quick commerce, or facility management is preferred.
* Experience in managing field operations teams across multiple locations.
* Hands\-on experience in inventory management and vendor coordination.
* Client and stakeholder management.
* Vendor management and coordination.
* Data analysis and reporting using MS Excel.

Such a profound transformation opportunity is a rare gift, where the purpose of our enterprise transcends the ordinary. If this vision resonates with you, we invite you to join us in our mission to spread joy and happiness in a world weighed down by stress and pressure. Together, let's play our part in making this world a more beautiful place.

title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About AiSensy** 




  





 AiSensy is a
 **WhatsApp Engagement \& Marketing platform** 
 helping businesses acquire, engage, sell, and support customers on WhatsApp.
 



  





 We work with leading brands including
 **Adani, Delhi Transport Corporation, Yakult, Godrej, Aditya Birla Hindalco, Wipro, Asian Paints, India Today Group, Skullcandy, Vivo, PhysicsWallah and Cosco** 
 , along with thousands of SMBs and growing businesses.
 



 Today,
 **250,000\+ businesses** 
 use AiSensy to power their WhatsApp engagement and marketing.
 



  





 We're building products across
 **WhatsApp Marketing, Click\-to\-WhatsApp Ads, AI Agents, conversational commerce, automation and payments** 
 .
 



  





 As AiSensy continues to scale, we're looking for a
 **Key Account Manager – Enterprise Accounts** 
 to own relationships with some of our most important customers and help them get significantly more value from AiSensy.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 This isn't a typical account management role where you simply check in with customers and resolve issues.
 



  





**You will own the relationship, growth, adoption, and revenue of strategic enterprise accounts.** 




  





 You'll become the primary point of contact for key customers, understand their business goals, identify opportunities to expand their use of AiSensy, and work with internal teams to make sure they succeed.
 



  





 Your goal is to move customers from:
 



**Customer → Active Customer → Growing Customer → Strategic AiSensy Account** 




  





 You'll work closely with
 **Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, Marketing, Partnerships, and Leadership** 
 to drive customer outcomes.
 



  





 We want someone who can build strong executive relationships, understand business problems, spot expansion opportunities, and
 **take ownership until things get done.** 




  





**What You'll Own** 




**1\. Enterprise Account Ownership** 



* Own a portfolio of strategic and enterprise customers.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Understand each customer's business model, objectives, challenges, and WhatsApp strategy.
* Establish regular account review and engagement cadences.
* Build strong relationships across multiple stakeholders within each account.
* Ensure customers receive a high\-quality AiSensy experience.
* Maintain a clear understanding of account health, risks, opportunities, and next steps.



  





**2\. Account Growth \& Revenue Expansion** 




 Your responsibility doesn't end once the customer is onboarded.
 



**You will actively identify opportunities to grow the account.** 



* Identify expansion opportunities within existing enterprise accounts.
* Drive upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across AiSensy's products.
* Identify opportunities around:
* WhatsApp Marketing
* Click\-to\-WhatsApp Ads
* AI Agents
* Automation
* Conversational Commerce
* Payments
* Expand AiSensy's presence across business units, teams, products, and use cases.
* Build account\-specific growth plans.
* Work with Sales and Product teams to convert opportunities into revenue.
* Maintain a healthy expansion pipeline across assigned accounts.
* Track account revenue, usage, adoption, and expansion potential.



  





**3\. Strategic Account Planning** 




 Build a clear growth plan for every strategic account.
 



 For each customer, understand:
 



**Where are they today?** 




**What are they using AiSensy for?** 




**What are they not using yet?** 




**What business problem can we solve next?** 




**Who are the decision\-makers?** 




**What can the account become?** 



* Create account plans for key customers.
* Map stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Understand customer business priorities and upcoming initiatives.
* Identify whitespace opportunities across products and teams.
* Build quarterly and annual account growth plans.
* Track progress against account\-level objectives.
* Present account plans and growth opportunities internally.



  





**4\. Customer Engagement \& Executive Relationships** 




 Build relationships beyond the day\-to\-day user.
 


* Conduct regular business reviews with enterprise customers.
* Engage senior stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Present AiSensy solutions based on business objectives.
* Share product updates, industry insights, and relevant use cases.
* Identify opportunities to bring AiSensy leadership into strategic conversations.
* Build relationships that support long\-term retention and expansion.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally.



 The goal is to become a
 **trusted business partner** 
 , not just another vendor contact.
 



  





**5\. Product Adoption \& Customer Success** 




 Help customers get more value from AiSensy.
 


* Monitor product adoption and account usage.
* Identify underutilized products and features.
* Educate customers on new AiSensy capabilities.
* Work with Customer Success and Product teams to improve adoption.
* Identify accounts showing declining engagement or usage.
* Build action plans for at\-risk accounts.
* Ensure customer issues are followed through to resolution.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate meaningful insights to Product and Leadership.



  





**6\. Customer Growth Programs** 




 Develop structured programs to increase engagement and business outcomes across enterprise accounts.
 


* Create account\-specific growth and adoption plans.
* Identify high\-impact WhatsApp use cases.
* Share best practices and successful customer use cases.
* Help customers improve their WhatsApp marketing and engagement strategy.
* Drive adoption of new AiSensy products and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to replicate successful use cases across different teams or business units.



  





**7\. Cross\-Functional Execution** 




 Enterprise accounts require strong internal coordination.
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Sales
* Customer Success
* Product
* Customer Support
* Marketing
* Partnerships
* Engineering
* Leadership



 to ensure smooth execution across strategic accounts.
 



 You will coordinate internal teams, manage expectations, remove blockers, and ensure commitments made to customers are followed through.
 



**You own the outcome—even when multiple teams are involved.** 




  





**8\. Retention \& Account Health** 




 Own the overall health of your accounts.
 



 Monitor:
 


* Product usage
* Customer engagement
* Revenue
* Expansion
* Renewal
* Support issues
* Customer satisfaction
* Stakeholder relationships



 Identify churn risks early.
 



 Build account recovery plans where required.
 



 Work proactively rather than waiting for the customer to raise a problem.
 



  





**9\. Customer Advocacy \& Strategic Relationships** 




 Turn successful customers into long\-term AiSensy advocates.
 


* Identify customers with strong business outcomes.
* Build opportunities for:
* Case studies
* Customer testimonials
* Customer stories
* Webinars
* Events
* References

title: Brand Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Us** 




  





**Tooused** 
 powers circularity for India's leading brands, retailers, textile producers, and households.
 



  





**Tooused's** 
 vision is to divert 1 billion textiles from landfill by 2030, recycling them for a second life instead, and we’re on track to do it with India's first full\-stack textile recycling platform. This platform is setting the course for the future of the industry, connecting textile waste to responsible end\-of\-life options, meaningfully addressing the textile waste crisis, and redefining the sustainability narrative for the next generation – to one that is win\-win\-win for brands, consumers, and our planet.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 We are building
 **TakeBack** 
 for Brands. It gives a brand everything it needs to run its own take\-back programme without building any of it, including reverse logistics across the country, chain of custody on every garment, and the reporting brands will need as India's textile EPR rules take shape.
 



  





 We already have early interest from brands like NewMe, No Nasties, Mahina and Debaans. What we do not have yet is one person who owns this line end to end. That is this role.
 



  





 You will be the first commercial hire on
 **TakeBack** 
 . You will find the brands, run the pitch, close the deal, and then stay on to get the programme live with our ops and tech teams. This is not a role where you hand off after signature. At our stage, the person who sells it is the person who makes it work.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Build and run the brand pipeline, from cold outreach and events to inbound and referrals
* Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, pitch, commercials, negotiation and close
* Design each brand's take\-back programme with them, covering collection format, customer incentive, logistics flow and reporting
* Work with our ops and tech teams to launch signed brands and keep them running
* Be the brand's main point of contact after go\-live, and own renewal and expansion
* Build the pitch materials as you go, including decks, pricing models, and case studies
* Track what is and is not working in the funnel and tell us plainly
* Keep on top of EPR and textile regulation in India, and translate it into a reason for brands to act now



  





**What we are looking for** 





 This is a hands\-on commercial role with responsibility for building the pipeline, winning business, and getting programmes live.
 




  




* **2 to 5 years** 
 in B2B retail sales, partnerships, key accounts, or category management
* Background in fashion, retail, D2C, sustainability
* **Create opportunities proactively:** 
 You will research brands, identify decision\-makers, initiate outreach, and follow up consistently. The founders will support important conversations; you will own keeping opportunities moving.
* **Work towards agreed outcomes:** 
 We will set targets for qualified brand conversations, proposals, signed agreements, and programme launches. A qualified conversation should establish a relevant need, the decision\-making process, and a clear next step.
* **Keep the pipeline current:** 
 Record meaningful activity in our shared CRM or tracker by the next working day. Every active opportunity should show the contact, latest discussion, stage, next action, and follow\-up date.
* **Make progress and blockers visible:** 
 Share a weekly update covering what moved forward, what stalled, why, and what support you need. Raise risks early and recommend a next step.
* **Own delivery with the team:** 
 Confirm operational and technical feasibility before making commitments. After signature, coordinate the launch, track open issues, and keep the brand informed until they are resolved.
* **Ensure continuity:** 
 When an account changes hands or your engagement ends, provide an organised handover covering contacts, commitments, documents, pending actions, and timelines. Another team member should be able to continue the work from those records.



  





**What we are not looking for** 




  




* Someone who only wants to work warm inbound
* Someone who needs a fully built product, a fixed price list, and a finished deck on day one
* Someone who treats sustainability as a talking point rather than an operating problem



  





**Why this is worth your time** 




  





 Textile EPR is coming to India. When it lands, every mid and large apparel brand in the country will need a take\-back partner, and very few will want to build the infrastructure themselves. We already have the grid running. This role is the person who turns that into a business before the rules force everyone to catch up.
 



  





 You will report directly to the founder, and you will own the line rather than a slice of it. If it works, you build the team under it.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Fixed salary plus performance\-linked incentive on signed and launched brands. ESOPs on the table for the right person. We will talk numbers openly in the first call.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 Send your CV to hello@tooused.com with a short note on one brand you think should be running a take\-back programme in India and how you would get to them. We read those notes.

 HONO.ai is a premium HR\-Tech Solution and range of HR Services for all your requirements. HONO aims to nurture Human Relationships, propel employees’ pursuit of realizing their true potential and embrace the best of talent through a host of innovative technologies. title: Named Account Manager
description:
Adobe India is on a breakout growth trajectory and is well positioned in the South Asia region to drive exponential business growth in the next few years.
   

  

 As the Account Manager for Adobe Digital Media, you will be responsible for accelerating the growth in the assigned Named Accounts for Digital Media portfolio (Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, Adobe Sign etc.). This is very much a blend of "Farming" and “Hunting” role. You will be a seasoned sales professional who can identify strategic business opportunities in the assigned Named Accounts and work collaboratively with the ecosystem including CSM, Solution Consultants, Strategic Development Team, BDRs, ISRs, Channel partners etc. to achieve the revenue targets and growth in the accounts. This role is instrumental in contributing to a robust sales culture and requires an enterprise growth vision, confident and influential person who can develop strong business relationships across the board.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Create, maintain and execute a business plan for the assigned accounts with goals and objectives, based on opportunity, customer needs, and Adobe's strategic direction.
* Meet or exceed quota targets and increase the wallet share in the assigned account.
* Develop effective and specific account plans.
* Ability to build C Level relationships with CxOs via value\-based selling involving return on investment analysis.
* Become a trusted advisor to customers by establishing and augmenting account relationships.
* Develop customer perspective to understands each customer’s business priorities, strategic growth plans, technology strategy and the competitive landscape in the account.
* Follow a well\-adapted approach to maintaining a rolling 2Q pipeline and maintain and progress current pipe.
* Use and collaborate with business functions including Marketing, CSM, License Advisory, Inside sales, Partners and channels etc. to funnel pipeline into the assigned territory and drive growth in the assigned accounts.
* Advance and close sales opportunities \- through the successful execution of the sales strategy and roadmap.


**What you need to succeed:**
* Bachelor’s Degree and preferably an MBA from respected colleges in the country
* Minimum of 12/15 years of consultative sales experience including strategic selling, persuasion and negotiation
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience of selling software / could subscriptions to enterprise customers.
* Experience collaborating with both internal team members and external customers as a part of a solution\-based sales process.
* Demonstrated ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization.
* Strong communication skills to synthesize complex issues and communicate into simple messages
* Willingness and ability to travel within your specified geographic region


**What leading at Adobe means?**
 At Adobe, we’re passionate about developing leaders at all levels of the organization from individual contributors to people managers. Anyone who’s considering a career with us should know that we evaluate leadership based on these five capabilities:
   

  

* Demonstrating Strong EQ (Be Aware) – Having a keen sense of self awareness is the foundation of leadership at Adobe. As a leader, we look to you to inspire teams to greatness with compassion and mindfulness of your impact on others from interns to the Board of Directors. And whether you’re in headquarters, New York, London, Tokyo or Bangalore, you’re attuned to emotional, situational and cultural surroundings and adapt your approach accordingly.
* Selecting Talent (Be a Recruiter) – You’re on top of current and future talent needs as the business evolves because one of your key goals is to build high performing teams. You do so by adopting a rigorous approach to hiring superior talent and are intentionally inclusive to attract diversity of ideas and experiences.
* Role Modeling Check\-In (Be a Coach) – We don’t believe in annual reviews and rankings. That’s why, feedback flows continually at Adobe. You’re a motivational and effective coach; a leader who discusses expectations, feedback and development regularly with your direct reports. To succeed in this role, you’ll need to address performance gaps early and effectively, and be open to seeking feedback from others to improve your performance and your team’s.
* Leading Change (Be an Agent of Change) – Change leadership is what you do! You actively find opportunities to align team goals with organizational change. You’re phenomenal at building support for change because you communicate with conviction and you help those around you to see both the rational and mechanics for business changes and how to adapt accordingly.
* Scaling the Business (Be an Owner) – You’re someone who sees and understands the vision of the company. You’re able to articulate business strategy and develop business processes, systems and structures to make performance sustainable. Your mission is to deliver an exceptional customer experience by promoting shared goals and driving accountability.


**More reasons why Adobe life is the good life**
* Skip those awful “performance reviews.”
* Work in a place that cultivates great leaders throughout the organization. A place that understands that product innovation comes from people innovation.
* Feed your brain and grow your skills with our educational assistance program.
* Take off for a four\-week sabbatical after five years of employment. (As in “don’t even check your email the whole time.”)
* Give to your favorite cause each year, and we’ll match your charitable donation
* Enjoy serious discounts on the Adobe software that will make friends jealous.
* Those “best places to work” lists love us (in multiple countries).
* Put your mind at ease with our health and welfare benefits, industry\-competitive salary, and more.

 Qualifications
   

  

 Strong client\-facing and customer relationship skills.
   

  

 Proven experience in Catering Sales, Event Sales, Hospitality, or Food \& Beverage.

 Good understanding of event planning and catering requirements.
   

  

 Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and sales\-closing skills.
   

  

 Ability to build long\-term relationships with clients and event planners.
   

  

 Strong follow\-up and lead\-conversion skills.
   

  

 Good organizational and time\-management abilities.
   

  

 Basic proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and sales/CRM systems.
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Service Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Chamunda Pharma Machinery Pvt. Ltd., established in 1981, is recognized globally for quality, reliability, and service in machinery for pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, ayurveda, chemical, cosmetics, and food industries. The company offers comprehensive solutions including granulation suites and tableting lines, turnkey project solutions, containment isolator design and supply, qualification and validation, and after\-sales support and service. With a workforce of over 250 professionals, Chamunda has built a strong network in India and more than 65 countries, with over 12,000 machines successfully installed. The organization focuses on customized solutions, innovation, and customer satisfaction, aiming to build long\-term partnerships by delivering reliable, efficient machinery tailored to client needs.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Service Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad. The Service Manager will oversee after\-sales service operations, including planning and coordinating installation, commissioning, maintenance, and repair of machinery at client sites. Responsibilities include managing service teams, scheduling and prioritizing service calls, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues, and maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. The role involves collaborating with engineering, production, and sales teams to address client requirements, analyze recurring issues, and recommend improvements to service processes. The Service Manager will also prepare service reports, monitor key performance indicators, manage spare parts and resources, and ensure adherence to safety, quality, and compliance standards.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong technical skills in mechanical or electrical engineering, with experience in industrial or process machinery, preferably in pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, or related sectors.
* Candidates should possess service management and operations skills, including field service coordination, maintenance planning, troubleshooting, and after\-sales support.
* Candidates should possess leadership and team management skills, including the ability to guide service technicians, allocate resources, and foster a collaborative, safety\-focused work environment.
* Candidates should possess customer relationship and communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication, negotiation, and a customer\-centric approach to resolving issues.
* Candidates should possess organizational and analytical skills, including documentation, report preparation, data analysis, and use of service management or CRM tools.
* Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical, or related field) and prior experience in service or maintenance roles within machinery or capital equipment industries are highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on\-site at client locations as needed, willingness to travel, and familiarity with quality, safety, and regulatory standards applicable to pharma machinery are advantageous.

title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow\-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world\-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long\-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer\-centric, operationally excellent, and high\-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business\- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer\-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations\- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People\-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial \- Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock\-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation\-to\-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow\-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.

title: End User Support Engineer (L2/L3) - DWS
description:
Reference 26000HWH
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**End User Support Engineer (L2/L3\) \- Digital Workplace Services**
**Job Summary**
 The End User Support Engineer is responsible for managing, supporting, and maintaining end\-user computing infrastructure, workplace technologies, and associated services to ensure high availability, operational excellence, and exceptional user experience. The role provides Level 2 and Level 3 technical support, drives service improvements through automation and process optimization, manages printer services, coordinates with vendors, and ensures compliance with security, operational, and governance standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Profile required**
**End User Support \& Service Operations**
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for end\-user infrastructure, systems, applications, and workplace technologies.
* Install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems, authorized application software, and system management tools.
* Respond to incidents, service requests, and technical queries from users, service providers, site personnel, and external vendors.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, software, operating system, and infrastructure issues.
* Ensure timely issue resolution while meeting service level agreements (SLAs).
* Coordinate with GTS teams, infrastructure teams, and external vendors for issue resolution and service improvements.
* Maintain operational stability and ensure minimal downtime across supported environments.
* Work experience in End point device management (including laptop, Mobile device) via Microsoft Intune portal.


**Infrastructure \& System Management**
* Participate in the planning, implementation, and support of IT infrastructure and operational support systems.
* Proactively monitor and maintain systems to ensure maximum availability, performance, and reliability.
* Maintain security, backup, recovery, and redundancy strategies.
* Support endpoint management activities, including device deployment, software distribution, patch management, and compliance monitoring.
* Ensure all supported systems adhere to organizational security and compliance requirements.


**Printer Management \& Support**
* Manage and support enterprise printing services, including network printers, multifunction devices (MFDs), and print servers (HP, Canon).
* Install, configure, troubleshoot, maintain, and replace printers as required by coordinating with cross functional departments like Network (HCS) and EVS (End point team).
* Coordinate printer deployment, relocation, upgrade, and decommissioning activities.
* Troubleshoot print queues, printer drivers, connectivity issues, firmware updates, and print management applications.
* Monitor printer availability and service health to minimize business impact.
* Manage printer\-related incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.


**Vendor Coordination \& Governance**
* Act as the primary liaison between IT teams and external vendors for support services and issue resolution.
* Coordinate vendor activities for hardware replacement, break\-fix support, warranty claims, and technical escalations.
* Maintain vendor contacts, support documentation, service agreements, and escalation matrices.
* Conduct Monthly Vendor Review Meetings to discuss:
+ Open incidents and escalations
+ Service performance and SLA compliance
+ Printer service performance
+ Improvement opportunities
+ Risks and mitigation plans
+ Action item tracking and closure

* Monitor vendor performance and drive accountability against contractual obligations and service expectations.


**Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**
* Develop, document, and maintain support processes, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and reduce manual effort.
* Create and implement automation scripts, self\-heal solutions, DIY initiatives, and process improvements.
* Drive operational excellence by ensuring compliance with SOPs, governance standards, and operational KPIs.
* Contribute innovative solutions that improve productivity, service quality, and customer experience.


**Project Support**
* Support infrastructure and workplace technology projects.
* Ensure assigned project tasks are completed within agreed timelines.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to achieve project objectives successfully.


**Knowledge Management \& Team Development**
* Participate in learning and development activities covering technical, process, and behavioral competencies.
* Share knowledge and best practices with team members.
* Conduct at least two internal knowledge\-sharing sessions annually.
* Pursue relevant certifications aligned with organizational and technology requirements.


**Technical Skills Required**
**End User Computing**
* Windows 10/11 Administration
* Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint)
* Active Directory \& Azure Active Directory
* Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager
* Software Deployment \& Packaging
* Device Imaging \& Provisioning
* Endpoint Security Solutions


**Infrastructure Support**
* Hardware Troubleshooting (Desktop, Laptop, Docking Stations, Mobile Devices)
* VPN and Remote Access Support
* Basic Networking (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi)
* Patch Management
* System Monitoring Tools
* ITSM Tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira, etc.)


**Printer \& Asset Management**
* Enterprise Printer Support
* Print Server Administration
* Multifunction Device (MFD) Support
* Asset Lifecycle Management
* Warranty and Vendor Management


**Automation \& Scripting**
* PowerShell (Preferred)
* Process Automation
* Self\-Heal Script Development


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong customer service orientation
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking
* Ownership and accountability
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Ability to work under pressure and manage priorities effectively


**Education \& Experience**
**Education**
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
   

  

**Experience**
* 4 to 8\+ years of experience in End User Computing (EUC), Desktop Support, Digital Workplace Services, or IT Infrastructure Support.
* Experience managing enterprise end\-user environments, printer services, vendor coordination, and L2/L3 support operations.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Microsoft Certified Endpoint Administrator Associate
* Microsoft 365 Administrator
* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
* ITIL Foundation
* CompTIA A\+ / Network\+


**Success Criteria**
 The successful candidate will deliver stable, secure, and scalable end\-user services, maintain operational excellence, proactively drive automation and innovation, effectively manage vendor relationships and printer services, and consistently provide a best\-in\-class user experience while ensuring compliance with organizational standards and business objectives.
   

  

**Why join us**
 “We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status”
   

  

**Business insight**
 At Société Générale, we are convinced that people are drivers of change, and that the world of tomorrow will be shaped by all their initiatives, from the smallest to the most ambitious.
   

  

 Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating and taking action are part of our DNA.
   

  

 If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!
   

  

 Still hesitating?
   

  

 You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices and sharing their skills with charities. There are many ways to get involved.
   

  

 We are committed to support accelerating our Group’s ESG strategy by implementing ESG principles in all our activities and policies. They are translated in our business activity (ESG assessment, reporting, project management or IT activities), our work environment and in our responsible practices for environment protection

title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
**Opportunity Overview**
 ZeroFox seeks a Sr. IT Specialist to support a growing multinational cybersecurity company. The successful candidate will work with the corporate IT team on daily operations and long\-term IT goals, covering in\-house support, global team assistance across India and other locations, and end\-to\-end employee onboarding and offboarding.
   

  

 Role and Responsibilities
   

  

* Respond to in\-house and remote IT requests from employees via walk\-in, email, and service tickets; document all interactions in the ITSM ticketing system.
* Support the India office and global teams, handling incidents and requests across time zones.
* Resolve employee issues through cross\-departmental collaboration; stay current on software and hardware updates.
* Work with employees and IT staff to gather requirements, assess impact on existing systems, and implement solutions.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and IT documentation.
* Procure, configure, and stage devices (laptops, peripherals, mobile) fully before a new hire's first day.
* Enroll devices via MDM (e.g., Jamf, Intune, Kandji) and provision accounts through IdP platforms (e.g., Okta, Azure AD) with appropriate SSO, MFA, and access rights.
* Coordinate with HR and department leads to complete onboarding tasks on schedule for local and global hires.
* Execute offboarding procedures — account deprovisioning, device retrieval or remote wipe, and license reclamation.
* Maintain an accurate catalog of hardware assets, software licenses, and user assignments.
* Administer MDM and IdP platforms for policy configuration, compliance, and user lifecycle management across global endpoints.
* Manage ITSM tools for incident tracking, change management, and asset management.
* Perform hardware installation, configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, and repairs for computers, handheld devices, and peripherals.
* Work with the systems team to ensure applications are patched on time per security and compliance requirements.


**Required Qualifications And Skills**
* 3\+ years of IT support or similar experience.
* 1\+ years working with various hardware and software, including Apple laptops.
* Hands\-on experience with MDM platforms (Jamf Pro, Intune, or Kandji) for device enrollment, policy enforcement, and compliance.
* Proficiency with IdP solutions (Okta, Azure AD, or OneLogin) including SSO, MFA, and user lifecycle management.
* Experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Zendesk or Freshservice) for ticketing, SLA tracking, and asset management.
* Proven ability to manage IT onboarding and offboarding end\-to\-end.
* Ability to support distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and multitasking skills.
* Fluent in written and spoken English.
* Availability to work occasional evenings and weekends.


**Desired Qualifications And Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Prior experience supporting employees across India and global offices.


 Benefits
   

  

* Amazing Product: ZeroFOX has created a paradigm shifting cyber security product
* Awesome Culture: ZeroFOX is a community – most describe our team as a group of close knit, incredibly talented, and highly caffeinated people. All are encouraged and required to incorporate innovative ideas and prototypes into our product. Suggestions around streamlining communication, development practices and operations are welcomed
* Get Things Done: Innovation is woven into the fabric of our organization. Every aspect of our operations is purposeful; enabling us to research, develop and innovate faster than the competition
* Benefits: Competitive compensation and benefits package available

title: Support Engineer 1
description:
**Job Description**
 Serves as a point of contact for customers, fielding inquiries via phone or electronic channels. Provides technical support by troubleshooting and resolving simple issues encountered with assigned Oracle product(s). Coordinates with more experienced peers to report and support the resolution of routine design, reliability, and maintenance issues. Maintains service request and/or product documentation and learns to create Knowledge Base articles and/or troubleshooting guides for resolving issues. Provides assistance to internal teams and stakeholders on diverse customer situations and technical issues. Learns to leverage automation/tooling (e.g., A.I. Assistance) to discover root causes of common issues and begins to identify potential enhancements to existing support processes, workflows, guidelines, and best practices.

title: Technical Analyst – Cloud Infrastructure
description:
Shape the future of work in complex industries.
   

  

 At Falkor, we help some of the world's most complex industries operate with greater clarity, confidence, and control.
   

  

 Built on more than 200 years of KONGSBERG industrial heritage, our industrial intelligence platform connects people, systems, and workflows across energy, processing, power, renewables, and other heavy\-asset industries.
   

  

 We turn complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance across the asset lifecycle.
   

  

 As industries evolve, we're building the technology that helps people see further, decide faster, and operate with confidence.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Technical Analyst – Cloud Infrastructure to join the Customer Support team. This hands\-on support role is suited to a professional with approximately 3\+ years of experience in cloud operations, technical support, or infrastructure support.
   

  

 The successful candidate will support customers with onboarding, troubleshooting, and the reliable operation of cloud\-based services. This role will work closely with Customer Support colleagues and collaborate with Cloud Architects, Solution Architects, Engineering, Product, and Delivery/Customer Success teams as escalation and delivery partners.
   

  

**What You’ll Do** 
 –
   

  

**Customer Support and Cloud Operations**
* Monitor, support, and troubleshoot cloud\-based services across Microsoft Azure and related platforms.
* Support incident response, service restoration, root cause analysis, and follow\-up activities.
* Use dashboards, logs, alerts, and runbooks to identify issues, validate service health, and support customer\-facing operations.
* Maintain accurate handover notes, operational documentation, and support records.


**Customer Enablement and Delivery Support**
* Partner with Cloud and Solution Architects to support effective customer onboarding and delivery execution.
* Assist customers by troubleshooting platform usage issues, onboarding queries, and initial implementation or integration steps.
* Serve as a technical liaison between customers and internal teams to ensure issues are clearly understood and resolved efficiently.
* Contribute to improved customer experience, customer satisfaction, and delivery confidence.


**SLA Management and Support Operations**
* Ensure support requests are managed in accordance with defined SLAs, severity levels, and operational processes.
* Provide customers with timely updates, clear communication, and effective resolution for critical incidents.
* Follow SOPs for ticket prioritization, incident response, escalation workflows, and customer communication.
* Maintain operational discipline to ensure support workflows remain reliable, predictable, and scalable.


**Technical Troubleshooting and Escalation**
* Support Kubernetes\-based cloud services through basic health checks, deployment validation, and first\-level troubleshooting.
* Troubleshoot common issues related to access, configuration, connectivity, workload failures, resource utilization, logs, and monitoring alerts.
* Hands on experience on Grafana, GitOps, no\-SQL DB’s, CI/CD tools, service mesh concepts and hybrid infrastructure.
* Escalate defects, feature gaps, or complex platform issues with clear context, reproduction steps, logs, and diagnostics.


**Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement**
* Develop and maintain troubleshooting guides, support playbooks, root cause summaries, and customer\-facing explanations.
* Identify recurring issue patterns and recommend improvements to reduce repeat incidents.
* Collaborate with Support, Engineering, Product, and Delivery/Customer Success teams to strengthen product quality and internal troubleshooting capability.


**Shift\-Based Support Coverage**
* Provide cloud support coverage as part of a planned shift roster.
* Work rotational shifts in alignment with Customer Support coverage requirements and business needs. Indicative shift timings include 5:00 AM–2:00 PM, 12:00 PM–9:00 PM, and 8:00 PM–5:00 AM.
* Provide weekend coverage when assigned, ensuring timely handovers and continuity of service.


**What We're Looking For**
* Approximately 3\+ years of experience in cloud support, infrastructure operations, platform support, or a related technical support role.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and foundational exposure to Kubernetes, containers, or cloud\-native services.
* Sound understanding of incident management, monitoring and operational support processes.
* Hands on experience on full\-stack observability platforms like Grafana (including but not limited to querying logs, metrics, traces, setting up dashboards \& alerts).

description:

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required
* Willingness to travel as required

description:

 At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935\. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50\+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
   

  

**DEM (Digital Experience Management) Analyst**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* The DEM Analyst is responsible for proactively analysing the digital experience of end users and identifying potential areas for improvement within End User Experience Management technologies, such as Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack, and Aternity, as part of the End User Analytics Services that Fujitsu provides to our customers.
* As the DEM Analyst, you will focus on analysing the digital experience scores on a proactive basis and providing reports to account team stakeholders on the key issues that are causing drops in digital experience and recommendations for improvement areas.
* You will also conduct deeper investigations with support from relevant resolver groups, utilizing the DEM tool and other key service performance data, such as ticket analysis, to understand the breadth and impact of the issue.
* You will oversee the implementation of any new requirements from improvement recommendations and are responsible for reporting the status and benefits of these improvements.
* Continuous learning is an important part of this role and you will be expected to participate in learning sessions and reading facilitated by our vendor partners or the Centre of Excellence (aka DEM Dojo) use cases and best practices.
* It is expected that the role owner will have a close relationship with the Digital Advisor and the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead.
* The Digital Advisor is an additional advisory role who is deployed on a project\-basis that will be responsible for defining and shaping the digital experience score and XLAs and will also identify the first set of improvement opportunities and recommendations.
* You will be expected to continue the work of the Digital Advisor once the service is in a steady state and work through the improvement backlog or identify new opportunity areas.
* This continuation also includes working closely with the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead to create a complete picture of user experience, with your focus being on technology\-level experience and the DA \& UX Lead focusing on service\-level experience.
* The DA \& UX Lead will be a key stakeholder in providing requirements for any use cases that involved contact with end users. You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery
* Demonstrate good interpersonal skills, diplomacy in dealing with customers and internal teams Good experience of at least one DEM technology (Aternity, Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack), including supporting the utilization of the technology for tangible benefit
* Certification in at least on DEM technology to an analyst level Experience in 2nd line support and triaging issues to 3rd line resolver groups Experience in problem or incident management, with a good understanding of how the end user impact of technology issues Ideally, a good understanding of other automation technologies, such as Resolve and RPA


**Mandatory Skills**
 Nexthink, PowerShell Script Developer, Windows 10, 11 OS Knowledge.
   

  

 Relocation Supported: No
   

  

 Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Helpdesk Engineer
description:
**Summary:** 
 This role involves providing hands\-on L1/L2 IT support to users, enhancing the existing Helpdesk team. The primary goal is to ensure efficient technical support while maintaining system security and operational excellence.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities:**
* Provide first and second\-level technical support to end\-users, resolving hardware, software, and network\-related incidents and requests.
* Utilize ServiceNow as the primary ticketing system for incident and service request management, ensuring accurate and timely documentation, prioritization, and resolution.
* Administer and support mobile device management solutions, including AirWatch, for the deployment, configuration, and security of corporate mobile devices.
* Leverage Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) for software deployment, patch management, operating system deployment, and inventory management of end\-user devices.
* Assist in identifying and remediating security vulnerabilities on end\-user devices and associated infrastructure, adhering to established security policies and procedures.
* Coordinate and execute IT\-related aspects of office moves, new employee onboarding, and equipment changes, ensuring seamless transitions.
* Provide remote IT support and ensure the functionality of IT infrastructure in regional and satellite offices.
* Offer on\-site and remote IT support for company events, ensuring the reliable operation of AV equipment, network connectivity, and other IT resources.


**Key Requirements:**
* Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and endpoint management.
* Experience with ServiceNow or a similar ITSM/ticketing platform.
* Experience with asset and inventory management.
* Exposure to Windows migration, patch management, and vulnerability remediation.


**Nice to Have:**
* Experience with mobile device management solutions.
* Familiarity with IT compliance regulations.
* Knowledge of IT security best practices.


**Other Details:**
* Contract Duration: 6 Months
* Shift Timing: 6\.30 am to 3\.30 pm and 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Friday.
* Work Environment: Requires working from the office.

description:

* General knowledge of SolidWorks CAD platforms.
* Experience delivering and supporting IIS Web Sites, logs, and servers; familiarity with log viewers, monitoring, and app pools.
* Proficiency in report and dashboard generation.
* Experience in IT Service Management (incident, request, change) with ServiceNow.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills; ability to work with cross\-functional teams.

* Experience integrating PLM with ERP/CRM ecosystems.
