title: Manager, Membership – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As the
 **Manager, Membership – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)** 
 , you will lead the execution, governance, and continuous improvement of U.S. Membership operations supporting Amgen's commercial contracting and market access organization. You will oversee customer eligibility, GPO alignments, customer onboarding, membership maintenance, contract alignment, customer master data governance, 340B/PHS eligibility management, rebate and pricing\-related customer support, and operational controls.
   

  

 Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with Membership SMEs, Market Access, Contracting, Pricing, Government Pricing, Customer Operations, Finance, Information Systems, MDM teams, wholesalers, GPOs, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready execution of Membership operations. You will lead a team of Associates and Senior Associates while supporting transition, capability building, stakeholder engagement, and operational excellence across the Membership function.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
*Membership Operations Leadership*
* Lead end\-to\-end Membership operations including customer onboarding, eligibility validation, customer setup, system alignment, ongoing maintenance, reporting, and closeout activities.
* Ensure execution of activities within established SLAs, quality standards, operational controls, and compliance requirements.
* Oversee intake and triage activities for membership requests, declaration forms (DEC), roster updates, customer changes, and contract alignment activities.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues impacting customer eligibility, membership alignment, customer setup, and stakeholder satisfaction.


*Customer Eligibility \& Membership Governance*
* Lead governance of customer eligibility determinations, GPO participation validation, class\-of\-trade assessments, contract alignment reviews, and membership approvals.
* Oversee validation activities involving DEA, HIN, HIBCC, HRSA, OneKey, customer identifiers, legal entity hierarchies, and parent\-child relationships.
* Review and approve complex customer setup requests, hierarchy modifications, contract eligibility decisions, and compliance\-sensitive customer updates.
* Govern customer additions, drops, strategy changes, acquisitions, organizational restructures, and customer maintenance requests.


*Customer Master Data \& System Governance*
* Oversee customer setup and maintenance activities across HCM, GCPS, SAP, MDM, OneKey, and related commercial operations platforms.
* Ensure timely creation and maintenance of customer records, legal entity hierarchies, customer attributes, contract affiliations, and GPO alignments.
* Partner with MDM and Information Systems teams to resolve customer data issues, interface failures, hierarchy challenges, and system synchronization problems.
* Support UAT activities, system enhancements, process automation initiatives, and technology transformation efforts.


*Rebuttal, Escalations \& Exception Management*
* Lead customer eligibility dispute investigations, denial reviews, rebuttal activities, and exception resolution processes.
* Provide decision support and recommendations for disputed customer eligibility determinations involving GPOs, wholesalers, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure complete documentation, audit trails, business rationale, and stakeholder communications supporting membership decisions.
* Drive resolution of complex operational issues impacting pricing access, membership alignments, customer eligibility, rebates, chargebacks, and contract execution.


*340B, PHS \& Specialized Membership Programs*
* Oversee quarterly Public Health Service (PHS) and 340B eligibility maintenance activities, including OPA file reviews, customer additions, removals, and eligibility updates.
* Ensure timely maintenance of SAP flags, CPOCOT assignments, customer eligibility statuses, and contract alignments supporting 340B participation.
* Govern controls supporting wholesaler notifications, eligibility reporting, and system synchronization activities.
* Provide oversight for VA, Kaiser, OBU, IBU, Specialty Pharmacy, Hospital Coalition, , and other specialized Membership programs.


*Reporting, Analytics \& Continuous Improvement*
* Own Membership KPI reporting, SLA reporting, operational dashboards, management reporting, customer eligibility reporting, and ad hoc analytical requests.
* Lead trend analysis, root cause investigations, workload assessments, dispute reviews, and operational health monitoring.
* Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, reporting enhancements, and productivity initiatives.
* Support special projects, business initiatives, system implementations, and transformation efforts.


*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*
* Support special projects, business initiatives, system implementations, and transformation efforts.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation supporting customer eligibility determinations, approvals, setup activities, roster updates, and membership decisions.
* Support SOX testing, internal audits, compliance reviews, and control monitoring activities.
* Proactively identify and mitigate operational, financial, compliance, and data quality risks.


*People Leadership, Transition \& Capability Building*
* Lead, coach, and develop Membership Associates and Senior Associates within AIN.
* Establish performance expectations, quality standards, career development plans, and capability development frameworks.
* Support hiring, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and workforce planning activities.
* Partner with ATO SMEs to establish SOPs, training plans, readiness criteria, governance models, and transition plans supporting migration of Membership activities into AIN.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is an experienced pharmaceutical commercial operations leader with expertise in customer eligibility, membership operations, contract administration, master data governance, market access operations, and stakeholder management. The individual should possess strong leadership, analytical, problem\-solving, and change\-management skills, with the ability to lead teams in a highly regulated environment.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in business administration, Finance, Commerce, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
* 8 to 12 years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial operations, Membership operations, Market Access, Customer Master Data, Managed Markets, Contracts \& Pricing, Revenue Management, or related business functions.
* 2\+ years of people leadership, project leadership, or process ownership experience.
* Strong analytical, operational, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in regulated environments with controls, governance, and compliance requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep understanding of U.S. pharmaceutical customer eligibility, GPO operations, customer master data management, Market Access, and Membership governance.
* Experience with GCPS, HCM, SAP, Model N, OneKey, HIBCC, HRSA/OPA, Tableau, Power BI, and related commercial operations systems.
* Knowledge of 340B, PHS, Hospital Coalition, Specialty Pharmacy, VA, Kaiser, OBU, IBU, customer onboarding, and eligibility processes.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting audits, SOX controls, governance programs, and operational transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading global delivery teams, transition programs, and capability\-building initiatives.
* Strong leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills.

title: USA Properties Business Manager
description:
**PRIME DEVELOPERS US** 




*Job Description* 




**Property Business Manager** 




*(Based at Hyderabad Office, India \| Managing One US Commercial Property)* 




**Company** 





 Prime Developers – Texas\-based commercial real estate developer/owner\-operator (est. 2017\), managing retail, flex, and office plaza properties across Austin, Cedar Park, Leander, and Lewisville, TX.
 




**Location** 





 Hyderabad Office, India – in\-office role
 




**Scope** 





 One assigned US commercial property
 




**Reports To** 





 Company Leadership / Ownership
 




**Direct Reports** 





 On\-site Property Manager and ground staff at the assigned property
 




**Work Hours** 





 Overlap with US business hours (Central Time) required
 




**Reporting Cadence** 





 Regular reports to leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance
 




**About Prime Developers** 





 Prime Developers has offered real estate development and investment services since 2017, specializing in iconic commercial and residential properties across the Texas market. The company owns and operates a growing portfolio of multi\-tenant retail, flex, and office plazas, and is actively acquiring additional commercial spaces — creating an expanding need for hands\-on, accountable operational oversight across the portfolio.
 




**Role Overview** 





 Prime Developers is looking for a Property Business Manager, based at the company's Hyderabad office, to take full ownership of the day\-to\-day wellbeing, performance, and growth of one assigned US commercial property. This is not a ground\-up development role — the focus is on operating, maintaining, and growing an established building/commercial space after acquisition or completion.
 





 The person in this role will act as the single point of accountability for the assigned property, directing and coordinating an on\-site Property Manager and ground staff based in the US, while personally owning leasing/bookings, maintenance oversight, marketing, accounting coordination, and overall growth of the asset. Regular reports will be shared with leadership on occupancy, maintenance, and financial performance.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Own the end\-to\-end performance of the assigned commercial property — treat it like a business unit with full accountability for its upkeep and growth.
 



 • Exercise decision\-making authority on growth\-oriented initiatives for the property — leasing terms, budget allocation, capex, vendor contracts — and be able to justify each decision with clear financial and operational reasoning.
 **(This will discuss with client)** 




 • Direct and coordinate the on\-site Property Manager and ground staff (maintenance, leasing/front\-desk, vendors) from the Hyderabad office.
 



 • Oversee bookings, leasing, and occupancy — track vacancies, tenant renewals, and new leasing opportunities to maximize occupancy and revenue.
 



 • Manage maintenance operations — schedule repairs and preventive maintenance, track work orders, and ensure ground staff/vendors resolve issues promptly.
 



 • Coordinate accounting and financial oversight — track rent collection, operating expenses, budgets, and P\&L for each property in partnership with accounting/finance resources.
 **(If Applicable)** 




 • Drive marketing and growth initiatives — improve property visibility, tenant mix, and occupancy through marketing efforts and local partnerships.
 



 • Manage vendor and contractor relationships — sourcing, negotiating, and overseeing US\-based vendors for repairs, landscaping, security, and other services.
 **(Client Decision)** 




 • Ensure compliance with US property regulations, local codes, licensing, and insurance requirements applicable to each property.
 **(If applicable/required)** 




 • Provide regular reporting to leadership on occupancy, financial performance, maintenance status, and growth initiatives for the property.
 



 • Be ready to take on additional properties and support onboarding/operational setup as the company's portfolio grows.
 



**Requirements** 




 • MBA in Finance (or equivalent) with 2–3 years of relevant experience, including a demonstrated track record of making business/financial decisions and justifying them with sound reasoning and data.
 



 • Prior experience in property management, facilities management, or commercial real estate operations (US market experience strongly preferred but not mandate).
 



 • Demonstrated ability to manage a team remotely and hold on\-site staff accountable without being physically present at the property.
 



 • Working knowledge of leasing/occupancy management, basic accounting/P\&L, and vendor management.
 



 • Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable working significant overlap with US business hours.
 



 • Familiarity with property management or leasing software (e.g., AppFolio, Buildium, or similar) is a plus.
 **(These are software’s recommended but its client decision)** 



* • Highly organized, ownership\-driven mindset — comfortable being the accountable owner of an asset's outcomes rather than just a coordinator.

 We are planning to establish a PET and plastic recycling plant in Hyderabad and are seeking an
 



 experienced Project Head to take complete ownership of the project from concept to
 



 commercial operations.

 design, machinery selection, construction, installation, commissioning, recruitment, feedstock
 



 sourcing, customer development and ongoing plant operations.

  Prepare the detailed project report, business plan, budget and implementation schedule.

  Establish customers for recycled flakes, pellets and other finished products.
 



  Recruit and train the production, maintenance, quality, EHS and administrative teams.

 Environmental Engineering.

 recycling plant.

 pelletizing, utilities and wastewater treatment.
 



  Experience handling capex, vendor negotiations, statutory coordination and project
 



 teams.
 



  Willingness to work regularly from the project site in Hyderabad.
 



 Candidates should submit their resume with details of the recycling plants they have
 



 established, including capacity, products, project budget, timeline, machinery suppliers, exact
 



 responsibilities and operational results.

title: Manager R&D
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Laboratory Setting, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)
   

  

**About Company:**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO) is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $45 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. While our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our global distributed team delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.
   

  

 DESCRIPTION:
   

  

 As Manager, R\&D, you will lead a focused and diverse SPCI Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) team, driving cost optimization, project execution, continuous improvement. You will collaborate with global and cross\-functional partners to build a strong pipeline of VAVE initiatives and deliver measurable business impact.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the SPCI VAVE team and drive the strategy, development, and execution of cost\-out initiatives across programs.
* Deliver \~$5M or more in annual cost savings while developing and maintaining a strong \~$10M\+ cost\-out pipeline to support the following year’s savings commitments.
* Drive execution excellence by coordinating cross\-functional project teams, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule while maintaining or improving product quality.
* Generate and develop cost\-out opportunities using structured ideation and analysis techniques, including product cost analysis, should\-costing, costed BOM analysis, site material\-spend analysis, product teardown, competitive benchmarking, and VAVE methodologies.
* Engage effectively with global partners and stakeholders, communicate progress, highlight risks and opportunities, and proactively seek support when required.
* Provide leadership, supervision, and coordination across project management and engineering design activities for VAVE projects as part of the programs.
* Partners with project leaders to identify and address project risks early, establish clear mitigation plans, and remove barriers to successful execution.
* Collaborate closely to develop robust Design Verification Plans (DVPs) supporting project implementation.
* Identify process gaps and establish standard work and PPI systems to strengthen execution and drive continuous improvement. Apply PPI and Lean methodologies and support PPI, Keys, and Lean initiatives.
* Develop and execute the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), including effective management of resources and project expenses.
* Establish and maintain the team's proficiency matrix and resource\-loading plans to ensure the right capabilities and capacity are available to meet program priorities.
* Mentor, coach, and develop team members, providing guidance and opportunities that support their continued professional and technical growth.
* Perform all responsibilities in alignment with the Code of Ethics, Diversity \& Inclusion principles, and the 4\-I Values.


**Required Qualifications, Skills And Competencies**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 10\+ years of engineering experience (8\+ years with a Master’s degree), with strong experience in sustenance engineering and Cost\-Out/VAVE project execution.
* 3\+ years of leadership and multi\-project management experience, including management of programs with \~25\+ concurrent projects.
* Proven track record of delivering approximately $5M\+ in cost savings and building and managing a significant Cost\-Out/VAVE pipeline.
* Strong expertise in VAVE and product cost optimization, with hands\-on experience in product cost analysis, should\-costing, costed BOM analysis, material\-spend analysis, product teardown, and competitive benchmarking.
* Proficiency in stage\-gate and technical review processes, with experience driving projects through key engineering and business milestones.
* Strong program management skills, including planning, prioritization, execution, risk management, resource allocation, and delivery against commitments.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution excellence across multiple cross\-functional initiatives, delivering projects on schedule while maintaining or improving product quality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical, business, and leadership audiences.
* Strong people leadership and talent development skills, including mentoring, coaching, capability development, resource planning, and performance management.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to support identification of root causes and drive effective solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications, Skills And Competencies**
* Master’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; MBA is an added advantage.
* Proven ability to lead strategic, cross\-functional initiatives and translate strategy into actionable plans and measurable results.
* Strong knowledge and practical application of PPI, Lean, and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
* Working knowledge of regulatory requirements, product certifications, and applicable engineering standards, preferably in a regulated product development environment.
* Ability to operate effectively in a global matrix organization, build strong cross\-functional relationships, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Ability to interpret complex simulation, experimental, and engineering data and translate insights into sound technical and business decisions.

 \- Post Graduate (MBA's / Masters) degree in Finance or Business Administration
   

  

 Certifications if any \- Any certification related to research is preferred, but not mandatory
   

  

**Experience Range**

**Foundational Skills** 
 \*
   

  

* Hands\-on experience of Industry/Market level databases such as Gartner, Wood Mackenzie, IDC, BMI, EMIS, Frost \& Sullivan, Euromonitor, SNL, Nielsen, etc.

 Data Infrastructure \& Strategic Initiatives team is responsible for all the automation aspects of testing processes, ensuring quality of data and independent testing of corporate \& business level process and regulatory controls by providing seamless access to the appropriate data \& platforms required to execute the associated portfolio of tests.
   

  

 A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as “An independent point\-in\-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre\-defined pass/fail criteria.” Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite. Please note: This is not an application/software testing or application/software development role.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an SME, drive sustainable automation in EIT (Enterprise Independent Testing) test design, development, and implementation using a modern infrastructure and thoughtfully\-designed solutions. Additionally, train/mentor the Test Automation team and help with creating dashboards for the reporting purposes.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with key stakeholders across the Bank to understand modeling and testing business processes and requirements
* Perform debugging and code reviews to ensure quality of code.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**IT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Senior Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and scale the Zero Trust Security Portfolio across EY GDS. This role will be responsible for leading complex client programs, building high\-performing teams, and driving innovation across Infrastructure Security capabilities.
   

  

 The Senior Manager will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, helping organizations transition from traditional security to Zero Trust Security. The role requires deep experience in cybersecurity architecture, network security, and zero trust security in cyber.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise \& cloud environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in zero\-trust and micro\-segmentation solutions including Zscaler, Guardicore and Illumio.
* Define logical patterns \& develop use cases for zero trust capabilities across Network, Identity \& Access Management, Device, Application and other security domains
* Work in multiple domains of security technologies viz Network segmentation, Application gateways, security automation, Firewalls, VPN, SDN, SD\-WAN, IAM solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Good exposure in requirement understanding, security frameworks, technical documentation, designing HLDs and LLDs.
* Well\-versed in encrypting all end\-to\-end communication regardless of the location, authorizing access to resources on a per\-session basis, enforcing the temporary and dynamic nature of authentication and authorization.
* Monitoring all assets to be in the most secure state possible and maintaining visibility into the security of the entire network and business's resources.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of zero trust market needs/challenges and assist in the planning, design and development of go\-to\-market solutions.
* Understand SaaS based technologies and identity\-based micro\-segmentation for cloud workloads and their implications for the enterprise.
* Document or enhance documentation on zero\-trust architecture requirements.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s Zero Trust, Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of experience across Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Expertise in Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (NIST 800\-207, NIST 800\-53, ZT DoD, CISA ZTMM).
* Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.
* Deep technical understanding of zero trust architecture and solutioning of zero trust security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for zero trust security including governance and operating models.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem\-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Engage with CISOs, CIOs, plant leadership, OT operations teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager Shared Services
description:
Manager – Quality Audit (Order to Cash
   

  

**Job Title: Manager – Quality Audit (Order to Cash)**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Manager – Quality Audit to lead the Quality Management Framework for Order to Cash (OTC) operations across Billing, Cash Application, Collections, and Dispute Resolution. This role will be accountable for designing and sustaining a disciplined, repeatable, and data\-driven audit program that improves operational accuracy, strengthens internal controls, and connects quality outcomes to measurable business performance. The Manager will collaborate closely with vendor partners and cross\-functional stakeholders to define requirements, co\-build audit solutions, and drive successful deployment of audit workflows, risk\-based sampling, defect management, RCA/CAPA processes, and quality performance reporting across OTC operations. The role will also establish globally aligned audit standards, governance routines, and calibration practices to ensure consistency, transparency, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will combine strong OTC process expertise, audit and controls knowledge, leadership capability, and a proven ability to convert quality insights into sustained operational improvement and service excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Management Framework Leadership:** 
 Lead the end\-to\-end quality audit program for OTC processes and define enterprise standards for audit execution, governance, and continuous improvement across regions and teams.
   

  

**Audit Strategy \& Execution:** 
 Design and run transaction\-level audits across Billing, Cash Application, Collections, and Dispute Resolution using approved scorecards, evidence requirements, and quality dimensions such as SOP adherence, documentation, approvals, coding accuracy, outcome quality, and closure/completion.
   

  

**Sampling Methodology:** 
 Establish and maintain risk\-informed sampling methodologies by process and subprocess, with clear rules for ramp\-up, stabilization, and run\-rate operations; increase sample rates based on repeat defects, declining quality trends, new transitions, or elevated business risk.
   

  

**Error Taxonomy \& Calibration:** 
 Standardize critical and non\-critical error definitions, promote consistent scoring through calibration sessions, and resolve audit disputes through fact\-based review and governance escalation when needed.
   

  

**Defect Management, RCA \& CAPA:** 
 Own the defect management process, including centralized defect logging, trend analysis, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, containment, effectiveness validation, and closure discipline.
   

  

**Governance, Controls \& Compliance:** 
 Strengthen governance by ensuring adherence to internal controls, audit standards, SOX/statutory requirements, and approved operating procedures. Support control documentation, audit readiness, and remediation tracking in partnership with internal and external audit stakeholders.
   

  

**Performance Reporting \& Business Insight:** 
 Develop and socialize scorecards, dashboards, and management reporting that provide visibility to audit pass rates, defect trends, critical error rates, rework, first\-time\-right, process accuracy, CAPA closure, and links to business outcomes such as customer experience, revenue protection, working capital, and SLA performance.
   

  

**Stakeholder Management:** 
 Act as the primary quality contact for operations leaders, process owners, transition teams, and cross\-functional partners. Facilitate daily quality huddles, weekly calibrations, and monthly quality and operations reviews to drive issue resolution and decision\-making.
   

  

**Continuous Improvement \& Automation:** 
 Identify recurring pain points and conversion opportunities for SOP updates, job aids, training refresh, control redesign, and automation of sampling, audit execution, defect tracking, and reporting. Champion use of digital tools and analytics to improve audit efficiency and traceability.
   

  

**Team Leadership \& Capability Building:** 
 Recruit, coach, and develop quality analysts or auditors; set performance expectations; create capability plans; and build a prevention\-led quality culture that drives accountability, consistency, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Transition \& Stabilization Support:** 
 Provide quality oversight for migrations, scope expansions, and process changes by validating readiness criteria, reviewing documentation, increasing audit coverage where appropriate, and ensuring a controlled handoff to steady\-state operations.
   

  

**Customer and Business Outcome Focus:** 
 Ensure audit findings are translated into meaningful operational actions that reduce escalations, improve service quality, protect cash flow, reduce revenue leakage, and strengthen overall OTC health.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.
   

  

 8–10 years of progressive experience in Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, Finance Shared Services, Quality Audit, Controls, or Operational Excellence roles.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience across key OTC sub\-processes such as Billing, Cash Application, Collections, Dispute Resolution, and AR reporting or reconciliations. Working with
   

  

 3\+ years of people leadership or matrix leadership experience in a shared services, GBS, BPO, or complex operations environment.
   

  

 Experience designing or managing audit frameworks, scorecards, sampling plans, defect management, and RCA/CAPA processes.
   

  

 Strong familiarity with internal controls, SOX or compliance requirements, and process documentation standards.
   

  

**Certifications**
 Preferred: CPA, CA, CIA, CISA, Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, Lean, or equivalent quality / audit certification. Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), PMP, Quality Management certifications, or other finance controls / continuous improvement credentials.
   

  

**General Accountabilities And Job Information**
 This role typically operates in a global or regional shared services environment and may require collaboration across time zones and functional boundaries.
   

  

 Success in this role is measured through sustained improvements in audit accuracy, reduction in repeat defects and rework, stronger compliance adherence, improved governance effectiveness, and demonstrable impact to OTC business outcomes. Strong coaching and people\-development capability with a track record of building high\-performing, quality\-focused teams.

 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.

 Our Company

title: Financial Inclusion District Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vedavaag Systems Ltd is a technology\-driven company headquartered in India, focusing on innovative solutions that support governance, financial services, and inclusive growth. The organization works closely with public and private sector partners to extend essential services to underserved and rural communities. Vedavaag Systems Ltd emphasizes operational efficiency, customer\-centric service delivery, and sustainable models that promote financial inclusion. The company offers opportunities for professionals interested in social impact, technology\-enabled service delivery, and expanding access to financial services across diverse regions in India.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Financial Inclusion District Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Telangana, India. This role oversees district\-level financial inclusion initiatives, including planning, implementing, and monitoring programs that extend banking and financial services to underserved communities. The person in this role will manage field teams, coordinate with partner banks and agencies, track performance against outreach and service targets, and ensure compliance with relevant policies and guidelines. Daily responsibilities include reviewing operational reports, resolving escalated issues, conducting site visits, facilitating community engagement activities, and ensuring quality customer service and data accuracy. The District Manager will also promote inclusive practices, support training and capacity building for staff, and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and service delivery.

**Job Description**
**Assistant Manager / Manager \- OTC Settlement \& Collateral**
**Office Location \- Mumbai, Airoli**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced professional to join our Capital Markets Operations team as an Assistant Manager / Manager.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for end\-to\-end OTC Derivatives Operations, including trade lifecycle management, pre and post\-settlement activities, Nostro reconciliations, collateral management, margin call processing, dispute resolution, and corporate actions. The ideal candidate should possess strong operational expertise, stakeholder management skills, and hands\-on experience in driving automation initiatives using AI, Agentic Bots, and Intelligent Process Automation solutions.
   

  

**OTC Operations \& Settlement**
* Manage end\-to\-end OTC trade lifecycle processes across various asset classes including FX, Equities, Rates, and Credit Derivatives.
* Oversee pre\-settlement and post\-settlement activities, ensuring timely and accurate settlement of trades.
* Investigate and resolve settlement failures, breaks, and operational discrepancies.

* Investigate reconciliation breaks and coordinate with counterparties, custodians, and internal stakeholders for timely resolution.
* Ensure aging items are minimized and tracked through closure.
* Prepare MIS and reconciliation metrics for management review.


**Collateral Management \& Margin Operations**
* Manage collateral allocation, optimization, substitutions, and collateral movements.
* Oversee daily variation margin, initial margin, and regulatory margin calculations.
* Process and validate margin calls with counterparties.
* Ensure compliance with ISDA, CSA, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor collateral exposures and mitigate settlement and counterparty risks.


**Dispute Management**
* Investigate and resolve margin and valuation disputes with counterparties.
* Track dispute aging and implement root cause analysis to prevent recurring issues.

title: Global Command Center Operations Senior Manager
description:
**About NCR Atleos**
 NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Global Command Center Operations Manager is responsible for leading the 24x7 Global Command Center responsible for monitoring, event correlation, incident response, escalation coordination, operational communications, and service reliability across critical infrastructure, applications, networks, job scheduling, and telephony services. This role provides operational leadership for geographically distributed teams and ensures that Command Center functions consistently meet availability, resiliency, compliance, and service management expectations.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a hands\-on, metrics\-driven operations leader with strong ITIL/ITSM discipline, deep infrastructure operations awareness, and the ability to translate technical events into clear executive\-level business impact. This leader will drive process maturity, automation, alert quality, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement across global operations while maintaining a high\-accountability and service\-focused team culture.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
 Operational Leadership and Service Reliability
   

  

* Lead day\-to\-day and shift\-based 24x7 Global Command Center operations across monitoring, triage, escalation, incident communications, and operational coordination.
* Oversee functional coverage for server operations monitoring, network operations monitoring, application operations monitoring, lab operations monitoring, Helix/Control\-M job scheduling, Windows and Linux L2 support, and Genesys/IP telephony operations.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs, OLAs, uptime expectations, alert response targets, escalation procedures, and operational performance metrics.
* Drive proactive monitoring, event correlation, alert tuning, runbook quality, and automation to reduce noise, improve response times, and minimize manual intervention.
* Maintain operational readiness for high\-severity events, business\-impacting incidents, planned maintenance windows, and critical change activity.


 Incident, Problem, and Change Management
   

  

* Lead Command Center participation in major incidents by coordinating bridge engagement, ensuring role clarity, maintaining focus on service restoration, and escalating to appropriate technical and leadership teams.
* Partner with Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, infrastructure, application, security, and vendor teams to support fast restoration and durable corrective actions.
* Review incident trends, recurring alerts, failed jobs, chronic infrastructure events, and escalation patterns to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support post\-incident reviews, root cause analysis, known error documentation, corrective/preventive action tracking, and lessons\-learned adoption.
* Ensure Command Center teams follow approved change, incident, problem, access, and communication processes.


 Governance, Compliance, and Audit Readiness
   

  

* Create, maintain, and enforce SOPs, technical runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, operational checklists, and process documentation.
* Ensure operational evidence is complete, accurate, timely, and defensible for internal reviews, SOX audits, control testing, and regulatory inquiries.
* Partner with security, risk, compliance, and technology owners to ensure adherence to enterprise standards, access protocols, and data protection expectations.
* Establish governance routines to review operational metrics, control gaps, aged actions, process exceptions, and continuous improvement progress.


 Team Leadership and Talent Development
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a globally distributed team of team leads, engineers, analysts, and operations specialists across multiple shifts and domains.
* Own staffing plans, shift coverage, onboarding, training, performance expectations, development plans, succession planning, and quality accountability.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, operational discipline, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with site leadership to monitor team engagement, morale, readiness, skill gaps, escalation behaviors, and adherence to operational standards.


 Metrics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define, monitor, and report operational KPIs including availability, SLA adherence, alert volume, alert aging, MTTA/MTTR, escalation effectiveness, incident recurrence, job failure trends, change\-related incidents, and runbook compliance.
* Prepare concise executive\-level updates on operational health, incident trends, risk areas, improvement plans, staffing readiness, and service reliability.
* Use data to identify systemic issues, automation opportunities, process bottlenecks, and training needs.
* Partner with tool owners and engineering teams to improve dashboards, observability, event correlation, workflow automation, and operational intelligence.


 Vendor and Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Manage vendor engagement related to operations tools, monitoring platforms, job scheduling, infrastructure services, telecom platforms, and support escalations.
* Hold vendors and internal service teams accountable for service delivery, timely escalation, issue ownership, and contractual/service commitments.
* Serve as an operational bridge between senior leadership, infrastructure teams, application teams, security, service management, vendors, and site leadership.
* Support budget planning, resource planning, capacity needs, tool rationalization, and operational investment recommendations.


**Skill Requirements/Preferences**
 Required Skills and Experience
   

  

* 12\+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure operations, technology operations, command center, NOC/SOC/AOC, service management, or related enterprise technology functions.
* 8\+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers, team leads, engineers, analysts, or shift\-based operational teams in a 24x7 environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing global or multi\-site operations with cross\-functional responsibility for service reliability, monitoring, incident response, escalation, and executive communication.
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, major incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, and service level management.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, alerting, ITSM, and job scheduling platforms such as ServiceNow, Helix, Control\-M, SolarWinds, Grafana, Splunk, Nagios, Zabbix, Datadog, AppDynamics, or equivalent tools.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server operations, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, network fundamentals, firewalls, VPNs, SD\-WAN, DNS/DHCP, telephony/VoIP, and application operations monitoring.
* Experience creating operational dashboards, performance reporting, service health reviews, incident trend analysis, and continuous improvement plans.
* Experience supporting audit, compliance, access control, SOX, control evidence, policy adherence, and operational governance processes.
* Strong vendor management, escalation management, service accountability, and stakeholder communication capabilities.


**Preferred Technical Skills**
* Experience with hybrid cloud environments including Azure, Oracle Cloud, AWS, VMware vSphere, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience improving event management through alert rationalization, event correlation, automation, AIOps, or runbook orchestration.
* Familiarity with resiliency practices including disaster recovery, business continuity, capacity planning, lifecycle management, backup/recovery, high availability, and operational risk reduction.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation concepts using PowerShell, Python, Bash, API integrations, workflow automation, or infrastructure\-as\-code concepts.
* Experience leading transformation efforts that modernize command center operations, reduce toil, improve service health visibility, or improve incident response maturity.


 SOME OF THE SOFT SKILLS / ABILITIES REQUIRED FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE INCLUDE
   

  

* Calm, composed leadership during high\-pressure, business\-impacting incidents.
* Clear, concise, and audience\-appropriate communication for executives, technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to command and control incident bridges while maintaining accountability, urgency, and respectful collaboration.
* Strong judgment, prioritization, and decision\-making when managing competing business, technical, and operational demands.
* Ability to translate technical issues into business impact, risk, service health, and actionable leadership updates.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build trust, develop team leads, provide feedback, and reinforce standard work.
* High ownership and follow\-through across open actions, recurring issues, audit items, staffing needs, and operational risks.
* Process discipline with the ability to standardize work, reduce ambiguity, document expectations, and drive consistent execution.
* Strong analytical capability with a focus on metrics, trend analysis, root cause thinking, and measurable improvement.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority and create alignment across geographically distributed stakeholders.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, global, shift\-based environment where priorities may change quickly.


**Additional Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL 4 Foundation, ITIL Managing Professional, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, CISSP, CISM, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Linux, Cisco, VMware, ServiceNow, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience leading a global command center, NOC, SOC, AOC, infrastructure operations center, managed services operations, or enterprise service reliability function.
* Experience building or maturing operating models, RACI matrices, escalation frameworks, QA programs, knowledge management practices, or operational control points.
* Experience with financial services, payments, ATM, retail banking, regulated infrastructure, or other high\-availability customer\-impacting technology environments.
* Experience supporting business continuity, disaster recovery exercises, command center readiness testing, crisis management, or operational resilience programs.
* Experience managing cross\-cultural teams, offshore/onshore delivery models, and vendor\-supported services.


**Education Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Technology, or a related discipline required, or equivalent combination of education and progressive enterprise IT operations experience.
* Master’s degree in Information Systems, Technology Management, Business Administration, or related discipline preferred.
* Relevant professional certifications may be considered in combination with demonstrated leadership and enterprise technology operations experience.


 WORK ENVIRONMENT AND EXPECTATIONS
   

  

* Full\-time role based in Mumbai, India with expectation to work from the office five days per week unless otherwise approved by leadership.
* Must be able to support a 24x7 global operations model, including rotational schedules, after\-hours escalations, planned maintenance windows, and major incident response as business needs require.
* Must be comfortable working with global stakeholders across multiple time zones and supporting business\-critical technology services.

title: Equity Swaps Corporate Actions (Prime Services)-Manager
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****
 We are seeking an experienced Officer‑level professional for our Equity Swaps Corporate Actions team, responsible for overseeing and executing day‑to‑day BAU processing for Equity Swaps in line with the operating model, internal SLAs, and control frameworks.
   

  

 The role sits within State Street Markets Operations’ Financing Solutions business, supporting the Prime Services Equity Swaps product. The Officer will act as a key point of escalation and subject matter expert, partnering closely with Trading, Swap Operations, Stock Loan, Custody, and Risk teams to manage mandatory and voluntary events, restrictions, and lifecycle processing in a controlled, audit‑ready environment. Corporate actions on equity swaps represent a high‑risk, high‑complexity operational area where errors can directly impact P\&L, client outcomes, and regulatory posture. As an Officer, this role plays a critical part in safeguarding economic neutrality, ensuring accurate processing outcomes, and reinforcing a strong control and escalation framework across synthetic and hedge books.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets which is transforming our operating model that provides support to sales and trading desks across all regions EMEA, APAC and North America 24/6\. Since synthetic market access is growing globally, Prime Services are expanding their product offering to include Equity Swaps. Clients take advantage of a range of financing solutions, from memo\-pledge and self\-financing to self\-borrow and repledge. Our Secured financing solution offers accessibility to cash investment and financing outlets for a wide range of institutional participants. State Street is one of the largest agent’s lenders in the world, with over 40 years of experience and more than 250clients across multiple global markets. Our depth of lendable assets and strong market position provides more trading opportunities When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSGM business unit. Join us to make your mark in the capital markets industry.
   

  

****What You Will Be Responsible For****
 As Equity Swaps Corporate Actions (Prime Services)\-Manager, you will:
   

  

* Oversee and perform processing of mandatory and voluntary corporate actions and dividend events impacting Equity Swaps portfolios.
* Manage and review event lifecycle activities including event capture, entitlement calculation, election processing, and settlement of cash and stock outcomes.
* Act as an escalation point for complex or time‑sensitive voluntary corporate action elections, providing guidance and decision support as required.
* Ensure accurate booking and alignment of corporate action adjustments across swap and custody accounts.
* Review, investigate, and resolve breaks related to positions, entitlements, or cash flows, determining root cause and appropriate remediation.
* Oversee execution of daily, event‑based, and periodic controls, ensuring adherence to documented procedures and control standards.
* Escalate material issues, control gaps, or processing risks in line with governance and escalation frameworks.
* Provide support and guidance to Senior Associates on complex processing, investigations, and control execution.
* Liaise with internal teams including Swap Operations, Trading, Stock Loan, and Custody to resolve issues and manage event impacts.
* Support responses to internal and external queries related to swap‑linked corporate actions and income events.


****What We Value****
* These skills will help you succeed in this role
* Strong technical understanding of corporate actions and asset servicing within an Equity Swaps or Prime Services environment.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment in managing risk, prioritizing issues, and determining when escalation is required.
* Strong reconciliation, investigative, and problem‑solving skills.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure, especially around critical market deadlines.
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time‑management skills.


****What You Will Bring To The Role****
* Strong front‑to‑back understanding of Equity Swap Operations processes, lifecycle events, and interactions between synthetic and physical positions.
* Hands‑on experience supporting front‑office exception management, middle‑office systems, and downstream settlement / payment processes.

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 GCOR Trade Surveillance team monitors firm’s trading activity from a market abuse/market manipulation perspective. Global trade surveillance activities are designed to adhere to financial services laws, rules and regulations to determine whether key controls are operating as intended and are effective in terms of mitigating compliance risk (e.g. compliance policy, standard or procedure). Continuous surveillance of business activities is performed through automated systems (SMARTS, Actimize etc.) and filters. Surveillance is also performed through patterns and trends analysis, and manual reviews.
   

  

 This team in GCOR Trade surveillance will work very closely with the APAC Regional Trade Suverillance teams to conduct surevillance efforts on fixed income and equities
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Individuals will be part of the Trade Surveillance group supporting one of the global regions AMRS, EMEA and APR. Individual will be responsible for monitoring trading activities across multiple asset classes for market abuse and manipulation. The individuals will also be responsible for investigating potential compliance/control room issues with multiple levels of management for appropriate disposition
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Perform trade surveillance on restricted and watch listed securities.
* Obtain deal updates (from Investment Bankers) – when needed for watch list reviews.
* Conduct trade surveillance to monitor market abuse across asset classes (equity, fixed income and derivatives trading).
* Monitor trading activity using various exceptions based reports.
* Liaising with upper management, preparing and presenting monthly reviews to senior management.
* Working closely with the Line of Business (LOB) to understand the process and managing LOB process expectations.
* Managing day to day process requirements.
* Managing employee conflict.
* Conducting employee performance discussions.
* Analyze T\+1 trading data on trade surveillance platforms for potential compliance issues.
* Investigate potential compliance issues with management and document findings.
* Work with the global compliance teams to document findings.
* Analyze and organize data, identifying any trends in a timely manner.
* Maintain accurate, organized and current compliance records and documentation in a manner consistent with the department’s needs.
* Participate in the Parameter Review process for the Trade Surveillance models.
* Enables smooth migrations of work to GBS from onshore and maintaining/creating LOB confidence for the GBS team.
* Conducting LOB/GBS Executive presentations, including routine and monthly connects.
* Understand end to end Internal Controls and broader Global Business Services functions to ensure adherence to enterprise standards and reporting requirements.
* Train and set up a strong, fungible /Cross trained pool of resources within the GBS Trade Surveillance team


**Requirements\***
* Education\* Postgraduate in any field. Certifications If Any


**Experience Range\***
* 10\-13 years


**Foundational skills\***
* Experience in capital markets operations with a thorough understanding of trade life cycle and surveillance functions
* Strong capital market knowledge
* Working knowledge of derivative products
* Strong analytical, interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills
* Excel skills and attention to detail
* Strong English written and verbal communication skills
* Experience in working with Surveillance applications like Actimize, SMARTS.
* Ability to work in a high\-energy and dynamic environment.
* Ability to multi\-task, assist in critical items/projects and those that require extensive research, while independently prioritizing his/her workload
* Ability to analyze large sets of data to develop and present executive level reporting
* Experience in operating on a global scale, across multiple functions/regions and with multiple stakeholder

description:
**Role Summary** 




**Eze Perfumes** 

 is looking for a data\-obsessed, results\-driven
 
**Marketplace Growth Manager** 

 to join our Mumbai\-based global operations team. Your primary mission is to own the P\&L and scale our brand presence across major
 
**US marketplaces** 

 , with a primary focus on
 
**Amazon (FBA)** 

 and
 
**Walmart (WFS)** 

 .
 





 This role requires a unique individual who can sit in Mumbai but think like a US consumer. You will be responsible for the entire marketplace lifecycle—from strategic inventory planning and cross\-border logistics to high\-performance PPC advertising and AI\-driven listing optimization. You will act as the "CEO" of our US marketplace channels, ensuring Sawai’s heritage\-rich fragrances become a household name in the North American market.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Strategy \& P\&L Ownership** 



* **Revenue Accountability:** 

 Own the end\-to\-end P\&L for US marketplaces, including top\-line revenue, contribution margins, and platform\-specific fees.
* **GTM Execution:** 

 Develop and execute the Go\-To\-Market strategy for new product launches in the US, ensuring optimal pricing, positioning, and initial review velocity.
* **Growth Roadmaps:** 

 Build monthly and quarterly growth plans that balance aggressive customer acquisition with sustainable profitability.



**2\. Amazon \& Walmart Channel Mastery** 



* **Listing Excellence:** 

 Own the creation and optimization of SEO\-rich product listings, including titles, bullet points, and backend keywords tailored specifically to US search intent.
* **A\+ Content \& Storefronts:** 

 Work with the content team to ensure Amazon A\+ content and Brand Stores reflect a premium, luxury fragrance aesthetic.
* **Account Health:** 

 Monitor and maintain "Gold Standard" account health metrics, managing IPI scores, buyer\-seller messaging, and compliance with platform policies.



**3\. High\-Performance Advertising (PPC)** 



* **Campaign Management:** 

 Direct and optimize Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display ads to maintain a target ACOS/TACOS.
* **Competitor Conquesting:** 

 Implement aggressive keyword\-bidding strategies to capture market share from competitors in the premium fragrance and essential oil categories.
* **DSP \& External Traffic:** 

 Explore and manage Amazon DSP or external traffic drivers (Social to Amazon) to boost ranking and BSR.



**4\. Cross\-Border Logistics \& Inventory Planning** 



* **Demand Forecasting:** 

 Coordinate with the Mumbai and Silvassa teams to forecast US demand, ensuring stock is manufactured and shipped in time to avoid stockouts.
* **FBA/WFS Management:** 

 Manage shipments from India to US 3PLs or Amazon/Walmart fulfilment centers.
* **Efficiency:** 

 Optimize "Inventory Age" and minimize storage fees through strategic liquidation or promotional pulses.



**5\. AI\-Driven Operations** 



* **Automation:** 

 Implement AI tools for automated keyword research, sentiment analysis of customer reviews, and competitive price monitoring.
* **Content Scaling:** 

 Use LLMs to rapidly iterate on ad copy, A/B test listing titles, and automate routine reporting tasks.
* **Sentiment Analysis:** 

 Leverage AI to decode "Voice of Customer" data from reviews to inform the R\&D team in India for future product iterations.



**Technical Proficiencies \& Tools** 



* **Marketplace Core:** 

 Amazon Seller Central and Ads (Expert), Walmart Seller Center, eBay.
* **Analytics \& Research:** 

 Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Viral Launch.
* **Advertising Tech:** 

 Amazon Advertising Console, Pacvue, or Perpetua.
* **AI Stack:** 

 ChatGPT/Claude (for SEO \& Copy), Midjourney (for creative ideation), and Excel/Google Sheets (Advanced formulas \& Pivot Tables).
* **Operations:** 

 Experience with ERPs and cross\-border shipping documentation (ShipStation, etc.).



**Core Strengths** 



* **The "Global\-Local" Mindset:** 

 Ability to translate Indian manufacturing excellence into a brand voice that resonates with US luxury buyers.
* **Analytical Rigor:** 

 You don’t make guesses; you make data\-backed decisions based on click\-through rates, conversion rates, and session data.
* **Agility:** 

 The US marketplace landscape changes weekly (algorithm updates, fee changes); you must be able to pivot strategy instantly.



**The Ideal Fit** 



* You have a proven track record of managing a $1M\+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) portfolio on Amazon US.
* You are comfortable working hours that overlap with the US East Coast/West Coast to coordinate with partners and monitor live sales events (e.g., Prime Day).
* You have a passion for the fragrance/beauty industry and understand the nuances of selling "scent" through a digital screen.



**How to Apply** 





 If you are ready to take a heritage Indian brand to the global stage, send your resume and a summary of your biggest marketplace "win" to
 
**hr@incredibleindriya.com** 

 .
 




**Eze Perfumes** 

 is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate the intersection of Indian craftsmanship and global digital commerce.

 Why join The Leela?

 : Be part of a team that is dedicated to providing the highest standards of service and hospitality.
* **Innovative Environment** 
 : Be part of a team that encourages creativity and innovation, ensuring that we stay at the forefront of luxury hospitality.

 : Benefit from our strong pipeline of future projects and opportunities for career advancement within The Leela and our global alliances.
* **Cultural Experiences** 
 : Engage with the rich cultural tapestry of India, bringing unique and authentic experiences to our discerning guests.



  





 Position Overview
 



**Reporting to: Vice President \- Procurement** 




**Location:** 
 The Leela Corporate Office, Mumbai
 



 The Manager / Senior Manager – Procurement \& Contracts (Civil) will be responsible for managing procurement and contracting activities related to civil and interior works across project developments. This role involves leading the procurement lifecycle for construction packages, evaluating technical and commercial requirements, managing contract finalization, and ensuring adherence to contractual, regulatory, and project requirements.
 



  





 The incumbent will work closely with project teams, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to support the successful delivery of project procurement objectives. The role requires strong expertise in contract management, commercial negotiations, technical evaluation of civil and interior packages, and a thorough understanding of construction industry practices and standards.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Procurement \& Contract Finalization** 



* Lead procurement and contract finalization activities for moderate\-value civil and interior work packages.
* Manage sourcing, bid evaluation, commercial discussions, and award recommendations for project\-related procurement requirements.

* Support the preparation, negotiation, execution, and administration of contracts.

**Technical Evaluation \& Commercial Assessment**

**Contract Administration**

**Compliance \& Industry Standards**

* Support risk identification and mitigation throughout the procurement process.



**Market Intelligence \& Industry Awareness**

* Monitor market developments to support informed procurement decisions.
* Identify opportunities to improve procurement effectiveness through industry best practices and innovation.
* Provide market insights and recommendations that support project procurement requirements.



**Stakeholder Collaboration** 



* Work closely with project teams, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders throughout the procurement lifecycle.
* Coordinate with multiple functions involved in project procurement and contracting activities.
* Support smooth execution of procurement activities by facilitating effective communication among stakeholders.
* Contribute to the successful achievement of project timelines and procurement objectives.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* Graduate in Civil Engineering.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Degree or Diploma in Management.
* PMP Certification.
* Post Graduate Specialization.



**Experience** 



* Approximately 6 to 8 years of relevant experience within the real estate industry.
* Experience working on reputed construction projects with responsibility for procurement and contracting activities.

**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 



* Procurement and contracting of civil and interior work packages.

* Management of contract variations, claims, NT items, and disputes.
* Knowledge of safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

**Core Competencies**

* Contract Management
* Technical Evaluation
* Commercial Negotiation
* BOQ Analysis
* Contract Administration
* Risk Assessment
* Regulatory Compliance

* Stakeholder Management

**Success Indicators**

**Personal Attributes**

title: Consulting Project Management
description:

Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs.

We take pride in embodying Microsoft's mission of empowerment, promoting a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and fostering a culture of inclusivity where everyone is encouraged to share their unique perspectives and be their authentic selves. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to life\-changing innovations that impact billions of people worldwide.

 In addition, the CPM is directly accountable on the program execution, escalations, stakeholder management and financial profitability of the program, leading the project team members, and collaborating with cross\-functional units to deliver impactful outcomes to our customers.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Accountabilities:
   

  

* Portfolio Delivery \& Governance


 Own end‑to‑end delivery health across a portfolio of ISD consulting projects within INDIA.
   

  

 Establish and enforce standard delivery governance, including Project health reporting, Customer and internal Steering Committees, Executive escalations and corrective actions. Proactively identify systemic delivery risks and drive early intervention across projects.
   

  

* Financial \& Commercial Accountability


 Accountable for portfolio‑level financial performance, including forecast accuracy, cost control, and margin protection.
   

  

 Partner with CPMs to manage Sub‑contractor and partner costs, Scope, change control, and delivery‑driven financial risks, and ensure clean project closure and financial hygiene. Act as a trusted partner to Finance and Delivery Leadership on delivery‑related financial matters.
   

  

* Customer \& Stakeholder Leadership


 Act as a escalation point for complex delivery challenges and at‑risk engagements. Lead customer conversations related to Delivery recovery, Governance reset, Confidence and trust restoration. Partner with EOU and Architects to ensure delivery remains aligned to customer outcomes and value realization.
   

  

* Expansion \& Consumption


 Enable consistent account expansion motion, ensuring delivery insights translate into business opportunities. Ensure project team identify expansion signals through delivery milestones and customer rhythms
   

  

 Execute disciplined handoffs to CSAMs / Sellers using ISD processes and tools. Reinforce a delivery‑led growth mindset across the INDIA portfolio.
   

  

* Cross‑Functional Collaboration


 Internal: ISD Leadership, GCID, EAG, ABS, CSAMs, Architects, Sales, Finance, Partner Management
   

  

 External: Customer sponsors and executives, delivery partners, system integrators
   

  

**Success Measures**
 Predictable portfolio delivery outcomes;
   

  

 Improved financial health and forecast accuracy;
   

  

 Strong customer satisfaction and delivery confidence;
   

  

 Increased maturity and consistency of CPM practices;
   

  

 Tangible Expansion Opportunity contributions and Adoption enabled through delivery excellence (Job1/2/Usage Excellence)
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications (RQs)
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in related field AND 8\+ years of experience in customer‑facing consulting delivery, program/project management, or digital transformation, including responsibility for complex, multi‑workstream engagements;
* 2\+ years of experience managing multiple projects or a delivery portfolio, with accountability for delivery outcomes beyond a single engagement;
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and development of project/program managers or equivalent roles;
* Proven ability to operate in a matrixed, cross‑functional environment, partnering effectively with Sales, Engineering, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders;


**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**
* 10\+ years of experience in consulting, large‑scale delivery transformation, or enterprise program leadership, preferably across multiple customers or geographies.
* Experience managing delivery financials, including forecasting, cost control, margin protection, and project closure discipline, and partner / subcontractor management across different markets.
* Experience enabling delivery‑led growth outcomes, such as identifying expansion signals, partnering on opportunity handoffs, or supporting pipeline creation through delivery insights.

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. description:
