title: Manager - Customer Technical Service, India
description:
**Roquette** 
 is a family\-owned global leader in plant\-based ingredients and a leading provider of pharmaceutical excipients.
   

  

**Want to help us make a difference?**
 Using plant\-based resources, we collaborate with our customers and partners to imagine and offer ingredients to better feed people and treat patients.
   

  

 Each of our ingredients responds to unique and essential needs, and they enable healthier lifestyles.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Team Leader – Food Application Scientist** 
 to lead our India Application (CTS) Laboratory and drive technical innovation across Savory, Baking, Dairy, Beverage, Confectionery, and Plant\-Based applications. This role combines strong people leadership with hands\-on application development, customer engagement, and cross\-functional collaboration to support business growth and innovation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a seasoned food scientist with deep technical expertise, strong commercial acumen, and proven experience leading high\-performing teams in an international food ingredients environment.
   

  

 This position will be located in
 **Mumbai.**
**Our Team**
 Drawing insights from customer interactions, our CTS team develops, formulates, and evaluates our customers' products in the labs.
   

  

 As the markets we serve at Roquette are Global, the CTS teams are globally based to better serve our customers around 4 areas (Europe, Americas, Greater Asia \& China).
   

  

 The CTS team builds strong partnerships with our Global R\&D, as well as our commercial and marketing teams, to enhance customer service and support.
   

  

**Their mission?**
 To support the NBI’s business growth for Greater Asia region focusing on India with application work in the Dairy, Beverage and Confectionery Area. In addition to that, to support the technical development role India for local customers and channel partners.
   

  

**Your Experience And Talents Will Make The Difference To**
**Team Leadership \& Application Excellence**
* Lead and develop the India Food Application (CTS) team, fostering a high\-performance and collaborative culture.
* Ensure timely and effective technical support for customer projects involving both new product development and existing ingredient portfolios.
* Prioritize application projects in partnership with Commercial and Marketing teams to support strategic business objectives.
* Coach and mentor team members, supporting their technical and professional development.
* Promote a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and scientific excellence.


**Customer \& Technical Support**
* Provide expert application support to customers across Dairy, Beverage, Confectionery, Savory, Baking and Plant\-Based Nutrition segments.
* Visit customers regularly to support product development, technical discussions, troubleshooting, training programs, and innovation workshops.
* Collaborate with channel partners on customer visits, product concepts, technical training, promotional campaigns, and business opportunity development.
* Deliver technical presentations, seminars, and application training for internal and external stakeholders.
* Together with Marketing team, coordinate, plan and execute promotional events like trade shows, customer seminars and webinars.


**Product Development \& Innovation**
* Provide strategic technical leadership in identifying, evaluating, and translating new ingredient technologies into commercially viable food applications for the Indian market. Develop innovation roadmaps and recommend product development strategies based on market insights, customer needs, competitive analysis, and technical feasibility.
* Lead the development and evaluation of innovative food and beverage applications, including:
+ Savory – sauces, dressing, meat, non\-meat
+ Baking – snacks, cereals, cakes etc
+ Dairy products
+ Plant\-based alternatives
+ Specialized nutrition
+ Ready\-to\-drink beverages
+ Ready\-to\-mix powders
+ Yogurt
+ Paneer
+ Confectionery applications

* Design, execute, and evaluate laboratory and pilot\-scale trials using a scientific approach.
* Conduct shelf\-life studies, analytical testing, and performance evaluations of application prototypes.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of laboratory activities, trial results, reports, and technical presentations while supporting innovation and intellectual property initiatives.


**Laboratory Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure laboratory operations comply with company safety, food safety, quality, and regulatory standards.
* Develop, implement, and continuously improve laboratory SOPs, processes, and best practices.
* Maintain laboratory equipment and support efficient day\-to\-day laboratory operations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance laboratory efficiency and effectiveness.


**Collaboration \& Global Connectivity**
* Partner closely with Commercial, Marketing, Quality, R\&D, and Global Food CTS teams to deliver customer\-focused solutions.
* Collaborate with global CTS teams to share technical knowledge, best practices, and support cross\-regional projects.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and market trends through participation in technical forums and industry events.


**Additional Key Responsibilities – Laboratory Setup \& Infrastructure Management**
* Lead the planning, setup, expansion, and continuous enhancement of food application laboratories in line with business and innovation requirements.
* Define laboratory infrastructure requirements, including utilities, workflow design, food safety, hygiene, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate, recommend, and procure laboratory and pilot\-scale equipment based on application needs, technical specifications, budget, and long\-term business objectives.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Procurement, EHS, and Quality teams during laboratory design, commissioning, equipment installation, qualification, and validation.
* Develop equipment qualification, calibration, preventive maintenance, and lifecycle management plans to ensure reliable laboratory operations.
* Ensure laboratory facilities comply with food safety, regulatory, and company standards while driving continuous improvement in laboratory capabilities.


**What We Will Love About You**
* Strong business and commercial acumen with a customer\-centric mindset.
* Deep understanding of the Indian food ingredients and food applications market.
* Excellent technical knowledge of Savory, Baking, Dairy and Beverage applications.
* Strong influencing, stakeholder management, and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Outstanding presentation, communication, and technical training skills.
* Proven leadership capability with experience mentoring, coaching, and developing technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with experience working in multicultural and cross\-functional teams.
* Passion for innovation and delivering customer\-focused solutions.


 And also …
   

  

* Master's or Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Dairy Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 20 years of experience in Food Application, Product Development, or Technical Service within the food ingredients industry.
* At least 10 years of hands\-on experience in Savory, Baking Dairy and Beverage applications.
* Experience in Plant\-Based Nutrition and Specialized Nutrition is highly desirable.
* Minimum 10 years of people management experience, leading technical or application teams.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects within a multinational or international organization.
* Demonstrated customer engagement, technical problem\-solving, and innovation capabilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across cultures.


**Why Join Us?**
 This is an opportunity to lead a high\-impact technical team, shape customer innovation, and contribute to the development of next\-generation food solutions while collaborating with global experts in a dynamic international environment.
   

  

**If you identify yourself in this position, please apply by uploading your resume and let's start the journey together!**
 Roquette is proud to be a global company where you can find personal and professional growth through multiple diverse experiences.
   

  

 Roquette strives to create a dynamic workforce while remaining firmly committed to equal opportunity by complying with EEO laws.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, Roquette understands that to be successful we must always be inclusive in our approach.
   

  

 To find out more about our products, values and sustainable development ambitions visit us at www.roquette.com and at www.sustainability.roquette.com

 Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and help clients improve cross\-border trade operations through Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) solutions. This role focuses on leading end\-to\-end GTM programs, including solution design, compliance controls, integrations, and governance. You will help translate global trade policy into scalable Oracle GTM configurations, workflows, and operating processes that support compliant and efficient trade execution. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, compliance, and business transformation in a complex global environment.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior, Tax Services on the Oracle Global Trade Management (GTM) team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Own the Oracle GTM workstream across discovery, design, build, test, deploy, and hypercare, and manage day\-to\-day priorities, dependencies, delivery quality, scope, RAID, estimates, and status reporting.
* Define end\-to\-end trade architecture across Oracle GTM and connected enterprise systems, and translate policy and regulatory requirements into enforceable controls, workflows, and audit\-ready traceability.
* Lead Oracle GTM solution design and oversight across restricted party screening, sanctions and export controls, classification, origin, valuation, license management, free trade agreement and preference programs, documentation, landed cost, and exception handling.
* Lead integration design, trade master data governance, reconciliation, monitoring, and control evidence across ERP, OMS, WMS, TMS, PIM, PLM, and external providers.
* Own testing strategy, user acceptance testing, cutover planning, hypercare, training materials, operating model design, governance cadence, and KPI alignment.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Oracle and global trade transformation teams help organizations improve trade compliance, customs readiness, and cross\-border operations through technology\-enabled solutions. The team works across compliance, supply chain, finance, legal, and technology stakeholders to design scalable operating models, controls, and integrations that support accuracy, efficiency, and auditability. Professionals in this area support complex transformation programs involving Oracle GTM, connected enterprise platforms, data governance, and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 8\-12\+ years of experience in global trade or compliance technology delivery, including 3\-6\+ years in Oracle Global Trade Management implementation leadership.
* Experience leading at least one full lifecycle Oracle Global Trade Management implementation or major transformation.
* Experience with restricted party screening, sanctions or embargo controls, import or export compliance, export controls, Harmonized System or Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification, country of origin, valuation, licensing controls, or free trade agreement and preference concepts.
* Experience translating legal or compliance policy into system rules, workflows, and measurable controls.
* Experience with estimates, RAID management, quality gates, and executive\-ready status communication.
* Experience with integration design across APIs, flat files, middleware, mapping, error handling, monitoring, and reconciliation.
* Experience leading data migration, data conversion, and validation activities.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Working knowledge of Oracle ERP, supply chain management, Oracle Transportation Management, or Oracle Integration Cloud.
* SQL or data analysis capability.
* Experience with broker or filing provider integrations and customs data handoff patterns.
* Experience building global templates with localized compliance extensions.
* Experience supporting audit requirements, control evidence, and traceability.
* Prior consulting lead experience across multi\-client or multi\-program delivery.


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

title: Independent Director
description:
More choice can disguise duplication, poor differentiation and trapped working capital. The Director will challenge the architecture of categories, opening price points, premium ladders, private labels and seasonal ranges. Management should demonstrate which customer missions each range serves, how products earn space online and in stores, and when a slow\-moving item will be marked down, returned, repurposed or exited.
 



  





 Board reporting must connect assortment breadth with availability, margin, inventory age, fulfilment complexity and customer satisfaction. Revenue growth that depends on proliferating low\-productivity stock\-keeping units should be recognised early.
 



  





 Items used for cooking, storage and household organisation can create safety, durability and disclosure obligations. The Director will examine supplier qualification, material declarations, product testing, labelling, complaint investigation, batch traceability and recall readiness. Private\-label ambition must be matched by clear ownership of specification and quality—not delegated informally to the supplier.
 



  





 When an adverse signal appears, the Board needs a decision process that protects customers before legal certainty is complete. The appointee will ask whether marketplace sellers, imported ranges and exclusive products are governed to comparable standards.
 



  





 The Director will help the Board look beyond gross billing to realised margin after discount, funding, payment cost, fulfilment, returns, damage, loyalty benefits and clearance. Supplier rebates and promotional support should be recognised only when the underlying conditions are evidenced. Channel teams must not shift inventory or cost between stores, digital operations and marketplaces to make one route appear successful.
 



  





 The Board will expect the appointee to probe price integrity, personalised offers, dark patterns, misleading scarcity messages and the fairness of refund or exchange practices.
 



  





 An omnichannel promise depends on accurate location\-level stock, dependable reservation and a rational fulfilment decision. The Director will oversee management’s response to phantom inventory, cancelled orders, split shipments, store\-pick failures, shrinkage and reverse\-logistics leakage. Investment proposals for automation, distribution capacity or new stores should be tested against demand density and the full cost to serve.
 



  





 The appointee will insist on decision\-ready store economics: mature versus ramp\-up performance, occupancy burden, local catchment, cannibalisation, labour productivity, omnichannel contribution and exit costs. Lease commitments need downside cases and explicit approval limits. A flagship’s strategic value may be real, but it must be articulated and reviewed rather than used indefinitely to excuse poor economics.
 



  





 Loyalty and personalisation can improve relevance, but they also create privacy, consent and security duties. The Director will question what data is collected, why it is retained, how models shape offers, and whether customers can exercise meaningful choice. Technology partners, payment providers, delivery networks and marketplace channels should be subject to risk\-based oversight and incident responsibilities that are understood before failure.
 



  





**The Board contribution beyond oversight** 




  





 The new Director will participate in annual strategy, capital\-allocation and leadership reviews. They should help management balance store expansion, digital capability, supply\-chain resilience, private\-label development and brand investment. The Board wants independent thinking on customer proposition and disciplined experimentation: pilots need hypotheses, decision dates and stopping rules.
 



  





 The appointee may serve on audit, risk, stakeholder or nomination and remuneration committees. They will support succession planning for merchandising, operations, technology and supply\-chain leadership; review incentives for unintended behaviours; and seek direct assurance where management information does not reconcile with customer or employee experience.
 



  





**The person sought** 




  





 The mandate suits a former chief executive, chief operating officer, commercial leader, supply\-chain leader, finance leader or digital\-retail executive who has governed a multi\-category consumer business.
 



  





 Experience with sourcing, private labels, inventory, store economics, e\-commerce or consumer protection is strongly relevant. The candidate must be comfortable moving from a customer complaint to its systemic operational and financial implications.
 



  





 Independence, curiosity and willingness to visit operations are essential. Applicants must hold active IICA Independent Directors Databank registration and disclose current interests involving suppliers, marketplaces, landlords, logistics providers, payment companies or competing retailers.

title: AI Transformation Lead
description:
**Experience:** 
 4–6 Years

 Mumbai

 Operations / Transformation
 



**Organisation:** 
 Havas Life Mumbai
 



  





**About Havas Life Mumbai** 




 At Havas Life Mumbai, we believe meaningful ideas have the power to improve lives. As part of the global Havas Health Network, we partner with leading pharmaceutical, healthcare, wellness, and consumer health brands to create award\-winning campaigns that educate, inspire, and drive real impact. From brand strategy and integrated campaigns to digital experiences, content, and medical communications, our work combines creativity with science to solve complex healthcare challenges.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for an
 **AI Lead** 
 who can drive the next phase of
 **AI\-led transformation** 
 at Havas Life Mumbai.
 



 This role is about identifying how AI can fundamentally improve the way we work from
 **process redesign and automation to productivity, cost optimisation and smarter program management** 
 . You will work across functions to identify opportunities, evaluate emerging AI solutions and take initiatives from idea to implementation and measurable business impact – by aligning to the global Havas vision and mission and AI Transformation framework.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Identify operational and process inefficiencies across functions and develop AI\-led solutions to improve productivity, quality, speed and scalability.
* Lead AI transformation programs end\-to\-end from opportunity identification and business case development to implementation, adoption and impact measurement.
* Evaluate and experiment with Generative AI, AI agents, automation platforms, LLM\-based tools and emerging AI technologies to identify practical business applications.
* Liaise with Global AI teams and implement mandates to local.
* Partner with Creative, Strategy, Medical, Client Servicing, Operations, HR, Finance and other teams to redesign workflows and implement AI\-enabled processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation, resource optimisation and cost reduction, and build measurable ROI cases for transformation initiatives.
* Manage multiple cross\-functional programs, including timelines, stakeholders, dependencies, milestones, and success metrics.
* Establish scalable AI\-enabled workflows, frameworks, and operating models that can be adopted across teams.
* Track and communicate productivity gains, cost efficiencies, adoption and business impact of AI initiatives to leadership.
* Drive AI adoption and change management through workshops, training, and continuous enablement.
* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI landscape, identifying tools and technologies that can create meaningful competitive and operational advantages for the organisation.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 4–8 years of experience in AI transformation, digital/business transformation, automation, consulting, operations excellence, program management, innovation, or related roles.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, workflow automation and emerging AI tools/platforms.
* Proven ability to translate business problems into practical technology and AI solutions.
* Strong program management and stakeholder management skills, with experience driving cross\-functional initiatives.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify and quantify productivity, efficiency, and cost\-saving opportunities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and presentation skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where experimentation, learning, and implementation are equally important.
* Experience in advertising, healthcare/pharma, consulting, technology or other complex, fast\-paced environments will be an advantage.
* This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role we are looking for someone who can connect AI with business, people, processes and measurable outcomes.



  





**Why This Role?** 




 This is an opportunity to build and shape how an organisation works with AI, not simply introducing new tools.
 



 You will have the opportunity to work across functions, influence leadership, redesign operating models, build AI\-enabled solutions and deliver tangible improvements in productivity, efficiency and cost.
 



  





**About Havas Life Mumbai**




 Havas Life Sorento is India’s leading Health \& Wellness marketing, communications, digital \& health tech company. It’s a part of Havas Health \& You, the world’s largest global health \& wellness network \& part of Havas India, which unites 18 companies and diversified services across Creative, Media, and Health verticals. Centered around Human Purpose, agency believes that brands rightly have a role to play in culture and make a positive impact on the wider world, thus creating meaningful brand platforms that don’t just grow, they grow well. It has significant depth of strategic, creative, and technology competence needed for modern marketing of health brands \& businesses.
 



 For more information, visit https://in.havas.com/havas\-life/ and follow Havas Life Sorento on social media.
 



  





***About Havas India:***




*Founded in 1835 in Paris, Havas is one of the world’s largest global communications groups, with nearly 23,000 people in over 100 countries. With the ambition to help brands unlock Growth, Powered by Desire, Havas brings together creativity, media, technology and production capabilities to build strong, desirable brands that people genuinely want to engage with. Its integrated model is supported by Converged.AI, the Group’s operating system that unifies data, technology, and AI to deliver optimized, scalable marketing solutions across the full customer journey. AI\-driven, fueled by human ingenuity, and grounded in the belief that desire drives both brand performance and business outcomes, Havas teams collaborate within Havas Villages worldwide to cultivate reputation, relevance, and long‑term preference for clients.* 




  





*India is one of Havas’ major markets. Havas India brings together the expertise of 25 agencies, specialised divisions, and strategic alliances across three verticals: Havas Creative Network, Havas Media Network \& Havas Health Network. To meet the evolving needs of its clients, Havas India has developed a seamlessly integrated strategy and operating system, Converged.AI, fusing global expertise, tools, and capabilities to create, produce, and distribute real\-time, optimised, and personalised marketing solutions at scale.*

Today, we proudly serve 400\+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

**Great People \| Great Food \| Great Experience \| Greater Good**

 To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of:

**Are you excited to join our team as Associate Manager – Vending Operations?** 




 Do you enjoy driving operational excellence and building strong client relationships? If your answer is a resounding yes, then we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





 As an
 **Associate Manager – Vending Operations** 
 at SmartQ, you will be responsible for managing and optimizing day\-to\-day vending operations to ensure service excellence, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. You will coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams, monitor machine performance and inventory, and drive continuous improvements to support business growth.
 



  





 Do you possess all these skills and wish to make an impact in the world of food and technology? Join us now!
 



  





**Roles and responsibilities:** 



* Manage end\-to\-end operations of vending machines across assigned client locations.
* Ensure high machine uptime through preventive maintenance and timely breakdown resolution.
* Oversee inventory planning, stock replenishment, and minimize stock\-outs across vending machines.
* Coordinate with warehouse, procurement, logistics, and maintenance teams for uninterrupted operations.
* Lead and manage field executives, refill staff, and service technicians to achieve operational KPIs.
* Monitor vending sales, inventory movement, machine performance, and operational dashboards.
* Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with operational SOPs, food safety, and hygiene standards.
* Resolve client escalations promptly and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.
* Track service requests and ensure SLA adherence for maintenance and issue resolution.
* Analyze sales and consumption trends to optimize product assortment and inventory levels.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives and improve operational efficiency.
* Support new machine deployments, client onboarding, and expansion projects.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management review.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, statutory requirements, and safety standards.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 2– 4 years of experience in operations management.
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Hospitality, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in vending operations, retail operations, food service, FMCG distribution, quick commerce, or facility management is preferred.

description:
Please note: Prior experience as a miller in a wheat flour mill is a must. It is also mandatory to have a certificate from Indian School of Milling Technology (CFTRI Mysore) or from a similar program demonstrating formal education in milling of wheat.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 As the Head Miller / Plant Head, you will be responsible for leading the entire milling and production process, managing the plant’s operations, workforce, and facility resources. This position requires extensive experience in flour milling, plant management, and production planning, as well as a strong focus on quality control, efficiency, and compliance.

 •

 : Maintain rigorous quality control for all flour products, conducting regular checks and calibrating processes to ensure consistency.
 



 •
 **Equipment Maintenance** 
 : Establish and manage preventative maintenance schedules, coordinate repairs, and ensure milling equipment operates at peak efficiency.
 



  





**Plant Management** 




  





 •
 **Production Planning and Coordination** 
 : Develop and implement production schedules, balancing demand with plant capacity and resources to achieve production goals.
 



 •

 •

 •

 : Uphold strict adherence to safety standards and food industry regulations; foster a safe workplace environment through training and inspections.
 



  





**Leadership and Team Management** 




  





 •
 **Workforce Management** 
 : Directly oversee the milling and production teams, including staffing, performance management, and training.
 



 •
 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 
 : Liaise with other departments, such as quality control, logistics, and procurement, to ensure smooth production and delivery operations.
 



 •
 **Budget and Resource Management** 
 : Manage the plant’s operational budget, monitor resource allocation, and implement cost\-saving measures where possible.
 



  





**Reporting and Documentation** 




  





 •
 **Data Analysis and Reporting** 
 : Maintain accurate records of production metrics, quality standards, inventory levels, and equipment performance; generate and present reports for senior management.
 



 •
 **Continuous Improvement Initiatives** 
 : Drive process improvement and innovation by implementing best practices, exploring new technologies, and analyzing production data to enhance plant efficiency.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 •
 **Experience** 
 : Minimum of 7\-10 years in flour milling and plant management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
 



 •
 **Education** 
 : Degree in Milling Science, Food Technology, Mechanical Engineering, or related field preferred.
 



 •
 **Technical Proficiency** 
 : Knowledge of milling equipment, plant operations, and modern production technology; experience with automated systems is a plus.
 



 •
 **Leadership Ability** 
 : Strong team leadership, decision\-making, and communication skills.
 



 •
 **Analytical Skills** 
 : Competency in analyzing production metrics, troubleshooting, and strategic planning.
 



 •
 **Safety and Compliance Knowledge** 
 : Deep understanding of health and safety standards in food production and plant operations.

**Team: 7 Corporate Event Planners \+ 1 Operations Executive** 




**Working Hours: Aligned to UAE business hours** 




**Weekly Off: Any 2 days of the week** 




  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for a Team Lead to lead our corporate events team and own its commercial performance.
 



 You will manage 7 planners and 1 operations executive, with your primary focus on hitting revenue and margin targets, improving conversion, coaching planners to sell better, and maintaining high delivery standards.
 



 This is a player\-coach role. You will personally stay close to important opportunities and client situations while helping the team consistently perform at a higher level.
 



 You don't need to build a large operations function. You need to build a high\-performing sales and event\-planning team.
 



  





**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Own Team Revenue \& Performance** 




 • Own monthly team targets for revenue, gross margin, conversion and productivity.
 



 • Break targets into clear individual planner goals and track performance through live dashboards.
 



 • Identify performance gaps early and put corrective actions in place.
 



 • Run regular pipeline, conversion and performance reviews.
 



 • Escalate risks with a diagnosis and proposed solution, not just the problem.
 



**2\. Coach the Team to Sell Better** 




 • Coach planners on qualification, discovery, proposals, pricing, negotiation, follow\-up and closing.
 



 • Review live opportunities and help unblock difficult deals.
 



 • Identify what separates high performers from low performers and replicate those behaviours across the team.
 



 • Develop underperforming planners through clear expectations, coaching and follow\-through.
 



 • Build a culture of ownership, urgency and commercial discipline.
 



**3\. Stay Close to Clients \& Sales** 




 • Personally handle selected high\-value opportunities and important client escalations.
 



 • Support the team on complex negotiations and strategic accounts.
 



 • Ensure planners are selling profitable events, not just chasing topline revenue.
 



 • Maintain strong client relationships and drive repeat business.
 



**4\. Maintain Event\-Planning Quality** 




 • Use your event and venue expertise to challenge proposals, commercials and delivery plans where required.
 



 • Help planners anticipate operational risks before they reach the client.
 



 • Ensure strong handover from sale through event delivery and closure.
 



**5\. Help us Improve Through AI \& Product** 




 • Drive adoption of our AI tools across the team.
 



 • Identify where AI, automation or better workflows can improve sales productivity and conversion.
 



 • Share structured feedback with Product based on real planner and client problems.
 



 • Help the team adapt quickly as our systems and workflows evolve.
 



  





**Must Have** 




 • 6–10 years of total experience
 



 • 2–3\+ years managing a team of 6\+
 



 • Experience in corporate events, MICE, hospitality, hotel banquets, event production, travel, events agencies or another relevant customer\-facing commercial environment
 



 • Proven experience personally owning a sales/revenue target
 



 • Experience coaching and improving sales performance within a team
 



 • Strong understanding of revenue, gross margin and conversion
 



 • Strong spoken and written English
 



 • Comfortable working with dashboards, CRM and performance data
 



 • Strong problem\-solving mindset and comfort operating without a perfect playbook
 



  





**Good to Have** 




 • UAE / GCC / international B2B client exposure
 



 • Experience leading event planners or corporate\-event sales teams
 



 • Strong venue, supplier or MICE network
 



 • Experience using AI meaningfully in day\-to\-day work
 



 • Experience working with Product, technology or automation teams
 



 • Experience building or improving sales processes and SOPs
 



  





**Please apply only if the shift pattern and non\-weekend weekly off genuinely work for you.**

**Overview**
 The Data Migration Lead will oversee and execute the migration of geospatial data from legacy systems such as GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri's Utility Network (UN). This role requires expertise in Esri technologies, Utility Network configuration, and data transformation tools like FME. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in utilities (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and experience managing complex data migration projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end data migration projects from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri Utility Network.
* Analyze legacy data models and design migration strategies to align with Esri Utility Network schema and best practices.

* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) workflows using FME and Python (ArcPy).
* Perform data quality assessments and validations to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness during migration.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define migration objectives, and ensure alignment with business needs.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data compatibility, schema mapping, and network topology during migration.
* Optimize migration processes for performance and scalability, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity.
* Document migration workflows, methodologies, and lessons learned for future reference.
* Provide training and support to teams on Esri Utility Network and post\-migration processes.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 8\-12 years of experience in GIS, with at least 4\-6 years in data migration projects.
* Strong expertise in Esri technologies, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, and Utility Network.
* Hands\-on experience with data migration from GE Smallworld and Geometric Network to Esri platforms.
* Proficiency in FME (Feature Manipulation Engine) for data transformation and automation.
* Advanced Python scripting skills (ArcPy) for geoprocessing and data migration tasks.
* In\-depth knowledge of utility network models (Gas, Electric, Water, Telecom) and their operational workflows.
* Experience with spatial databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills to manage cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Esri Utility Network configuration, including network rules, subnetwork management, and tracing.
* Familiarity with Agile project management methodologies and tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of GE Smallworld data structures and migration challenges.
* Experience with large\-scale enterprise GIS implementations and integrations.
* Certification in Esri technologies or FME is a plus.

description:

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering; Master's Degree preferred.
* 15\+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience in automotive or industrial operations.


**Skills**
* Strong expertise in Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, Operational Excellence, and Continuous Improvement.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing finance, cost management, productivity improvement, and capital investments.
* Experience with digital manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, Smart Factory initiatives, RTPPM, OEE, and data\-driven decision making.
* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Knowledge of labor relations, employee engagement, talent development, and statutory compliance.

title: Production Supervisor CNC/VMC
description:
**Company Description** 
 Patlon Interlocks India Pvt. Ltd. traces its origins to 1972, when panel lock manufacturing began under the trade name Toyota Manufacturing Co. The business expanded into key interlocking systems and established Patlon Industries in 1983 in Lonavala. In April 2008, Patlon Industries was incorporated as Patlon Interlocks India Pvt. Ltd. Today, the company is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer and supplier of mechanical and electro\-mechanical safety interlocking systems, discharge rods, and isolator switch panels. Patlon Interlocks India Pvt. Ltd. is recognized for its focus on safety, quality, and reliable solutions for industrial applications.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Production Supervisor CNC/VMC is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Lonavala. This role oversees day\-to\-day CNC and VMC machining operations, ensuring production targets, quality standards, and safety guidelines are met. Responsibilities include managing operator teams, assigning tasks, monitoring machine performance, and resolving production issues. The Production Supervisor will coordinate production schedules, optimize resource utilization, track output, and maintain production records. The role also involves collaborating with quality, maintenance, and planning teams to support continuous improvement and timely delivery.

* Strong supervisory skills, including team leadership and shop\-floor coordination.

* Experience in production management within CNC/VMC machining environments.
* Effective communication skills for interacting with operators, engineers, and management.

description:
Inventory Liquidation \& Stock Optimization Manager
   


**Location:** 
 Bijwasan, Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 5–12 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Auto Spare Parts \& Accessories
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  




 Role Overview
 
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Inventory Liquidation \& Stock Optimization Manager** 
 with strong expertise in the
 **Auto Spare Parts \& Accessories industry** 
 .
 



 The role will be responsible for ensuring that inventory remains
 **liquid, productive and commercially viable** 
 , with a strong focus on reducing ageing, slow\-moving and non\-moving stock and preventing unnecessary inventory accumulation. The ideal candidate should have strong
 **market/customer connect, inventory analytics, pricing \& discounting expertise, and commercial understanding** 
 to convert inventory into sales while protecting
 



 margins.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Inventory Liquidation \& Ageing Management
 * Analyse inventory ageing across SKU, brand, category, model and location.
* Develop and execute liquidation plans for
 **slow\-moving, non\-moving, obsolete and excess inventory** 
 .
* Define SKU\-wise liquidation priorities based on ageing, value, demand and margin.
* Monitor inventory turnover and ensure continuous stock movement.
* Develop mechanisms to prevent inventory from becoming stagnant.



  




 2\. Data \& Inventory Analytics
 * Analyse
 **inventory ageing, stock holding, sell\-through, inventory turnover, sales velocity and SKU performance** 
 .
* Prepare regular MIS and dashboards for inventory movement and liquidation.
* Identify dead stock and excess inventory through data\-driven analysis.
* Analyse customer purchase patterns and historical sales to identify potential buyers for specific inventory.
* Track liquidation value, recovery value, discount impact and margin realization.



  




 3\. Customer \& Market Development
 * Build and maintain a strong network of
 **distributors, dealers, retailers, workshops and other trade customers** 
 .
* Proactively approach customers for specific slow\-moving or excess SKUs.
* Map available inventory against customer demand and market requirements.
* Develop alternate sales channels for products with low regular movement.
* Maintain strong market intelligence on pricing, demand and competitor activity.



  




 4\. Pricing \& Discount Management
 * Design
 **SKU\-wise/customer\-wise discount structures** 
 for inventory liquidation.
* Determine appropriate discount levels based on stock ageing, purchase cost, market price and expected recovery.
* Balance liquidation speed with
 **gross margin and contribution margin** 
 .
* Develop promotional/bulk\-buying offers for ageing inventory.
* Monitor the impact of discounts on inventory recovery and profitability.



  




 5\. Commercial \& Working Capital Management
 * Focus on reducing
 **working capital blocked in inventory** 
 .
* Monitor inventory value versus sales velocity.
* Identify opportunities to convert dormant inventory into cash.
* Coordinate with Finance, Sales, Purchase and Warehouse teams for liquidation decisions.
* Recommend purchase controls based on inventory performance and demand trends.



  




 6\. Process \& Control
 * Establish SKU\-level inventory movement targets.
* Create ageing buckets and liquidation action plans.
* Set up regular review mechanisms for
 **30/60/90/120\+ day inventory** 
 .

* Gross Margin / Contribution Margin

 in inventory liquidation, inventory management, commercial operations, sales or stock optimization.

* Strong understanding of
 **automotive spare parts, accessories, brands, applications and aftermarket distribution** 
 .
* Strong customer and market network in the automotive aftermarket.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **inventory ageing and liquidation strategies** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of pricing, discounting, margins and commercial negotiations.
* Advanced Excel/MIS and strong data interpretation skills.
* Experience working with
 **ERP/inventory management systems** 
 .
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.

 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate is someone who understands that

This includes computer hardware and software, networking infrastructure, CCTV and video surveillance, access control systems, and AI\-driven solutions used for guard force monitoring, incident detection, and operational efficiency. The role leads a team of 10 qualified support professionals and is accountable for system uptime, security systems reliability, budget management, vendor relationships, and the technology roadmap that enables reliable, technology\-augmented security service delivery to clients.

* Demonstrated ownership of an IT/technical budget

* Server/OS administration and hardware lifecycle management
* CCTV/VMS systems at scale, with storage/retention and multi\-site monitoring experience

title: Sr Manager - Decision Intelligence
description:
**Job Description**
**About Busuu**
 Busuu is one of the world's leading language\-learning platforms, part of Chegg. We help over 100 million learners build language skills that change their lives — through apps, web, and now an AI\-first product experience. We operate across consumer (B2C) and business (B2B/enterprise) markets in over 100 countries
   

  

**About Decision Intelligence**
 Decision Intelligence (DI) is the central capability that makes the business measurable, governed, and trusted. It spans data insights and analytics across the organization, operating through three layers: analytics partners embedded in business teams, a central hub that owns standards, metrics architecture, experimentation, and governance, and a platform layer (Data Engineering) that builds the infrastructure.
   

  

 DI does not govern business decisions — it governs the standards that make those decisions trustworthy and evidence\-based. We don't build dashboards on request; we build the foundations teams build on. We work hybrid with team members across India, the UK, and the EU.
   

  

**The Role**
 You are the operational backbone of Busuu's Decision Intelligence function. As Head of Decision Intelligence, you anchor business\-wide strategic intelligence, run the hub day\-to\-day, manage and develop analytics leaders as a player\-coach, and own the methodology behind Busuu's weekly business performance reporting and monthly leadership reviews.
   

  

 You operate as a player\-coach: you lead capability work in the hub, grow direct reports across the organization, and continue to contribute hands\-on to strategic analytics work. You partner with senior analytics stakeholders on metrics architecture and strategy, with the Director on hub direction, and with business leaders on analytics\-driven narratives.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue of the function — turning measurement into operating decisions across the business. It is also a role with a clear trajectory: the right person grows into broader strategic leadership scope over time as the function scales.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business\-wide strategic owner — anchor cross\-functional business narrative, deep\-dives, and performance readouts. Be the credible analytics voice in leadership forums and key business meetings.
* Player\-coach for direct reports — Develop 3\-4 analytics leaders on craft, level progression, and strategic partnership capability. Balance coaching and mentorship with your own hands\-on strategic analytics contributions.
* Weekly business performance reporting — design, narrative arc, and analytical integrity of weekly business performance summaries.
* Monthly leadership review architecture — partner with senior analytics stakeholders on monthly business review structure; you own the weekly\-to\-monthly narrative connection.
* Experimentation standards — co\-build testing rigor and best practices across the organization.
* Hub operations — day\-to\-day leadership of the analytics hub as the synthesis layer that makes cross\-functional signals usable for executive decisions.
* Metrics architecture co\-ownership — co\-own metrics definition and architecture with senior analytics partners.
* Business performance deep\-dives — cross\-functional lens, working with your team on methodology and insights.
* Strategic planning and forecasting — the senior analytics voice on business strategy, OKR setting, and opportunity sizing.


**Required**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or consulting at meaningful scale — ideally with hands\-on analytical depth and people leadership combined.
* Demonstrated player\-coach experience — managing 3\+ analysts or data scientists while continuing to contribute as a senior individual contributor to strategic work. Comfortable in both leadership and hands\-on analytical work.
* Strong commercial instinct — you understand how analytics maps to business outcomes (revenue, retention, lifetime value, unit economics, conversion).
* Strategic narrative skill — you translate quantitative measurement into executive\-grade communication that drives decisions, not just describes them.
* Senior stakeholder influence — comfortable operating with Directors, VPs, and General Managers. Diplomatic but direct.

title: Senior Finance Manager – International Finance Operations & Management
description:
**About OnDemand International** 




 OnDemand International is a global corporate services and business mobility firm supporting businesses, entrepreneurs, and enterprises with international company formation, compliance coordination, accounting support, and business expansion services.
 



 Our finance function manages multi\-entity and multi\-currency operations across India, the UK, Europe, Australia, Singapore, and other international markets. We are looking for a strong finance professional who can bring structure, accuracy, reporting discipline, financial control, and operational visibility to a growing global business.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are hiring a 
 **Senior Finance Manager – International Finance Operations \& Management** 




**Reporting** 
  to manage and strengthen our finance function across multiple countries. This role is best suited for candidates with a strong academic background in commerce, accounting, and finance, preferably with a 
 **B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance** 
  qualification, along with hands\-on experience in accounting operations, management reporting, financial controls, reconciliations, compliance coordination, and team management. The position requires a practical finance professional who can run day\-to\-day finance operations, review books, manage reporting timelines, coordinate with country\-level accountants and advisors, and present clear financial visibility to senior management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Financial Control \& Management Reporting
 



 • Own financial control across all OnDemand International entities, ensuring accuracy,
 



 completeness, and integrity of books across multiple jurisdictions.
 



 • Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to the Managing Partner and
 



 leadership team.
 



 • Lead month\-end and year\-end closing activities across multiple entities.
 



 • Monitor cash flow, working capital, receivables, payables, expenses, and financial performance
 



 across the group.
 



 • Build and maintain reporting dashboards, MIS reports, and management accounts for leadership
 



 review.
 



 • Ensure internal approval workflows, payment controls, documentation, and reporting systems are
 



 properly followed.
 



 • Support the development and implementation of internal finance controls, reporting formats, and
 



 review mechanisms.
 



  





**Multi\-Country Finance Operations** 




 • Oversee finance operations across India, the UK, Europe, Australia, Singapore, and other relevant
 



 jurisdictions.
 



 • Coordinate with local accountants, bookkeepers, auditors, tax advisors, and statutory agents in
 



 each country.
 



 • Ensure books are maintained in line with applicable country\-level accounting and reporting
 



 requirements.
 



 • Manage multi\-currency accounting, inter\-company transactions, reconciliations, and consolidated
 



 group\-level reporting.
 



 • Maintain financial records, entity\-wise reports, and country\-wise compliance trackers.
 



 • Ensure timely coordination for accounting updates, reporting deadlines, statutory filings, and
 



 management review requirements.
 



  





**Accounting \& Bookkeeping Oversight** 




 • Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, payroll accounting,
 



 expense booking, invoicing, and general ledger maintenance.
 



 • Review journal entries, vendor payments, client invoices, expense claims, and reconciliations
 



 prepared by the accounting team.
 



 • Ensure proper chart of accounts, accounting structure, documentation, and reporting discipline
 



 across entities.• Identify gaps in existing accounting processes and implement practical systems to improve accuracy, efficiency, and control.• Identify gaps in existing accounting processes and implement practical systems to improve accuracy, efficiency, and control.
 



 • Ensure finance records are properly maintained and available for management review, external
 



 advisors, and audit coordination.
 



  





**Tax \& Compliance Coordination** 




 • Track direct and indirect tax\-related obligations across operating entities, including GST/VAT,
 



 corporation tax, withholding tax, payroll\-related statutory requirements, and other recurring
 



 filings.
 



 • Coordinate with external tax advisors and country\-specific consultants for filings, clarifications,
 



 documentation, and compliance updates.
 



 • Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure internal follow\-up so that deadlines are not missed.
 



 • Review tax and compliance information from an operational finance perspective before
 



 submission to external advisors.
 



 • Support management with visibility on upcoming compliance requirements, filing status, and
 



 pending action items.
 



  





**Team Management** 




 • Lead and manage a team of accountants, bookkeepers, and finance executives working across
 



 multiple entities.
 



 • Allocate responsibilities, review work quality, set reporting timelines, and ensure accountability
 



 within the finance team.
 



 • Act as the senior finance escalation point for internal teams and management.
 



 • Build systems, process notes, checklists, and documentation to reduce dependency on individuals
 



 and make the finance function scalable.
 



 • Train and guide team members to improve accuracy, reporting quality, and process discipline.
 



  





**Required Candidate Profile** 




**We are looking for candidates who have:** 




 • 8–10\+ years of progressive experience in finance, accounting, MIS, management reporting, and
 



 finance operations.
 



 • Strong academic foundation in commerce, accounting, and finance.
 



 • B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance background preferred.
 



 • Hands\-on experience managing books, reports, reconciliations, cash flow, payables, receivables,
 



 and management accounts.
 



 • Experience working with multi\-entity or multi\-country finance operations.
 



 • Ability to review the work of accountants and bookkeepers across different entities.
 



 • Strong understanding of financial reporting, consolidation, inter\-company transactions, and multi\-
 



 currency accounting.
 



 • Practical working knowledge of GST/VAT, tax coordination, statutory filing timelines, and
 



 compliance tracking.
 



 • Experience using accounting platforms such as Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero, Tally, SAP, or
 



 similar systems.
 



 • Strong Excel, MIS, reporting, and financial analysis skills.
 



 • Ability to work directly with founders, senior management, and internal business teams.
 



 • Demonstrated continuity, ownership, and depth of experience in previous finance roles.
 



  





**Educational Preference** 




**Strong preference will be given to candidates with:** 




 • B.Com / M.Com / accounting\-based graduation.
 



 • MBA in Finance from a recognised institution.
 



 • Hands\-on finance operations and reporting experience in a company, group, consulting firm, or
 



 multi\-entity business environment.
 



  





 This role is best aligned with candidates who have practical experience in corporate finance operations, accounting management, MIS reporting, reconciliations, multi\-entity finance coordination, and management\-level financial reporting. Candidates from audit, taxation, advisory, or statutory compliance backgrounds are welcome to apply, provided they have practical experience managing in\-house finance operations, accounting teams, reporting cycles, reconciliations, and management reporting.
 



**Preferred Background** 




 • Prior experience in a corporate services firm, consulting company, international business group, or
 



 multi\-entity organisation.
 



 • Experience reporting directly to founders, directors, managing partners, or senior leadership.
 



 • Exposure to international accounting coordination across countries such as the UK, Europe,
 



 Australia, Singapore, or India.
 



 • Experience managing finance teams and creating scalable reporting processes.
 



 • Understanding of cross\-border inter\-company structures and transfer pricing coordination will be
 



 an advantage.
 



  





**Candidate Requirements** 




 • Must be based in Delhi NCR or willing to commute daily to the Delhi office.
 



 • This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office role. There is no remote or hybrid option.
 



 • Immediate or early joiners will be preferred.
 



 • Candidates with demonstrated ownership and meaningful tenure in previous finance roles will be
 



 prioritised.
 



 • Must be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, founder\-led, multi\-entity business environment.
 



  





**Why Join OnDemand International** 




 This is a senior, high\-ownership finance role with direct access to the Managing Partner and exposure to international business operations across multiple countries. You will not be limited to maintaining one company’s books. You will be responsible for building, managing, and improving a finance function that supports a growing global business. The role offers strong exposure to international finance operations, management reporting, multi\-entity accounting, team leadership, compliance coordination, and financial process building.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates may send their CV at
 **:** 
  
 **hr@ondemandint.com** 




  





**Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Interviews will be conducted in person at our Delhi** 




**office.**

title: CSP - Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence & Retention
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
**CSP \- Value Stream Owner, Service Excellence \& Retention**
**Department** 
**Client Servicing Platforms**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**
**Reports To** 
**Head of Client Servicing Platforms**
**Level** 
**8**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our Client Servicing Platform team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 As a business, we are constantly evolving how we work to stay ahead of what our clients need and to deliver on our Forward 8 ambitions. FIL Platforms represents the next step in that journey \- bringing together Asset Management Delivery, Enterprise Technology Services, and delivery and change teams from across the business into a single integrated structure, designed for clarity, speed, and impact.
   

  

 That structure is organised around Platforms, each a focused unit of capability with a single accountable owner and within each Platform, a set of Value Streams that translate strategic priorities into funded, sequenced delivery.
   

  

 Your value stream sits at the heart of that model. It exists to connect our talent and expertise directly to the priorities that matter most, delivering value for our clients with less duplication and fewer competing backlogs
   

  

 Client Servicing Platform is accountable for delivering on Fidelity’s client commitments after engagement, ensuring servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent and scalable across regions. The team owns the end\-to\-end client servicing journey, focusing on standardisation, transparency and repeatable delivery.
   

  

 The Service \& Retain value stream owns the platform capabilities that strengthen service performance and deepen long\-term client relationships. It brings together live service stability, continuous improvement, client insight and relationship\-focused outcomes so that service delivery is transparent, repeatable and aligned to client needs across regions.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 A value stream is FIL's core delivery construct \- the unit through which strategy becomes execution. Each value stream is underpinned by a clear roadmap, supported by the right people and capabilities required to deliver it. It sits below the Platform and above the Agile Release Train (ARTs) and Squads that do the work, and it is the layer where sequencing is decided, scope is defined and refined, and outcomes are owned.
   

  

 As a Value Stream Owner you represent the voice of the customer \- translating their strategic needs into delivery, as well as the Platform priorities.
   

  

 You will lead across both run (e.g. live service performance and stability) and change (e.g. delivery and continuous improvement). You’ll enable your teams to focus on the work that makes the biggest difference to FIL and its clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Client Servicing Platforms, you will lead the Service \& Retain value stream, ensuring Fidelity’s client servicing outcomes are reliable, consistent, scalable and continually improving across the end\-to\-end client journey.
   

  

 Key outcomes
   

  

* Reliable, consistent and scalable servicing outcomes across the end\-to\-end client servicing journey.
* A coherent roadmap across the Strengthen Service and Deepen Relationships ARTs, linked to platform OKRs and client value.
* Clear ownership of service stability, operational risk, client insight and continuous optimisation.
* Transparent performance tracking focused on service quality, client retention, engagement, cost\-to\-serve and platform effectiveness.


 Day to day, this means:
   

  

* Setting and defining the value stream vision (Objective \& Key Results) and roadmap, keeping it aligned to platform OKRs and FIL's Forward 8 priorities as both evolve with a focus on continuously delivering incremental value at all times.
* Acting as Value Stream Owner within the LPM process, accepting agreed demand into the backlog and leading delivery through the quarterly planning and execution cycle.
* Owning the Initiative backlog, and development of the Lean Business Case and making sequencing decisions.
* Managing the value stream budget and headcount within allocated funding levels, and making the case for investment where it is needed.
* Tracking and reporting on outcomes, not just delivery progress \- knowing what has actually moved and being honest when it has not.
* Leading Quarterly Planning Cycles and ensuring the ARTs are co\-ordinating a coherent, well\-sequenced plan.
* Managing operational risk and service stability within the value stream alongside the change agenda.
* Building and developing the leadership team within the value stream, and holding them accountable to outcomes.
* Accountable for role modelling and championing the correct behaviours and change culture.
* Championing and driving the value stream at the relevant governance forums and with senior stakeholders.
* Transiting the value stream to the North Star view over time (reducing dependencies and additional coordination horizontal layers).


**About You**
 This role will suit if you’ve run, changed and owned a large, complex global product (including service, platform, proposition or product) at scale, including: the viability, the operational, the technical, and value dimensions.
   

  

**Specifically, we are looking for:**
* Commercial acumen to own a business outcome and make the value case for a value stream's priorities.
* A genuine track record of building high\-performing, engaged teams to move the dial on performance metrics via the value delivered.
* An individual who has led both run and change, and are comfortable being fully accountable for live performance, delivery outcomes, operational effectiveness and the long\-term health of a value stream.
* An individual who can engage senior stakeholders with integrity, using sound judgement and negotiation skills to influence outcomes, manage competing interests and ensuring the right initiatives are being delivered in the right way.
* Strong familiarity with Agile operating models at scale; experience with SAFe or a comparable framework is an advantage.
* Financial management experience \- owning a budget, making trade\-offs, and being accountable for spend against outcomes.
* The technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering leads on architecture, debt, and delivery risk.
* Sound judgement in complex, regulated environments, balancing experience, delivery feasibility, risk, control and operational practicality without losing momentum.
* The ability to define the longer\-term direction for a value stream while staying close enough to execution, risk, delivery and operational detail to ensure results are actually achieved.
* An excellent communicator who can motivate and align large teams (including matrixed roles), create shared understanding across complex stakeholder groups and maintain momentum through clarity, consistency and presence.
* Enterprise\-first individual, supporting the creation of common, reusable patterns and repeatable solutions that improve consistency, speed and simplicity across the platforms.


 Behavioural expectations
   

  

**Brave**
* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.


**Bold**
* Set clear, outcome led direction and make decisive tradeoffs at valuestream level.
* Simplify governance, roles and interfaces to reduce duplication and escalation.
* Delegate real decision authority and protect teams’ ability to move at pace.


**Curious**
* Drive continuous prioritisation based on flow, outcomes and data.
* Expect evidence led conversations (not status updates) in the appropriate governance forums.
* Use delivery data to inform funding, sequencing and capacity decisions.


**Compassionate**
* Act as a visible advocate for client outcomes across the value stream.
* Build psychological safety so issues are raised early rather than escalated late.
* Balance pace with sustainability and colleague wellbeing.


 Feel rewarded
   

  

 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.


**Life At WPP Media \& Benefits**
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events.  10\+ years

 EduCrypt — EdTech SaaS Platform
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **"Technical Project Manager / Delivery Manager"** 
 to own end\-to\-end delivery for EduCrypt, our EdTech SaaS platform. The role requires someone who is equally comfortable in sprint rooms and in architecture discussions — driving planning and execution across a large, cross\-functional development team while staying hands\-on enough to understand infrastructure, code, and quality risks well enough to challenge them.
 



  





**Key Qualifications** 



* **10\+ years of experience in technical project / delivery management, including at least one stint managing a large development team.**
* Strong understanding of AWS infrastructure — core services, environment setup, scaling, cost, and reliability trade\-offs, sufficient to hold informed conversations with DevOps/SRE.
* Working understanding of MySQL and MongoDB — schema thinking, indexing basics, and when to reach for relational vs. document stores.
* **Working understanding of Node.js / Nest.js — able to read code, review PRs at a conceptual level, and reason about API and service design.**
* Working understanding of Laravel — enough to support legacy/PHP\-stack conversations and cross\-stack delivery planning.
* Having good understanding of Android, iOS and Web development.
* Solid grounding in both manual and automation testing, and hands\-on experience building test plans and QA strategy.
* Understanding of application security and VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing) — able to interpret findings, prioritize remediation, and track closure.
* Demonstrated capability managing all development team across multiple pods/squads.
* Strong track record in sprint planning and execution — backlog grooming, estimation, velocity tracking, and release management.
* Excellent communication skills — able to translate between engineering, QA, security, and business stakeholders.
* Direct exposure to AI\-assisted development — using AI tools to write, review, or accelerate code, and comfort evaluating AI\-generated output.
* Familiarity with AI workflows — prompt\-driven development processes, AI\-in\-the\-loop QA/documentation, and evaluating where AI fits into the delivery pipeline.
* **1–2 products' worth of ownership experience, with 3\+ years on at least one product from a similar stage (SaaS / EdTech preferred).**



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Own delivery planning, sprint execution, and release tracking across the EduCrypt engineering team.**
* Translate product requirements into technical documentation, test plans, and execution\-ready tickets.
* Coordinate manual and automation QA efforts; review test coverage and sign off on release readiness.
* Track and triage production issues; drive root\-cause analysis and ensure timely resolution and feedback loops.
* Partner with security/VAPT vendors or internal teams to track vulnerability remediation.
* Monitor AWS infrastructure health and costs in coordination with DevOps, flagging risks early.
* Produce regular status reports, delivery dashboards, and data\-driven insights for leadership.
* **Champion the use of AI tools within the team to improve coding velocity, QA, and documentation quality.**
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release/deployment governance (change management, rollback planning).
* Familiarity with EdTech\-specific concerns: DRM/content protection (e.g., Widevine/HLS), payment gateway integrations, and data privacy for student data.
* Exposure to Agile scaling frameworks (e.g., SAFe, Scrum\-of\-Scrums) given the 40\+ team size.
* Basic financial/commercial literacy (budget tracking, P\&L or delivery\-cost accountability).

title: Chief Track – BID Position
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems.
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water \& Environment for public and private organizations.
   

  

 Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost\-effective and made\-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
   

  

 SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know\-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
   

  

 SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know\-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).
   

  

 Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork \& Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling \& Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re\-modelling etc.
   

  

 Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
   

  

 Currently, we are bidding for Semi High Speed Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Track is the key position in these BIDs.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Technical Approval and Design Review: Lead the review and final approval of all permanent way designs, track alignments, geometry, and component specifications (rails, sleepers, fastenings) to ensure they meet the stringent high\-speed performance, safety, and operational standards.
* Quality Control and Construction Supervision: Establish and enforce rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) protocols for all track installation activities, including earthworks, ballast laying, welding, stressing, and geometry correction.
* Interface Management: Directly manage the technical interface between track works and other critical systems (e.g., Civil structures like bridges and tunnels, Signaling systems, and OHE/Power systems) to ensure seamless and safe integration.
* Ensure absolute compliance of the track system with national railway codes, international best practices, and project\-specific technical specifications to guarantee safety and long\-term maintainability.
* Develop and oversee the testing and commissioning strategy for the track, including the use of specialized track recording cars and geometry measurement equipment, to secure final certification for high\-speed operation.
* Provide expert technical guidance and direction to the main track contractors, resolving complex field issues, approving methodologies, and certifying progress payments based on verified quality and adherence to design.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Qualification: Graduate in Engineering or equivalent with working knowledge of reading, writing and speaking in English \[additional marks for PG in Engineering or equivalent]
* Minimum Experience: 20 years post minimum qualification in any Rail based Passenger Transit system \[additional marks for more experience in any Rail based Passenger Transit system\*]
* Relevant Experience: 10 years’ experience for Design or Installation of Ballast\-less Track system including Track Alignment for MRTS /Regional Rail /High Speed Rail as Chief Track Expert or equivalent position \[additional marks for more experience; experience in position one level below allowed with less weightage]
* Eligible Assignment\*\*(see below): Must have experience of 1 Eligible Assignment as Chief Track Expert or equivalent position for full\-time continuous deployment of not less than 2 years \[additional marks for more Eligible Assignments; less weightage for position one level below]
* International Experience: Minimum 3 years’ experience on projects for Rail based Passenger Transit system with operational speed of 160 kmph or more in Developed country(s) as defined in latest list of Developed countries as per Department of Economics and Social Affairs of the United Nations Secretariat (UN\-DESA)/World Bank – High Income Economies.
* Rail\-based Passenger Transit System shall mean
* High Speed Transit System / Regional Rail Transit System (with operational speed of 160kmh and above) OR
* Urban/Suburban/Intercity/Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS) \[excluding LRT with design PHPDT less than 20000/Tram/Monorail Systems]
* Shall mean experience of working as a personnel of General Consultant / Project Management Consultant / Employer’s Personnel in a work / project in a Rail based


 Passenger Transit System with operational speed of 160 kmph or more comprising:
   

  

* Construction of Civil structures (at\-grade/elevated/underground) AND
* Installation of Systems (Track, Rolling Stock, Traction \& Power Supply, Signalling)


 Including Detailed Design or Proof checking of designs; Bid Process Management; Project and Interface Management; Construction Supervision and System Installations and Testing \& Commissioning.
   

  

 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!
