description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Manager Operations** 
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**
* Asset Servicing team is part of the Markets and Securities Services Operations functions. AS team processes all voluntary and mandatory corporate action (including Income processing) across various UK, Europe and MENA jurisdiction.
* The department is also responsible for data validation for Equity and UK income collectives and capital mandatory corporate action. Team is divided into mainly three sub\-groups \- corporate action team (processes all capital voluntary \& mandatory corporate action), Income processing team (processes for Dividend, Coupon interest payment \& Pool factor processing) and corporate action validation team (validates corporate action for Equity, UK Income collectives, Capital mandatory corporate action).
* Ensure high\-quality service to the business area in terms of funds ensuring that risks are minimized and profit is maximized through effective management of costs. Ensure that process and procedures are continually reviewed and improved and the changes are communicated and implemented effectively. The job also entails checking on internal audits and measures undertaken and regularly reviews them in order to maintain quality and productivity at the optimum level.
* Responsible for managing performance and deliveries of funds/client sign offs to valuation teams. Contribution towards sustainable savings in relation to Process Efficiencies
* Supporting each global product on a regional basis by function or market. To plan for standardization of Asset Servicing processes by sharing the best practices across the various markets with the aim to enhance cost effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Role will be of individual contributor in nature and will not have team reporting to the role. Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures.
* High level variation and specific manual processes required by Product/System/Client/jurisdiction/ client
* To be aware of the Operational Risk scenario associated with the role and to ensure that all actions during your employment with HSBC take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring. Ensure effective escalation process is in place.


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Bachelor’s degree in commerce or qualifications in accounting/finance industry or relevant experience. Detailed understanding of single sub\-process, control points, end to end process risk.
* Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting. Excellent knowledge of ICON/Geneva/Multifonds as accounting system.
* Excellent knowledge and relevant experience in Asset Servicing with clear understanding of the E2E Fund Accounting Model.
* Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds and reconciliations.
* 3\-5 years of relevant Funds administration experience. Excellent Team Management skills with ability to handle personnel issues and strong team bonding.
* Efficient Time Management and ability to multitask work and priorities to meet defined deadlines. Ability to build excellent rapport and working relationships with other departments and jurisdiction thus ensuring smooth operations.
* Should have demonstrated behavior in line with HSBC values throughout. Strong working knowledge on MS Office
* Will be expected to maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, together with any issues raised by external regulators. Must be aware of the operational risk scenarios associated with this role and act upon pertinent risk (if any).

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Deputy Project Manager \- IBMS**

The incumbent will be responsible for end\-to\-end project execution, stakeholder coordination, resource management, and ensuring timely project completion while maintaining quality, safety, and commercial objectives.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage and execute IBMS projects from initiation to commissioning and handover.

* Handle project risks, change requests, and escalation management.
* Support procurement and material planning activities to avoid project delays.
* Ensure compliance with safety standards, statutory requirements, and company policies.
* Coordinate with engineering and programming teams for system integration and troubleshooting.
* Participate in client meetings and provide technical and execution\-related support.


 Technical Expertise Required
   

  

 Strong experience in execution and project management of the following systems:
   

  

* Integrated Building Management System (IBMS)
* Building Management System (BMS)
* Fire Alarm System (FAS)
* Access Control System (ACS)
* CCTV / Video Surveillance System
* Public Address System (PA)
* Intrusion Detection System
* Networking and Structured Cabling
* HVAC Integration
* Energy Monitoring System (EMS)
* SCADA Integration (preferred)


 Educational Qualification
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical \& Electronics, or related Engineering discipline.
* Project Management certification will be an added advantage.


 Desired Experience
   

  

* 8\-12 years of experience in IBMS/BMS/ELV project execution and project management.
* Proven experience in handling commercial buildings, IT parks, hospitals, airports, metro, industrial, smart city, or large infrastructure projects.
* Hands\-on experience in project planning, scheduling, coordination, commissioning, and client management.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of IBMS architecture, protocols, and system integration.

* Proficiency in MS Project, Primavera, AutoCAD, and MS Office.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Commercial awareness and contract management understanding.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight timelines.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* On\-time project delivery.
* Project profitability and cost control.
* Successful commissioning and handover.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Quality and safety compliance.
* Team productivity and resource optimization.


**Location:** 
 Kolkata (with travel to project sites across Eastern Region as required).

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Transformation Delivery – Senior Consultant**
 The Transformation Delivery practice @ EY provides a rewarding career opportunity, targeted toward becoming a professional in complex business, technology and infrastructure transformation, not simply being a generalist. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in today’s marketplace, come join our dynamic TD\&E team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Our clients are seeking and hiring a new type of Transformation Delivery expert – one who provides strategic guidance but is also deeply embedded in the delivery and success of their programs. Traditional suppliers, such as strategy houses, systems integrators and engineering project management consultants, cannot provide the complete service our clients now demand. Our insights and capabilities across all portfolio levels in planning, analysis and delivery are integrated into our core offerings, and this exemplifies our unique viewpoint over traditional program management. We also offer services that focus on 'bridging the gap’ between execution and strategy primarily by designing and implementing frameworks and solutions that allow companies to make data\-driven decisions to optimize and manage portfolios and programs/projects. With digital transformations being a focus of EY, we have incorporated technology into our processes, automating manual work and enabling us to provide greater insights and value to our clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 A successful Transformation Design and Execution Senior will work with our clients to design and establish Transformation Management Office (TMO), Program Management Office (PMO) or Project Portfolio Management business processes and solutions to manage high profile complex programs by applying proven EY frameworks and methodologies based on industry recognized global standards.
   

  

 You will partner with engagement leadership to design and establish core processes and support a delivery team in planning, controlling, and executing complex programs, PMO’s and Transformation Offices. In your role, you will gain valuable insights and help drive strategic conversations with key stakeholders.
   

  

 You will also work closely with our Technology Solutions team to creatively leverage technology to support processes as part of the overall solution design.
   

  

 Key deliverables that you will work on are:
   

  

* Assessments and Process Design
* Roadmap Development and Execution
* PMO Setup \& Run
* Sustainable Templates and processes
* Dashboards and Automations


**Responsibilities, Skills, And Attributes For Success**
* Active listener, passionate learner with a creative and high\-performance mindset. Committed and driven towards helping and supporting the team in every aspect possible
* Having a successful and proven track record in some or all of below areas:
+ Business analysis
+ Transformation Management, Project Management, Change Management
+ Problem Solving, Design Thinking, root cause assessment
+ Process improvement, business improvement
+ Supporting cross\-functional teams

* Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills as a standard \- problem solving, critical thinking, conceptualizing, communication, leadership, presentation, workshop facilitation, storytelling, etc.
* Flexible, willing to work in hybrid model and open to support time zones
* Strong communication and presentation skills and be able to express yourself effectively, by breaking down complex structures into digestible and relevant points for a diverse set of clients and colleagues, at all levels
* Team player that collaborates well in a group setting to quickly and effectively accomplish tasks
* Flexibility in embracing and adapting to change
* Be able to strive in ambiguous environments and use analytical and creative thinking to find and develop innovative solutions to complex problems.
* Be curious and pay attention to detail, exercise active listening and be to anticipate and identify risks and escalate issues as appropriate
* Foster an innovative and inclusive team\-oriented work environment and demonstrate leadership by playing an active role in counselling and mentoring junior consultants within the organization
* Possess good business acumen and remain current on new developments in consulting capabilities and industry trends
* Demonstrate in\-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge.
* Develop and maintain long\-term client relationships and networks
* Develop and maintain relationships with team members across EY practices to serve client needs
* Cultivate and participate in business development opportunities. Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess/present ways to serve clients.
* Support planning activities for large, complex client programs
* Own tracking activities for key milestones and deliverables to ensure project stays on track according to plan
* Develop key reports and communicate relevant client insights


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree (BE \- B. Tech / MCA) and a minimum of 6\-9 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and a minimum of 4 years of related work experience
* Approximately 6\+ years’ experience on large scale complex programs providing consulting services in at least one of the following areas:
+ PMO/EPMO design/set up and delivery, program road\-mapping design, resource/capacity management, program execution
+ PMO maturity assessment, PMO Setup \& Operations
+ Transformation Office design/set up and delivery, Value/Benefit realization
+ End\-to End Portfolio Management implementation – intake and demand management, portfolio prioritization, portfolio selection, financial management
+ End\-to End ERP implementation

* Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills
* Flexible to work in US and UK time zones
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
* Knowledge of project and portfolio management (PPM) methodologies (Agile, Hybrid, SAFe, DevOps. etc.) and tools (Microsoft based tools such as Azure DevOps, MS Project Online, others such as Jira, Planview, Planisware, Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
* PPM certifications such as PMI, Prince2, Scrum Master, Scrum Product Owner, SAFe or equivalent are beneficial


**Good to have**
* MBA or relevant graduate degree is a plus
* Understanding of Agile concepts
* Business analysis skills
* Potential certifications include: PMP, Six Sigma, Scrum, Agile SAFe
* Sector experience in areas such as Automotive, Advanced Manufacturing \& Mobility, Consumer Products and Goods, Media and Entertainment, Life Sciences, and Consumer Products
* Experience supporting and participating in pursuit efforts. Experience with the end\-to\-end RFP process (RFP, Response, Proposal, Client Presentation, SOW and Execution) and understanding of client procurement processes
* Experience working in either of the following sector Pharma, Healthcare, Energy, Infrastructure, Oil and Gas, CPR or Technology.


**What We Look For**
 We look for people who can develop and implement creative solutions to challenging problems and work well with teams to accomplish it. We look for people with an entrepreneurial spirit: innovative by nature, always creating new approaches, products, services, and technologies. Helping clients solve tough problems and implement solutions requires strong intellectual abilities and rigor as well as a practical sense of what works and what does not. We seek people who strive to lead themselves, their teams, and their communities, and who can foster effective teamwork to drive results. Is this you? Read more…
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange.
   

  

**Plus, we offer:**
* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* Freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Service Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Chamunda Pharma Machinery Pvt. Ltd., established in 1981, is recognized globally for quality, reliability, and service in machinery for pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, ayurveda, chemical, cosmetics, and food industries. The company offers comprehensive solutions including granulation suites and tableting lines, turnkey project solutions, containment isolator design and supply, qualification and validation, and after\-sales support and service. With a workforce of over 250 professionals, Chamunda has built a strong network in India and more than 65 countries, with over 12,000 machines successfully installed. The organization focuses on customized solutions, innovation, and customer satisfaction, aiming to build long\-term partnerships by delivering reliable, efficient machinery tailored to client needs.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Service Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad. The Service Manager will oversee after\-sales service operations, including planning and coordinating installation, commissioning, maintenance, and repair of machinery at client sites. Responsibilities include managing service teams, scheduling and prioritizing service calls, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues, and maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. The role involves collaborating with engineering, production, and sales teams to address client requirements, analyze recurring issues, and recommend improvements to service processes. The Service Manager will also prepare service reports, monitor key performance indicators, manage spare parts and resources, and ensure adherence to safety, quality, and compliance standards.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong technical skills in mechanical or electrical engineering, with experience in industrial or process machinery, preferably in pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, or related sectors.
* Candidates should possess service management and operations skills, including field service coordination, maintenance planning, troubleshooting, and after\-sales support.
* Candidates should possess leadership and team management skills, including the ability to guide service technicians, allocate resources, and foster a collaborative, safety\-focused work environment.
* Candidates should possess customer relationship and communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication, negotiation, and a customer\-centric approach to resolving issues.
* Candidates should possess organizational and analytical skills, including documentation, report preparation, data analysis, and use of service management or CRM tools.
* Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical, or related field) and prior experience in service or maintenance roles within machinery or capital equipment industries are highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on\-site at client locations as needed, willingness to travel, and familiarity with quality, safety, and regulatory standards applicable to pharma machinery are advantageous.

title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. title: Independent Director
description:
**The mandate through a project’s life** 




  





 The company designs and manufactures process equipment used in food\-production environments. The Board needs an Independent Director who can govern the entire obligation created when an engineered system is sold—from interpretation of process requirements through fabrication, site integration, performance acceptance and long\-term service. Success cannot be measured only by dispatch: an apparently complete project can still carry unresolved hygiene, performance, documentation or margin exposure.
 



  





**Gate one: accepting the problem** 




  





 Before a bid becomes a contract, management must understand the customer’s product, process conditions, cleaning method, utilities, interfaces, throughput assumptions and acceptance criteria. The Director will challenge bid governance where requirements are incomplete, guarantees are broad or the proposed solution relies on untested assumptions. Commercial urgency should not bypass engineering review, capacity confirmation, site\-risk assessment or a clear allocation of interface responsibility.
 



  





 The Board should receive visibility into contractual exposure for delay, performance shortfall, contamination, consequential loss, intellectual property and changes in customer scope. Risk premiums and contingencies must be grounded in the actual project rather than applied mechanically.
 



  





**Gate two: freezing a cleanable design** 




  





 The appointee will seek assurance that hygienic design principles are built into equipment geometry, material choice, seals, welds, drainage, accessibility, instrumentation and cleaning validation. Design review should involve manufacturing, quality, service and commissioning, not remain isolated within engineering.
 



  





 Changes after design freeze need controlled technical and commercial assessment.
 



  





 Where digital controls or remote connections form part of the system, the Board must understand software ownership, access privileges, patching, data use and safe fallback. A cyber event that changes a process parameter can become a product\-safety event.
 



  





**Gate three: fabricating what was approved** 




  





 Material identity, surface condition, welding practice, outsourced treatment, calibration and inspection evidence all influence fitness for use. The Director will review how the company qualifies special processes, controls non\-conformance and preserves traceability. Schedule pressure must not move unfinished or conditionally accepted work downstream without named accountability and an agreed closure path.
 



  





 Management information should connect shop loading, material availability, engineering releases, rework and subcontractor performance. Reported project progress should represent earned completion, not expenditure or physical presence on the shop floor.
 



  





**Gate four: integrating at site** 




  





 Installation and commissioning often expose assumptions that were invisible during design. The Director will question site\-readiness checks, change control, safety planning, customer dependencies and escalation routes. Acceptance tests should be objective, witnessed and tied to the contracted duty. Punch lists must distinguish cosmetic completion from issues that prevent safe or hygienic operation.
 



  





 Revenue recognition, retention, warranty provision and project closure should reflect substantive acceptance and remaining obligations. The finance view and the project view must reconcile.
 



  





**Gate five: learning through service** 




  





 Warranty calls, spares demand, cleaning difficulties and repeat interventions contain product\-development intelligence. The appointee will encourage a closed loop from service into design standards, supplier decisions and commercial qualification. Aftermarket strategy should create genuine availability and performance value, not dependency through inaccessible information or restrictive practices.
 



  





**The enterprise decisions surrounding the gates** 




  





 The Director will participate in capacity, technology and market choices. They will evaluate whether modularisation, standard platforms, automation or strategic sourcing can improve delivery without concealing customer\-specific engineering. Working\-capital oversight will cover advances, milestone billing, long\-lead purchases, work in progress, claims and retentions. The Board will expect candid scenario analysis before expanding facilities or entering unfamiliar applications.
 



  





 Leadership review will include engineering authority, project\-management capability, quality independence, service responsiveness and succession for scarce technical roles. Safety, environmental performance and contractor governance will be treated as operating fundamentals.
 



  





**Experience and temperament** 




  





 The ideal candidate has senior responsibility in process equipment, food manufacturing, capital projects, industrial engineering, quality, operations, finance or project\-based business. Experience governing hygienic design, complex commissioning, contract risk or lifecycle service will be useful. The Board needs a person who can explore a technical issue deeply while preserving the distinction between oversight and execution.
 



  





 Candidates must be financially literate, conflict\-free and actively registered in the IICA Independent Directors Databank. Any relationship with customers, engineering consultants, component suppliers, contractors or competing equipment businesses must be declared.
 



  





**Candidate response** 




  





 Applications through India ID Exchange should include the Board profile, IICA confirmation and a brief explanation of how the candidate would determine whether a delayed project is suffering from execution weakness, defective commercial assumptions or both.

title: Change Management Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **NewCo Build**
**Job Description**
**Job Title Change Management Specialist**
**Function: (Category for Job Posting)**
**Job Summary:**
 The Service Management (SM) Change Management Specialist role is responsible for monitoring the ongoing ‘wellnesses of Information Technology (IT) Change Management processes, procedures and policies. The role drives the analytical review of the relevant processes, scheduled reporting and other metrics to confirm that the end\-to\-end processes are operating in a Business as Usual (BAU) mode or to identify exceptions to same. The role leads discussions with Change Lead and /or business leaders on identified process exceptions and recommends potential solutions to rectify breaks in a specific process. The role requires a solid working knowledge of and certification in the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) framework as part of the role’s core mandate to drive best practices in the alignment of business needs to IT capabilities. The role acts as thought leader in the use of the Service Management tool as trainer to the user population and are advanced users of its monitoring capabilities for IT’s processes. The role may have management responsibility for the Process Analysts who provide the process analytics and is generally guided by the Change Process Lead.
   

  

**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Designs, assesses and delivers the performance analysis of all day\-to\-day Change process under its remit to determine the stability of local, area, global IT applications and the effectiveness of their processes, procedures and policies. Examines Critical Success Factors (CSF), Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and other key metrics produced on a daily, weekly or monthly basis as a critical component of the analysis.
* Defines and coordinates senior level meetings inclusive of monthly services reviews and more frequent meetings to identify root cause of change failures with intent to improve production stability. Identifies change caused outages in co\-ordination with Incident Management and drives input into Continuous Service Improvement and/or Risk Registers.
* Engages with Incident, Problem, Release Management and consults in major outage discussions/meetings as a thought leader on current processes and adds valued insight across senior members of the organization on efforts to restore overall services.
* Actively participates and works with lead/ other stakeholders in design, build and maintenance of CMDB
* Assumes and drives responsibility for escalation actions, as needed, when it is observed that the appropriate IT process is not being adhered to.
* Organizes and leads appropriate post mortem activities with senior members of the organization on Change processes not executed appropriately and drives follow through on actions identified as a result.
* Drives adherence to NewCo build’s compliance standards of IT processes and procedures wherever applicable. Develops and directs practices to improve compliance mandates and/or identifies and implements improvements in process/procedures to support existing compliance directives.
* Leads and coordinates meetings with all levels of the organization directly or under guidance of Lead to review existing KPIs and other metrics aligned to a specific process to drive continued improvements and production stability and/or end user satisfaction. Identifies \& assesses risks, forecasts challenges and opportunities and provides related recommendations including the proposed creation of new KPIs and other modifications based on analysis.
* Engages with vendors for getting root cause and solution of the issues as required.
* Researches, recommends, develops, and implements updates and amendments to the Service Management tool to reflect identified enhancements or changes to process and procedures. Partners with the Quality Management and Automation team to develop and implement necessary modifications to the tool so that it reflects the latest services, procedures and activities.
* Designs and develops training materials, communiques and related documentation to inform and train IT users in the Change process and tool and to embed the process as part of the required business knowledge of the IT organization.
* Ascertains best practices in aligning business needs to an IT organization by maintaining a strong knowledge of industry standards in process management through formal certification and training in the ITIL framework and a knowledge of current and proposed future state of IT processes and procedures
* A good knowledge in dashboards and reporting
* Willingness to work on required automation initiatives and understanding of the same will be added advantage
* Should be willing to work during weekends and in rotational shifts


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires a strong analytical acumen and solution orientation to understand the nuances of Change Management process across cultures and geographic regions as well as within the IT organization. The role additionally requires consultative questioning and influence management skills as well as solid business knowledge of IT services and capabilities to identify the source of a service break and recommend viable solutions that will properly and efficiently resume service delivery.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* A comprehensive knowledge of the Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes in general and Change Management in particular with an eye to progressive levels of certification as required. Proven experience to leverage and interpret the ITIL process in enhancing current business process and procedures
* Solid advanced interpersonal skills to engage, as a thought leader, senior executives of the firm, in cross business discussions within a matrixed, geographically dispersed organization and to build a solid network of peers and others of influence. Uses these relationships to connect colleagues, challenge insightfully to improve processes and propose credible options
* Well defined consultative skills to conduct effective questioning , hone in on key issues to formulate ideas and materials as well as present those ideas clearly and concisely to all levels of the organization including senior and/or executive management
* Advanced oral, presentation and written communication skills in the English language. Exhibits the ability to adapt communication style to the style of others, developing rapport and staying calm under pressure and to build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Has an active learning acumen about the application/infrastructure delivery and related operations organizations to engage team members in issues resolution with confidence and credibility
* Strong analytical and problem solving ability to escalate and negotiate complex and conflicting issues in IT technical investigations, handle multiple and shifting priorities across a broad spectrum of operating environments and to drive solutions that are both financially sound and operationally feasible.
* Excellent Microsoft Office experience, predominantly Excel, Visio and PowerPoint. Strong skills in knowledge sharing tools such as SharePoint
* Assists the Change Management Process Lead with resolving team conflicts, providing peer mentoring, and with the implementation \& communication of difficult decisions; is able to manage team or project by delegating work effectively and using appropriate resources
* Willing to work in rotational shifts and also during weekends


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 Contingent on location, the role can be an individual contributor or may manage Change Management Analysts. As manager, the role requires seasoned management skills inclusive of recommending staff for hire to SM / Change Management Lead, setting objectives aligned to those for the lead and SM as a whole, reviewing accomplishments, coaching for success and counselling for improvement. Assigned staff may be remote based and/or in a work from home setting that will require distance management skills across locations, cultures and time zones. The role itself is generally guided by the Change Management Lead
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
 The role may also require the periodic allocation of additional time on the job to support multiple demands and escalating issues.
   

  

**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
 College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc) or comparable job experience
   

  

**Experience:**
 Approximately 8 to 10 years of experience in an Operational/Service Management role with at least 3\-5 years in Change Management.
   

  

**Certification Requirements:**
 ITIL v2 or v3 Foundations training, or higher level of ITIL Certification as may be required

* At least 15 years experience in architecture, engineering, implementation and operations OT/IoT/IIoT systems and at least 6 years of experience in assessing, implementing and operating security controls for these environments.
* Bachelor or college degree in related field or equivalent work experience
* MBA (Good to have)

* Expertise in solution development, implementation and operation of SCADA, ICS ad DCS systems.

title: Career Counsellor | Meerut
description:
**Company Description** 
 iDreamCareer (iDC) is India’s most trusted career guidance brand, working with leading education boards, private schools, and government institutions to empower students in making informed career choices. As the Technical Partner to CBSE and the first career guidance company to feature on Shark Tank India, iDC has a strong track record of innovation and impact. Its AI\-powered platforms, including BlueSpring for private schools and PathShila for government schools, support millions of students through structured guidance programs. Powered by iDC ONE, India’s advanced career guidance AI, iDC collaborates with a large network of independent career counsellors, companies, and institutions. The iDC Council, with over 5,550 active certified counsellors trained in partnership with Boston University’s Wheelock College, reflects iDC’s commitment to building a world where every child can pursue a joyful and meaningful career.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 \-
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 : Contractual (Full Time)
 



**Contract Duration:** 
 till Jan 2027
 



**Locations:** 
 Meerut, UP
 



  





**Role Summary** 





 The Counsellor will support career guidance and student engagement initiatives by coordinating with schools, conducting AI Career Awareness sessions, maintaining data records, and managing assigned assets. This is a field\-based role that requires daily travel to schools and educational institutions within the assigned city.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. School Coordination** 



* Coordinate regularly with school authorities, teachers, and designated school contacts.
* Schedule and manage AI Career Awareness sessions.
* Ensure smooth communication between the organization and partner schools.
* Support the planning and execution of school\-based activities and events.



**2\. AI Career Awareness Sessions** 



* Conduct AI Career Awareness sessions using the organization's portal, videos, and learning resources.
* Guide students on emerging career opportunities, future skills, and technology trends.
* Facilitate student participation and address basic queries during sessions.
* Ensure proper setup and operation of audiovisual equipment during presentations.



**3\. Data Management \& MIS Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate daily records of activities, school visits, and student participation.
* Update MIS reports and databases on a regular basis.
* Ensure timely submission of reports and documentation.
* Track program outcomes and maintain relevant records.



**4\. Asset Management** 



* Manage and maintain assigned assets responsibly.
* Ensure proper usage, safety, and upkeep of equipment.
* Report any damage, loss, or maintenance requirements promptly.
* Maintain records of asset allocation and utilization.



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Graduate or pursuing Graduation in any discipline.
* Willingness to work in the field on a daily basis.
* Open to travelling extensively within the city for school visits and program implementation.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable operating audiovisual equipment such as projectors, speakers, microphones, TVs, and displays.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to coordinate effectively with schools and manage multiple tasks.
* Strong organizational, reporting, and documentation skills.



**Preferred Attributes** 



* Interest in education, career counselling, and emerging technologies.
* Ability to engage and interact confidently with students.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, and responsible attitude.
* Ability to work independently and meet assigned targets.



**Key Requirement** 





 This is primarily a field\-based role. The selected candidate will be required to travel daily within the assigned city, visit schools, conduct awareness sessions, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure smooth execution of program activities.
 




  





**Reporting To** 




  





**Program Coordinator / Project Manager**

title: Backend Developer
description:
We are looking for a Backend Developer with 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Node.js and Python to join our engineering team. You will build and maintain server\-side applications, RESTful APIs, database systems, and business logic. You will work closely with frontend developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful or GraphQL APIs using Node.js and Python.
* Build server\-side logic and application workflows.

* Design clean database schemas and write optimized queries.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Develop secure authentication and authorization systems using JWT, OAuth, or similar methods.
* Connect third\-party services such as payment gateways, cloud storage, and messaging platforms.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Implement caching solutions such as Redis when required.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews.
* Troubleshoot bugs and production issues.
* Work with frontend developers, product managers, and DevOps teams.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum meetings, requirement discussions, and effort estimation.



  





**Required Skills** 



* 2\+ years of professional experience in backend development with Node.js and/or Python.
* Strong knowledge of modern JavaScript and ES6\+.
* Good knowledge of Python programming and backend development.
* Good understanding of asynchronous programming, Promises, Async/Await, and the Node.js Event Loop.
* Hands\-on experience with Express.js, NestJS, FastAPI, Django, Flask, or similar frameworks.
* Strong understanding of RESTful API development.
* Experience with middleware, error handling, authentication, and API security.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar databases.
* Knowledge of database schema design and query optimization.
* Experience with ORM/ODM tools such as Prisma, TypeORM, Mongoose, Sequelize, SQLAlchemy, or Django ORM.
* Knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or Insomnia.
* Basic understanding of Docker and Linux.
* Familiarity with CI/CD and deployment processes.
* TypeScript experience is preferred.



  





**Tools and Technologies** 



* Node.js
* Python
* Express.js / NestJS
* FastAPI / Django / Flask
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* PostgreSQL / MySQL / MongoDB
* Prisma / TypeORM / Mongoose / Sequelize
* SQLAlchemy / Django ORM
* REST API / GraphQL
* Redis
* JWT / OAuth
* Git / GitHub
* Postman / Insomnia
* Docker
* Linux
* Jest / Mocha / Pytest
* CI/CD pipelines



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of professional backend development experience.
* Experience working on production\-grade Node.js and/or Python applications.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good understanding of software development practices.
* Ability to work independently as well as with a development team.



  





**What We Expect** 



* Write clean, structured, and maintainable code.
* Take ownership of assigned backend features and tasks.
* Understand requirements and convert them into practical technical solutions.
* Follow coding standards and development best practices.
* Test your work before delivery.
* Communicate clearly with team members and stakeholders.
* Be willing to learn new technologies and improve your technical skills.
* Take responsibility for resolving issues and delivering tasks within agreed timelines.



  





**Location Requirement** 



* Kerala\-based candidates only

title: AI Engineer – Agentic AI & Cloud Discovery
description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Start Date:** 
 November 2026
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4\+ years
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 The engineering organization is scaling rapidly in India, with two AI Engineer openings focused on turning AI and machine learning capabilities into
 **reliable, production\-grade security products** 
 .
   

  

 We're looking for engineers who are equally comfortable building
 **production services in Go** 
 and developing
 **LLM/ML pipelines in Python** 
 , with the ability to move quickly from experimentation to hardened production systems.
   

  

 You'll join one of two workstreams:
   

  

* Agentic AI Forensics: Turn agent traces, prompts, tool calls, and security events into structured, explainable findings for security analysts using LLM reasoning, RAG, structured extraction, and rigorous evaluation.
* Cloud Discovery: Classify cloud resources and workloads to identify AI agents, model endpoints, and AI\-enabled applications, while inferring their purpose and security risk using LLM/ML classification at scale.


 Both workstreams share the same foundations:
 **Go for production services, Python for experimentation and data pipelines, LLM APIs, rigorous evaluation, and cloud\-native deployment.**
 What You'll Do
   

  

* Design and build LLM\-powered analysis and classification pipelines, then productionize them as Go services.
* Prototype approaches in Python, including prompting strategies, RAG, structured extraction, and ML classifiers, and ship solutions that meet defined accuracy targets.
* Define ground\-truth datasets, evaluation metrics, and regression suites to continuously measure and improve model quality.
* Monitor model quality and drift in production and build processes to identify and address degradation.
* Collaborate with security researchers to translate attack patterns and risk signals into detection and summarization logic.
* Integrate AI\-powered capabilities with event, storage, and UI layers to surface actionable results to security teams.
* Use AI\-assisted development workflows to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and experimentation.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years shipping LLM\- or ML\-backed features to production.
* Strong Go skills for production backend services and strong Python skills for experimentation and data pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and RAG.
* Experience evaluating LLM/ML systems through offline evaluations, human review, regression suites, or similar approaches.
* Understanding of AI agent architectures, including tool calling, MCP or similar protocols, multi\-step planning, and common failure modes.
* Experience with cloud\-native deployment using Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable using modern AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar. This is a must\-have.
* Strong ownership and the ability to work independently in a remote\-first, distributed environment.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Background in security analytics, SIEM/SOAR, or digital forensics.
* Practical knowledge of major cloud provider APIs, IAM models, and resource inventory.
* Experience with vector databases, embedding pipelines, or model fine\-tuning for classification or extraction.
* Familiarity with tracing AI applications and OpenTelemetry\-style observability.
* Previous experience in cybersecurity, security tooling, or trust \& safety.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted or agentic development workflows across engineering teams.


 AI\-First Engineering
   

  

 AI is a core part of the engineering workflow on this team.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in real\-world software development, including the tools you use, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed the way you work.
   

  

 We're looking for engineers who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for quality, productivity, and problem\-solving** 
 , not simply as an autocomplete tool.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Work on a greenfield product at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
* Turn cutting\-edge LLM/ML approaches into production systems protecting enterprise customers.
* Work across both AI experimentation and production engineering, from Python prototypes to Go services.
* Take ownership of a key workstream and influence architecture from an early stage.
* Collaborate with a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of the development process.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
   

  

 In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Coretek is looking for a Data Engineer to build and operate the pipelines and data models that the rest of the business runs on. You'll own ingestion from source systems through to curated, well\-documented datasets that analysts, data scientists, and application teams depend on. This is a hands\-on engineering role: you'll write production code, design schemas, and be accountable for the reliability and cost of what you ship.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines that are idempotent, observable, and recoverable
* Model data for analytics (dimensional models, semantic layers, and curated marts), balancing query performance against maintainability
* Integrate data from operational databases, SaaS APIs, files, and event streams, including handling schema drift and late\-arriving data
* Build data quality checks (freshness, volume, uniqueness, referential integrity) into pipelines rather than bolting them on afterward, and define how failures alert and escalate
* Own pipelines in production: monitoring, on\-call rotation for data incidents, root\-cause analysis, and backfills
* Tune performance and cost (partitioning, clustering, file sizing, warehouse and cluster sizing) and make the tradeoffs explicit
* Apply engineering discipline to data: version control, code review, CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure as code
* Implement access controls, PII handling, retention, and lineage and audit requirements in partnership with security and compliance
* Partner with analysts, data scientists, and product engineers to turn ambiguous requirements into durable data contracts
* Maintain data dictionaries, lineage, and pipeline runbooks so consumers can find a dataset, understand what each field means and how current it is, and use it correctly without having to ask the team that built it


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years building production data pipelines
* Strong hands\-on Python development for data engineering, with real testing, packaging, and code review practice, not scripting alone
* Working knowledge of PySpark: DataFrame and SQL APIs, joins and aggregations at scale, partitioning and shuffle behavior, and the ability to read a Spark UI to diagnose a slow or failing job
* Strong SQL: window functions, query plans, and performance tuning, not just SELECTs
* Hands\-on experience with the Azure data platform: Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse/Fabric, and ADLS
* Solid data modeling fundamentals: normalization, star schemas, slowly changing dimensions
* Git\-based workflow and experience shipping through CI/CD
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to debug a failing pipeline end to end and articulate the impact to diverse audiences, including non\-technical stakeholders
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the judgment to find the root cause of a data issue rather than patching the symptom
* Strong knowledge and experience in working with customers in a consultative approach in a technical environment


**Additional Qualifications**
* Streaming experience (Kafka, Event Hubs)
* Lakehouse formats: Delta Lake, Iceberg
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, GDPR): auditability, encryption, data residency
* Experience building data platforms for ML or supporting feature pipelines
* Proven ability to manage multiple client projects and deliver high\-quality results on time
* Experience in Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control and pipelines

title: Global Senior Domain Solution Architect Enterprise Platforms
description:
Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!
   

  

 We are looking for a Global Senior Domain Solution Architect, Enterprise Platforms, to lead the architecture and evolution of shared technology platforms that enable enterprise workflow, automation, cloud\-native application capabilities, DevOps, IT service management, and reusable cross\-functional services. This role ensures enterprise platforms are scalable, secure, compliant, cost\-efficient, and aligned with business strategy and enterprise architecture principles.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  

* Contribute to the development and evolution of the target architecture, technology roadmap, and reusable architecture standards for shared enterprise platforms, including workflow and service management, automation, DevOps, low\-code/no\-code, cloud platform services, and other reusable technology capabilities.
* Develop solution architectures for the implementation, modernization, consolidation, integration, and continuous evolution of platforms within the Enterprise Platforms domain.
* Deliver architecture services, governance activities, architecture modeling, and documentation across global programs, projects, product teams, and platform initiatives, including conceptual and logical architectures, platform blueprints, capability maps, technology standards, and architecture decision records.
* Define and apply reusable architecture patterns, principles, standards, and reference architectures to improve platform consistency, interoperability, scalability, reuse, and long\-term maintainability.
* Evaluate platform capabilities, identify technology gaps and functional overlaps, and provide recommendations regarding platform adoption, modernization, consolidation, rationalization, or retirement.
* Support platform ownership and product teams in defining platform boundaries, shared services, technology roadmaps, lifecycle strategies, and non\-functional requirements while promoting platform reuse, standardization, automation, and self\-service capabilities.
* Ensure platform architectures meet enterprise requirements for cybersecurity, data privacy, resilience, availability, business continuity, disaster recovery, GxP, and other applicable regulatory, quality, and compliance frameworks.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure and Cloud, Data and Analytics, Integration, SAP, business application teams, vendors, and implementation partners to ensure architectural alignment, validate platform capabilities, and advise on emerging technologies and platform innovations relevant to Sandoz.


**Key Performance Indicator**
* Consistent, well\-governed, secure, resilient, and cost\-effective enterprise platform architectures supported by documented target architectures, technology roadmaps, standards, reusable architecture patterns, increased platform reuse and standardization, reduced technology duplication, and clearly defined ownership boundaries.


**Essential Requirements**
**What You'll Bring to the Role:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; master's degree preferred.
* 5\+ years of IT experience, including experience in solution, platform, domain, or enterprise architecture roles.
* Experience designing, governing, or evolving shared enterprise technology platforms within complex global organizations.
* Practical experience with enterprise platform technologies, including IT service management, enterprise workflow, automation, low\-code/no\-code, DevOps, cloud application platforms, container platforms, and developer enablement capabilities.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture concepts, including platform\-as\-a\-service, container orchestration, cloud\-native application services, identity and access management, observability, resilience, shared cloud services, and hybrid technology environments.
* Understanding of DevOps and software delivery capabilities, including source code management, CI/CD, artifact management, automated testing, infrastructure as code, platform engineering practices, and modern application delivery approaches.
* Ability to define platform boundaries, identify capability overlaps, translate business and technology requirements into scalable platform architectures and roadmaps, and apply architecture tools and modeling techniques such as ArchiMate, UML, BPMN, and SAP LeanIX.
* Knowledge of non\-functional architecture requirements, including cybersecurity, privacy, availability, performance, scalability, interoperability, business continuity, disaster recovery, supportability, applicable regulatory and quality frameworks (including GxP, data integrity, data privacy, and computerized system lifecycle requirements), combined with strong consulting, stakeholder management, communication, and enterprise architecture skills; fluent in English.


**Desirable Requirements**
* Experience working across SaaS, PaaS, cloud, and on\-premises environments, collaborating with application, data, integration, security, infrastructure, and operations teams.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, life sciences, or other highly regulated industries.


**You'll Receive**
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* Flexible and hybrid working opportunities.
* Ongoing learning, professional development, and certification support.
* Exposure to global security and technology initiatives.
* Career growth opportunities within a dynamic and evolving global organization.
* An inclusive, collaborative, and purpose\-driven work environment.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

**Join us!**

**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced RMA Systems Engineer to analyze, diagnose, and resolve complex hardware and system level failures across our cloud infrastructure platform. This role is responsible for evaluating failure patterns across GPU, CPU, and server environments, determining appropriate remediation strategies, and improving how Vultr manages hardware lifecycle and vendor interactions. The ideal candidate brings strong systems\-level troubleshooting expertise and the ability to analyze non\-routine technical issues, determine root cause, and make informed decisions on repair, replacement, or escalation paths.
   

  

 This is a highly visible role that partners closely with Infrastructure, Engineering, and Vendor teams to ensure system reliability and continuous improvement of Vultr’s RMA processes. It will also require the ability to adapt to the latest technology, help drive resolutions for never before seen issues and develop documentation as the technology evolves. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze GPU/CPU hardware failures by evaluating system logs, performance data, firmware behavior, and workload interactions to determine root cause.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting across hardware, firmware, and operating system layers to validate faults and identify appropriate remediation paths.
* Serve as a technical liaison with hardware vendors, providing detailed diagnostic data, interpreting vendor responses, and influencing resolution strategies.
* Determine and coordinate on\-site hardware remediation activities based on technical analysis, system impact, and priority, including guiding vendors and internal teams on appropriate repair or replacement actions.
* Evaluate software and firmware versions to identify compatibility issues or contributing factors to system failures.
* Validate and certify system stability and readiness prior to returning hardware to production environments.
* Identify recurring failure patterns and recommend improvements to RMA workflows, vendor processes, and hardware lifecycle management.
* Create and maintain detailed technical documentation, including failure analysis, troubleshooting methodologies, and resolution outcomes.
* Manage and contribute to technical case documentation within vendor portals, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with diagnostic findings.


**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience managing RMA processes or hardware logistics in a technical environment.
* Experience using Jira to manage, track, and document technical issues, RMA cases, and vendor escalations, including maintaining accurate and audit\-ready case records.
* Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting complex hardware and system\-level issues in a data center or infrastructure environment.
* Experience in RMA workflows, hardware lifecycle management, or infrastructure support.
* Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA and/or AMD GPU technologies.
* Familiarity with analyzing system logs, firmware behavior, and performance metrics to determine root cause.
* Experience working with hardware vendors and managing technical escalations or support cases.
* Strong understanding of server hardware, system architecture, and data center operations.
* Ability to analyze technical issues, apply judgment, and determine appropriate resolution paths.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in documenting technical findings and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and vendor support portals.
* Experience working with microcloud or distributed infrastructure environments, including understanding of system architecture and hardware integration.
* Experience supporting or analyzing systems within data center environments, including hardware lifecycle, performance, and reliability considerations.

 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

title: Senior Agilist - Product Group (Banking Foundation)
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Product Senior Agilist owns the delivery and transformation system for a Product Group, ensuring predictable execution across multiple Agile Teams, and manages the Team Agilists in the Product Group, ensuring consistent execution discipline, system transparency, and continuous advancement of Radiance maturity. This role ensures that flow, alignment, and continuous improvement are established at the Product Group level. Acting as the facilitator of cross\-team events and a coach for product, design and engineering leadership, the Product Agilist drives the product transformation, orchestrates planning and delivery across teams, resolves systemic impediments, leads risk management, and ensures that practices are consistent with organizational standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish and operate the Product Group planning and execution cadence, including PI Planning, Release Management, Work Intake governance, and Inspect \& Adapt.
* Lead transformation and execution of a Product (team of teams). Cultivate and lead high\-performing, cross\-functional teams by leveraging exceptional communication and employing advanced coaching and mentoring techniques
* Effectively leading global products involves managing relationships at an enterprise level, cultivating long\-term, mutually beneficial relationships to enhance the outcomes of products at scale
* Support alignment across multiple Agile Teams by making dependencies visible, escalating systemic impediments, manage cross\-team risks, and driving coordinated delivery.
* Partner with Product, Design and Engineering Managers to ensure clarity of priorities, effective planning, and risk mitigation.
* Serve as a member of the Product Group Leadership Team (PLT).
* Help the Product Group team integrate with the Portfolio and navigate complexity.
* Collaborate with Portfolio and Product Area Leadership Teams to drive Product and Portfolio success.
* Coach Product Group Managers in effective Agile road\-mapping and backlog management.
* Collaborate with other Product Group Agilists across the entire portfolio to ensure practices are consistent with organizational standards and framework.
* Lead and develop the Team Agilists within the Product Group, ensuring strong execution discipline, consistent Radiance practices, and continuous development of team\-level delivery leadership.
* Ensure transparent execution tracking across the Product Group, including readiness, delivery progress, predictability, risks, and impediments, enabling the Product Group Leadership Team to make timely decisions.Apply and improve organizational standards and identify opportunities for change.
* Coach the Product Leadership Team in Agile principles and flow\-based delivery.
* Actively participate in the Agilists Community of Practice (CoP) to share learnings and promote continuous improvement, leading areas of our practice transformation.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning within the organization to proactively build and develop its knowledge base
* Maintain transparent execution visibility for the Product Group Leadership Team through delivery metrics, risk tracking, and readiness signals.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of experience in Agile leadership, with at least 1 year having responsibility over an entire team\-of\-teams, agile program or product.
* Proven success facilitating and aligning multiple teams around shared objectives and cadences.
* Mastery of several Agile product, process and technical practices (Scrum, Kanban, XP, Crystal, Amplio).
* Demonstrable experience with and operational knowledge of several team\-of\-teams Lean and Agile methods and scaling practices (Kanban, SAFe, LeSS, Nexus, ToC).
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve systemic impediments impacting multiple teams.
* Ability to clarify their product needs, challenges, and opportunities, articulate a transformation vision, and pursue it.
* Skilled in facilitation, servant leadership, and conflict resolution.
* Experience in product development (new product introduction and mature product sustaining).
* Experience working with Product Managers and Engineering Managers in a technology\-driven environment.
* Skilled in using Agile metrics to inform decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Coached senior leaders and stakeholders (director level and above preferred)
* Led multi\-team change initiatives and coached other facilitators and change agents


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in fintech, SaaS, or other fast\-paced technology industries.
* Familiarity with lean portfolio management and product governance practices.


**Core Competencies**
* Facilitation at Scale – Brings together multiple teams and functions to align on objectives and outcomes.
* Servant Leadership – Builds trust, empowers others, and removes barriers to success.
* Coaching Mindset – Guides Team Agilists, Product Leaders, and Engineers in Agile practices.
* Systems Thinking – Recognizes interdependencies and works to optimize flow across teams.
* Continuous Improvement – Drives learning, adaptation, and the evolution of practices across the product to enhance value delivery and team maturity.


**Reporting \& Relationships**
* Reports to: Lead Agilist
* Collaborators: Product Manager, Engineering Manager(s), Team Agilists, Designers
* Peers: Other Product Agilists


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Specialist, Business Analysis
description:
**Job Posting Title: Specialist, Business Analysis**
**Level/Function: Specialist, Business Analysis**
**Overview**
 The Alternative Investments Business Analyst (BA) partners with Product Managers, Product Owners, and other BAs to help transform and scale the solution suite. The BA will translate business objectives into well\-formed backlog items, ensure shared understanding across onshore and offshore development and QA teams, and uphold delivery quality through strong requirements discipline, data insights, and ceremony support.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is highly analytical, experienced in supporting multiple priorities, and understands modern software delivery practices including Agile methodologies, backlog management, requirements engineering, continuous improvement, release planning, and stakeholder collaboration. You will help turn business needs into actionable requirements and support effective delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Responsible for business requirements gathering, functional design, providing support of user acceptance testing, and project implementation. This position will interact with all levels of the organization to ensure timely completion with the highest degree of quality for industry, regulatory, and client initiatives. Core responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Gather user requirements from external/internal clients via User Requirements Documentation and/or end\-user interviews
* Participate in project estimation process
* Build relationships with various external and internal stakeholders
* Along with stakeholders and technical development staff, create functional design documents based upon user requirements
* Work with QA/QE to create a strong test plan to ensure project quality
* Validate that completed work meets Definition of Done (acceptance criteria satisfied; code reviewed; unit/integration tests passed; security checks; documentation updated; feature toggles; deployment notes, etc.).
* Support UAT and post\-release monitoring; analyze defects and usage outcomes to drive backlog improvements.
* Report project status to stakeholders as well as project management or senior executives
* Develop an expertise in retail alternative investments, including private equity, private credit, hedge funds, non\-traded REITs, and interval funds, and the industry ecosystem for processing these products (e.g., DTCC AIP, InvestCloud Private Markets Network, CAIS, SS\&C AltServ).


**Your Experience**
* 6\-8 years of professional experience in a Business Analysis role, preferably in financial services.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Business, or a related field.
* Experience in writing client facing documents such as scope documents, functional documents, use cases as well as Acceptance criteria is preferred.
* Able to understand and communicate simple to somewhat involved technical concepts.
* Excellent analytical problem solving, organization, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment.
* Willing to learn and adopt new technologies.
* Able to work autonomously and in teams, excited by new technologies and industry initiatives, and will never back down from the challenges of scale.
* Experience building successful client and internal team relationships.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in US English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with US\-based teams.
