**Job Description**
**Position Purpose:**
 As Regional Launch Director, you'll be accountable for maximizing the value of the launch, leading development and execution of E2E plan through cross functional collaboration. Contributes to the development and execution of the strategic regional launch plan, tactical program development and implementation including marketing mix and operational plans that optimize sales, market share and revenue growth in the short and long term. Commercial launch readiness is achieved through close collaboration with Commercial teams in market, and with close collaboration and support from Platforms, Development, BD, Regulatory, IP/Legal, STO and ESO.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

* Proactively lead the development and implementation of strategic regional launch readiness.
* Monitor the launch performance, competitive environment to quickly identify plan changes.
* Manage ROI assessments of tactical programs \& through collaboration with Commercial Leadership, develop and execute action plans to address competitive threats and/ or exogenous market events, maximizing pipeline value.
* Engage with other functional teams to ensure operational launch readiness of Region SIR launches and ensure E2E coordination to maximize commercial opportunities.
* Collaborate with Platforms on critical issues related to market commercialization, aligning as appropriate to their global product launch strategy.
* Together with Supply Chain and Platforms, drive decisions for regional product allocations if needed, at\-risk manufacturing and API purchases to optimize upsides and mitigate risk.
* Provide leadership to the market team and extended functional launch team members including coaching, advising, and developing team members
* Ensure compliance with Sandoz policies and procedures and full integration into the Sandoz culture and support resources
* Perform other duties as required by the Region from time to time.


**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**
* A minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical industry experience in the GLP\-1 or Biosimilar field
* Sales/commercial leadership and mindset
* Sound Project Management experience (min 5 years)
* Hands\-on approach combined with business acumen, strategic thinking, and pragmatism
* Experience in managing/leading cross\-functional matrix teams
* Excellent communication and relationship management skills
* Stakeholder engagement with respect for different cultures and diverse groups.


**Why Sandoz?**
 Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100\+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human rightof access to good healthcare.
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
   

  

**Skills Desired**
 Agility, Brand Awareness, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Customer Engagement, Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Data Strategy, Digital Marketing, Go\-To\-Market Strategy, Influencing Skills, Inspirational Leadership, Marketing Strategy, Media Campaigns, People Management, Product Marketing, Product Roadmap, Return on Investment (ROI), Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Marketing

title: Financial Inclusion District Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vedavaag Systems Ltd is a technology\-driven company headquartered in India, focusing on innovative solutions that support governance, financial services, and inclusive growth. The organization works closely with public and private sector partners to extend essential services to underserved and rural communities. Vedavaag Systems Ltd emphasizes operational efficiency, customer\-centric service delivery, and sustainable models that promote financial inclusion. The company offers opportunities for professionals interested in social impact, technology\-enabled service delivery, and expanding access to financial services across diverse regions in India.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Financial Inclusion District Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Telangana, India. This role oversees district\-level financial inclusion initiatives, including planning, implementing, and monitoring programs that extend banking and financial services to underserved communities. The person in this role will manage field teams, coordinate with partner banks and agencies, track performance against outreach and service targets, and ensure compliance with relevant policies and guidelines. Daily responsibilities include reviewing operational reports, resolving escalated issues, conducting site visits, facilitating community engagement activities, and ensuring quality customer service and data accuracy. The District Manager will also promote inclusive practices, support training and capacity building for staff, and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and service delivery.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong Program Management and Project Management skills to plan, execute, and monitor district\-level financial inclusion initiatives.
* Experience in Diversity \& Inclusion and Employee Engagement to foster an inclusive, motivated, and high\-performing field workforce.
* Excellent Communication skills, including the ability to collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and community stakeholders.
* Background in banking, financial services, or financial inclusion programs is highly beneficial.
* Ability to analyze data, prepare performance reports, and use insights to drive improvements in outreach and service quality.
* Proven people\-management experience, including supervising field teams and conducting training and performance evaluations.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, social sciences, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site across district locations in Telangana and willingness to travel within the assigned region as needed.

title: Manager - Transaction Services
description:
With experience gained from thousands of transactions, our teams provide insightful analysis, thorough plans, and impactful execution before and after the deal closes. Riveron delivers solutions throughout the transaction lifecycle, allowing us to partner at a much deeper level to maximize long\-term value.
   

  

 A comprehensive understanding of the financial data and operational issues underlying M\&A is critical to a successful outcome. Riveron enables executives to make informed decisions by identifying risks and opportunities unique to each transaction.
   

  

 Riveron’s full spectrum of M\&A capabilities includes Buy\-side Due Diligence, Sell\-Side Due Diligence, Operational Due Diligence, Transaction Tax, Lender Services, Integration Services, opening Balance Sheet \& Financial Reporting, and Distressed Transaction Services.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You excel at building, nurturing, and sustaining strong client relationships.
* You consistently deliver high\-quality results while maintaining a positive and engaging work style.
* You perform well in fast\-paced, dynamic environments and adapt quickly to change.
* You proactively identify challenges and naturally seek effective solutions.
* You bring strong analytical abilities along with clear, persuasive written and verbal communication skills.
* You enjoy contributing to firm\-wide initiatives, including community service, training, recruitment, and company events.
* You are willing and able to travel as required.


**What You’ll Do**
* Use financial acumen, including knowledge of accounting standards such as GAAP, to assist clients on a variety of financial and tax issues associated with M\&A transactions.
* Draft EBITDA tables with supporting calculations and networking capital analysis while factoring in the underlying metrics of the business.
* Lead management meetings for due diligence projects.
* Highlight the risks and opportunities associated with gross margins, working capital requirements, or synergy assessments.
* Coordinate and manage engagements throughout the transaction life cycle.
* Participate actively in the development of junior team members by providing coaching and performance feedback and fostering a team\-based working culture.


**Qualifications**
* CPA/CA/MBA Finance/ Bachelor’s or Master’s in Accounting
* Minimum 5\-7 years of relevant experience, including 2 years of transaction experience focused on quality of earnings, networking capital, and cash flows

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**Analyst – GBS Finance Planning \& Performance Management
   

  

 Location: Benguluru, Karnataka**
**Role Overview**
 The Analyst will support the GBS Finance Planning \& Performance Management agenda across GCC India, GCC Mexico, broader GBS zones, non\-GCC components including NA, EPDM, WHQ, external vendor/tower ecosystems, and partners such as Genpact. The role will assist in preparing AOP and LE inputs, monthly reporting, variance analysis, accrual and true\-up support, intercompany recharge tracking, cross\-zone cost transfer coordination, and leadership review materials. This position is expected to work closely with finance managers, GBS stakeholders, accounting, procurement, vendor teams, and controllership to ensure accurate data, timely reporting, clear documentation, and smooth execution of core finance processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Financial planning and reporting support: Support AOP, LE, forecasting, and performance reporting activities for the assigned GBS scope, including data consolidation, budget input preparation, variance analysis, and review deck support.
* AOP and LE process coordination: Assist with budget tracker maintenance, cost center and package\-level data checks, service cost assumptions, upload templates, review comments, and follow\-ups required for timely submissions.
* Stakeholder coordination: Work with GCC, GBS zone, NA, EPDM, WHQ, tower, vendor, and finance stakeholders to collect inputs, validate movements, track open items, and support resolution of planning and reporting queries.
* Vendor and tower cost support: Assist in validating vendor cost data, Genpact inputs, billing trends, commitments, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, invoice details, and budget adherence for assigned areas.
* Management reporting support: Prepare and update GBS MBR, AOP, LE, variance, and performance review files by converting financial data into clear summaries, bridges, commentary, risks, opportunities, and pending action trackers.
* Accounting and control support: Support accruals, reclasses, true\-ups, intercompany recharges, cost allocations, and cross\-zone transfer documentation in coordination with accounting, controllership, and finance stakeholders.
* Process discipline and documentation: Maintain trackers, working files, supporting schedules, audit trails, and standard process documentation to ensure accuracy, repeatability, and timely execution of finance activities.


**Core Process Scope / Supporting Activities**
 This role supports finance operations for the broader GBS planning and reporting agenda, including GCC and non\-GCC components across GBS zones, NA, EPDM, WHQ, commercial management activities, PR/PO tracking, vendor invoice validation, intercompany recharge support, monthly accruals, GBS MBR reporting, LE updates, NA Services Package AOP uploads, yearly tracker maintenance, and Tier 1 project actuals tracking. The Analyst will be responsible for maintaining accurate files, coordinating inputs, performing initial data checks, highlighting variances, and supporting timely follow\-up with stakeholders.
   

  

**Experience Profile**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or related field; MBA, CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent finance qualification will be an advantage.
* 5\+ years of experience in FP\&A, commercial finance, shared services finance, ZBB, GBS finance, accounting support, reporting, vendor cost tracking, or financial planning operations.
* Basic understanding of AOP, LE, forecasting, monthly close, variance analysis, accruals, recharge, cost center reporting, and management reporting processes.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with SAP HANA, financial reporting tools, Power BI, or planning systems will be preferred.
* Ability to work with large data sets, perform reconciliations, identify variances, maintain trackers, and summarize findings clearly for manager review.
* Good communication and collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate across finance, accounting, procurement, vendor, and business stakeholders in a global environment.
* Detail\-oriented approach with the ability to meet timelines, follow standard processes, document assumptions, and escalate risks or open items in a timely manner.


 Location(s)
   

  

 Bengaluru \- Brookfield GCC

description:

* 4 years of experience in treasury, corporate finance, investment banking, or a management consulting role.


**Preferred qualifications:**

 Financial Analysts ensure that Google makes sound financial decisions. * Advocate AI and automation best practices within Treasury, proactively researching emerging technologies to drive continuous improvement in departmental standards and practices.

 Are you energized by turning numbers into narratives that shape strategic decisions? Our Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) team sits at the heart of the business, partnering with senior leaders to drive profitability, efficiency, and smart growth. As a
 **Senior Associate, Central Expense \& Headcount** 
 , you'll own two of our most important financial levers—
 **headcount and expenses** 
 —and translate complex data into insights that influence how the line of business operates and invests.
   

  

 Candidates Profile: The ideal candidate is a finance professional who combines strong analytical capability with business curiosity and stakeholder engagement. The individual should be comfortable working through financial planning, expense analysis, reporting and decision support. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys understanding business drivers, solving problems, improving processes, and providing insights that help senior stakeholders make informed decisions.

* Lead transformation — Champion process improvement, automation, and dashboarding initiatives that elevate how the team works.
* Shape the reporting roadmap — Drive the analysis, design, and development of Expense and Headcount reporting from concept to delivery.


**Required Qualification**
* MBA, CA, CFA, CPA, Post Graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: Planning \& Analysis / FP\&A, CFO support or business finance, Corporate finance, Expense management, Financial reporting and management reporting, Financial research or valuation, Banking, financial services, consulting, or analytics
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; hands\-on experience with Essbase or any financial reporting system.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex issues and present financial insights clearly to senior audiences.
* A highly motivated self\-starter with strong time\-management and prioritization skills, able to thrive under tight deadlines.

**Nice To Have (Preferred)**

* Experience with Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Alteryx, Power BI).
* Programming or automation skills (e.g., Python, SQL, VBA) to support process automation.

title: Risk - Credit Risk - Vice President - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**Who We Are**
 At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.
   

  

**Divisional Overview**
 The Risk division is responsible for credit, market and operational risk, model risk, independent liquidity risk, and insurance throughout the firm. Whether assessing the creditworthiness of the firm’s counterparties, monitoring market risks associated with trading activities, or offering analytical and regulatory compliance support, our work contributes directly to the firm’s success. The division is ideal for collaborative individuals who have strong ethics and attention to detail.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Credit Risk (CR) is responsible for managing the firm’s credit exposure to its trading and lending counterparties. Leveraging its extensive expertise in financial, credit and risk analysis, CR ensures that credit exposure to our counterparts is managed within the firm’s risk appetite. Staffed with more than 300 professionals, CR operates through 11 different offices around the world and credit professionals work closely with many areas of the firm. Given this structure, CR professionals gain diverse financial experience and a broad perspective on how the entire firm functions. The interaction with numerous departments and the range of projects that ensue allow for a challenging, varied and multi\-dimensional work environment.
   

  

**Credit Research Group**
 Credit Research Group plays a key role in assessing the credit and financial strength of corporate, financial institution, and sovereign counterparties by performing fundamental credit analysis through writing research reviews (covering both the counterparty and industry in which the counterparty transacts). This team is also responsible for the ongoing surveillance of all corporate/financial institution/sovereign counterparties, assignment of internal credit ratings, and participation in regulatory exams.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Qualifications**
**Responsibilities**
**Performing Counterparty Analysis And Risk Management**
* Assess the credit and financial strength of the firm's corporate borrowers and counterparts by performing fundamental credit analysis of counterparties using both quantitative and qualitative factors
* Review and provide recommendations for loan transactions, determine appetite and regulatory ratings, monitor credit trends in the portfolio, perform distressed analysis and estimate potential impairments
* Analyze the credit implications on corporate clients of various financial transactions including debt, equity and hybrid offerings, mergers and acquisitions, restructuring and share repurchases
* Build and maintain financial projection models
* Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership and answer questions relating to analysis performed
* Monitor counterparties for changes in creditworthiness and take appropriate action
* Perform portfolio\-level stress testing and scenario analysis to evaluate the impact of macroeconomic shocks on counterparty creditworthiness and portfolio performance.
* (Good to have) Demonstrated ability to design, test, and refine structured prompts—utilizing prompting techniques to guide Large Language Models (LLMs) in analyzing unstructured data sources, extracting key financial metrics


**Other Key Responsibilities Include**
* Working collaboratively with Risk Engineering colleagues to continually identify and solve for operating efficiency


 This position description is intended to describe the duties most frequently performed by an individual in this position. It is not intended to be a complete list of assigned duties but to describe a position level. The role shall be performed within a professional office environment. Goldman Sachs has health and safety polices that are available for all workers upon request. There are no specific health risks associate with the role.
   

  

* Spreading historical and projected financials in Credit systems and performing analysis including peer comparison to identify and document trends and anomalies necessary in assessing creditworthiness
* Coordinate with global colleagues in GS Risk teams as well as with other divisions
* Support key Risk governance and approval committees


**Qualifications**
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in business or finance, Masters preferred
* 7\-10 years of experience in a related corporate credit risk role with experience in credit analysis, ratings analysis, corporate finance and/or research desired
* Functional background or relevant experience in finance and accounting
* Highly motivated with strong academic background
* Team player with an ability to work effectively with colleagues in other regional offices
* Flexibility, ability to learn quickly
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments concurrently
* Familiarity with regulatory rating requirements and application of such guidance is preferred
* Strong analytical, presentational and communication skills require


**About Goldman Sachs**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

description:

title: Finance Associate
description:
**Position Overview** 




 We do not have a finance function yet. Revenue arrives in USD, most of our creator payments go out in USD, and everything in between is currently held together by founders, an external CA firm, and a handful of operational workarounds. This role exists to change that. You will bring day\-to\-day finance in\-house and build the systems that let the business run without the founders in the weeds.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own the full USD\-INR cycle end to end: inbound remittances, documentation, outbound creator payments, and cutting forex conversion losses at every step.
* Run internal payroll and creator payouts on a fixed cadence, calculated, checked, and on time, across a large base of US\-based creators and the internal team.
* Build a management information system that reflects how the business actually operates, and reconcile it against the books of accounts and bank cash flows.
* Manage our external CA and CS partners — review their work, catch errors, and keep GST, TDS, FEMA, and statutory filings on track.
* Track invoices raised against receivables collected and flag collection risk early.
* Hunt down cost leaks — bank commissions, idle cash, avoidable consultant spend — and propose better structures with clear trade\-offs.
* Write finance and admin SOPs from scratch where none exist, and rebuild the ones that no longer hold.
* Own finance and administration operations end to end, escalating only what genuinely needs a founder decision.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




**Must\-Have** 



* CA, CPA, or ACCA — completed or actively tracking toward it.
* **CA freshers post\-articleship are welcome; other backgrounds should bring roughly one to three years of relevant experience.**
* Working command of accounting fundamentals and what the numbers actually mean for a business, not just how they are calculated.
* Practical understanding of GST, TDS, and cross\-border payment documentation.
* Ability to define a problem and its constraints end to end before reaching for a solution.
* Clear, fluent English — you will interact directly with US\-based creators, vendors, and partners.
* Comfort building process from scratch in an environment that is still being figured out.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Exposure to cross\-border remittances, treasury, or forex cost optimisation.
* Experience in a high\-growth startup or an execution\-heavy advisory or transaction\-services team.
* Hands\-on experience preparing an MIS and reconciling it with the books.
* Familiarity with payroll and creator or vendor payout platforms.



  





**Logistics** 



* **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
* **Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
* **Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
* **Department:** 
 Finance and Administration
* **Working Pattern:** 
 Six\-day work week for the coming months
* **Experience:** 
 CA freshers post\-articleship, or one to three years for other backgrounds

title: Senior Accountant, Statutory Reporting
description:
**The opportunity**
 Unity’s Accounting team is looking for a highly skilled Senior Accountant to be an integral part of our dynamic, global finance organization. In this role, you will serve as the crucial gatekeeper for our Indian entity's financial compliance, bridging our global US GAAP ledger with local regulatory requirements. You will step into a tech\-forward, high\-impact environment where you will own end\-to\-end Ind AS statutory reporting, drive process engineering, and leverage modern technology to streamline GAAP\-to\-GAAP adjustments. If you are a problem\-solver who thrives at the intersection of local accounting compliance, global collaboration, and AI\-driven automation, you will find an exciting home with our team.
   

  

 You will have an immediate impact by tightening our local compliance footprint and ensuring our Indian statutory reporting is bulletproof. Working closely under the guidance of your Singapore\-based manager, you will serve as the localized expert who reviews global transactions, flags compliance issues early, and collaborates regionally on how to resolve them.
   

  

 At Unity, you’ll make a difference. In a collaborative, fast paced environment, we’re redefining development, solving hard problems, and enabling the success of our community. Inclusion at Unity is driven by one overarching framework: Empathy, Respect, and Opportunity.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* India Statutory Reporting: Drive end\-to\-end statutory financial reporting for the India entity in strict compliance with Ind AS and Schedule III of the Companies Act.
* GAAP Review \& Alignment: On a regular basis, thoroughly review global US GAAP transactions posted by other teams to understand their nature, and calculate, prepare, and post the necessary adjustments to align the financial numbers with Ind AS for local statutory purposes.
* Direct Manager Collaboration: Proactively identify and discuss any compliance issues, structural variances, or transaction anomalies with your direct manager, collaboratively developing practical solutions to resolve them.
* Tech\-Driven Problem Solving: Actively identify variances between US GAAP and Ind AS, trace them to their root cause, and resolve them by reviewing operational processes, system enhancement, and utilizing AI tools or automation to track and reconcile cross\-border data.


**What We're Looking For**
* Ind AS \& Schedule III Financial Preparation: Proven ability to independently prepare a complete set of financial statements (Balance Sheet, P\&L, Cash Flow, and Notes) in strict compliance with Ind AS and Schedule III of the Indian Companies Act, 2013\.
* US GAAP to Ind AS Reconciliation: Technical capability to analyze transactions recorded under US GAAP, map the ledger differences, and post accurate Ind AS adjustment entries.
* CARO \& Statutory Audit Management: Experience drafting audit schedules and directly addressing queries for Companies Auditor’s Report Order (CARO) clauses, including fixed assets and related\-party transaction testing.
* ERP Systems Ledger Management: Practical proficiency in executing multi\-currency reconciliations, adjusting sub\-ledgers, and managing parallel ledger configurations in ERPs

title: Asset Management/Procurement Coordinator
description:
**We Are?** 




 We are EnerMech, a specialist service company that delivers safe, integrated solutions for complex energy projects.
 



 For over 50 years, we've been energizing our clients across the world with unrivalled expertise, equipment, and technology that supports the entire asset life\-cycle offshore and on land.
 



 We enable progress through our three global business lines: Energy Solutions, Infrastructure \& Industrial Solutions, and Lifting Solutions.
 



 Within these areas, we offer a wide range of services, including cranes, lifting, fluid power, training, equipment rental, pipeline and subsea, process, and valves all designed to help our clients optimize performance, enhance reliability, and improve efficiency.
 



 With a focus on operational excellence, we deliver value through our customized integrated solutions. This approach reduces risk and enhances efficiencies making us a leading and trusted partner every step of the way.
   





**The Role and Responsibilities** 




 Job Purpose:
 



 To manage and coordinate the complete lifecycle of assets and procurement processes within the Shared Services Centre, ensure accurate data management, compliance, and operational efficiency. The role focuses on maintaining asset master data, facilitating end\-to\-end P2P workflows, and supporting cross\-functional collaboration for timely and cost\-effective outcomes.
   





 Responsibilities:
 



 Asset Management:
 


* Manage asset master data in NAV by creating/updating item cards, asset numbers, and maintaining essential records for mobilization, status, and allocation across global entities and jobs


* Ensure timely and accurate updates of resource status and inventory; maintain standardized databases for all asset\-related documents


* Facilitate end\-to\-end asset lifecycle tracking, including Load Out Lists, rental and third\-party asset updates and coordination with regional teams


* Create, manage, and track Purchase Quotations (PQs) for hire and purchase of assets in Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2009 R2, ensuring full traceability from initiation to execution


* Validate and update asset certificates in NAV, maintain job certification folders and registers, and ensure standardized document naming for maintenance records


* Prepare and deliver weekly, fortnightly, monthly, and ad hoc reports



 Procurement:
 


* Ensure timely PQ creation, PO conversion, GRN posting, and necessary amendments
* Follow up on open POs and Unposted Invoices to resolve discrepancies with AP team and requestors, thereby supporting accurate invoice processing and enabling timely payment by the finance team
* Coordinate with regional and SSC teams to optimize procurement processes, resolve discrepancies, and maintain consistency across global operations
* Maintain procurement records and prepare daily activity reports
* Initiate and monitor supplier follow\-ups for compliance documents, update NAV records for expiry tracking, and ensure proper documentation for audits
* Prepare and deliver weekly, fortnightly, monthly, and ad hoc reports
* Create and maintain SOPs for any new processes or changes in Asset Management and Procurement workflows, supporting operational efficiency and aligning with global standards and best practices



**You Are** 




 Anticipated Skills
 


* Data\-driven, detail\-oriented, with good organizational capabilities
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and critical thinking abilities, essential for asset lifecycle and procurement coordination
* Communication and stakeholder management, effectively liaising with finance, operations, logistics
* Comfortable under high\-pressure and deadline\-driven environments, with good adaptability and flexibility, and willingness to extend working hours when operational needs demand



 Experience
 


* Bachelor's degree in any stream with 2\-3 years of relevant experience
* Ability to effectively use Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PDF applications for reporting and documentation



**Diversity \& Inclusion** 




 EnerMech is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive organisation. We believe that diversity enriches our team, and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, cultures, and identities. You will have good organisational and time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines, along with effective communication skills.

**Vendor Management**

 • Conduct vendor evaluations and performance assessments.Develop and maintain strong vendor relationships.

description:

 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The fundamental purpose of this role is to drive improvement in forecast accuracy by optimizing the business processes, collaborating with business stakeholders and provide insights to the business partners (Regional Demand planners) to enhance business decisions and to support optimal service level for South East and Middle East Asian markets. This role requires you to operate in 11\.00 am to 8\.00 pm shift.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Manage forecasting and replenishment activities by maintaining accurate Sales and Stock Upload and IMS Forecast uploads, validating statistical forecasts in OMP, running Distributor Replenishment Planning and Sell\-In/Sell\-Out models, reconciling inventory gaps, and generating bottom\-up shipment plans.
* Partner with Demand Managers and distributors to develop the consensus demand plan, capture assumptions, enrich forecasts with market intelligence, analyze cycle\-over\-cycle changes, and identify risks, opportunities, and trend shifts.
* Maintain planning\-system and master\-data integrity by ensuring accurate Stock Keeping Unit and item\-planning setup, new product launches, delistings, Product Life Cycle updates, forecast volumes, control\-model and Sell\-In/Sell\-Out inputs, and timely SharePoint requests.
* Support the Sales and Operations Planning cycle by preparing Demand Review pre\-work, In\-Market Sales, Shipments, and Inventory analyses, building\-block summaries, Key Performance Indicator reports, assumption tracking, and version\-controlled monthly reporting.
* Track forecast accuracy, bias, stock availability, ageing, order\-versus\-plan, and supply\-chain Key Performance Indicators; perform root\-cause analysis for shipment forecast errors and communicate data\-driven recommendations with strong ownership, collaboration, attention to detail, and problem\-solving skills.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Education: Full Time graduation from an accredited university
* Experience: 3 years of related experience in demand planning
* Technical Skills: Operations and Demand planning process, Excel, Planning systems (like OMP/SAP/O9 etc)
* Soft Skills: Critical thinking, learning agility, ability to work in ambiguous situations and different markets, strong communication and stakeholder management.


**Preferred Qualifications**

description:

* Data Integration and Governance: Establish robust data integration processes to ensure seamless data flows between Power BI and other financial systems, while maintaining data integrity and governance standards.

* Continuous Improvement: Stay abreast of Power BI updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for process improvements, enhancements, and innovation.

* Expertise in Power BI model building, including blueprinting, module design, formula creation, and dashboard development.
* Deep understanding of financial concepts and FP\&A processes, with the ability to translate business requirements into actionable Power BI solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail and a passion for driving data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams, manage multiple priorities, and drive projects to successful completion within defined timelines.
* Prior experience in consulting and/or leading projects is a plus.
* Experience in the education industry is a plus.

Team members work in a dynamic setting that combines manufacturing, supply chain, and finance functions to support business performance. **Role Description** 
 The Financial Planning and Analysis Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for driving financial insights that support strategic and operational decision\-making. * Demonstrated ability to work on\-site in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and maintain high standards of accuracy and integrity.

 Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
   

  

 We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
   

  

 We are proud to be part of an ever\-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee\-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
   

  

 Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be brilliant.
   

  

**About The Business Unit**
 Global Delivery Services Centre (GDSC) is a high\-impact business unit within Mott MacDonald, dedicated to enhancing project delivery across our global operations.
   

  

 As part of GDSC, you’ll join a team that champions excellence in both technical and digital disciplines, supporting projects at every stage of the lifecycle—from concept to completion. We work to international design standards and regulations, ensuring our contributions meet the highest benchmarks of quality and innovation.
   

  

 At GDSC, you’ll be empowered to collaborate across borders, grow your expertise, and make a meaningful impact on infrastructure and development projects that shape communities worldwide.
   

  

**Responsibilities will include:**
* Understand the project commercials and cost management of the project including,
* Preparing budget, resource profiling
* Monitor the actual cost/hours against budget, earned value analysis
* Preparation of agreements, change control notes, invoices
* Follow up with internal clients on approval of change control notes, invoices etc.
* Preparing weekly/monthly progress reports
* Supporting Project Manager on Business Management System activities
* Understanding the existing dashboards and preparing new dashboards using power BI along with digital team
* Supporting Project Manager in their daily tasks, as \& when required
* Storing project data properly as directed by Project Manager and ensure use of standard templates, information etc. across all similar projects.
* Proactive involving in improving the processes through automation and use of digital delivery practices.


**Candidate Specification:**
* BE/ BTech or B.Com / M.Com Degree in Accounting/Finance. Any additional degree in Finance would be an added advantage.
* Minimum 6 years of experience in project control and commercial management of Infrastructure projects within the design consultancy sector.
* Having excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Flexible working**
 At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work\-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.
   

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**
* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long\-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing

title: Senior Project Control Specialist
description:
**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

***As a Senior Project Control Specialist with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
* Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.
* Develop and finalise the Project Controls Plan as per Project requirements and interface with Client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.
* Actively participate in Schedule development and guide the team to the required Planning and scheduling requirements.
* Conduct / lead Schedule workshops, IAP sessions and focus discussions on Schedule baselining and forecast exercises as required.
* Review, Tracking \& monitoring Schedule \& Critical areas through LEM and Scrums, raising the flag for the delays \& areas of concerns.
* Establish WBS and CBS required for the project as per the reporting requirements in line with the Client discussions.
* Interact with Project and department stakeholders in functional discussions and support required in delivering the Projects assigned.
* Preparation and analysis of Project performance statistics and analytics as appropriate.
* Lead to set up Project Cost reports, internal monitoring metrics and other reporting requirements.
* Monitoring \& controlling the cost by various analysis and time to time information Management about the risk areas.
* Performing Risk Analysis on the Schedule and provide inputs / recommendations.
* Generating various reports like Progress S\-curves, Lookahead Plan, Variance Analysis, Productivity Analysis.
* Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
* Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports
* Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, Concerns, and recovery plans etc.
* Work closely with the Project and Engineering managers to ensure proactive approach on addressing project performance and recovery measures all times.
* Mentor and guide junior team members and impart knowledge transfer time to time.
* Participate internal innovative forums and contribute for the Digital growth in project delivery wherever possible.
* Preparation of project cost reports and provide forecast analysis and trends of the project.
* Liaise effectively with multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaborative relationships, and ensuring alignment between planning, execution, and project objectives.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Tertiary qualifications in Graduate in Engineering/Technology.
* 12\+ years of experience in Working for similar type Projects/Industry experience.
* Proven leadership and communication skills
* Extensive experience in Oil \& Gas, energy sector \& Chemicals.
* Sound knowledge of Planning, Cost control and Monitoring.
* A dedication to client satisfaction
* Excellent relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
* You will be an enthusiastic team player, with excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive thinking and solution\-oriented delivery.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
   

  

 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work.  This is an opportunity for an experienced Senior Risk Regulatory Reporting Analyst to play a pivotal role in ensuring Citi's compliance with Indian regulatory requirements, directly shaping the quality and integrity of credit risk data submitted to the Reserve Bank of India. Based within Citi's Risk Data Analytics, Reporting and Technology function, you will own end\-to\-end regulatory reporting processes across credit bureaus, working closely with senior leadership, business teams, and oversight functions to deliver accurate, timely, and audit\-ready submissions. **Responsibilities**

* Oversee the submission of credit data to four credit bureaus, monitoring data quality metrics and taking corrective action where rejection rates or quality index scores require improvement.
* Conduct root cause analysis on data rejected by credit bureaus and present findings and improvement plans to senior management to drive measurable gains in reporting quality.
* Coordinate fortnightly resubmission of rejected credit records across all bureaus, ensuring each cycle is completed within prescribed regulatory timelines.
* Monitor and resolve customer complaints and disputes received from credit bureaus and directly from customers, liaising with the internal ombudsman function and meeting regulatory resolution deadlines.
* Issue regulatory default notifications to affected customers following each fortnightly reporting cycle, in accordance with compliance obligations.
* Partner with business, risk, and technology teams to support the implementation of compliance frameworks and respond to audit, governance review, and regulatory inspection requirements.
* Provide business analysis input to risk data platforms and tools, contributing to solutions that improve reporting efficiency and meet ad hoc regulatory requests.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with practical use of VBA for reporting automation or process efficiency.
* Clear and confident communicator at all levels, with the ability to present complex data quality findings and compliance updates to senior stakeholders.
* Track record of managing multiple concurrent regulatory deliverables without compromising accuracy or deadline adherence.

description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Senior Analyst (Data Strategy \& Acquisition)**
**Roche India \- Roche Services and Solutions**
**Hyderabad / Chennai**
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
   

  

 That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics \& technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to build deep expertise in the external healthcare data ecosystem and contribute to decisions that shape how Roche uses data to support commercial and strategic business needs in the U.S. market.
   

  

 You will be exposed to a broad range of U.S. healthcare and pharmaceutical data sources, including payer, market access, sales, claims, alerts, field, competitive intelligence, and market intelligence datasets. You will learn how these datasets are created, how they differ from one another, where they are strong, where they have limitations, and how they can be applied to real business questions.
   

  

 You will work closely with U.S. stakeholders, external data vendors, and cross\-functional Roche teams. The role provides a strong platform to develop skills in data strategy, vendor evaluation, stakeholder consultation, business problem\-solving, and structured communication.
   

  

 This opportunity is well suited for candidates with a life sciences, pharma, healthcare analytics, consulting, market research, business research, or commercial analytics background who are interested in moving into a broader data strategy and acquisition role. The role will allow you to develop the ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, assess business fit, and support informed data\-related decisions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the evaluation, acquisition, and ongoing management of external healthcare and commercial data sources used by Roche U.S. business teams
* Work with U.S. stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify use cases, and translate business questions into data requirements or evaluation criteria
* Evaluate new and existing datasets and vendors based on business relevance, data coverage, methodology, usability, quality, limitations, and fit\-for\-purpose application
* Support the assessment and maintenance of payer intelligence datasets, including sources such as MMIT and DRG Fingertip, to address commercial and market access business needs
* Support the evaluation of sales, claims, alert\-based, field, competitive intelligence, and market intelligence datasets from vendors such as IQVIA, Komodo Health, Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group, NCCN, and similar healthcare data sources
* Partner with external data vendors to understand source methodologies, resolve data\-related questions, clarify deliverables, and support timely access to high\-quality datasets
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to onboard datasets, document business requirements, track evaluation findings, and support decision\-making around data investments
* Apply structured thinking to assess whether a dataset can answer the intended business question, identify potential gaps or risks, and recommend practical next steps
* Challenge assumptions and provide constructive pushback when data sources, methodologies, or stakeholder requests may not align with the intended business objective
* Perform basic data review, profiling, validation, or exploratory analysis when needed to investigate data issues, compare data sources, or support dataset evaluation
* Develop and maintain documentation, including dataset summaries, evaluation notes, vendor comparisons, business requirements, standard operating procedures, and knowledge\-sharing materials
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying ways to make data evaluation, acquisition, documentation, and stakeholder engagement processes more efficient and consistent


**Who You Are**
* You holds a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Healthcare, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline and 5\+ years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, life sciences consulting, healthcare analytics, market research, competitive intelligence, business research, commercial analytics, or related domain
* You bring a strong foundation in life sciences, pharma, healthcare, or a related field, with the ability to understand business questions and connect them to appropriate data sources, methodologies, and decision\-making needs
* You demonstrate structured thinking, sound reasoning, and the ability to engage with stakeholders in a consultative manner. You are able to assess information objectively, ask relevant questions, identify gaps or risks, and communicate findings clearly
* You are comfortable working in a cross\-functional environment with U.S. stakeholders and external vendors, and you are motivated to build expertise in healthcare data strategy, external data evaluation, and commercial data acquisition
* Strong understanding of life sciences, pharma, healthcare, or the broader pharmaceutical industry is required
* Understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, healthcare ecosystem, drug development process, commercial landscape, or market access environment is strongly preferred
* Prior exposure to U.S. healthcare, pharmaceutical commercial data, payer data, claims data, sales data, field data, alerts, market intelligence, or competitive intelligence is an advantage
* Experience working in consulting, business research, market research, analytics, or cross\-functional project environments would be valuable


**Skills \& Capabilities**
**Must have:**
* Strong foundation in biology, life sciences, pharma, healthcare, or the pharmaceutical industry
* Ability to understand business questions and translate them into clear data needs, evaluation criteria, or actionable next steps
* Strong analytical reasoning and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail
* Ability to ask strategic questions, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive pushback where appropriate
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, especially while working with U.S. business stakeholders
* Ability to collaborate effectively across time zones with U.S.\-based teams
* Strong documentation and organizational skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while working both independently and collaboratively


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have:**
* Exposure to external healthcare data vendors or platforms such as MMIT, DRG Fingertip, IQVIA, Komodo Health, Evaluate, Citeline, Spherix Global Insights, Dedham Group, NCCN, or similar sources
* Familiarity with payer intelligence, sales, claims, real\-world data, field intelligence, market access, competitive intelligence, or market intelligence datasets
* Basic understanding of data quality concepts, dataset profiling, data validation, or data comparison
* Familiarity with SQL or willingness to learn SQL for basic data extraction, validation, and investigation
* Exposure to visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, or similar platforms
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear summaries, recommendations, and “so what?” insights for stakeholders


**Mindset:**
* Consultative and structured in approach
* Curious about the healthcare and pharmaceutical data ecosystem
* Comfortable working across business, data, vendor, and stakeholder discussions
* Able to understand the “why” behind stakeholder requests
* Proactive in identifying risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement
* Open to learning new data sources, methodologies, tools, and business areas
* Comfortable working with evolving priorities in a U.S. stakeholder\-facing environment


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. * Increase Vendor Managed Inventory, Reduced Guide\-Time and Electronic Data Interface penetration.


 Supply Management:
   

  

* Manage regional supplier contract negotiations, which includes Memorandums of Comprehension, Non\-disclosure and regional pricing agreements.
* Develop and maintain supplier relationships.
* Measure and report Purchase Price Variance and initiate action plans.
* Monitor and manage supplier times.
* Mitigates shortages, excess on order and excess on hand.
* Participate on and help global and regional commodity teams.
* Contribute information/data on top spend suppliers for quarterly scorecards.


 Customer Supply Chain Management:
   

  

* Manages material cost reviews.
* Drive initiatives to improve gross material margin.
* Identify, implement and drive actions for Retained Purchase Price Variance (RPPV) optimization.
* Drive reconciliation process with customer (PPV, Premium charges, carrying costs, freight charges, excess and obsolete inventory, Non\-cancelable, Non\-Returnable (NCNR), etc.)

**Technology \& Operations \> Supply Chain \> Performance Management**
 The SIOP Performance Management team improves operational performance and execution excellence across the Service Supply Chain. Acting as a bridge between Planning, Commercial, Logistics, Procurement, and Service functions, the team ensures alignment on business priorities and enables effective end\-to\-end execution.
   

  

 The department oversees performance management, Sales \& Operations Execution (S\&OE), data governance, process improvement, automation, and business intelligence. By combining cross\-functional collaboration with data\-driven insights, the team supports revenue enablement, service availability, and continuous improvement across the global Service organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Improve supply chain performance through effective master data governance, process optimization, and automation initiatives
* Analyze master data structures and business rules to identify opportunities for improved planning accuracy, inventory optimization, and service performance
* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, and Operations stakeholders to ensure data supports business objectives
* Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for supply chain performance issues linked to data, processes, or system setup
* Define and implement scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve process efficiency
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by leveraging digital tools, automation, and data\-driven decision making
* Govern key master data domains and ensure data quality standards across global supply chain processes
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize supply chain processes across regions and functions


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field
* 5\+ years of experience within Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, Master Data, or Performance Management
* Good understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes and their interaction with planning, inventory, and service performance
* Experience working in a global business environment
* History of improving processes and business results through data\-driven insights
* Experience working with ERP systems, SAP S/4HANA


**Competencies**
* Deep knowledge of master data management and its effect on supply chain performance
* Experience working with SAP master data objects and supply chain\-relevant data structures, including Material, Location, Vendor, and Customer Master Data
* Advanced Excel skills and experience using digital tools for business analysis
* Understanding of inventory management, planning concepts, and supply chain optimization
* Experience with automation tools, reporting solutions, or process digitization initiatives
* Ability to connect business requirements with system and data solutions
* Strategic mindset with the ability to connect operational details to business outcomes
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in a simple manner
* Curious and improvement\-oriented approach
* Highly organized approach marked by initiative and follow\-through
* Comfortable questioning established processes and helping bring about change
* Able to navigate ambiguity and work across organizational boundaries

 Our company offers an engaging position with great opportunities to grow both professionally and personally in an inspiring workplace at a top producer of wind turbines worldwide. We highly value initiative, responsibility and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. title: Manager - Accounting & External Reporting
description:
**Job Description**
**Why This Role Matters**
 This role sits at the
 **heart of the company's financial governance framework** 
 . The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that business performance is
 **reported accurately** 
 , risks are
 **identified early** 
 , controls are
 **robust** 
 , and external reporting standards are upheld with the
 **highest level of discipline** 
 .
   

  

 The role requires a finance leader who can combine:
   

  

* Strong technical accounting depth
* Business understanding
* Governance mindset
* Stakeholder influence
* People leadership
* Ability to operate in a complex multinational environment


 This is
 **not a transactional accounting role** 
 . It is a
 **senior controllership role** 
 with high visibility, strong stakeholder engagement, and significant ownership of financial reporting quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Accounting, Controllership \& Financial Governance
* Own and drive the accounting and controllership agenda for the business.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial books and reported numbers.
* Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes with strong governance and discipline.
* Review and approve complex accounting entries, provisions, accruals, reconciliations, and judgment\-based accounting matters.
* Ensure early identification and resolution of accounting, reporting, or control risks through robust Balance Sheet reviews
* Drive a strong "no surprises" controllership culture across the finance ecosystem.
* Own External Reporting \& Statutory Financial Statements
* Lead preparation and review of statutory financial statements in line with applicable accounting standards.
* Ensure compliance with Ind AS / IFRS / USGAAP and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Own notes to accounts, disclosures, schedules, reporting packs, and management representation requirements.
* Partner with external auditors to ensure smooth statutory audits, limited reviews, and annual reporting cycles.
* Ensure high\-quality, audit\-ready documentation and strong substantiation of financial positions.
* Act as a Strategic Finance Partner \& Specialist on Accounting Matters
* Partner with business finance and functional teams on accounting implications of business decisions.
* Provide guidance on complex transactions, new business models, commercial arrangements, provisions, revenue recognition, cost accounting, and financial reporting treatment.
* Support leadership with clear interpretation of accounting impacts and financial risks.
* Help business teams understand the downstream reporting and compliance implications of operational decisions.
* Oversee Treasury related operations where required.
* Partner Internal Controls, Risk \& Audit Readiness
* Ensure strong adherence to internal control and SOX/control frameworks.
* Lead control reviews, risk assessments, remediation plans, and governance actions.
* Partner with internal audit, external audit, and control teams to resolve observations.
* Drive accountability across teams for timely closure of audit points and control gaps.
* Strengthen the overall control environment through proactive risk identification.
* Drive Process Excellence \& Finance Transformation
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and strengthen accounting and reporting processes.
* Lead improvement initiatives across close, reconciliations, reporting, audit documentation, and controls.
* Partner with shared services and technology teams to improve process reliability and scalability.
* Support ERP / SAP / S4HANA\-related transitions, reporting enhancements, and digital finance initiatives where applicable.
* Reduce manual dependency and improve quality, speed, and transparency of reporting outputs.
* Lead, Coach \& Build a High\-Performing Team
* Manage and develop a team of finance professionals.
* Set clear priorities, performance expectations, timelines, and ownership standards.
* Build technical capability in accounting, reporting, controls, and audit readiness.
* Coach team members to move from task execution to judgment\-led controllership.
* Create a culture of accountability, precision, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Partner effectively with shared services teams and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver high\-quality outcomes.


 Ideal Candidate Profile
   

  

**Education**
* Chartered Accountant is mandatory.


**Experience**
* Around 12–15 years of post\-qualification experience.
* Preference: FMCG / Consumer Goods / Manufacturing / Large listed or multinational organizations
* Strong experience in accounting, controllership, external reporting, audit, and financial governance.
* Experience in managing teams is important.
* Prior exposure to large multinational, listed, FMCG, manufacturing, or complex matrix organizations will be preferred.
* Candidates with a combination of accounting/external reporting and finance business partnering experience will be highly relevant.


**Technical Skills Required**
* Strong knowledge of Ind AS / IFRS.
* Deep understanding of financial close, statutory reporting, audit, and accounting governance.
* Strong exposure to balance sheet reviews, provisions, accruals, reconciliations, financial statements, and disclosures.
* Strong control mindset, preferably with SOX/internal controls exposure.
* Ability to interpret complex accounting matters and translate them into business\-friendly guidance.
* ERP exposure, especially SAP / S4HANA, will be an advantage.


**Leadership Capabilities**
 The successful candidate should demonstrate:
   

  

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* High\-quality judgement on accounting and reporting matters.
* Strong people leadership and team development capability.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Sharp attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger business context.
* Ability to simplify complex financial topics for business stakeholders.

title: Research Analyst
description:
**About 79th East** 




 79th East Private Limited is a Hyderabad\-based investment services firm – an AMFI\-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN\-364145\) and a distributor of Portfolio Management Services. Our work is research\-led: we build our own view on funds and stocks rather than passing on someone else's.
 



**The role** 




 You will build and maintain the firm's internal view of markets, funds and stocks. This research is for our own use – it shapes what we recommend and how we guide clients. It is hands\-on analytical work from day one, not a support role.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Mutual fund due diligence – category comparisons, factsheet and portfolio analysis, performance and risk attribution, and maintaining the recommended\-fund list.
* Single\-stock analysis – screening, financial analysis and sector work, to our house factsheet format.
* Support the equity basket products: construction, periodic review and reconciliation.
* Client portfolio analysis – overlap and look\-through studies, rebalancing notes and investment\-committee notes.
* Draft investor\-facing material – the monthly market letter, blog articles and webinar content – in plain, accurate language.
* Keep the research process documented and repeatable, with every figure traceable to its source.



**What you must bring** 



* Valid NISM Series XV (Research Analyst) certificate – mandatory.
* 2–3 years in equity or mutual fund research, or a research\-facing role at a broking house, AMC, wealth firm or research provider.
* Strong Excel and financial analysis; comfortable building and auditing a model.
* Ability to write clearly for a non\-specialist reader.
* Graduate in commerce, finance or economics.
* Hyderabad local candidates only – the role is on\-site at Ameerpet.



**Added advantage** 



* NISM Series V\-A, VIII or XXI\-A.
* CFA (any level), FRM or MBA (Finance).
* Screener, Capitaline, Ace Equity, Bloomberg or similar research tools.
* Working knowledge of AI tools such as Claude.
* Proficiency in Telugu and/or Hindi.



**Location and salary** 



* Location: Ameerpet, Hyderabad – full\-time, on\-site.
* Salary: up to Rs 5,00,000 per year (CTC), based on experience.

 Email your CV to info@79the.com with the subject "Research Analyst – Hyderabad", mentioning the validity date of your NISM Series XV certificate. If you can share one research note or model you have written, please attach it.
